It is the matriarch, Victoria Talbridge who is a master manipulator with her fingers in every plot in both countries.  Like a mafia queen she fights to make her family supreme and beside her, J.R. Ewing and Tony Soprano are babes in arms.  I plan to read this again, soon.  It is great.  A real page turner.
top_5.summary: Five Stars for a rising star in Alternate History.

top_5.description: The Number One international bestselling author of Jurassic Park, Congo and Sphere takes on global warming in this gripping and critically acclaimed thriller. In Paris, a physicist dies after performing a laboratory experiment for a beautiful visitor. In the jungles of Malaysia, a mysterious buyer purchases deadly cavitation technology, built to his specifications. In Vancouver, a small research submarine is leased for use in the waters of New Guinea. And in Tokyo, an intelligence agent tries to understand what it all means. Thus begins Michael Crichton's exciting and provocative techno-thriller State of Fear. Only Crichton's unique ability to blend scientific fact with pulse-pounding fiction could bring such disparate elements to a heart-stopping conclusion. This is Crichton's most wide-ranging thriller. State of Fear takes the reader from the glaciers of Iceland to the volcanoes of Antarctica, from the Arizona desert to the deadly jungles of the Solomon Islands, from the streets of Paris to the beaches of Los Angeles. The novel races forward on a roller-coaster thrill ride, all the while keeping the brain in high gear. Gripping and thought-provoking, State of Fear is Michael Crichton at his best.
top_5.reviewText: What I like about Michael Crichton is that when he gets down to dealing with a controversial subject he makes it a point to research, footnote to share his research, and give a bibliography so that the reader may study on his own and make up his mind.  That is what set Rising Sun and Disclosure apart from so many other books on the market.  In State of Fear, Crichton has given us both a page turning thriller and an education.  He exposes the radical environmental extremists, the self serving scam artists out to make a buck, the laughable but also frightening media types who want to be seen as leaders of the liberal establishment, and bumbling bureaucrats who have put the world into a real "state of fear" over global warming and the end of the world.  This doesn't mean that Crichton makes light of the idealists who feel they have something to be concerned about without being the tree huggers parodied by conservatives.  The book does point up a need  for real science not the fake fuzzy logic we see in the newspapers most every day and watch  on televison most every night.  For those who might dismiss the facts in this book the reader would do well to research the materials, and charts, and graphs that are providied.  In any other book this might sound like a bore, however the author knows how to craft a rip roaring adventure story that is gripping and to use a cliche, hard to put down.  While the author's books have all made excellent motion pictures, this one may have a problem in Hollywood.  The elite liberal establishment may not want to make this a film, as it deserves, not unless they decide to water it down and kill the real essence of what the author is saying.  I for one will do all I can to urge this being made a film and will do all I can in my own humble way to protest if Hollywood doesn't get it right.  Thank you Michael Crichton for not being afraid to research the truth and then to spread the word.
top_5.summary: Only the media brain washed would not like this book.

top_5.description: With all of her possessions packed in a moving van, Helen starts on her journey to put the pieces of her life back together. Through the assistance of her friends, family, faith, and a twist of fate, Helen finds the strength and empowerment she needs to get control of her circumstances. She also finds that the tragic events of her life soon become comic, especially with the guidance and help-- mostly unsolicited, by the way--of her pot-smoking, gun-toting, and much beloved, grandmother figure Madea.
top_5.reviewText: My wife and I almost over looked this film as the title and cover picture made us think it was one of those exploitive movies.  We are glad we did finally buy it and loved it so much we bought the DVDs available of Tyler Perrys stage plays. This man is a genius as a writer, an actor, a director, and a producer.  It is refreshing that such a strong Christian can get his message across the way he has been doing for about a decade now.  The film is the most spiritual commecially made film we have ever seen outside of some of those made by groups like the Billy Graham Association.  The acting and music is superb.  There is a definite message that is mixed with drama and comedy. You will love Madea.  We have recommended this in our church and every place where someone will listen to us.
top_5.summary: This film will deservedly be considered as a classic.

input: Generate the review text written by a reviewer who has a given an overall rating of "4.0" for a product with description "The BLACK+DECKER BC2WBD 2 amp battery charger and maintainer lets you charge your batteries anywhere, whether outside in the elements or out on your boat, without having to worry about an accident. Charges 12 volt AGM, GEL and WET batteries in RVs, specialty vehicles, antique and classic cars, marine deep cycle batteries, motorcycles, lawn mowers, ATVs, snowmobiles, and personal watercrafts. Connect the battery charger and maintainer with the included 12V DC accessory plug, battery clips, or battery ring terminals. Charging automatically stops when battery is fully charged or topped off and switches to float mode monitoring to maintain charge. Built-in circuit protection guards against overcharging, reverse polarity, or short circuit and is ETL certified for performance and safety. Features an IPX7-rated waterproof housing, making this the ideal charger even in the most challenging environments; completely sealed and capable of withstanding direct water or rain exposure. The BLACK+DECKER BC2WBD 2 amp battery charger and maintainer also features a hanging hook and magnetic backing, allowing you to position the unit for convenient, hands-free operation; includes a limited 1 year manufacturer warranty.". The summary of the review text is "Simple to use and interpret, super convenient magnetic base for attaching and being water proof is a great plus.".
output:
The Good:
  - The unit charges as advertised.
  - Water proof is nice as I can hang it my motorcycle outside without worry.
  - Super convenient strong magnet base to slap on the side of a metal surface and also built in loop to hook it on something.
  - Simplicity of operation, attach to battery then plug into AC.
  -  Simple easily understood status lights.
  -  Cables provided with alligator clips, cigarette lighter and for a permanent attachment to battery terminals.  The later great for motorcycle battery tender use.
The Bad:
  - The instruction are silent on the "maintainer" capability.  I assume this means a batter tender that will sense the charge and then reduce the charge current in order not to overcharge and reduce the life of the battery.  The Amazon page has a bit more information on this so I must believe it is acting like a "tender" but again the document mentions zero on this.  1 star is held back for this important feature that is not described in the documentation.
The Observations:
-  This unit is commonly called a trickle charger so it  does not have the power to  turn over a engine on its own.  It must over several hours provide a low current to a battery which will then store the charge and provide a greater amperage then the charger itself to turn over an engine.

Conclusion:
Simple to use and interpret, super convenient magnetic base for attaching and being water proof is a great plus.

profile.description: AmazonBasics brings you everyday items at a great value. An Amazon Brand.
profile.reviewText:
The Good:
  * About the same size as a standard pillow.
  *  Large enough to wrap around your head.
  *  When opening the valve, it will self inflate to about 2-3" thickness.
  *  You can blow in air to inflate additionally.  The picture for the product is as it would appear after you have blown some air in.  The self inflation would be much thinner.
  *  Comfort is good.  Probably the self inflation size is a bit on the low side but again you can add air to your preference.
. *  The covering is very cloth like and comfortable.  I would probably add a pillow cover just for the familiarity.
  *  Deflating is easy, unscrew the valve and roll up.  Easy to roll up into the size to easily fit back into its soft case.
  *  Lighter than a standard pillow
  *  Comes with a locking pull string case and elastic bands to hold the roll shape.
The marginal:
  *  The elastic roll bands are not attached to the pillow and easily lost.
  *  It doesnt roll up very small, about 5" x 12", and not that much smaller than a standard foam pillow can role up or 7x15.
  *  Cost is unknown as of this review in order to guage the value.

Conclusion:
Comfortable, easily deployed and stored, a bit on the large size when rolled but more convenient to carry and lighter than a standard pillow rolled up.
profile.summary: Comfortable and easily rolled into compact tube shape.

profile.description: We don't know when or if this item will be back in stock.
profile.reviewText:
This is a Suzuki factory  OEM part.
Easy to install:
Comes with all the hardware you need, except for some grease.  Easy to bolt on into existing threaded holes of the bike.  The hard part is the installation of the two springs used to hold it up the stand.  After several failed attempts to pry the springs on, I searched the web and found videos describing the use of small dia rope or strong string to pull the springs into place.  It worked the first try (but Im without a couple shoe strings:))
Rides well:  When I ride (and I ride on some rough roads) I do not hear the stand bouncing as its held firmly in place by the springs and a rubber foot that was provided as part of the install prevents any metal on metal contact.
Easy to use:  Forward and down pressure with your left foot on the stand while simultaneously pulling up and back on the bike will easily get the rear wheel off the ground.
profile.summary: Easy to install (when you know the trick for installing springs) and works great.

profile.description: Full Grain Leather and Mesh Upper. Padded collar . Full length cushion sock lining. Shaft height 7 "; Heel height 1.25". Oil-resistant rubber outsole. Cement Construction.
profile.reviewText:
I took these on a 350 mile ride before evaluating them here.  Im not sure why these are called a motorcycle boots other then for marketing purposes.  It has no toe pad or reinforcement for the gear shift lever nor has protected padding along the outside or front.  In fact the vulnerable outside sides are a mesh like material and not leather, while the inside is leather......seems that's backwards for protection.  No zipper which I knew going in, but after lacing these on and off I can see that a good feature to reduce the time and hassle.  During the ride it was cool in the morning with the wind chill (air temp maybe low 70's) and my toes got very cold to the point I was looking for a place to stop and buy plastic bags to cover my feet.  The toe box materials in no leather nor does it appear to be air permeable but none-the-less one would not be able to use these in cold or even cool weather without additional foot insulation.  As the day heated up into the 80s, the boots became comfortable so for hot riding they would be fine.
On the plus side, they are very comfortable and lite out of the box and required no break in.  The sole pattern is very aggressive so should grab well on dirt/gravel roads.  I bought a size 12 EE and they fit great.
profile.summary: Not Specifically for Motorcycle

profile.description: Features Titanium Bonded blades that are 3x harder than untreated steel and will stay sharper longer. Handle material is 70% recycled content and rubber is 100% recycled content. Packaging is post consumer content. Wavy blades for pristine cuts. Blade Tension Control. Corrosion and adhesive resistant. Lifetime Warranty. Green/Black handles. Powered by Clauss.
profile.reviewText: I used it extensively this weekend filling several garbage cans with the trimmings.  I trimmed bougainvillea branches up to 3/4" thick.  So given that this trimmer style is meant more as a hedge trimmer for smaller diameter stems, I would say it was very impressive that I could cut through such large branches.  It held up and I didn't feel it dull as the day progressed.  It has a wavy cutting edge  which may make it harder to sharpen but that is only an observation as it never dulled to the point I thought I needed to freshen the cutting edge.  I don't understand the value of the tension adjust (green knurled knob at pivot) as  I would think one would always want the pivot to be as friction free as possible. None-the-less it was an excellent trimmer and I thought a great value.
profile.summary: Cut through larger branches than its intended for

profile.description: The sleek design features a sliding USB connector, which smoothly extends from the drive at the push of a thumb. The capless mechanical design eliminates the hassle of lost drive caps. The USB connector can be made ready for use with just one hand, for greater convenience when speed is a must.
profile.reviewText:
It works fine transferring large movie files from my laptop to the ADATA as USB2 but will not work as USB3.  Other mfr flash work find as usb3 on my laptop.  The storage size allows about 6+ full length HD movies to be stored.  the flash drive was recognized by all the devices I used and transferred data from the laptop and to the Sony Bluray player where I played the movies directly from the flash drive.
The connector retractor is nice as it protects the USB connector from damage when carrying in your pocket in computer case and eliminates the eventual loss of a unattached  protective cap.
The device would have been more perfect if it had  loop to attached to a key chain but the photo is clearly shows there is not one and I made the purchase knowing that.
My laptop supposedly has USB 3 and I would get messages when attached it that I should move it to another USB to get the full speed.  So Im not sure if it was operating at the max speed and if this was a computer, driver or other problem.  I can say it played HD 1080P 60Hz movies perfectly..
profile.summary: Wont do USB3, otherwise Works Great, Connector is Protected and Played HD 1080P Movies Perfectly

profile.description: Full Guarantee + ships very fast - ONLY ShubanditcompanyLLC has the new stronger Skinz with a stronger heel strap and new non slip walking bottom sleeve protectors Shubandit Inc. is the leader for taking care of all gear shifter scuff marks. With a proven track record - word of mouth is great from all fellow motorcyclist - Shubandit Co. has the newest latest strongest style now just out - thanks and ride safe fellow riders.
profile.reviewText:
Update after 10 months of weekend use.  The protective tubing and the underling elastic  straps wore out completely to the point the tube disappeared and the elastic bands under the sole separated completely.  See the attached picture.  Even for its advertised use of a scuff protector unless you basically don't walk on it its not rugged enough to last.  A  shifter pad it doesnt have much padding but it does prevent scuffing on your nice shoes if you ride your motorcycle to work.

  I got this for more has a pad between my foot and the shifter than a scuff protector.
After a few hundred miles of use Ive noticed that the tubes used to protect the elastic bands under your foot are slipper when you put your foot down on asphalt, especially if it hot or your on a oil spot.  Once I had to catch myself from laying the bike down when I my foot slipped on the from the tubes.  So I hold back 1 star due to this.  Also the protective tubes on the bottom wear away after about 5,000 miles of travel and eventually fall off and the bands holding it in place seperate apart.
profile.summary: Elastic bands quickly wear out and plastic tubes cause you to lose foot traction

profile.description: Whether you're basking in the sun, gathering around the campfire, listening to your favorite band at an outdoor concert, or sitting around the pool chatting with friends, the Rendezvous provides the comfort and strength you want in a chair. The Rendezvous sits low to the ground and allows you to lean back at a perfect angle to relax and stretch out your legs. It collapses and fits into the included carry bag so transporting and storing the chair is convenient and easy.
profile.reviewText:
Its small and compact and ruggedly built.  Im 6'1", 250 and held my weight without concern. I pack it on my motorcycle and it easily straps to the side or is short enough to strap across the back. Comfortable enough for a low chair, I found it very adequate for my use.
 At 7lbs Im not sure it would be so backpack friendly but as I carry it on a motorcycle my requirements were more for compactness.
One caution, the foam arm cushions are made of something ants love.  After 2 hours of putting the chair down to camp, the arms were covered with ants to the point you could not see the cushions.  After knocking the ants off, the once smooth cushion was no pot marked with holes where the ants had removed material.
After using it the first time I found I desperately would have liked a head rest.  Not a knock against the chair, only my choice.
profile.summary: Small,compact and ruggedly built...but beware ants love to eat the cushions.

profile.description: Speed up breakfast with the BLACK+DECKER Rapid Toast 2-Slice Toaster. Built to toast 50% faster than previous BLACK+DECKER models, this toaster delivers efficient performance with a variety of shade options. The extra-wide slots make it easy to fit any type of bread, and the extended lift ensures you retrieve toasted items safely. Bagel and frozen functions let you customize the toaster for special tasks, delivering perfectly toasted results every time. Start your day out right with the trusted name in home appliances, BLACK+DECKER.
profile.reviewText: A big disappointment.  We have complained for years how long it takes a toaster to work.  We saw the word "rapid" for this Black and Decker and didn't hesitate to purchase to replace our decade old toaster.  Well.....the Black and Decker is only marginally faster than a 10 year old toaster and it still takes 2 cycles to get the bread toasted when set to the maximum setting or level 6.  At the first pop up the bread is barely toasted and it takes a 2nd cycle to get what anyone would expect for toasted bread.  Its a simple attractive looking toaster and the action is nice with a button that will pop up the bread.  But come on!  How hard is it to make a simple toaster that works like toasters of old where it will actually toast bread in one cycle?  Keep the bagels and the defrost settings and  the fancy blinking lights and just pop up the bread when its properly toasted!  How hard can it be!!
profile.summary: A Big Disappointment.  Only marginally faster then a decades old toaster.

profile.description: By simply self-molding a Sharkfin to each earbud, you will discover a long-term comfortable tight sealed fit that prevents irritation so you can feel the music and not your earphones. Sharkfin mutes outside noise allowing you to enjoy your music at lower and safer volumes. Once in, your buds will always stay in place during workouts, they won't shift or fall out of your ears. Sharkfin is specially formulated to be sweat, water and UV resistant. It quickly molds in 5 minutes and will ensure a heightened listening experience to the music you love.
profile.reviewText: The product did not hold the ear bud I was trying to use encase in the self-molding material.  I followed the directions and made 3 equal volumes (I guess 3 in case you make a mistake) of the 2 different materials.........rolled 2 sections together to mix evenly and made a log.  The log was wrapped around the ear bud and the entire assembly was inserted in the ear, ear bud in place and the material was pushed in all around the ear bud into the ear.  Let set for 5 minutes.  Upon removal the ear bud immediately broke out of the material.  As an ear plug, with the provided plugs it might work fine but its advertised to also work with ear buds which it could not accomplish so for my application and the advertised capability it gets 1 star.
profile.summary: Would not hold earbuds

profile.description: Designed for the on and off road enthusiast the GIVI engine guards give a more rugged and aggressive look as well as offering better overall protection for those unforseen mishaps. Made from one inch tubing and available in matte black the GIVI engine guards are a great addition for the serious motorcycle enthusiast.
profile.reviewText:
From experience I can say the guards have protected the bike when I dropped it.  The bars are well positioned to keep the bike sides from being damaged from simple dropping at a stop for whatever reason (foot slips in gravel, pant leg caught up in foot peg) to low speed crashes.  The bars will rust however.  The bars and bolts are not stainless but anodized.  From the incidents mentioned above, scratches on the bars have begun to rust but this is better then damage to the bike.

The installation instructions are a joke!.  Dont bother with them.  Find a U-tube video for insight on how to install them.  The guards come with all the hardware that you need to install (almost).  The guards come with 9 metric hex bolts all the same length.  They replace the short bolts used to hold the engine in place so its important to tighten these well and also use a thread locker like locktite (which the factory bolts have on them but instructions don't mention of course).  The bars join together using an inner reinforcing tube under the bike in front of the engine and O-rings slip on the tube to help prevent vibration noise.  This is where the "almost all the hardware" was supplied........the 9th bolt provided is the same length as all the others however, it is not long enough to reach between the brackets joining the bars together.....its impossible.  I had to go to the hardware store to buy a longer metric bolt to fit but finally job done.

Conclusion:  The guards are an inexpensive way to protect the bike from much costlier damage then a few scratches on the bars.  Once you work through the installation issues, they are a good value and do the job.
profile.summary: Have installation issues, but once working through those they are a good value and do the job.

profile.description: 14.4V, lithium ion, cyclonic action cordless DUSTBUSTER, rotating, slim nozzle Targets dirt in tight spaces, 50percent more reach, less bending & better accessibility, brush & crevice tool accessories are located on-board, no loose items, wide mouth design to scoop up large debris, cyclonic action spins dust & debris away from the filter so suction power stays strong, translucent, bag less dirt bowl makes it easy to see dirt & empty, removable, washable dirt bowl & filters allow for a thorough, hygienic cleaning, 3 stage filtration means less clogging & cleaner air exhaust, 3 versatile ways to store: Horizontally, Vertically, or mount on a wall, charging indicator light allows you to always know you have a good connection, lightweight & portable for quick clean ups, energy star approved charging system saves energy & helps protect batteries
profile.reviewText:
THE GOOD:
  - Well balanced in hand and light weight.
  - The nozzle extension (they call it crevice tool) is convenient. Its integrated in the the nozzle and is extended from inside.
  -  With the nozzle extended, its much more convenient and easy on the back when standing and reaching areas on the floor.
  -  Its easy to access the dust bowl to dump and the filter to clean.
  -  I ran it for a good 5 minutes and did not seem to reduce suction.
THE MEDIOCRE:
  - The suction is adequate but not great.  For reference, it would readily intake a nickle coin, and with a little more work a quarter coin.
  -  Comes with a wall mountable bracket to hang the unit and a wall wart charger but you still have to plug the cable in to charge it.
  -  The charging electrical connection is not integrated into the bracket
THE BAD:
  -  Its loud.  Almost uncomfortably loud.  I have a full size vacuum that is significantly quieter.
  -  For some reason, it had a hard time sucking up sand.
  -  The brush is almost useless.  It only works in 1 direction.  On an upswing there is nothing to lock it in place and it slides off.
  -  Its pricey at $60.

THE CONCLUSION:
Its an adequate machine for small jobs  of loose light material.  Denser material with small surface area, like sand, it had trouble with.  The loudness of the noise it makes is uncomfortable.  For the price it seems expensive for the performance.  Considering everything, I've given it an average rating of 3 stars.
profile.summary: Comfortable Balance/ Light weight but Mediocre Suction, Very Loud and  Expensive for the Performance

profile.description: Motorcycle and scooter security for moderate crime areas dual reinforced high security disc style cylinder. 5mm pin diameter fits smaller vent holes. Compact lightweight and weatherproof. Includes pouch for easier transport. Stapler style disc lock immobilizes vehicle to prevent roll-away or ride-away theft.
profile.reviewText: This is heavy steel and the fact that its painted high vizyellow is probably the best deterrent of all.  The lock cylinder with key moves in and out with the pin so that makes it easy to put some pressure on it while you search for the hole in your brake disk.  Then you just push the lock cylinder in and turn and remove the key.  Its small enough to fit inside a small pouch I have on my handle bars.  It comes with a coiled wire, also hi viz, with closed loops on each end so one end locks in the Disc lock and the other end you can slip over your grip so you don't inadvertently try to drive off without removing the lock.
profile.summary: Easy attachment and very visible

profile.description: .011-.052 Custom Light Gauge Acoustic Guitar Strings, Phosphor Bronze
profile.reviewText:
I installed these on a dreadnought style or large body Yamaha acoustic.  I wasn't sure about the size so I choose the medium size.
The GOOD:
  * The strings were not individually wrapped but were easily separated and a color coded button helped ID the string location (E-E) to make sure you select the correct string.
  * The tuning end of the string has about 4" section of unwrapped core that makes it easier to insert into the hole of the tuning axle.
  *  Once tuned, the sound was crisp and rich.  I think the mediums were the right size for this large body guitar.
  *  There was no additional neck deflection or additional neck adjustment due to tension of the strings.
  *  After first turning and a small bit of stretching each string and another re-tune the strings maintained tune very well.
  *  Very good competitive price.
The BAD:
  *  Not a thing.

Conclusion:
Provided crisp rich sound on a large body guitar at a great price.
profile.summary: Provided crisp rich sound on a large body guitar at a great price.

profile.description: alaxy S7 Case, Aduro Shell & Holster COMBO Case Super Slim Shell Case w/Built-In Kickstand + Swivel Belt Clip Holster for Samsung Galaxy S7
profile.reviewText:
The Bad:
- The phone is very hard to remove from the holster.
- Eventually the tabs on either side of the holster that hold the case+phone into the holster side broke off because of the tight fit.
- Both tabs, right and left,  broke off at about the same time.
- Without the tabs the holster is useless to use and the phone will not be retain in the holster.
- The seller. Emtronic warranty clain is BS.  They  did not stand behind the product, instead referring me to the mfr, Aduro for a warranty issue.
-  The manufacture, Aduro,  after several attempts has not returned any of my requests for warranty consideration.

The Good
- Otherwise when the tabs are in place,  the case+ holster  protects the phone if  dropped and gives easy access albeit with some difficulty to extract when clipped on the belt to take a quick  snapshot or other use.
- The phone case (w/o holster) also provides protection if dropped on an edge and perhaps more importantly provides a good secure grip.  About 1000x more grip then with the phone itself or without the case.
- Amazon backed up the sale.  While the seller or the mfr would not replace the case, Amazon stepped in and made it right with a refund and free shipping on a replacement.

Conclusion:
A defective product but luckily Amazon was there to back up the sale and provide a refund.  I always recommend to use Amazon when buying as they are very fair on resolving issues.
profile.summary: Fits to tight in holster and holster broke.  Seller would not replace.  Amazon stepped in to make it right with a refund!

profile.description: The RAP-B-201U-A, short double socket arm, has a socket at both ends that accommodates 1" ball bases. This socket technology allows for almost infinite adjustment and perfect viewing angles. Dimensions: Overall Length: 2.38" Socket-To-Socket, Length: 2".
profile.reviewText:
Very secure mounting and easy to adjust.  Once mounted and if not tighted too much there is enough RAM ball friction to move the GPS and still have it securely mounted even when exposed to freeway wind speeds.  The short arm is perfect for locating the GPS I mount at a perfect height when located on the motorcycle handle bar (on a mirror extender with RAM ball).  The one annoyance I have is that to remove it, both RAM balls need to come loose and you just have to be careful to hold onto it and tighten it back onto the side you want to keep it with (mount side or GPS side).
AFter 3 months of use the mount revealed some major design flaws:
1)  the tightening knob will come off the bolt and the assembly halfs and pieces will fall apart.  This happens often.
2)  when the above happens and you happen not to recover the washers that fell off, you cannot tighten again unless you found and reinstalled the washers that sit between the knob and the body.  The washers are required to tighten.
A simple fix would have been to keep the knob from unscrewing all the way.
profile.summary: Very secure mount and nice short height but major flaws

profile.description: You don't need an emergency to enjoy delicious Mountain House meals. This two week food supply includes 42 total just-add-water meals that can be eaten directly out of the pouch! Enjoy comforting meals like Biscuits and Gravy, Beef Stroganoff, Pasta Primavera and more. This kit is lightweight and compact, making it easy to store. Take Mountain House with you on your camping trips, hunting excursions, or tuck it away Just In Case...you find yourself in an emergency situation. With a 30 Year Taste Guarantee, have peace of mind knowing Mountain House has you covered from your outdoor adventures to those nights when the power is out.
profile.reviewText:
Taste:
Ive tried a few of the packages provided with the Mountain House 3 Day Emergency Food Supply and they were good to very good.  The freeze dried contents are surprisingly tasty.  On a camping trip or if indeed for an emergency they would be downright delicious.  One of my favorites was Beef Stroganoff.  Generous amount of noodles soaked with flavor small bites of beef was very tasty.  The sauce was thick and clung to the noodles.  Not what you would expect from processed food.  The Pasta Primavera was also very good while the Scrambled Eggs with Bacon did lose of the texture your used to but it still tasted fine and with a great bacon flavor.  Another good one is the Chicken and Rice.  Its really rice in chicken broth with no chunks of chicken but still it was very good.  With 3 servings in a single pouch it was really too much in one sitting.

Convenience:
Generally all you need to do tear the top off the pouch, removed the desiccant, add boiling water in the correct quantity for the dinner, stir, reseal the bag and let sit for 10 minutes and its ready.  The packages are nicely designed with a wide bottom so that they will stand up on their own when heavy with water and you can eat directly out of the pouch. A nice practical touch.  The kit is provided in 4 tightly packed boxes of different sizes reflecting amount of packages in 2, 3, and 5 day supplies.  The boxes efficient fit and store on a shelf.  Surprisingly there is a 25 year shelf life on these.  Long enough to consider passing on down to your children when they are grown:)

Variety:
Provided in 4 boxes of 3, 4 and 5 day meals for one person.  A variety of meals are provided for breakfast, lunch and dinner.  For example the 3 day box contains 6 different meal pouches.

The amount of food:
Each pouch contains at least 1.5 servings and in some cases 3 servings as is the case for Rice and Chicken.  I mention this because there is plenty of food in a pouch.  Im a big person with a big appetite and I was satisfied after trying each of the few meals I did.
All together the entire emergency pack provides 100 servings.  So over a 14 day period this is an average 7.1 servings/day or just under 2 servings per meal.  There is a lot of food here!

The cost
Currently shown on Amazon at a cost of $250 for the 14 day emergency pack this equates to $2.50 per servings.  A very reasonable cost.  When purchasing separately, a Beef Stroganoff 2.5 serving pouch is $6.99 or $2.79 per serving.  Thats about a 10% savings over buying individually so there is some cost benefit to buying the emergency variety package.

Nutrition
Each pouch is different  nutrition and what caught my eye was the sodium.  The Rice and Chicken as an example contains 33% of your recommend daily sodium intake and the entire pouch would be 100%.  Not a problem in an emergency or the occasional camp trip but for those  with high blood pressure not recommend as a steady diet.

Conclusion:
This is very good food.  Some pouches taste better than others but all are good tasting and fulfilling and will taste that much better when you really need it.  Conveniently boxed and easily stored in your pantry with a 25 year shelf life.  It seems a very reasonable cost to have this emergency kit on hand or simply to buy more economically for frequent campers then individual pouches.
profile.summary: Very Good Flavor and Filling

profile.description: This 24-hour switch timer is both practical and durable, with an easy-to-use interface and timing pins that stay put, so you never have to worry about losing them. The 125-volt-rated switch installs easily into a single-gang or multi-gang electrical box, replacing your existing light switch. No more falling asleep with the lights on accidentally anymore! Once youve tried this switch timer, you may wonder how you ever got by without it.
profile.reviewText:
The timer is simple to set up.  That's why we purchased this Woods timer and it easily met our expectations in that regard.  It's also easy to install into an existing electrical wall box if you are remotely handy around the house.  AFter 18 month of operation it failed, got stuck on a time and would not pass that spot.
most disappointingly, the Woods timer does not come with a cover and as far as we can find searching online or at a number of hardware stores,  there is not an existing cover made that will fit over the body of the timer. profile.description: Columbia performance stretch camouflage printed boxer brief is durable for sports and outdoor activities. No bunching or tightness around thighs but supportive. Performance Columbia logo waistband. Compass blue signature bartack. Omni-wick advanced evaporation pulls moisture away from the body and enables perspiration to evaporate quickly. Flat anti-chafing stitches. Tag free. Antimicrobial treatment on fabric. 2 pack combo
profile.reviewText:
While the Columbia garment is called a boxer brief, these shorts are the same family as popular Under Armour athletic garments or athletic compression shorts.

The Good:
  *  The light silky smooth material slides over the skin and feels well....invisible.
  * One reason I went to the compression shorts for walking/jogging was for the elimination of thigh chaffing that often occurred with cotton shorts..
  * The Columbias address this with their self described  flat inner thigh seam that helps prevent chaffing.
  *  Its a large seam and I was skeptical of at first but after wearing them I agree they do a better job of chaffing protection then even the Under Amours I normally wear.
  *  The elastic waist band is wide allowing the short to securely stay in place during exercise.
  *  As far as cost goes, a quick survey on Amazon suggests the Columbia's are a good value as they are about 25% less then an equivalent Under Amour brief.

The Bad:
  *  While these would be wonderful for daily underwear,  you really have to want to use them as they are 12x the cost of Fruit of the Loom cotton briefs or "tighty whities".
  * You have to take a little more trouble cleaning, probably separating from other wash, as they  should only be washed on gentle and  cold water with the lowest drying setting (I prefer to hang dry)..

Conclusion:
I'm a big fan of compression shorts and Columbia's line does not disappoint.  They are smooth and light, eliminate chaffing at a more than competitive price compared to other performance underwear.
profile.summary: Silky Smooth Compression Short and a Great Value

profile.description: Heavy-duty PVC-coated nylon boot covers designed to easily slip on or off over boots. Feature abrasion-resistant 500-denier nylon reinforced toe and heel sections. Elasticized top cuff helps seal out moisture. Reflective Tour Master logos increase visibility.
profile.reviewText: I've not used these in the rain, but I have tried them on over my motorcycle riding boots.  I wear size 12 boots and it was a struggle to get these over them.  The construction and the material used  would probably keep your feet dry as long as you have water proof pants over the top of them so water doesn't seep down the top and don't step in puddles. These covers wrap around the bottom of your foot with elastic straps across the bottom.  If you do any walking at all, I would guess the strap and the elastic edge would wear out quickly and they certainly are not going to keep water out if your standing in an inch or more of it.
profile.summary: Dissapointed they have no sole

The lever drops from the weight of the bird and allows it to access the large hole to drink the nectar.  This design is to keep the wasps out as they will flock to it, dive in and die, ruining the nectar. profile.description: TeraFlex Quick Disconnects are the leader in the industry. This design combines silent function with ease of use. The upper sway bar link end has an OEM quality narrow shoulder ball socket for no maintenance long term durability and silent function. The lower sway bar link end has a large polyurethane ball and pin for easy sway bar link removal. When connected for street use the link provides immediate reaction during sway bar loading to eliminate excess play. This results in improved lateral control and steering response compared to the stock rubber sway bar link bushings. When off-roading the sway bar links quickly disconnect and swing up out of the way for unrestricted axle articulation.
profile.reviewText:
This instructions are poor, even bad and misleading.  Minimal directions but if you jump into the install you'll figure it out.  The mfr installation video found online was not much help either.
Biggest install issue:
*  The body frame interferes with the disconnected swaybar up swing to reach the swaybar to the holding pins.
The biggest issue I had for a brand new stock 2017 JKU Sahara was that the sway bar would not swing up to the holding pin becuase a tubular frame support extruded out the frame and interfered with it.  (See Picture).  I called Teraflex and they said they were aware of the issue and the solution was to grind away the tube extension until the swaybar had clearance to swing past it.  They said all jeeps were not made the same and they did not plan on modifying the kit but were planning on rewriting the instructions to mention this potential issue.  The car  dealer Jeep performance parts dude said they install these all the time with no problem.  Yea no problem is you consider grinding on the frame not a problem.

Some installation tips...
*  Check the swing clearance of the swaybar.  As all Jeeps are slightly different (per TeraFlex)  so you may need to get an angle grinder with a metal grinding disk and a face shield (Harbor Freight) if you don't have one.  When under the Jeep your face is right in it so you'll want a face shield.
*  There is good access to the suspension when the Jeep is on the ground so you don't need to raise it to install the kit.
*  It helps a lot if you turn the tires all the way left on one tire and then right on the other to get even more clearance.
* You'll need 18mm socket with deep throat, 3/4" socket, ratchet and extensions, wrenches, a large flat blade screwdriver or prybar, a torque wrench with at least 18" handle (75 fl/lbs of torque is a lot so you need the leverage), some thread locker glue and possibly a angle grinder with metal disk (discussed earlier).
*  Dont forget the grease nipples.  The grease nipples should be installed first or before the link is installed and also lubricated with a grease gun.  This is not mentioned anywhere in the instructions.
*  Unlike the instructions both stock links should be removed before installing the replacements as it makes it easier.
*  The 2 body mount bolts needs a 18mm long socket as the bolt extends well past the nut to be removed and a short socket will not reach it nor will a wrench because it surrounded by a cup.
*  Some of the nuts provided are 3/4" so you need a socket or wrench of that size also.
*  The 75 ft/lb required on the body mount nuts is a lot.  You'll need a torque wrench with a long handle and some socket extensions to be able to get to a point you have the clearance and leverage to pull hard enough.
*  The brackets that pin the links  when you disconnect have to be held in place when you tighten the nuts as it swings out of place when tightening.  Use a lever (long flat blade screwdriver) to leverage it when tightening.
*  Be aware of the orientation of the pins holes before tightening so you have the pins located for most convenient access when under the jeep.
* Additionally the linkage is not adjustable in length.  While specified for a 0-2" lift, for a 0 lift jeep, the sway bar sits at about 30 degrees angle off horizontal.  The Jeep spec is that the sway bar should be +/- 5 degrees off horizonal.  That is why other manufactures of disconnects allow the linkage to be adjustable.

Performance
* On driver performance with the swaybar attached, I could feel no difference in body roll between the stock and the Teraflex.  With the swaybar detached a marked improvement in cab tilt when taking offroad.  When driving on paved with swaybar disconnected the Jeep drove like a old Buick swaying in the turns.  You have be very careful in the turns when its disconnected.
*  Attached and removing is a b*****ch.  The bearing that slides over the pin  is so tight it requires a pry bar to remove and a large throated wrench to be able to squeeze it on the pin.  It fits fine on the holding pins just not the suspension pins.
Conclusion:
Having to grind the chassis on a 2017  to get the Teraflex to fit was a shock and was  not mentioned anywhere by Teraflex.  Any reasonable DIYer who is not afraid to get dirty can do this without the need to put it up on a lift.  However, know what I know now about the difficulty to attache and remove and the out of spec angle of the sway bar I would have purchased other adjustable disconnects  manufactured by JKS.
profile.summary: Frame needs grinding for link clearance on a new 2017 Sahara.  Difficult to attach and remove.  Sway bar angle out of spec.

profile.description: Crank up the color with limited Edition Sharpie color burst permanent markers! intensely bright, the supercharged shades create energizing visuals that always stand out. Each color burst Sharpie marker also features bold, vivid ink that's quick drying, water resistant and permanent for lasting impressions on almost any surface. Whether you're drawing on paper or marking on plastic, youll boldly ignite your Expressions with Sharpie color burst.
profile.reviewText: Gone are the boring colors from Sharpie.  The variety of 24 color burst colors is fantastic.  All colors of the rainbow. These would be great to use on invitations as they have a very nice ultra fine point that rolls nicely on paper.  I have always like the fact that Sharpie is a permanent marker. They seem to be able to write on most everything and it lasts forever.  The cap fits securely on the pen. Great addition to my office supplies. The packaging lists six color names, but the markers have no indication what the color is.  So, if you want to use it again, you kinda have to guess as to which one it was. I give 5 stars.
profile.summary: Many colors, fine tip writes on anything permanently

profile.description: Design for safety without sacrificing comfort, The Peltor Sport bull's eye hearing protector reduces sound levels for reliable passive hearing protection. This mid-range NRR provides excellent noise reduction, yet maintains a low profile. Features: - 3M Peltor Sport bull's eye hearing protector - lightweight and comfortable for extended wear - fully adjustable headband ergonomically engineered to reduce pressure points - open frame reduces heat buildup and improves comfort when worn with hats/caps - soft, conformable rings provide a better seal - stylish, two-colour design Specifications: - Color: Black/Gray - mid-range 27 decibel NRR with low to moderate profile.
profile.reviewText: I use these primarily in my woodworking shop.  I'm very careful about wearing ear protection when operating the machinery.  I have a variety of hearing protectors and mostly use inexpensive Harbor Freight protectors which are very adequate for isolating loud sound.  However, the Peltors offer significantly more noise isolation then the HFs.  It can be seen when comparing the specs of 17 vs 30 db.  It was very obvious when comparing sound the to when the table saw was on.  The Peltors also fold up into a very nice compact shape.  Also very comfortable to wear.  I wore them for long periods and never felt compelled to remove them.  If using for shooting they are fine.  Other quality shooting ear muffs have similar attenuation ratings.  But in my experience its best to get an electronic muff  that still allows you to hear speaking while only attenuating the loud sounds.
profile.summary: Excellent noise isolation and comfort.

profile.description: The iconic Daddy Polo from Original Penguin continues to be the "cool cat" of the polos with this cotton variation from Original Penguin. A contrast color on the placket gives it a stylish detail while the pique cotton weaving gives this polo a subtle textured feel to the fingertips that makes this polo smooth and rockin'. The Daddy Polo has your back - twenty-four hours a day, any day of the week.
profile.reviewText:
I always wear XL.  I like Walmart Faded Glory Polos XL as a reference.
This shirt is XL.  It fits my girth fine.  I have a 38" waist and am 6' 1".
Stylistically the collar is very narrow and the sleeves reach half way to the elbow.....something to get used to.
It has a split on each side bottom for what purpose Im not sure but could be worn tucked or out.
The material to my preference feels thin but it is soft to the touch and comfortable on the skin.
Being 100% cotton the wash instructions show warm wash and low tumble dry.  A question is whether it will shrink after a wash.  Ill update this review after a wash and check the fit.
profile.summary: Fits well as XL and material is soft to the skin.

profile.description: Red white and blue patriotic American watch blue Jean color band American patriotic flag watch leather band material quartz movement. The top of the watchband looks like dental material the inside is a soft leather material. ( Band color may slightly very From Picture )
profile.reviewText:
Granted its an inexpensive novelty watch but its attractive and most importantly patriotic.
The blue jean band is a treat touch and matches great with the patinad US Flag watch face.
It comes with a battery installed and also a spare battery.
The stem has a plastic block to prevent the battery from engaging until you remove it.
The watch has a major problem however and this is the band keeps coming off the watch.  The spring loaded band pins are too loose or too small and don't adequately hold the band in place.  The band comes loose with the slightest bump against something.
As nice as it looks, the bottom line is that if you cant wear it, its not a very functional watch.
profile.summary: Great Looking Patriotic Watch but the Band Comes off All the time.

profile.description: The Belkin USB-C to Mini-B Charge Cable allows you to charge and sync your digital camera, MP3 Player, hub, or other peripherals to a USB-C enabled device and supports transfer speeds of 480 Mbps. Plus the cable also supports up to 500 milliamps of power output for charging Mini-B devices.
profile.reviewText: I didn't look closely enough at the cable.  I thought it was a standard large USB connector (USB A) to a mini USB.  But it has a Mini B to a C type reversible connector.  I don't see any use for this cable with any of the electronics I have.  All my laptops have A connectors and some of the older electronics like my older GPS have the mini B but thats it.  I don't think the B is used much anymore .  The mini B end of the cable is marked so you know which end is up and plugging it in.  The C type is symmetrical so it doesn't matter which way it plugs in.  the cable appears to be very well made and the strain relief to the connectors is very strong.  I would expect the cable to be very reliable.
profile.summary: Odd connector configuration.  Not very usable.

profile.description: Drops, dirt, disasters  Defender Series for Galaxy S7 is tough enough to withstand the worst. In fact, its the toughest Defender Series yet. Featuring a death-defying design with a built-in screen protector, plush foam buffer, rigid inner shell and resilient outer slipcover, Defender Series walks away from falls unscathed. To top it off, Defender Series comes with a heavy-duty holster thats a belt clip and kickstand.
profile.reviewText:
This case is really best only if you want the extra protection from scratches, dust and dropping it.  I say extra because the phone itself  provides good dust protection and there are other cases that are smaller and more compacts that will protect the phone from drops.
The good:
* the outer shell is large and the textured outer case provides a nice secure grip.
* the phone is completely enclosed for dust protection with soft rubber covers for the USB and audio jacks, sealed rubber button extensions for the volume and power buttons and the screen itself is enclosed and protected by a outer touch screen.
* All the isolating membranes work well for the buttons
* the screen protector works, no pun intended, transparently, its as sensitive as if you were touching the actual phones screen. and with no visual aberrations.
* The cradle has a nice belt clip that swivels to position the phone as you like it and the clip itself is spring load with a nice hook on the end that will prevent the phone from coming off.
* One handed operation to remove the phone or lock it back in the cradle is easy with a little practice to remove the phone from is cradel.

The bad
* The speaker and mic are exposed and they must be to operate so the phone is not 100% enclosed and those areas are no more protected from the cover.
* The instructions to open the case to install the phone are simple pictures that provide little help.

Conclusion:
The case is well built and will provide additional protection in rugged environments without diminishing functional access to the controls.
profile.summary: Well Built and Provide Xtra Protection Without Diminishing Functionality.

profile.description: Genuine Suzuki V-Strom Hand Guards Part # 57300-27825-291 Hand guards for the V-Strom protect against wind and debris. Easy to install. Fits: 2004-2011 Suzuki V-Strom 650
profile.reviewText: OEM handguards.  They are mainly meant to deflect wind and debris.  They are not designed to hold up against hard hits from tree branches or protecting the levers if putting the bike down.  I can attest to that as I have had them come off but was always able to snap them back into place.  If you want something for protection against hard hits you will need to get something like Barkbusters or Acerbis  with the metal bar protector behind the plastic shield.  For what these are designed to do, they are excellent and inexpensive compared to the others. The large surface area completely protects hands from wind sucking the heat out of fingers and the occasional sting of a large bugs or road debris.  During a summer ride I often seem them covered with remnants of locust and other bugs.  From what I have seen while researching, the OEM surface area is also much larger than what Barkbusters or Acerbis offer and again the OEMs are much cheaper.
profile.summary: Excellent for wind and debris impact protection.

profile.description: The Samsung Galaxy S7 unlocks a Galaxy of technology that takes your smartphone experience to a new level. The bigger, more stunning screen completes the slimmer design. Why not have a phone thats water resistant, too? Galaxy S7 withstands splashes, spills and even dunks. Capture the moment like a professional with dual-pixel technology, offering faster autofocus and low-light sensor. Combine that with a longer-lasting battery and expandable memory, and you have a device thats more than a smartphone. Its a Galaxy. The Galaxy S7 comes in 32GB. Available in Black Onyx or Gold Platinum.
profile.reviewText:
As far a phone functions, email, texting, browsing one android  phone is the same as another in my opinion.  I replaced a LG G2 with this Galaxy S7 both operated equally fine as far as those functions go..
But the camera......what a major disappointment especially after putting out the huge $ for this phone.  The reviews from various publications rated the camera top notch.  Its fine if you never use the zoom.  But once you zoom in the resolution goes down the tubes.  The pictures are fuzzy and grainy.  This is especially disappointing since the zoom is only up to 8x.  This is probably a result of the lower than industry standard sensor pixels of 12M.  My LG G2 was 13m and took better zoom pictures then this phone.  I use a holster for easy access to document my riding adventures.  I can say most of my pics are using a zoom so if I could return the phone I would.  So now Im going to have to go back to the use of the small camera which has 16M pixels and optical zoom.
profile.summary: Camera is huge dissapointment for such an expensive phone.

profile.description: Quickly and securely transfer photos, videos, and files with the affordable, high-performance Lexar Jump Drive S35 USB 3.0 drive. With speeds up to 150MB/s read and 60MB/s write, you can now transfer a 3GB HD video clip in less than 1 minute, compared to the 4 minutes it takes using a standard USB 2.0 drive. profile.reviewText:
The Good:

*  Their is an activity light which is very helpful to provide confidence a transfer is working.
*  I was able to copy movies from PC to it and the Sony Blueray player had no problem recognizing the drive when inserted.

 *  Also it transfers large files like movies much more quickly than a HP 64G flash.  Like 2x as fast.

profile.description: The K70 LUX has Cherry MX Brown switches backed by a lightweight aluminum chassis. CUE enabled advanced lighting control and large font keycaps deliver dynamic, vibrant backlighting
profile.reviewText:
*  This keyboard is my first mechanical keyboard, and the Cherry Brown switches give you good tactile feedback whether you're typing or gaming.
*  The keys aren't exactly silent, but they are much quieter than the Red switches.
*  The extra textured keycaps are a nice addition and easy to install but can be a little weird when using the keyboard for typing.
*  The wrist guard included is low profile and doesnt offer much wrist support because the keyboard itself is actually rather tall.
*  The backlit LED keys are a nice touch, though the Corsair software to control them can be a bit cumbersome.
*  I love the volume wheel which allows me to quickly adjust volume.
*  There is a significant weight to the keyboard which keeps it from moving around when Im using it.
Conclusion:
Overall this is an excellent mechanical keyboard, and while the LED lighting can be distracting it is totally customizable.
profile.summary: Excellent, Good tactile feel and I like the subtantial heft to it

profile.description: Easy Gardener Sun Screen Fabric helps you keep your cool when temperatures soar. Sun Screen Fabric is a versatile solution for all who want to enjoy the outdoors without risking too much sun and heat. The innovative, breathable fabric allows heat to escape while cooling the area, reducing temperatures up to 15 degrees. Enhance privacy as you create shade just about anywhere. Ideal for patios, play areas and pet enclosures. Sun Screen Fabric is easy to install, long-lasting and cleans easily with a garden hose. Fabric is available in multiple colors and a variety of sizes. Easy Gardener manufactures and distributes over 200 products to top lawn and garden retailers in the United States, Canada and United Kingdom. Our product lines include landscape fabrics, shade fabrics, fertilizers, tree care products, landscape edging, sun screen fabrics, netting, fencing and garden staples.
profile.reviewText:
I used this Easy Gardener Sun Screen Fabric  to add over the top of a trellis patio cover to help block the bright sun that came between each trellis.  I found when sitting under the cover that when the sun was overhead the light coming between the trellis was glaring in the eyes and required me to wear a hat to shield the sun.  The trellis spacing is at 50%.
 After installing the Sunscreen fabric I found even with its 75% light blockage spec that the sun was still too bright and glaring to the eye.
The picture attached shows the shadow cast by the sun with and without the Sun Screen,  On the left  of the picture is direct sun and on the right is with the tan Sun Screen Fabric..  You can see from the picture while the fabric provides some shade it still lets a significant amount of light through.
The 2nd picture is looking up through the patio cover trellis with the Sunscreen installed.
Conclusion:
I felt there need to be more sun blocking then was provided by the 75% Sun Screen Fabric.
profile.summary: Does not block enough light for patio cover.

profile.description: Samsonite didn't set out to reinvent the wheel, we simply set out to take luggage maneuverability further than ever before.
profile.reviewText:
There a many good reviews here so I'll focus on some items that were  important to me and I could not glean from reading the reviews.  This review is based on using it for 2 different cross country trips
It rolls great on 4 wheels even when on rough surfaces such as asphalt and balance is not a problem when resting a 2nd smaller bag on top.
It also rolls well on 2 wheels when tilted forward.  It also rolls straight this way (on 2 wheels) and doesn't wander side to side
It has only 1 pocket on top which is great because I want the volume in the case as I see the pockets not being that flexible to hold items and still fit in the plane overhead.
The case material is strong and the zippers easily manipulated even with an overfull case.
The side handle is made thinly to sit fairly flush and because of this it is not the most comfortable to use but for me and my infrequent use, e.g., maybe to retrieve from a bus rack,  it was not a problem.
The handle when extended is very strong and can be used to lift the bag over steps without risk of snapped the handle.
Its a great case and easy to roll in 2 or 4 wheel style.
profile.summary: Great rugged case and easy to roll in 2 or 4 wheel style.

profile.description: A premier wrist brace providing maximum support and stabilization.
profile.reviewText:
I fractured the scaphoid bone in my wrist when I hyper extended during a tumble off the front of my motorcycle.  It was casted for 12 weeks and now its in removable velcro splint with metal bars on both side which fixes the wrist motion almost as well as the cast.  To begin riding again, I wanted a wrist brace that would allow me to grip the handle bars, have the flexibility to manage throttle, brake and clutch, wear gloves and provide wrist protection especially for hyper extension.

After taking the WB01 out of the box  and seeing the flexible foam support inserts I was skeptical the WB01 would provide hyper extension protection.  But after installing both the supplied inserts and snugging up the straps, the WB01 provided solid wrist support to prevent it bending backwards as well as side to side bracing.

I've not ridden with it yet but I'm very confident after testing it that it would prevent wrist hyper extension.
profile.summary: Great Motion with Hyper Extension protection.

profile.description: MagnoGrip is a manufacturer of bold magnetic work gear and hand tools. Our patented Pro FingerGrip Magnetic Glove allows you to store metal parts and fasteners on the back of your hand while working. The index finger is embedded with a small magnet for use as a pick up tool. No more digging in your pockets for screws or keeping nails in your mouth! Designed to be Gloves First, our Pro FingerGrip Magnetic Glove delivers superior protection and performance in a comfortable and secure fit. The palm material is enabled with Touchscreen Technology for operating smart phones and tablets. Our proprietary Maximum Feel fingertip design allows for pick up of small items without removing glove. Use our Pro FingerGrip Magnetic Glove to conveniently store fasteners on your hand for easy access while you work. Ideal for holding nails, screws, nuts, bolts and drill bits. Work on projects without the frustration of losing your tools or patience! Patented magnetic glove Powerful magnet in back of glove for storing metal parts and fasteners. Magnetic fingertip for pick up of small parts and fasteners in tight spaces. Touchscreen Technology allows use of smart phone or tablet without removing glove. Neoprene around wrist and knuckles for a comfortable and secure fit 4-way stretch Spandex back for snug fit Terry cloth sweat wipe on back of thumb Adjustable wrist strap and natural pull tab for pulling gloves on and off Reinforced palm with nonslip grip Hand wash and hang dry Warning: Keep away from magnetic sensitive devices. WARNING: Cancer and Reproductive Harm  www.P65Warnings.ca.gov
profile.reviewText:
Well made and the magnets are very practical.

The good:
Fitment:
Ive purchased a lot of work gloves, typically large,  and these are large and fit very well.
The fingers are snug enough to be able to pick up smallish items and slides easily over the palm with no constriction.
A velcro wrist strap, reinforced with tough plastic secures the glove to your hand.

Construction:
Leather fingers:  The gloves themselves have leather fingers and palm with a grip material reinforcement on the palms.
I found the leather fingers particularly important as the wood working I wear gloves for  requires sliding of wood against the tips which will quickly wear holes in the finger tips.
Leather fingers are particular rugged and long lasting for my type of use.
The top and wrist area uses a slightly elastic material and porous that provides a nice snug fit and is breathable.
The back of the thumb area uses a different soft material that seems to quickly fuzz up and catch and hold small bits of debris.  A minor annoyance.

Magnets:
I was surprised how well they work and how practical the magnets are to use.
Left and right index fingers have a small magnets that make it super convenient to pick up individual screws and for example to select a particular size drill bit laying among  many others in a shelf on on a table.  T
he finger tip magnets I found to be extremely useful.
The back of the hand magnets, about 2" x 3.5",  allow you to hold several screws for ready access and helps  streamline the process.

The bad:
The back of the thumb area uses a different soft material that seems to quickly fuzz up and catch and hold small bits of debris.  A minor annoyance.
Until you get used to them,  the magnets can grab unwanted items.  After awhile you learn how to avoid things like that.  Again a minor inconvenience and something you overcome with experience.

Conclusion:
These are excellent gloves.  These gloves are well made, rugged and the magnets are very practical to use.
profile.summary: Well made, rugged and the magnets are very practical to use.

profile.description: The Compaclite Multi-use outdoor table/stool/footrest with Carry Bag is perfect for camping, fishing, hiking, backpacking and all outdoor activities. Ergonomically designed for comfort, stability and durability. Convenient storage pockets/drink holder. Quick and easy to setup and store. Trendy camouflage print to blend in when you want to and stand out when you don't.
profile.reviewText:
The outdoor table is a nice compact design you could carry in a backpack or in my case easily find a place to attach it on the back of a motorcycle.
The packaged unit is a tube measuring 15" x 5" and when assembled is 20" wide x 16" deep x 12.5" high.
 The table support collapses for storing and is based on the shock cord approach routinely used for tent poles.
The entire support assembly is attached together and its simple to assemble by placing the legs and table top support into their corded mate.
The table top is a tough material with reinforcing bands underneath that tightly stretches across the top with net pockets along the side.  The top is attached in 4 corners by cloth pockets for the poles and tabs are sewn in to help pull the corners into place.
The top is very taught and the tabs to pull along with a little bend of the pole will seat the pole.
Some pictures are provided for your evaluation to illustrate the construction and use.

The Good:
- Easy to assemble and disassemble the support legs with the top.
- Compact for travel.  Easy to roll back up into a nice compact tube and zip up inside its cloth case. (see picture)
- Assy instructions are permanently attached as a tag (but its so easy to assemble you won't need them).
- Comes with side pockets for holding items (see picture)
- Tough.  The table top is made of a tough material that will likely hold up for a long time
- No Small parts to lose.  Only 2 pieces, the top and the base held together with shock cord.

The Marginal:
- Not a stool.  The description states it can be used as stool to sit on.  Its too flimsy for that.  Any larger adult would soon find themselves on the ground with a broken or deformed stand.  But that's marketing and if that's not your intent to use as a stool, then no problem.
-  Heavy.  At 4 lbs, its really to heavy for a backpacker.  The support base is made of steel not aluminum
- Unstable.  The top is not flat or stable  It has an angle from the corners and bounces like a trampoline.  So its problematic to place a cup on it and for it to remain upright or stable.  If you balance a cup on it and put a plate or something else on the top, more the bouncing of the top will likely cause the cup to  tip over. (see picture)
- Poor drink holders.  The side nets claimed to drink holders do no work well as cup holder  The cup when inserted want to tilt over at 45 degrees (see picture)

Conclusion:
Its fine for what it is, a simple table, easy to carry and assemble to keep things off the ground and in easy reach.  If you discount the enthusiastic marketing about using it as a sitting stool and the cup holders it will do fine to hold plates or other items within easier reach.
profile.summary: Fine for a small table but unstable for drinks and too heavy for backpacking

profile.description: ParkingTarget is a peel & stick parking marker for the garage floor. Order on Amazon and get a FREE pair of Pink, Blue, Red, Green and Yellow decals with each order! (See photos for more details) See Sponsored Link for more information.
profile.reviewText:
The Good:
- While only 1.25" tall one can easily feel the bump without rolling over when easing forward with a car.
The entire bottom surface peel-n-stick adhered strongly to our epoxy painted garage floor which was not very flat due to silicon grit mixed in the paint.
Only a single bump is necessary to help aim and locate the car in the garage.

The Bad:
-  After a couple of months and only say 1 dozen stops with the car the bump I noticed the pad has started to slip off of the double adhesive pad while the floor end stays attached.
- And after perhaps 3 more parkings the entire target has slipped off the adhesive (see picture).  I reduced rating to 3stars due to this.
- The only solution will be to perhaps epoxy in place or better yet set anchors in the cement and screw target in place..

Conclusion:
You can easily feel the target when your wheels hit but the provided tape adhesive will not hold the target in place after repeated bumps with the tire.
profile.summary: Easily felt when easing forward but over short time adhesive tape fails

profile.description: The POWERTEC family of power tool switches provide the essential function of safeguarding you and your power-tools for your professional or home workshop. They are approved by UL, TUV, CSA, CE, ETL standards and they fit most of the power tools on the market. Check the listed specifications to assure that this switch meets your application.
profile.reviewText:
I installed this on a bandsaw using a motor drawing 13A at 115vac.
The GOOD:
The switch contacts were labeled on the case making it easy to wire
It has 2 throws so one can switch both hot and neutral or both phases of a 230V line.
The start button has a very positive detent and the stop paddle works great.
The stop paddle is easily removed for ease of installation or if you just want to use the stop button vs the paddle.
The BAD:
The switch is deep, too deep to fit a standard about 1.75" deep electrical box.  I purchased a box that was 2.75" and then there was room for the body of the switch along with the wiring and its connectors.
Also the screws supplied do not match the threads of a standard electrical box.  One needs to replace the screws with 1.5" long screws that will thread into box.
Also the screws don't align perfectly with a standard electrical box spacing but it is close enough that the screw can get started and eventually snug up.
profile.summary: Good switch action but needs to install in a deep electrical box.

profile.description: The HAMMERHEAD Compact Self-Leveling Cross Line Laser with Adjustable Mounting Clamp projects bright horizontal, vertical or cross lines onto flat surfaces with the accuracy of 1/4 inch at 30 feet. The unit will self-level when positioned within 4 degrees of level; an LED indicator turns red when the unit is positioned outside of the self-leveling range. In the lock (manual) mode, the cross line laser can be positioned to project lines that are not level or plumb for projects that require them. The included adjustable mounting clamp easily attaches to a variety of surfaces to extend the utility of the tool. The cross line laser may also be mounted on any 1/4" threaded tripod screw. Kit includes: (1) Compact Self-Leveling Cross Line Laser, (1) Adjustable Mounting Clamp and (2) AA Batteries
profile.reviewText:
For reference, I am a consummate DIYer with broad range of experience from framing to fine furniture making.  If you do a lot of indoor work whether it be pictures hanging or straightening, installing shelving, chair rails, indoor carpentry etc, this is an incredibly versatile and inexpensive tool to have.

The included clamp is great allowing one to attach to a convenient location and it has 3 axis of adjustment so its easy to get it within the auto leveling range and lock it down.  The auto leveling will find level once set within 4 degrees of level.  Indoors I get usable brightness from the laser line from probably more then 33' away with indoor lights turned on.  (Thats the max distance I could get in my house but it will go longer).  It has about 90 degrees of projection so  even a wall 25' away will have a line more than completely across.  Just 3' from the wall will give you a line that is at least 9' across.  This unit can eliminate need for pencil marks on the wall so no clean up or paint over later.

Part of its versatility is that it can also be used in a non auto level mode.  When you turn it on by holding down the laser button on top , the mirrors will lock in place and you can project any angle you want say for example if you are putting in chair rail along a stair case or want to line up ceiling lamps along a reference.

In auto mode the line will bounce if you have it attached to a location that moves when walking across a wood floor for example but this is just an annoyance.

I rate it 4 stars because it cannot be used outside in sunlight.  The laser projection is not bright enough.  In my case I tried to use it outside in a completely overcast sky, about to rain, and at 11am.  I could not see the projection line when it was more then 3' or 4' away.

But it you are aware of this limitation, the HLCL01 is still a very useful, versatile and inexpensive tool to have in your tool quiver for indoor use.
profile.summary: Versatile time saver, but not bright enough for outdoors

profile.description: Pencils will work great onRite in the RainAll-Weather Paper but sometimes you need a pen. This All-Weather Metal Pen writes on wet paper and upside down, the pressurized ink cartridge performs in temperatures from -30F to 250F.The ink won't leak, evaporate, or blow up in your pocket. Brass metal barrel is constructed from an actual 4" long .375 MAG bullet casing. Black Ink. Refill cartridges available.
profile.reviewText:
An expensive novelty pen.
This pen at a whopping $23 at the time of this review which is very expensive for a pen but for a gun nut the novelty aspect may be worth it.
The pen consists of an actual .375 unused magnum brass shell only (in this case Hornady) with a precision fit pen body inserted into the open end.
The pen body itself is also brass.
The pen has a small o-ring so that allows it stays in place when inserted into the empty shell.
The pen can be inserted in either orientation to expose the pen end or reversed to store the pen end.
When inserted it extends much farther then an actual bullet in a 375 round and thats probably a good thing so it doesn't get accidentally included with the live rounds.
Its reasonably comfortable to hold as an occasional pen but it too small for a constant use writing tool.
The ink in the pen is pressurized so it will write upside down and they claim it will write over grease and on photos and is permanent ink.
There is no clip to attached the pen to anything which would diminish the illusion of a bullet but is very impractical..
Conclusion
An expensive novelty pen whose value is in its looks as a rifle round.
profile.summary: An expensive novelty pen whose value is in its looks as a rifle round

profile.description: Defiant Daylight Adjusting Digital Timer allows you to automate indoor/outdoor lights with ease. It also provides sunset/sunrise times and has a random vacation security option.
profile.reviewText:
The BAD:
- The setup is well.....a nightmare.  My arms got tired trying to set it up.  I could never get it to work.
- I only wanted a simple turn on in evening, turn off in morning scenario.
- It would manually turn on and off the lights but after dozens of  trys with 2 different people, checking each night before I finally gave up.
- The display is very dim, difficult to read without getting up very close.
-  The display characters are very small and difficult to read
-  The instructions refer to a video online to help understand how to setup. The video refers back to the paperwork instructions provided with the unit...jeez!
- also, it does not come with a wall cover.
The GOOD:
-  Not much.  the on/off switch worked.
Conclusion:
Pass on this timer unless you can hire a Stanford PhD in computer science to program it for you.
profile.summary: Setup is a nightmare.  Display is very dim.  Could not ever get timer to work.  Need a PhD to program

profile.description: Bohn Adventure Armored Pants are a revelation! How many of us just like to ride in Jeans? It's like they were invented for motorcycling! But somehow our knees feel rather exposed, to say nothing of our hips, thighs and tailbone. Our fully armored All-Season Adventure Armored Riding Pants fit comfortable hip, thigh and tailbone pads with slim, articulated knee and shin armor in a stretch Lycra pant - all designed to fit under your jeans. Your friends will never know! Features: Breathable, stretch Lycra fabric with ventilated crotch panel for added comfort. Bohn Zorb CE-Level 1 knee/shin, hip, thigh and tailbone armor.
