profile.description: Park N Place will assist you in parking perfectly every time. No more dents and scratches from hitting garage walls and other objects. The portable base utilizes a flexible rod with red light that flashes when contact is made with your car bumper. Perfect for hard to judge oversized SUVs and utility trucks. Two Batteries are included. Made of Fiberglass.
profile.reviewText:
I bought this gadget to everyone from driving into the boxes and junk lining the garage walls, and Im happy to say that after 5 years of use it is still getting the job done.  The sign is a little flimsy and simply touching it with the bumper of the car would make it scoot closer and closer to the wall, but I fixed that issue by weighting it down with a 2 lb dumbbell weights.  The flashing lights also stopped working after just a few weeks, but the lights really aren't necessary.  When you touch the pole with the cars bumper the stop sign sways so that is enough to indicate that you have gone far enough.

So a handy little gadget that will keep your garage treasures from being crush by the car.
profile.summary: Needs to be weighted down, but gets the job done

profile.description: Hanover's Summer Night 5 Pc. Gas Fire Pit Set is a stunning outdoor lounging set with modern elegance and enchanting performance. The gas fire pit, with flames roasting coals right on the center, is easy to use and easy to love featuring a beautifully decorated base which accommodates a 20-lb. propane tank (not included) and a control panel for adjusting flame height. Along the perimeter of the fire pit is an elegant, roomy, Dura stone tabletop with ample space to sit your beverages while you're relaxing in the deep-cushioned rocking chairs. The four chairs feature heavy steel extrusion frames. The back and seat cushions are built to last with quick-drying, stain resistant, UV protected, 100% polyester wrapped around polyurethane foam. Beautifully and durably designed, this set will keep you and your friends enjoying the outdoors long into the season year after year.
profile.reviewText:
I'm a little stumped on how to rate this set.  From a construction standpoint both the chairs and the fire pit are top notch, but while I love the chairs I honestly don't care for the "look" of the fire pit.  It is just too Gothic/medieval looking for my tastes.

Chairs:

* The chairs are sturdy and well-constructed (will probably last for decades).  Everything seems to be made of the highest quality materials.

*  The frames are made of heavy-gauge aluminum-alloy, and finished in an attractive shade of oiled-rubbed bronze.  There are subtle hints of gold along the edges of the metal bars and the circular details on the sides of the chair.

*  The welded joints are flat and smooth with no rough seams to snag your clothing or prick your fingers.

*  The chairs are described as rockers, but the motion is very subtle.  The "rocking" is a smooth back and forth motion and with very little of an up and down element, more like a glider and less like the see-saw motion of a traditional rocking chair.

* The cushions are plump and the stuffing is soft.  The fabric is thick enough to withstand years of exposure to the elements.  But I also found the think fabric a little stiff and coarse (more on the burlap end than the polished cotton end).  The color of the fabric is an earthy kind of yellowish brown.  It is a little dull and boring at first glance, but I added some bright floral throw pillows to brighten it up.  The bottom cushions have extra strong Velcro straps to secure them to the chair, but the back cushion is not attached to the chair.  Having the back cushion loose lets you adjust the plump cushion for the most comfortable position.  The loose, back cushion also allows a tall person to remove it completely.  I have some tall (6'+) people in the family, and they have mentioned that the fat pillows force them to sit too far forward in the chair.  Removing the back cushion makes them feel less like they are perched on the edge of the seat.  The metal back of the chair is also nicely curved so sitting without the back cushion is completely comfortable.

Fire Pit:

I'm sorry but I just don't like the way the fire pit looks.  It is big and bulky and looks like something you would find in a medieval castle, or at Stonehenge, or at Machu Picchu.  Did I mention that it was Big?  And Huge?  And Heavy?  This is not something that you can easily put away during the summer.  I also don't care for the molded decorations on the sides of the pit.  The fiberglass is painted black and gold to match the chairs, but the dark colors just make the pit look like a massive boulder.  My first impression when I unboxed the pit was that someone had sent me King Arthur's Stone.

But on a positive note the fire pit is easy to operate.  Hooking up the propane is a snap, and the lava rocks are so much nicer than the popping wood of my old fire pit.  It is also great that you can adjust the flame to suite the mood or the outside temperature.  But I do wish the pit came with a cover to conceal and protect the element/fire ring when not in use.  The fire pit is too big to store in the shed during the summer so I'm afraid the pit will have to weather the heat, humidity and rain of summer.  I expect bugs and mildew will invade the dark recesses of the pit in no time flat.

So how many stars?  I'll give it 4.  I love the chairs and most of my objections to the fire pit are just a matter of personal taste.
profile.summary: Love the rockers, but don't care for the fire pit as much

profile.description: The Panasonic Bluetooth Cordless Phone KX-TG7875S Link2Cell with Enhanced Noise Reduction & Digital Answering Machine adds power and range to a home office or small business office system. Link2Cell syncs up to two smartphones to easily make and take cell calls from 5 portable handsets. A message forwarding feature keeps you connected by sending recorded messages to your cell phone. Other smart features include talking Caller ID, noise reduction, USB cell phone charging port, the ability to block up to 250 numbers with Call Block, one-touch cell phone pairing, a crystal clear 1.8-inch white backlit handset display, 18 minutes of voicemail, an energy saver mode and 3,000 number phonebook transfer.
profile.reviewText: My 80 year-old mother was moving just a few blocks down the street, and for some reason the phone company couldn't transfer her land line number to the new house. She was very upset over losing a number she had for 30 years so I decided to transfer her land line number to a cell phone and use the Link2Cell feature available on this Panasonic phone. Everything worked great. Pairing was a snap, setup was easy, and the call quality was fantastic. But then we noticed that the Panasonic Answering Machine wouldn't work with the incoming cell phone calls (we have no land line in the house). I tried a few thing (like setting the Panasonic's ring count to 2, fiddling with the "Cellular line only mode", etc), but nothing worked. I then found a section in the manual that the Answering System will only work with Land Line calls. Bummer. (Note: my mom just can't get the hang of voice mail on her cell phone.) In the end I got the Panasonic's Answering System to work, but I had to add the Xtreme Technologies Xlink BTTN Bluetooth Gateway-Black to the setup. I paired the XLink to the cell phone and then connected the XLink to the Panasonic using a land line cable. The Panasonic was fooled into thinking the call was coming through a land line and the Answering System worked without a hitch. Even the Caller ID works. My Mom is very happy now. She especially like the Talking Caller ID although the pronunciation of certain very easy/common names is so bad it is comical. I wish the phone had the ability to record your own name for the numbers. So in the end this phone has a lot of features that in theory are great but in practice are cumbersome and hard to use.
profile.summary: Panasonic Answering Machine will ONLY work with Land Line

profile.description: Insects invading your corner of the world? Whatever insect you're fighting, Black Flag productsare dedicated to providing the tools you need to regain control. With formulas that act fast and never back down, Black Flag insect controls have been arming homeowners in the battle against invading bugs for more years than any other brand. Black Flag Foaming Wasp & Hornet Killer aerosol spray delivers a blanketing foam to kill wasps, hornets and yellow jackets by contact. Also use it to control carpenter ants, harvester ants mud daubers, scorpions, spiders (including black widow and brown recluse) and tent caterpillars. The foaming jet spray shoots a powerful stream up 20 feet for fast knockdown, so you can treat nests above ground from a distance. To control stinging insects, apply to the nest outdoors at sunset, when insects are least active. Spray with the wind at your back. Stand up to 20 feet away from the nest, then aim and begin spraying while slowly walking toward the nest. Treat until the nest is soaked. Wait at least 24 hours before removing the nest. Remember, treat the nest  do not target individual wasps, hornets, mud daubers or yellow jackets. This formula leaves no oily residue and is non-staining to most home siding, depending on age and cleanliness. Before using in an area where spray may contact home siding, test in an inconspicuous area and recheck in a few hours.
profile.reviewText:
This Black Flag foaming spray kills the wasps on contact --- WHEN you can hit them with the foam.  I found the trigger mechanism on this can a little wonky.  It keeps falling off so I have to hold it in place while I try to spray.  The form shoots off in a burst, but it sprays a huge area.  The spray isn't a tight stream like I used to with other sprays.  And after the trigger is released, the last bit of foam loses its force and ends up oozing all over my hands and fingers.  Very messy.  I feel like I have to put on rubber gloves before using this spray.

So 5 starts for the wasp killing chemicals in the spray, but 0 stars for the spray mechanism itself.
profile.summary: Chemical kills the wasps, but trigger spray is messy and inaccurate

profile.description: Dreambaby pop-up static cling car shades are a fantastic, innovative way to protect the whole family from the sun's powerful uv rays while driving. The static cling shade simply attaches to the window, without the need for suction cups.
profile.reviewText:
Because my skin burns so easily I always use a window shade when I am in the car.  Ive always used the shades with the suction cups, and those things drove me crazy.  The suction cups were always coming loose causing the shade to fall from the window, and the suction cups would leave unsightly ring marks all over the glass.

But this static cling shade solves both problems.  This shade goes on with just a swipe of the hand, and it clings securely to the window regardless of heat, cold, or humidity.  It never falls off on its own.  Once in place it stays in place.  For it to come off you just gently tug on one side and it peels right off.  And best of all when you do take it off it doesnt leave any marks behind.  I am so glad I no longer have to scrub those suction cup rings from my windows.

When you are not using the shade you can fold it into quarter and stuff it into its storage bag, but I just keep the unfolded shade tucked between my seat and the center console.

The only minor issue I have with the shade is that it doesnt look very attractive from the outside.  If you are outside the car looking in, the shade looks all wrinkly and bubbly like a bad window tint job.  Also, the description says it comes with a reusable shade storage bag, but the bag is just the clear, plastic package that it came in.

So this static cling shade is a great idea.  Im so glad I never have to use those suction cup shades again.
profile.summary: Yea, no more suction cup marks on my windows

profile.description: Powerful cyclonic Jet Force technology and bagless, hourglass dust cup deliver superior suction, easy dirt disposal and quiet operation. Soft bristles lift dirt and debris from carpets while gently buffing hardwood floors. Remarkable performance picking up particulate that is often left behind when cleaning tile. Vacuum head retracts to allow suction flush with walls. Grab and remove stubborn pet hair without clogging using the double-roller, gliding pet brush. Perfect for stairs, upholstery, beds and car interiors.
profile.reviewText:
At first I was a little skeptical about this vacuum.  The beater bar/multi-surface nozzle is very small (it is about half the size of my old canister vacuum) and I was afraid that it would take much longer to clean the house, but this vacuum turned out to be great.  The small beater bar is actually a big plus because the petite size lets it get into tight spaces, under furniture, and up on the baseboards.  And in the wide open spaces of the house the vacuum is quick and moves forward with hardly any effort.  The spinning brushes in the nozzle seem to pull the beater bar forward.  It handles my thick pile carpet without bogging down, and it whizzes across hard surfaces like a race car.  It almost feels like a self-propelled lawn mower that will move forward on its own if you let it.  The brushes in the beater bar also seem to shine and buff the hardwood floor without putting the slightest scratch on the finish.  This thing works great on all surfaces: thick carpet, rugs, hardwood, and tile.

I also love the Edge Grabber.  Why didn't anyone think of this before?  When you push the beater bar against the shoe molding or wall the front inch of the beater bar flips up and allows the suction to get flush with the wall.  It is like getting the cleaning power of the crevice tool in the beater bar.  There is also a brush on the front of the Edge Grabber which helps remove dust, pet hair, cobwebs, and even tiny spiders on the shoe molding.

Suction-wise the vacuum is pretty good.  It grabs every speck of dirt from the hard floors without any problems.  On the carpets it doesnt pull up as much stuff as my robotic vacuum, but the robot spends 5 times as long cleaning the carpet as I spend pushing the beater bar around so I expected the robot to gather more dirt/dog hair/carpet fibers.

Emptying the dirt cup is very easy.  Just lift one lever and pull out the cup.  Push another lever and the bottom swings open and all the dirt tumbles out into the garbage can.  No tricks or struggles getting the dirt cup on and off.  The capacity of the cup is also quite large.  I was able to clean the entire house (2500 sq ft) without having to empty it once.

But this Panasonic is not without flaws.  One thing I really don't like is that the beater bar and wand won't stand on its own.  There is a slot on the back of the vacuum where you can attach the beater bar, but it is difficult lining up the grooves and getting it to attach securely.  The beater bar also doesnt have a light to help you find the dirt in dark places.  And if you pull on the hose just right the canister will flip over and land on the back of the canister (where the exhaust vest is).  I accidently dragged it across my hardwood floor like this.  Ouch.  Thankfully I didn't do any damage, but I am much more careful now.  My final gripe is the snap-on caddy that holds the two of the three accessory tools.  The caddy itself is securely attached, but the tools (crevice and dusting brush) keep falling off.  My ancient canister vacuum held the tools safe and secure in an internal compartment.  I miss that about the older vacuums.  I also had a problem with the vacuum tripping a fuse.  My fault I guess because I had all the lights and fans on.  But strangely the fuse was tripped when I turned the vacuum off and not when I turned it on.  Now I just turn a few lights on a time and haven't had any problems with the fuses.

So except for a few nit picking items this is the perfect multi-floor canister vacuum.  It is easy to use both in wide open spaces and in tight places.  The hinged connection of the beater bar to the wand lets the two lay completely flat so the beater bar can get completely under beds and furniture.  The Edge Grabber is the coolest new vacuum feature Ive seen in a while, good job Panasonic.  But best of all this vacuum has great suction and picks up every speck of dirt, hair and debris in sight.
profile.summary: Almost perfect canister vacuum  Love the Edge Grabber, the small beater bar, and the self-propel action

profile.description: Get incontinence and postpartum underwear you can depend on with Always Discreet. This super-absorbent disposable underwear has an incredible fit and up to 100% bladder leak protection. The incontinence briefs have a RapidDry core that covers you from front to back for protection where you need it. The core technology turns liquid to gel to absorb even the heaviest leaks. The Double LeakGuards help keep wetness away from edges and stop leaks where they happen most. NEW 360 FormFit has elastics to pull the contoured core closer to the body, so it fits the same size range as before, but more discreetly. Say goodbye to bulky adult diapers and hello to smooth and comfortable fit with 360 FormFit. As always, exclusive OdorLock technology helps neutralize odors instantly and continuously. With Always Discreet incontinence underwear, you can walk with poise while wearing discreet, amazing protection.
profile.reviewText:
My 81 year old Mother has a nighttime bladder problem and has been using Poise pads for years.  She recently tried out the Always Discreet Ultimate pads and loved them.  She now wants me to start buy them  instead of the Poise.

But she did not like the Always Discreet Underwear at all.  She said they were too tight around the legs (she is a size 12/14), they made a crinkling noise when she walks or turns in her sleep, and they felt hot.  Said they were not comfortable at all, and that she would stick with her Always Discreet Ultimate pads.  But she also said they were very absorbent, and they had no trouble handling her nighttime leaks.

I also want to add that before this test my Mom had only used the incontinence pads, never the underwear.  So her opinion may be influenced by that fact.
profile.summary: Not very comfortable (according to my 81 year old mother)

profile.description: Trying to decide between the classic Pivot Power and the compact Pivot Power Mini? Fret no longer, because Pivot Power Junior is here to bridge the gap. It's most like the original, but with four adjustable outlets (instead of six) and two feet of cable (instead of six), making it a better fit for small spaces.
profile.reviewText:
Great power strip.  I have a lot of bulky plugs and adapters, and they all fit perfectly into this quirky power strip.  No more daisy-chaining power strips together.  At 5' the extension cord is a bit short.  My desk is about 5 ft from the power outlet so I needed to add another extension cord to make it reach.

The Quirky also strip has an On/Off button that glows bright white when on.  (Caution: At night it glows brighter than a nightlight.) The power button itself feels a little flimsy (doesn't feel as sturdy as an on/off switch), but I typically just turn the strip on and leave it on so it is not an issue with me.

So great power strip.  I can see myself buying more of these.
profile.summary: Even the bulkiest plugs and adapters fit comfortably into this strip, but wish the cord was longer

profile.description: The T.S. Shure Daisy Girls Horse Pals Wooden Magnetic Dress-Ups Set provides hours of imaginative pretend play. Have fun creating many different outfits for Poppy and her horse Clover! This expansive set includes 40 wooden magnetic outfit and horse themed pieces. Each wooden magnetic piece is beautifully illustrated. The magnetized pieces allow for creative play options on a range of magnetic surfaces. This set also includes a clear carrying bag with a colorful feather trip and a snap closure pocket, perfect for travel and storage at home. Dress-up set includes wooden magnetic Poppy and her horse Clover, and 40 wooden magnetic outfit and accessory pieces with a horse theme. Have hours of imaginative pretend play fun creating many different outfits for Poppy and her horse Clover. A clear, glamorous carrying case with a snap closure pocket and a stylish feather trim is also included! This interactive set promotes imaginative play and storytelling. Perfect for ages 3 and up! Dress-up set includes wooden magnetic Poppy and her horse Clover, and 40 wooden magnetic outfit and accessory pieces with a horse theme Have hours of imaginative pretend play fun creating many different outfits for Poppy and her horse Clover. A clear, glamorous carrying case with a snap closure pocket and a stylish feather trim is also included! This interactive set promotes imaginative play and storytelling. Perfect for ages 3 and up!
profile.reviewText:
I was horse crazy as a kid so I fell in love with this Daisy Girls Horse Pals set at first sight, and when it arrived I wasn't disappointed.  It is cute, cute, cute.  The pink feather poofed bag is adorable, and the figures are brightly colored and attractively drawn.  The "paper dolls" and accessories are made from a thick cardboard/particle board that is about 1/4 inch thick.  With normal play these things should last for a few years.  And best of all it is physical play for the kids and not electronic.  My niece is crazy about those apps that allow you to dress, apply makeup, and style the hair of the digital model; so it was fun pulling her back into the physical world.

The set comes with 40 different accessories with lots of different outfits for both Polly and Clover.  The pose of the figures (and some of the accessories) seem to suggest that the two are standing in the Winners Circle after a completion.  In addition to the clothing and saddles there are also trophies, ribbons, and the winner's bouquet of flowers.  The outfits can be mixed and matched randomly, but if your child is a fashionista the challenge is putting together matching outfits so that both horse and rider are perfectly coordinated.

And while the set is adorable and provides endless hours of play, I do have a few issues with it.  Biggest complaint is that the dolls will not stand on their own.  The set should come with a grooved block of wood that would hold the dolls upright.  Second issue is that the back of Polly and Clover should have a magnetic coating too.  After spending time coordinating the outfits of both Polly and Clover, I wanted to (umm...sorry - my niece wanted to) stick them on the refrigerator so she could take a picture with her creation and send it to her mom and dad.  I had to scramble to find spare magnets that I could glue to the back of Polly and Clover.  Another minor nit is that the dressage outfit is not complete.  There is clothing for Polly, but no helmet or top hat, and no braided mane for Clover.  The English saddle for Clover also has this green pad under it that looks like a bed of lettuce leaves.  Strange.

So in summary this magnetic paper doll set is too cute for words, and best of all it is physical play that will get your child off of the tablet and those paper doll apps.
profile.summary: Paper dolls with a modern twist - glue a magnet to the back so you can display them on the refrigerator

profile.description: IntroducingBIC Kids! The BIC Kids products were designed with a Guiding Line to direct finger placement, a Grip for easier holding and a place to personalize. Teachers confirm that if a child develops bad habits with handwriting, it becomes difficult to fix once established. Parents and Teachers agree that handwriting is vital for your children to learn correctly. BIC Kids products went through extensive development and testing process designed with input from experts. Works with both Lefties and Righties.
profile.reviewText:
This kid-centric mechanical pencil is designed to help little kids learn to write, but I guess my family is different because it sparked their math skills.  They didn't care about writing; they just wanted to know how many clicks it would take to get the lead out.  I kept thinking about that Tootsie Roll commercial with Mr. Owl

Anyway cute little kid-centric mechanical pencil.  On the plus side it is short and stubby, uses thick almost unbreakable lead, and has a little thingy that helps kids keep their fingers positioned correctly.  But two major things I didn't like about it 1) the eraser wasn't attached to the pencil so it will get lost very quickly, and 2) it is a little difficult to load the lead.  Your need to depress the plunger while carefully threading the lead into a little opening.  Not something a child can do on their own.

So how many clicks does it take to get the lead out?  Dont know, got bored with the game after about 30 clicks.
profile.summary: How many clicks does it take to get the lead out?

profile.description: The Zak! Designs 2-unit Caddy, Saucy and Zesty servers set is functional in the kitchen and beautiful on the table. The caddy quickly and easily stores and transports your Saucy and Zesty Server bottles. The removable handle makes the caddy even more functional, as the bottles are easily accessible once the handle is removed and the base is placed on the table. The Saucy server has a larger hole, allowing thicker dressings to flow easily. The attached cap flips open for easy pouring but is attached, so it won't get lost. The Zesty Server is push button activated with a narrower opening for better control when pouring vinaigrettes and thin dressings. Both tops keep dressings fresh while preventing spills. The permanent and accurate measurements make whipping up your favorite homemade dressing easy or allow you to see how much of your preferred store bought dressing is left. All three items are made from BPA-free plastic, making them durable enough for everyday use. With bright colors and innovative design, they work with any decor and are perfect for use in your kitchen and on your dining room or outdoor table. Each bottle is 8-inches high, 2.5-inches in diameter and holds 10-ounces. Refrigerator and dishwasher safe. Do not microwave. By Zak! Designs - creative ideas for home entertaining.
profile.reviewText:
This Zaks! Caddy and Sauce Bottle set is festive and fun looking, and it arrived just in time for our annual Cinco De Mayo Taco Extravaganza.

I filled the sauce bottles with homemade salsa and used the four wells in the caddy to hold pickled peppers, jalapenos, mangos, and carrots.  The caddy is supposed to be used to carry the sauce bottles, but the design of the caddy makes it more suited for condiments.  There is even a clear plastic cover that protects the contents and seals them in while you carry it.  The caddy also comes with a carrying handle, but I didn't attach it because I didn't see a need for it as I wasn't carrying the sauce bottles anywhere. (Plus it took up a lot of space.)

One thing to note is that the bottles aren't squeezable.  So the sauces you put into the bottles need to be pretty fluid.  Probably not good for things like mayonnaise or ketchup or mustard.

So if you are like to have casual parties or outdoor gatherings, this is a good set to have on hand.
profile.summary: Caddy is great for condiments.  Also be aware that bottles aren't squeezable

profile.description: Weve designed a safe and incredibly soft electric mattress pad that not only warms your bed, but also rejuvenates it. Amazing is the best word to describe this ultra-plush pad with its incredibly soft, supportive and luxurious Micro-Velour fabric top. Due to the all over penetrating warmth of this low-voltage mattress pad, youll start saving money on your energy bill while lowering your thermostat. Constructed within the pad is the patented Safe & Warm low-voltage technology. This low-voltage mattress pad includes a small power supply box that changes 120 volt AC home current into non-hazardous low voltage DC current (very similar to a battery) to provide warmth, protection and safety even if the pad becomes wet. Unlike other warming pads with their thick bulky wires, the heating wires in the Soft Heat pads are so small, they are virtually unnoticeable. During construction we place the ultra thin wires 3-inches apart and evenly distribute them from head to toe. The benefit to you is a pad that gives more of an even heat and has no annoying hot or cold spots. The california king size pad is divided in two separate zones and comes standard with two easy to read, easy to turn, non-slip computerized controllers to adjust the temperature of each side of the bed giving individual comfort and control. For cozy sheets before bed time, it has an automatic pre-heat and hold feature. You simply turn it on and the pad will warm up on HI until it reaches the temperature that you pre set your dial on, and then adjusts itself to hold it there. For your safety convenience and power conservation, it has an automatic shut off feature that will shut the pad off after 10 hours just in case you forget. It also comes standard with built in over-temperature protection for that extra bit of safety and peace of mind. On the controller, a giant backlit display with auto dimming feature provides more convenience for night time adjustments with out having to turn on the lights.
profile.reviewText:
I purchased this for my elderly mother, and because only one side of the bed needed to be warmed I only plugged in one transformer.  And man was that transformer noisy.  It buzzed and whined and vibrated slightly, but silly me I thought it was supposed to do that.  The pad also never produced a lot of heat, but again I thought that was how it worked.  Low wattage = low, gentle heat.

But after just a few uses over a few months the transformer stopped working.  The light on the controller wouldnt come on and the pad wouldnt heat.  I switched to the second controller and what a difference!  There was no buzzing or noise from the transformer, and the now the pad gets hot  really, really hot.

So if your transformer is buzzing there is probably something wrong with it.  Return it before the Amazon return window ends.
profile.summary: Softest most comfortable electric heating pad Ive ever touched, but one of the transformers failed after just a few uses

profile.description: These English Tea Store brand teapots are affordable, high quality teapots. These fine ceramic teapots are suitable for everyday household use, tea rooms and restaurants. Each teapot's capacity is approximately 16 ounces and are both dishwasher and microwave safe. Not for use on the stove.
profile.reviewText:
This is a sweet little teapot.  The shape is attractive and the color is lovely.  Mine is Lime Green, but it is a very muted Lime  I was afraid it was going to look too bright and brassy, but the color is great.  A set of these pots would look great displayed on a kitchen shelf.

From a functional standpoint it works well too.  It pours without drips, and keeps the water hot for about 45 minutes.  Another thing I like is that the handle stays completely cool even though the belly of the pot and the spout is hot.  On Amazons product page it says that the teapot is microwavable, but it doesnt say that on the bottom of the pot.  Most pottery I have is stamped with Microwave Safe if it is, so Im not sure I would risk sticking this thing in the microwave to boil the water.

There are also strainer holes between the belly of the pot and the spout.  The holes are a little large so internal strainer would only work if you are using loose tea that is made up of larger pieces.

So nice little teapot for one.  Im going to get a few more and display them on my kitchen shelf.
profile.summary: Sweet little teapot  Has an internal strainer, and the handle stays cool even when the pot is hot

profile.description: Control Talk Universal controls your phone and your music
profile.reviewText:
These Monster N-Tune  HD Colour It Loud headphones come in a rainbow of bright, shiny colors that will appeal to people who like to stand out in a crowd.  They are bold, brassy, and shout, Look at Me!

Sound  Sounds-wise the N-Tune is pretty good: nothing to blow your mind, but nothing horrible either.  They sound better in the mid and high range than in the low.  The deep bass in The Knifes Silent Shout, and the horns in John Coltranes Jazzy Blue Train both sound a little mushy, but the thumping, heart-pulsing beat of  Shinedowns  Diamond Eyes and the mid-tones of Eminems  Lose Yourself sound great.  The high vocals in Charlotte Churchs rendition of Pie Jesu also come through crystal clear, and the strings, bass and percussion of Coldplays Viva La Vida have a true melancholy tone.

Fit/Comfort  These headphones are a little smallish, and they look downright dainty when compared to other on-ear headphones that I have.  They are better suited for small heads and small ears.  The cushions are perfectly round instead of oval or egg shaped, and they are a good 1/2 inch smaller than the ear cushions on my Street pair.  The cushions themselves are pillowy and squishy, and feel cool against my face.  There is also no annoying crinkling sound when you squeeze the cushions.  The headband is nicely padded, and is narrow enough that it doesnt cause my head to sweat.  The arms and headband flex quite a bit, but there is a bit of tension in the arms.  Almost too much tension because there was a noticeable force pressing the ear pieces firmly against my ears and skull.  The pressure wasn't uncomfortable, and I was able to wear the headphones for an hour any discomfort, but the press may get uncomfortable if the headphones are worn for extended periods of time.  But I do expect the tension in the arms will loosen with time and continuous use.  I was also happy to find that I could wear these headphones with my glasses.  I only needed to lift the temple arms of my glasses up a fraction of an inch to get them away from the pressure point of the cushions.  That was a nice surprise.

Durability -  Ive been using the headphone for a  week now, and I haven't had any problems with them so far.  I have stuffed them into my backpack, tossed them on my desk, and accidently dropped them on the floor a few times.  I have flexed the headband from the resting width of 1-1/2 inches to 8 inches without anything popping or cracking.  When I first started using the headphones I had a problem with no sound coming through the right earpiece, but after a few minutes it started to work and has been fine since then.  The headphones also come with a soft and silky storage bag.  (Although I wish the bag was color coordinated with the color of the headphone and not just a boring gray.)

Complaints - Other than the mushy bass, the only thing I don't like about the headphones is the fact that they don't fold up.  Having hinged arms would allow the headphones to fold into a smaller size making them easier and safer to store and transport.

So overall these Monster N-Tunes are a decent on-ear headphone for the price.  With the bright candy colors and dainty size they will appeal to both the young and the young at heart.
profile.summary: These headphones will make you stand out in a crowd  and they sound pretty good too

profile.description: The only digital dryer of its kind, the FHI Heat EPS 2100 Black Diamond Ceramic Professional Hair Dryer features a digital temperature control with color-coded heat and fan speed setting from 99F to 241F which allows for customization depending on hair type and texture. The dryer features a lightweight motor with RapidTek Heating Technology. Black diamond ceramic dries the hair evenly and reduces drying time up to 50% while producing increased amounts of negative ions to seal in moisture, repel humidity, reduce frizz and help eliminate static. Exclusive Proprietary Nano-Fuzeion Technology, gentle far infrared heat, and low EMF (Electromagnetic Field) prevents damage to the hair to produce unmatched conditioning and shine. Ergonomically designed with a professional length cord that includes a self-gripping closure and hang up hook for ease of storage.
profile.reviewText:
This hair dryer is powerful and can produce enough heat to burn.  It has 5 different heat setting and 5 different fans settings that give you 25 unique combinations.  With that many combinations there is a setting that is perfect for every type of hair.  The dryer is also light and ergonomic.  Most of the dryers weight is centered about the handle which makes it very easy to hold and use.

But (and this is a huge BUT) the digital display and the controls on this thing are just down-right wacky.  The color-coded display is particularly strange because it is linked to the fan speed and not the temperature.  When you increase the fan speed the color of the display cycles from yellow/tan to green to blue to orange to red, but when you increase the temperature using the heat control buttons the color of the display does not change.  IDK, but this seems backwards.  You should get the red display warning when the temperature is maxed out not when the fan speed is maxed out.

Even the instruction manual highlights the strangeness of the color-coding.  Page 7 gives the temperature ranges of the different colors as:

Yellow  99 F to 205 F
Green - 111 F to 212 F
Blue  108 F to 219 F
Orange  106 F to 230 F
Red  122 F to 241 F

With such large and overlapping ranges the colors have no meaning with regards to temperature.  A more accurate table would read:

Fan Speed 1  Yellow  possible temperature ranges: 99 F to 205 F
Fan Speed 2  Green  possible temperature ranges:  111 F to 212 F
Fan Speed 3  Blue  possible temperature ranges:  108 F to 219 F
Fan Speed 4  Orange  possible temperature ranges: 106 F to 230 F
Fan Speed 5  Red  possible temperature ranges:  122 F to 241 F

So nice hair dryer that can be customized to handle any type of hair, but the digital display still needs some work.

PS: some tricks to using the controls that the instruction manual does not tell you about.
Press and hold the MAX Fan button for 2 seconds to switch from Celsius to Fahrenheit.
Press and hold the MIN Temperature button for 2 seconds to quickly reset to the lowest fan and temperature setting.
Press and hold the MAX Temperature button for 2 seconds to quickly change to the highest fan and temperature setting.
profile.summary: Works well, but color of display tied to fan speed and not temperature

profile.description: With costumes designed for toddlers through plus size adults, Rubies has spared no effort to bring their customers the largest collection of licensed and traditional costumes, accessories and novelty decor items available anywhere. Whether for Christmas, Mardi Gras, Easter, St. Patrick's Day, Halloween, or just play time - Rubies has you covered Family owned and family operated, Rubies has always focused on bringing your family the costumes items you really want from all over the world. From their 2-million square foot facility in New York City Rubies works every day to be an innovator in both manufacturing and design of scary, funny, historical, and mythical ensembles and costume replicas. So from witches to wenches to vampires to vagrants, from Graceland to galaxies far, far away, Rubies is sure to offer the seasonal items to inspire and entertain any time of year.
profile.reviewText:
From a distance this dress looks amazing.  The jewel tones of the crushed velvet fabric are beautiful and the lace and gold trim is bright and sparkly.  But up close you can see some problems with the construction.  Seams are misaligned, gobs of loose threads everywhere, unraveling ribbon, and decorative trims not sewn flat but instead have lots of bunching.  But this is just a costume, so construction quality is about par for what you normally get.

Size-wise it fits a little strange.  I am tall, about 58-1/2 and this dress hits me about 3 inches above my ankle.  I normally wear in size 8, Im small boned, wear a 34 A bra, and this dress is extremely tight in the chest.  The waist is a good fit, and there is lots of room at the hips, but the neck line is much too wide.  This is supposed to fit off the shoulders, but this thing actually falls off my shoulders.  The neckline is even too wide to stay on a hanger.  I had to put a dart in the back so it would stay on my shoulders.

But like I said this dress is beautiful, so I don't mind having to make a few modifications to get it to stay on.  But be warned --- if your bust size is any bigger than 34 inches this dress probably won't fit.
profile.summary: Looks amazing from a distance, but construction is a little haphazard  fits a bra size of about 34

profile.description: The InterDesign Medium Basket is great for extra storage and organization anywhere in the home. Includes a chrome handle for portability and it's stackable to maximize your storage space.
profile.reviewText:
My kitchen pantry was a disorganized mess until I discovered these baskets.  I use them to organize small things that tend to get lost in the clutter.  I have one just for spices, one for baking ingredients, one for my K-cup coffee, one for my teas.

The basket is made of thick, durable plastic.  This thing will last forever.  The bottom is solid (so things won't fall through), but the sides have cutouts which allow the air to circulate around your items inside.  I found the metal handle tends to pop loose if the container is empty, but once loaded with stuff the handles seems more secure.  The handle also makes it easy to pull the box from the pantry or cabinet shelf, and it also makes it easy to carry all your spices to the stove.  They are a snap to clean, and they come in enough colors to coordinate with any decor.

I love these things.
profile.summary: Great for organizing the kitchen pantry, the bathroom, the office

profile.description: Flowerhouse Farmhouse Greenhouse Enjoy Gardening All Year Round The Farmhouse design is compact and lightweight for easy transport, setup and take down. Only minimal assembly is required. 2 screened doors and 12 screened vent openings allow for optimum air circulation. With the vents open, outside air circulates throughout the Farmhouse to prepare plants for planting in outdoor conditions. With the vents closed, the 100% waterproof Gro-Tec material will promote and maintain high humidity levels desirable for a superior growing environment. The Gro-Tec material is UV resistant with rip stop protection for longer life of your greenhouse. The Gro-Tec material is more beneficial for plant growth than clear glass or plastic because it diffuses or scatters light. Diffused light can benefit plants, both by reducing excess light on upper leaves and by increasing the amount of light reflected onto lower leaves. Too much direct sunlight on the upper leaves can overheat the plant and thus reduce photosynthesis. The Farmhouse features a unique, zip-together design. You can zip one Farmhouse to another infinitely. The outer walls form partitions between the Farmhouses so you can create diverse growing environments to suit your needs. Includes Ground Stakes, Tie Downs, and Carrying Pack Shade Cover 2 Zippered Doors 12 Zippered Screen Vent Windows 4 Portholes for Hoses, Power Cords Etc Dimensions: 9 ft High x 9 ft Wide x 8 ft Deep
profile.reviewText:
Over the last 8 years I've gone through 2 of the smaller Farmhouse model, and have been very pleased with the how they protected my tropical plants from the occasional freezes we get in South Louisiana.  This year I needed more space so I decided to get the larger Farmhouse XL version.  I figured it would be more difficult it would be to assemble, but I had put together the smaller version by myself so I figured I would be able to manage this one too.

Well I was wrong.  Believe me and the instruction that come with the XL version: you will need 3 people to put this thing up!!! (Or two people and two sturdy trees.)

Assembly of the greenhouse is pretty straightforward if you follow the instruction to the letter, and keep telling yourself that all the pieces WILL eventually fit together.  You also need a lot of brute strength, sweat, and some cursing.  The fit is unbelievable tight, and after assembling the first few poles you think, "no way will this thing fit together, they sent me the wrong poles."  But in the end all the pieces do fit, and you will get the greenhouse in the picture.

Observations:

&#10003 The greenhouse is easy to assemble if you have 3 people and a lot of brute strength to push, pull and force the poles into position.

&#10003 You will need a heater to keep the greenhouse warm on cold days/nights.  Without a heater the interior of the greenhouse is the same temperature as the air outside.

&#10003 On a sunny day the temperature inside the greenhouse will skyrocket.  You need to monitor the temperature and open the windows and the doors as needed.

&#10003 It gets very humid inside the greenhouse.  You need a heater that can take all the moisture or move the heater in and out every day.

&#10003 The greenhouse will only last 3-4 seasons.  The fiberglass frame creates a lot of pressure against the plastic shell, and after a few years the plastic around the pressure points starts to fray.  The greenhouse also gets very dirty from dead leaves and bugs that accumulate around the bottom edge.

&#10003 Even though the product description says the XL has 2 screen doors and 12 screen windows there is NO screening.  Honestly I never used the door screens on my smaller Farmhouse so the lack of screens does not bother me.  The greenhouse is in my fenced back yard so I don't have a problem with animals getting in.  Although I do get lots of flying bugs, frogs, and once a small grass snake.

&#10003 The product description also said that the XL can zip to another greenhouse, but this is not accurate either.  The regular size Farmhouse had the zipper which allowed you to chain multiple greenhouses together, but the XL does not.

&#10003 This is a minor issue, but I not like the green cords that are used for high wind tie downs.  The green color makes them hard to see.  I've run into them many times while taking the dog outside in the middle of the night.  I now use neon orange cord as my tie downs.

&#10003 Disassembling the green house is a snap. One person can take it down in a matter of minutes.  But good luck getting the greenhouse back into its storage bag.  Folding it small enough takes a lot of brute force and "Twister" like moves.

 So all-in-all I'm very pleased with my XL Farmhouse.  It is a pain to assemble, but 45 minutes of aggravation is worth it to save all my delicate plants.
profile.summary: Great Greenhouse but really do need 3 people to assemble

profile.description: Highly durable 3' x 2' rich light cherry-colored cork bulletin board backed by high-density fiberboard secures documents with push pins. Delivers quality performance when communication and collaboration is needed in high-profile, frequent-use work environments, personal offices and conference rooms. Self-healing surface eliminates unsightly pin holes. High-density backing for maximum pin-holding power, ensuring documents stay securely posted. Fasten photos or important documents without holes using included Quartet Quick Clips. Patented Easy Mount hanging system secures board to wall in multiple places, guaranteeing easy and accurate installation. Modern, dark gray cork and light cherry frame blends seamlessly into contemporary interiors. Available in other frames and sizes.
profile.reviewText:
The product description talks about the Easy Mount hanging system but honestly I was a little intimidated by the metal brackets, 1-1/2 screws, wall anchors, and 7 step mounting instructions.  I also have this strange aversion to putting holes in my walls (I know Im weird).  So in the end I just stuck some 3M Command Hooks on the wall and hung the bulletin board from that, and it worked great.  Probably not the most secure mounting method, but if/when it falls Ill think about using those monster brackets and screws. (Note: The board weights a little under 5 lbs so I used two 3lb Command Hooks to secure it to the wall.)

As for the Quartet Cork Board itself, it is high materials and quality construction.  The gray and black color of the plastic frame is neutral and very business-like.  The cork itself is about average thickness.  You can push the pin all the way through the cork, but because of the thickness of the frame the pins won't go into the wall.  The self-healing ability of the cork is very nice, but will only work with the thinner pins.

So overall this is a very nice cork board for the price.  If you are looking for a board that will blend into a contemporary office setting, this Quartet Cork Board would be a perfect choice.
profile.summary: Secured to the wall with 3M Command Hooks

profile.description: Made with 100% natural oils, the Divine Youth Oil has a light, silky texture with a non-oily finish, that melts into the skin beautifully. Thanks to the exceptional anti-aging properties of immortelle essential oil from Corsica, it helps fight the visible signs of aging for a skin texture that appears replenished, as if plumped from within. Bursting with vitality, skin is simply more radiant.
profile.reviewText:
I usually avoided oil skin products because I have naturally oily skin and tend to breakout, but this winter has been unusually harsh (even in the deep south) so I decided to give it a try. Well I was pleasantly surprised at how light and silky this LOccitane Divine Oil felt. It absorbed quickly into my skin and didn't leave any oily residue. It does have a very strong, astringent scent, and while the scent does dissipate after a few minutes it doesnt go away completely. If you are sensitive to smells, this product may give you some problems.

The instructions tell you to apply this oil first, so my new routine is to wash my face and then apply the oil. I let it dry/absorb completely before I finish with my normal nighttime moisturizers and eye cream (Clinique). I also found that I have to wash my hands at least twice before applying my other creams. If the Divine Oil gets anywhere near my eyes, my eyes start to water and itch. Once a little of the Divine Oil was on my fingertip and accidentally got transferred to my eye cream. As soon as I applied the cream to my eye area I knew something was wrong. I washed my face and eye immediately, but my eye felt swollen and itchy for 30 minutes after that. So be very, very careful with this Oil around your eyes.

Ive been using the Divine Oil for about a week now, and I do think it is making my skin softer (much softer than the Clinique moisturizer), but I haven't noticed any plumping of my skin or any radiance. But I will finish the whole bottle before I decide if the results are worth the price.
profile.summary: Does make my skin softer but haven't noticed any plumping or radiance

profile.description: Set in the near future, Frank, a retired cat burglar, has two grown kids who are concerned he can no longer live alone. They are tempted to place him in a nursing home until Franks son chooses a different option: against the old mans wishes, he buys Frank a walking, talking humanoid robot programmed to improve his physical and mental health. What follows is an often hilarious and heartwarming story about finding friends and family in the most unexpected places. Starring an ensemble cast led by Academy Award nominee Frank Langella (2008, Best Actor, Frost/Nixon), Academy Award Winner Susan Sarandon (1995, Best Actress, Dead Man Walking), Liv Tyler and James Marsden.
profile.reviewText:
**SPOILERS BELOW **

This is a sad movie that tries to be a comedy even while it focuses on the effects of dementia.  It is a story about a former cat burglar (Frank) who is increasingly showing signs of dementia and Alzheimer.  His son, who lives 5 hours away, gives his father a robot that functions as a butler/cook/housekeeper/medical assistant.

The robot is adorable and his voice and logic reminded me of the computer, Hal, on "2001 A Space Odyssey".  The interaction between Frank and the robot are great.  At first Frank hates the robot, but soon Frank becomes dependent on the robot and thinks of the robot as his only friend.  Sad, sad, sad.  But there are some funny moments too.  Like when Frank teaches the robot how to pick locks and open a safe, and when Frank tells the robot about the jewelry heist he has planned.  The robot goes along with the heists because the "planning" is stimulating Frank both mentally and physically and the stimulation is keeping Frank's dementia at bay.

If the movie had just been a story about a doddering old man planning a jewelry heist with his robot, it would have been an enjoyable caper.  But toward the end the movie started to focus more and more on the progression of Frank's dementia and the light-hearted charm of the move started to fade.  In the end I just found it sad, very very sad.
profile.summary: Bitter-sweet look at life with dementia

profile.description: This one-of-a-kind jump rope provides superior kink-free, smooth-glide rope performance with every turn. Flexible 10-foot rope adjusts quickly and easily. Sure-grip, foam contoured handles fit comfortably and securely in hand.
profile.reviewText:
I have very mixed feelings about this jump rope.  I love the handles.  They fit my hands perfectly.  They are lightweight, the foam grips are comfortable, and the ability to adjust the length of the rope from the handles is great.  I also like the spinners at the end of the handles that keep the rope from getting twisted.

BUT I really, really dislike the rope.  The thin, lightweight PVC rope is constantly getting kinked, and my feet get hung-up on the bends.  The rope seemed to work better if Im jumping ultra-fast, but I cant maintain those speeds for very long and as soon as I slowed down the rope snags my feet again.

So if you jump ultra-fast all the time, this jump rope is great.  But if you vary your jumping speed, this ultra-light jump rope might not be the best choice.
profile.summary: Love the handles/grips  hate the plastic rope

profile.description: Wipe new car restorer, safe and effective to use on plastic, rubber, chrome, vinyl, leather, acrylic, ceramic and metallic surfaces; do not use on glass.
profile.reviewText:
I was provided with a sample of this Wipe New Trim, but before I could try it on my faded, 10-year-old Jeep some yahoo totaled my baby.  Sniff, I really liked that Jeep.  So without an old car to test the Wipe New on I was stumped.  Finally I decided to test it on an old rubber storage can cover I had in the back yard.  And you know what?  It worked great.  I didn't really bother cleaning off the cover; I just dried off the moisture and swiped on the New Wipe liquid.  I only coated about half the cover so I could see the before and after side-by-side.

And as you can see in the photo below it worked Great.  (I did have a few streaks in it, but that is because I took about 2 seconds to apply it, and I didn't put much liquid on the applicator.  I would have been a lot more careful on a car.)  The Wipe New went on glossy and stayed glossy after it dried.  It is like applying a coat of shinny finger nail polish to your car's trim.  I wish I still had my Jeep.  This stuff would have made its old, faded trim look like new.
profile.summary: Likeglossy  finger nail polish for your car's trim

profile.description: The hoover air hard floor multi-cyclonic Bagless canister cleans hard floors with extra soft brushes. Maneuver around furniture and corners with ease as the specialized hard floor turbine nozzle gently removes dirt & debris from wood, tile, laminate and more. Then get to above floor messes with the 6.5 Ft. Hose, crevice tool and dusting brush.
profile.reviewText:
Ive only had this Hoover SH40072 model for a short while, but it has worked great so far.  No problems with over-heating or clogging.  It seems like it has gone through a major redesign since the problematic SH400070 version.

I already have a Neato (which is amazing) that does the bulk of my vacuuming, but I needed another vacuuming for quick touch-ups and cleaning hard to reach places like corners, under the sofa, mini-blinds, sofas & chairs.  I didn't want to spend a lot of money (Dyson), so I purchased this SH40072 and crossed my fingers. And so-far-so good.

*** Things I like about the vacuum:

1) Suction is great, and it has this lever that you can open and close to adjust the amount of suction.  Max suction is great for the floor and area rugs, but you definitely need to decrease the power when cleaning the mini-blinds.

2) Seems to handle the dog hair without any problems.

3) Very light weight.  I can easy pick it up and move it from place to place.  My previous canister vacuum had to be dragged around by the hose.

4) Love, love, love the fact that the telescoping extension wand extends to fit my height.  No more leaning over to vacuum the floor.  The extension wand is also great for cleaning the very tops of the mini-blinds.

5)  The beater-bar has a very low profile so it easily fits under the sofa and furniture.  The area where the wand fits into the beater-bar also has this swivel feature that lets you lay the wand flat on the floor when you are trying to reach under the sofa.

6) Works on my area-rug.  The vacuum was easy to push on my area rug.  No skipping, jumping or snagging.  Also picked up all the specks of dirt and dead grass that I could see.

7) The power cord is 17 long.  It is a little short for my needs, but not a major issue.  And as you are pulling the cord from the machine the cord also has these colored bands to tell you when to stop.  Yellow means you are getting close to the end of the cord (so pull gently), and red means you are at the end of the cord so stop pulling.

8) The extension wand is very, very light so it easy to keep it extended while cleaning the mini-blinds, but to get it so light they have taken all the electronics and smarts from the wand which cause other problems (see below).

9)  Fast (almost too fast) cord retraction.

10) Canister is easy to get on and off.

11) Easy to clean stairs with the crevice tool and the beater-bar. You can connect the beater-bar to the hose and eliminate the long extension wand.

12) Crevice tool is great for cleaning the car.

13) No bags to buy: just open the canister and dump all the gray clumps of debris into the trash.  You can also wash the filter which again saves money.  Wish I could wash the filters on my Neato.

14) Looks very cool.  Funky shape and colors just like the Dyson (without the Dyson price).

*** Things I don't like about the vacuum:

1) There is no On/Off switch on the extension wand.  The power button is on the canister.  It is a pain to constantly have to reach down to turn it off. Or use my foot and tip the canister over.

2) The power button looks just like the cord retraction button.  Both are green and while they do have different symbols, they are hard to see when you are standing up.  They should have colored the power button red.

3) The clip for attaching the crevice tool and dust brush to the extension hose is kind of dinky.

4) The huge hose takes up a lot of room in the closet, and the clip that holds the hose/extension wand/beater-bar to the canister is very fragile looking.  Im sure that is going to break in no time.

So at this point I can say that I love this vacuum.  It gets the job done without any fuss or strain.  I will update if I have any problems with it in the future.

Update 3-14-16:  vacuum still working great.  I use it once a week to clean the blinds, the furniture, the baseboard, and all the places the robot vacuum  (Neato) can't reach.
profile.summary: Multi-purpose vacuum that clean exceptionally well.  Cleans floors, area rugs, blinds, furniture, even cobwebs from the ceiling

profile.description: Measure, mark, and cut faster and more confidently with the TEKTON 16 ft. x 3/4 in. Tape Measure. It takes extra time to read regular tape measures, counting lines between numbers, double checking to make sure it's right. Or worse, you can easily lose your place and read the wrong line, ultimately resulting in a frustrating and costly cutting mistake. Eliminate all that with these easy-to-read, easy-to-follow fractions every 1/8 in., marked in alternating black and red colors for even more clarity. Made of strong, impact-resistant ABS material, the compact housing is designed to fit comfortably in your hand. Non-slip, rubber grips give you extra control, preventing drops. Activate the thumb switch and the tape locks in place for hands-free marking or use the one-touch pause button to momentarily hold tape position for quick marks or double checking a measurement. For accurate measurements, the triple-rivet end hook slides to compensate for hook thickness. Snap the belt clip onto your tool belt, pouch or pocket and this tape goes anywhere you go.
profile.reviewText:
This isn't the most attractive or conspicuous tape measure I've owned, but it sure does work the best. It has this unique feature that magically locks the tape in place.  Not matter how much or how little you extend the tape, as soon as you stop pulling, the tape gets locked securely at that location.  When you want to retract the tape, just press a button.  I found myself mesmerized by the locking trick: I sat there for a few minutes pulling out all 16 feet by small increments just to watch it lock into place every time.  The metal tape itself is also very sturdy.  I was able stretch out 89 inches of unsupported tape before the tape bent under its own weight.  This is important if you are trying to measure a vertical wall by yourself.  The retraction is also very smooth and relatively quiet, and the numbers on the tape are big and easy to read.  I also like that it is in inches/feet and centimeters/meters.

The only thing I don't like about the tape measure is it black and aluminum color scheme.  It is just too dull and bland.  It's almost like a chameleon that fades into whatever background you place it in.  It needs to be bright orange, yellow or lime green; anything to make easier to find in my cluttered workshop.  In the end I wrapped some orange around it, so now this Tekton is the perfect tape measure.
profile.summary: Locking mechanism is the greatest, but black & aluminum colors are not bold enough

profile.reviewText:
I installed this camera in the front of my house only to take it down because it was too big and unsightly (and I was afraid the HOA and neighbors would complain).  At 8 inches long it looks very industrial; like something mounted on a factory building.

So instead of mounting it under the eaves, I placed the camera behind an attic window that faces the front of the house.  And surprisingly it works great.  I had to turn of the nighttime IR lights, but even with the IR turn off I can still see amazingly well.  (Note there is some light from the porch and street lights.)

Setup of the camera was a little difficult.  Actually the setup of the software and the port through my firewall was very difficult.  The software is somewhat clunky and parts will only work with Internet Explorer while other parts will only work with Safari/Firefox.  It also took a lot of effort setting up access to the recordings and live feed from outside my home network.  It still doesnt work perfectly because when outside my home network I can only access the Sharx camera on devices that have a remembered connection to my home WiFi network.  So when Im at work I can view the cameras live feed from my tablet (using the WiFi at work) but not from my work PC.  (And allowing anonymous access didn't work.)  I also have some cloud based cameras inside the house, and they were a snap to setup.  So if you are not comfortable fiddling with your router and firewall settings it might be better to go with a cloud based camera.

I was also never able to get the email alerts to function correctly, but in the end the alerts would not be practical because I get too many motion alerts.  I live on a busy street and even tailoring the motion monitoring area of camera I still get tons of recordings.

But even with all the setup issues I still like this camera.  Even from behind a window the quality of the image is great.  The quality was even good enough to identify the car that knocked down and dragged away my mailbox.  And a few pictures sent to the kids parents was enough to get them to pay for a new box, post, and cement.
profile.summary: Even works from behind a window (once you turn off the IR lights)

profile.description: GreenWorks offer a range of systems to choose from in corded and cordless tools. Leading in innovation, the corded Lawn system offers a variety of tools to get all your yard work done quickly and efficiently. Whether you need something economical or with greater performance, the GreenWorks Corded Lawn Tools provide reliable options without the hassle of gas or the high cost of operation throughout the years. Get started within seconds and leave the gas hassle behind. Choose from trimmers, chainsaws, mowers, snow throwers, dethatchers, pressure washers .
profile.reviewText:
Honestly I was a little underwhelmed by the power of this GreenWorks GW1950 power washer.  I just didn't think it had enough oomph.  I tried to clean the mildew for aluminum siding but didn't have much success.  (The house is only 1 year old so the mildew isn't horrible.)  I stood just a few feet away from the siding and had to work and re-work the same area to get it to come clean.  I also tried cleaning the mildew and stains from concrete with limited success.  I read that you can buy a rotary brush attachment for the pressure washer, so I will try that and see if that removes the mildew from the siding.

Another issue I had with the GW1950 was its instability when moving it around the yard.  It has small tires and short wheel base so when I tried to push/pull it across the uneven yard the thing kept toppling over.  It rolls fine on concrete, but in the grass I ended up carrying it around.

I also had problems with the GW1950 tripping breakers.  The garage area has a 15 amp GFCI breaker which should be able to handle the 13 amps that the GW1950 pulls, but every time I turned the GW1950 on the breaker would trip.  Everything was shut off in the garage except a few things that were a pain to disconnect: controller for the sprinklers, U-Verse box, garage door button.  I also tried using an extension cord and plugging into an outlet on a different breaker, but this also caused that breaker to trip. (Note: the house is new so the wiring should be okay.)

But I was able to successfully clean a few things with the GW1950.  It worked great on the windows, and I was able to remove the snail trails and dead worms baked onto the concrete patio.  I also used it to wash the truck.

So this GreenWorks GW1950 seems to work well on light clean-up jobs, but it couldn't remove the mildew from my siding.
profile.summary: A little underwhelmed - more like a Power Rinser

profile.description: The Goal Zero Lighthouse 250 is a bright, USB rechargeable LED lantern. You decide how long the Lighthouse 250 lasts, on one charge, with its dimmable light for tent or trail. Red light to alert. Charge your USB device conveniently with a built in USB output port.
profile.reviewText:
Im an admitted gadget-geek and my first reaction to this Lantern was, That looks so Cool. It reminds me of a Swiss Army Knife. Things pop-up and things fold down. Everything has a purpose, and there is no wasted space.

The first thing I noticed about the lantern was the bold chartreuse color of the gadgets: the hand crank, the USB charger, the power dial, rubber grippers on the stand. In addition to being cool-looking, the reflective, neon green color makes the lantern easy to spot even under low-light and night-time conditions.

The second thing I noticed on the lantern was the ring of red emergency lights that encircle the top of the lantern. When you activate the emergency flashers the on/off cycling of the lights creates a spinning chase pattern. Whats really amusing is that the red, chasing lights make the dome-shaped lantern look like a flying saucer. (All the kids wanted to use the alien lantern.) But while the red lights are very noticeable, they are a little on the dim side. There is also no way to control the intensity of the emergency flashers like you can control the brightness of the white bulb. Another more troubling issue I had with the emergency light was the push button that turns it on and off. The button is much too easy to push. I had the lantern in my backpack when someone noticed a red blinking glow coming from the bag. I opened the bag and sure enough the lantern was inside flashing away. Something inside the bag must have touched the button and activated the lights! I had an alien disco going on in my backpack.

Other cool features on the lantern are:

1) The Stand - the stand folds down to form a platform for the lantern, and folds up to form a stylish, guard-rail looking grill against the lanterns globe. Very Art-Deco looking.

2) Hanger - there is a metal handle that unsnaps from the top and allows the lantern to be hung.

3) Crank - the neon green hand crank is cool, but more of a novelty item in my book. The crank flips up from the top of the lantern and forms a flat crank that can be spun to charge the lantern. (Note: cranking is much easier if you hold the lantern upside down or on its side.) But it takes a lot of effort to charge the lantern with the crank so this is something you would only use in a dire emergency. (Or if the kids are bored and you want to keep them occupied. Or if there is a zombie apocalypse and it is the only source of light.)

4) USB Charger - The lantern has a USB charging cable that is permanently attached to the lantern. The cable is about 9-1/2 inches long and coils around the lantern and snaps into place when not in use. My only complaint about the cable is the length: it is way too short. It is impossible to charge this thing in my car because once I plug it into the charging port/cigarette lighter I have nowhere to place the lantern given the 9-1/2 cable length limitation.

5) Light Dial - There is a dial that rotates to turn the lantern light to the desired intensity. The dial is easy to turn, and unlike the emergency button, I had no problems with the dial being turned accidentally while inside my backpack. The light that the lantern produces is sufficient for most camping/power outage needs. You cant use it to light up a ball park, but you can use it to find you way to the outhouse.

6) There is an output USB jack that allows you to charge other USB devices like your phone, or your Kindle, or perhaps your Goal Zero 250 Lantern??? So what happens if I plug the lanterns USB charging cable into the lanterns USB output jack? Will the lantern charge itself? Hummm.

So all-in-all Im very impressed with this Goal Zero Lighthouse 250 Lantern. It is a creative blend of form and function, and except for the easy-on emergency light button it is perfect for our camping needs.
profile.summary: Creative blend of form and function, but the emergency flashers much too easy to turn on

For International Only:Dodging speeding cars, crazed cabbies and eight million cranky pedestriansis all in a day's work for Wilee (Joseph Gordon-Levitt), the best of New York's agile and aggressive bicycle messengers. It takes a special breed to ride the fixie bike. Riders
profile.reviewText:
I really enjoyed this movie.  The plot was a little thin: bicycle messenger must deliver a letter before a 7:00 pm deadline while being chased by a corrupt cop who wants the letter for himself.  But it was fun, action packed, and the bicycle tricks/culture was a change from the ordinary chase scenes.  The acting was well done, and the characters were interesting.  The corrupt cop was the best of the bunch.  He had this attitude like "Are you really going to make me kill you?  You know killing you will really spoil my day.  Just do what I want and we will both be happy."  He was hilarious.

Another interesting thing about the movie was the manipulation of the time line.  Characters were introduced and interacted for a time, but then suddenly the story would go back in time and you were shown how and why each character ended up in their current predicament.  I know the trick has been done before but it was handled well.
profile.summary: Fun action movie, with an interesting "bouncing" time line

profile.description: Liam Neeson returns as Bryan Mills, the retired CIA agent with a particular set of skills' who stopped at nothing to save his daughter Kim from Albanian kidnappers. When the father of one of the kidnappers swears revenge and takes Bryan and his wife hostage during their family vacation in Istanbul, Bryan enlists Kim to help them escape...
profile.reviewText:
Taken 2 suffers from the typical movie sequel clich, the second one is not as good as the first.  Both movies followed exactly the same formula: villain kidnaps family of the hero, car chases ensue, body count mounts, hero kills head honcho villain in a climatic confrontation, hero and family live happily ever after.

But while Taken was a fantastic movie and had me on the edge of my seat the whole time, Taken 2 was kinda ho-hum.  I had two big issues with the plot:  1) The whole kidnapping, chase, and rescue scenario was so far-fetched  that it was almost laughable.  2) The villain was made to look too "human".  In the first scene of Take 2 the villain (a gray-haired old man) is shown burying his son and other family members and vowing revenge against his son's killer.  In a different movie this story line would have made this man the hero.  This setup just made the old man look like less of an evil psychopath (like the villain in the first movie) and more like a grieving father bent on revenge.

The things that saved this movie were the great acting and the beautiful location.
profile.summary: The sequel is never as good as the original

profile.description: The versatile SwissGear SA5963 ScanSmart Laptop Backpack is made for convenience and functionality and is loaded with features. Starting with ScanSmart technology, this backpack comes with a laptop-only computer compartment that is airport friendly, allowing you to keep most computers up to 13 inches in size safe when passing through security. At the TSA checkpoint, simply unfold to flat position and place the bag onto the X-ray belt. It's as easy as that.
profile.reviewText:
This SwissGear backpack is exceptionally well made, but it is small  it looks like something a child would carry.  Im using this backpack to hold my 11-1/2 Surface Pro 3, and the backpack is perfect for that size device.  The SP3 fits a little loose in the smartScan pocket, but if I keep the SP3 in its protective sleeve (which makes it 13) it fits perfectly without any jiggling around.  You might be able to squeeze a 14 device into the padded pocket of this backback, but I don't think it is realistically sized for a 15 laptop.
Beyond the size issue, the backpack is exceptionally well made.  There are a lot of leather accents, and there are zippers (6 in all) and compartments everywhere.  A zippered compartment on the side hold a 17 oz bottle of water, a small zipper on the top is perfect for a wallet and keys or your phone.  The top compartment has a soft, fabric lining that will keep the phone safe from scratches.  My 5-1/2 phone fits comfortably, but something larger probably won't fit.  At the front of the backpack is a larger zippered compartment that has cubbies for pens, IDs, chargers, etc, and behind that is another larger compartment for more stuff.  The largest compartment at the back folds flat (I guess so you can open it up and send it through the airport scanners).  One side of the back compartment has a pocket that is thickly padded with a strap to keep the laptop in place, and on the other side is another pocket that is cushioned enough to protectively hold another device.
The bag has lots of zippers which are all sturdy and have fancy, rubberized edges.  The carrying handle at the top of the backpack is thick and wide and comfortably padded.
In the style department this thing looks a little boxy and squat.  It tall enough to fit the laptop without having any extra room at the top.  This bag looks no-nonsense and very businesslike.  It looks okay, but it is not going to win any style competitions.

So if you have a smaller laptop (14 and under), and want a high-quality, subdued looking backpack  this is the backpack for you.  And if you like organizing and compartmentalize all your stuff, this backpack is a dream come true.
profile.summary: More for a 13 Tablet/Laptop  It is small, but exceptionally well made
