profile.reviewText: If you have not discovered the pleasures of Pocket Sandwiches or savory tarts, you are in for a real treat. I have actually been making them for some time using the omelet plates on my George Foreman grill. Pocket sandwiches use dough (I often use rolled out biscuits from the can) and any filling you want. For me, it is an awesome way to use up my leftovers. If you don't want to get fancy, just take your leftover meat and shredded cheese and bake it into a tart. Do you make impossible pies? I was happy to read that it would make them - the Bisquick web site (Impossibly Easy Mini Pies) has a whole list of mini pie recipes. They are aimed at muffin pans, but they will work perfectly here. The key element is making sure MEAT is cooked in advance. With shell, these only hold 1/2 cup, so the size is correct for the recipes. After experimenting a bit, I discovered that these worked VERY well and created my video to show how easy it is. In case you can't see the video - here are the instructions: Mix 1/2 Cup of Baking Mix, 1/2 cup of milk, and 2 eggs. Chop up ingredients you want in your mini pie and have them ready When the pan is heated, add 1 TBS of baking mixture Put in about 1/2 cup of fillings - I used turkey, onions, spiced apple slices, and cheese in the video Top with another TBS of baking mixture Cook for about 8 minutes Cool and eat. And eat. And Eat. Fortunately this makes 8 mini pies. You can either use the impossible pie quiche recipe or follow one with a real crust found in the recipe book ... so, yes, quiche is possible AND easy. (Or should I say "impossible" and easy?) I love impossible because I don't have to roll out or cut a crust! Obviously it will make fruit pies (used cooked fruit), but it will also make small shells you can use to fill with your precooked custard pies. Just bake the shells first and let them cool before adding your filling. However, you won't want to use this for anything that cooks for a long time in the oven - like Pumpkin pies. It comes with a two-sided cutter - one for the shell and the other for a top. It also comes with a small center that pushes the shell down into the pie area. I find that a roll of standard biscuits makes three pies (two for the bottom crust, one for the top) with a biscuit left over (just put it in the fourth spot). A set of pre-made pie crusts makes can be cut into four 2-crust pies, plus it will have dough you can roll out to make more. Or you can make your own pie crust. You do have to oil the pan before you use it. Like I mentioned earlier, these hold about a half cup of filling, so servings are small. Just perfect for making individual servings for small groups. Or perfect for finishing off yourself! I appreciate that it has a timer on the front, but the timer does NOT control the on/off setting. Once the timer goes off, the appliance remains on and heating until it is unplugged. This is one of the two reasons I have given this only four stars. No on/off switch. The second issue is that these are NOT removable plates. They have to be hand cleaned after use and it really makes it more difficult to make sure that the surface is fully cleaned. Still this has become one of my favorite appliances simply because it does so much. Four Happy Stars.
profile.summary: Yes you can ... Much more than pies

profile.description: BISSELL PowerClean Upright Vacuum, 16N59 The PowerClean Vacuum has a complete system with nine cyclones providing non-stop suction to pull out embedded dirt for a deep down clean each time you vacuum. profile.reviewText:
Over the years I have assembled countless vacuum cleaners, so much so that I get a knot in my stomach thinking about it! So it was a VERY pleasant surprise to discover this only used four screws ... Two to attach the handle, and two to  hold the back where you coil the cord. Other than that, you simply add the attachments!

A couple of weeks ago, we added a second family to our household, and we now have THREE chihuahuas and TWO cats roaming our house. I knew my small floor vacuum would never be up to the task, so I was happy to try out this vacuum through the Vine program.

After assembling it, I vacuumed the hallway, a major source of pet traffic! Imagine my shock when it picked up enough pet hair in this short area to fill the cup. It also worked well picking up at litter off the bare floor. Very powerful. Because of this, it is heavier than I am used to, but it steers easily. In fact, it picked up well from the sides as well as the front, minimizing my use of the crevice tool.

I popped off the cup and carried it out to the trash. It came off easily, and fully emptied into the trash, I didn't have to dig out the hair as I have had to do in earlier bagless vacuums. I just opened it over the trash, not a single problem or mess. It also popped back into place easily. It was one of the smoothest and easiest I had experienced, and it renewed my faith in bagless systems.

Features I already like:
The hand held brush for the furniture
The power and brush controls on the handle
The hepa filter (I am allergic to cats, so this permits me to vacuum)
The fact that everything except the hepa filter can be washed and doesn't need to be replaced
Having the belt be lifetime (I hate changing belts)

Obviously it is still new, and we will have to see how it holds up over time, but I am really loving it!

profile.description: Looking for snack options that are high in nutrients but low in calories? Want to offer your family delicious food options to dress up morning oatmeal or replace that bag of potato chips at lunch? The Hamilton Beach Food Dehydrator helps accomplish these goals by taking food preparation to the next level. It opens the door to endless possibilities deemed too difficult to do in the past. With five stackable drying trays and 500 watts of power, it's easy to dry a variety of fruits and vegetables and even make beef jerky. The continuous airflow feature provides even drying, eliminating the need to rotate trays. This dehydrator includes an adjustable thermometer for better performance and a timer with automatic shutoff. A food dehydrator lets you to make healthy foods at home like crunchy green beans or dried sweet potato sticks. Have a sweet tooth? Banana chips or dried apples with cinnamon are the perfect fix. And since the fruits are not bogged down with additives or preservatives, their natural sweetness shines. The Hamilton Beach Food Dehydrator comes with two specialty sheets for added versatility. Use the mesh sheet to dry garden herbs for year-round enjoyment, or puree summer fruits and spread on the solid sheet for homemade fruit rolls. Wholesome, home-made snacks for the entire family. Now that's Good Thinking.
profile.reviewText:
I have been dehydrating foods of my own for fifteen years, since I have preservative allergies (both nitrite and sulfite). I actually wasn't expecting to like this particular dehydrator, but I was surprised at how much it holds for a compact size.

For my first experiment, I used a complete pineapple, cut into strips (1/4") and three apples. I quickly discovered that it only filled 3 1/2 trays. So next time I will plan more. Because of the apples, I decided to set the entire thing for 16 hours at 125 degrees. At the end of this time, I felt the apples still had a bit more moisture than I think should be there, but with the peels, I think they were harder to dehydrate. The pineapples were leathery, but again with moisture.

These can be cleaned in the dishwasher as long as you don't use sanitemp, and I would also suggest air drying for safety. Best of all, with the square shape, they fit in my dishwasher.

The manual is excellent and even offers suggestions for drying fruits, safe storage, and recipes for Jerky. It even explains the "easy cutting method" - partially freeze your meat before slicing it. However, I often use the "easiest cutting method" and let my butcher cut it. So if you are a beginner, you don't need a book to get started, although you might want to explore one later.

I won't be drying any herbs, and with only one liner for fruit leather, I won't be using it either. But I learned long ago that if you have an empty tray, add it to the bottom with the liner and it will collect any drips and make cleanup a breeze. Much easier than washing out the bottom of the dehydrator.

Another thing to note is that for heat distribution, there is one tray that must always be the top tray (and always used). If you are dehydrating multiple fruits, you will want to consider which fruit to put on this tray, I normally put the one that has the longest time frame so I can easily pull out the other trays.

This has a reasonable length cord (still short), and runs with a mild hum in the background. I do not hear it in the living room when I run it in the kitchen.
profile.summary: Everything a beginner needs

profile.description: IMainGo XP is an ultra-portable stereo and protective case that custom fits your iPad 1 or 2. Four speakers and tuned bass delivers an amazing sound-clear highs, rich deep basses. Just open your iMainGo XP. Plug in your iPad. Turn your music on. Stand back. Perfect for music, movies, and games.
profile.reviewText: As a professional, I often find myself using my iPad in ways that the traditional user does not. In fact, the reason I finally made a decision on the iPad was my ability to work using PowerPoint on the iPad, and being able to create and work with word documents. I frequently create on my laptop, then grab and go with my iPad. So when I had a chance to test this product, I had several applications that were important for me. I needed to be able to show video clips, use power point, and occasionally play music for a larger group of people. For these purposes, this is an awesome purchase, in fact I highly recommend it. The sound is loud and clear, and having the combined speaker system and cover makes it easy to bring everything with me, ready to go. It is also ideal for watching movies, since the separate stand holds it in several different positions. For these things, I would actually rate it five stars. However, I am using my iPad in other ways. I read books on it. I keep notes on it for speaking. I play solitaire on it, and scrabble, and use it for FaceTime with my daughter and her family. It is my primary source for reading email and accessing the Internet. None of these items require speakers. When I am using my iPad for these other purposes, let's be honest, this case, complete with speakers is heavy. I was unable to locate the actual specs for the weight of just the case, but the shipping weight is over three pounds. I find that the case easily triples the weight of my iPad 2. This makes it difficult to use it for these other applications without removing it from the case. There are some very, very nice features in this case, and while I don't intend to drop my iPad to see how much protection this cover offers, it feels a bit like having my iPad wearing a suit of armor. It is designed with full access to all buttons and cameras, and you can even charge it inside of the case. The only problematic area is the "off" button for the iPad itself. Since this button is not accessible with the case on, there is an external button, which pushes against the case holding the iPad 2, which then pushes the off button on the iPad. It doesn't work as smoothly as it could, and with its location, I need to partly close the case in order to access it. I love it for what it is, but if you are buying it for someone else, you might want to consider whether the downside of the weight will allow it to be practical for them. How do they use their iPad? If the speakers are important, then this might be the perfect product. However, if they need their case to be light and practical, you might want to consider a lightweight case and a separate dock, like the Logitech Speaker Stand for iPad (980-000590) for those times when speakers give a boost to their experience. EDITED - I was finally able to locate a scale for this. It weighs in at exactly 2 pounds ... with the iPod enclosed, it weighs 3 pounds 5 ounces.
profile.summary: Great for presentations ...

profile.reviewText: This particular item was shipped UPS. So, it isn't the manufacturers fault that it arrived battered with the boarded palate under it broken and the sides torn. Of course, the fact that UPS also delivered this on its side made it problematic for me. And, it didn't help that it arrived only one hour before a tornado passed overhead. No worries on needing this immediately, since it was 80 degrees outside. As a result, It took awhile, but I finally scooted the box into the garage where I was able to cut it open. I had read the manual online in advance, so I really wasn't surprised by a lot! Yes, you do have to assemble the wheels. Yes, it is a pain to do this - not so much since UPS already had it on its side! Of course, the best part of downloading the manual is that you can actually read it clearly. Other than the wheels, this arrives fairly ready to go. You will need to purchase oil for this (3 bottles to start) as well as gasoline. The safety feature shuts it off if the oil gets low so that you don't have to be concerned. It is also just as easy to start as my husband's riding mower. As one of your options, this has a 30 amp twist lock. This allows you to work with your electrician and use this to actually power two breakers in your home rather than use the extension cords. However, since we are using this for occasional use, we opted to purchase the power cords and run them into the house. This gives very clear instructions on keeping gas in it - you will need to purchase STA-BIL which will help keep your gas from gathering moisture. It gives a max of 10% ethanol, which is likely what your local gas station carries. The reason for the limit on ethanol is that it deteriorates the gas quickly by gathering moisture. A few years ago, our area was caught in an ice storm where suddenly generators were needed - no power for ten days. But, many of our local neighbors saw their wonderful generator not start because of failing to follow directions. With old gas, moisture, and lack of keeping it tuned up, we saw a 50% failure rate. So I was very impressed with the fact that this recommends running it for 20 minutes a month to ensure that everything goes well - in addition to using the preservative to keep your gas fresh. Before you decide whether this particular model is the one you want (and at this price you really do need to consider carefully) you need to decide what you will be using this for. Now, if you use one of these for construction, you probably aren't even reading this review. BUT, if you are using it for home use, your really do need to sit down and do some figuring. Some of the more common usages are listed above. In our case, we have purchased a 1500 watt oil filled heater. We chose this option because it didn't have the power needs when clicking on and off that some other heaters had. Plus it provided consistent warmth that could help us survive a snow storm. Our refrigerator runs at 500 watts, but needs that extra surge when the motor first kicks on - ditto with our freezer. We decided that the refrigerator would have priority over the freezer, since we would be in and out more. For cooking, we have our microwave (1300 Watts), toaster oven(1500 Watts), big Boss induction stovetop (1300 watts), and NuWave (1500 watts). OR, we can save on power by using our much lower wattage slow cooker. If all of this sounds like you will run out of power, remember that you don't need to constantly run these items. You can plug and unplug items as you need them. In fact, Amazon recently began offering the Wonderbag Non-Electric Portable Slow Cooker with Recipe Cookbook, Red Batik. You heat your food then put it in the bag to continue cooking itself. Not bad for any time, but a good choice when you are on limited power. If you are considering running a laptop or charging sensitive electrical equipment with this, I strongly recommend you keep on hand a UPS Power supply. This is a battery back up that is often used for power outages to keep electrical equipment from going down. BUT, it also prevents surges and "dirty power" like you might find with a generator. So plug the UPS into the generator, and plug the electronic equipment into the UPS to keep things running smoothly, especially as your heater or other equipment draw on the power. At this hefty weight, I would strongly recommend this for home use. Even with the wheels, you probably don't need this much power around your campfire! Polaris sells smaller and much lighter versions of the generator which will really work a lot better. A good choice for lots of power at home for those who (like me) occasionally need some back up. It gives that extra peace of mind.

profile.description: KEURIG KOLD delivers on-demand choice of freshly made cold beverages right at home: Coke, Diet Coke, Dr. Pepper, Canada Dry, craft sodas, seltzers, iced teas, flavored waters, sports drinks, cocktail mixers, and more all made with signature Keurig simplicity. Choose your pod, pop it in the drink maker and press the KOLD button. The KOLD drink maker will do the rest. Before you know it, you'll be enjoying perfectly chilled, still or sparkling beverages made fresh, just for you. No CO2 canister, no messy syrup bottles and no fuss.
profile.reviewText:
I did not buy this through Amazon. I bought it directly through Keurig at an introductory price. Besides pricing around, here are some things that I have learned and experienced.

We were early adapters to Soda Stream, and prefer not to have a CO2 bottle to replace. Throw in the fact that I am always forgetting to put my bottles back in the fridge, and this looked like a good solution. No CO2 canister, no refrigeration.

As you likely know, the pods are pricy. They come four to a package, and there are very limited varieties currently available, especially in diet. Sadly, not only are the varieties limited, but the flavors leave a bit to be desired. Not only are they a bit to be desired, they don't always work right. On a machine priced like this, and pods that cost more than cans, you really expect a bit more than having to poke a hole in the bottom of the cup to get the last of the cola out.

It is that, as much as the price that led me to leave a less than stellar review. My husband immediately did a thumbs down ... and asked for the canned variety.

Each carbonated pod comes with the CO2 beads in the top, and the syrup in the bottom. You peel the freshness seal off of the bottom and insert the pod, just like a Kcup. Push the button, and instant soda. :)  There are cautions everywhere not to try eating the microbeads because they will cause serious injury.

There are also noncarbonated pods.

It takes two hours to cool down the first time, and you hear the fan running. You then prime it (following the directions) and you are ready to go. You need to keep it plugged in unless you want to go through the two hour cool down again. It says it uses about the same amount of power as a mini refrigerator.

The one thing that not even the owners manual told me is that you CAN get ice cold water from this. Like the coffee Brewer, just lift and close and the button will flash showing it is ready to dispense! Believe it or not, that is probably the BEST feature here - Ice cold filtered water on demand. :) BUT, I could get that signing up with a water service.

Because you can do cold water, you can add your own flavoring to the water once it is dispensed. With the pods being so costly, I will be using this concept to add powdered flavoring so my granddaughter can use the soda maker too.

Overall, I would say that the concept outweighs the reality. One thing that would turn around my opinion would be to have "fizz only pods" so that I could make my own soda and add the amount of syrup that tasted good to us. I guess Soda Stream spoiled us for standardized drinks.
profile.summary: Flavor less than expected - limited available - Don't always work right

profile.description: If you're like most whiskey drinkers, you probably chill your whiskey with ice. Well after spending money on premium whiskey or scotch why would you dilute it with water? These Chilling Rocks are the perfect way to slightly chill your spirit without diluting the complex flavors. These Chilling Rocks are made from 100% soapstone's and are non-porous that will not change the whiskey's flavor or odor, keeping your whiskey as original as possible. The Chilling Rocks are gentler than ice and are best used to cool down your favorite spirit just enough to take off the edge without reducing flavor. The Chilling Rocks intent is to slightly chill the drink to take the edge off. Soapstone is made up of talc which will not react to water, alcohol and or other drinks. If used with care, soapstone will not scratch your glasses. About Soapstone: Known for its ability to maintain a temperature for long periods of time, natural soapstone is listed as Generally Regarded As Safe (GRAS) by the FDA. Soapstone is made up of talc which will not react to water, alcohol and or other drinks. If used with care, soapstone will not scratch your glasses. Proper Usage: While slightly damp, Store them in the freezer for at least 4 hours before use. Add 3 Rocks to your glass, and pour your favorite spirit until it reaches the height of 1 stone (about 2 fl oz). Let stand a few minutes and then enjoy your spirit. When finished, rinse the rocks and store in the freezer while it is still damp for next time NOTE: place them in the freeze when they are still damp and not totally dry, the minor dampness does not dilute your drink but it will help the Rocks bring down the temperature of your drink by a few degrees more. Chilling Rocks are not meant to cool as a drink as quickly or as much as ice. They are intended to provide a slight chill-between 8 and 15 degrees-that will to take the edge off without dilution.
profile.reviewText:
These small soapstone cubes are perfect for cooling off about 2 oz of beverage, whether it is alcohol (more likely with 2 oz) or another substance.

These are the first Whiskey Rocks I have had, and I was surprised at how small they are (common among these rocks). I suppose if you are drinking whiskey, I don't need to caution you about them being a choke hazard, but they really are.

Since I don't drink whiskey, I tested these in a couple of ounces of soda and was surprised at how nicely they cooled it off - not ice cold, but definitely chilled. At first I hoped that these would work in larger glasses of soda, however, that isn't their purpose and they are too small to really be effective for that purpose, although they might keep your soda chilled longer.

I am grateful to have received a complimentary set for the purpose of testing and reviewing these.
profile.summary: Nice ice - designed for 2 oz

profile.description: Built for performance and durability, the stylish, stainless-steel Frigidaire Professional Slow Cooker is designed for you to get great results in the kitchen. Featuring a spacious 7-quart design that looks great in the kitchen, this slow cooker makes the most of counter space, providing a large cooking capacity. The Frigidaire Professional Slow Cooker that provides even, uniform heating to ensure superior slow cooking results.
profile.reviewText:
The primary reason why this is called a professional slow cooker is that it is so large - it will hold a full 7 quarts! But Big is not always better.

Why does it matter what size slow cooker you buy? Because in order to prevent burning you MUST have the cooker at least half full; in fact, 2/3 to 3/4 full is a much better ratio. This is particularly true in really nice cookers (like this one) which have "surround" heat - not just bottom heat. So make sure you really WANT something this large.

My previous slow cooker (which I still have) is four quarts - and is the perfect size for most of what I make. I can go down to two quarts (or up to four) and still be safe. This particular cooker should be used for recipes four quarts or above.

I love this particular size because it can do those big jobs my smaller one won't, especially when I am canning. I can make huge batches of food. It also works for potlucks when I am making meals for a very large group of people.

If you are wondering, yes, you can fit a turkey (under 10 pounds) in this cooker. BUT, you need to make sure it is fully thawed before putting it in. Turkey, in order to be safe, needs to reach 140 degrees within three hours to make it safe for consumption. You would probably want to cook the stuffing in a separate container to ensure food safety.

Since lifting the lid adds a full half hour to the cooking time (really!) I love the fact that this one has a clear glass lid that makes it easy to see through. Other than that, it has the removable ceramic base (I remember the days when these didn't come out), and the three settings - High, Low, and Warm.

Even the lowest settings can burn food if not handled properly, so keep an eye on your pot. While the earliest slow cookers had lower temperatures, they also contributed to many incidents of food poisonings, so they now run higher temperatures.

You also need to be sure that meats are thawed before putting them into the cooker. This will prevent discrepancies oftemperature (extreme cold against heated pot) that could cause your ceramic to crack.

Just a quick comparison - if you are converting from stove top to slow cooker- 15-30 minutes translates to 4-6 hours on the low setting. If you would normally cook it for an hour (or more) you can count on around 8 hours on low in the slow cooker. This makes it ideal for getting your meal ready in the morning, then enjoying it in the evening for dinner.

Again - this baby is HUGE - if you are looking for a large one, this will do. If you have a "normal" family, I'd go for a smaller choice, because this is one case where big isn't always better!
profile.summary: For Big Families and Parties

profile.description: Deep-clean and sanitize sealed hard floors--including wood, tile, linoleum, and vinyl--in one fell swoop with the Shark S3501 Professional Steam Pocket Hard Surface Cleaner. Using just superheated tap water and patented two-sided microfiber pads, this lightweight, easy-to-use tool heats up in 30 seconds and automatically releases steam with every push-forward motion. A powerful weapon against ground-in dirt, dust, and dried spills.
profile.reviewText:
At age 60, I am not a huge fan of mopping floors, squeezing water out, and all of the hassles that come with scrubbing the floor. So, when I saw this in an awesome sale locally, I grabbed one for my kitchen. I looked in the box, and there wasn't a cute guy inside ready to mop my floor, so I figured I'd have to do it myself.

It was easy to assemble, click, click, click, and easy to figure out how to use. You plug it in and pull it back and forth, just like a regular mop, but without all of the dirty water.

This being my first steam mop, I was not aware how they worked. To prime the steam, you prime the machine by pumping the handle up and down a couple of times. Within 30 seconds, the steam comes out, and you are ready to mop. The steam is produced as you pull the mop back and forth, using that same pumping action naturally.

It swivels, turns, and even flops over to use both sides without changing the pad.

With 2 dogs and 2 cats living in our home, I thought I might need to mop my floor ahead of time, but I was pleasantly surprised by the fact that the steam actually cleaned my floor with nothing else. I used a little pumping action to add extra steam on the dirtiest spot.

The instructions remind you to check this out on a small area of your floor, since certain floors may not work well with steam. Be sure to follow these instructions.

My one complaint (if you can call it that), is that the mop doesn't stand upright by itself, but that is a part of the flip/flop option where you can use both sides of the pad by flopping it over.

I'm not going to say it makes mopping the floor fun, but it does make it easy!
profile.summary: My Floor was easy to clean ...

profile.description: Choose from 14 unique bread settings to enjoy bakery results at home! This 2-pound bread maker is easy to use thanks to the digital display, pre-programmed settings, and a fruit and nut dispenser that automatically adds extras at the right time. Youll get great results using the 14 baking functions, which include low-carb, gluten free, and artisan dough. You can choose the size loaf you're making1lb, 1.5lb, or 2lband how you want the crust to turn outlight, medium, or dark. The delay bake timer and even heating technology ensure that every loaf will come out just right, and at the right time! Included is a recipe book with over 80 recipes that are compatible with this 2-pound bread machine, a collapsible measuring cup and adjustable measuring spoon.
profile.reviewText: I have owned three bread makers in the past. All from different companies. My first one made loaves that were tall and looked funny. But I really loved the bread, and the smell that came with it! I finally wore it out. I hated digging the paddle out of the bottom. My second one was a tragic mistake by the company. It had an inherent flaw - bread stuck to the pan. Even after they replaced the pan for free - the second pan was even worse. I gave up making bread ... because even when I finally got the bread out of the pan, I still had to dig the paddle out of the bottom. I really loved my Sunbeam 5891 2-Pound Programmable Breadmaker, so much so that I actually recently purchased one for my daughter. It does many things the earlier bread makers didn't, including quickbread and cakes. It makes gluten-free bread. It has fast settings and normal settings. And it even has a jam setting! It is shaped so that loaves come out looking like loaves. Only one thing I didn't like - I had to dig the paddle out of the bottom. (sigh) And then - Breadman came out with this wonderful selection! A Bread Maker that does NOT leave the paddle sticking in the middle! Even more, it has all of the settings I used on my Sunbeam (although it is missing the cakes, which I didn't use) AND the automatic fruit and nut dispenser!!! So I set my Sunbeam aside, and "went for it." The bread maker of my dreams. How does it work? The feature works by creating a one-way paddle that collapses when it is reversed. So the paddle turns and kneads while it goes in one direction. At the end of the kneading cycles, the machine reverses the turning of the paddle and it collapses into the bottom of the pan. As a result, while you have the impression of the paddle in the bottom of the loaf, the paddle is not stuck inside of the bread! So don't think it's perfect, it's just much better than before. Cookbook and manual: This comes with a wonderful manual that even gives a comparison chart so that you can use whatever yeast is available in your store. All of the recipes use standard yeast, so you need to adapt them if you want to use fast-rise or other variations. The book is also very clear on how to use the various settings. Even more, the cookbook included has a wide selection of recipes for every setting. I would recommend using the included cookbook before you go out and buy any other recipe book for your machine. I did have a "tiny" problem with one of the recipes - for cinnamon raisin bread. It reversed two of the ingredient amounts - showing 1/2 cup yeast and 3/4 tsp raisins. :-( The mistake was easy to spot, by someone who knows a little bit about bread making. Features: One of my favorite features on this (besides not pulling the paddle out and having the automatic nut and fruit dispenser) is the fact that it will make quickbreads, and even has recipes for them. My next trip to the store will be for bananas and macadamia nuts - for banana macadamia nut bread. :-) For me, this machine was worth it - just for the two extra features. However, since it is so close to the Sunbeam, except for these two features, and the Sunbeam cost is much lower, you will need to make your own choice. Did I mention I really LOVE not having to dig the paddle out of the loaf? EDITED - I have dropped this rating down to 4 stars - When I attempted to make cinnamon raisin nut bread, the nuts got caught below the paddle and scratched the surface of the pan. Amazon immediately sent me out a replacement using overnight mail, and gave me 30 days to return the defective machine at their expense. If I encounter any future problems with the machine, I will pull the rest of the stars, but Amazon itself was very helpful in resolving the issue. Edited a year later ... Aside from the first problem with the paddle, my bread maker has performed without any further problems. A+ .... Edited Feb 2012: Since writing this review, a friend turned me on to Artisan Bread in Five Minutes a Day: The Discovery That Revolutionizes Home Baking . You do need a stone, but it is actually EASIER than the bread maker, and ;-) you definitely never have a problem with it. It takes less time and effort than using one of these. So, while I still love my machine, I do a lot more bread by hand now. Edited April 2013 - still my favorite ever breadmaker!
profile.summary: NO PADDLE IN THE BREAD ...

Since it fits, I went ahead and ordered the George Foreman GFP84BP Evolve Grill 84-Square Inch Deep-Dish Accessory Bake Pan which is perfect for even backing a small cake or casserole! This model opens wider than my earlier model making it even better for grilling steaks and making paninis, which is why it fits the deep dish. I would say 5 servings was "pushing it," but 4 servings (which is what we use) is perfect. My only complaint about the George Foreman is the tray that goes under it - I have mixed feelings, even with this one that fits deeper under the grill. On the positive side, having the tray be a separate piece means that it is easy, very easy, to pull it out and clean it without worrying about the crevices that come with other trays that fit underneath. At the same time, it can be moved by accident leaving your counter a mess. While I have used other indoor electric grills, George Foreman has become my favorite.
profile.summary: Fits my other removable plates ...

profile.description: Richard Sheff, MD is a family physician with over 30 years of experience in medicine. He chose the specialty of family medicine because he wanted to see and treat patients as whole people whose illness and wellness are a result of the complex interplay of their biological, psychological, social, and cultural circumstances. The years have taught him that to this must be added recognition of each patient's spiritual circumstances if they are truly to be seen as a whole person, including understanding their illness and wellness.
profile.reviewText:
As someone who works in a different field of the caring ministry, I was particularly drawn by Dr. Sheff's desire to combine both emotional and physical healing in his patients. I did one of my own internships inside of a hospital setting, as a hospital chaplain, and have acted as a hospice chaplain, so I was particularly intrigued by his desire to describe how his years of training molded him into the doctor he became.

Sadly, the medical system at that time (and even now) did not do the job it could to create doctors who cared for their patients as a whole being. Even worse, the demands of the field make it even harder for the doctors to remain a whole being themselves. Their mistakes and traumatic levels of training leave someone bruised and battered. While their knowledge increases, their compassion is put on hold until some later date ... and perhaps is never regained.

Perhaps the most memorable moments involved the cadavers that were used for the doctors to learn the intricate details of the human body. By placing the bodies in such sterile and cold environments, the doctors began to see the body only from a physical point of view, never as a whole person. And while the autopsies and the entire experience gained the doctors the physical experience they needed to identify diseases and illnesses, there was always a sense of intrusion upon the patients.

I was grateful for the ending, where Dr. Sheff finally began to listen to his patients, although it took much longer for him to begin listening to his own heart.

I strongly recommend this book for anyone considering the medical field, and found it personally interesting. I found myself questioning some of the times a pastor puts aside their own feelings, much like a doctor, and began looking at my own profession a bit differently. So, while I read this book thinking I would just be informed about doctors, I found myself changed. The book was, indeed, an unexpected friend.

I am grateful to Cadence for sending me a copy of this book so that I could add it to my reading list. I was very blessed.
profile.summary: An unexpected friend ...

profile.reviewText: One of the things you should really do if you are considering one of these is check around. I found the best value (in my case) was not on Amazon. profile.description: This sturdy and strong manual juicer is ideal for travel, camping, or for any time you want juice on-the-go. It juices all types of fruits and vegetables and is also ideal as a wheatgrass juice press. No electricity required, and, unlike many other manual juicers, you will be impressed by the versatility. Not only can you juice wheat grass, you can also enjoy fresh nutritious juice from leafy greens. Its unique single-auger juicer design uses an extremely gentle and efficient process to extract more high quality juice from all of your favorite fruits and vegetables with a simple turn of the crank.
profile.reviewText:
I enjoy canning, and I enjoy all of the wonderful gadgets that go with it, so I was actually EXCITED when Chefs Mark offered me a complimentary sample of their product to test at home and to consider reviewing.

Let's start with the basics - this is easy to assemble, easy to use, and best of all EASY TO CLEAN! I can tell you from personal experience that it takes longer for me to clean my electric juicer than to juice a basket of fruit. Not so with this, you disassemble it, most of the parts will actually go into the dishwasher, although they clean up without that.

In fact, there is not a single piece to worry about rusting.

I have also used salsa makers, so I was a bit concerned about whether this would stand up, since my manual salsa makers always have their handles break off. As a result, I not only tested this thoroughly, I also examined it. Because of the way it is built, with a spiral that pushes the fruit through, it does not have a place where it would get stuck easily or need to be forced. In fact, it it gets a bit tight, you simply loosen it about 1/2 turn backwards, and it quickly goes forward again. While it is plastic, I feel comfortable that this won't break nearly as easily as the other handles.

I tested this with the two most used fruits in our home, apples and oranges.

In the absence of any instructions as to cutting up the fruit, I cut the apples in sixths and pushed them through. They occasionally wouldn't seem to be moving, and I simply flipped them over and they moved through fine. One apple successfully produced nearly 1/2 cup of apple juice.

The oranges were a bigger puzzle since my electric juicer won't do oranges. To peel or not to peel, that was the question. I decided that if I had to peel them I didn't like it anyway, so I cut a small orange into fourths, unpeeled. Bingo, it went right through, the juice into the cup and the pulp (and peel) out the other end. Since oranges went so well, I will be doing lemons the same way.

It takes up about 1/4 of the space of the electric juicer and is perfect for doing smaller amounts of fruit.

Problems I encountered -

My counter wasn't perfectly clean, and the suction came loose at one point. I was impressed that it easily re-suctioned with a single twist.

There are instructions for assembling and disassembling and cleaning. There are no instructions for operating in the sense of whether to peel items, leave seeds in them (like apples), or generally what to do except to put the fruit in. While this is disconcerting (and a bit of an adventure), most cooks will quickly discover their own "best" way to handle these issues.

Special Note - Wondering what to do with all of that fiber? You can actually add it into your muffins or cakes. Since this comes out the end like tiny sausages, it is easy to measure and add to your favorites - apple would go well into bran or cinnamon muffins, orange into any cake-like muffin. Both would add not only fiber, but also great flavor.

While normally I would have deducted a star for the lack of instructions, this little baby is so practical and so fun, makes cute fiber sausages, and best of all is so easy to clean that I'm giving it the full five stars!

************

Edited - This morning I was making muffins for a group and wanted to add something special. I took a single orange and added the juice and the pulp to the recipe for a dozen chocolate chip muffins. I carefully washed the orange to make sure the peel was safe. Then I put the entire orange (1/4 at a time) through the juicer. After collecting everything from the other end, I added this to a recipe for a dozen chocolate chip muffins.

I got five stars for the way they turned out - a supreme delight. I know I would never have done this with my large electric juicer - too hard to get out, too hard to clean, too hard to get everything together. This has joined my "mixer" as a tool that I can use on a regular basis!
profile.summary: Handy, quick, just right for small jobs

profile.description: Enjoy the memory foam support and the microfiber comfort of this perfect pillow. While in the past, I bought whatever pillow was on sale, a couple of years ago, my husband's health began to fail.  Suddenly pillows became essential for propping, sitting, raising, and most importantly, getting a good night's sleep.

These are not the same as the other memory foam pillows I have used. They have a firm pillow of memory foam, then a cover on the outside of them that feels like polyester padding.  It is slippery when you lay on it.

profile.description: Eliminate the inconvenience of AA batteries - just charge and go with this sleek, ultra-convenient label maker. Packed with new features inspired by LabelManager users to help you get the results you want with more ease and convenience. The large 1 1/5 x 2 1/3 Inches screen displays two lines of label text. Plus, the graphical display lets you see text effects onscreen before you print. Works faster with an improved user interface that displays all menu options onscreen without scrolling and includes intuitive icons for formatting options. Familiar ABC - style keyboard. Offers quick access to special symbols. Choose from three font styles, six font sizes and one of eight different box or underline styles. Nine label memory and easy insertion of saved text. Prints up to 10 copies of the same label. Includes rechargeable lithium ion battery, charging cord, starter label cassette, one 1/2" x 10' black on white tape cartridge and user manual.
profile.reviewText: I have been using a label machine since we opened our store three years ago. My label machine of choice back then was the Brother PT-1950 P-touch PC-Ready Labeler for Small Workgroups. I was grateful to check out the Dymo Label Machine because there were some serious problems with my older machine. Here are the features I really like in the Dymo. 1) Rechargeable batteries included. No need to worry about the batteries, just plug in and keep charged, then when you are ready to go, grab the label machine and take it with you. 2) "Short" ends on the labels. The Brother left over an inch on either side of the labels, and wasted about 50% of the labels I made. Given the cost of the labels, this is a feature that is truly helpful. 3) The ability to easily save the label for re-use later. 4) The "sizing" feature on the Dymo. It is possible to designate a length of label, then ask the Dymo to print the label to that size. This is particularly nice for putting labels on Items I have canned. 5) The "fancy" outline capability on the labels (again, a nice feature for canned goods I enter in the fair). Nice counts. 6) The easy capability of making 2-line labels. 7) The ability to add symbols (Like $ % @) makes it very functional for a store or business. 8) The labels do come in clear, making the mirror image feature (a nice addition) practical for putting the label on the inside of a window or other glass and have it come through in the correct directions. A couple of areas that disappointed me - small, but I wanted to point them out. A) You cannot use the Dymo Label Manager while it is plugged in. The adapter it uses is intended ONLY for charging the label machine. So you really DO need to keep those batteries charged for when you are using it. B) It will take me awhile to get used to the Alphabetic keyboard ... C) The Brother PT had an "automatic cut" feature, this one must be manually cut by pushing the button hard enough to clip through the label. * Note - the video is a bit blurry, but I wanted to post it anyway so that you could see some of the features. It's a VERY handy machine!
profile.summary: Lightweight, Easy to Use ...

profile.description: The Quick 'N Easy Comfort Mattress offers the utmost in comfort, safety and convenience. Its inner core is encased in fire retardant barrier, meeting regulation 16 CFR 1633. A non-slip bottom and 4 corner straps keep the mattress securely in place. Two carry handles on the side make lifting and placement easier.
profile.reviewText:
We used this to replace the very uncomfortable mattress included that was included with my husband's hospital bed. I tested it before having him sleep on it, and found it firm but comfortable. He needs the firmness to be able to push off of it to stand.

I like the fact that it is nylon, because it feels nicer. But that makes it water resistant rather than waterproof, so I am using a washable waterproof pad under (and on top of) his sheets.

This comes in an easy to lift box.  Assembly amounts to unrolling it and tearing the plastic off. It quickly expands to full size, which is approx a twin long. In fact, we are using that size sheets on it.

One of my thoughts is that because of the size, this would make an EXCELLENT gift to someone living in a college dorm if their bed is twin long (many are). It would easily set on top of or replace the dorm mattress with a significantly higher level of comfort, and cost is low enough to leave it behind when college is done, and it is light enough to move from room to room.
profile.summary: Everything I hoped it would be

profile.description: Launch your way through cool "glow in the dark" tracks with the Techno Gears Marble Mania Vortex 2.0. The automatic marble launcher is just one feature of this 300+ piece construction set. Fun space sounds, 3-D connectors and glowing channels will have the entire family enjoying this new twist on a traditional marble run. Requires three AA batteries (not included). Ages 8+ years.
profile.reviewText:
Think autism, and you will know why I adore this particular marble run.

As a grandparent of a child with autism, I am always looking for things that will intrigue them. This does it.  It takes awhile to set up (and in my opinion needs to be kept set up - who wants to do it over and over), but once it is done correctly, it functions smoothly, recirculating the marbles (complete with sound) over and over again.

The manual for assembling this is very detailed, and I didn't find it hard to do at all. BUT, there is one thing you need to pay attention to - the order in which you assemble the pieces is critical to how it fits together. Instead of clipping into one another, these are held together with clips (not sure why they did it that way). So a higher piece must always be above a lower piece. That way, the marbles will always run smoothly. If you get it backwards, you end up with a bump in the roadway for the marbles that throws everything off.

Half of the fun is intended to be building a structure that works. That is a super idea for older children. However, at times it seems a bit more complex than it needs to be for a marble run. Think of it, in a sense, as a 300 piece 3D Puzzle with benefits!

I have used other marble runs and actually find them much easier to assemble, but not necessarily the same KIND of fun, or the same kind of challenge. This is unique in concept and implementation. I love the finished product, but think the process of assembly could have been simplified.
profile.summary: A 3D puzzle to assemble

profile.description: Eat fresh and healthy from freezer to table using FoodSaver Freeze 'N Steam bags. These microwaveable bags are designed with strong, multi-ply construction to block moisture and oxygen and prevent freezer burn. Always have a healthy meal on hand by prepping food, freezing in bags and then microwaving whenever you are ready for a hot meal. Enjoy fresh, seasonal foods any time of year by portion sealing in peak season and freezing for future use. Ideal for busy households too; forego the high-fat, high-calorie fast foods and serve quick, home-cooked meals in a snap with no pots or pans to clean either! Use with FoodSaver Heat-Seal Vacuum Sealing Systems to keep food fresh up to 5X longer. BPA free. Contains 16 Freeze 'N Steam quart-size microwave cooking bags.
profile.reviewText:
I purchased these at the time I purchased a number of items in bulk, and I want to mention that they work wonderfully.

I especially appreciate that the cook times are printed on the side of the bag, making it especially easy to use them. For that reason alone, they deserve five stars.

But, if you are considering using them, I want to remind you that these are in essence "steam" bags. I enjoy them most when I blanch and freeze vegetables to be re-used. These can be easily sealed and frozen.

It does give time for raw meat, eg. chicken, but I would recommend that you incorporate vegetables or herbs to give your chicken flavor. I normally freeze my chicken before sealing it, since it is often too juicy otherwise to give a good seal.

I do recommend them, but suggest that you consider how they are to be used before making your purchase.

OK, I confess. I have Echo and only purchased these because I could use Echo to control them. They work perfectly. After I installed the Hub, I am grateful to be able to say that the GE bulbs work well with it as well, and we now have most of our home controlled using this particular hub.

It plugs into an ethernet slot on my WiFi Router. Following a power outage, it had some difficulty reconnecting to a couple of bulbs, but that was quickly fixed by rerunning the app.

profile.description: Palais Glassware Elegant Bougeoir Collection, Set of 3 Hurricane Candle holders add a bit of flair and bring subtle warmth to your living space. Elegant enough for special occasions, but you'll want to leave them out every day. Bring a touch of royalty into your home with this Set of spectacular tall hurricane candle holders. Made up of glass , these beautiful candleholders will leave the viewers spell bound. A brilliant work of art from the Palais Glassware Elegant Bougeoir Collection, it will readily grace every contemporary room setting.
profile.reviewText:
Review of Amber finish

I received a free sample of these to examine for my review and was incredibly impressed.

I chose the amber finish, and with the candles inside they are ideal for any table or house decor. While I don't have a fireplace, I can picture them sitting on a mantle.

Because I originally thought these held a votive candle, they are larger than I expected. The photo actually shows the with a 3" pillar candle. Also, the stem is amber (not clear like the photo)  and have gold flecks on the exterior of the stem. At 12", 14", and 16" tall, they are an impressive set.

profile.summary: Amber with gold flecks

profile.description: The education solution from Kensington that offers an easy way to meet Common Core Standards when conducting tests with iPad tablets. Designed for the iPad Air and iPad 4th gen, this Kensington Wired Keyboard for education features a Lightning connector that provides easy plug-and-play installation without any software or drivers and eliminates the need to pair the tablet and keyboard. Because it's wired, there's also no need for batteries or recharging. The full-size keys are highly durable and tamper-resistant so they're far less susceptible to popping off or getting pried up.
profile.reviewText:
I use my iPad to do a lot of things, including taking notes at meetings, writing emails, and writing Amazon reviews. While touchscreen keyboards are nice, I have to use the one or two finger approach which is relatively slow. I haven found a Bluetooth keyboard that feels good.

This keyboard is perfect for my needs. With no concerns about batteries and pairing, I simply slip it into my case and bring it with me.

There seems to be several conversations concerning the power usage because it plugs into your iPad. Since this is a mechanical device, if there is any poer draw at all, it will be minuscule, especially compared to the power required to maintain a Bluetooth connection to a keyboard.

A good choice, I can now touch type again.

If you are looking for some keyboard hacks, I have included a link in my comments section - allowing you to use your keyboard a bit more efficiently
profile.summary: Ten finger typing again.

profile.description: Agatha Christie's most audacious crime mystery, reissued with a striking new cover designed to appeal to the latest generation of Agatha Christie fans and book lovers. Roger Ackroyd knew too much. He knew that the woman he loved had poisoned her brutal first husband. He suspected also that someone had been blackmailing her. Now, tragically, came the news that she had taken her own life with a drug overdose. But the evening post brought Roger one last fatal scrap of information. Unfortunately, before he could finish the letter, he was stabbed to death!
profile.reviewText:
I am not certain that Agatha Christie was the first to write a novel in the way this one was written, but she certainly did it well! Having Dr. Sheppard write the novel on behalf of Hercule made this a treasure, and the story is revealed one page at a time. (I guess that sounds silly, but sometimes authors do jump around, and Agatha Christie does not).

All of the clues are in place, the story is told in completeness, almost, but only Hercule Poirot can untangle the final story and reveal to us what his brain cells have already told him.

While the Agatha Christie stories are now dated, if you have not read this particular novel of hers, I do recommend it as one of her best.
profile.summary: One of my favorites ...

profile.description: Don't leave home without your Portable Weather Alert Radio! This portable Public Alert Radio provides emergency alerts anywhere in the U.S. When traveling, boating, hiking or working outdoors, use the WR601 to receive weather information and emergency broadcasts from the National Weather Service. With the non-volatile memory built-in, no need to reprogram your SAME codes when the batteries run out! Features: Monitors U.S. Emergency All Hazards, and Emergency Alert System (EAS) weather bulletins, warnings, & forecasts Receives all National Oceanic & Atmospheric Association (NOAA) reports, which provides all available emergency advisories on tornadoes, severe thunderstorms, floods, evacuations, civil danger warnings & more Flexible programmingselect Specific Area Message Encoding (SAME) broadcasts in up to 6 different counties 100 decibel audio alarm with visual alert signal 3 levels of NOAA messages: Statement, Watch, Warning Non Volatile Memory Back-up Dual alarm with snooze function Includes convenient stand (to hold unit) and AC Adapter
profile.reviewText:
I have actually programmed a dozen or more of these for my friends who weren't able to figure them out.

It has a selection of stations so you can receive the one closest to you, and you can program in your own county so that you don't have to hear all of the alerts in your area.

We recently moved and we had to reprogram ours without instructions. It took me awhile, but we got everything right.

My only complaint is that occasionally when the stand is separated from the power supply there is a surge and I have to reset everything.

I enjoy this model because we can take it in the car with us when we need to stay on top of the weather.
profile.summary: Hard to program, but very nice

profile.description: George Foreman Omelet Plate for the G5 George Foreman mulit interchangeable plate grill
profile.reviewText:
I recently purchased this based on someone else's review who mentioned these could do a lot more than omelets. How wonderfully true.

While I have made omelets in these (very nice 3 omelets, each one prepared to order), I fell in love with it over Thanksgiving weekend when I was using up leftovers.

I took a roll of refrigerator biscuits, chopped turkey, a slice of swiss cheese, and a tiny spoonful of apple pie.

I flattened the biscuits and used two for the bottom and one for the top, using 9 of the 10 biscuits. I added the chopped turkey, 1/3 slice of swiss cheese, and the apple pie onto the two I had flattened together on the bottom. Then I placed the third flattened biscuit on the top, trying to seal it in place a bit.

I added a tiny bit of butter to each section once it was hot, then placed the biscuits into the plates. Within 3 minutes, I had an awesome turkey pocket sandwich using only ingredients I had on hand.

FYI, I heated the grill to Hi, then turned it down to low while it was cooking, and it was a very crispy brown.

Pillsbury suggests using the grands, but I would have had to go to the store, so I experimented using the smaller ones, which came out fine. More than fine! This was a fun experiment for me, but best of all it could easily accommodate different family members wanting different ingredients in their little sandwiches.

The recipe book also includes instructions for making small pie crusts inside of each well, which could be interesting, although I haven't tried that. So if you are interested in making this kind of product, and if you already have the grill, this will save you from purchasing 2-3 other small appliances.

This plate has doubled the value of my grill for me. Highly recommended!
profile.summary: A Roll of Biscuits plus Leftovers equals a pocket sandwich

profile.description: No more scrambling to gather together all your must have items before dashing out of the door ...introducing the Lexx Wallet Case for iPhone 4S and iPhone 4. Lexx gives you stylish functionality in a comfortably slender design, while keeping all you need in one secure place, for convenience and peace of mind. Its hard shell is wrapped in genuine leather for a premium look and feel, while protecting your iPhone and providing two handy slots for up to 8 cards...such as credit cards, travel card, driving license, store cards, cash and keys. Lexx allows you full access to your iPhone's screen, camera and all the ports. Safe, sleek and slim. For more details please visit www.vaultskin.com
profile.reviewText:
Today I don't walk out of my house without my iPhone in my pocket. While I found a wallet that allowed me to squeeze my phone in at Wally World, It meant grabbing my phone, grabbing my wallet, and squeezing my phone into my wallet!

With this I am keeping my Driver's license in the top pocket, and my gas card and one other credit card in the side pocket. It also has room to keep some cash using it this way, meaning I am now truly grab and go as I pop out the door. I can't tell you how important this is to me.

The descriptions says "up to 8 cards" but I wouldn't recommend it for that many, unless they were slim pieces of paper. The side pocket closes magnetically, and I would be concerned about losing my cards if it were overloaded. I would suggest 2-3 as a max for credit cards.

This will NOT replace your "real wallet," if you are like me and carry loads of stuff. It won't carry your change and your keys. But it will let you get out the door for most trips quickly and easily with a minimum of hassle. And if you want to keep a couple of keys in the magnetic pocket instead of the cards, it is your choice!

The wallet case popped on my iPhone 4 very easily and did not cover any area I needed access to, including the back camera, making this very functional.

The front pocket is very tight (at least for now) which is why I entrusted my drivers license to it. Hopefully I won't be having to pull it out too often for an officer of the law!

It fit on one of my chargers easily without any problem - the other required an extender to make it work correctly. So you will need to check your dock or charger to make sure it will accept this slight thickness without problems.

And it really doesn't feel any different holding or using this than the cover I was already using. It saves me loads of hassle in worrying about one more thing to lose (my wallet) when running around.

The only thing I miss on this (that I had on my other wallet) was a strap to wrap around my wrist. But it is a small price to pay.

I am grateful (very grateful in this case) to have received a complimentary sample to test, since I have replaced my regular wallet and am using this for myself.

Very nice! If you are looking (like I was) for a quick and easy solution for the basics, you won't go wrong with this.
profile.summary: What I've been looking for!

profile.description: Are you seeing straight or seeing double? Either way, you have to call it fast to win this high energy dice game. Scoop up two batches of dice and let them roll. Quick. All players scan the array for matching symbols between the orange and white dice. The first to call a match gets to grab all the dice with that symbol. No Matches? No problem. It's another chance to win. Shout "Nada." to collect all the remaining dice. Think sharp and act fast to match, snatch and win. If you're really feeling loco for Nada, mix it up with the additional game variations.
profile.reviewText:
In the directions it states that this game is aimed at ages 7 to adult. However, I would suggest that it will most likely be enjoyed by elementary school age children. Even then the game is not as fascinating as some others and could provide a few arguments among the kids.

There are four variations of the game, but all involve the same process, you roll the dice then try to find a match on the orange and white dice. If you are correct you get to keep all of the dice with that Image. The one with the most dice at the end wins.

Since children are naturally competitive, it is sometimes difficult to tell which one calls the number first and there can be arguments. (The rules say you start over when this happens.).

Older children and adults will likely grow bored after a short period of time.

The place I can best see this game is at a birthday party. The host can have door prizes arranged with each child receiving a gift, but having them numbered from first to last.

I received a complimentary sample to test for a review.
profile.summary: Nada - best for yournger children - with supervision

profile.description: The G16 is the perfect bulb for accenting your home. While not dimmable, this light bulb creates a warm atmosphere, while providing your family cost savings and efficiency. We recommend it for accent lighting, chandeliers, string lighting, specialty fixtures, signs, and as a low wattage night light. G7 Power believes in energy solutions that make sense, both economically and aesthetically. We're a small town business with big time products, started by local Veterans with the goal of bringing sensible energy solutions to your home and office.
profile.reviewText:
As a top reviewer, we are occasionally offered complimentary products for review - this one was generously offered to me by the manufacturer, so I agreed. Once it arrived, I realized I didn't have the right socket to test it, until I grabbed an old string of Christmas lights with the large socket. It is a candelabra light, and if you are looking here, I suspect it is exactly the kind of light you want.

This was my first experience with an LED light and I am suitably impressed. Here are some first impressions:

It is shatterproof
It is bright
It does have a nice black base, just like the photo, kind of surprising for me in a light bulb ... but it looks classy is the best way to describe it.
I timed it, and it did last 50,000 hours without going out. JUST KIDDING - longevity is one thing I really can't test with a lifetime this long, I would be testing it for nearly six years.

Nevertheless, as far as I can tell, this is far superior to the previous glass bulbs while saving energy and your electric bill.

The one thing I would mention is that if you replace your bulb you replace all of them at the same time with the same type of bulb to give your candelabra a uniform look. We currently have an overhead in the living room with a different size bulb where we didn't take my advice - it is funny to look at because the different bulbs that ended up there have different amounts of "white" - making the color uneven.
profile.summary: A powerful LITTLE light for your candelabra

profile.description: Kid's Air Bed - Great for camping, nap time or sleepovers! Easy to use hand-held 2-in-1 pump can inflate or deflate the air bed in approximately 3 minutes. A special one-way intake valve insures no air is lost during the inflating process. No need to blow up the bed manually with your mouth  Deflated dimensions: 60*37*7"  Inflated dimensions: 62*39*9"  Supported Max Weight: 132 lbs. (60 KG)  Flock top, PVC side and bottom:  Travel bag: Nylon (included)  Side and bottom PVC thickness: 0.31mm, top flock with thickness 0.52mm.  Bed/Coil Construction: Horizontal Coils  Recommended for kids ages 3 and up  Folded dimensions: 17.75" * 8.75" * 5.65"  Pump Type: External AC air pump 110V (included)
profile.reviewText: I have a seven year old granddaughter who loves anything to do with camping. She is forever making tents out of her blankets and sleeping on the floor. Since my husband and I care for her when our daughter isn't home, we were looking for an easy solution to her being able to stay over with us. At our age, hauling out a heavy twin air mattress is a bit of a pain, especially since I injured my rotator cuff. This is light enough for her to carry! As soon as she saw this she "fell in love" with it. As soon as I picked it up, I fell in love as well. It has a "two stage" air hole that can be used. Stage 1 is fully open and pumps up fast. Very fast. They say 3 minutes? To 80% was about 30 seconds. (You can see how quickly it inflates in the video - there is no time lapse) After you get a majority of the air in, you close it to stage 2. Air goes in more slowly at this point, but it doesn't come out. This allows you to fully achieve a firm mattress. Not only is this light to set up, once the mattress is full you can easily move it into location. It is large enough for her to spread out on, and she loves going to sleep on it. With my experience with air mattresses, I do recommend you get a lightweight blanket or mattress pad. While it has a nice top, this will give it the protection from all kinds of incidents that can happen with kids - and will make it just a touch more comfortable. I have given a video, mostly so that you can see how quick the process is. I actually sat under the mattress while it blew up. I have filled and emptied the mattress and must admit it is as easy to empty as to fill and put away, especially with a little "help" from granddaughter. Because it is so light she can fold it and put it in the bag with just a little help from me. Five stars! Very much Five stars. I am grateful to have received a sample mattress to test for my review, and am even more grateful for the wonderful grandchild who is enjoying it.
profile.summary: Light, Easy, Portable, and perfect for grandkids

profile.description: This is a set of 4 professional heavy duty sand bags. Their unique saddlebag design can be draped over or clamped onto light stand legs, or to boom arms to provide extra stability. With dual 10" x 9" interior compartments, these heavy duty bags can be filled and emptied over and over again with sand, gravel, even nuts and bolts. These sandbags will prove to be an integral part of your studio system for years to come.
profile.reviewText:
These sandbags are easy to use because of the saddlebag style. You can add to each side of the saddlebags to fill.

As far as holding 20 pounds, I believe that is the maximum weight that these can hold without tearing - not the amount of sand that you can use to fill them. So if you use metal weights or gravel inside them, you need to be cautious about not overfilling them.

We are using ours to hold down some outdoor items during the wind, and they have proven to be very effective. As I look at my Christmas ornaments, I am making sure these are ready to go for the lighter weight items.

I received a free sample of these to test and have been pleased with the results.
profile.summary: Can be filled with anything

profile.description: Express yourself! Set of 2 replacement grills. Easy to fit and suitable for Jongo S3 speakers. Color coordinate to match your mood.
profile.reviewText:
This wireless speaker provides excellent sound and is designed to be connected to others giving more of a surround sound feel. The one issue I had when trying to connect it actually was the "lots of options." I want to be able to plug and play ... and I did have to read through the directions just to make it work.

This seems to be the year of the wireless speaker - and this fits in well with most designs and offers lots of compatibility. It even has an app to allow you to stream from your iPad.

If you are looking for different options - this has them. If you are looking for simple (sigh) the very wonderful choice this offers makes people like me intimidated.
profile.summary: Good sound - lots of options

profile.description: With millions of fishermen casting their lines worldwide, this will be the perfect clock to "mount" on walls in their man caves, cottages, basements or garages. Dial features twelve of the most popular freshwater gamefish in North America, beautifully illustrated by world-renowned outdoor artist, Jon Q. Wright. To add ambiance, each hour is announced by a variety of action fishing sounds. As an added bonus, packaging contains educational information on fish behavior and their natural habitats. Clock is perfect for wall or desk, using the built-in stand. A light sensor deactivates sounds when room is dark. 3 AA batteries, not included. 8 inch diameter.
profile.reviewText:
My dad is a trout fisherman. And just last month, our granddaughter caught her first fish - a sign of many to come! So I was happy to check out this gamefish clock.

Unlike the tractor clocks (different tractors on the hour), or the bird one (chirping happily), this clock will bring back thoughts of a splashy fish. It splashes on the hour, and reminds you of that moment you feel that pull on the end of your line.

The light sensor works correctly, meaning it only splashes when it is light out, giving you a peaceful night's sleep. No fish waking you up on the hour.

I have given this four stars instead of five because my Granddaughter is learning to tell time and isn't able to use this because it doesn't have numbers. I might not have even noticed the lack of numbers if it weren't for her.

I received a complimentary sample of this clock to test for a review.
profile.summary: It splashes on the hour

profile.description: The Nerf Rebelle Messenger Blaster can do so much more than launch a dart - you can write and send secret messages on the darts. Use the secret decoder to see the message. Measures approximately 9 1/2-inches long. Ages 8 and up.
profile.reviewText:
OK, forget the spy thing! This is a hot Nuff gun made for girls! And it has awesome range!

From the purple (Sophia the first's favorite color) to the easy to spot Nerf bullets, this enthralled my granddaughter. It took her awhile to sort things out
If you hold the trigger while you pull back the loader, the bullets shoot
This hoots one at a time, and you have to recock every time
Shooting up means it goes further
You have to watch where the Nerf bullets go

We moved the action to our large back yard, since I was a bit worried about the street and cars.

Perhaps if she was into spies, the other aspects would have interested her. But for now, the fun gun is enough!
profile.summary: A girl gun - cool

profile.description: When their only daughter Blair leaves the family nest, Luther and Nora Krank (Tim Allen and Jamie Lee Curtis) decide to book an island cruise to beat the yuletide blues and just skip the holidays. But their decision to boycott tradition has the whole neighborhood in an uproar, and when Blair callson Christmas Eve to announce a surprise visit with her new fiance, the Kranks have just twelve hours to perform a miracle and pull themselves and their neighbors together to throw the best celebration ever! With fast-paced energy and support from Dan Aykroyd, Cheech Marin, Jake Busey and M. EmmetWalsh, this hilarious adaptation of John Grisham's best-selling novel, "Skipping Christmas" has become "an instant family classic!" (Gorman Woodfin, CBN)
profile.reviewText:
I was first introduced to this wonderfully tender book by John Grisham back in 2001. However, I do not enjoy the movie nearly as much as the book itself.

What was tender humor in the book became a bit slapstick in the movie, even though the plot is very close to the original book.

The basic idea is that once their daughter leaves home, Luther Krank decides to get away from the ice and snow. His solution? By not spending money on Christmas, he can save enough to go to the Caribbean. Unfortunately, his neighbors don't like this departure from the norm.

Perhaps I would have enjoyed the movie more if I hadn't fallen in love with the book, but for me, the movie came out a mediocre.
profile.summary: OK, but book is better - much better
