profile.description: The Stepaire Bandit Nap Pad is a convenient all-in-one nap pad with its very own built-in pump, fleece blanket and pillow! Kids will love inflating their own nap pad for daycare, preschool, travel and Grandma's house. The one-inch inflatable nap pad creates an effective barrier from cold floors and adds an extra layer for ultimate comfort. Comes with a convenient carrying bag
profile.reviewText:
I had thought this little nap pad would make a nice addition to have on hand for little ones needing a nap. Sadly, the product is better in concept than in implementation.

It is narrow and long, so if your toddler tosses and turns, this may not be the right choice, but it will handle a taller toddler with no problem.

The Good:
The blow up portion slides in and out easily making this washable.
It has a nice wide fleece covering, that will go over your toddler when he/she is laying on it.
Colors are nice.
Once it is blown up, it makes a nice pad.
The head portion seems very nice to lay your head down.

The Bad:
After 10 minutes of pumping on the pump, it only had the tiniest amount of air. (To those who are wondering YES I had the emptying part closed. Yes I wore shoes. Yes I pumped and pumped and pumped).

I finally gave up and opened the back and blew it up myself. It only took about 4-5 large breaths. It is possible the pump was defective, but I a unable to tell since it is completely enclosed within the mattress.

So yes to the product, no to the pump. Since the key factor here seems to involve being able to pump it up in 40 seconds with your foot, I probably would look around to find something that met my needs, unless you aren't adverse to blowing it up yourself.
profile.summary: Easier to blow up by mouth

profile.description: The Oliso Pro Smart Vacuum Sealer is powerful enough for commercial use, yet compact enough to easily fit on your kitchen counter or in any drawer. The revolutionary PUNCH-&-SEAL technology combined with the heavy-duty multi-layer constructed bags keeps food fresh 5X longer, reduces food waste, and saves you hundreds of dollars a year on groceries. The Oliso Pro Smart Vacuum Sealer also features a no-touch start system, which allows you to just insert a VAC-SNAP bag and the vacuum sealer does the rest. Works great for microwaving, simmering and sous vide cooking. Advanced functions include a moist mode liquid detection feature, which allows for greater precision when sealing wet foods or liquids. Dry mode allows you to seal dry goods, such as herbs and spices. Stop & seal mode works great for soft/fragile foods and the flexi tube attachment seals bottles and jars with ease. The large drip tray is removable and easy to clean. The pre-made heavy duty VAC-SNAP zipper top bags are resealable up to 10 times, BPA free and made of #7 recyclable material. Includes 1 Oliso Pro Smart Vacuum Sealer, 1 Flexi Tube, 1 Magnetic Zip Disc, Wine + Oil Freshkeeper, 3 Medium (1 Quart) VAC-SNAP bags, 2 Large VAC-SNAP (1 Gallon) Bags. Backed by a 1 year limited lifetime manufacturer warranty.
profile.reviewText: I use a LOT of ziplock bags even though I have a different sealer. The problem has always been the inability to open the bag without scissors or a knife on hand (not very handy for lunches) and having to have lots of extra space to cut open the bags and reseal them. This handy sealer takes care of both issues. The bags "zip" open (and shut if you are on the go) AND when you are at home it creates a vacuum seal on your food. So you can seal it, take some out, and reseal it - up to 10 times. This makes it perfect for items you use only a small amount of, either frozen or dry! So it works very well for anyone who wants to be able to easily open an item and reseal it. At the same time, the bags are very sturdy and well insulated and are perfect for freezer foods. Since it has both a dry and wet setting, you can correctly seal your items without worries. A couple of things you do need to remember. First, it comes with a disk to ensure that your bags are sealed. If they aren't the vacuum won't hold, so make sure you use the disk, even if you think you have sealed it correctly. Second, it creates a strong vacuum seal. That is a good thing, but it is important to remember when you are thinking about using it on dry items, since it will "crunch" your pretzels and potato chips once the seal is complete. I purchased the quart bags Oliso Frisper Vac-Snap Quart Bags - 20 pack to go with this since I have found over time this is the best size for my use and works well with everything from cheese to snack items.
profile.summary: Everything I always wanted in a sealer

profile.description: Make them up, shake them up and show them off with the cutest display set around, the Glitzi Globes Disney Princess Castle.
profile.reviewText:
If your kids are into the glitzy globes, they will enjoy showing them off in this castle which holds 12 globes plus the four character large globe that is included. All pieces snap together easily.

Besides the large globe, which holds four princesses, you can also make three smaller globes to display.

To make the large globe you place all four princesses and their thrones inside of the large globe along with a glitter piece. After covering it and making sure it is sealed, you add water, then spin to break up the glitter. You can also spin the princesses. The hole has a plug at the top.

The small globes are made using the treasure chest. You place an animal on each of the three bottoms. You place a bottom on
one side and a globe on the other. Then, after adding the glitter, you close it to seal it. You do have to shake pretty vigorously to shake up the glitter.

To give perspective, the animals and princesses are smaller than a fingernail. So these are very small.

I timed it, and the total assembly time for all of the globes was less than 7 minutes. So don't count on this being a fun craft activity that will last awhile. Instead, these are anticipated to be display collectables once made.

My granddaughter is into tiny figures and toys, so I will see how long these keep her interest. But since she enjoys playing with the toys instead of looking at them, her interest in these probably won't last long. Given the hefty price tag, I probably wouldn't have paid for this.
profile.summary: Princesses and animals thumbnail sized

profile.description: With his faithful Indian Companion, Tonto, the daring and resourceful masked rider of the plains let the fight for law and order in the early western United States. Nowhere in the pages of history can one find a greater champion of justice. Return with us now to those thrilling days of yesteryear. From out of the past come the thundering hoof beats of the great horse, Silver! The Lone Ranger rides again!.
profile.reviewText:
My husband loves all of the Lone Ranger titles, so when Dreamwork Classics offered me the opportunity to try these out and comment on them for a review, I was happy to do so.

The works are amazingly clear given the age of the original series, and the sound quality was well done. I found no problems with watching them, except to get them away from my husband long enough to check them out for a review.

Besides my husband's enjoyment of the series, I have fond memories of them as a child, watching the series with my family. While the final episodes were in color, I can only tell by watching them today, since we did not have a color TV and all of them were black and white for us.

These 8 episodes are especially fun to watch.

Five stars because of the quality of the reproduction.
profile.summary: Hi Yo Silver Away ...

profile.description: The Brew-in-Mug Extra-fine Tea Infuser with Lid, is complete with an easy grip silicon rimmed stainless-steel lid. The infuser gives you a perfect even brew every time, and enables you to brew fine teas such as Rooibos tea to large whole-leaf teas like Oolong tea. It fits in American standard mugs. Flip the lid and it works as an infuser holder. With this infuser, brewing your favorite cup of tea is now easier than ever!
profile.reviewText:
When I purchased this, I thought it would set down inside of the teapot. It doesn't. It is intended to sit on TOP of the cup with the base in the water.

It is much larger than my teaballs (a plus), but since I can't use it inside of my teapot, and it won't fit nicely on top, that isn't necessarily a great thing. It will fit into a standard cup with the rim holding up the edges.

I had wanted it to make cold brew coffee and tea, and it does work for both of them, but not the way I hoped. Three stars, it is OK. I wouldn't have purchased it if I realized the lid was simply a cover and not a seal.
profile.summary: Perfect, note that lid doesn't seal

profile.description: Jeaneez! Enjoy the comfort of leggings with the stylish, modern look of jeans. These leggings look just like real skinny jeans, and the have light compression zones to make your back side and legs look thinner and firmer, while also minimize love handles. There are no bulky zippers, buttons, or hooks which makes for a seamless look when layering. Perfect for everyday wear, or dressed them up for a night on the town.
profile.reviewText:
Having recently lost weight, I decided to pick up some leggings. I am still in the 14/16 range, so I chose the L/XL. I must admit, I would NOT have been happy if I were still a larger size. But at this range, they worked, with one exception.

The area where I sit is still larger than they have planned. Either that, or I want to wear them too high. If you look at the photo, the gal is wearing them low. So these do ride down lower than I normally wear my pants.

Other than that, I love these. They fit slim tight, and hug my curves. And best of all, the design makes them wearable in public.

Comfortable and sexy.
profile.summary: Fit Slim Tight, run small, not a lot of derriere space, but I love them.

profile.reviewText: I purchased two of these locally when I began buying raw milk, since I needed to buy my own containers, and they needed to be glass to rapidly cool the milk. I LOVE the shape of these, and they fit nicely in my refrigerator. Unfortunately, since we are transporting the milk home in these, having the lid not seal is a bit problematic! So after reviewing my options, I ended up buying JARDEN HOME BRANDS #68100 Ball 6PK 1/2GAL W/M Jar. I was unable to find them locally, and bought them through Amazon. At the same time, when I get the milk home, I put it in these containers. By holding the seal tightly, you can shake these, and they are easier to use to pour with than the mason jars. It is VERY hard to find glass today, so I am grateful for these. While I use milk in mine, since glass lets your beverages get cooler, it is always nice to have a glass jug on hand!
profile.summary: Only problem is the sealing lid

profile.description: Breeze through food preparation tasks with the beautifully designed Chef'n PalmPeeler (Cherry). Peel fruits and vegetables with this comfort-designed peeler. Nestling comfortably in the palm of a hand, slide the peeler on to a finger to peel through peaches, pears, and more. Power through peeling tasks with the 18/10 stainless steel blade and remove potato eyes with the tool on the peeler's tip. With soft palm and finger grips, peel in comfort without worrying of dropping the peeler or accidental slips. Clean the peeler easily on the top rack of the dishwasher.
profile.reviewText:
First and foremost, I purchased this item in a chefs store and did not pay the shipping cost found here on Amazon, but now that I've used the peeler, I would pay it, if I couldn't find it locally because I will never go back to the old way of peeling. Really, it is revolutionary!

First of all, the ruberized ring is open, and slides easily onto my center finger. The blade then runs up and down from my finger to my wrist. With a simple motion, almost like petting the carrot, the peel comes off. I completed two pounds of carrots in just a few minutes. It was a completely natural movement! Best of all, it worked smoothly and I only had to go over any area a single time, if anything, it almost peeled too deeply.

After many years of cooking, I can't believe that someone came up with this wonderful invention!
profile.summary: I will never go back!

profile.description: Designed to be slim and stylish, the FUEL iON Charging Pad provides the perfect solution for home or travel. Slip the FUEL iON Pad into a travel bag, or set its minimalist design on a nightstand to always have the power of wireless magnetic charging at your convenience. Using a compatible FUEL iON Case for iPhone 5/5S, Samsung Galaxy S4, Samsung Galaxy S5, or Samsung Galaxy Note 3, simply place the phone on the FUEL iON Charging Pad to magnetically secure and charge. Its simply better than competing wireless charging technologies - FUEL ion's powerful rare-earth magnets form a direct connection to charge compatible phones as fast as a cord connection. The FUEL iON Charging Pad is backed by a 2-year warranty and has built in circuit protection against over voltage, over current, and short circuit.
profile.reviewText:
I received a free sample of this item for my iPhone 5s to examine and test for my review. This is my honest impression.

I really didn't expect to like this item as much as I actually do. I was already using a battery case that offered complete protection for my phone AND synched seamlessly with my computer when plugged in.

However, there are some issues with a battery case, including the weight and size. If you enjoy "Hey Siri," you actually have to turn her off when using a battery case, because she drains both batteries dry in less time than you would normally use for one battery! This Hybrid is actually very cool!

First of all, since it is simply a magnetic way of connecting the charge, it is more efficient than Qi. There is no real loss of power between the two items.

Second, the case is actually easy to put on and remove. Unlike some cases, this has a small clip at the bottom that allows you to easily release it from the case. This is important if you synch your iPhone using a cord, since my computer did not recognize the phone using the included micro cord. I normally synch using Bluetooth, but a recent update required a direct connect to reset that feature.

Third, This is easy to use. If you want a battery for the case, you can purchase one separately. I am grateful they included one with the package they sent me because you can charge both the charger and the phone at once. Place the charger, then place the phone. They both charge. Slip both in your purse or briefcase when you leave, and you always have an easy way to charge your phone.

Fourth, They included a back up plan. Every item, the charger (of course) the case, the battery ALL can be charged using a standard cord. SO, if you are away from home and charger, you can still use a standard cord to charge your phone or battery.

The magnets almost jump together, and they firmly hold the phone in place. Having this on the table next to where I work means that I can keep it charged any time I am at home, keep it in sight, and not worry about plugging it in or unplugging it. It really is grab and go.

The battery is especially nice since it also has a USB port so that I can use it to charge other items as well.

I debated at first about deducting a star because of the synch issue. BUT, since the case easily slips on and off, and since it is so convenient, and since I normally synch without a cord anyway, I didn't feel like it was a big enough issue to deduct a star.

They also sell a car charger, or you can use a micro cord in your car. The car charger is a "vacuum stick on" and comes with a plug with two USB slots, another very nice touch. Since my car has a textured dash, it actually would not stick, but I used it in my cup holder where it works. Again, you don't have to worry about plugging it in or unplugging it - simply place it on the magnetic surface and it remains charged.

EDITED - I stand behind my five star rating. From the time I first used my case on the 5S until this week, it never left my phone. BEFORE I upgraded, the one thing I checked was to see if this was available for my new phone. This is the only time I have ever been more concerned about the case than the phone. I then immediately purchased the case for the iPhone 6 - and my transition was complete.

I have used this constantly, including adding the battery pack to my purse when the phone was running low. So I am not only a happy reviewer, I am now a full customer who still loves this.
profile.summary: EDIT - Just upgraded to an iPhone 6 and this was the first thing I bought

profile.description: The SunBell Solar Lamp and Phone Charger offers a unique all-in-one design. It works as a reading lamp, a ceiling lamp, a flashlight, and as a mobile phone charger. profile.reviewText:
While I don't intend to take this on a camping trip, I love having this solar lamp on my patio. We live in a rural area where light is hard to come by, and I appreciate solar. Unfortunately, as you probably understand, I don't get a lot of sun on my patio. This has an external charger that I can lay out to my yard where it does get enough sun to keep it charged.

This evening (when did it start to get dark so early?) we ordered Pizza. I had this hanging from our porch swing, and it provided enough light for the pizza delivery guy to deliver and for us to dig in on one of the few nice evenings we have had recently.

profile.summary: You Light Up My Life

After Peace Corps in the Andes Mountains of South America, she pursued an MFA in studio art, worked in clay then fiber and fabrics, and now she draws, paints, journals prolifically, and writes poems and prose. profile.reviewText:
As someone who enjoys the meditative aspect of Labyrinths, I picked up this book in hopes of finding new ways of "walking" the labyrinth after realizing how meditative coloring was as a whole.

This book has an awesome section at the beginning on the history of Labyrinths, the types of Labyrinth, and even directions for creating your own, either on paper or in real space. There is a space for meditations on the opposing page (or back of the one you are drawing on), but if you use markers, it will bleed through.

I prefer to remove my pages for coloring, and this does NOT have perforations, but the designs are far enough away from the center that it is easy to tear the pages out.

Most of the designs are relatively simple, some are more complex than I like (why I chose four stars).

I find that choosing the colors to match my mood works best, along with attempting to create a visual path into the maze. This helps as I retain the pages and use them for further meditation. I have done some with crayons, some with colored pencils, and some with markers. I found that long-term, the ones with the glitter crayola markers provided an unexpected benefit since they provide a surface for my fingers to follow as I trace and retrace the path.

I really wouldn't recommend this as a coloring book for just anyone - rather as an extension of the Labyrinth for someone who is looking for this particular type of meditation. As a coloring book alone, it would be boring. As an experience, it is awesome.
profile.summary: If you love Labyrinths, this book is a good choice

profile.description: Easy to read display with high contrast blue backlight to make the measurements easily visible.
profile.reviewText: I often use scales when cooking and dieting and I especially appreciate this scale which includes its own "slip-free" bowl to use while weighing. You can also use your own box or bowl, but this one fits so nicely (and holds 2 liters) that you will probably end up using it most of the time. It fits nicely over the scale as a cover, so you can keep it right with the scale. This is the smaller of the Smart Weigh scales and will weigh up to 2000 grams (in US terms, that is a little over 4 1/2 pounds). Since a majority of my weighing needs fall into this capacity, it is perfect in my kitchen, whether measuring fruit for canning or measuring the quantity of food I am supposed to be consuming. However, if you need something larger, Smart Weigh does offer Smart Weigh CSB5KG Cuisine Digital Scale with Removable Bowl 11lbs / 5000g x 1g - Black which weighs items up to 11 pounds. It includes clear instructions - and is very simple to use. I love the ease of doing "tare weight" because you simply put the bowl (or other item) on the scale before turning it on. It automatically begins your weight at -0-. The Mode (M) allows you to quickly move between ounces and grams (as wells as ozt and dwt). Since many recipe books include the gram weight of foods, having it available is very handy. Something important is the ability to calibrate the scale if it gets out of calibration. All in all, this is not only an accurate scale but it is also easy to use and works nicely in the kitchen. I received a complimentary sample to test for my review. I am happy to report that it surpassed my expectations.
profile.summary: Comes with its own bowl

profile.description: Boulder Creek 24 inch Outdoor Steel Fire Pit with Heat Resistant Mesh Lid and Safety Ring and handle for Easy Transportation.
profile.reviewText:
I purchased this locally and have been very impressed. I kept it outdoors all season, and remembered to turn it upside down when it rained, so it remains rust free. I also have a cover for mine that I use during the winter.  I love having the ring around the outside which makes it easy to move AND empty!

profile.description: Supreme sound, simplified Stream music from your phone, tablet or other Bluetooth device and hear every impressive detail through stylish wireless speakers.
profile.reviewText:
I have spent an hour trying to set up what is supposed to be a simple speaker system. It comes with a quick start guide showing where to plug everything in. It also tells how to pair the speaker system with your device (computer or any Bluetooth device).

Like any standard speakers, the two treble speakers plug into the Base sub woofer. In this case, you also plug a control into the sub woofer that is supposed to turn the system on and off. If you are having trouble with turning it on (I did), you have to hit the power button once, lightly. To turn on Bluetooth, you hold the Bluetooth button down for two seconds with the power on. The device had power and turned on and synched to my Bluetooth on my computer.

However, it did not play. I turned the sound up and down. I connected and disconnected the Bluetooth. In frustration, I also connected it with the Audio cord (included), no sound at all coming out of any of the speakers.

Since this is the first time I have synched speakers to my Dell computer, I assumed I was doing something wrong on the computer itself. I disconnected the speakers and voila, my sound was back on my computer.

I then synched the Bluetooth speakers to my iPhone - my standard device that I use to test speakers in my home. It paired perfectly and showed connected. BUT, it did not play. Since I am very experienced in using my iPhone on Bluetooth, I realized it had to be something wrong with the speaker configuration.

I checked every cord to make certain it was fully plugged in. It is obvious it is getting power, since the "corded remote" which turns it on and hooks up the Bluetooth has power through the Sub Woofer. I then checked the minimal instructions to make certain I hadn't missed a button to push or a cord to plug in. I found no problem with this.

I still concede that I may have missed something. But after an hour and a half, I am frustrated. I track my comments, so if someone knows what I have done wrong, please send me a note that way (or my e-mail is on my profile page). Unless I discover otherwise, these have one star. Did not work on arrival.

If this were a purchase on Amazon (instead of a Vine product) I would take advantage of Amazon's wonderful guarantee.
profile.summary: Could not get them to work :'(

profile.description: Knee Benz combine ease of use, comfort and durability to create an extremely flexible, waterproof kneepad. Our exclusive design incorporates a tough vinyl patch at the point where the knee contacts the ground and can be worn over pants or with shorts.
profile.reviewText:
Our house has a major issue, our heater is in the crawl space. About 30 feet under the house, and as the designated filter changer, not only do I have my fear of snakes and spiders to deal with, but since I have to crawl over concrete and gravel. When I emerged last time with bruised knees and a tear in my pants, I began searching for a good set of knee pads.

I chose these because they had two bands, thigh and below knee. They are waterproof and appear to have nice padding. All of these things are true.

However, as a female with size 16 thighs (that's my trouser size) the thigh portion of these is barely long enough to surround my thighs. When I kneel, they are very uncomfortable, and when I crawl, they slip to the side off of my knees after only a few steps on my knees. They will work, but I won't be adding them to my gardening gear for normal use.

It is likely a size issue, and I am looking at a different set.

I recommend these somewhat conditionally for women with thighs smaller than mine.
profile.summary: For Skinny Thighs do shift when using

profile.description: Cook Hard-Boiled Eggs Without the Shell. Just Crack, Boil and Twist
profile.reviewText:
I saw these at a local store and thought, what a wonderful idea.

And it is a super ... Idea.

Unfortunately, it is not so good when it comes to practicality. Six cups, with four pieces each, means you have to wash 24 pieces each time you use them. The pieces also need to be oiled before using them.

What is fantastic is that they do exactly what they say. You can even season your eggs in advance, or using egg beaters, make your own boiled eggs. They sit nicely in the pan, and the eggs do turn out perfect.

What isn't so great is that it takes longer for the eggs to cook, and with only six in a box, a family would quickly run into trouble making these as a meal for more than two people. And I'm sure I already mentioned the issue of cleanup.

5 stars for the way they work, just like they are supposed to.

-0- stars for being practical.

3 stars total.
profile.summary: Good idea, not so great application ...

profile.description: The Polar PIM10BLS portable ice maker is so easy to use that you simply pour water into the top of the unit to make ice. It has a viewing window so you can see the ice when it is done. The PIM10BLS portable ice maker makes ice in just a few minutes, includes a ice scoop, an easy pour fill jug and a removable ice storage drawer.
profile.reviewText: Nearly two years ago I purchased and began using my NewAir AI100BK Portable Icemaker. For two years it faithfully supported my frappe habit, saving me countless amounts of money by bringing me ice for my Mr. Coffee BVMC-FM1 20-Ounce Frappe Maker. I was happy. However all good things (and electrical products) come to an end, and after nursing it along for three months, it quietly died. I grieved and then moved on. I chose the Polar because it opens in the front, fitting under my counters better, and actually holds about the same amount of ice. The drain for the water is underneath, allowing an easy way to empty it. It makes ice just as fast as my previous one, if anything, while this is smaller, it seems to be even better insulated. The poles that freeze the water are inside where they can't be touched by children. The guidelines state that you should clean it (bleach in water) regularly, and give instructions on saving your ice once the basket is full. It also recommends emptying it if you aren't using the ice. Since I let my previous maker run continuously, with the ice melting into the bottom and being remade, not only is this a better choice for health, but it will likely prolong the use. To fill this ice maker you remove the drawer and fill the bottom. It comes with a pitcher which makes it easy to do, it also includes a scoop for the ice. You then plug it in and it makes ice ... Three choices of sizes. It doesn't state that you need to use any specific water, but the flavor of ice is dependent upon the water you use. When the drawer is full or the reservoir of water gets too low, a light comes on and it stops making ice. If the drawer is full (about 1/2 gallon of ice), put the ice in a ziplock bag and it will keep making ice. If you don't remove your ice it slowly melts back into the reservoir. I thought parts were missing when mine first arrived, only to discover that the cord and pitcher were in the reservoir ... The scoop was in the drawer. I have ice again. I am happy. Edited - I have noticed that once my drawer is full, I need to push the stop and start button to get it to start making ice again. If I don't, it takes awhile to reset. I have also noticed that this particular model is more efficient when it makes the cubes, so I now keep my setting on medium cubes. The other model began to immediately make ice once it fell below a certain level, so that it always had ice. This particular model focuses on making ice to be frozen. As a result, if I want guaranteed ice at any given moment in time, I need to empty it into the bags and freezer. Final edit - stars removed. It was great while it lasted, but died after less than 5 months use. Going back to the New Air.
profile.summary: Frappe heaven ..DRATS - see edit, died after 5 months!

profile.reviewText:
As you might guess, even the crystal on this necklace is very small. In fact, at first I thought that the O in LOVE was simply engraved, but looking closely, there are crystals inside.

The word LOVE is over an inch long. and it s held on an 18" chain.

This is stamped with 925 on the back, indicating sterling silver, however please carefully read the description, since it clearly states that this is Sterling Silver PLATED. This keeps the price down and still makes a very nice piece of jewelry, but don't think you are getting genuine 100% sterling.

This is a very pretty piece, and I would suggest it best as a gift for those interested in costume jewelry, young teens, or kids purchasing a mother's day gift for their mom.

I received a free sample of this item to test and examine for my review. While I might have given this five stars because of the way it looks, I am concerned about using 925 Silver within the description as being misleading and am removing a star. Just removing one star, because the actual description is very clear it is plated.
profile.summary: Silver PLATED - pretty necklace

profile.description: Core and slice apples and pears with ease with the Unves Apple Divider. Soft, wide handles take the pressure off your hands, and sharp, stainless steel blades glide easily through fruit and yield perfect slices. The handles are raised to assure ample clearance between your hands and the table.
profile.reviewText:
I have been using apple wedgers to make my life easier since I became a grandmother. While I don't mind slicing apples, this actually makes it fun.

This is a medium size (there are larger ones out there) that will do apples up to 4 inches in diameter. The key is actually a bit of manhandling of the apple. You aren't gentle when you use one of these or you only end up part way through.

My technique is to set the apple on a cutting board so that I don't have to worry about it. I take the apple wedger and make sure I set it in the center. Then I whomp it down! The more firmly you whomp it, the better it cuts down to the bottom. Of course, sometimes it doesn't make it. Then you just break the rest of it apart.

There are two nice reasons to use a wedger. The first is that it impresses the grandkids. :) The second is that there is some satisfaction to whomping apples.

Just so you know, it probably isn't your best choice for apple pie, since it leaves the skin on. But it is awesome for dehydrating your own apple slices. These are kind of thick, so they require extra time drying, but the pieces are uniform which makes it nice.

I received a complimentary sample of this item so that I could whomp a few apples and see how it worked. It worked just as well as any I have used. It is sturdy and very nice.
profile.summary: Medium size apple wedger

profile.description: This lighted blow mold Nativity Collection Joseph, Mary and Baby Jesus from General Foam will make a great addition to your holiday dcor! This product is made of durable polyresin and is built for indoor or outdoor use. During the day, the figures' pearlized finish adds a subtle glow that enhances the appearance of Jesus, Mary and Joseph. At night the nativity scene illuminates to create added interest in your holiday display. This collection looks great placed on a front porch or in your yard. This nativity scene works wonderfully for indoor decoration as well. Made in America, this General Foam plastic blow mold nativity scene will surely light up your holidays for years to come. Baby Jesus lights up with type C7 bulb and 3-foot power cord (bulb included for your convenience) and Joseph and Mary light up with type A bulbs and a 4-foot power cord. Joseph stands 28"H, Mary 27"H and Baby Jesus 14"H.
profile.reviewText:
I have had my set for seven years now. They have sat through snowstorms, been encased in ice, and have ridden on floats in parades. The only mishap was that last year when I went to set it up, we blew a fuse. Fortunately, our local electronics store had just the fuse we needed!

The colors aren't as bright as they used to be, but these have weathered well.

Because they are plastic, the one thing that is a problem is wind. I tend to place mine in a sheltered spot. You can also stake them down. In fact, the wise men have been especially more prone to be blown over, likely because they are further out in the yard than the nativity.

Do price around, since I noticed that they were less expensive at a local store, and that Amazon had multiple listings.

I use this set along with the nativity, a cow, and a sheep.
profile.summary: Nice set, colors fade over time

profile.description: This new Foodsaver vacuum sealer has been designed with the sportsman in mind. This unit has a rugged design to handle the toughest jobs. It has improved vacuuming performance, an intelligent sealing system to handle multiple, consecutive jobs and oversized buttons. This unit is equipped with an extra deep drip tray that is removable and easy to clean in the dishwasher. Includes built-in roll holder and cutter to simplify making custom-size bags. Bag material, accessory hose and instruction manual included.
profile.reviewText: This particular model of the foodsaver comes with the following items included: 1 Roll 11" x 20' bagging material 2 each 1-gallon bags 3 each 1-quart bags It also incorporates the accessory tube, so that it can be used with the Foodsaver Accessories. I was a bit surprised when I received it, because it did not include the one thing that would have made it an excellent outdoors tool - the DC adapter cord which would permit it to be used by sportsmen in the field. This cord IS available with the GameSaver Pro Silver - which may be best for those actually wanting to use this to clean and package game in the field. Having used Foodsaver models in the past, there are several features that I particularly enjoyed on this model as I tested it INSIDE my kitchen. :-) First - the Foodsaver makes it easy to create bags, using their cutting strip and their easy-to-operate system. The lever on the right has three settings, closed (where it can operate), store (so the gasket won't be constantly crushed and will last longer), and open. Not hard. There are two buttons on the top. Seal and vacuum and seal. You use the Seal button to create one side of the bag, the cutting strip to cut it off afterwards at the right length, and the vacuum and seal button to remove the air and seal the bag. The lights go on to show you what it is doing, so you don't have to guess. The second thing I liked about this particular vacuum sealer is that while it sealed the items I put inside of it, when I used it on dehydrated vegetables, it did not crush them. A different model, FoodSaver - GameSaver says that it has a sensitivity control. This seems to be true, as far as I can tell on this model as well. I really do like the "seal only" feature, since it lets me repackage even the most sensitive items - like marshmallows, without worrying that they will end up in one chunky blob. Obviously, with air, they won't last as long ... The foodsaver bags and material are multi-ply, and allow you to freeze, microwave, simmer, and just use them for storage. For liquid items, or items like fresh fruits and vegetables, it is best to blanch and freeze them first, then do the vacuum sealing, before you store them long-term in your freezer. I have done this with corn on the cob with excellent results, and will be handling my broccoli the same way. A friend does this with grated Zucchini as well, but I'm not sure I will - by the time mine is done producing, I never want to see it again, and would hate to spend my whole winter trying to find new ways to use it. The same goes for bread - by freezing it first, you can vacuum seal it and keep it fresh MUCH longer. By freezing ice cubes in sealed bags, it makes it easy to take them with you, either in your ice chest or without. Once they are melted, they are an excellent source of water. It also permits you to make drip-free icebags for boo-boos for the little ones. For items with some moisture (eg fresh meat), the extra-large drip tray catches the drips, and is easily removed and cleaned. For the best seal, you need to prefreeze the meat as well, but if you place a paper towel at the top of the meat, you can seal it. I have priced around, and short of going through a major membership store, Amazon seems to have excellent prices on the additional bags and bagging materials. However, I also noticed that there were MANY complaints about the foodsaver accessories, so I would be cautious and read up before I purchased those. A quick hint - you can package individual smaller items in smaller bags - eg. your pills for a trip. Seal one end of the roll, decide how long you want it, cut and remove. Then, turning your "bag" sideways, seal as many columns as you will need. Place your pills or smaller items down into the bottom of each row. Seal them across the top. Fill the next row, and once again seal across the top. If you are dividing into thirds, each row will have three little packs. Since there is only one seal, you will need to be cautious in cutting off the sections you are using, but it can be handy. This is also the way you would handle smaller amounts of matches and other items you carry. This is a new model, so I will definitely report any future problems, but it is working well and doing a fantastic job on my kitchen items. I put the 4 stars (instead of 5) because I feel that if Foodsaver is going to advertise an items as "outdoor," they should include at least the option of purchasing an adapter for the model. ***Special Edit*** My Son-in-law will deploy back to the Persian Gulf this fall. One of the issues he had with the food items I sent to him (eg. candy) was sand getting in them, so, while last time I ended up putting everything in sealed sandwich bags, hopefully this time the vacuum sealer will make the items more secure and help them to last longer.
profile.summary: Good for inkitchen, not so sure about outdoors

profile.description: willow light tree has 200 LED lights.Willow shows its nature green in spring and summer.When handing branches move,they look like girls' dancing, it's elegant and attractive.16 feet power cord extremely extends light tree's usage range.And it stands still and steady with iron stand feet. With bright green willows and curved trunk,the tree are elegant and artistic, which looks the spring is always in the air. With the advantages of energy saving, high brightness and long life span,LED lights are widely used.More importantly,they are safe and secure and suitable for decorating garden, office, party, park and community,etc. Tips: To make sure the tree standstill, adjusting the tree's standing direction to the opposite site of mounting plate's pillar.  The tree can be shaped as wanted by bending and arranging the branches to a natural and beautiful appearance. After DIY shapes for a few times, there is a small chance that causes loose connection between branches and trunk. If you encounter this problem, wrap it tight with electrical tape. Same color tape with branches is suggested. During installation or pulling out of the package, leaves might fall off.Just put it gently onto the bulb.And additional spare leaves are attached in PP bag. Wish you have long and beautiful sights.
profile.reviewText: One of my favorite occupations is sitting on my front porch (or back deck) at night watching the fireflies. Since I am out in the evening I have really come to appreciate delicate items with LED lights to light up the night somewhat, without casting light around. This wonderful willow tree with its green light is a perfect accompaniment to my yard. It comes tightly wrapped in silicone and needs to be untangled once it arrives. When I first got it, it looked very awkward - even ugly. Then I realized that I could bend and shape the branches into a much more natural shape. It took awhile to get it exactly the way I wanted it, but once I got it that way, I was very pleased. The poles are held together (and to the square bottom stand) using set screws and do remain tight. There are four peg that hold the stand firmly into the ground. My ground was soft, so I had no problem inserting them, depending on the ground, you might need a hammer. When looking at the tree in daylight, the branches and poles are covered with what appears to be a brown electrical tape. It is very noticeable when looking closely, however, at a few steps away, it was not obvious. Additionally, at night, obviously, it is not noticeable at all. The same holds true of the plastic leaves. They are not lifelike - but glisten gently in the sunshine and are beautiful at night. I have tried to capture both in my video. The holder in the base is at a slight angle as is the bottom pole. In order for the tree to look and work right, take a bit of time to turn things around so that the tree doesn't look like it is about to fall over. The leave are a gentle green plastic that really do light up well. With two connection points - one on the tree and one at the base - the cord does not hang from the tree, although the connection point is visible in the daytime. Another important note, these look the same but are one-way connections with a positive and negative point. It is important that you line them up correctly or the tree will not light up correctly, especially when you plug these into the adapter plug. The branches sway softly in the breeze and bring a sense of summer to the yard. I received a free sample to test for my unbiased review and to create the video. I am grateful and am enjoying this in my front yard. EDITED - It is now September 22 and autumn is approaching. It is still fun to drive up to my house in the evening and see this tree lit up! In spite of winds and rains, it has held up well and is just as nice today as it was the day I set it up! I will take it down when I put my Christmas decorations up, but for now it is still my favorite yard decoration.
profile.summary: Sways gently in the breeze

profile.reviewText:
First of all, the loom is great. It is longer than the Rainbow loom and with extra rows (plus the ability to link them together), and the loops that come with it are nice and sturdy. I picked mine up at a local discount store.

But, there are a couple of serious issues with this. First of all, there is no reason to make a flimsy plastic hook. None at all. Fortunately, I had a regular small crochet hook on hand and quickly grabbed it. It made a huge difference.

Second, the instructions were crappy. So you take the second rubber band off of the second peg and put it over the third peg and you repeat that. Huh? I went to their video instructions and didn't understand. THEN I finally found the slow, step by step instructions over at Rainbow! I got it!

There are only 600 bands that come with this along with c clips. The bands are all mixed together in a single bag, so you get the random colors that fall into the bag.

I am still learning more things to make, using the teaching videos, and once you replace the hook and figure out how to make these it is kind of fun. If you would like to make your own loom, you can using nails and a board, but this is quite handy.

So thumbs up on the loom, but get your own hook and a nicer assortment of bands.
profile.summary: Once I figured it out ...

profile.description: The YaYa3D Printing Pen can be used to make crafts, school projects, home decor, gifts, and much more! Trace shapes on paper, build a 3D model using a design, or simply doodle - in the air! Use the pen to draw up or down, making cubes, spirals, and more. You can also draw several flat shapes and then connect them, allowing you to make an even wider range of shapes! What about drawing a design on paper and then tracing it with the YaYa3D Printing Pen? profile.reviewText:
I am amazed at how easy it is to use the YaYa3D Pen. As someone who has been doing arts and crafts for many years, it works a lot like a glue pen, except it flows easier and is much lighter.

The controls are simple, on, off, forward, and reverse. The reverse lets you back out the unmelted filament.

Best of all, this takes standard sized filament!

What I am currently making is a personal set of Christmas ornaments for my tree. I am using a flat surface (actually parchment paper) and after making a square base am writing the names of family members and doing easily drawn decorations in the corners, like square presents and holly leaves and Christmas trees. A loop on top completes the process. They will make nice gifts for family members when they come over on Christmas Day.

I have had no problems with this operating correctly, and truly love all of the options available! The most fun is "writing in the air," although it takes patience and a steady hand.

As someone who has worked with N and HO train sets and 1/2 and 1" doll houses, I can see some awesome uses in both of these areas in creating details using this pen. With practice, you could create infinite new possibilities! From tiny cars, benches, tombstones, rocks, people, ripples on water ...

For doll houses you can make plates, food, a fire in the fireplace, a grate, jewelry, you name it!

It does take a bit of practice for the detail stuff, but if my husband and I still owned our trains and doll houses hobby shop, we would most assuredly be carrying and recommending these!

I received a sample so that I could test this for my review and am very, very happy with it!

profile.description: These liquid chalk ink markers create a stunning chalk like effect on a variety of hard, non porous surfaces. See images above. profile.description: Easy glide precision retractable rotary cutter. Ideal to use for quilting and knitting projects, papers, scrapbooks.
profile.reviewText:
I confess! My secret vice is quilting, or rather piecing together quilts. Give me a disappearing nine patch pattern and I'm in seventh heaven. So I have used rotary cutters quite a bit.

There are many competitors on the market, and after viewing the OLFA 9654 RTY-2/DX 45mm Ergonomic Rotary Cutter, which is nearly identical, I believe that the Olfa 45mm blades will fit. Olfa Rotary Blade Refill Pack RB45-5 (45mm) I took mine apart and the blade centers were also identical.

Both cutters work the same way. You pull the handle back to reveal the rotary blade. Mine came with a very sharp blade and I was able to cut through several layers of fabric with it easily. When you release the handle, the blade pops back and it is not exposed to little fingers. Now that I have a granddaughter around, that is a very good thing. A simple pop of the button locks it into place.

There is a textured area at the top of the handle and the top of the rotary cutter so that your thumb can press down onto the blade to cut through.

The problem for me is that I have very small hands. The combined handles make it just a bit harder to use (thus the four stars for me). Most people with larger hands will not even notice it.

A very nice rotary cutter - love the safety feature. Wish my hands were more normal sized.

I received a sample of this cutter to take apart, cut with, and test for my review. It now resides in my box of quilting tools.

profile.reviewText: This is one of my two favorite Max Lucado children's books, the other being You Are Special (Max Lucado's Wemmicks). In this particular story, Paladin seeks adventure in a place where he knows he shouldn't go. Thinking he will be safe, he exits the village Shaddai has built through a hole in the wall. I find this to be an excellent resource when I am discussing the issue of sin with children. God creates the boundaries of safety for all of us. But God allows the openings and the choices we make, as Shaddai says "I want the children to stay because they want to, not because they have to." We have freedom to choose ... An excellent resource for all trying to convey the idea of freedom of choice and its consequences to children.
profile.summary: Keeping us safe ... but letting us be free

profile.description: The kitchen safe is the time-lock container designed to help us fight temptations. USA today and time magazine call it "brilliant!" here's how it works: 1) place an item in the kitchen safe 2) rotate the button to set the timer (from 1 minute to 10 days) 3) press the button to activate the lock once locked, the kitchen safe cannot be opened until the timer reaches zero. Seriously, there are no overrides, once it's locked, its locked. Studies of highly successful people show that the best strategy for achieving goals is to avoid relying on willpower in all situations. These people are more likely to use something called pre commitment, which significantly improves odds of achieving goals. Pre commitment is the notion of committing to a smart choice early, when we know we will be tempted by a bad choice later. The kitchen safe is a tool that enables us to pre commit to smart choices.
profile.reviewText:
One very important note if you are considering purchasing this and using it. THERE IS NO OVERRIDE.

Once you put something inside the box, it will stay there until the timer counts down. In fact, in case of a failure on the part of the Kitchen Safe, your only option is to break into the box to retrieve your item. The instructions caution you to be careful if you have to break in, since there could be sharp fragments.

Still, what would a timed safe be if you could turn off the timer and get in at will?

There are many practical ways to use this, including time outs on electronics and candy (just don't put your chocolate in there if you aren't willing to wait!). It is large enough for smaller electronics. You can even put the remote control in it and drive someone crazy! And, if you want to limit the temptation at work to respond to texts on your phone, just slip it in there with the timer set for your next break or lunch.

BUT, the most awesome thing I will be using this for is gifts! You can either set the item inside the safe where it can be seen (and drooled over) but not opened, or you can line this with wrapping paper and put the gift inside where a child can watch it count down to a birthday, Christmas, or any special event!

Picture a child counting down the days and hours till Christmas, then hearing it click open to reveal ... whatever you have put inside!

Because it can't be opened till the timer goes off, you can even pack this with the gift and ship it to your college student or child who might otherwise open it early.

Fun - with some very practical applications as well!

EDIT - one of my questions addressed to the company was what happens if the batteries go dead? Apparently, there is a permanent memory chip imbedded that periodically is updated. So when you replace the batteries, they start at the last saved memory.

A second question, I discovered on my own - the timer goes up to ten days.

Still loving it.
profile.summary: World's Best Gift Box!

profile.description: Restyled for 2014, the Weber Q 220 is now the Weber Q 2200. The grill has the same great performance and sleek styling, but adds new aesthetics that are both functional and fun, including larger grip handle and control knobs, ergonomic side handles, sturdy front and rear cradles, larger-sized fold-out side tables with greater rigidity plus the familiar Weber Q logo prominently branded in the lid. Split grates allow for a grate/griddle cooking combination: Just replace one of the grates with the Q 2000-series compatible griddle (sold separately) and experience an alternative way to prepare breakfast, lunch and dinner on your grill. The tall lid accommodates the grilling of small roasts and birds, while the large built-in thermometer allows you to monitor temperatures inside the grill. The Weber Q 2200 is ideal for use when camping and tailgating but, thanks to a design that offers both compact overall size and large grilling surface, can double as a stationary grill in your outdoor living space. The grill runs on disposable LP cylinders (not included), but an optional LP adapter hose for 20-lb. tanks is available as an accessory. A seamless stainless steel burner is your assurance of durability and long-lasting performance. The cast-aluminum lid and body are both lightweight and rugged. May be used with Weber Portable Cart model #6557 and Q Cart model #6525.
profile.reviewText:
The Q2200 description states that it is fully assembled.

When I requested this grill (the Q 2200) though Vine, I was especially excited that it stated it was FULLY ASSEMBLED. When it arrived I discovered the truth - it is "generally assembled" but has some parts that need to be assembled, and I don't just mean sliding things in place.

The lid is held on by pegs with cotter pins, (not too bad, except one hole wasn't fully drilled and I had to pound it through on one side). The front handle must be assembled (3 parts) with screws using a Philips head screwdriver. the control pops on, as does the ignition button. Of course, you need to slide the drip collector (with disposable aluminum holder) on, and put in the extra heavy (most of the 45 pounds) grate in place.

The heavy weight grill impressed me, and the sides flip up and fold under for carrying or protection from the elements. Best of all, it uses EITHER size of the small disposable propane cylinders! No worry about finding the correct size. You can buy an adapter and hook this up to a large refillable propane tank if you would like.

I enjoy having the small size (I buy 16 oz tanks) so that it is even more portable and perfect for a tailgating party. It also allows me to keep several extras on hand. I use them for both my grill and my "emergency" stove in case of power outage.

This lights easily and has a high lid for a roast (or small turkey). Having come from California, I love being able to BBQ a turkey on my grill. The wide handle makes it easy to control the flame, and the thermometer in the lid makes it easy to monitor the temperature during your cooking.

It is much more portable than my larger grill and yet is large enough to cook meals for the four of us without trouble. Everything (except the weight of the grate) makes this easy to handle and carry, and the heavier grate means nicely seared steaks.

IF this had been described correctly (partially assembled) I would have given it five stars. I am giving it four, because I think it is important to catch buyer's attention and let them know to expect a bit of assembly, not because it is a less than five star product.
profile.summary: Some Assembly required - but a very nice grill

profile.description:

Remote Control with Battery
profile.reviewText:
I was provided a sample of this product in order to test it for a review.

First of all, like the other reviewers, I had difficulty finding the antenna within the packaging. However, once I found it, the hummer worked well. At least it worked well for awhile. After I ran it across a rocky bumping area, it suddenly stopped. Even recharging the batteries and changing the ones in the controller did not make it run. I suspect it caused a loose wire, but I am not the kind of person who knows how to take these things apart and reattach the wire. Since the headlights did not work from the beginning, there may have been a wiring issue to start with.

So why three stars? Because I love this car! It is worth it at this price point even if it isn't RC. And I noticed the other reviewers didn't have the same problem, so I want to give the Hummer the benefit of the doubt.

The battery compartment in the bottom has a tiny screw that holds  the rechargeable battery pack in. BUT it latches perfectly fine without it. So if you are one of those people (like me) who hates tiny screws, rest assured that the battery pack stays in fine under most conditions without it.

What puzzled me completely was the back of the package and instructions since the RC controller that came with the Hummer was not in any way related to the one pictured. It took a lot of trial and error to figure things out.

A funky little toy that will please younger kids.
profile.summary: Mine had a wire work loose, but worked fine until then

profile.description: When you want all the power and performance, without fumes or the noise, the Troy-Bilt TB154E Electric Garden Cultivator is a great choice. The Troy-Bilt TB154E offers all the benefits of the standard push cultivator for soil preparation and bed maintenance with the ease of an electric motor. The TB154E is simple to start - just a push of a button - and lightweight for easy control in tight spaces, including flower beds and vegetable gardens. profile.reviewText:
After pricing various tillers and cultivators, and examining them in the store, I decided on this one for several reasons, most of which involved our specific needs. When I mentioned on a gardening forum I was getting a Rototiller, they thought I said Rottweiler, and the name stuck.

We do not have rocky soil, and are putting in a vegetable garden area and border around our yard, which is 1/3 acre. We needed something, but didn't need a huge piece of equipment. This is lightweight enough for me to use, and yet it gets the job done. Since I just hit 60 years old, I really appreciate how easy it is for me!

It came almost completely assembled, I only had to fasten the handle on, then plug it in. We already use electric gardening items, so I had the necessary cord on hand. Everything adjusts and clips on easily, really a no tools required machine. The safety buttons and features are awesome for a novice like me.

The manual advised that I should try getting used to the controls, and I am glad I did! It pulled forward like it really wanted to take off like its nickname, Rottweiler.  After a couple of tries, I was able to work it easily. In fact, it tore through an area that would have taken hours to do by hand in only a few minutes. We had mowed the grass short before I started, and it chopped through, breaking up the soil, grass and weeds!

We will be collecting cow patties from a friend and mixing them in to create a good blend for next spring, so it is doing all of the hard dirty work for us. But for now, I'm taking my little Rottweiler for a walk during the morning and getting things ready.

*** Edit - it is now Spring, and I want to report that this little monster is still chewing away. I set up my garden patch with it and took it over to my daughter's home where we cleared out several patches of grass (after knocking down the weeds with a Weed Whacker), into the rich deep soil that is in her yard!

Probably my only problem is that since my yard is so large, I had to buy a longer cord to run it.

It runs forward quickly, then tills more deeply as you pull it backwards. The work isn't "easy" like it would be on a riding one, or one that was really heavy, but for our garden work, this is awesome.

In her yard, I tried tilling where there were some heavy weeds, and they got tangled pretty badly, so I had to clean them out, but it wasn't a problem at all, just took a couple of small gardening tools and worked at it for about 5 minutes. After that, we made sure that we cut down the weeds a bit first.

Still very pleased.
profile.summary: My Rottweiler - quiet but mean

profile.description: StufZ Burger Press
profile.reviewText:
I spent some time planning my first burgers and am glad that I did, since the whole thing isn't necessarily intuitive.

The top has two aspects.

 The first one turns and presses the hole into the bottom burger. It directs you to press it down several times. What I found was that it worked MUCH better if I didn't just bunch up the burger in the middle, rather that I spread it out across the bottom where I didn't need as much energy to punch it down.

After you fill the bottom, you turn the top, locking the first part in place, then you spread the top burger across the top and plunge the ENTIRE top down to seal the edges.  Whoop, perfect.

I found that I needed to use 1/4 to 1/3 pound burger to make sure they fried up well (1/2 pound was too much).

I received a complimentary sample to test for my review, and gave it the full works to check it out!

It is a bit awkward, but it really does work! So four stars - taking one off for the fact that it is a bit awkward. I have used mine several times and am pleased with the results.

profile.description: Vectra 3D protects your pets against parasites and pathogens. Vectra 3D uses a three pronged approach to keep your pet safe from disease carrying agents by utilizing Dinotefuran, Permethrin and Pyriproxyfen. The Dinotefuran is an insecticide that functions by causing continuous stimulation of the nervous system of insects upon first contact. This stimulation leads to tremors and quick deaths in insects as they land on your dog. Permethrin is an adulticide and works to repel vectors, such as mosquitoes, ticks and sand flies by causing them to lose control of their nervous system. Lastly, Pyripoxyfen, an insect growth regulator, works to prevent development of fleas in their early stages. This keeps them as eggs, larvae and pupae until the other active ingredients functionally decimate them. Vectra 3D has been clinically shown to provide fastacting protection against multiple pests lasting up to one month. In addition to repelling mosquitoes, ticks, and sand flies, Vectra 3D repels and kills fleas, lice, and mites quickly and effectively. In fact, it has been shown to reduce the number of ticks in only 24hours and begins killing fleas within the first two hours of use. Vectra 3D remains effective after bathing and it can be used on dogs and puppies older than 7 weeks. Vectra 3D comes in 4 dosing sizes based on your dogss body weight. The product is available for all weights in packs of 3doses and packs of 6doses. Vectra 3D Green for Dogs Puppies is intended for dogs between 2.5 and 20 pounds and this particular package comes with 6 doses. For heavier dogs, use Vectra 3D Blue, Vectra 3D Purple, or Vecra 3D Red. Vectra 3D is also available for Cats and Kittens. Please read the application instructions thoroughly before applying Vectra 3D to your pets. Key Features: Kills fleas, ticks, sand flies, mosquitoes, lice and mites on contact before they can bite Repels pests for full month per dose Comes in Four varieties depending on dog weight: Teal for dogs 1
profile.reviewText:
This was actually recommended (and supplied) by my Vet for our 11 pound chihuahua. Do NOT use it for dogs smaller than ten pounds. The price here on Amazon is comparable to what I am paying through the vet.

What we have found is that this is very effective not only in killing off the fleas, but this keeps them from biting (according to the Vet). Since our dogs are allergic to flea bites, they get pretty miserable and this has made a huge difference for them. We have a six pound and an 11 pound dog, so we buy two different sizes. They don't get as agitated when we apply this as they do with the Front Line - you spread it from tail up to neck - I'm not certain if that is the reason, or simply that it doesn't irritate their skin as much.

Having experienced problems with different flea medications, I recommend you discuss this with your vet before purchasing. Also, be certain that your dogs are within the size range on the package.

These slip over the head, then the strap feeds through the top and around the chest of the dog.  While her dog still wiggles a lot getting it on, I found it easy to get him safely into it when I was assisting her.

We have two chihuahuas, and I know how easily they manage to get out of most harnesses (and into everything), so I was very impressed at the effectiveness.

Edited -
Since this original review, our older chihuahua passed over the rainbow and we picked up a rescue chihuahua from a local agency. Only 5 pounds, she had been used for nearly 5 years as a breeder in a puppy mill. When the agency got her, she was filthy, had a huge flea infestation, giardia, and tapeworms.

She is scared of everyone and everything, and has become a pampered addition to our collection. If the first 5 years of her life were abuse, we will take care of her as a princess the rest of her life. profile.summary: Perfect for wiggly chihuahuas!

profile.description: A microchip identifies your lost cat  but only if someone finds it first. GPS trackers are heavy, and despite the hype, not accurate enough for finding cats in many of their hiding places. The unique Loc8tor Pet is the world's leading cat finder and has already saved thousands of cats around the world from getting lost. Loc8tor Pet gives cat owners real peace of mind. It works like an electronic game of hot and cold and will show you the right direction to walk to find your cat.
profile.reviewText:
We purchased these after chasing our chihuahuas who had gotten out of our yard. We went one way, they had gone the other.

The most important thing you need to realize is that the 400 ft that is listed is line of sight only! It uses the example in the book that if you lose your model airplane in a tree (up high and in line of sight) it will work the full 400 feet. However, if you have chihuahuas (short, low to the ground, and NOT in line of sight) you will have more luck locating them within 100 feet.

For us, where our dogs go more than 100 feet from our property it works best by driving the car and using it out the window to see if they are within range.
profile.summary: Good Product - Limited Range ...

profile.description: All of the Back to Basics essential canning tools in one simple kit. Includes: Canning Funnel, Jar Wrench, Jar Lifter, Kitchen Tongs, and Magnetic Lid Lifter.

profile.description: Give your aerobic workout an extra boost with the Universal Aerobic Step System for the Wii Fit Balance Board, PlayStation Move, and Xbox 360 Kinect. The Universal Aerobic Step System functions as a 2 leveled aerobic step for the PlayStation Move and Xbox 360 Kinect, but also elevates your Wii Fit Balance Board to a full 4 inches, a standard height for actual step aerobics. The platform adjusts to two different height levels with ease. profile.reviewText:
My daughter has a Wii fitness program, so when I was offered a complimentary sample, I immediately thought she would enjoy the extra workout. I was surprised when she told me she had actually been considering buying one.

When the box arrived, however, she was in the middle of a move and it sat under my television waiting for all to happen on her end. She has finally set up her Wii again and is as happy with it as I was. So, five stars.
profile.summary: Perfect, with or without the Wii ...

profile.description: Take the guesswork out of cooking meat and poultry with This Thermometer, which features 15 Preprogrammed Temperatures to grill all you foods to perfection. A magnetic back and folding design let you store the thermometer on a counter or on a grill. A pre- alarm sound off when your meat is within 10 degrees of your desired temperature so that you are aware that it is about to get done so that you can remove the food from the grill and let it rest, as the resting period will rise the Temperatures of all foods by 6 to 8 degrees when left to rest in a warm place (resting is crucial for redistributing the juices in the meat). Cooking anything to perfection requires knowing when it reaches the ideal internal temperature before and after resting. Using this Thermometer with the included DB-Tech Temperature Guide will always get the meat the way you and your family likes it
profile.reviewText:
I don't know how YOUR evenings go, but I usually pop my food in the oven (or the BBQ) and wait until I think it is done. That doesn't always work, especially since my husband prefers his meat medium rare.

First of all, the magnet chart is just about what you would find in any cookbook and gives a general idea of what temperature you should cook your food. Nice - but not exciting.

But the probe - is nice. What I like best is that it gives you the temperature of the meat without opening the grill and losing the heat.

It adjusts based on the type of meat and how well you want it done. Since meat continues cooking after you take it off, the early warning lets you take it off early and still have the meat the way you want it.

This works best for thicker meats that need the probe, steaks, roasts, and chicken breasts.

A very nice thermometer - even works with the turkey on Thanksgiving.

I received a complementary thermometer to test to determine whether I was willing to write a review. I am grateful to report that it worked just like it said.
profile.summary: No More Burned Meats ...

profile.description: Brighten any yard or garden with this charming kinetic wind sculpture from Iron Stop. Designed to capture the slightest breeze, it features a brilliant display of butterflies surrounding a vibrant yellow flower. With a 16" diameter, it creates a colorful, eye-catching focal point in your yard that can't be missed. Quality construction and a long-lasting finish make it a wonderful gift for family, friends, or your own garden. Pole included for easy installation anywhere.
profile.reviewText:
This took about five minutes to set up - more to get it in the ground, since it is late summer and the ground is hard.

I chose this item to review because it goes well with the other items I have lining the new ramp we had built last year. I actually thought it would be taller. The six and a half feet includes the height of the windmill spinner and the six inches that go into the ground. So it is a medium size spinner.

You do have to bend the butterflies yourself to catch the breeze correctly. But, once you do, it works. I suggest that you consider bringing it inside during stiff breezes, since the nut can be loosened by excessive spin speed.
profile.summary: Six feet from ground to top

profile.description: As a young boy, Mark always enjoyed reading, writing and the outdoors. His father took him on many fabulous outdoor adventures that just fueled his passion for nature. By the time he was 13 years old, he was swimming with dolphins, manatees and sharks. He became a certified scuba diver at this young age and spent his summers diving in the Florida Keys with his father and older brother. He has been places that most people only dream of. His passion for nature did not stop as he got older. He continues to observe, study and respect nature to this day. If there is a turtle in the road, Mark is the guy that will stop in the middle of traffic to help the turtle cross the street. Now Mark shares his passion for nature with his own family. His children have been a great influence and inspiration to him and his writing, and now he is sharing his adventures and knowledge with the world. Mark presently resides in New Smyrna Beach Florida with his wife and two children.
profile.reviewText:
This cute little book, complete with photos is ideal for six year olds.

The basic story is about the child's night light and how the light protected the child from all kinds of bad things in their room. It would be super if you have a child who is afraid of the dark and you want to encourage them by giving them a nightlight. most of the words are easy to learn and read.

While it talks about monsters and other things, the photos are cute enough to offset the fear a child might experience by talking about those things. However, as all books for this age group, the wise parent Will preview the book to ensure that it doesn't give their over imaginative child ideas about things to be afraid of. My own Granddaughter enjoyed reading this with me on my iPad, and giggled at the monster and zombie.

Our Granddaughter still has a battery powered nightlight for her own use ... So I know the power of this little tale. :-)

However, as a pastor, I am also teaching her about the light of the world that never goes out. So for parents who want to use this tale, this is a good beginning story for young children beginning to learn about Jesus. Kids can relate to physical things better than esoteric words, so teaching them about Spark, the light, can be a lead in to them later understanding a different meaning.

For those who are not Christian, the tale easily stands on its own as Spark simply being their nightlight.

I was provided a gift copy of this book to read to my Granddaughter for a review.

Edit

I thought this would be a one time story. Instead, she climbs up in the chair with me and asks to read it, after repetition, she even reads the harder words. It has become a favorite adn continues to be one!
profile.summary: A Favorite-Granddaughter keeps asking for the story!

profile.description: Discover what makes SmartBlend smart. Purina ONE SmartBlend Natural Lamb & Rice Formula adult dry dog food starts with real lamb as the #1 ingredient to help maintain your dog's strong muscles, including a healthy heart. Each meal is highly-digestible and has a combination of protein-rich tender, meaty morsels and crunchy kibble, providing a taste your dog will love to help ensure he gets the complete and balanced nutrition he needs. profile.reviewText:
I really didn't think I would be reviewing this food. I received a small sample (about 6 oz) in the mail - not even sure why.

As soon as I opened the bag, three chihuahuas were on my lap sniffing the bag. Once it was opened, they went ballistic! In fact, they ate several pieces each just as if it were dog treats.

profile.reviewText:
My daughter has an older cat who has arthritis, so moving in with us was particularly traumatic and led to many "cat issues" ... It didn't help that when the movers arrived they let him out and he hid under the deck for two days before we found him.

So we have been using calming collars as well as this to help him to adjust. While the situation isn't perfect, I can tell the difference when he needs a new collar ... so I'm giving these four stars since they seem to be working for us.

She is moving into her own home (another change, and cats don't like change), and we are putting these in her new home to (hopefully) help him with the adjustment.
profile.summary: Cats need attention ...

profile.description: Charge your iPad or iPhone at the fastest possible speed with this charger that works in any power outlet. Use the Home Charger with the Lightning connector for iPad and iPhone to charge faster than ever. And of course, you can still use your 30-pin cable.
profile.reviewText:
There are always a lot of chargers and cords that come out after a product is made, and since I recently purchased the 5s, I was excited to try this charger from Belkin out on my home phone.

First of all, the 2.1 Amps/10 Watts is enough power to charge more than your iPhone - it is fully capable of charging your iPad as well.
