profile.description: open box, like new. Free gift with "Money Making secret revealed" DVD
profile.reviewText:
However, after thinking about the purpose of why things need to be repeated, I GOT it!!!

He brings up unconscious competence (see Nice Girls Don't Get the Corner Office 101 for an instructive chart on how this works.  That books really makes it simple.)

Try to get past Trudeau's arrogance and talk on the "brotherhood."  He has a tendency to be a little arrogant - "the people that are here at the seminar paid big money . . . the royal families that are here . . . we are in the Swiss Alps."

Two of the Imperative Questions that he asks is, "What are you willing to give up to get what you want?  Are you willing to give up watching TV to learn these principles?"

WHAT I LOVE ABOUT THIS CD set:
"Your brain puts out a frequency 24/7 and that frequency has to return to us. Everything in the universe is working together to match that frequency . . . What you wants, wants you: friends, accolades, success, achievement, happiness, bliss, etc..  Yes, this is a repeats a lot of The Secret, but it's something positive to listen to, and hearing things with a different voice helps in manifesting your goals."

This is good brain food to fall asleep listening to.

************UPDATE*******************
After watching The LOOKOUT on ABC that originally aired on 5/29, I am deeply disturbed by this man's character.  There are some nuggets of truth in this CD set, but Mr. Trudeau is found to be a money launderer by investigative journalists and fraud by the FTC in regards to his weight loss book.
profile.summary: At First I Was Put Off By His Repetition Teaching

profile.description: Lois P. Frankel, Ph.D., lives in Pasadena, California
profile.reviewText:
First, I must advise getting a paperback or hardback copy of the book.  This book has a couple of quizzes (the introduction has ten questions and chapter one has 49.  I photocopied the larger quiz so I that I could respond to the questions, track the scores in each category, and add, etc.  For this reason, I think it would be awkward to do on Kindle.

This is the uniquest book that I've ever read.  The author wants us to read the two chapters where our scores were weakest, FIRST.  I've never heard of anything like that before, but it makes total sense.  This is a good idea so that we don't get bogged down with other behaviors we have to learn.  Our greatest weaknesses are what we need help with the most.

Speaking of behavior, the author doesn't beat us up for being "socialized".  She validates her readers by letting us know that we have some strengths.  She also lets us know that our weaknesses can be retrained.  I love Chart 3, the Unconscious Competence chart.  She explains the process in an uncomplicated way, and there's an illustration to even break the information down further.

One of my weaknesses is in how I have superstitious thoughts (How I Think chapter).  The author articulates the concepts so that you CAN change your thinking.  "Expressing my opinions will get me fired," isn't necessarily true.  The author says it best: your parents grew up thinking that way, and it may have been true in their day, but it's not true now.  VERY TRUE!!!

I love the author's candidacy and authenticity.  She admits that she doesn't do all the tools herself.  People that say they are perfect, and all too often those same people fall from their self-imposed pedestals, often in a very public way.  Ms. Frankel gives us all the tools, 101 of them, and we get to pick our own to use.

OUTSTANDING BOOK!!!

Thank you, thank you, thank you!

PS:  I came across this book by reading Get Rich, Lucky Bitch by Denise Duffield Thomas.  That's a good book too.  I haven't finished it, so I haven't had a chance to review it.  I haven't finished it, not because it isn't good, but because I'm savoring every morsel, and applying the principles.  And there are sooo many freebies, money mantras, a worksheet, and three MP3s!  I love it!!
profile.summary: Every Woman Needs to Read This Book

profile.description: Sacred Chants. Approximately 66 minutes in length.
profile.reviewText:
I don't know what's being chanted, but I set an intention to hear what the title says it's doing - hear chants of the 108 sacred names of God.  It's clearing, cleansing.  I don't know how to explain it, but I'll try to articulate it - I actually feel like negative karma is getting dissipated, and my chakras and surroundings being cleared as well.  I love the instruments and music- not sure what they are called.  I love the sacred chants.  Sometimes I want to dance, sometimes i just want to bliss out (meditate myself into a trance), and sometimes when I listen I just want to be present and still.

Thank you Amazon for carrying this CD on MP3.  I used to hear it periodically at a metaphysical bookstore, so it's nice to go back to my roots, so to speak.
profile.summary: Other Worldly, Blissful and Powerful - ENCHANTING!!!

profile.description: Scotch Expressions Washi Tape comes in a variety of colors so you can decorate and personalize your projects. Add a unique touch to home decor or a fresh accent to a simple vase. There's no end to the creative ways you can use Scotch Expressions Washi Tape!
profile.reviewText:
I thought I was getting a really good deal at 6 rolls/pack for $10.  It still is a good deal, but the color is not as gold as I thought it would be (from looking from the pictures) - which is part of the risk of buying things from the Internet.  So now I have lots of khaki based washi.  I have more vibrant washi colors so it makes it hard to combine, but I have used this as a base for some washi and have washi'd over this washi leaving peek-a-boo strips (washi'ing over washi is kind of redundant).  I'll find other uses for it and have used this in lieu of regular, clear Scotch tape for packages and posters and such.

Also, this doesn't feel like typical washi, it has a Scotch tape feel and texture to it, which means it isn't as forgiving or re-positionable like other types of washi.  Think colored Scotch tape - when you use regular Scotch tape and have to re-position it, it normally brings some of the paper or cardboard with it. Decorative paper tape is usually re-positionable, which is what I think of when I tihink of washi.

If the color was more true to gold, I would have given it another star.
profile.summary: Identity Crisis?  In Real Life This is More of a Khaki Flavored Gold vs. Yellow Gold (or Gold Gold)

profile.description: Blank Flash Card Dispenser Box Card Size 2'' x 3'' 1000 cards
profile.reviewText:
I use these cards for my language studies and they work fantastic for me!  I am able to conjugate verbs on one card (I write medium-size to big).  The cards don't seem flimsy at all to me, but it could be because they are compact.  I can't use with a sharpie due to bleed through, but I use a dark-colored ink pen, which is fine.  I love that you get 1000 cards for $7.  I love the petite size because I feel like I'm not wasting space like with the bigger index cards.  My classmates have cut their cards but they sometimes look sloppy because they use a paper cutter.  I'm glad I went this route - frustration free!  I am a perfectionist when it comes to straight edges, and I know I would be recycling the grossly messed up cut cards had I had to cut them myself.

The only thing I would change is the container.  My cards are always coming out.  I am thinking about using saran-wrap, or baggie, until I can find and buy a plastic container for the cards.
profile.summary: Love the Cards, Hate the Container

top_5.description: Nominated for five Academy Awards including Best Original Screenplay, this magical comedy earned overwhelming acclaim nationwide! A painfully shy waitress working at a tiny Paris cafe, Amlie makes a surprising discovery and sees her life drastically changed for the better! From then on, Amlie dedicates herself to helping others find happiness ... in the most delightfully unexpected way! But will she have the courage to do for herself what she has done for others?
top_5.reviewText:
I'm not just saying that because I love Paris, which I do.  This movie is nothing I would have picked to watch (someone else made me watch it), but it was just odd enough to capture my attention.  First we start off with Amelie's conception and then it highlights certain pivotal moments of her childhood.  GENIUS!  Without giving too much away, we see her craftiness in childhood when she takes revenge.  Another moment of GENIUS!  The director is genius.  This movie is genius.

Great scenery.  Great acting.  Great casting.  Amelie is very relatable, especially to other introverts.  I found myself reminiscing on how I was like her when I was younger and more shy.  Audrey Tautou reminded me of Audrey Hepburn.  They couldn't have picked a more gorgeous Amelie.

Bise, bise!  Au revoir!
top_5.summary: Quirky and I Love It!

top_5.description: Will Atenton (Daniel Craig) quit a high-profile job in Manhattan to relocate his wife, Libby (Oscar-winner Rachel Weisz), and their two daughters to a quaint New England town. But as they settle into their new life, they discover their perfect home was once the murder scene of a mother and her children. When Will investigates, hes not sure if hes seeing ghosts or if the tragic events are somehow related to his past. The only clues come from his mysterious neighbor, Ann (Oscar-nominee Naomi Watts), who helps him piece together this haunting puzzle. Full of twists and suspense, this psychological thriller will have you on the edge of your seat.
top_5.reviewText:
I hadn't heard of this movie before and I'm surprised that Daniel Craig was in a flop.  (I checked Wiki and this movie did not do well at all.)  Two big actors?  It's surprising.  Do NOT watch the trailer.  It contains a massive spoiler alert.

This movie had me glued from start to finish.  I didn't know what was going to happen next.  Great plot! Great acting!  Great suspense!  I looked at the trailer at the end of the movie, prior to writing this review because a lot of people were saying not to look at the trailer.  It's true!  Don't look at the trailer prior to watching this movie.  That was lame that a big spoiler is in the trailer, and it would ruin it for anyone.
top_5.summary: This Review Does Not Contain Spoilers.  Do NOT watch the TRAILER!

top_5.description: LifeBook T4220 Tablet PC with Genuine Windows Vista Business with Free Microsoft Office OneNote 2007; Intel Core 2 Duo Processor T7500 (2.2 GHz, 4 MB L2 cache, 800 MHz FSB); Intel 965GM + ICH8M Chipset; 1GB RAM (1 slot used), Two DIMM slots, max 4 GB, 200-pin SO-DIMM, DDR2 667 MHz with dual channel support; 12.1" (active) XGA indoor/outdoor display with greater than 160 degree viewing angles; Mobile Intel GMA X3100 with Intel Clear Video Technology enabling DX10 and MPEG-2; 60GB SATA 150, 5400 rpm hard drive; Modular Dual-Layer Multi-Format DVD Writer (Up to: 8x DVD-ROM, 8x DVD-R/+R/+RW, 6x DVD-RW, 4x DL DVD-R/+R, 5x DVD-RAM, 24x CD-ROM/CD-R, 10x CD-RW); Integrated 56K V.90 modem Gigabit Ethernet LAN; Intel Wireless WiFi Link 4965AGN (802.11a/b/g/draft-n) and Bluetooth 2.0; 10.8V 5200mAH Lithium ion Battery; Ultimate security with integrated Fingerprint Sensor, embedded TPM, dedicated Smart Card slot, Security Button Panel, and security lock slot; LoJack/Computrace ready.
top_5.reviewText:
This was one of my favorite laptops back in the day.  You could swivel the screen until it collapsed on the keyboard, and then you could write (or draw or doddle) on the screen with a stylus like a notebook.  This was way ahead of its time, but then Apple came out with iPads and then other companies came out with their version of tablets. I would have kept it, but the keys started going out one by one.  First an arrow key, then the letter N.  Finally and splurged and got my current laptop which I love and has lasted for three years (product review to follow, maybe?).

What was great about this laptop was that it wasn't too bulky, nor was it all that heavy.  It offered great protection because the screen would swivel back into a regular laptop position, and then you would close it.  I wouldn't mind investing in a similar, newer version of this product.  My ipad seems so disconnected from a laptop, but the Fujitsu hybrid truly was the best of both worlds (tablet and laptop) because I was able to use the MS suite.
top_5.summary: Had This Back in the Day Before the Current Version of Tablets

top_5.description: Dr. Joy DeGruy is a priceless asset to us all. She has lifted the bandages from the 400 year-old abscess of slavery that remains un-healed. Many black and white Americans have been taught that slavery ended by legislative means in 1865 - so the issue is neatly side-stepped in school curricula, print and broadcast media. However, the hallmark of classroom teaching and responsible journalism must be proper context - for full understanding. The removal of the slave shackle is important, but what about the emotional damage suffered by the enslaved? Dr. DeGruy has raised this argument brilliantly, for years, lecturing far and wide. Her many appearances on my program, Like It Is, have evoked huge audience reactions from our viewers. Many have told me how coming to understand Dr. DeGruy's message on "Post Traumatic Slave Syndrome" has helped them grapple with the multiplicity of problems today. I share those feelings of my viewers. Now Dr. DeGruy has set down her highly important message/thesis in print. And so, to quote this wondrous physician: "Let the healing begin." -Gil Noble, Producer and Host, Like It Is, WABC_TV Dr. Joy DeGruy's Post Traumatic Slave Syndrome: America's Legacy of Enduring Injury and Healing is a masterwork. Her deep understanding, critical analysis, and determination to illuminate core truths are essential to addressing the long-lived devastation of slavery. Her book is the balm we need to heal ourselves and our relationships. It is a gift of wholeness. -Susan Taylor, Editorial Director, Essence Magazine Dr. DeGruy's book is seminal research in the field of differential cross- cultural diagnosis for mental health. Cultural Competence is a requirement for mental health and behavioral science workers. This text is required reading for all learners and practitioners. It is a vast reservoir of the how, why what, when, and where for much of the enduring injury and psychic pain of African Americans. This text moves us beyond deficit modeling and pathology; it opens a window to innovative models for healing in our multi-ethnic, pluralistic and linguistically diverse society. -Edwin J. Nichols, Ph.D. Clinical/Industrial Psychologist. At last, the book that all people who are truly interested in under- standing the lingering psychological and social impact of enslavement on Africans and Europeans has arrived. It is no exaggeration to say that Dr. DeGruy's Post Traumatic Slave Syndrome will mark a milestone in the understanding of the relationship between racism and slavery. Read this book again and again and then give it to your friends, family and colleagues who want to understand how the ghost of slavery haunts us all. -Dr. Ray Winbush, Institute for Urban Research, Morgan State University Dr. DeGruy's mesmerizing, riveting book is vital reading for our time. The corrosive residue on unmitigated and unrelieved atrocities called chattel slavery scours out the very core of our national identity. Neither the descendants of chattel slavery nor its designers have been unscathed. One - doomed to mythologize its meaning, the other - to turn searing pain into self-loathing. We ignore our history at our own peril. With Dr. DeGruy's potent words we can and will heal. -Adeliade L. Sanford, Vice Chancellor, Board of Regents, State of New York
top_5.reviewText:
I had came across this phenomenal lecturer on Youtube.com (from the advice of my mentor) and knew instantly that I wanted to hear more of what this woman had to say.  This book is a great supplement to her Youtube.com video at http://youtu.be/PMVRyD4UlHk?t=20s.  The Youtube video could stand alone; whereas, this book is icing.  The Youtube seemed more detailed, especially in terms of cognitive dissonance and other things like the postcard pictures of lynchings.  I think the video is more recent and therefore there are more supporting facts.  Regardless, this should be required reading for African Americans, especially in an academic setting.

Even though America has a tarnished past, especially when it comes to the stain of slavery and the subsequent treatment of African Americans, this book offers hope and concrete steps to heal from PTSS.  This book has touched me at a deep level, just hearing about other people's reactions was very validating, especially when it comes to anger seething beneath the surface.

One thing that I enjoyed learning through the video that wasn't in the book was that the Statue of Liberty's chains (not shown in most photos or on film) was supposed to symbolize America's abolition of slavery in 1865.  We don't hear about that, but this has been a fact verified on the government's website at www.nps.gov/stli/historyculture/abolition.htm.  This woman is phenomenal and I hope the truth continues to come out.
top_5.summary: Very Validating, Especially in the Wake of Michael Brown's Death

input: Generate the review text written by a reviewer who has a given an overall rating of "5.0" for a product with description "Engineered to be the world's most advanced graphics cards, XFX R9 290 GPUs feature the award-winning GCN Architecture for unrivalled performance and efficiency.". The summary of the review text is "A review, not from a miner -- for you Clementines out there.".
output:
I had to downgrade a SLI setup, due to money reasons -- Twin 760 FTW . I'm convinced I am not the only one this has happened to.

So I did some tireless research, and also went to Toms Hardware's best graphics card for the money, and I came up with this card.
Always been a fan of Nvidia and EVGA. Not because of blind loyalty, but because I never had any issues with the products and they preformed well.

I was about to pull the trigger on a GTX 770 4 GIG, and something stopped me. Was I getting the best performance for my money? Or was I simply just following Nvidia and EVGA around throwing money at them?

First off, Modded Skyrim, uses over 2 gigs of memory, so I needed something at least 3. It also helps with the future. Who knows what kind of use we see from Star Citizen? People say getting over 2 gigs of memory on a card is a sales trick and isn't needed but those people aren't considering modded games and future proofing.

Looking at EVGA products the cheapest 770 I could find was 409.00 dollars -- with 4 gigs of memory, that was before sales tax.
This card ran 417.00 with sales tax, so it's cheaper than the EVGA 770 4 gigs in every respect.

I know the Nvidia fan boys claim they go after the 770, and 760 because they run cooler, both are less loud -- and that was true, with the original reference cooler, but not anymore.
This card runs cooler than my 760 FTW, by around 4c. So I can only imagine, the same holds true for the 770. The sound is identical to me. The drivers are about the same now days, just ask the upset Nvidia owners about various game never being optimized. Team green has issues too. I won't even bother compare it to the 780, because that card is overpriced compared to this one. But for your information, the R9 matches the 780 nearly stride for stride and comes up on top for certain games.

The fact was simple, this card is cooler, runs the same temp as a GTX 770 and it's cheaper. Performance wise? This card eats the 770 for breakfast, 20-30% performance gain and that's without overclocking. So what's the catch? There isn't one.

Nvidia jacks up the prices on their stuff, and has built up a brand where most people are okay giving too much money for their cards.
I went with this card, and I am extremely happy with the result.

Lets add in Mantle in the future, Star Citizen will use it. It's support will only get better over time, teaming it up with my 8350fx, has been an amazing gaming experience.

Only games I play right now is Marvel Heroes and Wildstar. Both games perform amazing with this card. I expect the same thing with Dragon Age 3 and Shadows of Mordor.

***************UPDATE 9/19/14

While I stand by the 290 XFX as a great product, with no performance issues whatsoever. The release of the new 900 series by Nvidia, withdraws my recommendation for buying this. The reason? The 970 is 18% faster then the 290 (based on benchmarks). It sells for around 320-350 and uses less power.
So it is cheaper of your electric bill, and it's cheaper all together.
I have been a fan of AMD for a long time, but ultimately, all I care about the best performance I can get for my games.
Makes it easier to buy two in the future due to the price.
Nvidia may very well get it's hands on Mantle someday, through a license deal. So I recommend now changing to team green.

This is not a knock on AMD. The World of Graphics cards, changes all the time, it's a constant war, and great for the consumer. Since the R9 series launched AMD was in clear control of providing a cheaper faster option. No anymore.

I will recommend picking this card up, if (when) AMD does price cuts to compete with Nvidia. Such as 18% cheaper than the 970.

profile.description: NVIDIA's flagship GeForce GTX 1080 is the most advanced gaming GPU ever created, powered by the new NVIDIA Pascal architecture. The GeForce GTX 1080 comes with ultra-fast FinFET and high-bandwidth GDDR5X technologies, plus support for DirectX 12 features to deliver the fastest, smoothest, most power-efficient gaming experiences. Get the power to drive VR, ultra-high-resolution, and multiple monitors. Plus, bring more realism to every game with NVIDIA GameWorks technologies that deliver a true cinematic experience, smoother gameplay, and amazing new image-capture to share your game. All with the lowest latency and plug-and-play compatibility with leading VR headset.
profile.reviewText:
This card is amazing. But it isn't beyond incredible like many tech reviewers are saying. The reason for my lack of awe; I only game in 4k and because of which I am not as impressed after Nvidia's questionable presentation that portrayed as just short of something that produces liquid gold. At 1440p I already got 60+ performance with my AMD Nano and my Titan X. So I am not impressed or surprised at all the 1080 manages to do this with ease - it should.

1440 benchmarks mean little to me, and anything lower than that is a joke for this card. If 1440 is the resolution for you buy this card without a thought. A single GTX 1080 can manage 50+ frame rates at 4k but games like Total War Warhammer- it drops in the high 40's. That is amazing for sure but not all that amazing compared to my Titan X which can manage high 30's on average in all games at 4k and the 980ti is just as good as the Titan X.

The price makes this card much more impressive, it is cheaper than both the Titan X and 980ti. But lets be honest reference cards are only great for two kinds of people. Those who want to rip off the cooler right away and water cool it and those who don't care about overclocking - who just want a little tank that will run forever without worry. It also dumps hot air out of your case which is nice but be prepared for a lot of hot hair with the founders cooler.

What is amazing to be is not many reviewers are talking about the heat for the reference cards, 67c is not even close to correct and Nvidia did little to clear it up. This card will easily run about 80c if you let it and it will idle down quickly when it does. So you really have to adjust the fan profile to make sure it does not idle and adjust temp limit. You may even have to go as high as 60%-80% fan speed to get the results you want. The card isn't too loud when adjusted that high either which I was surprised.

I have tried to look at the founders card being priced so high from a balanced point of view and I just can't see how it is acceptable. I see it only as a "need to have it on release day" tax which is hardly different (but cheaper) than what scalpers do on ebay with new tech.
The non-reference cards will be better fit for my needs towards 4k. I can overclock them and get better performance and maybe even max out 4k frame rates.

Plenty of amazing cards to chose from that will be coming out soon, ASUS, EVGA and ZOTEC look to be the best. Some could sell 100 dollars less than the founders, so could sell as much or slightly more. Regardless those are the cards that seem worth it. Assuming you are the kind of person who can wait slightly longer.

The non-reference cards allow for more power, they will cool much better for those don't want to water cool, EVGA will make a hybrid version, and honestly there is no downside. It makes no sense no to wait a few hours, days, week longer (sorry there are conflicting reports). Unless you want to watercool them yourself, or run in SLI.
Founders chips aren't cherry picked as the best ones, nothing about them is really different than no reference. So again the extra money makes no sense.

Pros
- Overall performance especially at 1440p
- reference design
- fan runs quiet even at high %

Cons
- reference model runs very hot
- 100 dollar got to have it now extra tax.
- Will be able to get one soon that runs cooler for the same price or cheaper
- Probably will need to overclock to get around 60fps for 4k

Grade
A- (Founders) A+++++++++++ (non reference/hybrid/watercooled)

Conclusion
A no brainer card for 1440p (honestly it is probably even too much but hey future proofing), for VR it is amazing too but for those of us who play only at 4k it is probably best to wait for non-reference models unless we want to watercool it ourselves or slap a hybrid on it (even still you are overpaying and voiding your warranty). It could use a overclock for some games at 4k.
I imagine the 1080ti and this generations Titan will be able to max out 4k easily with one card. Which is probably why this card can't max out frame rates for 4k resolutions for many games. Nvidia wants big spending pc gamers to look at those two beasts when they come.
profile.summary: Amazing card! But consider waiting for non reference... I mean, sorry; "non founder" models.

profile.description: Sapphire Radeon R9 295X2 8GB GDDR5 DVI-D / Quad Mini DP PCI-Express Graphics Card
profile.reviewText:
The only thing keeping this card for being a perfect 5-star rating is the crossfire aspect and the fact 4 gigs of memory per card does not equal 8 gigs total it still is only 4 gigs. But that only really matters if you are running 4k. Crossfire is hit or miss some games will love it and some games will hate it.

I have gotten some games to run great with crossfire off. Which is the same thing as switching to a single card (which some have said) and it is nice to switch back to crossfire for games that will use it.  The cooling is great and worth the price compared to two reference 290xs.

So why take this card over a 980? Have you seen the benchmarks for windows 10? So my advice if you are upgrading to windows 10? Try this card out and or a 290x. See if you get better performance.

Even with the rumor that te 300 series is out in June. The 200 series will be cheaper and the better deal if it offers great windows 10 performance.

This card performs great right now if I have problems I turn crossfire off. I run it fine on my EVGA 850 gold. Hell, I even tried to run Tri crossfire thinking I couldn't do that but that worked fine too. Affordable upgrade options in the future at the very least. I think a lot of people's problems is they are running this card on their sparkle power 500 w power supply that is 10 years old. Or not disabling crossfire for some games. Disable crossfire if you are not using it. It's simple.
profile.summary: The only thing keeping this card for being a perfect 5-star rating is the crossfire aspect and the fact ...

profile.description: Wii U is the revolutionary console from Nintendo, featuring high definition graphics and the innovative Wii U GamePad controller. Play great games in all new ways, only on Wii U!
profile.reviewText:
Video games are my greatest hobby. They inspire my writing, help me relieve stress and have given some of the best memories of my life. I am also a PC gamer. My PC costs more (built it myself) than many college student's cars. I laugh as I play my games flawlessly at 4k while Playstation and X-box One fans fight to the death in comment sections.

I have my HTC Vive set up at my desk, that costs more than a X-box One and Playstation 4 combined. So you understand I am a hardcore gamer and use my computer for everything, from work to games, I fully embrace the idea of PC gamer master race. I love my PC more than what it considered healthy. But I love Nintendo too. I play my Wii U and 3DS just as much. Currently I use them more than my HTC Vive and my 4k gaming rig.

I can play games like Halo on PC and do it better. Any game X-box offers as a non exclusive I can buy on PC and run it better. Playstation 4, I already have VR so that doesn't interest me. I may not be able to play Uncharted and it is a great series but I can play something almost like it on PC. I can watch Blu rays at 4k and I can do everything those boxes offer media wise and more.

I can't duplicate that with Nintendo unless I use emulators but that robs from the industry and Nintendo. There is only one Mario from my childhood regardless what game he is in, there is only one Zelda, Metroid and that is to name just a few. Nintendo offers experiences that nothing can match or duplicate. Even having a powerful PC with the best of everything can't duplicate it.
The Wii U is a great console and the hardware is amazing. I say this as a PC snob. It has some great games too and offers a experience that blows the other two consoles away.

The criticisms of the Wii U are fair however and I admit that as a fan. It lacks graphic power and so many titles wouldn't come to the system. It's slightly on par with or above a X-box 360. So the Wii U missed out on many gamers. On top of that they confused the hell out of people with the tablet controller, the name and the PR wasn't casual friendly.

The lack of games complaint is also fair. Now the games the do have are typical Nintendo quality and are amazing. But they do lack in number. The worst offense is the lack of a Zelda game - a new Zelda game. Plenty of people bought the Wii U just for a new Zelda alone and instead nothing for years. Yeah we got some amazing remakes AMAZING but that isn't enough for any real Zelda fan.

Nintendo also claims they want to cease production of this console by 2018. There will be a lack of titles even more from this point forward. The new Nintendo system will come out in 2017 and the Wii U will be quickly forgotten with focus on the NX. The most forgotten console ever for Nintendo without a doubt. The 3DS will slowly get killed off in favor of shifting their games to mobile and seems will go the way of the Wii U apart for the fact the 3DS was much more successful. Wii U sales wise pooped the bed regardless of it's quality.

All of that said? I do not regret my purchase for a second. Because I still have my original Nintendo, Super Nintendo, N64, Game Cube and Wii. I play them years later. They all have something to offer. Wii U games aren't going to stop being amazing just like the games made for other systems. Nintendo games age like fine wine when they are good or great. I still play Bases Loaded, Black Bass, and Contra to this day - Mega Man 2 my favorite game of all time - tied on with Castlevania.

Keep in mind you will still be able to buy Zelda Wii U next year if you pass on the NX. The 3ds will still play all the games it does now and I have a windows phone so I won't get to play any of the mobile Nintendo games anyway (not supported) and even if they do become supported the phone sucks for games.

The final reason for my lack of regret is very simple. My niece, playing Mario Cart or Zelda her eyes just light up. She plays all of my PC games, and has seen the best gaming has to offer tech wise. But nothing gets the reaction Nintendo does. I look into her eyes as she lights up and smiles playing Zelda and I see myself as a young kid. That same spark and excitement that made my childhood magical - that got me through good times and bad.

No way will I regret my purchase for that reason alone and even after all these years at 36 that sense of wonder, along with excitement still lives in me the same way it did as a little kid. I'll end up giving my niece my Wii U when I get the NX and hopefully her spark and sense of humor never fades either.
profile.summary: The forgotten console, that offers the most to gamers.

profile.description: Rainbow Six Siege is an intense, new approach to the first-person shooter experience. Choose from a variety of unique Counter-Terrorist Operators and master their abilities as you lead your team through tense, thrilling, and destructive team-based combat.
profile.reviewText:
PROS: If you have a full team of friends? There is no better shooter this year.

CONS: If you don't? You can't rely on strangers who may or may not talk to provide an enjoyable experience. If anything this breeds toxic behavior. So if you are a solo focused multiplayer type person. This game is an easy pass.

I have a gaming system and it isn't for everybody but I find it useful. I expect a dollar an hour for my time invested in any game (yep I have heard all the trolls in regards to the dollar an hour comparisons - so funny kek).
A game like Skyrim? I put in over 300 hours and it is safe to say I made an outstanding purchase even at 150 dollars for the collectors edition at the time. But I have also bought many games where
I lost money on paying triple A price only to manage a handful of hours. Even some indie titles I think five dollars is a great deal on a game I am mildly interested in and then I never play it even though
it is a great deal I lost money.

Enter in RainbowSix: Seige. I have been a fan of these game for years and you can imagine when I found there to be no campaign I was very disappointed. Then I looked at the price tage and scoffed. That much for a non campaign game?
Insane! Typical Ubishit tricks again. But then I looked at it differently because when anyone is overractive they are rarely intelligent. I tried to remember the campaign from the other games and I couldn't. By saying that I could not remember I mean I couldn't even remember the smallest detail of any of the other games.
The book I could easily recall but not the stories told in games. Then I started to consider how many other campaigns I beat in other shooters and I could think of very few. When you think about it? Not really a big deal. Yes people have a right
to be disappointed but it certainly isn't the end of your gaming hobby either.

Then you look at the launch price and many felt it is too high for a multiplayer only game - especially with the season pass. At first I felt the same way but after playing it I can tell you I will easily get the money to time ratio I explained above because I enjoy it.
I compared it to battlefront the ulimate edition. Then I looked at the Black Ops III deluxe edition. Both over 100 dollars, Both with no campaign or a short one and I started to realize it might seem high but it is cheaper than other offerings - outside of Halo which is a
aquired taste and only on one system. And even then it is only 60 dollars in some cases. I just wanted to get those points out of the way. All that matters is how the game is and what it offers.

Believe it or not this could be the best multiplayer shooter of the year with on big IF. You have Halo 5, Battlefront, Call of Duty Black Ops III and then Rainbow Six: Seige. Sadly it does not take a genius to figure out Christmas wise what game people will
probably pick out of that group. It is just not a household names compared to those giants.

But here is the reality. While it might not be able to compare in name. It blows all of those others away as a game. While the others seem like easy choices to make you would be wrong.
This is a real shooter and runs in the same vein as the great shooters in the past and the destructable environment is amazing. Yes battlefront has some of that but nothing like this where it is part of the gameplay and strategy. That is
where this game shines. Another amazing aspect is you really feel incentive to progress in this game. The maps are amazing. The weapons smooth the whole concept is so well done.

I'm as shocked as anyone the start of this year I thought this would be the worst shooter of the year and that you could almost bet on it. While Battlefront or Halo would be the best. Now you could argue Battlefront is the worst and Rainbow Six is
the best. Any fan of multiplayer shooters owes it to themselves to give this game a try but just know this game is unlike other shooters. It is team based. No not a team death match team. Not a zone out a lone wolf it team.
This is a team shooter where you will need to talk with other people. So it is best to have a bunch of friends who want to play this game.

The one down side to this game is just how people are in general. You throw some random stangers together to play a game and you probably won't get the best results. In fact people who are part of an organized team will probably farm teams like that
for hours on end. So if you are going to invest in the game? Do so with the knowledge you shouldn't bother if you have no intention wanting to be social. I can't exactly punish a game that requires teamwork when there are so many other offerings on the market
where you can ignore everything solo or with a friend and have fun.

Grade B+
profile.summary: If you are a solo player? Look elsewhere.

profile.description: Platform:Xbox One | Edition:Legacy Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare - Xbox One Legacy Edition
profile.reviewText:
If you enjoyed the last game? You will enjoy this game. How much really depends on how fast you get bored. Because everything will feel somewhat the same after awhile. This is a very safe play by Activision and one that I am not convinced pays off. Yes it will sell millions of copies. No doubt making a ton of money but it is hard to imagine this won't be deemed the most bland game of the series.

Multiplayer feels infinitely the same. Now the campaign is amazing, and I love the modern warfare remaster I can't save how much I loved those. But let me ask you something? How many people do you know buy call of duty of the campaign? How many people do you know finish the campaign? I know some do but lets face is this game is all about the multiplayer. That is where it truly lacks.

I know I gave Battlefield 1 game of the year, narrowly beating out Dark Souls III but not by much. But that has nothing to do with this average review, I try to be as fair as possible. My friends love Call of Duty on their impression are largely the same was mine - it doesn't do anything different enough and feels the same.

Pros
- Graphics
- Sound
- Gameplay
- Campaign
- Modern Warfare remaster

Cons
- Feels infinitely the same as the previous title
- Plays it too safe
- Lacks where it counts which is multiplayer

Grade
C

Conclusion
While not a bad game, it isn't a good game either. With Battlefield 1 and the surprisingly amazing Titan Fall 2 (still working on my review) I can't make the case for anyone to pick this up. Unless your love of COD is the campaigns and you really want the remaster. The end result is a multiplayer that offers Infinitely the same warfare.
profile.summary: Infinitely the same warfare.

profile.description: Bethesda Game Studios, the award-winning creators of Fallout 3 and Skyrim, welcomes you to the world of Fallout 4. Winner of more than 50 Game of the Year awards, including top honors at the 2016 D.I.C.E. Awards. Fallout 4 is the studio's most ambitious game ever and the next generation of open-world gaming. As the sole survivor of Vault 111, you enter a world destroyed by nuclear war. Only you can rebuild and determine the fate of the Wasteland. Welcome home.
profile.reviewText:
There are problems with NPC's they will patrol with guns sometimes but the only thing is they are holding nothing but air.
They will become trapped behind cars but continue walking. One of my first missions was a escort mission. The leader of a group
of NPC became trapped behind a car in the middle of the road and wouldn't move. I even fast traveled to the location where they were
headed and he was still stuck back there but stuff like this happens in all Bethesda RPGs.

It's easy to say that Fallout 4 is a pretty good game but isn't easy to say it is a great game. It feels largely like the same game we have played before
when I can't say that about Morrowind, Obvlion and Skyrim. It's a fun game, a pollished shooter and a RPG set in a world like this is always a breath of fresh air. But the reality is it just isn't the overhyped monster fans of the series claim. It's not a GOTY winner they claimed it would be beginning of the year. That honor falls on Witcher 3, Legacy of the Void, Metal Gear, Rise of the Tomb and others. Rise of the Tomb Raider and Legacy of the Void got lost in the hype of Fallout but are both better games. Someone short on money should invest in those games if you have a X-box One and a good PC anyway.

Grade: B
profile.summary: A pretty good game. Not the overhyped monster the gaming press and fans proclaim.

profile.description: Featuring a fully customized PlayStation4 and DualShock4 wireless controller inspired by Darth Vader, there's no better place for the ultimate Star Wars fan to immerse themselves in Star Wars Battlefront.
profile.reviewText:
The game is average at best. As I said in my review it's like trying to play a beautiful picture. That was my expectation going into it anyway. But I didn't buy it for the game. I am selling the game. I bought this for Lord Vader who is timeless and my favorite character probably in the history of fantasy and science fiction.

I also bought this for the controller and plan on ordering another one when they are available to buy solo soon (within the next few weeks). I own the Destiny white edition bundle and the X-box One Halo 5 edition and both of those are fantastic. They look amazing and were the two best custom consoles ever. Until this blew both away. Which is saying something.

This is every Star Wars fans dream and although the game is something some would like to forget, Vader himself is unforgettable. Sell the game and get an even better deal on this dark gem. Regardless if you keep the game or not? It's impossible to be disappointed with the console itself.
profile.summary: The design is strong with this one!

profile.description: As fires fade and the world falls into ruin, developer FROMSOFTWARE and director Hidetaka Miyazaki continue their critically-acclaimed and genre-defining series with Dark Souls III. Fans and newcomers alike will get lost in the games hallmark rewarding gameplay and immersive graphics. Now only embers remain...
profile.reviewText:
**Update
Dark Souls III currently is my game of the year. Playing this game at 4k with my Titan X is a dream and it is buttery smooth. No lags or dips or problems of any kind. That being said there is some issues with the game in the form of glitches. As good as my Titan X runs the game, it runs as bad on my Fury series card at 4k and under.
Also the summoning system works about 75% of the time. The other 25% you will get trapped in the wrong world, or people will float slightly off the ground and the bosses won't attack. But don't let those things fool you - this is very much a flawed masterpiece. It's the Mona Lisa with a coffee stain in the corner.
RPGs just don't have this kind of depth and challenge anymore. Think about how you can play this game for a minute. You can be like me a Covenant of the Sun (Sun Bro) and help people kill bosses all day long. In theory you can get to a point and stop advancing and farm metals all day long. You can join a covenant where you invade other players realms and kill them.
You can be a guardian of players while they quest and kill the ganker players. You can just help someone and quest. You can be an anti hero spirit where you can attack others or help them. I could go on and on. You can also play the game offline and ignore it all. Or you could do all of it at the same time.
You see Dark Souls III is not just a challenge and it sure as hell is not a game you beat to brag about. There is more complexity and immersion - along with challenge. That you can't find in any other RPG released the past 16 years. I love the Elder Scrolls, The Dragon Ages (to a point, mainly the first), the Mass Effects (2 is the best game of all time for me) and the Knights of the old republic as well.
But this game is truly special the more you play the more you understand the possibilities and things to do are almost as vast as an MMO. Along with a ton of replay value with the covenants and classes.

I loved the first Dark Souls and I was asked point blank back then, "Why do you and others love this game so much. There is a limited story and it's too hard." At first I believed I couldn't speak for all players who loved this game, just myself.
But the more I thought about it I believed I could speak for most gamers who love it or at least do my very best. I responded with, "Developers 90% of the time underestimate how rewarding it is when we the players overcome a challenge. When we achieve something and celebrate. Not simply go through the motions without much resistance just to reach an end. Though I like games like that - ones that offer an experiece more so than a challenge. Dark Souls never forgets about that reward of overcoming a hellish resistance."
You see this series takes me back to being a little kid being a a friends house. Playing the original Castlevania and trying to beat the character "Death", the second to final boss who was Dracula. I could never do it. Not then, not now. That is right I still can't kill him even to this day but I always thought to myself, If I defeated Death how amazing would that have been back then?
Well now I know. It is amazing! Gaming rarely gets more rewarding than that apart from me playing a game like Mass Effect 2 or Skyrim. Where I feel like I am apart of that world and I am the character. So other than roleplay nothing compares.
I loved Dark Souls I, and II. Masterpeices in my opinion to various degrees. I remember playing Dark Souls thinking no way a sequel could ever be better. Well Dark Souls II was and of course I felt the same way, "Yeah 3 will be a great game but no way can they outdo this."
I was wrong again. Don't let some professional reviews fool you. This game is the best in the series and is a game of the year contender. The boss fights are better, the would is more beautiful and the gameplay is just as spectacular as it has ever been. No more needs to be added or said, it's yet another masterpeice and I might add it's the best PC version of the series to date - performance wise.
I read an article on MMORPG.com saying how Dark Souls games need an easy button. That having one such button doesn't effect people who want to play it on the hardest settings. No offense but this person doesn't seem to understand the point of the series.
This is a love letter back to a time when some games weren't afraid to be really hard and test skill. That is is a dying breed because developers are scared to death if a game isn't easy people will not buy their game.
Saying these games need to be easy is like saying Bioware shouldn't tell stories and make it all action combat. If you don't like story? Pick another game. Dark Souls isn't about reaching the end just for the sake of doing it - this game is not about story. It's about overcoming challenges and as I said overcoming such an obstacle is amazing. Not to mention they would abandon their fans who this series was built for - we don't want a game extremely hard to beat to show we are better than those who can't do it. We just want an experience like the glory days of gaming that needs to come back more so in it's own genre.
I remember some negative reviews of The Division from critics too. "Boss fights were too hard!" Remember that isn't a bad thing for everyone and it isn't something you should take points off for an easy button doesn't have to be employed on every game now days.

Pros
- Graphics
- Art Direction
- Beautiful large world
- Best Boss Fights of the series mostly
- Extreme challenge compared to the previous games
- Combat Mechanics and system
- Music
Cons
- As much as I love the series. It is starting to feel very familar and fatigue does set in faster than ever. Three is enough. I hope they take this challenging gameplay in a new title and direction. I would really enjoy it if more studios weren't afraid of making love letters back to NES games.
Grade
A++++
profile.summary: Echoes of gaming past. FOR THE SUN BROS!
