profile.description: The Fellowes Quasar+ Plastic Comb Binding Machine is perfect for meeting the binding needs of medium to large offices. The Quasar+ is a hard-working machine that can easily punch up to 22 sheets of paper at a time and can bind documents as large as 500 sheets using a 2" binding comb. The Quasar+ utilizes a vertical punching throat to help ensures accurate punch alignment. The Fellowes Quasar+ features a built-in comb storage tray with a document measurement device for added convenience and quick set-up. It also includes an adjustable rotary edge guide to help center documents for punching.
profile.reviewText:
I've had this Fellowes Quasar+ binding machine for about 3 weeks and I like it.  I use this for combo home use and office use.  It's good for binding kids school reports to give extra polish or binding club info packets.  At the office I use it to bind the occasional presentation that may be more important than usual (again gives that extra polish).

This Quasar+ (currently $185) is the higher end model in the Fellowes line compared to their Pulsar+ ($120) and Star+ ($70) models.  I will say this Quasar+ is probably more horsepower than I need for my own usage profile - I highlighted some specs below and also url link for Fellowes spec comparison of the models since I didn't see them easily viewable on Amazon:
  -Quasar:  punches 22 sheets, binds up to 500 sheets in one comb.
  -Pulsar:  punches 18 sheets, binds 300
  -Star:  punches 12 sheets, binds 150.
http://www.fellowes.com/us/en/Products/Pages/product-compare.aspx?cat=BUSINESS-MACHINES&subcat=BINDING_MACHINES&tercat=PLASTIC_COMB_BINDING&prods=US-5006501,US-5006801,US-5227201

In terms of actual usability I find this Quasar intuitive and easy to use - it has alignment guides to make binding easier, etc.  I find the build quality good and sturdy - it is large and heavy and it's worth noting that the Amazon description currently says it weights 7.5 pounds which is incorrect - it actually weights around 16 pounds.  View it as good exercise if you need to move this binding machine around.  This binding machine comes with only a handful of plastic combs included but it's easy to order more (on Amazon of course) and they are pretty inexpensive at $.05-$.10 each.

I mentioned this Quasar (currently $185) is probably more horsepower than I need - shoot me now (before the audience does) if I ever create a presentation for work or an Indian Guides welcome booklet that is 500 pages.  For my usage the Pulsar model ($120) looks like it would do just fine (though sadly from the specs still same heavy weight and large dimensions).  If you really do need the higher capacity that the Quasar offers then this is a solid product offering - overall I rate the Quasar 4-stars in consideration of price/value.
profile.summary: This heavyweight gets the job done and really is heavy (weights 16lbs, not the 7.5lbs currently described here)

profile.description: The spot clean cordless spot cleaner is perfect for removing spots and stains from those hard-to-reach areas that are always difficult to clean. Its portability makes it ideal for use on upholstered and outdoor furniture, car interiors, and more. The 3-n-1 stair tool makes it easy to clean corners, edges, and treads of carpeted stairs. Powerful scrubbing technology gets down deep to ensure that stains are permanently removed. With lithium-ion battery technology, you'll enjoy 20-minute run times and rechargeable performance with every use. Plus, we've got you covered with a 2-year limited warranty.
profile.reviewText:
Researching and understanding the differences in "portable carpet cleaners" can be confusing/time consuming - I know because I just went through this exercise so my review could be more informative.  After using this Bissell Spotclean 1570 and learning more about the competitive landscape I can say that the key benefits of this Bissell 1570 boils down to two things:  1) cordless, 2) lightweight.  Part of the confusion for me was that many of these types of spot cleaners are referred to as "portable" which makes me think "cordless"...but that's not true in this case...most of these type of spotcleaners listed as "portable" also have cords and require electric outlets (if you go on to read the more detailed product descriptions)..so this B1570 really is more "portable" than most other "portable" spot cleaners.

If you don't need cordless and lightweight then in my experience there are portable cleaners that give you more bang for your buck - in particular the Bissell "Spot Bot" which I've used and is awesome with it's autopilot-type cleaning setting (sidenote - they should delete the word "pet" in the model name because it works great for people without pets too).

For the most part I've had great experiences with Bissell products and this B1570 is no exception.  Easy to use right out of the box (after charging), worked great on all the stains I've tried it on so far (home, car, office cubicle rug with some nasty long existing stains that apparently require DIY).  I will say that in all those cases a corded spot remover would have worked for me as well - also the Bissell is manual operator cleaning - ideally for me I prefer autopilot cleaning such as SpotBot but either way gets the job done at the end of the day. B1570 has an internal battery that is definitely not replaceable (the user manual explains how to remove the battery for disposal and it involves cutting wires)...when the battery becomes inoperable over time I believe the charging cord can still be used to operate the B1570 (if not this would be a dealkiller for me).  Actually battery run time is good enough to get the job done for spot jobs - 15-20 minutes runtime in my experience thus far.

As product comparison info was not easy for me to find I've pasted a Bissell url link below that compares this B1570 to some other portable spot cleaners they offer.  Key takeaways from me - 1) this is the only "cordless" spotcleaner that Bissell currently offers in this size range, 2) B1570 is lighter than most other comparable corded spotcleaners (SpotBot weighs in at 13+ lbs though that info not listed in this chart for some reason), 3) the Bissell 5207F appears to be very similar in specs to this reviewed B1570 including tank size and only 1+ pound heavier except it has a cord (not truly battery cordless).
http://www.bissell.com/product_comparison.aspx?ids=9164,36850,2865,26065

Overall - at current price of $150 this Bissell 1570 is not cheap but if you value cordless and lightweight then this is a good choice (currently there aren't alot of choices for these specs from what I can tell).  If you can live with a cord and heavier weight then I think there are better bangs for the bucks currently out there such as Bissell SpotBot.  Overall I rate the B1570 4-STARS in consideration of price/value.
profile.summary: Key benefits of Bissell 1570 boils down to two things:  1) cordless, 2) lightweight

profile.description: PowerCurve 6 Outlet Surge Protector
profile.reviewText:
I received my 360 Electrical 36053 from my favorite store - Amazon.  Based on my use this far I declare it "mostly good".

The "GOOD":
 -It's a nice size for a two outlet + USB surge protector (fairly compact).
 -The build quality is good - appears durable.
 -The swiveling plugs are very handy to accommodate bulky adapters.
 -The USB power is not wimpy.  I've been trying to upgrade my wimpiest 1 Amp USB chargers since alot of phones/tablets (even my HP Chromebook) these days are able to charge faster with more Amps - from the info provided on the 360 product I wasn't totally clear on it's Amp output capabilities for single device (ie, is that 1 Amp per outlet or more?).  What I've since found is this surge outlet has 2 USB's but it appears if you use just one USB at a time it gives you full 2.1 Amp output but if you use both USB at the same time your Amps output will be less.  Per the 360 instruction book "USB ports typically share power output..small devices require less...large devices require more".

The "WHAT COULD BE BETTER":
 -Like alot of other surge protectors I've used the power lights (two of them) can be annoying if you have this plugged in a place where that might bother you (eg, bedroom, anywhere else where visually distracting).  Would be nice if this feature included an off switch...in the meantime a tailored piece of black masking tape does the trick to cover up the lights.
 -This surge protector plugs in and then extends to the right side at a right angle and does not give you an option to swivel that position.  In my case I had a door jam on the right side that was too close to the outlet and prevented me from using it in that spot.

Overall, a nice product with a few things that could be better.  At $18 price, 4-stars from me in consideration of price/value.
profile.summary: Mostly good, a few annoyances + USB power info

profile.description: alarm clock numbers on ceiling
profile.reviewText:
The best thing about this alarm clock is the projection of time onto ceiling or wall - a handy feature when I'm feeling extra lazy in bed.  The projection is clear and very readable.
Setting the clock and the alarm are not that intuitive but I figured it out after fiddling with it and it gets easier with practice.
I wish the LCD display had adjustable brightness - when plugged into electric outlet the screen is too bright for me to keep near my bed....when using battery power only the screen is too dim for me to easily read it.
But overall at $17 current price which isn't that much $4 these days... this alarm clock does function as a clock, an alarm, and the projection is cool.  3-STAR rating from me in consideration of price/value.
profile.summary: The best thing about this alarm clock is the projection...

profile.description: Stylish, feather light and seriously powerful, the Drops 360 RP-HJX6M In-Ear Headphones deliver a full range of exceptional sound performance. Its premium 12mm coaxial dual neodymium magnet drivers produce a level of deep, rich bass and clear, high-treble tones (5Hz-25kHz) not often experienced in ultra-compact headphones. Distortion is kept to a minimum with a color-matched aluminum ring on each speaker housing. Panasonic's ultra-soft earpads fit naturally into the ear to stay comfortably in place while walking, working or just relaxing. And no matter where you are, their airtight design fit snugly to reduce ambient noise. For individual comfort and fit, a set of S/M/L earpads is included. Drops 360 also incorporate longer, more direct audio ports to channel high-performance sound directly into the ears for hours of listening enjoyment. At the same time managing music and calls is quick and simple with an inline mic and remote. They work seamlessly with iPhone/iPod/iPad, Blackberry and Android devices to adjust volume and switch effortlessly from music to calls and back again with one-touch ease. An included travel case keeps your headphones safe and sound when not in use.
profile.reviewText:
A person can never have too many ear buds these days (especially when your kids steal them all) - so I was happy to add these Panasonic RP-HJX6M-R (Metallic Red) to my collection...
 --Sound Quality:  good, not great IMO.  The bigger speaker cone in earbud definitely gives more bass but a bit muddy.  Overall sound quality maybe a bit better than the plethora of ~$10 Panasonic earbuds that I have.
 --Comfort:  not as good as most ear buds IMO.  I use ear buds for lightweight comfort else I step up to over-ear headphones.  The same enlarged speaker cone on these earbuds that create a bit of extra base also create extra weight...hence less comfortable and a bit unwieldy in my ears.  Also the earbud rubber seems to stick a bit deeper into my ear than I like and vs typical earbud.
  --Color:  this is specific to "Metallic Red" color that I have but I don't really like the color in actual life.  The earbud piece is a decent shade of metallic red but the cord is kind of a "reddish/ brownish/ slight purplish" color that I don't find attractive (and it's not a very Manly color if applicable to you).  I won't factor color in my rating since this everyone has their own personal preferences on color - that this is just side note about my thoughts on specific color I have.

So overall, at current price of $44 these earbuds are pricier than my typical earbuds. Sound quality is a bit better than my typical earbuds but not as comfortable due to extra speaker bulk (which is equally important to me).  3-STAR rating from me in consideration of price/value.
profile.summary: Sound quality a bit better than my typical earbuds but not as comfortable due to extra speaker bulk...

profile.description: Thule's 3 Bike Raceway Pro Rack makes transporting your toys a hassle-free endeavor. SureTight ratcheting locking cables provides a secure attachment, while the FitDial allows you to make sure the rack fits precisely to your vehicle. Your bikes will be safe in the RoadDampening cradles, and the NoSway cages prevent bike-to-bike contact. The adjustable cradle arms accommodate every size of bike, and the lockable cable (lock included) secures your two-wheel investments to the rack.
profile.reviewText:
I've always had great experiences with Thule products in terms of quality and design so I was more than happy to add this Thule Raceway Pro 3-Bike Strap Rack to my Thule collection. First I will say that I use a tow hitch bike rack whenever possible (as opposed to a strap-type bike rack). My bias is due to the fact that back in time I was using a strap rack while cruising on the freeway - the rack started fishtailing around and the next thing I see in my rearview mirror is one of my favorite bikes tumbling down the freeway.  But, the reality is that sometimes you need a strap rack - lots of SUVs have a hitch to use but most non-SUVs (and many SuVs) do not have a hitch.  So, strap racks have there place too and I need one.

If you need a strap bike rack - this Thule is about as nice as they come (and at current price of $360 it better be nice considering some lesser strap racks can be had for under $100).  The #1 thing to check with this rack is to CHECK THAT THIS RACK IS LISTED AS A FIT FOR YOUR CAR MODEL.  The url link to "Thule Fit Guide" is currently listed in the Amazon product description - I also pasted it below (then choose "Rear" rack and your car model details.  From what I've seen there are many vehicles that are not listed as compatible with this rack - my Audi Q7 SuV and BMW 335i convertible are not listed as compatible with this rack.  Luckily my parents Lexus RX350 SuV (no hitch) is listed as compatible (for model years 2005-2015) and we need a good bike rack for this vehicle.
http://www.thule.com/en-us/us/buyers-guide?c=bike+carriers&dealerid=ade008bb-0487-4004-a7de-258e886b1cfb&utm_source=amazon&utm_medium=retailertraffic&utm_campaign=fitguide&q=kmyX43sAq

Based on actual use - this Thule Raceway rack has high quality and high design which is what I would expect from the brand.  The rack was very easy to get up and running out of the box (I'm not that handy).  The "FitDial" is a great feature and always you to tweak the settings for your specific vehicle (if you are lucky enough to be on the list) and gives a very good almost custom fit to the vehicle.  Rubber padded in all the right places so the car doesn't get scratched.  Anti-sway is effective in keeping the bikes from moving around as much (best I've seen thus far on a strap rack).  Quick and easy (minutes) to install/ remove after you get the hang of it and folds up very quickly for easy storage.  This Raceway has performed great around town and is very sturdy  - I'm ready to try the freeway again with this strap rack (if I have any issues I will update this review later).

So in summary, another great Thule product if you need a strap rack and your car is lucky enough to be on the fit list (I guess counterpoint to this is you  can clearly see if you should attempt to use this rack on your vehicle or not - I've seen some strap racks where that info is not as clear).  This Raceway Pro rack looks good and works good and is restoring my faith in strap racks (best I've used).  Of course at the current price of $360 (up to 4x cost of low end strap racks) - this Thule better be great.  Overall rating from me for this Thule strap rack - in consideration of price/value and less flexibility in the types of vehicles (family, friends, etc) on the approved usage list - 4-STARS.
profile.summary: Best strap rack I've used (if your vehicle is lucky enough to be on the fit list - be sure to check online first)

profile.description: Bring down the sky yet again in the fast-paced warfare of the sequel to Titanfall with the officially licensed Titanfall 2 Marauder SRS Stereo Headset for PlayStation 4. Block out distractions with noise-cancelling technology for clear audio, hear Titanfall 2 the way you're supposed to with well-balanced sound, and stay comfortable during long gaming sessions with the light-weight build. Position the flexible and pivoting boom mic, plug in your headset to your controller, and settle down for endless hours of high-quality audio. With a wired headset featuring a dynamic haptic driver that allows you to adjust the bass levels of your game, as well as easily-accessible volume and mic muting controls located on the ear cupyou'll be able to instantly chat with friends and other players. Feel your games in a whole new and exciting way.
profile.reviewText:
PDP Titanfall2 headset...a fairly decent value at current price of $60 on Amazon...trial

What I like:
  ++Versatility across multiple hardware platforms...this puppy says PS4 in the title but you can plug it in any 3.5mm jack and it works right away (at least on my mobile phone, tablets, and laptops) without fiddling with modes/buttons.  I never understood why some headsets were only compatible with one platform such as Xbox-1, etc...then I've had other headsets that work on more than one platform but you have to toggle modes trial & error style until you figure it out.  Why can't they all just be like this PDP...just plug it into a jack that fits and it works fine (a BIG Thumbs up).
 ++Sound Quality.  Actually PS4 or just some Pandora on mobile phone...I think the sound is good at this pricepoint with crisp highs and good bass.
 ++Comfortable.  I've seen some reviews posted here on Amazon saying this PDP headset is snug on the Noggin.  Well, I've written prior reviews about other headsets complaining about snug fits on my Noggin (5'10" male adult, slightly big Noggin on account of my big Brainses)...but I find these PDP's perfectly comfortable to wear for extended period.  Really my 14-year old son is main user (slightly big Noggin but not sure about Brainses)...he has no complaints about comfort (and he would let me know for sure).
 ++Don't need batteries to operate.  Yes, you can insert 2 AAA batteries to get the Haptic feedback feature...but the headphones still work fine for listening without any batteries (and sound quality still good).

What could be better:
 --I don't like the unremovable mic and headset cord.  The Mic not being removable is undesirable because if you want to just use this headset to listen to tunes you are still forced to look like a Gamer Dweeb with a Mic in your face....then again the deco finish is Camo military-style so I guess you are screwed anyway.  The headset cord being non-removable is undesirable because if it frays you are done (kids do dumb stuff)...or it you want longer or shorter cord you are Shoot-Out-Of-Luck.
 --Battery Life.  Yes, this headset works fine for sound without batteries.  But if you want the Haptic feedback you need to power with 2 AAA batteries.  My son reports that he has to change out the batteries every day and that is very inconvenient for him (he is super lazy)...not too mention he has used all my AAA battery supply (I will admit that he probably plays more hours per day than he claims).
 --Buttons.  Overall build quality is good rugged plastic but the nature of these made to look like military-style gear leaves it difficult for me to find what are the real headset buttons to press...so I just press around like a fool until I find a button.
 --Mic doesn't sound that good on PS4.  While the sound is good...my son reports that his friends tell him on Mic he sound like a tin-voiced robot when speaking to them on PS4 (whatever that means).

Other Notes:
 ~~When writing this review I tried to view the user manual online on PDP website (since of course my son long since tossed/lost the paper manual).  I could not find the user manual online for this (annoying).

****In Summary, I think the sound quality is surprisingly good, comfortable to me even for my slightly big Noggin, Mic sounds "tinny" on PS4, batteries drain fast for haptic but on bright side headset still works good without batteries when using just for sound, I wish the Mic was removable, #1 benefit is that it is plug-and-play across multiple hardware platforms using 3.5mm jack size.  At current price of $60 actually a decent value compared to other options I've used in the past....3.75 STAR rating by me for price/value with all things considered.
profile.summary: #1 benefit is works plug-and-play across multiple 3.5mm jack hardware platforms...

profile.description: The Scotts MaxFlex Heavy Duty Garden Hose is ideally used for gardening, landscaping, pressure-washing, and other maintenance; a durable hose that will last throughout the seasons, using weather-resistant material that remains flexible during the winter and strong nylon reinforcement. Garden hose is designed with a co-polymer material that makes it durable and flexible in a range of temperatures and is 30% lighter than standard hoses; features a burst strength of 500 PSI allowing use for tough jobs and crush-proof aluminum couplings that maintain their shape, even when driven over by a truck. Hose uses Lay-Flat technology that prevents the hose from twisting and kinking at the spigot, making it easy to maneuver around lawns and gardens. Lightweight and easy to roll up and store; comes with a lifetime warranty.
profile.reviewText:
I seem to go through quite a few garden hoses.  At least a couple times per year one of my hoses seems to develop a tear and spray water everywhere (usually in my face).  One of my hoses even tore in half near the connection valve and it was less than one year old.  Maybe it's because I tend to buy $20 garden hoses at Home Depot.

Well this Scotts MaxFlex garden hose retails at $45 and it's definitely nicer than my $20 hoses.  The hosing is more rugged, the valves are more rugged, the hose doesn't kink that easily.  A very nice hose - if I can get 1 years use out of it (without getting sprayed in the face) then it's worth it for me to buy another one for $45 (instead of 2 subpar $20 hoses).  So overall, 5-stars from me in consideration of price/value thus far - if I have any quality issues I will update my review.
profile.summary: On the expensive side but appears worth it

profile.description: Smith's #50525 Pack Pal 10-in-1 is one of their coolest products ever. The Pack Pal is similar in size and construction to Smith's popular line of Pocket Pal knife sharpeners, but packs a much bigger punch. It is lightweight, compact, and durable like Smith's other pocket-sized products, but this product was designed not just for hunters and fisherman. It will also be an essential part of gear bags for backpackers, hikers, campers, and climbers. The new Pack Pal features nine different tools in one compact and lightweight unit. The following tools are included: standard knife blade, saw blade, compass, fire starter, carbide sharpener, signal mirror, whistle, removable LED light with clip, and tweezers. There is also room to store extra batteries for the LED light or some dry tinder for starting a fire. The knife and saw blades are constructed from 440C steel and the tungsten carbide blades in the sharpening apparatus are both reversible and replaceable. It is hard to believe all of these tools can be packed into this one compact unit weighing in at only 2.6 ounces and measuring a measly 3-3/4" in length and 1-1/2" in width.
profile.reviewText:
I've has this Smith 50525 10-1 survival pal multi-tool for about one month.  I've used some well designed Smith products in the past but this tool misses the mark for me - particularly around the ~$25 pricepoint I saw it listed at before my review.

Really the main thing that misses the mark for me is the plastic construction and the various loose pieces both of which don't bode well over time.  In this price range there is alot of nice multi tools constructed of metal (steel, etc) which is more durable material in the long run.  Also on this Smith tool I'm not crazy about the hinged plastic door that opens to reveal a mirror and another mini-multi tool which must be pried out from inside (sharpener, faint whistle, etc)...to me it seems this hinged door is a weak point in the plastic case that might break pretty easily.  The 2 main blades retract from the main body but I had trouble swinging one of them out when I first tried it...I had to bend the plastic case a bit to allow the knife to be able to swing past the plastic.  It's hard to tell what tool is what and what pieces you should pull on to release vs what you shouldn't pull on or you'll break something.  The dangling paracord is really one time use and then the compass doesn't have a spot on the tool.

In summary, I'm always a fan of multi-tool gadgets but I still prefer my old school swiss army knife over this Smith plastic newfangled gadget.  Would I gladly have this Smith 50525 tool if I suddenly was lost in the wilderness (ie, due to sole survivor plane crash, alien abduction/release, just plain had too much to drink the night before, any other random scenario) and this was the only tool I had - sure.  But if given a choice, I prefer less plastic and less loose parts which are easy to lose.  Overall 2-STAR rating from me in consideration of price/value.
profile.summary: I prefer less plastic, less loose parts in my survival tools...

profile.description: Featuring all the functionality and portability of the Chant BT, but with bigger, bolder sonic strength, the CHANT BT Sport works with Bluetooth enabled devices and many more through the auxiliary input. 2 x 4.5W, 1.75" and 2 x passive radiators assure a maximum listening experience. Plus, it's water-resistant for enhanced outdoor use. Take it with you everywhere, and build your own wall of sound.
profile.reviewText:
I've been using this House of Marley "Chant Sport" speaker and there are many reasons to like it:
  +A good outdoor active portable speaker/ good build quality.  Has some weather/water resistance as backed up by IPX7 rating/certification (google it for more info).  The form factor is great - like a tall soda can which means it fits in my bicycle cup holder.  Materials appear rugged and overall look is attractive.
  +The sound quality is great for the size.  Crisp clear sound with decent bass for the size - better sound than most portable speakers in this size range I have used.
  +Good plug and play usability/design.  Bluetooth easily synched with my phone on first try.  Minimalist controls on top of speaker make it easy to use:  4 buttons is all you need (volume up/down, power, bluetooth).  Battery life advertised at 8 hours usage which is about what I get in my usage over the course of a few days.

Recharging is easy via included mini USB cable (standard size used by Android).  My only gripe and minus 1-star is that the rechargeable battery is sealed which means you can't easily replace the rechargeable battery after it wears out - if you recharge this speaker daily that means within a few years the battery will probably be shot.  If you're like me and only recharge a couple of times per week then I think the product life is realistic enough for today's consumer electronics.

Overall this House of Marley speaker is a great choice if you're looking for a quality outdoor/active speaker with good sound.  The House of Marley brand is reputable enough in my opinion and they've been putting out some creative/interesting sound products with good reviews as you can peruse by searching their name on Amazon.  At current price of $99 this Chant Sport is priced is on the high side relative to some other portable speakers on the market but the Chant Sport does have premium features in this segment such as weatherizing and better than typical sound quality.  Rechargeable battery is not replaceable but product life should still be reasonable enough for owners that aren't recharging the speaker every day.  Overall 4-STAR rating by me in consideration of price/value.
profile.summary: Good portable speaker/sound for outdoor/active use

profile.description: The low-profile and feather light design of Ink'd Wireless won't cramp your style and are comfortable enough to wear all day. Supreme Sound and a noise-isolating fit deliver rich, clear audio for any type of music. The flexible collar packs up to  its original size for easy storage in a pocket or bag. An 8-hour rechargeable battery lets you listen longer, and the built-in mic and remote let you take calls and control your music without ever having to reach for your phone. And thanks to 30-feet of Bluetooth range, you're free to roam.
profile.reviewText:
I've been using these Skullcandy Ink'd bluetooth earbuds (in the white color) and I have to say that I REALLY like this bluetooth headphone form factor.  Most bluetooth headphones I own carry there weight (battery, etc) on the ears and/or head.  The biggest thing I like about these Ink'd headphones is that the weight (ie, battery & controls) is on the neckstrap and thus my ear/noggin are more comfortable.  This leaves me comfortably cordless to listen to my tunes while working on my PC or just walking around.  I've also done some light jogging with these things on and I just put the neckstrap under my t-shirt collar so it doesn't bounce around. Notables by me:
 ++Battery charging is easy with standard Android-type charger. I get about 6-8 hours battery life per charge which is good for lightweight bluetooth headphone.
++Sound quality: actually very good. Crisp clear sound and good enough bass.
+++Comfort: VERY comfortable for me.  Simple earbud type headphones that you stick into ear (no fancy shapes to try to twist into the right spot in your ear)...they go in easy (they aren't too big) but they still stay in well.
++Ease of bluetooth pairing/ connectivity. Easy with my Android phone - just turned the earbuds to pairing and I was in business. Pairing with my latest Windows 7 laptop (Dell Latitude E7450) was once again a Wintel hassle but I'll put the fault on my laptop - I couldn't get the Ink'd earbuds to pair until I downloaded (again for my new pc) the updated version of Dell "Wireless 380 Bluetooth Driver"...then I reinstalled the Ink'd earbuds and they worked great on my laptop.
 --What could be better:  the actual cords that go from the neckstrap to the earbuds are VERY thin...they haven't frayed yet but I'm worried they might.  Probably made this thin to minimize weight but I'd be willing to sacrifice the extra fractions of an ounce to have the earbud cables be a bit more thick/ ruggedized.
So overall I have to say for current price of $50 on Amazon that these Skullcandy Ink'ds are a good value considering they are fairly unique from what I've seen with the weight shifted more to your neck and they are my new favorite comfort pair of cordless bluetooth headphones (as of now). 5-STAR rating from me in consideration of price/ value.
profile.summary: My new favorite pair of cordless bluetooth headphones (comfortable / light on my noggin)...

profile.description: Flexzilla premium Hybrid polymer garden hose now features Swivel Grip female & Male fittings. The comfortable gripping surface is much easier to turn & tighten. Flexzilla Swivel Grip makes connecting the hose to the spigot or attachments a breeze. The swivel action ensures that either end can be easily attached & the hose extended without twisting, so sprinklers lie flat & your work is more efficient. Plus, with our superior female hose end O-ring seal, you get a long-term, leak-free connection at the spigot that outlasts the competition by far. The premium Hybrid polymer inner tube material is drinking water safe.
profile.reviewText:
Since there are multiple model#'s listed on this Amazon page - my review is for Flexzilla 50' HFZG550YWS.  I've owned alot of hoses in my life - I have 4 hoses at my house always active (1 front yard, 3 backyard)....every year it seems like I am buying at least one new hose.  Tips I've learned to prolong hose life:  store them in shady areas (direct sunlight not good for hose life), don't keep water in the hose when you're not using (ie, don't rely on your spray nozzle stopper), don't buy any fancy new fangled gimmicky garden hoses.

For awhile I was into the flat-house, curly hose, fabric-hose-in-a-cup fads...but all those gimmicky hoses never seemed to work as advertised...quick to leak, tore easy, jumbled up into knots, first to fail, even sprayed me in the face a couple of times.  So now that I'm older and wiser I stick to  the good ol' fashion traditional garden hoses.  And this Flexilla is a mighty fine good ol' fashioned garden hose but still able to leverage modern technology via the material it's made out of "hybrid polymer" which is touted as delivering a hose that is lighter, stronger, and lasts longer.

What I like about this Flexilla:  the lighter weight really is nice and easier to move around, not totally kink free but less kinky than my other hoses, the swivels on both hose ends are very convenient and my manual sprinklers don't flip upside anymore (another common way I used to spray myself in the face).

In terms of Cons I don't really have anything bad to say about this Flexilla other than it is a bit pricier than your typical 50 foot hose...I see this Flexilla priced anywhere form $35-$50 depending on the date and the retailer - even on Amazon it seems like there are different prices for this hose (as of today Walmart has this hose for ~$41).  There are some other top selling 50' hoses currently on Amazon at ~$25 range.

So is the Flexilla worth the extra money?...I think at ~$40 price range it is worth the extra money if the durability is as advertised (I will update my review should there be any premature issues).  Besides the durability the extra bucks get you the lighter weight, less kinking, and the swivel ends...those features make this my new favorite garden hose at my house and I'm willing to pay a bit extra for that.  5-STAR rating from me in consideration of price/value.
profile.summary: A bit pricier than standard garden hose but worth it...

profile.description: DEWALT UTC (Ultimate Trim Compressor )
profile.reviewText:
Not all my tools are DeWALT but the stuff I have that is DeWALT I am always impressed with - well built, simple, effective.  They tend to be a bit pricier than some other tools I have but in my experience they last longer and are more effective - so I reach for them first.

I've never owned an air compressor - only borrowed one occasionally for light duty around the house - pressure washing,  installing trim, etc.  So I'm happy to own this DeWALT DWFP55130 - I've had this for about one month and it suits my basic needs just fine.  What I like most about this unit is the small lightweight size - not big enough for my contractor to use on a big remodeling job but perfect for my basic needs around the house - easy to move around.  Second, it is quiet for an air compressor - but compared to some other air compressors I've used this is much quieter (some of it to do with smaller size) which is also valuable when using around the house.  Lastly, the build quality is great and appears durable and the DeWALT brand also adds to my confidence.

At $230, a good price for home use air compressor - overall I rate 5-stars in consideration of price/value.
profile.summary: I'm always impressed with DeWALT

profile.description: Crusher offers an audio experience unlike any other on the market  one that puts you front row for your favorite music and movies. Utilizing two full-range 40mm audio drivers and additional dual bass drivers, Crusher transforms your audio into an immersive experience you dont just hear, you feel. Pair that with wireless technology and up to 40 hours of battery life, and you have a premium Bluetooth headphone with powerful bass you can feel.
profile.reviewText:
I've got alot of different headphones...these Skullycandy Crusher Wireless are my new favorite pair.  I like pretty much all aspects of these headphones:
 +++Most importantly amazing sound and the haptic bass takes the immersive experience to another level (and I like Bass,
 +++very comfortable with the higher end memory foam material,
 +++overall headphones have good build quality yet fold compactly nicely into included carry bag,
 +++bluetooth very easy to pair (first try for me which is not always the case) and these headphones still come with removable cord if you don't want to go wireless in some situations, and overall the features are easy to use,
 +++Amazing battery life...30-40 hours on one charge (micro USB).  I've got some headphones that need to be recharged what seems like every day...not these Crushers.

 ---My only knock is that aesthetically the headphone styling is rather bland and doesn't do justice to the performance they offer...but that is also subjective to personal taste.

Overall, at current price of $190 these puppies are not cheap...but IMO they deliver the goods in this price range...5-STAR rating by me in consideration of price/value.
profile.summary: Not cheap...but IMO they deliver the goods in this price range...

profile.description: Calvin Klein basics. Comfortable, 100% cotton underwear. Original Calvin Klein aesthetic.
profile.reviewText:
I bought the 3-pack of black v-neck CK's via Amazon in May'09.  I purchased men's size "Medium" based on the fact that I bought the same 3-pack last year in size "Large" and the fit was bigger than I wanted.  I am 5'10", 195lbs and usually wear a size "Large" in most men's tops.

In terms of sizing I was looking for a fit that is slightly snug versus too baggy (as the Larges were for me) so now that I have the size Mediums they are working out much better for my preference (especially since I've noticed they also tend to stretch out a bit over time).  Bad news is I have 6 of these tshirts clogging up my dresser drawers now, good news is since I have the Medium and Large sizes I can gain a few pounds and I'm still good to go (beer me).

I do agree with some other reviewers that CK tshirts do tend to be thin material and they aren't your typical stand alone t-shirt you can show off about town.  They are good tshirts under another piece of clothing, as pajama top, or working around the yard.  I actually like the fact that CK v-necks are thin because they are very comfortable to wear for incognito usage.

Style-wise a good looking t-shirt with nice looking v-neck shape.

Overall: 4 out of 5 stars. High marks for looks and comfort for my intended usage, minus 1 star for the slightly strange sizing causing inventory buildup in my dresser drawers.

I hope you found my review helpful.
profile.summary: I like these although size seems to run big

profile.description: The Lifetime driveway volleyball set is perfect for Pickleball, badminton, volleyball, and other fun family games. The all-weather net and poles have an easy telescoping adjustment that creates six different height settings (36", 49", 61", 65", 78", and 90") to accommodate a variety of games. The portable bases fill with sand or water and can be moved to any desired location. This portable design makes the set perfect for driveway, beach, pool, or backyard play! the set-up is quick and easy, and the all-weather materials will last for years of family fun. The Lifetime driveway volleyball set comes with 4 wooden paddles, 2 Pickleballs, and 2 shuttlecocks. It also includes a carry bag for the accessories including 4 ground stakes and Yellow guy ropes.
profile.reviewText:
I really like this Lifetime set and I'm using it now in place of my old net/set from another well-regarded brand.

What I like:
 ++The #1 thing I like is ease of setup/use.  Once I setup the weighted legs I was good to go - I filled the stand with water from hose and I also added ground stakes to the supporting ground poles for extra support.  The net then just clips on easy with the included carabiners...and then we were in action.  This setup was much easier than my other net/set which doesn't have weighted feet and thus lots of groundstaking, falling/leaning, fiddling, and #@! cursing.  It is very easy to raise/lower the net poles to different heights which my kids enjoy for v-ball spikes.  Also with this Lifetime it is easy to just unclip the net and put away...I just left the weighted feet under the porch and grab/go as needed.
 ++The sort of badminton-type game with wood paddles and weird shuttlecock is actually a very fun game and my kids love it.  It's very easy to rally the shuttlecock back and forth because it has slow lazy flight...even my novice kids were quickly doing 10 volley rallies.

Overall, this is a great set because it is easy to use...we're already using it way more frequently than my old set because it is quick to get up and running.  Quality is good enough but not premium.  Current price of $129 is a bit high relative to some other options out there but still I give it an overall rating of 4-STARS in consideration of price/value because we are using it and enjoying it (5-STARS if price less than $100).
profile.summary: This is a great set because it is easy to use (way easier than my old net/set)...

profile.description: Protect and organize quadcopter drones like never before. A patent-pending design and Form Shell technology pushes the limits of flexibility and protection so you can take your drone wherever you want. The Drone Gaurd CS 300 provides dynamic organization options, as well as several carrying solutions to meet a variety of travel and flight-plan needs. The adjustable system of dividers takes organization well beyond the "pick-and-pluck" system of other drone cases on the market. Organization of the case is as simple as moving dividers to fit the days needs. Keep all the necessary equipment in easy reach with dedicated storage for blades, props, GoPro or other action video cameras, batteries, cables, chargers, mounts or just about anything else you could need. A lightly padded back-pad and removable backpack straps allow for easy carrying to further flying destinations. Take drones on walks, hikes, biking; go further with greater ease and piece of mind that everything is protected and secure. Easily remove the backpack straps for storage or long transport. Quadcopter drones have been in need of a versatile, lightweight and portable case with a superior protection capacity. The Drone Guard CS 300 is the answer! Made by serious pilots for serious pilots, experience the difference today.
profile.reviewText:
I could "drone" on but this Lowepro CS300 is a great quality carrying case for smaller drones - for bigger drones (check your drone dimensions vs carrying case spec) they make case CS400 which you can also check out on Amazon.  Probably the biggest decision to make is if you should spend the extra $20 an (current price difference) and get the bigger CS400 bag for future flexibility.

The best parts parts about this Lowepro case are the build quality and thoughtfulness of design...basically the entire interior of the bag is configurable with velcro dividers so you can tailor to your own needs (as long as your unit can successfully fit in the case).  Also dedicated section to store smaller parts/ accessories.  This case is good quality - "formshell" outer composite shell appears durable but lightweight and slightly padded to protect your gadgets.  Speaking of gadgets - the flexibility of the configuration of this case means you may well be able to use if for other stuff you want to protect if you use your imagination and test the fit - my son heading to his friends house with his xbox comes to mind.  Zippers are good quality and work well (a pet peeve of mine when a cheap zipper ruins a product experience).  Comfortable as a backpack as well - the lightweight also aids in comfort.

So overall - very good case choice for your smaller drone.  Good quality/ materials, well thought out design including configurable inside layout.  At current price of $129 a bit pricey relative to some other options out there but you are paying for the good quality and design - the more expensive your drone is the more it might be worth it.  Another major consideration is that the larger sized CS400 model is currently only $20 more - I haven't that model in person so I can't visualize how much bigger it is (the specs only look a few inches bigger at each dimension) - if big brother CS400 still fit my smaller sized drone nicely I would be tempted to just buy the bigger case so I had more flexibility in the future for not much more cost.  For the CS300 - overall 4-STAR rating by me in consideration of price/value.
profile.summary: CS300 is a good quality case but might be better to buy larger CS400 for extra $20

profile.description: Compact DVD player compatible with DVD, VCD, CD, CD-R/-RW, HDCD, DVD-R/-RW and JPEG, with progressive scan.
profile.reviewText:
I purchased this Haier DVD50 in May'09 via retailer on Amazon.com because I wanted a small form factor DVD player for my bedroom.  It was JOA (Junk On Arrival).

The first time I tried to use it it would not eject my DVD back to me.  After much shaking and button pushing I finally got my DVD back.  Over the next few days I tried a few other DVDs and they all got stuck and wouldn't easily eject from the tray.  The things we take for granted in life such as easily getting your rental DVD back so you can return it.  I finally couldn't take the hassle anymore and just put the DVD player back in the box...of course I check the amazon vendor ANT's return policy and it says any defective items should be referred to the manufacturer for warranty...I'm sure that will be a fun adventure for me on a $30 DVD player if I dare to try it.

The other very annoying thing I found about this DVD player was that the red light is on all the time and it doesn't appear to change if the power is on or off.  I could never even tell when the DVD player was on as I fiddled around trying to get my DVD discs back.

The one positive I will give it is it does have a visually appealing design (nice chrome trim) relative to some of the other compact DVD players out there.  But overall, this thing was junk on arrival and a hassle for me.
profile.summary: JOA (Junk On Arrival)

profile.description: From industry firsts to industry standards, Marineland products are designed with both performance and style in mind. We push precision and power beyond the expected and listen to our loyal customers to make our products even better. We do this because at the heart of our innovative spirit is a desire to help hobbyists everywhere do more, create more and, most of all, enjoy more. So whatever your customers are passionate about  freshwater or saltwater, big or small, beauty or science  help them make their aquarium their own. Make it Marineland. Create an eye-catching aquarium with the Nook 5 aquarium kit! Hidden filtration, sleek lighting and a curved front edge set this tank apart from the rest and allow you to have great viewing at all angles. This sleek looking tank provides a fish focal point in any room. Complete your look with gravel and plants that add personality to this easy to maintain, 5-gallon kit.
profile.reviewText:
My kids have some sub-5 gallon fish tanks so we were happy to upgrade to this Nook 5-Gallon...

 ++(Good):  The Shape of the tank:  a nice shape that maximizes viewing area...visually at first it appears smaller than 5 gallons (but we did indeed put 5 gallons of water in).

 -- (Could be better) The Lid cover.  Very thin/flimsy and slips into the water very easily when you open the tank (I taped down one side in the back with masking tape to prevent this).  More importantly there are large gaps/spaces in the lid (the biggest open space is the front center area which you can see in the product picture...the problem with this is that my son always like to have an ADF (African Dwarf Frog) in his tank and we've had one leap out before..so the big gaps are a no no.  I resolved this problem by DIY'ing extra lid cover pieces to cover the gaps (I used a black plastic folder page to cut shapes from).

 --(Could be better) The lighting.  The LED is nice and bright but would be nice to have a second setting for less brightness or color lighting options like some other tanks that I have come with.

 --(Could be better).  The filter that is included is a bit on the noisier side than at least some of the other filters that I have.  Not totally disruptive noisy but not as quiet as it could be.

Overall, we like the tank and my son's fish seem happy as well so far.  Attractive tank and easy setup...the #1 thing that needs improvement is the lid cover.  At current price of $61 a bit pricey though relative to some other kit options you can get....3-STAR rating by me in consideration of price/value.
profile.summary: Attractive on my son's nightstand, Lid Covering is weakest link...

profile.description: The USAPA approved Pickleball-X Challenger paddle is a responsive aluminum paddle perfect for intermediate and beginner players looking to get into the game of pickleball.
profile.reviewText:
Even though this paddle is currently priced at only $20 and is not a high end paddle...it was a HUGE upgrade for me.  I was using a wooden paddle that came included as part of a multi-sport net-set (not Franklin brand)...the darn wooden paddle had sharp edges that actually cut myself on more than once @#%@...

So the first thing that I like about this Franklin paddle is the rounded edges as you can seen from the picture...so I promptly chucked my @#!@ old torture device/ paddle in the recycle bin.  Second I like the weight of this paddle....lighter than my wood paddle and feels good when I swing it.  I hit the ball well with this paddle though velocity seems slightly down compared to the hard wood paddle I was using.  But hey...I play pickleball with my kids occasionally for fun and to get them outside...I have no delusions of grandeur about making the Olympic team.

Overall for me this $20 paddle fits the bill and no more @#!@ bloody cuts.  5-STAR rating by me in consideration of price/value.
profile.summary: Only $20 but an upgrade for me...I like it...

profile.description: The Franklin perfect pump is an all in one inflation machine that ensures every ball is inflated to proper air pressure levels. The built-in pressure gauge provides accurate measurements so you always inflate your ball with precision, ensuring you meet the optimal level of air pressure. The dual action pump cuts inflation time in half as you inflate both on the pull and push stroke. The needle fits securely in the pump handle so you can see the pressure as you inflated. The set includes 3 needles. This technologically advanced pump includes all the tools you need to professionally inflate your balls perfectly.
profile.reviewText:
I never seem to have enough hand pumps around.  Between 2 kids, 6 sports, exercise balls, sports equipment laying in the sun, frayed pump lines, etc, etc...when the need arises..."WHO Took Dad's #@%  Pump!"  So, I gladly put this Franklin "Perfect Pump" to the test...and I like it (and still have it thus far).

What I  like:
 ++It pumps fast.  Dual action - air gets pumped while you push and pull handle.
 ++It's build pretty rugged.  Thick gauge plastic.  Appears pretty durable and doesn't have a little nylon hose like some other pumps I have which tends to be the first failure point.
 ++It's pretty compact which is handy.
 ++I like the storage compartment handle where you can put the air needles in (comes with 3).  It was a little unclear at first from the instructions where the storage compartment was - but I fiddled around and the handle unscrewed so I think that is the compartment.  I put the three needles in there loose...they rattled around so I also stuck some foam in there.

Other notables:
 --The air gauge doesn't seem that accurate but by rule of thumb anyway is to pump up my balls until they feel right ala Tom Brady (not just rely on a PSI#).
 --I wish this pump had a hole somewhere for a lanyard.  I like to attach my mini pumps to my gym bag (else my kids quickly lose them).

Overall, I've never had a Franklin pump but this is a nice pump.  Compact, fairly rugged, pumps very well.  At current $13 price pretty good value vs some other hand pumps I have - overall 5-STAR rating by me in consideration of price/value...2 PUMPS UP ;p !!
profile.summary: Compact, fairly rugged, pumps very well....2 PUMPS UP!!

profile.description: The trail Rider by Hollywood Racks fits most bikes using a padded universal frame clamp and adjustable wheel holders. Carries two bikes, lightweight and ruggedly built.
profile.reviewText:
I've been using this Hollywood Racks Trail Rider for about one month now.  Most importantly this thing is a hitch rack - a few years ago I was using a hitchless trunk attached bike rack and one of my beloved bikes flew off on the freeway after the rack came loose.  So based upon my own personal trauma I will now only use trailer hitch mounted racks since they are so much sturdier.

After opening the contents of this box the assembly looked to be a hassle but after a deep breath and carefully following the instructions it turned out to be easier than it looked.  This is a very sturdy and heavy metal rack - they make lighter metal racks but not for <$200.  Usage wise I really like the way this rack holds my bikes - just pop them on the trays and secure in place - quick and very sturdy on the road.  Personally I like this tray method better (faster, bikes wobble less) than racks I've used where you rest your bikes on rack bars and strap on.  After usage this rack does fold somewhat for storage though not as compact a shape when folded as I would like.

Overall at current price of $180 I think this is a good value for tray-type metal hitch rack.  5-stars from me in consideration of price/value.
profile.summary: Good Value (if you only need to carry two bikes)

profile.description: Mesh ball bag with a top drawstring and cord-lock. Holds eight to twelve inflated balls.
profile.reviewText:
I bought this ball bag from Amazon in Nov'08 and I have been using it for a few months.  I like to carry around a bunch of sports balls in the trunk of my car in case some impromptu sports time pops up in daily life and events (I've been the hero more than once for being at an event in the middle of nowhere and producing a football from my car trunk).

Overall I would say its been mediocre for me, but not great for my needs.
  - My #1 con would be the white color... I would prefer a black bag color to hide the dirt better.
  - My #2 con would be the size, it is too big.  I have at least 6 items in the bag and it is still seems empty.  If I had the option I would want a bit of a smaller bag so there wasn't loose material lying everywhere.

Overall I give it 3 out of 5 stars.  The bag does seem to be decent quality but the two "con" items I have do bug me.

I hope you found my review helpful.
profile.summary: Mediocre, could be better.

profile.description: SKLZ Pro Mini Hop Streetball is an authentic streetball backboard and break-away rim.
profile.reviewText:
This SKLZ Pro Mini Hoop is Sweeetttt.  I actually invented this product in my head many years ago after having various flimsy indoor nerf hoops hanging on a door in my house somewhere.  The nerf hoops always broke on me, etc and I wished I had a real quality indoor hoop for me and the kids to goof around with.  Enter "SKLZ Pro Mini Hoop" - this thing is basically your full-size outdoor backboard scaled down to hang on a door in your house.  The backboard is actually durable composite type material, actual metal rim (not nerf plastic), actual metal net that makes that satisfying "clink" sound when you swish it.

This hoop was easy for me to hang on door and has some padding to protect doors.  Comes with cool little basketball included.  My only gripes would be I don't really like pre-bought "scuffed / distressed" products since they can look a bit dingy - I would prefer unscuffed model.  And, kids playing hoops in the house can get a little annoying - most ideal for garage inside play.

Overall, at $41 I think this SKLZ is a great value, definitely 5-stars, and would make a great unique birthday/xmas gift for any young basketball loving kid (or adult).
profile.summary: Nerf Hoop On Steroids

profile.description: Between the carpool and the couch cushions, youre the CEO of the home front. Take care of your family  and take care of business, no matter where household pests rear their ugly heads. Show bugs whos boss with Hot Shot insecticides. Theyre your weapon of choice, giving you the clear advantage within your walls and at the bank. Save the day. Hot Shot Bed Bug Glue Trap provides an easy way to detect whether bed bugs are in your home. These disposable, ready-to-use traps detect bed bugs where they live and travel. These traps work best when placed in areas where bed bugs hide, such as on furniture and bed frame legs, between the mattress and box spring, on the floor and under furniture. This pesticide-free glue trap has a multifunctional design that helps provide early warning of bed bug infestations. When a bed bug is seen in the trap, begin the treatment process with Hot Shot bed bug control products. These traps are disposable  replace as needed. Check the trap at least once per week for evidence of bed bugs, such as small, reddish-brown bugs the size of an apple seed, small blood stains or dark excreta spots, dead bed bugs, shed skins or small, whitish eggs.
profile.reviewText:
The title sounds a bit fancy for what these are - low tech sticky paper.  The value is in giving you the idea - put some glue traps around and see if any  bed bugs get stuck in them - that way you know if you have a problem or not.  These don't solve your bed bug problem but the first step is knowing if you have a problem or not.  For example, my wife is always convinced we have bed bugs - so far we have no bed bugs in my glue traps after several weeks so that may convince her (and thus reducing my stress levels).  I did snare a little harmless spider (RIP).

Really to me these aren't much different than the fly glue paper I bought at the dollar store (which can also serve the same purpose).  But these Hot Shot Glue Traps have come down in price since I last checked - currently they're only around ~$3 for 4 of them.  And staring at the packaging is a good reminder to use them if you think you may need to (such as when your kid comes home from a week away at ymca camp - but I digress).  Overall I rate this product 3-STARS in consideration of price/value.
profile.summary: Low Tech but only a few bucks

profile.description: With convenient set up and easy portability, the SKLZ PitchBack is great for all diamond players and teams. Simply set up your training aid at the park, field, or even your backyard for hours of fun. The sturdy rebound net training improves throwing and fielding as the adjustable pitchback angles allow for pop flies, line drives, and grounders.
profile.reviewText:
I usually have good experiences with SKLZ products and thse Impact Heavy Duty Platic Baseballs are another quality product from SKLZ.  My son is in little league and before games they get pitched buckets of plastic balls to work on their swing and contact.  These SKLZ remind me of those plastic balls but better.  The sound of contact is very nice with these SKLZ due to the squashing action.  The ball gets pitched fairly straight (not like a wiffle ball) and upon contact these SKLZ don't fly that far (which is what you want for these types of balls).  Short flight helps with rounding up the balls as does the yellow color so you can see it hiding in the grass.  And of course they're fairly painless if the batting practice pitcher happens to get tagged.

Many swings with a little league metal bat and none of these SKLZ have broken so far (I've seen real wiffle balls break real fast this way).  At the current price of $20 for a pack of 12 I think this is a great value for a quality product - 5 STAR rating by me.
profile.summary: Great Value for a Quality Product

profile.description: Japan Import.
profile.reviewText:
I've been using these AmazonBasics "Premium In-Ear Headphones" for about one month now and this is my favorite pair of AmazonBasics (AB's) to date.  I tried the AB earbuds model with magnetic clips and while lots of cool features they just didn't fit into my ear that well.  I tried the AB On-Ear headphones model and while sound was dynamite they were pinching my dome which was a tad bit uncomfortable.  Enter these AB "Premiums" and this is Goldilocks for me - just right.  The fit is very comfortable, the sound is good for the price, and the build quality is great for the price.

What I like:
 +Great value.  You get alot for your $15 (current price).  High quality build - rugged ear buds, thick flat cord cable that is tangle resistant, fancy velvet carrying case, multiple sets of rubber ear covers.
 +Very comfortable.  Earbuds are a personal preference.  These are the type of earbuds I like.  They go a decent depth into your ear which means they don't fall out that easily and they also block outside noise for better sound.  I have average size adult male ears (I think?) - extra rubber ear tips can help you find the best fit if you have the ears closer to Dumbo or Beetlejuice.
 +Good sound for the price.  I compared these to a couple of other pairs of similar earbuds I have in same price range that are popular sellers on Amazon.  I listened to the same music track with all 3 pairs.  In my layperson opinion the AmazonBasics sounded best to me - the overall music sounded richer to me vs similarly priced competitors.  Yes they are a bit bassy (more than the other two pairs I compared them to) - but overall they had the richest sound to me and the music I played sounded best on the AB's.

What Could Be Better:
 -Slightly less Bassy.  This is the only knock I can think of.  A little less Bassy but already better than similarly priced competition.

In summary - my first 5 STAR rating for a pair of AmazonBasics headphones in consideration of price/value.  For the price - great quality, great comfort, great sound = great value.
profile.summary: 5-Stars for the price

profile.description: Style meets function in Safco's new Vamp LED lighting. These ingenious and practical lights feature a multi-pivot flexible neck creating just the right light for every work project. Going one step further, these clever lights have a USB port in the back of the base, giving you the option to recharge digital devices. With a 7-step touch dimming function that includes 4 warm and 4cool light settings, you control how to shed the light in your space with the tap of a finger. It's smarts and looks all rolled into one eye-pleasing light. Color Temperature 3000-6500K, total lumens 550, input voltage 100-240V ~ 50/60Hz 5A. UL listed power adapter included. 9W maximum power consumption. Aluminum and ABS plastic construction.
profile.reviewText:
I really like this Safco 1001 Vamp desk light.  It looks good, it's well made, it doesn't take up too much space on my desk, it's incredibly adjustable.

Adjustable lamp body hinged at the base and at the top elbow - basically you can adjust the angle to any position you can think of on your desk (or nightstand) - in the stationary position I just collapse the 2 stems together sticking up like an antenna so it's not in my way and the light even turns on while in this position.  Adjustable lighting - 8 different settings on the white color spectrum (warm through cool) - no debating about warm or cool - just touch the button at the base to find the right lighting for you.  USB charging port is very cool - I just stick my smartphone on the base and plug it in.

I had a few questions about this lamp where I couldn't find the answer in the documentation so I was geeky enough to email Safco customer service:
 1) Q:  Replacement bulb - are the LED bulbs replaceable and what size?
  A:  The LED lights do not need to be changed or replaced. Average lifespan is 50,000 hours that equals 5.7 years of continuous 24 hour usage.

 2) Q: The USB port - what is the amps output? ie, is 1 Amp charging or higher output 2.1 amp charging (preferred for tablets)
  A:  They didn't know the answer.  My guess is it's basic 1 amp output.

 3) Q: My light always turns on at brightest setting. Is there a way to default to dimmest setting when turned on?
  A: They didn't know the answer.  My guess is there is no way to change the default to turn on starting with dimmest setting.  Not a big deal but the light turning on full blast can be a bit jarring.

Overall - Great lamp!  At current price of $64 I might buy another one - 5-STAR rating from me in consideration of price/value.
profile.summary: I really like this Safco 1001 Vamp desk light

profile.description: The Ergorapido lithium ion brushroll clean Xtra 2-in-1 cordless offers two vacuums in one stylish design for cleaning on and above your bare floors. The 14.4V lithium ion battery gives you high performance for optimal cleaning performance, a long run time and fast charge. Electrolux patented self-cleaning brushroll removes tangled hair from the brushroll with the touch of a button. Thoroughly clean the bare floors in your home with the motorized brushroll and cordless convenience. Clean above the floor with the detachable handheld vacuum. The crevice tool and dusting brush store conveniently in the handle so you can clean crevices, stairs and flat surfaces in one easy step. 180 degree easy steer maneuverability offers smooth turning and movement, helping you twist and turn around furniture with ease. The Ergorapido lithium ion brushroll clean Xtra stands on its own for those unexpected interruptions and the lightweight, bag less design makes it easy for you to get around-get up and down stairs and carry from room to room. Plus, led headlights help you see the dirt so you don't leave any behind.
profile.reviewText:
I've been using this Electrolux Ergorapido for about a month and I have to say that I like it more than I thought I would.  Initially, the detachable handheld vac aspect seemed gimmicky to me but thus far that aspect has worked well and come in handy.

First off in looking over this Amazon listing page - the red model (14.4V) battery currently $130 and the blue model (10.8V) battery currently $90 really need to be moved to separate pages.  One of the reviews mentions poor battery life in the headline - this says it was for the "blue" colored Ergorapido which has a smaller battery - but its difficult to discern this without studying up.  In looking at the comparison chart of model#'s in the list it appears the difference between the blue and red are the bigger battery on the red (pretty important) and LED headlight on the red (I always like this feature so I can see my dirt in the nooks & crannies.

What I like about this vac:
 +Easy to assemble out of the box - one screen to connect 2 pieces, then plug in to charge the batter.  The instructions are kind of a messy jumble of loose papers - they could do with some simplification into a nice little booklet.
 +Amazingly light and maneuverable.  This thing swivels easily/ quickly and very quick to move around hardwood floors to pick up debris.  2 speeds.
 +More powerful than I thought.  This thing passed my "hairband test" where after I was done vacuuming it had enough power to suck all my daughter's random hairbands laying around up into the bag.
 +The handheld vac is useful.  Pop it out - vacuum under your couch, vacuum your car, etc.  The handheld functions as the motor and the debris bag for the stick.  Integrated design is nice - works well plugged into the broomstick, works well as a handheld.  Easy to pop in and out.
 +Debris bag easy to figure out and empty.  Not always the case for me with some vacuums but with this vac just pop out the debris container from the handheld, pop off the debris lid - shake over trash.
 +Overall good simple design, intuitive usage, appears to be durable (I will comeback and update this review later should that not be the case).

What could be better:
 -Battery lasts about 25 minutes for me so could be a bit longer.  But pretty good battery life considering how lightweight this vac is.

Overall very handy little vac - basically replaces a broom for me - lightweight like a broom but automagical and more versatile with the popout handheld vac (can't sweep the inside of your car with a broom).  Slightly pricey for this class of lightweight vacuums at current price of $130 for the red color - but a solid offering none-the-less - overall 4-STAR rating from me in consideration of price/value.
profile.summary: I like it more than I thought I would...

profile.description: The improved next generation of PUR faucet water filter is at your service with the PUR Advanced Faucet Water Filter - Chrome FM-3700B. With 1-click installation, superior contaminant removal, and a Two-year warranty, there's never been an easier or more reliable way to get PUR water. Each PUR faucet water filter gives you up to 100 gallons (2  3 months) of clean, healthy, great-tasting water.
profile.reviewText:
Have used this Pur faucet mounted filter for a few weeks.  I've got hard water in my area so drinking water in my family is either via bottled water or filters.  We typically go bottled water first then filtered water if we are out of bottled water...probably because the harder the water, the shorter the filter life seems to be.

I found this Pur has worked for me to provide good drinking water.  To be honest though, I am not a fan of faucet mounted because it is just too bulky and gets in the way of sink activities and water flow is a bit on the weak side.  My preference is filtered pitchers or actual filter system in the basement.  But, in a pinch this works for me.  Has been durable so far but can't say how it will hold up over time...if anything notable happens I will update this post.
profile.summary: Does the job, but are there better options

profile.description: This portable basketball system from Lifetime Products features a 52" Steel-Framed Shatter Proof backboard with an Action Grip height adjustment mechanism that adjusts from 7.5 to 10 feet high in 6-inch increments. It also includes a Slam-It Rim with an all-weather nylon net and a 3.5" diameter round steel pole. With a 35-gallon portable base, this system can easily be moved to a desired location. So bring the arena to your home with a residential basketball system from Lifetime Products.
profile.reviewText:
I got this Lifetime 90176 high end model to replace my trusty old Lifetime 1221 model...

My old 1221 model:  I gotta say that I've had a very good experience with the 1221 model which I bought on Amazon 5+ years ago (Aug'2011) for $99.  At the time my kids were 9 and 5....now my son is 14 and my daughter is 10 and they both love playing basketball even more now.  I remember  the old 1221 model was delivered in a giant box and my son and I spent hours building it...it has been on our driveway 24/7 year-round for 5+ years and is still amazing in good shape...the only breakage thus far is one rim metal ring that holds the net broke off...everything else is still in good shape.  But the 1221 has a smaller 44" backboard and most importantly not easy for kids to raise/lower the height so they can do some dunking...so I decided it's 90176 TIME!!...

My new 90176 model:  we love it.  First off had a bit of nostalgia when and even more GIANT box was delivered.  Then had some deja vu when building the thing with my son...took us 3+ hours but muddled through it just like we did with the last one (but I guess we built the last one fine because it's held up so long).  Still, kinda of a good father/son Saturday project where we can curse together @#! and bond.  The big improvements vs trusty old 1221 model are:
  +++The easy raise/lower feature of the rim height...kids can do it and the dunkability is something that doubles the driveway hoops fun for kids (and dads).
  +++The bigger and nicer quality backboard.  More like shooting in an indoor gym...my kids outgrew the smaller backboard.
  +++Overall quality - all the pieces are a notch up from my old 1221...a bit thicker/ sturdier/ more ruggedized.

Overall, hopefully this Lifetime 90176 will serve my family as well as the trusty old 1221...then  again current price is 3x of the old one so I would expect as much.  At current 90176 price of +$300 it ain't cheap (though I noticed prices vary higher/lower when doing google search so shop around)...but the 90176 is still a solid 4-STAR value for what you get (easy raise/lower, nice backboard, good experience with Lifetime brand).  So DUNK away my friend!!
profile.summary: DUNK away my friend!!...

profile.description: Smith Performance Sprayers are built to work as hard as you do. They are durable, professional products with an emphasis on chemical resistance and built to withstand the most demanding work conditions. The 190447 2-Gallon Industrial and Contractor Series Bleach Compression Sprayer is ideal for large jobs involving remediation, cleaning, degreasing or mold removal. Sprayer features a lockable shut-off to reduce hand fatigue, a nickel-plated brass poppet for strength and precision, and an easy-to-clean, in-line filtration system. The Viton seals offer the best chemical resistance to bleach and other harsh chemicals and are easily changed without using tools. The pressure release valve not only prevents over compression, but also helps prevent chemicals dispersing from tank onto the user prior to opening. Multiple nozzles included with the 190447 bleach sprayer for ultimate versatility: high foaming nozzle (enables visible confirmation of covered area and deeper grime penetration), wide flat fan nozzle (red, 0.25 GPM, angled at 70 Degree), narrow flat fan nozzle (yellow, 0.15 GPM, angled at 30 Degree), and adjustable poly nozzle (enables stream to cone patterns). Also accepts Tee Jet nozzles.
profile.reviewText:
Wow, so now I know what it's like to have a decent sprayer like this Smith 190447.  If you're the average homeowner like me you probably have a couple of the cheapie sprayers in your garage somewhere - most likely not working anymore.  I've got a couple of $15 specials (1 gallon) - they both worked great for a few months and I was busy spraying up a storm - plant fertilizer, bug poison, weed killer, etc, etc etc (basically whatever I could spray because its also kinda fun in a weird way).  Well after a few months my cheapie's would always break on me  - they would lose pressure so I couldn't really get a good spray pressure anymore and the wands would become so gunked up and I couldn't seem to get them clean.  So they remained in my garage to be repaired someday later (yeah right) or at least as some Frankenstein parts for my future new cheapie sprayer.

This Smith 190447 is not like my cheapie's...I guess those were "Yugo's" and this Smith is a Ford F150.  Everything on this Smith is triple quality - triple the plastic ruggedness, some metal parts for critical areas, easily changeable nozzles, extra bells and whistles that really are worth it like the built-in filter (which I am banking on to solve my clogging problems).  This thing holds more (2 gallons), pumps easier, sprays better - has held up well thus far.

In conclusion, I guess sometimes you do get what you pay for...sometimes you can go cheap and get a good value but when it comes to sprayers my conclusion is it's better to spend the extra money, get some better quality, and avoid yourself hassle/frustration (unless you're buying the cheapie for the in-laws or your annoying neighbor in which case that is perfectly fine).  At current price of $63 this Smith 190447 is well worth it to me - 5-STAR rating by me in consideration of price/value.

top_5.reviewText:
I've got these Panasonic wireless earbuds in red.  I've got quite a few Panasonic earbuds & headphones - in my experience they are a very reputable brand in this space.  For these newest wireless earbuds I sum up my feelings by saying "good but not great".

What I like:
 ++Lightweight = Comfy.  Both a plus and a minus (covered later).  On the plus side these are one of my lightest weight wireless bluetooth headphones...hence they are very comfortable to wear because it doesn't feel like I have any fishing weights dangling from my ears.
 ++Battery life pretty decent for being tiny/lightweight.  I'm getting about 4 hours battery life which I can live with consider the light weight that I like.
 ++Bluetooth was easy for me to synch.  Intuitive to connect and worked on the first try (yes this should be expected but I've had some difficult experiences before...particularly on some generic brands).

What could be better:
 --Lightweight = A Bit Flimsy.  The wires are skinny...not sure how long they will hold up.  Being lightweight and not ruggedized they don't work well for me when working out...they tend to bounce around during physical activity.  I've got some other wireless hybrid earbuds that grip my ears better and more effective for working out.  What I like to use these Panasonics for is at my workdesk...the lightweightness makes then very comfy to wear and since the most exercise I ever get at work is spinning my chair 180 degrees I don't have to worry about the headphones getting jostled.
 --Sound quality not that great IMO.  Certainly suitable to listen to music but sound is a bit "tinny"...maybe also a byproduct of lightweightness.  I've got some other earbuds (Panasonic wired included) that sound much better (but most cost more too).

So in summary at current price I think these are "good not great".  The best feature is the lightweight wireless aspect.  Sound quality ok, durability concerns.  3-STAR rating from me in consideration of price/value.
