input: Generate the review text written by a reviewer who has a given an overall rating of "4.0" for a product with description "Being immortal isn't all it's cracked up to be. Life's hard for a Greek god in the 21st century: nobody believes in you any more, even your own family doesn't respect you, and you're stuck in a delapidated hovel in north London with too many siblings and not enough hot water. But for Artemis (goddess of hunting, professional dog walker), Aphrodite (goddess of beauty, telephone sex operator) and Apollo (god of the sun, TV psychic) there's no way out...Until a meek cleaner and her would-be boyfriend come into their lives, and turn the world literally upside down. "Gods Behaving Badly" is that rare thing, a charming, funny, utterly original first novel that satisfies the head and the heart.". The summary of the review text is "'Gods Behaving Badly' is a roller coaster ride of wicked-fun! BCM".
output:
Gods Behaving Badly is a really interesting book. There is some colourful swearing and brief, sexual content, but these elements were essential to drive the story forward and help portray the characters temperaments more accurately. It was as if Apollo, Artemis, Aphrodite, Zeus and others...were living in a neighbourhood nearby; the author's skilful story-weaving talents should be commended! It is really nice to find an inventive plot and a creative new story. I was rapidly reeled-in to the story of these Gods from Mount Olympus and the interactions between the humans in this story. Theses God's are marvellously flawed. The interactions between the human characters and the unique facets of Alice and Neil personalities are mesmerizing. I was captivated by all of the little idiosyncrasies and the fallibility of these two, eccentric human characters. The plot moves forward with steady momentum and has some exciting twists and turns. At times you'll probably want to give Apollo a kick in the pants or tell Aphrodite to stop meddling, but one thing is for sure; this story WILL NOT bore you!

profile.description: A stunning novel set in the Tudor court, as the rivalry between Queen Mary and her half-sister Elizabeth is played out against a background of betrayal, conflict and passion. The savage rivalry of the daughters of Henry VIII, Mary Tudor and Elizabeth, mirrors that of their mothers, Katherine of Aragon and Anne Boleyn. Each will fight by any available means for the crown and future of the kingdom. Elizabeth's bitter struggle to claim the throne she believes is hers by right, and the man she desires almost more than her crown, is watched by her 'fool': a girl who has been forced to leave her homeland of Spain, as a Jew fleeing the Inquisition. In a court where truth is wittily denied and lies are mere games, it is the fool who can speak plainly: in these dangerous times, a woman must choose between ambition and love. Elizabeth will not make the same mistakes as her mother.
profile.reviewText:
The Queen's Fool is very compelling because of the main character, Hannah Green. When someone has gone through so much and lost loved ones in such a violent manner, it would scar you and should teach someone like Hannah, to `duck and cover'. This wonderfully-crafted character overcomes many fears and does what she has to do to survive, regardless of her own, internal struggles. Hannah's goodness and her big heart endears her first to the young King Edward and then to Queen Mary. As the story unfolds and Hannah finds herself in Queen Mary's service, thanks to the cunning Robert Dudley, she does the best that she can with her limited courtly talents and skills. Her integrity helps her to navigate her way through the perfidious court life and the dangerous schemes which she becomes embroiled in.
The story is skilfully written to give us time with Hannah Green while still supplying us with a very generous helping of the royals; including Robert Dudley, Elizabeth and Queen Mary. There are some interesting plot twists and the characters are vividly drawn to sweep us back to the times when your choice of faith and your loyalties could mean your unimaginable success or your plunging ruin and a traitor's death.
I highly recommend this book!

(8 out of 10 Diamonds) - Thoroughly enjoyed it

 2008-2009 Bobbie Crawford-McCoy (Book Reviews By Bobbie).
All rights reserved.
profile.summary: As Elizabeth plots for the throne and Queen Mary holds fast to her faith; can Hannah find a life and love of her own? BCM

profile.description: Lucian Beaumont, Viscount Rutland, had to be the most stubborn man in England. Even though Daisy Drake has both the funds and the expertise he needs to find a long-lost Roman treasure, the infuriating manrefuses to accept her help. But when Daisy attends a masquerade disguised as notorious courtesan Blanche La Tour, she discovers Blanche is the one woman Lucian cant resist. So Blanche offers Lucian the money he needs if he will accept her partner as part of his excavation team. What Lucian doesnt know but we do is who this new partner is.A refreshingly unconventional hero and heroine, an intriguingly different historical setting, and a surfeit of sizzling sexual chemistry all fall neatly into place in Bryans latest splendidly sexy romance. --John Charles
profile.reviewText:
Vexing the Viscount is a marvellous book, full sexual tension and wonderful characters whose stories pull you into their world for a few lovely hours. The pacing is smooth and steady, with vibrant visuals and intensely amusing banter. This story is very well written with an unerring focus on supplying the reader with a captivating story that includes lots of romance. The plot includes some fun twists and turns, that are sure to surprise. Lucian and Daisy are an enchanting mix. When they get tangled up together, sparks fly and sexual tension abounds! These characters have a sizzling chemistry which is sure to satisfy the romantic in all of us. Emily Bryan writes with talent and skill; she pours her heart into each and every page. I really enjoyed this book and I'm positive that you will enjoy it too.
I highly recommend this book!

(9 out of 10 Diamonds) - Loved it!

 2008-2009 Bobbie Crawford-McCoy (Book Reviews By Bobbie).
All rights reserved.
profile.summary: 'Vexing the Viscount' is witty and entertaining: a sizzling Historical Romance that you won't want to miss! BCM

profile.description: The Book of Eli is Sam Moffie's fourth novel.
profile.reviewText:
Practically perfect in every way; this describes our protagonist to a tee. An obsession with sexual satisfaction leads to a world of trouble for Eli Canaan when he cannot find the necessary sexual fulfilment within his marriage bed. While he understands that cheating on his wife could lead to a nasty divorce, the unsuspecting Eli lives his life in relative ease until his wife consults a local gypsy woman and asks for her help. From that moment on, his life would never be the same...

The Book of Eli will grab the reader's attention right away! Though Eli is a wonderful man who would do anything for anybody, his insatiable hunger for sexual satisfaction would be his undoing. While Eli is in "the midst of" with somebody else's wife, Abigail Canaan is trying to find a way to put an end to her husband's philandering ways. Using the services of a renowned gypsy woman, Abigail puts a hex on Eli as he is enjoying a mind-blowing climax with another woman. Suddenly, Eli realizes that he is not where he was moments ago. Shocked and more than a little disoriented, Eli hears the booming voice God.

While this story is a conversion message of sorts, it is anything but the typical spiel. Sam Moffie uses humour and a distinct writing style to illuminate and examine some philosophical, thought-provoking questions that many of us we have been asking for eons. The majority of the story takes place in heaven, where Eli spends his time conversing with God, Jesus and a number of famous characters who do their part to help him figure out the meaning of his life. The Book of Eli invites readers into a world with a mysterious, introspective feel and an enlightening premise. One of the most entertaining and enjoyable conversion stories ever told! A fair amount of swearing, vulgarities and unique dialogue between some of the celestial characters in the story might shock or offend some readers.

Copyright  Pinnacle: Author & Book Promotion --- Bobbie Crawford-McCoy

Her integrity helps her to navigate her way through the perfidious court life and the dangerous schemes which she becomes embroiled in.
The story is skilfully written to give us time with Hannah Green while still supplying us with a very generous helping of the royals; including Robert Dudley, Elizabeth and Queen Mary. There are some interesting plot twists and the characters are vividly drawn to sweep us back to the times when your choice of faith and your loyalties could mean your unimaginable success or your plunging ruin and a traitor's death.
I highly recommend this book!

top_5.description: Lucian Beaumont, Viscount Rutland, had to be the most stubborn man in England. Even though Daisy Drake has both the funds and the expertise he needs to find a long-lost Roman treasure, the infuriating manrefuses to accept her help. But when Daisy attends a masquerade disguised as notorious courtesan Blanche La Tour, she discovers Blanche is the one woman Lucian cant resist. top_5.reviewText:
Vexing the Viscount is a marvellous book, full sexual tension and wonderful characters whose stories pull you into their world for a few lovely hours. The pacing is smooth and steady, with vibrant visuals and intensely amusing banter. This story is very well written with an unerring focus on supplying the reader with a captivating story that includes lots of romance. The plot includes some fun twists and turns, that are sure to surprise. Lucian and Daisy are an enchanting mix. When they get tangled up together, sparks fly and sexual tension abounds! These characters have a sizzling chemistry which is sure to satisfy the romantic in all of us. Emily Bryan writes with talent and skill; she pours her heart into each and every page. I really enjoyed this book and I'm positive that you will enjoy it too.
I highly recommend this book!

(9 out of 10 Diamonds) - Loved it!

 2008-2009 Bobbie Crawford-McCoy (Book Reviews By Bobbie).

top_5.description: The Book of Eli is Sam Moffie's fourth novel.
top_5.reviewText:
Practically perfect in every way; this describes our protagonist to a tee. An obsession with sexual satisfaction leads to a world of trouble for Eli Canaan when he cannot find the necessary sexual fulfilment within his marriage bed. While he understands that cheating on his wife could lead to a nasty divorce, the unsuspecting Eli lives his life in relative ease until his wife consults a local gypsy woman and asks for her help. From that moment on, his life would never be the same...

The Book of Eli will grab the reader's attention right away! Though Eli is a wonderful man who would do anything for anybody, his insatiable hunger for sexual satisfaction would be his undoing. While Eli is in "the midst of" with somebody else's wife, Abigail Canaan is trying to find a way to put an end to her husband's philandering ways. Using the services of a renowned gypsy woman, Abigail puts a hex on Eli as he is enjoying a mind-blowing climax with another woman. Suddenly, Eli realizes that he is not where he was moments ago. Shocked and more than a little disoriented, Eli hears the booming voice God.

While this story is a conversion message of sorts, it is anything but the typical spiel. Sam Moffie uses humour and a distinct writing style to illuminate and examine some philosophical, thought-provoking questions that many of us we have been asking for eons. The majority of the story takes place in heaven, where Eli spends his time conversing with God, Jesus and a number of famous characters who do their part to help him figure out the meaning of his life. The Book of Eli invites readers into a world with a mysterious, introspective feel and an enlightening premise. One of the most entertaining and enjoyable conversion stories ever told! A fair amount of swearing, vulgarities and unique dialogue between some of the celestial characters in the story might shock or offend some readers.

Copyright  Pinnacle: Author & Book Promotion --- Bobbie Crawford-McCoy
top_5.summary: "One man's soul-searching journey; a provocative story that entertains with insight and wit."

input: Generate the review text written by a reviewer who has a given an overall rating of "5.0" for a product with description "This officially licensed backpack features the Mandalorians Icon and is perfect for a Star Wars fan.". The summary of the review text is "Great backpack for boys AND GIRLS".
output:
I started the school year off by purchasing the Bioworld Captian America backpack for my 8 year old son and the Loungefly Rainbow Dash backpack for my 11 year old daughter.  It quickly became clear that Rainbow Dash didn't have the capacity for the amount of stuff middle school kids have to haul to school and back, and I set off to find a replacement backpack.
The Captain America backpack was the perfect size and style for what my daughter needed, but her brother already had that backpack and refused to give it up.  So back to Amazon I go.
I searched for similar Bioworld backpacks - because the actual backpack was perfect.  Sadly there are not nearly enough choices available.  We looked through the Zelda backpacks, but the pictures and descriptions weren't consistent, and the reviews were not great, and I wanted to be sure I was getting exactly what was pictured.
We came across the Boba Fett backpack and the picture was perfect.  I click on the link and my daughter's face sinks a bit and she says "But the description says it's for boys".  I ensured her over and over that it was OK for a girl to carry that backpack (she's an Aspie and very literal, but I'm sure other girls have felt put off by the description).  I promised her that no one would know what the Amazon description said, and swore up and down it would be OK.  Before spending the money on another backpack I wanted to be sure she would use it, and no matter how sure I am, I never risk the Fett man.  After careful consideration, she gave into the power of the Force (and all the preemptive Disney Marketing) and decided this would be her next backpack.
The backpack showed up yesterday and she may have squealed like an 11 year old fangirl when she saw it.  Rainbow Dash was quickly pushed aside and books and papers went flying in all directions as she moved her supplies over to her new backpack.  I was a little worried about the size, as Captain America was bigger, but it fit her binder, her notebooks, her 11" HP stream, her pencil case and her reading books.  As an added bonus, she can hook her flute through the skateboard straps and free up her hands to fight off all the nerd boys who will be drooling over her and her amazing backpack.
The actual backpack seemed very sturdy.  I tested the zippers and they all worked well.  The laptop pouch was padded and perfect for her little laptop.  There were lots of pockets and places to store things like middle school ID cards and water bottles.  Other than the lame description that shows up for the Stormtrooper backpack - I'm very happy with it so far.

profile.description: This officially licensed Star Wars shirt features the franchise's #1 Dad, Darth Vader. The perfect gift for the #1 sith lord in your life.
profile.reviewText:
My generation was raised on Star Wars.  We saw the movies in the theaters with our parents.  We then raised our kids on it.  As far as we are concerned, the series started with Episode 4 and we begrudgingly accept the latest installment, but want nothing to do with anything that had Jar Jar in it.  Based on that criteria - I purchased this shirt the favorite dad in my life.
As you can imagine, this shirt brings a smile to the face of all who see it.  It's best worn when escorting children about town, it usually brings a smile to the faces of people passing by, and may even convince strangers to forgive the transgressions of your children - especially if your children are like mine and able to level a small town in 5 minutes flat.  It also allows for conversations with other Jedi knights who will strike up conversations over it as you enjoy conversations about Darth Vadar the way he was meant to be - not as a whiny little kid but as a solid villain with a soft side.
The fit was perfect and it has held up through several washings without any fading or shrinkage.  Sizing was accurate and the workmanship is acceptable.  The recipient was thrilled with it, and wears it often.  Overall, I give this a solid 5 stars.  Great gift for the #1 dad in your life.
profile.summary: I find your lack of shirts disturbing

profile.description: OFFICIALLY LICENSED PRODUCT BASED ON THE FAMOUS TV SERIES, Not a cheap reproduction. Doctor Who Fourth Doctor Tom Baker Action Figure: Continue your adventures through time and space with the Fourth Doctor! Detailed likeness of actor Tom Baker from Doctor Who. Action figure includes accessories, multiple points of articulation, and interchangeable heads!Continue your adventures through time and space with the Fourth Doctor! The Fourth Doctor from the long-running Doctor Who appeared in the British TV series from 1974 to 1981, and is perhaps most recognizable by his penchant for colorful accessories. Showcasing a nicely detailed likeness of actor Tom Baker, this highly entertaining action figure features multiple points of articulation, his signature multi-colored scarf, and two interchangeable heads! He stands about 5 1/2-inches tall. Age:  5+ Size:  5 1/2-inches tall
profile.reviewText:
Tom Baker - the longest lived incarnation of the Doctor - and for so many of my generation - he was their first doctor. I wasn't lucky enough to grow up with BBC, and I developed my Doctor Who addiction later in life. Regardless - as a true Whovian - I respect the the classics and the fourth doctor and his iconic scarf are one of the best known images of The Doctor.
When he arrived, I carefully studied the box - while debating - do I open it?  Do I keep him pristine in the box?  I went back and forth and decided that a figure this beautiful needed to be played with.
The first thing I noticed was the exceptional packaging. Every piece was perfectly placed and tied down, so there is no shifting during shipping. His tiny sonic screwdriver was held securely in place by a piece of tape and the body parts were carefully tied down to the package.
I carefully cut into the clamshell package and removed The Doctor from his plastic prison.  I took a few minutes to study the face and body - to admire the perfect details of the eyes and nose.  The scarf is plastic - not fabric - but it does move a bit. The arm and leg joints are articulated and can bend and move. The one thing I found is that the scarf is a bit stiff - which can affect posing - but it didn't affect it too much as you can see.
It was time for The Doctor to meet up with a Dalek and he was able to quickly take him down with the sonic screwdriver - which fit securely in his hand. He then decided to sit down and take a break and try to get his head on straight. We did try out the extra head but preferred the head with the signature hat.
This 4th Doctor is absolute perfection. The craftsmanship and detail are incredible. Part of me is regretting unboxing such an amazing collectible - but part of me can't wait to take him on more adventures. My kids are already planning a photo shoot for him in the Lego Tardis this weekend.  I'm sure he won't mind.
This product was purchased at a discount in exchange for an honest review and my honest opinion is that I would gladly purchase this product at full price.
profile.summary: A must have for your Doctor Who collection

profile.description: Star Wars Darth Vader Oven Glove Set - Silicone Heat Resistant up to 445 Degrees F - This glove is great for any fan of Star Wars, especially those who love to grill or cook indoors! Great anti-slip grip and embossed with the Empire insignia. *Please Note: Caution* Hot Pans should not be held for an extended period of time with these gloves, especially Cast Iron Pans with no protection on the handle. Cast Iron Pans can exceed temperatures beyond the silicone capacity. For Proper use, please ensure the glove is fit tightly on your hand before gripping anything hot, be aware of your surroundings and do not hold hot items for an extended period of time. Please contact the seller for any other questions regarding use.
profile.reviewText:
Cooking isn't just for women.  There are men who are at home in the kitchen too.
I had to replace the worn out kitchen mitts and had the chance to purchase these at a discount in exchange for an honest review.  Of course I had to say yes.  Because Vader gloves.  What a great chance to get gloves that work for the men and women in the house who cook.  (OK Im stereotyping a bit but not everyone was a fan of the pretty frilly flowered oven mitts that I own)
The first thing I noticed when I took them out of the bag is that they look awesome.  Absolutely awesome.  But that is what was expected.
I tried the gloves on and they were a bit snug on my hands - but not unusable.  My 20 year old son was able to wear them comfortably and he's a 6'5" beast of a child.  But I had another friend try them on and he couldn't fit his hands in all the way.  Im going to say they run small.
The test was to see if they worked.  And thats one of those tests that make you cringe a bit - because what if they dont?  Well - I tested them out in the oven - poking at the hot pan a few times with my finger to verify that my finger didn't get burned before I went in with both hands and pulled the pan out.  The gloves did their job and protected my hands from the heat.
I test all items that I review, whether provided at a discount or if I pay full price and I try to give the kind of feedback that I personally look for when I purchase items. These fit me - but seem to run small.  So where do these fall in the ranking?  Im wavering between 4 and 5 stars.  They do the job of protecting your hands from the heat and they look great - and they work great for me.  BUT - if you have big hands - these will not work for you.
profile.summary: Run SMALL - but super cute and do the job.

Park the landspeeder and enter, staying clear of the giant dewback drinking from the trough outside. Make sure Luke, Han and Obi-Wan have their weapons with them as they enter through the sliding door and walk past the droid scanner. Open out the building for easier play and order a drink while the Bith cantina band gets ready to play their instruments. Recreate scenes in the cantina from Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope, such as the showdown between Han Solo and Rodian bounty hunter Greedo. Includes 8 minifigures with assorted weapons and accessories: Han Solo, Luke Skywalker, Obi-Wan Kenobi, Greedo, a Sandtrooper and 3 Bith Musicians. Features Mos Eisley Cantina, a landspeeder, evaporator and a dewback with feeding area. Mos Eisley Cantina features a dome roof, entrance with sliding door and droid scanner, opening roof, slide-out floors to the middle rooms, bar with shelves, money and bottles, stage for the Bith band, seats, table and windows. Landspeeder features a dual cockpit, windscreen, 3 massive engines and a trunk. Dewback features an opening mouth, saddle with weapon holster plus brick pieces for when the saddle is removed.
profile.reviewText:
The Lego box was already a wretched hive of scum and villainy.  Lets face it - those little blocks on the floor at 3 am can do more damage than a fully armed and operational battle station.  The house is already teeming with superheroes and Lego characters - but really - who could say no to this amazing set.

I put it together with my 8 year old - who likes to consider himself to be an expert level builder.  Since I had to redo a few parts of the cantina - I would rate him more like an advanced builder - but not quite expert.  The colors in the instructions were a little difficult to tell apart - but overall it was totally doable.

The highlight of this set is the cantina band.  There's just no getting around it - the band is incredible.  I can almost hear the sound of the horns as we reenact the Cantina scene the way it was meant to be - with Hans firing first.  Out of all of the sets we own - this is probably our favorite.  My son will take it down and play with it when he watches the movie - just because it's that cool.

I may be slightly addicted to these containers.  I love to cook in batches and I also love to feed my friends.  At the same time, I don't want to risk any friendships by demanding my good Tupperware back. That's when I found these containers.  The price is low enough that I can afford to feed my friends and get the leftovers out of my house.  I love that these are sturdy and they don't leak. You can use these over and over.  They hold up to the microwave and the freezer.  They stack neatly in the fridge and freezer so you can find what you are looking for.  One thing Ive found when freezing - if you cover the food in the container with a piece of saran wrap (touching the top of the food) before freezing - you can prevent freezer burn. The empty containers also stack neatly for storage.
I can't say enough good things about these containers.  They are priced right, store well, keep your leftovers fresh and can be used over and over.  As an added bonus, the lids are interchangeable between the different sizes.
profile.summary: Great storage solution and priced right for sharing

We were selected to review this toy for BzzAgent and I'm so glad we did.  We've always stuck to other block sets because it's what we've always known.

The quality of the set was on par with other sets.  The figures are cute and creative.  My son carriers them everywhere. It's got a shark.  How much better can it get?

profile.reviewText:
I was throwing a party for a grown man who loves Batman.  That may be strange to you but that is just the way things go in my life I guess.  There was a Batman Pinata that we forgot to use, lots of margaritas and sausage.  Lots and lots of sausage.  It was quite the party.
So - I had already gone a bit overboard and wanted to get cute Batman settings - because Batman!  And here I am on Amazon.
Now this kit was for 16.  You can't beat that. 16 plates, 16 cups and 16 napkins.  All with Batman on it.  Since there were about 10 people who showed up - this worked out well.  If you are planning on a bigger group - get two sets.
The plates are the perfect size for cake.  The cups are not margarita sized - they are more fruit punch sized - but that's fine, we had other cups for the margaritas.  And we had big plates for the sausages..  And the napkins -well they are your typical kid sized party napkins.  This is your typical run of the mill disposable party table setting.
Overall I was very happy with this purchase.  It provided excellent value for the money and was able to give us the perfect finishing touches for a Batman party.  For an adult.  And if they worked this well for an adult party - Im sure your 5 year old will be thrilled.
profile.summary: Great party setting.  Guests loved it

profile.description: Ryan and ODonnnell are passionate about making high quality shoes that are fit for purpose. Irish dancing has evolved and the footwear must adapt with it and provide the protection and support required for such vigorous athletic moves. As Irish dance has become a sport dancers deserve the same protection as any other athlete. We have looked at running shoes and taken key elements and technology from them and designed our dance shoes to reflect these advancements. Our Evolution hard shoes are handcrafted in the UK using the finest of leathers offering supreme comfort and a glove like fit whilst giving support and durability. Our shoes feature out the box flexibility with black suede sole unit. Everything about our shoes is designed for a reason. From Noene shock dispersion sole unit to help prevent and cure injurys such as shin splints and tendentious to removing as many of the seams from inside the shoe which helps eliminate friction that causes blisters, including a padded heel cushioning top line which sits higher on the heel to ensures the correct support is given around the ankle, keeping the foot in the shoe. We also make our uppers with 5 eyelets similar to a running shoe giving further support round the ankle. Our heels and tips are semi hollow and therefore the lightest in the market. There are small chambers inside the heel which allows for the sound to be amplified which is what gives our heel and tips a sharper sound. The tips and heels on the Evolution shoes give dancers better posture as they are symmetrical, and made from advanced mould technology and not individually hand grinded down.
profile.reviewText:
I purchased my first pair of Ryan & O'Donnell hardshoes a few years ago at their booth at Worlds in Boston.  I'm an adult dancer and mother of a champ, and I was drawn in by the passion of the company - to build a better shoe.  Three years later, I have danced the shoes to pieces and had to replace them.  I contacted the company and they told me that I can get them through Amazon in the US.  Amazon.  BRILLIANT!
It took me a little bit to figure out the sizing.  I wear an 8 1/2 woman's medium width in US sizes, but I couldn't figure out the E's and F's and (M)'s for sizing and the "Youth" threw me off.  I purchased the same size I had before - which is a 6 M.  E is the wide width.  Just in case you are wondering.
As for the shoes - as a forty-something who has been puttering along in Irish Dance for 17 years, I consider myself very very lucky.  I've only had a sprained ankle, broken foot, shin splints and plantar fasciitis.  What I appreciate is that their shoes are made with foot health in mind.  These shoes are comfortable, and dance well.  I was able to get 3 years out of my last pair - which was the older original style - and I'm looking forward to seeing how far these take me.  I also purchased their ghillies as soon as they were released, so you can say I'm a fan of the brand.
profile.summary: Hardshoes that come ready to dance

profile.description: Colors are bright and vivid. Mr. Sketch markers have twice the ink of most markers to last super-long. The smooth-flowing bevel-tip makes sketching easier. The tip is sturdy to keep its shape even after months of coloring. The specially formulated, non-bleeding water-based ink is great for easels. It's safe for children and certified AP non-toxic. Each color has its own fun scent to feed your imagination. See product description for all color scent combinations. Includes magenta, pink, red, orange, yellow, light green, dark green, turquoise, light blue, blue, light purple, purple, brown, and black. Mr. Sketch color scent combinations are: Red Cherry; Orange Orange; Peach Peach; Yellow Lemon; Light Yellow Banana Split; Mint Green Tropical Punch; Green Mint; Dark Green Apple; Turquoise Mango; Light Blue Blue Raspberry Slushy; Blue Blueberry; Purple Grape; Lavender Cotton Candy; Hot Pink Melon; Magenta Raspberry; Petal Pink Bubble Gum; Black Licorice; Brown Cinnamon.
profile.reviewText:
For some strange reason, my 11 year old daughter has to draw and color a lot of pictures each night in her homework.  The problem is that she has issues grasping a pencil and she hates the busy work.  I had to try to find a way to make the process more enjoyable and then I thought - "what if doing homework was a little more fun?"
I remember a discussion with a teacher friend who swears by these markers and I ordered a set of the bold tips and the fine tips.  This review is for the bold tips.
My daughter has developed a new love for coloring.  She loves to sniff the pens and sniff the paper.  The added gimmick of making it smell good has taken the coloring aspect of her homework from a chore something that is almost fun.
I was happy with the inks - they are vibrant and the tips are solid and strong.  I expect these will last us a long time.
profile.summary: A little trick to make learning fun

profile.description: When you think of gel pens are you thinking dull, boring and unimaginative uses? Gone are the days gel pens used to come in dark, black or blue ink for the sole purpose of being serious and snooze-inducing. LolliZ introduces a new generation of fancy, color popping gel pens boasting a cocktail of shimmery hues to titillate the artist in each one of us. An array of 96 piece colorful gel pens set, great to sketch, draw, color, doodle, write and outline any art project, scrap book or craft you are creating. The thin precise tip lets your hand glide over the paper to get you the best visual results of your creative outbursts! Check this out! LolliZ 96 piece Gel Pens Set comes in assorted colors and styles. Tidy up fast: they come in a safe and easy storage packaging featuring four neat trays to insert each gel pen in its own individual place. Whether you are a school-age budding artist or a full-fledge professional, take your craft to the next level with confidence and creative style using LolliZ 96 Gel Pen Set.
profile.reviewText:
I initially bought my daughter the single set of these pens for $15 after she had been trying to use my Sakura pens.  Mama doesn't share.  Well when her set arrived, I may like them as much or more than my Sakura pens and I had to get myself a set.  I actually bought two sets for $25 and my son's girlfriend was gifted a set.  But then my youngest son started going after my gel pens and here I am again.  The sets are currently sold 2 boxes for $20 and I'm feeling like Oprah - "You get gel pens - you get gel pens - everybody gets gel pens!".  This is now my go-to gift for all the kids.
Enough about me - the pens write well.  The colors are vibrant - other reviewers have posted color charts and I recommend looking at those.  There are a few in the set that take a little while to get the ink moving, but once it's moving, it's moving.  They aren't going to save the world or create the next Mona Lisa or change your life, but the value for this set is amazing.  If you are on the fence, I suggest you give it a try.
profile.summary: Excellent collection for an excellent price

profile.description: Fudenosuke Soft Tip Brush Pen features a flexible brush tip for different writing and drawing techniques. Create extra-fine, fine or medium strokes by a change in brush pressure. Great for calligraphy and art drawings. Barrels are made of recycled polypropylene plastic. Fine tip  water-based, pigmented black ink. Odorless. Non-refillable.
profile.reviewText:
I have horrible handwriting.  I hate writing anything down.  I have a friend who is a calligraphy freak and she swears by these pens, so I decided to try them out.
I LOVE this pen.  Suddenly my chicken scratch looks pretty.  I'm focusing on changing the pressure and making thin lines and thick lines.  The pen writes beautifully and makes writing fun again.  I'm downloading calligraphy guides so I can make my letters pretty.  I don't want to say this pen is life changing, but I wish I had this when I was younger.  It makes writing so much more fun.
I made the mistake of leaving the cap off for a little bit and it got dry, but I was able to get the ink flowing right away. I've been using this pen for the last few weeks and have been super happy with the results.  I wound up buying more, one for my 12 year old daughter, one to keep at work, one for my purse... My daughter has dysgraphia and her handwriting is even worse than mine.  The amazing thing is that a child that hates to write is suddenly doing everything with this pen.  Even her math homework.
I know I sound a little crazy, but this pen is the best pen I've ever used and I wish I would have found these sooner.
profile.summary: Fun to use and writes beautifully

profile.description: Embelished Boot
profile.reviewText:
I purchased these boots for my daughter to wear for her River Song cosplay.  If you don't know what that means - don't worry.  It just means she likes dressing up like her favorite Doctor Who character.  If you do know what it means - extra credit for you!
The first thing I noticed about these boots was the excellent workmanship.  I wasn't expecting that to be honest - because the Amazon price was great.  Beyond great actually.  Like I couldn't not buy it great.  The boots are beautiful and well made - and worth every penny I paid.
But the true test was not how they look, but how they wear.  My daughter is very sensitive and they had to be comfortable enough to wear for an entire day at Disneyland while dressed up like a BBC tv show character.  Because it's all about looking good at Gallidays right?
Here's where I was truly impressed.  My daughter was able to wear the boots for 8 hours of walking and standing around in a theme park and they didn't hurt at all.  This is a child that is usually complaining after a few hours that her feet hurt and she wants to go home - but these boots were able to give her the support she needed to last an entire day.  I was thrilled with that.  Beauty and support are the holy grail when it comes to shoes.
I give these boots five enthusiastic stars - they are beautiful and fit great.  And as a bonus - they carry this boot in bigger sizes - so these boots can fit mom too!
profile.summary: Beautiful boots and great fit

profile.description: The Republic of Gilead offers Offred only one function: to breed. If she deviates, she will, like dissenters, be hanged at the wall or sent out to die slowly of radiation sickness. But even a repressive state cannot obliterate desire - neither Offred's nor that of the two men on which her future hangs...
profile.reviewText:
I've been going back to my high school days and rereading the works that helped to mold my personality.  This and 1984 are the two that resonate the most right now.  I always considered it to be a cautionary piece of speculative fiction set in an alternate universe.
The book is just as engaging now as it was 30 years ago.  You are sucked into the lives of these characters.  As I am a bit older, I am able to appreciate the depth of the characters more than I did before.  I imagine my children being ripped away from me and reassigned to other parents.  I imagine an existence where women only exist to serve men.  I used to think "this could never happen" but against the backdrop of current events, I am living in a world where this is actually happening, which makes the writing so much more vivid.
As we are looking at a time where women who miscarry are required to pay for a funeral for the fetus, and where mens sperm counts have dropped in half over the last 40 years, we need to take a minute to think about whether or not this is a work of speculative fiction, or if we should be asking Margaret Atwood for lottery numbers.
profile.summary: Nolite te bastardes carborundorum

profile.description: Pencils with Toppers - 9 pencils with 4 brick toppers that can attach to your favorite mini figures! Also clips into the LEGO Pencil Box or Organizer to keep them in place.
profile.reviewText:
I purchased this item at a discount in exchange for an honest review.  Lets put that out there from the start.  I only purchase items that my family can use and I have 2 kids (well 4 if you count my grown kids) who are obsessed with Legos.
Ive seen the Lego stationery products at the store before and my kids wanted to try them out.  I jumped on the chance to review these because - well Lego pencils.
My 8 year old hates going to school.  He has a hard time and I hate that he hates to go.  So any incentive to get him out the door is good in my book.  I figured these pencils might make writing more fun.
The box comes with several pencils with a lego design on them. They also include two small topper type lego pieces that you can put over your pencil and attach a minifigure to the pencil.  My son loves this concept since he wants to talk to his lego friends during class.  I don't like him taking minifigs to school - but Im hoping having them attached to a pencil keeps him from losing them.  Its a cute concept and he really likes them.  Hes not complaining about writing as much as he usually does and that makes this a winner for me.  I also like how you get a lot of pencils to use with the topper and I believe they may fit other pencils too.
I thoroughly test all items and do my best to give a fair and honest review as I know I count on reviews when I am making purchases.  I also consider the original price and value of the product and ask myself if I would pay full price for this item.  My only concern is that these pencils are expensive and if he loses them - well then he loses them.  The play value is good though and he is enjoying them.  If you find this review helpful - please let me know by clicking helpful.
profile.summary: Cute concept and fun idea

profile.description: Sometimes taking a shower is the last thing anyone wants to do. If you have to do it (Yes, please do), you may as well get a good laugh between bathroom trips. Sharp Shirters quirky fun shower curtains complement even the most obscure sense of humor. We have the most unique designs in the business ranging from pirate themed bathroom dcor and nautical designs to art deco and boho chic styles. Our cool fabric shower curtains provide all the jokes youve been missing in the bathroom. Beyond giving you a laugh, we guarantee satisfaction. Our waterproof curtains are printed on 100% polyester with the highest quality ink to ensure durability and vibrant colors. Furthermore, our curtains are mildew resistant and machine washable! Make every day fun with a quirky & unique shower curtain from Sharp Shirter!
profile.reviewText:
There is a time and a place for everything.  I would say the time for a stripper sloth shower curtain is now, and the place is the apartment of my son and his girlfriend.

I purchased this as a housewarming gift for the two most twisted people I know.  I just happened to carry one of them in my womb for 9 months.  When they opened the package - their eyes lit up with delight and they ran off to the bathroom to install this beautiful piece of contemporary art.  I couldn't tell if their roommate was appreciative or appalled - or a little bit of both.

If you are on the fence - I would say buy it.  You can impress your friends and be the talk of the town.
profile.summary: This belongs in every home

profile.description: Climb into your toasty bed and sleep soundly in quilted fleece softness. Controller comes with 10 Heat Settings and 10-Hour Auto Off. Exclusive wiring system senses & adjusts throughout the blanket for the highest peace of mind. Only from Sunbeam Heated Bedding.
profile.reviewText:
I live in San Diego and this really shouldn't be a necessity.  At the same time, I tend to run colder than the rest of the family and they don't always want the heat on when I do.
I had an electric blanket when I was younger, and I was hesitant to try one again.  I remember a thin blanket with hard wires.  I tried an electric blanket at a friends house and I was sold.
I first tried to find one locally, but this being San Diego, there weren't a lot of local choices.  Amazon to the rescue yet again.  I purchased this blanket and it arrived quickly.  I couldn't wait to try it out.
The first thing I noticed was that it was thick and plush.  The wires are in there but this isn't the electric blanket of my youth.  I laid it on my bed - my order is sheet, electric blanket and then comforter.  If it was colder, I would put another blanket between the sheet and the electric blanket, but this works well.  It doesn't get too hot, and I am not feeling the wires.  I keep it between a 2-5 since it's really not that cold here.
Ive been using it for the last few weeks and I am quite pleased with this purchase.  Im not sure how I lived without one of these to be honest.  It provides the perfect amount of warmth without heating up the entire house.  I am hoping to get many years of use out of this blanket.
profile.summary: Plush and warm - perfect

profile.description: Colored pencils with roll up Pencil case set Of 48 assorted colors water color capable for kids & adults
profile.reviewText:
I purchased this set at a discount in exchange for an honest review.  I am always looking for the perfect pencil.  In my perfect world, I would find a pencil that works as a water color pencil but also can stand alone as a colored pencil.
I tested these out and I was worried at first, that these may not dissolve the way I wanted in water.  The pencils handled well, and I thought they might be a little too hard.  After using them, I decided that they weren't too hard and would work fine. When I applied water, they painted nicely.  These pencils also sharpened well - no issues with the sharpener eating half of the pencil.  The pigment level was very nice.
This set also includes a case. The case is very nice and sturdy and holds the pencils neatly.  The pencils come neatly lined up and the only thing I would change would be providing a numbering system of some sort to help keep track of what colors you are using.
I thoroughly test all items and do my best to give a fair and honest review as I know I count on reviews when I am making purchases. I also consider the full price for the product and the value provided.  I would say that these pencils and case provide good value for your money.
profile.summary: Very nice set of watercolor pencils

profile.description: Leegoal 1 Pair of Replacement Earpad ear pad cushion for Bose Around Ear TP-1 Triport 1 Headphones.
profile.reviewText: I bought my Bose Triport TP1a headphones 6 years and three jobs ago. They have gotten me through years of loud talkers, obnoxious cube neighbors and even the desk tooth brusher in the next cube.  The ear covers were starting to go and I thought I had to replace them - which seemed like a waste because they still sound great.  A search at Amazon revealed these ear pads and my headphones are saved.  I can't tell if they are harder or softer than the originals - because it's been so long - all that matters is that I was able to snap off the old ones and snap in the new ones in under a minute.  Now I'm off to enjoy some music and block out tech support one cube over :)
profile.summary: My beloved headphones have been saved!

profile.description: They will be entering warp-speed when they run in the Adidas Kids Hyperfast 2.0 K  Best running shoe. A breathable mesh upper will help them keep their cool, while the Ortholite midsole provides lightweight comfort and manages moisture and odor.
profile.reviewText:
I noticed my daughter's PE grade was dropping.  When I asked her why she blamed her gym shoes.  She said they weren't comfortable and she couldn't run fast enough to make the minimum mile time.  Never fear - Amazon is here!
I searched through a lot of shoes looking for the perfect pair.  These came up in my search - the price was perfect, and the shoe seemed to be what she needed.
The only hiccup was that I ordered a size 5 and I was shipped a size 1.  Amazon gets extra credit for quickly fixing this and shipping me out a pair of size 5s in time for Christmas - because I am THAT mom who would put running shoes under the Christmas tree.
The good news is that her running time has improved and her grade is back up.  The shoes are comfortable and fit well.  She says they make it easier to run since they move with her feet.  The fact that they are the perfect shades of pink doesn't hurt.  Overall a great purchase and product for the price
profile.summary: My daughter credit's these shoes for her improved PE grade

profile.description: Powerful sound, lightweight design SoundTrue headphones feature an advanced acoustic design for clear, natural audio across the full spectrumfrom vocalists who hit the high note, right down to a good bass line groove. Go ahead, lose yourself in music. A softly padded headband and memory foam ear cushions stay comfortable no matter how long your playlist is. Convenience and durability More than a statement in style, SoundTrue headphones are designed to provide lasting quality. The audio cable attaches to a single earcup for greater freedom of movement and less tangling. It also detaches for convenient storage. The earcups conveniently fold flat and the headband is collapsible. And the included carrying case makes for easy transport while displaying your design choice. In tune and in touch SoundTrue headphones are designed specifically for use with your iPhone and other Apple products. The integrated inline remote located on the back of the microphone, lets you control music functionsadjust volume, play/pause tracks, skip tracks forward/backward, fast forward/rewind and change playlists. You can also switch between calls and music with onetouch easeall without reaching for your device. Many features are also compatible with today's most popular phones.
profile.reviewText:
I purchased these headphones 1 year and 3 months ago.  They were purchased to replace my last pair of Bose headphones that lasted 6 years.  Since my last experience was so positive, I had high hopes for these headphones.
I was very disappointed when I realized there was no sound in one ear.  My last pair stopped working in one ear and we tried redoing the wires to get a little more time out of them but 6 years appears to be the limit.
One selling point of this pair for me was the cord that could be replaced.  I managed to forget about that when the headphones stopped working.  Luckily, the sound started working again after I adjusted the cord.
profile.summary: So far so good

top_5.description: This officially licensed Star Wars shirt features the franchise's #1 Dad, Darth Vader. The perfect gift for the #1 sith lord in your life.
top_5.reviewText:
My generation was raised on Star Wars.  We saw the movies in the theaters with our parents.  We then raised our kids on it.  As far as we are concerned, the series started with Episode 4 and we begrudgingly accept the latest installment, but want nothing to do with anything that had Jar Jar in it.  Based on that criteria - I purchased this shirt the favorite dad in my life.
As you can imagine, this shirt brings a smile to the face of all who see it.  It's best worn when escorting children about town, it usually brings a smile to the faces of people passing by, and may even convince strangers to forgive the transgressions of your children - especially if your children are like mine and able to level a small town in 5 minutes flat.  It also allows for conversations with other Jedi knights who will strike up conversations over it as you enjoy conversations about Darth Vadar the way he was meant to be - not as a whiny little kid but as a solid villain with a soft side.
The fit was perfect and it has held up through several washings without any fading or shrinkage.  Sizing was accurate and the workmanship is acceptable.  The recipient was thrilled with it, and wears it often.  Overall, I give this a solid 5 stars.  Great gift for the #1 dad in your life.
top_5.summary: I find your lack of shirts disturbing

top_5.description: OFFICIALLY LICENSED PRODUCT BASED ON THE FAMOUS TV SERIES, Not a cheap reproduction. Doctor Who Fourth Doctor Tom Baker Action Figure: Continue your adventures through time and space with the Fourth Doctor! Detailed likeness of actor Tom Baker from Doctor Who. Action figure includes accessories, multiple points of articulation, and interchangeable heads!Continue your adventures through time and space with the Fourth Doctor! The Fourth Doctor from the long-running Doctor Who appeared in the British TV series from 1974 to 1981, and is perhaps most recognizable by his penchant for colorful accessories. Showcasing a nicely detailed likeness of actor Tom Baker, this highly entertaining action figure features multiple points of articulation, his signature multi-colored scarf, and two interchangeable heads! He stands about 5 1/2-inches tall. Age:  5+ Size:  5 1/2-inches tall
top_5.reviewText:
Tom Baker - the longest lived incarnation of the Doctor - and for so many of my generation - he was their first doctor. I wasn't lucky enough to grow up with BBC, and I developed my Doctor Who addiction later in life. Regardless - as a true Whovian - I respect the the classics and the fourth doctor and his iconic scarf are one of the best known images of The Doctor.
When he arrived, I carefully studied the box - while debating - do I open it?  Do I keep him pristine in the box?  I went back and forth and decided that a figure this beautiful needed to be played with.
The first thing I noticed was the exceptional packaging. Every piece was perfectly placed and tied down, so there is no shifting during shipping. His tiny sonic screwdriver was held securely in place by a piece of tape and the body parts were carefully tied down to the package.
I carefully cut into the clamshell package and removed The Doctor from his plastic prison.  I took a few minutes to study the face and body - to admire the perfect details of the eyes and nose.  The scarf is plastic - not fabric - but it does move a bit. The arm and leg joints are articulated and can bend and move. The one thing I found is that the scarf is a bit stiff - which can affect posing - but it didn't affect it too much as you can see.
It was time for The Doctor to meet up with a Dalek and he was able to quickly take him down with the sonic screwdriver - which fit securely in his hand. He then decided to sit down and take a break and try to get his head on straight. We did try out the extra head but preferred the head with the signature hat.
This 4th Doctor is absolute perfection. The craftsmanship and detail are incredible. Part of me is regretting unboxing such an amazing collectible - but part of me can't wait to take him on more adventures. My kids are already planning a photo shoot for him in the Lego Tardis this weekend.  I'm sure he won't mind.
This product was purchased at a discount in exchange for an honest review and my honest opinion is that I would gladly purchase this product at full price.
top_5.summary: A must have for your Doctor Who collection

top_5.description: Star Wars Darth Vader Oven Glove Set - Silicone Heat Resistant up to 445 Degrees F - This glove is great for any fan of Star Wars, especially those who love to grill or cook indoors! Great anti-slip grip and embossed with the Empire insignia. *Please Note: Caution* Hot Pans should not be held for an extended period of time with these gloves, especially Cast Iron Pans with no protection on the handle. Cast Iron Pans can exceed temperatures beyond the silicone capacity. For Proper use, please ensure the glove is fit tightly on your hand before gripping anything hot, be aware of your surroundings and do not hold hot items for an extended period of time. Please contact the seller for any other questions regarding use.
top_5.reviewText:
Cooking isn't just for women.  There are men who are at home in the kitchen too.
I had to replace the worn out kitchen mitts and had the chance to purchase these at a discount in exchange for an honest review.  Of course I had to say yes.  Because Vader gloves.  What a great chance to get gloves that work for the men and women in the house who cook.  (OK Im stereotyping a bit but not everyone was a fan of the pretty frilly flowered oven mitts that I own)
The first thing I noticed when I took them out of the bag is that they look awesome.  Absolutely awesome.  But that is what was expected.
I tried the gloves on and they were a bit snug on my hands - but not unusable.  My 20 year old son was able to wear them comfortably and he's a 6'5" beast of a child.  But I had another friend try them on and he couldn't fit his hands in all the way.  Im going to say they run small.
The test was to see if they worked.  And thats one of those tests that make you cringe a bit - because what if they dont?  Well - I tested them out in the oven - poking at the hot pan a few times with my finger to verify that my finger didn't get burned before I went in with both hands and pulled the pan out.  The gloves did their job and protected my hands from the heat.
I test all items that I review, whether provided at a discount or if I pay full price and I try to give the kind of feedback that I personally look for when I purchase items. These fit me - but seem to run small.  So where do these fall in the ranking?  Im wavering between 4 and 5 stars.  They do the job of protecting your hands from the heat and they look great - and they work great for me.  BUT - if you have big hands - these will not work for you.
top_5.summary: Run SMALL - but super cute and do the job.

top_5.description: Welcome to the noisy and dangerous Mos Eisley Cantina on the desert world of Tatooine! Park the landspeeder and enter, staying clear of the giant dewback drinking from the trough outside. Make sure Luke, Han and Obi-Wan have their weapons with them as they enter through the sliding door and walk past the droid scanner. Open out the building for easier play and order a drink while the Bith cantina band gets ready to play their instruments. Recreate scenes in the cantina from Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope, such as the showdown between Han Solo and Rodian bounty hunter Greedo. Includes 8 minifigures with assorted weapons and accessories: Han Solo, Luke Skywalker, Obi-Wan Kenobi, Greedo, a Sandtrooper and 3 Bith Musicians. Features Mos Eisley Cantina, a landspeeder, evaporator and a dewback with feeding area. Mos Eisley Cantina features a dome roof, entrance with sliding door and droid scanner, opening roof, slide-out floors to the middle rooms, bar with shelves, money and bottles, stage for the Bith band, seats, table and windows. Landspeeder features a dual cockpit, windscreen, 3 massive engines and a trunk. Dewback features an opening mouth, saddle with weapon holster plus brick pieces for when the saddle is removed.
top_5.reviewText:
The Lego box was already a wretched hive of scum and villainy.  Lets face it - those little blocks on the floor at 3 am can do more damage than a fully armed and operational battle station.  The house is already teeming with superheroes and Lego characters - but really - who could say no to this amazing set.

I put it together with my 8 year old - who likes to consider himself to be an expert level builder.  Since I had to redo a few parts of the cantina - I would rate him more like an advanced builder - but not quite expert.  The colors in the instructions were a little difficult to tell apart - but overall it was totally doable.

The highlight of this set is the cantina band.  There's just no getting around it - the band is incredible.  I can almost hear the sound of the horns as we reenact the Cantina scene the way it was meant to be - with Hans firing first.  Out of all of the sets we own - this is probably our favorite.  My son will take it down and play with it when he watches the movie - just because it's that cool.
top_5.summary: Great set for parents and kids - tons of play value

input: Generate the review text written by a reviewer who has a given an overall rating of "5.0" for a product with description "Gibbon's work, published in 1781 to 1789,  traces the trajectory of Western civilization (as well as the Islamic and Mongolian conquests) from the height of the Roman Empire to the fall of Byzantium--Wikipedia.". The summary of the review text is "Monumental, insightful, and ahead of its time".
output:
A truly monumental work, covering nearly a millennium and a half of European history, from the Antonine emperors through the rise of Christianity and the conversion of Constantine, Diocletian's attempts to restore the empire to its pagan roots and the final collapse of paganism, ending the first half with the fall of Rome and the end of empire in the west.  The second half mainly deals with the eastern Byzantine empire and includes many interesting historical episodes, from Justinian's attempt to reconquer the west, to Mohammed and the rise of the Arabs, Charlemagne, the Crusades, Zingis (Genghis) Khan and the Mogul (Mongol) conquests, through the final capture of Constantinople by the Ottoman Turks and the end of the empire in the east.

Gibbon was also so far ahead of his time that many historians to this day still haven't caught up to him in some respects, offering insightful interpretations of many of the events he covers.  For example, discussing the Mogul conquests and many other destructive wars, he argues that, contrary to the opinions of other historians who find all kinds of positive consequences resulting from such conquest, "If some partial disorders, some local oppressions, were healed by the sword...the remedy was far more pernicious than the disease."  Similarly, commenting on the invention of gunpowder, he writes: "If we contrast the rapid progress of this mischievous discovery with the slow and laborious advances of reason, science, and the arts of peace, a philosopher, according to his temper, will laugh or weep at the folly of mankind."

All this shows the influence on Gibbon of Voltaire, who held that history should properly focus on those who have actually contributed to the advance of civilization, rather than on kings and warriors who more often hold it back.  The Decline and Fall of the Roman Empire is mostly focused on the kings and warriors, but Gibbon clearly shares Voltaire's evaluation of them.  This is apparent from the opening pages, where Gibbon writes, "as long as mankind shall continue to bestow more liberal applause on their destroyers than on their benefactors, the thirst of military glory will ever be the vice of the most exalted characters."

Gibbon also shares Voltaire's evaluation of Christianity, and again is insightful ahead of his time.  For instance, he demolishes the idea that the early Christians were brutally and systematically persecuted by the pagan emperors, thoroughly demonstrating that such persecution as did take place was usually local, half-hearted if not reluctant, and short-lived.  But he doesn't stop there.  He shows how the Christians persecuted each other far more severely than the pagans ever did, ruthlessly stamping out any sect deemed heretical down through the centuries.  Further, he asks, if the Christians were so persecuted by the pagans, how come it's the Christians who ultimately won out and it's the pagans who were finally extinguished?  The outcome speaks for itself, but Gibbon writes movingly about the final triumph of Christianity and what that meant for pagans like Hypatia of Alexandria.

Gibbon's writing is full of such insight and is often quite witty, and his subjects are often very interesting.  My only complaint is that the material occasionally gets bogged down with page after page about the same city being taken and retaken by opposing sides in a conflict, and this can start to seem painfully redundant after a while (though if that's how it feels to read about it, just imagine what it must have been like to live through it!).  But just keep reading and it will soon again be worth it.  And even if at times I wish Gibbon would in some ways adjust his focus or his organization, I can forgive him all that for all the value his great work provides!

profile.description: The hauntingly prophetic classic novel set in a not-too-distant future where books are burned by a special task force of firemen. Guy Montag is a fireman. His job is to burn books, which are forbidden, being the source of all discord and unhappiness. Even so, Montag is unhappy; there is discord in his marriage. Are books hidden in his house? The Mechanical Hound of the Fire Department, armed with a lethal hypodermic, escorted by helicopters, is ready to track down those dissidents who defy society to preserve and read books. The classic novel of a post-literate future, 'Fahrenheit 451' stands alongside Orwell's '1984' and Huxley's 'Brave New World' as a prophetic account of Western civilization's enslavement by the media, drugs and conformity. Bradbury's powerful and poetic prose combines with uncanny insight into the potential of technology to create a novel which over fifty years from first publication, still has the power to dazzle and shock.
profile.reviewText:
Fahrenheit 451 was the first book I had to read for school that I actually liked, and was therefore to a large extent responsible for keeping my love of reading alive into adulthood.  That was nearly two decades ago, and rereading it now has been an equally delightful experience.  It is a truly great novel, and this is even easier to appreciate after having read the earlier versions "The Fireman" and "Long After Midnight", which by comparison and contrast serve to highlight the structure, the richness of descriptive detail, the astonishing variations in metaphors about heat and fire (and their opposites) throughout, and more.  Even apparently trivial lines of dialogue are laden with layers of meaning, as when Montag's wife tells him, "You don't look so hot yourself."

It is also fairly philosophically sophisticated.  While the novel is about a fireman who burns books, and Bradbury is clearly enamored of books, they are just a symbol: "It's not books you need, it's some of the things that once were in books. The same things could be in the 'parlour families' today. The same infinite detail and awareness could be projected through the radios and televisors, but are not. No, no, it's not books at all you're looking for! Take it where you can find it, in old phonograph records, old motion pictures, and in old friends; look for it in nature and look for it in yourself. Books were only one type of receptacle where we stored a lot of things we were afraid we might forget. There is nothing magical in them at all. The magic is only in what books say, how they stitched the patches of the universe together into one garment for us."

And it is not just about one political program versus another, or even about the individual versus the state, but about independence in the moral sphere, thinking and feeling for oneself: "I took the others on faith!...I don't want to change sides and just be *told* what to do.  There's no reason to change if I do that."

He even abstracts from books to the nature of creative activity in general: "It doesn't matter what you do,...so long as you change something from the way it was before you touched it into something that's like you after you take your hands away.  The difference between the man who just cuts lawns and a real gardener is in the touching.... The lawn-cutter might just as well not have been there at all; the gardener will be there a lifetime."

And there's so much more that's absolutely wonderful in this book that I can't even touch on here.  Bradbury isn't always entirely consistent and the book has some other minor flaws, but they are insignificant compared to its virtues.  Four and a half stars.
profile.summary: A truly great novel

profile.reviewText:
First of all, can I just say: What the heck is up with Tom Bombadil? I had the impression that he's a much-beloved character (at least in some circles)---but good grief, he makes even the elves seem hardly sappy at all by comparison! That whole section of the book was completely ridiculous---no wonder they left it out of the movie versions.

One aspect of the book that the movie didn't fully capture, though, was Tolkein's portrayal of power-lust, especially through the characters of Saruman and Boromir. The ring represents a somewhat different temptation for the halflings (particularly Smeagol and Bilbo), a sort of unhealthy obsession with material objects, similar to that represented by Voldemort's horcruxes in Harry Potter (which also symbolize power-lust and a neurotic fear of death).  The discussions between Gandalf and Saruman, and Frodo and Boromir, which were much better in the book and the movies should have used more of that dialogue or at least stayed truer to its spirit. They really helped bring out some of the basic themes of the novels more explicitly, but in the movie they were really watered down and generic by comparison, which really weakened the impact not only of those particular scenes, but of the movies overall.

I've also heard it complained that the movies tried to force non-existent and vaguely hinted at romances to the fore, but I actually thought strengthening some of the romantic storylines was one of the better changes made by the adapters. It helped emphasize the values at stake, and in some cases actually tightened the plot and cut out unnecessary characters. For example, it was much better to have Arwen meet Aragorn and the hobbits on their way to Rivendell instead of some other random elf who played no further role in the story, rather than just having her be present at the feast given for Frodo after his recovery and then occasionally dropping subtle hints that Aragorn is in love with her. Tolkein basically just told us that there was a romance between them---the movie dramatizes it. Sam's interest in Rosie the barmaid also gives him a stronger reason to want to return to the Shire other than just that he longs for a peaceful, quiet life of gardening, and thereby raises the stakes for his character. I know the peaceful quiet life of gardening was really the whole point for Tolkein, but let's face it, he was a bit fruity on the subject (as witness the whole Tom Bombadil fiasco).

As to this audio edition, Rob Inglis's narration is quite good---I enjoyed listening to his characterizations and performances of the songs and so forth.  Three and a half stars.

profile.description: Unusual book
profile.reviewText:
The Glass Books of the Dream Eaters is a promising fictional debut, but one that comes just shy of being able to keep its promises.

It follows three interesting characters whose personal intrigues lead them to become entangled in a political intrigue involving the cult of an alchemist painter who has invented a process for removing a person's memories--thereby making that person into an empty shell and thus a  subservient slave--and putting those memories into special blue glass books which allows "readers" to experience the memories contained therein first-hand.  An interesting concept, with interesting characters...but not *too* interesting.

The plot is a bit repetetive.  The three protagonists go to the villains' headquarters independently, are captured, then escape.  They meet up with each other, separate, each go back to the villains' headquarters, are captured...and so on.  During each cycle, they all learn a bit more about what's going on, and then share their new piece of the puzzle with the others when they are reunited, but this pattern does grow a bit tedious by the end.

Everything about this novel is "not quite."  The super-advanced, quasi-mystical technology of the villains *almost* works (in terms of the reader's suspension of disbelief), but not quite.  The characters are likeable, but not quite loveable.  Their stories are readable, but not compelling.  The author's prose style is more than competent, but not quite artistic or beautiful.

Rather than slogging through the whole book, my advice is to just pick up the abridged version on CD from the library.  Here's hoping that Gordon Dahlquist's second novel will be everything that this one could have been.
profile.summary: Not bad for a first novel--but not great, either

profile.reviewText:
I've greatly enjoyed Rick Riordan's young adult mythological fantasy series, and this final installment did not disappoint.  The Heroes of Olympus has been somewhat different from the original Percy Jackson and the Olympians, in some ways I didn't like as much, such as the plot feeling a bit more formulaic with fewer major twists, but in other ways I enjoyed even more, such as the bigger, more diverse cast of characters.  Riordan couldn't develop them all as fully, but over the course of the series I felt he did justice to all the central characters so that by the end I came to appreciate each of them as unique individuals.  And while their ethnic diversity was nice, and their diversity of Olympian parentage even more interesting, it was most gratifying that given those genetic backgrounds the essence of their characters grew out of their experiences and choices.

Some reviewers have complained that Percy and Annabeth get short shrift in their last book, and I can understand wanting to see more of them.  But personally, after having spent so much time with them already in the earlier books, I enjoyed spending more time with Reyna, Nico, Jason, and even Piper, but especially Leo.  And I was satisfied with the ending to Percy and Annabeth's story.

I have less sympathy with the complaint that the ending was "too happy" because none of the central protagonists died.  Sacrifice doesn't make things more meaningful, just pointlessly tragic.  If the heroes can figure out a way to triumph in the end that avoids the necessity of laying down their own lives, that makes them all the more heroic.  I, for one, applaud Rick Riordan for daring to give us a happy ending.  I would have been disappointed if he'd gone for the usual cheap trick of "heroic sacrifice".  The final chapter had me laughing from sheer delight, so as far as I'm concerned, The Blood of Olympus was a nearly perfect conclusion to a very worthwhile journey.  Thank you, Mr. Riordan.
profile.summary: A nearly perfect ending to a rewarding series

profile.reviewText:
Based on the plot blurb on the jacket, this didn't sound like one of Crichton's best novels, so I put off reading it for years.  Now I wish I hadn't.  Airframe stands up with his best.  A story of corporate politics, union violence, bureaucratic b.s., and media responsibility (or the lack thereof), Airframe weaves all of these elements into a seamless whole.

Casey Singleton is a single mom, and a vice-president of quality assurance at Norton, one of the world's top (and few remaining) manufacturers of airframes (i.e., the body of an airplane, but not the engines).  With a terrible but inexplicable accident threatening to upset a vital deal, it's up to her to get to the bottom of what actually happened in order to prove that the model of the plane is safe and reliable.  But the union, afraid that jobs are going to be outsourced, will go to any lengths to stop the deal, and that means derailing Casey's investigation.  Plus, it seems like there may be someone in upper management working against her as well.  On top of all this, Casey is appointed as the company's liaison with the media about the incident.  Can she deal with a violent union, back-stabbing co-workers, irresponsible journalists, senseless bureaucracy, and still solve the mystery in time?

As usual, Crichton puts in enough technical detail to make the story seem hyper-real, but not quite enough to bore the reader with minutiae entirely irrelevant to the story.  And unlike some of his more science-fictiony stuff, this novel is firmly in the realism camp, along with some of his other better novels (Disclosure and The Great Train Robbery come to mind).

A couple of minor drawbacks: Some of the characters are a bit thinly drawn, for instance the upper-level management of the company, whom Crichton portrays as very hard workers in a sort of vague way but who we otherwise have no idea how they got where they are.  And he treats some of his subject matter a bit inconsistently, for instance having a character who appears to be speaking for the author insist that federal regulation is the only way to ensure that corporations make safe products, but then showing regulatory agencies basically just getting in the way with a bunch of useless red tape and showing very clearly that the company's real motivation to put out a safe product is so they can actually sell it and make money off of it and not go out of business and all be out of jobs.

But these are fairly minor issues in the novel.  Overall, it's a great read, and I highly recommend it.
profile.summary: An exciting foray into the world of high-stakes enterprise
