****UPDATE 3/30/15****  DOES NOT have nearly the battery life advertised, and it is half of what it was 3 months ago.  I'm NOT IMPRESSED.  Wish I would have bought the Anker brand.  I have experience with their battery products, and although I can't speak to the speakers, I'm betting their claims are more accurate.

profile.description: Natural nutrition Plus Vitamins and Minerals and a taste cats love, combined in a convenient 16oz pouch. Purina Cat Chow Naturals is a dry cat food ideal for everyday feeding, with 100% complete & balanced nutrition that provides the 25 essential vitamins & minerals adult cats need. Formulated with high levels of protein like a cats natural diet, every meal includes real chicken, whole grains and garden greens. A natural fiber blend helps control hairballs.
profile.reviewText:
I've had a cat with sensitive digestion issues for about 8 years....  and I haved grain free, corn free, wheat free, you name it, I've bought it.  Trying to ease the 'digestive issues' fall out all over my home.  Again and again I found myself returning to this product, if even to mix it in 50/50 to make the GF products price something I could stomach.

Ultimately we ended up putting him on 'tummy meds' a few months back and this is now the ONLY food I am using with my cats and everyone seems to be doing well and happy with the food.  Honestly I found that a little amazing considering the price is low end...  but after buying AT LEAST  dozen types and brands of 'high end' foods...  this one really is the cats meow.

I will add that as an overall belief in my life, I treat human 'conditions' with adjustments in food and exercise. I am a holistic person who believes that what ails the planet these days is low quality food and too much artificial everything....  I would NOT have ever expected in my years of exploring the cat food market that I'd setting on this product to be the best balance of quality and price.
profile.summary: Surprised that this Purina Product 'won' the nearly 6 year 'cat food wars' comparison I've been living with my food allergy cat.

profile.description: Multi-purpose Cable Clips, Multiple Color Options, Great Value, 10pcs/package
profile.reviewText:
Once I locate my double sided CARPET TAPE to replace the foam double sided tape on these, they should be WONDERFUL once they stay where put!

They came from Hong Kong which took several weeks, but when I saw these I knew they were just what I wanted...  I have bi-level desk with a desktop computer and have my various USB cables plugged into a hub on the tower case...  well, I was tired of trying to fish them up through the hole in my desk.  Between gravity and cats, they just would not stay where I lay them on my main desk level and taping them in place was OK, but then you have all these layers of tape cuz you can only restick that so many times...  they hold the little cables right where I need them and make life so much simpler, now if they would just STAY stuck to the underside of the higher level of my desk it would be perfect.
profile.summary: Concept is PERFECT, sticky stuff on these is LAME

profile.description: American Metal Products 1500W6 6-Inch White Round Ceiling Diffuser Ceiling, Wall & Floor Diffusers
profile.reviewText:
I docked this one star, since I guess this is not really for a 6" duct / butterfly valve setup...  it was nearly impossible to screw this to the ceiling and would NOT align with the butterfly valve I used of the same brand.  It left me wishing I'd ordered the 8" to have more clearance between the valve cowl and the location I needed to use for these screw holes to go into the ceiling.

Otherwise, it is plenty light weight to screw right into your sheet rock ceiling without anchors... I have NO concerns about this coming lose even if we open and close the butterfly damper a few times a year.  If one is constantly adjusting the air flow, you may want to use anchors for where you attach this to your sheet rock.  In any case, I'd go with the 8" version if I had it to do over again... not sure that's really a problem with the product - but I guess I'd expect to order 6" parts for a 6" duct and have it all fit much easier than this did.
profile.summary: Nice looking, light weight, decent quality product.  Overall very pleased with the deal... read details for 4 vs 5 star review.

profile.description: 48 Inches Wide Walnut wood veneer finish credenza fits most 50 Inches and Smaller Flat Panels
profile.reviewText:
I had read all the reviews and managed to only have a couple scuff marks for shipping damage, it covers with a scratch cover product. So all in all I'd say that this was a GREAT value for the money and is a very nice piece of furniture.  I have a lot of antiques and high end items and it 'fits in' just fine.

It has poor directions for assembly, pictures that are not well marked, only two with a sequence of order to them. However, I have assembled similar pieces before with the cams and cam bolts, it was really pretty straight forward.  All the pieces where there, and it went fairly smooth. I'd say it took two of us about an hour to assemble, EXCEPT for the doors.  They were almost an hour themselfs and they still need adjustment to be centered and look just right.

UPDATED  01/2017
Once we got past that, it has held up well, and continues to be a good looking piece of furniture 4 years later...  highly recommend this piece. I like it so much I'm going to buy a matching stereo/media cabinet to put in the living room near it!
profile.summary: Really decent piece of furniture!  (moved 4 years later, moved well, still love this piece)

profile.description: Assassin's Creed is the next-gen game developed by Ubisoft Montreal that will redefine the action genre. While other games claim to be next-gen with impressive graphics and physics, Assassin's Creed merges technology, game design, theme, and emotions into a world where you instigate chaos and become a vulnerable, yet powerful, agent of change. The setting is 1191 AD. The Third Crusade is tearing the Holy Land apart. You, Altair, intend to stop the hostilities by suppressing both sides of the conflict. You are an Assassin, a warrior shrouded in secrecy and feared for your ruthlessness. Your actions can throw your immediate environment into chaos, and your existence will shape events during this pivotal moment in history. Key Features Be an Assassin Master the skills, tactics, and weapons of history's deadliest and most secretive clan of warriors. Plan your attacks, strike without mercy, and fight your way to escape. Realistic and responsive environments Crowds react to your moves and will either help or hinder you on your quests. Action with a new dimension total freedom Eliminate your targets wherever, whenever, and however. Stalk your prey through richly detailed, historically accurate, open-ended environments. Scale buildings, mount horses, blend in with crowds. Do whatever it takes to achieve your objectives. Relive the epic times of the Crusades Assassin's Creed immerses you in the realistic and historical Holy Land of the 12th century, featuring life-like graphics, ambience, and the subtle, yet detailed nuances of a living world. Intense action rooted in reality Experience heavy action blended with fluid and precise animations. Use a wide range of medieval weapons, and face your enemies in realistic swordfight duels. Next-gen gameplay The proprietary engine developed from the ground up for the next-gen console allows organic game design featuring open gameplay, intuitive control scheme, realistic interaction with environment, and a fluid, yet sharp, combat mechanic.
profile.reviewText:
I had serious reservations about allowing a 12/13 year old to play an 'M' game...  and still feel that almost all these games have too much violence and language in them...  I have resisted the 'M' games up until this point but after going to a game store with him, had to develop a different set of criteria for chosing games.  ALL the games are either 'too young' or 'too old' for this age of kid!!!

While I find that VERY IRRITATING we are forced to deal with it  (everything in life for the kids this age is either too young or too old for them!!  they are SO STUCK!!)  We agreed no sexual content being the reason, to TRY to avoid too graphic of voilence, and NOTHING ILLEGAL in the real world can be done.  Killing is illegal, we've discussed it - and even in the E and T rated games there is killing.  We have, up until this game, limited it to killing aliens and such.  this is a very difficult line to walk with the kids and I PERSONALLY would rather none of this crap exist at all.  But we make them socially out of place and unable to really make many friends if we limit EVERYTHING they participate in...

That said, they are killing people in this game, but the good guy vs. the bad guys are pretty clear.  Any recommendations on other games that fit the bill as well as this one has would be greatly appreciated!!  Just post a 'question' with your comments. Thanks!
profile.summary: My son LOVES this game...  all time favorite, so far.

profile.description: To help you maintain a healthy lifestyle, the Activity Tracker monitors your daily activities (Calories, Steps, Distances, and Fitness) and sleep efficiency.
profile.reviewText:
WELL, after reading so many reviews on this...  all over the board. I managed to get an open box item off another site for really cheap.  AND, there are a few things to pay attention to when you set this up. 1) you HAVE TO  get the software for the Activity Tracker from the Playstore, even if you want to use it with S Health.  Just do it, and then follow THAT setup through the pairing of the bluetooth.  I have used lots of bluetooth devices and tried to pair the device without the Activity Tracker software... NO DICE.  You HAVE TO use that software to pair it, and then it DOES link itself to the S Health app.  2)  Also, during setup you enter your age, height, etc. and it calculates your stride. Before blowing right past that, try to figure out if that is right and adjust it right then and there...  I'd like to shorten mine, and honestly I haven't figured out how to do that.  It's probably logging slightly more than my real steps per day, it seems quite sensitive worn on the wrist, and I think the distance is over stated.

I also like that it track the 'quality of sleep' wearing it on my wrist. I was bummed out that you have to switch it to, and then out of, sleep mode to track your sleep hours and quality... but hey, if you get this for $15-30 bucks, what do you expect right??

Others have said using the fob works better... maybe but I'm worried I'll wash the little bugger and not be mindful of it's location if I remove from the wrist strap..  maybe will try it out.

I owned a Gear Fit for a while, and honestly I'm happier with this.  While that may have tracked a bit more accurately, I also felt BOUND to my phone. It was pestering me for every text and email I got, etc.  and I just felt too tied to the technology. This does flash/buzz whatever when a text or call comes in, but it is not NEARLY as intrusive as the Gear Fit was.  So, I guess it depends on what you want.  I prefer this little gadget and it works well with managing my fitness and sleep goals. I really wanted something to do both, I'm one of those people that tends to forfeit sleep instead of doing less...  SO, it's good to get objective about things.
profile.summary: If you READ THE DIRECTIONS and follow them, this little thing does GREAT! for activity and sleep tracking with S Health.

profile.description: Clutterbuster Family Towel Bar is your family's solution to bathroom and bedroom clutter! This innovative towel bar is four towel bars in one--giving 300% more hanging space than a typical towel bar. The four parallel bars attach to a vertical pole that anchors to your door hinges. The horizontal bars swivel independently, so you can easily hang towels, robes, or swimwear to dry. And, because they swivel, you can still get into your bathroom or bedroom! Air drying towels between use keeps them fresher longer, so you spend less time, energy, and money washing and drying stuff that really doesn't need it yet. So make the most of that under used space behind the door. Make tidiness possible with the Hinge It Clutterbuster Family Towel Bar--the easy answer to shared space. With four bars at four heights, everyone in the family can keep their towel in reach and off the floor.
profile.reviewText:
As other reviewers have carried on about...  it does not fit snugly and does have that wobble thing going on.  HOWEVER, I have used this towel rack for FIVE YEARS.  It has held up to a boy from ages 8-14 at this point... and he is not very conscious about 'being gentle' with anything... typical boy.

I never did put the duct or electrical tape in the pole joins as other have...  considered taking it down to do so, but HAVE NEVER HAD A PROBLEM WITH IT.  My ONLY gripe is that we use large bath sheets and two work perfectly. When we have guests, and the top towel touches the one(s) below - if it's soaked, the dry towels below get damp.  SO, unbeknownst to anyone else...  when this situation is likely, I go first and mine is always the bottom towel, and then I dictate the order of showers from the 'bottom up' LOL.  And nobody has ever been the wiser.

I would not hesitate to buy this again, but I probably would wrap duct or electrical tape on the fittings before installation.
profile.summary: PERFECT for a small bathroom - I've used this for 5+ years and it's still as good as the day I installed it.

profile.reviewText:
UPDATE: They lasted 6 months, almost to the day.  I guess for $130 current price, I'd expect more.  NUTS.
_________________________________________________________________________________________________
Having to exchange for a half size larger...  So the 14.5 was just as expected or a tad snug. We ordered these is his current 'border line' size because it was HALF PRICE compared to ordering what would be the next half size...  as we do with our teenage boys.  SO, I guess we have to pay up or pick a different shoe, or color...  a game to be played for pricing on men's shoes this size I guess.

Can't provide any feedback as a worn item, they were tried on for 2 minutes and put back in the box.
profile.summary: Appear to be nice quality and less laces for a high-top will hopefully help with the on and off challenges...

profile.description: Microwave cavity paint which provides a "like new" finish on the inside of your microwave. No primer is needed with this 6-ounce spray paint. This microwave cavity paint is a snow white color.
profile.reviewText: WELL, I got a microwave from someone for free, and it was so bad that about 1/4 of the inside bottom was peeled and rusting.  Since I am moving and there is a built in convection/microwave in the new house, I just REALLY did not want to buy another one...  but I also could not tolerate the rusty mess and smell of the freebie... so I decided this owuld be a worthwhile investment.  And I guess it was...  sadly where the door closes it did 'stick to itself' even after allowing the door to stand open about about 18 hours after I painted.  But the base of the micro covered in 3 coats and is no longer disgusting - the smell of this was pretty bad for about 48-72 hours.  I am sensitive to smell, sometimes paint or even perfume odors can make me very ill feeling.  This came close, but I intentionally painted before leaving the house for a few hours and survived.
profile.summary: Good product - unreasonable amount of time needed to cure in my situation - but a vast improvement.

profile.description: Elevate your memory storage with Samsung USB 3.0 FIT technology. Get more mileage with a USB ideal for transfers between Ultra-Thin PCs and netbooks. Enjoy the best of both worlds with sleek, super-compact design as well as higher transfer speeds and rugged 5-proof durability.
profile.reviewText:
couldn't decide between like and love this...  WORKS GREAT. had to format it to use large files, but the transfer rate is phenomenal and error free.  But while the TINY size seems so smart, I actually seem to be more prone to losing this one.  So I guess it depends on how you're using it.  I use mine for moving a large volume of files from my desktop to the laptop, with USB 3 it's faster than pushing it over my WiFi and easier than stealing a wired connection from something to use for the laptop.

I have been using flash drives since they first arrived on the market and thought this was an AWESOME new option.  If I were using it to backup something on my laptop and leaving it plugged in all the time. Great...  but since it is usually NOT connected to a port, I seem to have a real hard time keeping track of this one.
profile.summary: Depends on how you use it...  WORKS Great, but TINY size is a debated feature for me

profile.description: 2-pack of RFA-67 6-volt batteries. Replacement batteries for PetSafe in-ground and wireless fence receiver collars and bark collars. Each battery lasts 1-3 months. For PetSafe fence, bark and training collars. See compatability chart below. Works with PIF-275 models. If this product is not meeting your needs, please contact PetSafe Brand. PetSafe brand has been an industry leading US manufacturer of pet behavior, containment and lifestyle products since 1991, helping millions of people and pets each year. Call, chat or email the PetSafe US-based customer care specialists six days a week.
profile.reviewText: The outside wireless fence and the inside 'puck' trainer system for the dog are can't live without items.  I took in a puppy mill mom who had apparently lived all her life in a cage.  Adapting her to going outside to 'go potty' and not be chained up or inside a fence has been a joy!  She loves her perceived freedom.  But she does not understand that she ALWAYS has to go out to go potty.  So the 'puck' helps keep her off my area rugs, etc. when she is home alone or over night in an attempt to keep her from going inside on the rugs - and then I got a second 'puck' when I discovered that the cats were in fact not eating double, but that she preferred the cat food over dog food and would eat all of their food too.  The collar has to beep merely ONE time for her to go 'oh yeah! I can't go there' and turn around and walk away.  Instant and consistent discipline and it's not associated with ME correcting here.  PERFECT.
profile.summary: Not sure the brand names ones are any better than the cheap ones.. but I love my Petsasfe systems

profile.description: Milliard Premium Mattress Protectors offer you the best in health benefits and allergy relief. This premium mattress protector incorporates specialized technology which will prevent fluids and allergy triggers such as pollen, dust mites and mold from penetrating the membrane cover while still allowing your mattress to breathe. Milliard Premium Mattress Protectors fit tight onto your mattress to offer you a healthier night's sleep.
profile.reviewText: This mattress pad fits on my Cal King fine, pulled tight (probably proportioned toward a Std King) getting it on over my 'down 2" mattress pad" that I was NOT willing to give up to get a waterproof one. The pad requires I use a triple loader at the laundrymat to wash so I want to avoid having to wash that if there was some sort of accident as well.  Got this due to a kitty that was going through renal failure...  he has since left this world.  It works fine, there is no odor or noise as some have reported, so I'm leaving it on the bed to fend off the chance of any other pet or kiddo accidents.  I did make some 'noise' going on the bed the first time, but once it was in place I didn't notice a thing.  I tend to have a hyper sensative nose and hearing...  so don't be concerned about that.
profile.summary: Peace of Mind at a decent price

profile.description: It is replacement incandescent light bulbs for may uses including ceiling lights, table/desk/floor lamps, cabinet lighting, closet lights, outdoor lights for home, office, restaurants, and stores. All bulbs are brand new and high brightness and long life.
profile.reviewText:
Thankfully this is a 5 pack, because the first bulb we used in the 'trouble light' I use for grilling lasted ONE use, about 20-30 minutes!!  The 2nd bulb has lasted 3 uses, but I am not optimistic about this product due to the first bulb being virtually worthless.  I'll try to remember to post when the 2nd bulb goes to verify or correct the expectation we now have for these bulbs.  The bulb that appears identical to this and came with the clamp on trouble light lasted 5 YEARS, and we grill 12 months of the year and used it for little else.

They fit correctly in our light, and we matched it up based on the electrical specs, size and appearance after an inability to use the bulb number off the original bulb.
profile.summary: Not sure.. 1st bulb lasted ONE use...  2nd one has lasted longer... hoping it was one bad bulb in the pack.

profile.description: The Explorer Tripod is perfect for digital, video and still cameras up to 4 pounds. Featuring quick release leg locks and 3 way pan head, this tripod is a breeze to set up. Utilizing a geared center post, this extends from 22" to 60" giving great range. Extra leg support offers better stability. Tripod bag included.
profile.reviewText: I like this one.  I had a full size one that belonged to my Dad for years and years but it weighted about 20x what this one does!!  This has a tilt function but you have to be careful which way you set this up to face if you want to use that...  there is very little in the form of directions so before you 'need' to use this you probably will benefit from doing some practice and experimentations with it.  I use it with a digital SLR and had enough challenge switching from the landscape position to portrait that I accidentlay changed the photo setting on my camera while doing it and had several sittings of a photo shoot turn out poorly as a result...  so practice and watch close when you are 'turning' your camera.
profile.summary: Good full size height and yet light enough to be called portable

profile.description: This clear vinyl, commercial grade chair mat is designed to help your chair roll easily on carpeted floors and prevent carpet wear caused by chair casters. It features a scuff and slip resistant top surface for durability and safety. The underside has a gripper back to firmly anchor the chair mat on low pile carpet, protecting your carpet from spills and damage. The mat includes a protruding lip to protect the carpet under the desk and allow the chair to roll even when it's all the way under the desk.
profile.reviewText:
For the price good.  It was a BEAR to get out of the package and unroll without drawing blood however, the carpet spikes are very sharp!!!  I unrolled it in my living room and piled books on it to flatten it for a day or two before attempting to position it at my desk.  I highly recomment that plan, this is 'curled' and hard to get it trained to lay flat.

I have a 60x48" rectangle before, on commercial carpet in a home office.  I preferred that greatly, but am moving in 3-4 months where I will have a cement floor and this was short term, so CHEAP was a top priority at my old one was disintegrating after 6-7 years of daily use.  This is fine, a little smaller than I prefer for a corner style desk where I DO roll right and left to get at cabinet drawers.
profile.summary: Seems of good quality, I'd prefer larger size since this is for daily office use...  but it fits my short term CHEAP need

profile.description: The Maxxima MLN-50 is the brightest plug-in Night Light available, with 5 White LEDs. This Night Light will turn on when it gets dark in your room and stay on until morning or until you turn on the main lights in your room.
profile.reviewText:
First, I was looking for night-only LED motion sensor night lights.  and sometimes the 'recommendations' and things others have bought after looking at the right product, are not a good match.  that happened here - my bad - but these are on when it's dark, no motion sensor.  AND THEY ARE INSANELY BRIGHT. SO, if that is what you want, these are a good buy.

I on the other hand cannot justify return fright on them and need to find them a new home - now that my motion sensor version of a different brand has arrived.  I like that motion sensor light in the bathroom at night, the whole purpose is NOT to be blinded by the lights for that middle of the night trip.
profile.summary: BLINDED BY THE LIGHT!!

profile.description: The item includes 4pcs dimmable 6W ST18 E26/E27 Medium Screw Base Edison LED Vintage Antique Filament Bulb, Squirrel Cage Nostalgic Tungsten Filament Replacement Incandescent Bulbs. 100-130V AC input voltage, warm white 2700k and low power consumption. Widely used for Bistro Lights, Large Tents, Decorative Wedding Lights, Decorative Light Strands, Commercial Light Strings, Chandeliers and Ornamental Fixtures.
profile.reviewText:
LOVE THEM! My husband is an LED fanatic, so when I decided I wanted to use Edison bulbs...  I was sure I was going to be told no!  But these have the right look, and the LED makes him happy too.  Well, and me, I hate our electric bill!  We used these in a rough wood light fixture we made with bulb cages and it is AWESOME!  They are plenty bright, but they do have the yellow cast to them... almost wish they had less yellow cast to them, but that is what makes them very much like the authentic old tyme bulbs that they looks like.

Highly recommend this product, we have been using them for about a month now. Very happy.
profile.summary: The real deal Edison bulb with old tyme glow and modern age energy efficiency!

profile.description: Natural Balance Alpha Grain-Free Chicken, Turkey Meal, and Duck Formula for Cats is a grain-free blend of multiple, high quality proteins, fruits and vegetables. Natural Balance has balanced your cat's nutritional needs with a formula that goes back to the grain-free benefits of the wild. A unique combination of proteins combined with the novel source of garbanzo beans to provide a balanced diet for your cat's overall well-being. Grain-free carbohydrate sources, like sweet potatoes, provide the energy your cat needs to thrive in their natural form. Prebiotics feed the beneficial bacteria that reside in a healthy digestive tract so that your cat can maintain optimal digestion. In addition to the legume garbanzo beans, an excellent source of fiber and protein, Natural Balance has also added pumpkin, cranberries and blueberries to help your cat achieve a harmonious balance that is both healthy and delicious. Garden greens have also been added to satisfy your cat's cravings. Complete and balanced for all breeds, from kittens to adults. Size: 10-Pound.
profile.reviewText:
I have a super sensitive cat...  and I have mixed this 50/50 with the other limited ingredient food that he seems to handle well, and I'm not having the best results.  But it's spring and maybe hairballs are a factor, but I may have to go back to the more expensive one.  it's a struggle to deal with a puking cat all the time, and I've messed around with this for 5 years now.

If you have a diet sensitive cat, I urge you to think through the cost of adding more.  With 5 of them in the house it becomes VERY expensive to feed the high quality grain free foods, but I'd be in a padded cell if I tried to feed it to one and not the others!
profile.summary: Best Price I've found on grain free...

profile.description: This mesh task chair provides exceptional support to the hard-working professionals in your office.Transparent mesh across the back allows air to circulate, keeping you cool no matter how high the pressure gets. Built-in lumbar support helps prevent back strain and muscle fatigue. The swivel seat is padded with three-inches of CA117 fire retardant foam and covered with black mesh upholstery. Its waterfall edge is designed to relieve pressure and promote healthy blood flow to your legs. Raise and lower the seat using the pneumatic seat height adjustment lever, conveniently located under the seat. Turn the tilt tension adjustment knob to increase or decrease the amount of force needed to rock or recline. Lock the seat in place with the tilt lock mechanism. Padded armrests take pressure off your shoulders and neck, and flip up and out of the way, as needed. The heavy-duty, nylon base with dual wheel casters makes it easy to roll across the floor.Whether it's a day filled with meetings or you're working to beat a tight deadline, this stylish chair will keep you cool and comfortable throughout your busy day.
profile.reviewText:
In spite of the mixed reviews I ordered, and within 10 days I can already tell this is a HUGE MISTAKE. The seat tilts to the left, which makes this a TERRIBLE chair for a full time work situation. I am a larger person, but not huge...  normally I look for something 'weight rated' but have been on a more limited budget, and have now WASTED $100.  I find the seat padding adequate and LOVE the arms that lift up for varied positions during the day... but the lumbar support portion is too low on me as well, at my hips more than my lower back.

Maybe chairs that NEED to fit and perform well just can't be bought online??  Wishing I had not done this.

I have to find out how on earth it can be returned, once assembled, that seems like an impossible task, the seat and wheels are NOT designed to come apart again.
profile.summary: Cheap quality, LEANS TO THE LEFT within a weeks time...  lumbar support is at my hips, not low back.  EPIC FAIL.

profile.description: The steel framed Platform Bed 2000 by Zinus features wooden slats that provide strong support for your memory foam, latex, or spring mattress. Low profile 10 inch height with 7 inches of clearance under the frame. Openings in two of the legs allow for attaching a headboard to this Platform bed. The Platform Bed 2000 provides stylish and strong support for your mattress. The stickers have arrows that are to be matched. Once matched, the frame will come together perfectly
profile.reviewText:
Having an XXL sized teen boy, I was looking for something STURDY and although i wish this was a little higher off the ground, this fits the requirements.  We looked at platforms of all types and found many rated for 300-400 pounds maximum, which for queen size is not allowing much weight per person.  My son is already 6'4" and 300 pounds at 15......  SO, knowing how teems 'flop' into bed, etc.  I was looking for more than the average rating and this accomplishes that!!

Per other reviews, YES... we had a challenge with the ends of some of the metal tubes being bent or crimped.  We had to pound out a couple ends to get them to slide together but it was not insurmountable and everything fit snugly together and the 'slat system' sets into place and stays in place with the velcro adhesion strip.  We did NOT peel the 'anti slide' strip off the top of a couple of the slats to 'adhere' the mattress to the slats as we are using a memory foam mattress with this and did not want to risk damage to the mattress.
profile.summary: In spite of a few 'less than perfect' aspects, 5 stars for it's sheer strength and sturdiness. Read details.

profile.description: Save energy and money with the ultra brite motion-activated LED light from GE. This Motion-Sensing night light automatically turns on when motion is sensed, up to 25 feet away, and turns off after 90 seconds of no activity. The light's Motion-Sensing and light-sensing technology means no wasted light, helping to keep your energy bills low by using just pennies worth of electricity per year. The energy-efficient GE ultra brite motion-activated LED light features 40-lumen, long-life LED bulbs that stay white and bright, while always being cool to the touch. This light is intended for indoor use and will only operate in low-light conditions. This product is UL listed and backed by a limited-lifetime warranty.
profile.reviewText:
I've had three different motion sensor 'night lights' like this...  and we opted for this one to have a hallway lit at the bottom of our basement stairs so that didn't have to turn on a lot of lights just to get to another room....  SO we were really hoping for the 25' sensor ability... and are not impressed.  From STRAIGHT AHEAD it MAY be close to 20' distance when it turns on, but from the side the sensor only picks up about 6' away and from above, even straight on it is a max of about 10'.  This one is much brighter than the other that we were comparing it to, so we appreciated that...  but if we were using in the bathroom for our master bedroom we would have been trading for a dimmer version.

Long and short of it, depends on what you want from it how well you'll like this.  I gave it 4 stars due to the brightness and the fact that it picks up the 'above' and straight ahead even 10' away which is about as good as I hoped, but I'm not thrilled since when I'm returning to go up the stairs it's doesn't detect I'm there until I'm much closer.  The one with the "round bubble" sensor in the front picks up the side distance at least 12' away...  so I like that even though the other distance isn't any more and the light isn't nearly as bright.

All of these that I have tried leave the light on for about 60 seconds after it stops sensing motion, which is fine.  I wish we could set the one in our master bath for a bit longer...  but it works to waive my hand if I need light longer than 1 minute.  ;-)

profile.description: Fresh green foliage reaches 8 to 12 feet tall, topped by long, thick silky-white "featherdusters" that bloom in late-summer and last for months! Pampas ornamental grass grows fairly fast, so is an ideal choice for filling in large, barren landscapes. It will also grow thick creating an effective privacy screen, wind break or sound barrier. Its long, graceful blades and delightfully fluffy pannicles (flower plumes) are beautiful. Unsurpassed for glorious texture and color in the landscape, this classic White Pampas Grass (Cortaderia Selloana) is the star of any garden it graces! The sturdy, fresh-green bloomstalks reach anywhere from 8 to 12 feet tall, capped by enormous snowy "featherdusters!" Like most ornamental grasses, pampas grass is pest-resistant. It is also highly drought-resistant and, once established, never needs watering. It will grow in most soils with hardly any work. Low to no maintenance. You can shear ornamental grasses each winter so that new growth comes out clean in Spring. You can do this every other year or less often if you like. However, you don't need to do any of that if you don't want to. The worst that will happen is your pampas grasses will look a little unkept and won't have a manicured look.

input: Generate the review text written by a reviewer who has a given an overall rating of "1.0" for a product with description "Lou Reed - Magic And Loss - Cd". The summary of the review text is "Genius Or Depressing Mess - Take Your Pick".
output: Magic And Loss is either Lou Reed's best or worst album depending on your taste ,but I can't listen to it. I owned it on cassette, and I'm not exactly sure where it is now. I played it in my car stereo one Sunday on the way to band practice, and found it so depressing, I wanted to throw it out the window, and swore I would NEVER play it again. For any record to bring these feelings from someone makes it almost a work of true creative genius just for that shock value, which Mr. Reed has been good at for all of his career. On the other hand you could say it's so depressing that the entertainment value is nil. Makes Berlin look like a Sunday picnic.

profile.description: CD
profile.reviewText: This is one of the most influential metal albums ever made. No rock collection is complete without this. "Sad Wings" was the next step in metal after the initial wave of Sabbath, Purple, and Uriah  Heep. Iron Maiden, Mercyful Fate, Metallica, Fates Warning and virtually all  of later progressive metal would be inconceivable had this record never  been made. Great writing, playing,changes in tempo, texture, and mood  throughout all the brilliant compositions. The opener "Victim Of  Changes" is THE Essential metal song. Halford's vocal range is  astounding throughout. His style re-invents the metal vocalist here. The  two guitar onslaught of Tipton and Downing is staggering and blazes the  trail for Hammett and Hetfield, Denner and Sherman, and virtually any heavy  band to come that would feature two axe slingers. This record commercially  was criminally ignored in it's time, but like all great underground works,  those who bought it were influenced and formed bands. Today's younger set  may be a little mystified by the stone age production, but any young  musician wanting to attempt the heavy stuff should begin here.
profile.summary: Modern Metal Starts Here

profile.reviewText: To me, UK became a lot less interesting once Alan Holdsworth and Bill Bruford exited. I was not ever a big fan of the Danger Money LP. It seemed like John Wetton was just leading the band down a sappy commercial road, which is especially apparent on the newer tracks on Night After Night, that he would further pursue with Asia. And musically they were becoming little more than a minor league ELP with the absense of a guitarist. I don't need to hear guitar with every band I listen to,but in this case it's tough not to miss Holdsworth (one of the best) when he has played with a better line-up of the band. Jobson does a commendable job covering some former guitar lines on keys, but really they should have gotten another guitarist especially for live shows. Bozzio is a great drummer too; I just prefer Bruford's style. He and Wetton are in my opinion the greatest rhythm section ever, going back to their association in King Crimson. If you really want to hear UK at their best live, seek out the out of print (pulled because Jobson didn't approve the release)Concert Classics release(I've got It !), which is far superior and features Bruford and Holdsworth and does contain material that made it to Danger Money(with their prescence it could have been almost as great as the debut LP,as this recording proves) as well as the greats from the debut.
profile.summary: Look For Concert Classics Instead

profile.reviewText: I was skeptical about even getting a DVD player,while I enjoy films and the occasional concert footage,I'm more of an audio than visual enthusist. My new computer had a DVD drive,so I wanted to check it out. Being a Crimson fan and knowing that they had released the first concert film exclusively conceived as a DVD my choice of a first purchase was simple. This performance by the double trio line-up blew my mind almost the same way the 80's video release The Noise-Live In Frejus had years before. With a six piece Crimson it was difficult to know "who was playing what" without actually seeing them do it,making this a revelation as a viewing experience for the Crimhead who missed seeing them live. The extra are OK; it's fun piecing together different players from various eras doing "Schizoid Man",but the show is the real meat.

profile.reviewText: Closely in league stylistically, and production wise with his more well known Trout Mask Replica LP, Decals is another volume of essential Beefheart. Some parts are a little more accessible than Trout Mask("Woe- Is- Uh- Me- Bop","Doctor Dark","Smithsonian Institute Blues(The Big Dig)")and point towards things to come (Clear Spot);while other moments test the avante-garde noise threshold of even the most advanced ears ("Japan In A Dishpan","Flash Gordon's Ape"). Tragically the more affordable domestic CD release of this is long out of print and this expensive import available here and the very limited edition 180 gram vinyl re-issue from Rhino (licensed from Warner-Reprise) are all that remain available. This classic Beefheart gem really needs to stay in print domestically and be accessible to the younger set who could learn so much from the master.
profile.summary: An Important Album From A Fabulous Artist

profile.description: REMASTERED : Huge 1979 album featuring "I Was Made For Lovin' You" & "Sure Know Something" plus a cover of The Rolling Stones '2000 Man'.
profile.reviewText: Though overall not quite in the league with their 4 and 5 star albums. Dynasty certainly has some fine Kiss moments. To kick things off, "I Was Made For Lovin' You", the band's biggest hit(yes it did better than "Beth" and 'Rock And Roll All Nite"-do the homework),and a fabulous rock/disco crossover tune from the same era of The Stones "Miss You", Blondie's "Heart Of Glass", and Rod Stewart's "Do Ya Think I'm Sexy." This was a great tune that fit "the times", something Kiss always strived for, to stay current while retaining their sound. Paul Stanley checks in with two more brilliant cuts, the near hit follow up "Sure Know Something", and the overlooked "Magic Touch".There are no less than three Ace Frehley cuts including The Stones cover "2000 Man",actually better than the original version, as well as his bratty "Hard Times" and the cool album closer "Save Your Love", one of those Kiss sleepers in the same league with Hotter Than Hell's "Strange Ways." Peter Criss' "Dirty Livin'" is a good dance floor thumper, and the only cut he played on in the studio(Anton Fig did the rest-Criss was in an accident and had difficulty drumming for some time). The only downers are two weak Simmons cuts, "Charisma" and "X-Ray Eyes" which sound like Love Gun leftovers, and typical of some of his "half interested" output of the 80's to come, where the band practically took a back seat (he admits) to his other activities. Maybe a 3 1/2 is more like it.
profile.summary: Better Than You Think

profile.description: The last studio effort from their Warner Bros. era, this 1975 LP nearly went Top 40 and features the late, great Tommy Bolin on guitar. Includes Comin' Home; Lady Luck; Dealer; Love Child; Drifter , and more!
profile.reviewText: I admit, on my first couple of listens I thought this Blackmoreless Purple wasn't quite right, but hey the band evolved into something a little different and Bolin was a guitar ace in his own right. There is some smokin' material here and it's a shame Bolin didn't live to follow this up. A vastly underrated album, as is the whole Coverdale/Hughes Purple era(how about an expanded version of Made In Europe ?), personally my favorite, though Stormbringer is a big dissappointment. This is the 2nd best Coverdale/Hughes material to the masterful Burn. If you passed it up years ago or didn't give it a good listen the first time around, pull this out and you'll be rewarded with a fresh listening experience. Just keep an open mind!!
