profile.description: Elegance, class and sophistication
profile.reviewText: I still can't believe how this thing unfolded out of the box and had the arm rests zipped inside, making this quite a compact delivery.  The assembly was straightforward and the end result is quite comfortable seating.  The bottom cushion is nice and springy and provides nice support.  The varying levels the back rests ratchet to make for varied options to sit however is comfortable for you.  Having support bars that rotate out of the back of the couch for support when it's being used flat is a nice touch. Makes the flat position much more stable and avoids tipping.  All-in-all a very simple way to get a good value futon/couch to your home.  This isn't plush designer furniture, but it is functional, comfortable and a great value.
profile.summary: This isn't plush designer furniture, but it is functional, comfortable and a great value.

profile.description: Secure closure without using tape. Strong, durable hand holes for comfortable moving and lifting. FastFold quick and easy assembly. No tape required - lid locks into place for secure closure. Easy to break down and store flat until ready for reuse. All boxes constructed from strong 32 ECT C-Flute Kraft corrugated board.
profile.reviewText:
How does one review a box?  Let's see:  does it take the shape of a box and carry things?  YES.  Does it do so easily with very little set up and no tape needed?  YES.  Is it sturdy and easy to carry?  YES.  Then I guess it is a 5-star box!

I have to admit, I have never priced boxes before - preferring to scrounge around and take whatever boxes were at work, the store etc.  But, when you get down to the several boxes worth of stuff you want to be sure are taken care of - it's probably a good idea to invest in a few quality boxes.  These are sturdy and easily break down to use again (or give to a friend who is moving).
profile.summary: What can I say?  They work and are EASY.

profile.description: This intelligent & practical storage design is well suited for any front hallway, mudroom or home office. The three storage compartments are ideal for hats, gloves and schoolbooks while four large hooks accommodate coats & jackets. Comes with our easy to install, two-piece hanging rail system and is an ideal companion piece for the Cubbie Bench. Constructed from a combination of high quality, laminated composite woods with an attractively profiled MDF top.
profile.reviewText: This is a joint review of the Sonoma Console unit Prepac Sonoma Black Living Room Console and the Cubbie Shelf unitPrepac Sonoma Black Entryway Cubbie Shelf. I bought this combo for my entryway/foyer. I have three kids and this console has three open cubbies under three drawers and the cubbie shelf has three cubbies and four coat hangers. A perfect organization idea. The kids each have their drop-off areas for school bags and books and I have a functional piece of furniture that didn't cost an arm and a leg. The Cubbie Shelf Unit provides hooks for hats, coats and/or keys and the two pieces together provide an impressive amount of room for storage and display. Of course, this is not fine handcrafted wood furniture. It took a little time to assemble and is bound to chip and wear more rapidly than a solid wood console. But this is a fraction of the cost of similar items and - did I mention I have three kids using this?? I would not want my $2000 storage unit absorbing the daily abuse of 3 school children! I'll take abuse to a sub-$200 unit and if it last 2 or three years and still looks OK, I've made out on the deal (and stressed a lot less!). If you are careful putting it together, I can not see why this wouldn't serve as perfectly well as an "adult" piece of furniture as it does for how I'm using it with the kids. The drawers hold a fair amount too and are on rails and slide nicely. Overall a very good value!
profile.summary: Good value and function

profile.description: Gillette; body wash; shampoo; face wash; soap; bar soap; liquid soap; cleanser; skin hydrator
profile.reviewText:
The Gillette Bodywash has a very clean scent.  At first it didn't seem "manly" enough, but I realized the scent wasn't flowery but more a clean smell.  Kind of like standing outside your house near the dryer vent when the dryer is running with some fabric softener sheets in the load.

The bodywash lathers up nicely and you don't need a ton to get the job done.  As for "hydration", it does not dry my skin and seems to work as advertised.  It rinses off and does not leave you feeling like there is something still on you (like some "moisturizing" or "hydrating" washes do).

So - if a dryer vent is a scent you enjoy - I recommend this!  If not - try another scent.
profile.summary: Nice, fresh scent.  Good lather.

profile.description: Unique two-in-one, smudge-resistant eraser lets user erase twice as many mistakes. Lead-optimizing technology for maximum write life from each lead. Strong #2 leads, perfect for standardized tests. Comfort grip for precise control.
profile.reviewText:
This is an excellent value with 4 pencils, extra lead and extra erasers.  The pencils have a solid/thick enough build to hold comfortably and don't leave me with hand cramps trying to grasp the typical skinny pencil.  Extra erasers are nothing new in a mechanical pencil - but how easy it is to flip the eraser around to use the second one, is new (at least to me!).  The eraser slides in and clips, so when you are in need of the second eraser, you simply press the lever to slide out the eraser and flip it over.  I know in previous iterations of pencils I've had, once the eraser is down to even with the plastic you need to take a paper clip (or some other prying device) and get the old eraser out and then wedge in another.  This is much easier and you have that back-up eraser on board already.

With no flaws (it's a pencil - it writes and it's comfortable!), and a few nice features, this is a 5-star product.
profile.summary: Substantial feel (and an extra eraser on board)

profile.description: The ultimate food preparation and handling gloves. Use the Aura Grill Gloves to protect your hands and avoid accidents with our insulated and waterproof 5-fingered grip gloves for all your cooking and grilling needs! Handle roasts right off the grill or to remove hot pans from your oven. Move vegetables like corn on the cob and skewers with ease. No more clumsy and loose towels, cloth mitts that fall apart or awkward grippers! The FDA-approved, BPA-free silicone used in our gloves is perfect for handling raw or uncooked foods and is waterproof and dishwasher safe. Food, oils, char and stains wash right off. Protect your hands better than traditional oven mitts or potholders. Aura Grill Gloves withstand temperatures up to 425 degrees! Includes 1 pair of heat-resistant, waterproof, silicone grip gloves.
profile.reviewText:
Good protection from grill heat and a step up to oven *glove* from oven *mitt*.  These protect well for your typical grill use and allow a little more dexterity in handling things like skewers or a rogue hot dog here and there.  My wife thought they looked a little skimpy for typical oven mitt duty on dishes from the oven - but they have proven up to the task.  Easy to pull trays of roasted veggies or muffin tins out with no threat of a burn.

The one thing I am surprised at is the size.  They are fairly bulky yet not so easy to get on my average sized male hands.  It might be because I associate oven mitts with being easy to slip on and off and expected the same here.  But it's not that they have to get on all your fingers, it's that the fingers are a little snug.

On a completely unimportant and random note - if your kids put them on and press down on their legs with them on, they leave a pattern of hearts all over where they were pressing! :)
profile.summary: Upgrade from the mitt!

profile.description: Perfect for packing a small apartment or dorm room! Convenient, all-in-one moving essentials kit including 8 small and 6 medium moving boxes with no-tape box assembly, lift-off lids and easy-carry handles, 4 rolls of bubble wrap, 1 roll of packing tape and 1 permanent black marker.
profile.reviewText: This is the ease and quality you'd expect from Bankers Box with a few extras for convenience sake.  I do not have the small apartment this would be perfect for so I can't speak to how well the overall set captures typical small movers' needs.  But I can say these are good sized boxes to get your books (small boxes) and photo albums and knick knacks (medium) packed away with ease.  In my experience, I'd call these "mid-level" boxes.  I've worked with cheaper boxes that feel like they'll fall apart and I've used the heavy duty ones.  These boxes won't support a full load of textbooks, but will take a reasonable load.  You'll notice the items I mentioned didn't need much bubble wrap.  That's a good thing, because there isn't a ton.  If you're packing glasses or dishes or the like, you're probably best off getting moving sets specifically for that purpose anyway, but you won't find enough protection here.  The marker is good (can't have enough of them when moving) and the tape is adequate.  You might want an entry level tape with a dispenser at your local supermarket to ease the cutting hassles though.  Overall, a good variety which adds to the already decent value.
profile.summary: A good (very basic) set

profile.description: An open, reclined shape with thin, brushed steel legs, the Kendrick chair lightens up contemporary style with airy ambiance. Smooth gentle curves are both modern and industrial. The beauty of this collection lies in its simplicity. Rich texture in a woven charcoal grey fabric provides an interesting variation to a the sleek, smooth steel base. Made with CA117 foam - a flexible polyurethane foam that will meet the component combustibility requirements of the California Bureau of Home Furnishings. Overall dimensions: 37-inch height, 33-inch width and a 30.5-inch depth. Other dimensions: Interior seat width: 22.5-Inch. Seat depth: 21-Inch. Seat height: 19.5-Inch. Back height: 26.25-Inch. Clearance: 10.75-Inch. Removable leg frame: 24-Inch long, 26-inch width and 11.25-inch height. Assembly required.
profile.reviewText:
First things first - you've got to like the style and be looking for a firm sitting/reading chair.  This is not a slouchy, TV binge watching chair.  This is a sit with good posture and have some support while you read or have a cup of coffee chair.  We got this to go in our bedroom as an occasional sitting chair, or reading chair.  It spent its first few weeks in our living room being ignored by all children looking to slump into a cushy seat.

It is a good looking chair (again, if that's the style you're after - it's very "like it or hate it") and it was pretty quick and easy to assemble the legs and get to sitting.  A pair of these would make a nice sitting nook at a reasonable price.
profile.summary: A firm, stylish option for a sitting/reading nook

profile.description: The perfect addition to a living room or den, this unit incorporates three drawers for lots of storage, and at 16 inches deep, is a great depth for decorative dishes, books and baskets. Features include a profiled top, side moldings and an arched kick plate, as well as solid brushed nickel knobs and a drawer that run on smooth, all-metal roller glides with built-in safety stops.
profile.reviewText: This is a joint review of the Sonoma Console unit Prepac Sonoma Black Living Room Console and the Cubbie Shelf unit Prepac Sonoma Black Entryway Cubbie Shelf. I bought this combo for my entryway/foyer. I have three kids and this console has three open cubbies under three drawers and the cubbie shelf has three cubbies and four coat hangers. A perfect organization idea. The kids each have their drop-off areas for school bags and books and I have a functional piece of furniture that didn't cost an arm and a leg. The Cubbie Shelf Unit provides hooks for hats, coats and/or keys and the two pieces together provide an impressive amount of room for storage and display. Of course, this is not fine handcrafted wood furniture. It took a little time to assemble and is bound to chip and wear more rapidly than a solid wood console. But this is a fraction of the cost of similar items and - did I mention I have three kids using this?? I would not want my $2000 storage unit absorbing the daily abuse of 3 school children! I'll take abuse to a sub-$200 unit and if it last 2 or three years and still looks OK, I've made out on the deal (and stressed a lot less!). If you are careful putting it together, I can not see why this wouldn't serve as perfectly well as an "adult" piece of furniture as it does for how I'm using it with the kids. The drawers hold a fair amount too and are on rails and slide nicely. Overall a very good value!
profile.summary: Good value and function

profile.description: Sturdy Good Looks - Grab Hold of your Style - Take control of your image with this eye-catching case. The raised hexagonal pattern accentuates the cases layers while creating a surface that is easy to grip. Max Grip, Max Protection The thin, yet durable material is a stylish way to keep your iPod's surface free of scratches and scuffs, without adding extra bulk.
profile.reviewText: This case is not for the meek!  It is bold and colorful and will stand out in a crowd!  It fits snugly and adds a nice amount of protection against scratches and scuffs and probably would handle a minor drop, but this is not an impact case by any means.  The raised rubber around the screen allows face down placement without screen damage and the the case makes the iTouch much easier to hold with its texture.  It looks and feels like a quality case.  If the style suits you, this is a good case.  The biggest drawback I see is the case is too thick around the docking port to dock without removing the case.  If you rarely dock than this isn't an issue, but for me this is a huge con.
profile.summary: Decent protection for reasonable added bulk

profile.description: 5512226 Features: -Contraption Lab Kit.-Contains hook and loop backer board with stand.-Unlimited configurations.-Develops skills of the scientific method- inquiry, hypothesis and testing. Includes: -Includes components such as cannon with flying pig, ore car, two curved tracks, four long tracks, six short tracks, two gears, wavy track and stairs.-Also includes plunger lever, steam pipe, toilet, chicken coop, boot-and-hand lever and trashcan.
profile.reviewText: My son, aged 8 (and to a lesser extent his older sisters) had a good time putting contraptions together and seeing what they could come up with.  Sometimes they worked, usually they didn't.  It just seems like everything needs to be perfectly placed and in many cases you still don't get the result you wanted.  The velcro gripping to the board is strong, but unfortunately, it also stick to the rug and it great for slicing toes and yanking up without said velcro.  This make the toy short lived.  It also isn't very friendly to store since you have to take it completely apart to fit into anything "normal game-sized".  It's a fun idea, and I can't say it was a disaster, it just wasn't used very much after the initial few attempts weren't met with a lot of success.  Combine that with broken pieces and I can't really recommend this.
profile.summary: A good idea - cheaply executed

profile.description: Brawny Dine-A-Cloth FLAX Cloths are unique because they are made using flax fiber1, which creates a naturally strong, absorbent and sustainable cleaning cloth designed to handle everything from front-of-house wiping (Bussing and Bar Towel) to back-of-house cleaning (Food Preparation and Chef Towel). Brawny Dine-A-Cloth FLAX Cloths make a perfect addition to our full line of foodservice wiper solutions, giving you an option for any and every cleaning task. 1 85% flax, 15% reconstituted cellulose fibers
profile.reviewText:
While made for a more industrial setting, these cloths pack quite a punch at home as well.  I was raised by a mother that rinsed "regular" paper towels for repeat usage, so having a cloth that can actually stand up to repeated rinsings makes me feel smarter about waste while actually having a towel that works multiple times.  She rinsed to save money.  I rinse to save money and not waste a roll of paper towels a day.  In a family of 9 there are many, many occasions to wipe things up.  You got jelly or something really sticky on the counter?  Regular and throw it away!  Typical counter/table wipe down?  Use one of these over and over!  Tough grill pan that will turn your cloth black or render a paper towel useless?  Use of on these for scrubbing and let it take the brunt.  Keep your dishcloths whiter and reduce laundry.  I wiped down every cabinet in the kitchen with just one of these towels.

Overall, a very tough towel that can stand up to repeat usage.  Seems like it will net out as less waste and less cost in the long run.
profile.summary: Seems like it will net out as less waste and less cost in the long run.

profile.description: Heres an exceptional way to store your woodworking tools, chisels, bits, screwdrivers, knives, and more. This Bora Pocket Tool Roll comes with 11 pockets, ranging in size from 3/8 to 2 1/4, allowing it to hold all of your precision tools, and keep them organized. The solid nylon and leather construction will last for years, and the sleeve pockets are strong, keeping everything safe and sound. True to its name, the tool roll rolls up, and the easy open-and-close hook and loop belt fastens it tight. Theres even a metal grommet to hang it on your pegboard, meaning all of your important finishing tools are always right where you need them. An excellent piece of Bora quality, no shop or garage is complete without one.
profile.reviewText: This is a handy little "nice to have" among all the tool storage options out there.  If you have a set of chisels, larger/wider drill bits, screwdriver or a combination of these, this will get them all in one place and rolled up in a secure, fairly durable package.  I'd give it 5-stars for usability and simplicity.  However, I dock this one star - in my opinion - for practicality.  Don't get me wrong, it's simple and might be exactly what you need for tool transport.  I, however, prefer drawers/bins, so I can see the tools and grab the one I need without unrolling stored tools.  If I needed to travel with a set of specific tools - this is perfect!  If I had a set of, say, chisels, then storing them all in one roll and knowing where they are would be perfect!  All in all, a good option to have to travel or sort sets.
profile.summary: A "nice to have" that is really nice to have.

profile.description: The Dragonwing girlgear Girls Seamless Racerback Sports Bra provides great support, comfort, and style. It is made of high performance yarn for super softness. Tag-free to eliminate chafing with a wide bottom band so it doesn't ride up. Dragonwing girlgear is performance wear for girls aged 8-17, and its made for all the sports they play: soccer, lacrosse, softball, field hockey, basketball, running, skiing, yoga, equestrian and many more. Give your girl the freedom and confidence to focus on the competition, skills, and teamwork of the sports she loves, empowering her to playand beher best.
profile.reviewText:
My daughter (age 14 and big for her age), fit fine in the size large and reported that it fit well and supported well.  She plays volleyball and had no issues with the bra.  However, she wasn't a huge fan of the material.  Not sure if it's a personal taste thing, but maybe the "fine gauge yarn for super softness" was such a change from normal fabric that she wasn't used to it?  It won't stop her from using it and she may grow to love it when used to it.  I'd say it's stylish, but I don't want anyone else seeing it so that's not a selling point for me ;)

A quality product with nice little touches to differentiate it (soft, anti-chafing, wicking).
profile.summary: Good fit/support - "weird" material

profile.description:
Jack Irish (Guy Pearce) is a man getting his life back together again. A former criminal lawyer whose world imploded, he now spends his days as a part-time investigator, debt collector, apprentice cabinet maker, punter and sometime lover the complete man really. An expert in finding those who don t want to be found dead or alive, Jack helps out his mates while avoiding the past. That is until the past finds him... 


Bad Debts and Black Tide 2 Disc Set
profile.reviewText: After a slow yet interesting first episode I wasn't sure I'd bother with the second.  But Jack is cool enough to want to see what else he gets into; brooding enough to not be a complete cliche; and the setting was different enough to keep me interested.  I am glad I watched the second episode.  While just as slow - probably even more plodding - it added a lot of humor and the story-line was a fun, twisty ride.  Maybe, it's my American TV sensibilities, but I feel that these "feature length episodes" could be easily wrapped up in an hour.  The moody wandering around to musical interludes are about 10 minutes of each episode.  I prefer this old school sleuthing (Jack says he's pre-Google) over today's attention deficit CSI cutaways, but this is just a little too slow for me.
profile.summary: Interesting, good characters and story, but too slow for me.

profile.description: Color Outside the Lines Design + Function Step away from the ordinary with an iPod case that blends a sense of sharp design and lifestyle elements with effective device protection. The polycarbonate layered structure makes it easy to grip and the metallic graphics will enhance your overall sense of style. Protection that Fits: The thin, yet durable material is a stylish way to keep your iPod's surface free of scratches and scuffs, without adding extra bulk.
profile.reviewText:
I'll start off by saying this case is NOT about protection.  Many reviews center around the fact that isn't going to protect your iTouch.  Even though the product description promises "effective device protection" it later tempers that by noting it's really only meant to "keep your iPod's surface free of scratches and scuffs".  And I would add that "surface" means the BACK of the iTouch not the screen!  So why did I give it 4-Stars?  Because the case does several other things well and I wasn't looking maximum protection.  If you want maximum protection, look elsewhere - this is a 2-star case at best.  If you want protection from scuffs, a textured case to make holding the device more comfortable, and a fairly stylish look than this is a 4-star case.  It is thin enough to allow docking on most of my devices which is a huge plus to me.

BOTTOM LINE: If you're looking for maximum protection, look elsewhere.  Looking for a little style and a scuff prevention?  This is your case.
profile.summary: Good for what it's meant to be

profile.description: The Vault for iPad Air is crafted with the same tried-and-true DNA found in all Pelican products. Providing an ultimate suit of armor without sacrificing device functionality, the slim, lightweight CE2180 Pelican ProGear Vault is dustproof, water resistant, shock-absorbent and drop-tested to ensure that a mobile device can handle an active lifestyle, anywhere. Made with engineering-grade aluminum, it is designed to provide vital defense from wind-driven rain, snow and dust - and with its elastomeric copolymer rubber interior to expertly absorb impact, the case can handle a four-foot drop unscathed. As versatile as it is defensive, the Vault for iPad mini protects tablets in a variety of ways: with the lid closed, it prevents impact damage to the screen. Open, the lid provides the freedom of cover-free use, an impact absorbing case (Meets Military Specification MIL-STD-810G) and a protective seal against water and dust (IP54 rated). Additionally, users can flip the cover over the back of the case to use with multiple viewing angles. The product boasts a water-resistant membrane to cover the microphone(s) and speakers, while still providing users with the utmost of high-fidelity audio. Additional features include optical-grade, Dragontrail glass on the rear camera area as well as a full-enclosure design. The CE2180 Vault for iPad Air is backed by a lifetime guarantee, comes in black with gray accents or gray with white accents.
profile.reviewText: This is one heck of a tough, "trouble-resistant" case.  I got it with the intent to swap out cases for road trips or vacations to ensure travel (and beach weather and moisture, etc.) didn't harm the iPad.  When I saw the process to put the case on - 15 very small screws - I realized this wasn't going to be a case to switch back and forth to.  We typically use a more "nimble" case that allows easier/lighter access to all controls and ports since this one is pretty hefty, but will continue to use this as a travel case to guard against the rigors of travel.  We'll just be sure to leave enough time - and patience - to handle all those screws!
profile.summary: Very protective - but requires "commitment"!

profile.description: Its one thing to make a nutritious pet food; its another to create one thats perfectly balanced. Hills Ideal Balance dry dog food with natural chicken and brown rice contains a blend of natural ingredients plus vitamins, minerals and amino acids that are perfectly balanced to provide your dog complete nutrition. This dry food for dogs contains real chicken as the #1 ingredient. This lean protein helps your dog stay slim and trim. It includes fruits and vegetables to support energy and boost natural defenses, brown rice for healthy digestion, and flaxseed to improve skin and coat. Hills developed Ideal Balance dry dog food without corn, wheat or soy, and it contains no artificial colors, flavors or preservatives. *Hills 100% Satisfaction Guarantee: We're confident your pet will enjoy Hill's Ideal Balance foods. We're so confident that we offer a 100% money-back guarantee. If you are unsatisfied for any reason, return the unused portion to Amazon for a full refund or replacement. For more information on returning an Amazon purchased product, visit the Amazon returns center.
profile.reviewText: It's hard to speak to the longer term health benefits after only a few weeks of feeding our dog this "healthy" option, but there are definitely some positives.  She likes this food and had no troubles switching over from a "lesser" (which probably means tastier - if less healthy) brand.  This is saying something because this dog will eat most anything dropped by the kitchen table UNLESS it's green.  She wouldn't eat broccoli if it were smothered in bacon grease - and now she's getting some fruits and vegetables in her food.  Also, we feel pretty confident that the occasional rashes she was getting were a result of her old food.  These have not surfaced since being on the Hill's alone.  It's a tough call to pay such a premium price, but I think we'll stick with this or a similar "healthy" variety rather than revert back to the cheap stuff.
profile.summary: Eats it without hesitation

profile.description: The future of lighting is here with the GE Lighting 69730 Energy Smart LED 11 watt (60 Watt equivalent) 800-Lumen A19 Dimmable Light Bulb. Unlike standard incandescents, GE Energy Smart LED general purpose bulbs last up to 15,000 hours--more than a decade at 3 hours per day use and equal to 15 incandescents. They also use 75% less energy, making them a brilliant idea for your budget. And, GE Energy Smart LED bulbs provide soft white light instantly while fitting in many of the same fixtures as standard incandescent bulbs. Make the change to GE Energy Smart LED general purpose bulbs today.
profile.reviewText: My first thought was LED = bright.  I pictured those little keychain flashlights that light up a city block with just three LEDs (ok I'm exaggerating, but they ARE bright).  This bulb is not made to be stark factory floor lighting.  It's got a feel very similar to the bulb it replaced - and frankly nicer than some slow to brighten CFLs.  If this bulb lasts anywhere near the lifespan (over a decade!?), that it claims, it is 5 stars for sure.  Right now, I have to go 4 stars because I can't afford to go around to every light fixture in the house with a $17 bulb, but I'm thinking as they die, they may be replaced with LED bulbs.
profile.summary: I expected harsh and bright - I got better than that

profile.description: The Ergorapido lithium ion brushroll clean Xtra 2-in-1 cordless offers two vacuums in one stylish design for cleaning on and above your bare floors. The 14.4V lithium ion battery gives you high performance for optimal cleaning performance, a long run time and fast charge. Electrolux patented self-cleaning brushroll removes tangled hair from the brushroll with the touch of a button. Thoroughly clean the bare floors in your home with the motorized brushroll and cordless convenience. Clean above the floor with the detachable handheld vacuum. The crevice tool and dusting brush store conveniently in the handle so you can clean crevices, stairs and flat surfaces in one easy step. 180 degree easy steer maneuverability offers smooth turning and movement, helping you twist and turn around furniture with ease. The Ergorapido lithium ion brushroll clean Xtra stands on its own for those unexpected interruptions and the lightweight, bag less design makes it easy for you to get around-get up and down stairs and carry from room to room. Plus, led headlights help you see the dirt so you don't leave any behind.
profile.reviewText: This lightweight and easily maneuverable vacuum is a winner!  No cords to  trail around means I can zip through the house in record time.  A quick once-over everything more often is WAY easier than lugging out the canister vac once a week.  Get under tight spaces and the kids will grab it and use it too!  Can't beat that.  The dust bin does fill quickly, but it's easy enough to empty.  Judging by how much I do end up emptying, I would say this vacuum cleans as well as most corded (heavy, clunky) vacuums I've had.  And did I mention the kids will even grab it and sweep around?!  The LED lights led to some serious shock when I saw the dog hair that lurked everywhere, but now I can see it to pick it up.  All around - a great product.
profile.summary: A great option for easy and frequent vacuuming!

profile.description: This stunning upholstered platform bed by Zinus will transform your bedroom. It ships in one carton with the frame, legs and ten wooden slats conveniently located in the zippered compartment in the back of the headboard for easy assembly. This classic upholstered platform bed features a button tufted headboard and low profile footboard style frame, with wood slats and exposed feet for support. The taupe tufted upholstery adds softness and provides a classic framework for your mattress. Another comfort innovation from Zinus. Pioneering comfort.
profile.reviewText: This is a good looking platform bed and upholstered headboard.  The assembly was straightforward and this seems like a SOLID platform.  The fabric is attractive in a basic, no frills kind of way.  Our only issue with the bed is the height of the headboard.  Or should I say, the LACK of height of the headboard.  By the time the mattress is on the bed the headboard is less than 2 feet.  It's not a "sit-up-against" type of headboard.  We are contemplating ways to concoct another rail to move the headboard up to see more of the headboard.  So far, it's a solid, attractive bed.  I am just docking a star based on it not being quite high enough to match what we'd really be after.
profile.summary: Solid and good looking...

profile.description: Black, ported drum head on 16 IN x 11 IN, 6-Lug, Bass Drum. 10 IN x 6 IN, 5-Lug Tom-Tom with Holder. 10 IN x 5 IN, 5-Lug, snare with stand. 10 IN Cymbal with Holder. Junior Hi-Hat Cymbal with stand. Bass Drum Pedal. Junior Drummer's Throne. Drum Key. Drum Sticks. Assembly Required, Instructions Included. No additional tools necessary. Overall Size: 36 IN L x 36 IN W x 36 IN H, Weight: 34 Pounds.
profile.reviewText:
I'll start off admitting, I am not a drummer or overly familiar with the different quality levels of drums.  However, I think I can safely say this set is at the low end of the quality spectrum.  For the price, however, this is still a great value.  The stands are all solid and seem to be of above average quality.  The Hi-hat is very sturdy and is probably the best of the bunch.  The drums are all perfectly fine to pound away on and get some basic drum skills down.  They just don't sound quite right.  I don't know how to better explain it.  The bass drum isn't deep enough.  The snare barely "snares".  The tom sounds a little too "pingy".  But, again, for a 6 year old to pound away and develop some rhythm, it is more than adequate.  I was a little surprised how long it took me to put them together (~90 mins or so), but it was pretty straightforward.  For some reason Blue was cheaper than the other colors which was perfect for me!

Oh, I almost forgot - the stool (throne) is scarily flimsy.  Not a problem for the 6 year old, but even the 8 year old was too big for it.

Bottom Line:  A great starter (or "trial") set to see if the drums are right for your kid.  I'd feel ridiculous if I invested hundreds for them to sit around.  As of now, it looks like I'll be investing in a better set in a couple years!
profile.summary: A good value starter set

profile.description: The SentrySafe Alarm Safe is equipped with a loud audible alarm that alerts you to attempted break in. Made in the USA, it's built tough to withstand a fire for up to a hour, stand up to flood and storm damage and stay intact after a 1-story fall. Its protection that provides peace from all of life's perils.
profile.reviewText:
This is one solid hunk of a safe!  I am not storing the crown jewels, but if I were, I feel they'd be safe in here.  Well, maybe not from fire, but from theft.  The safe is everything you need for most items.  The airtight seal requires silica packs to be used to avoid moisture damaging what you're storing.  The fire resistant feature that will protect your documents will allow the temperature to get hot enough in a fire that digital media and much jewelry will likely not make it out in a desirable condition.  So, it's not the end all of protection, but with the keypad and additional feature of having a key disable even that, your normal snoop/burglar/accidental loss problems should be solved.  A general fire that doesn't consume the area that your safe is in should also leave everything safe and sound inside.  For me, I wanted a place for important papers and years of years of accumulating bonds and car titles etc.  No heavy duty jewels or boxes of blackmail dvds that need to be guarded with a safe.  So this is a great fit for me.

Also, let's face it, you feel cool using it.  The keypad and handle give a satisfying thump and click when you open the safe (like in heist movies) and the led lights that then emit from the door into the safe make you feel way more important than you probably are.  Unless you have blackmail dvds of me in there - in which case - I apologize - you are very important and I mean you no offense.

Buy with confidence, but consider an offsite safety deposit box if you're looking at things that heat could damage.
profile.summary: A great option to secure important documents.

profile.description: Protect your artwork with the Mead Acadmie Casemade Sketchbook. Twinwire binding keeps your sheets secure. Sketchbook includes 70 sheets of white drawing paper that is heavyweight and archival quality. Use the sturdy, hard casemade cover as a drawing surface. Paper is acid-free, lignin-free and fade-resistant. 11 in. x 8.5 in. sheet size.
profile.reviewText: I can't claim to be overly familiar with too many variations of sketch pads (ex: 70 lb versus 60 lb), but I do know that this paper is substantial and not at all the bargain sketchbook material you'd find in the bargain bins at your larger craft/department stores.  This is acid free and of notable thickness to stand up to more media.  My daughter will be using this for her art class and as she uses different tools we'll see how she likes the paper for pencil, pastel, charcoal etc.  The cover is hefty, protective and sturdy and will hold up well to the rigors of her backpack.  If anything notable comes up based on the various uses, I'll update this review, but for now the paper has proven great to sketch on with pencil and the size and weight of each sheet is a plus.
profile.summary: A hefty cover to protect substantial sheets

profile.description: Introducing Shock Doctor's latest mouthguard innovation - the Ultra Braces Mouthguard. We've integrated a flexible outer shell and internal shock core with a remoldable gel bite surface to provide the most protective and adaptable mouthguard for athletes with braces. This triple-layer design allows the mouthguard to conform to changes in the athlete's teeth position without sacrificing fit or protection.
profile.reviewText: I'll start by saying a mouth guard can really only work if it's IN your mouth and in your mouth the RIGHT WAY.  I know that sounds obvious, but so many models are too bulky or make it too difficult to breathe that they spend a lot of time in athlete's mouths sideways being chewed on or "accidentally" left in the bag during practice because they're uncomfortable.  Our 12 year old had issues with several brands, but this product seems to have solved a lot of the issues he has encountered.  They fit over his braces and he says it's not hard to breathe.  Which means it STAYS IN and can do its job.  It's more pricey than the run of the mill options, but with the money invested in orthodontia, it's a small premium to pay to protect that investment!
profile.summary: The best feature of this mouth guard?  He keeps it IN!

profile.description: These beautiful tablecloths feature a slight sheen that elevates the sophistication of your table setting. The damask scroll design gives your table a fancy, fun, and unique look. The damask scroll is a very versatile design that can be used year round, but also looks stunning for the Holidays. Polyester is a great fabric for tablecloths because the material hardly shrinks and requires little to no ironing. All DIIs damask polyester tablecloths feature a fold-over hem, which creates a polished look for your table. Find DIIs full selection of colors & sizes by searching for DII Damask Polyester Tablecloths. To view more of our products visit amazon.com/dii.
profile.reviewText: Hard to go anything but 5 stars for a product that does what it's meant to do without issue - so five stars it is.  There are a few points that make this tablecloth earn this rating, but none of them are anything earth-shattering - after all, it's just a tablecloth.  But one that fits well, washes well and resists the light stain tests that out gathering put it to.  It really dressed up the standard issue outdoor folding table for am 80th birthday party we threw.  The cleanup, washing, and drying were all easy and an unwrinkled tablecloth from the dryer was an appreciated time saver.  The cream color, although marked as "Holiday", is certainly fine for any time of the year.  A good value for a nice looking product.
profile.summary: Looks nice and cleans up well.

profile.description: The ONE Smart Piano 61-Key Portable Keyboard White. This portable keyboard is an ideal instrument for beginners and experienced players alike. It is an excellent learner's tool, and a fun way for more experienced players to learn new music. There are 61 backlit keys that light up with sheet music through The ONE Smart Piano app. The ONE Light is portable, so you can take it with you anywhere. You can select from over 128 different instrument sounds. Carry the piano around anywhere with 6 AA batteries or use the power supply. It is available with a black or white chassis (select from drop-down menu). One key component of The ONE is the included app, which lets you take private lessons with top online instructors. Each lesson is integrated with light-up keys, so it's like having a teacher with you any time. The ONE Light comes with built-in speakers, so you can play any music through third-party apps such as Spotify, YouTube, Pandora, and more. Play your own renditions on top of the music. Your house can become a live music party-central. In addition to the external player input, the rear panel includes a mic input, pedal input, USB and an audio output for patching into larger amplification systems. This is a fun, versatile and satisfying keyboard that can help you grow as a musician. Whats not to like? NOTE: iPad pictured is sold separately.
profile.reviewText: The ONE keyboard is an uncluttered, good looking keyboard.  With it's lack of buttons, I feared there was a lack of functionality - but I was wrong.  Once plugged into my iPhone, there were hundreds of instruments and sounds to choose from in the app.  From dogs barking and cars crashing to drums and dozens of Chinese instruments (my daughters favorite was the bagpipes).  So that's the "fun" keyboard stuff.  What about the real learning and playing?  The lights help a little, but they're not enough on their own.  You have to work on hand position and actually use the video lessons to work on some fundamentals.  I guess in the "old days" this would have been a game changer, but as I brought up a video lesson for a song, my daughter just said, "there's millions of these tutorials on YouTube."  Still, it's nice to have all these tools available in one tool - the ONE and the mobile device.  Between the lessons and the lights, it really is a good way to learn.  At this point could you do the same with YouTube and a regular keyboard?  Maybe.  But the lights might be enough extra to keep the kids interested and on task.  I wish there was an adapter for my older model iPad.
profile.summary: A nice way to bring a few tools together

profile.description: Oxy stain destroyer formula starts working on contact to mobilize, lift, and penetrate the stain at the source to remove stains in 30 seconds. Instantly and permanently removes tough pet stains like tracked-in dirt, grass, mud, blood, vomit, feces and urine! Improves deep cleaning performance by up to 3X.
profile.reviewText: OK, I admit it - It's been a while since I've cleaned my carpet.  Any cleaning formula probably would have made a positive impression because there was so much to clean!  But even with expectations of seeing my carpet 2 to 3 shades lighter, this formula blew me away.  There were stains and dirt spots that had survived previous cleanings, vacuumings and spot removal attempts that were removed with this product!  I'm not claiming miracles, there were some, long-standing spots that even this formula couldn't handle, but this is definitely the cleanest my carpets have been in quite some time.  What impressed me most on top of that was the smell.  It wasn't a "cleaning product scent" or a masking perfume-like smell.  It just smelled clean.  Like clean laundry.  When I watch the commercials of people loving the "clean, fresh smell" of a product made to make things smell without cleaning them, I get a little aggravated.  If you want something to smell clean - CLEAN IT!  Now that I have a product that leaves me with a clean rug and a clean smell, maybe I'll motivate to get the job done a little more often.
profile.summary: Impressed with the cleaning and the smell

profile.description: In-Ear, Apple Control Talk - White
profile.reviewText:
I've bought and compared dozens of Monster products over the years and usually end up with the same conclusion: The same quality can be had at a better price.  But that was cables and adapters and the like.  This is headphones.  And they claim to have done something novel and extra with this product.  I'm not a Monster hater, so I'm fine to report, these are good, noise cancelling, great sounding headphones.  But again, I question what the premium price is for.

The packaging is impressive.  The array of ear buds to choose from to get your correct size is impressive.  These aren't items that should contribute to price though.  So how the headphones perform?  Very well.  The in-line mic for use with iPhone works as expected and is a convenient feature to have on quality headphones.  The over the ear part molds well to the ear to stay in and fairly tight, but it took several adjustments while I was running to keep them snug.  I'd say with the added weight (and swinging) of the mic, these aren't running headphones.

I'll stick with my behind the head headphones for running and enjoy the sound quality of these for around the house or for travelling.  My bottom line: Another good product that seems to have that "Monster Premium" associated with it.
profile.summary: Quality, but I often feel that Monster products come at a questionable premium

profile.description: You are at the helm in the fight for the future of the planet. Will you command the Alien Fleet or defend Humankind? Power up and scan the battlefield for locations to conceal your highly detailed, movie-based ships. Then, brace yourself for battle as electronic voice commands and sound effects signal your search-and-destroy mission to take out your opponents ships. Play on your own or battle a friend, and choose from three edge-of-your seat missions!
profile.reviewText:
Let's be honest - you have to be a certain type of personality to find "Classic" Battleship consistently entertaining.  It's a fairly slow moving game that requires a certain amount of patience and an inclination to use your noggin logically.  This updated electronic version doesn't eliminate your need for patience or logic, but it does give you a quick way to setup and an automated way to "attack" and track your successes.  This makes things move along a little quicker and, I must admit, gives you the tiniest thrill of pushing the launch button with each turn to hear the attack noises.  The advanced game versions also give you more options to speed things up, but I haven't played them enough to form a solid opinion.  The game isn't "Battleship" when you can wipe out a surrounding area on one turn.  It's still a strategic game, but it's not the same.

The board or console or whatever you'd call it, is impressive.  It gives the game a cool look and feel.  My son (age 7) was immediately taken by this game and played me and kept playing on 1-Player mode.  I could see the wheels turning in his mind as he decided where to attack next.  I can't ask for more out of toy than making a kid logically dissect a grid to determine optimal probability for success.  OK, I may be over-intellectualizing this, but he was definitely THINKING, which is good.

The voices and sound effects are fun touches and add some drama to the attacking process, but they are SLOW.  You might not notice at first, but after the hundredth turn, a 7 second launch sequence adds up!  I'd say, on its own, this game is a good addition to any household's stable.  In addition, as an update to the classic version, it has its merits and is worth an upgrade.
profile.summary: A fun update - and a key single player feature

profile.description: New Pacific Direct Metropolis Backless Counter Stool 26" Wood Seat,Gunmetal Gray,Set of 4
profile.reviewText: We built a countertop/seating area that stands about 39" off the ground.  We originally went with 30" stools and it definitely felt high for eating as we were sitting to high above the counter.  These 26" stools are the perfect height.  My limited sample set of measuring (dining room chairs to table, bar stool to bar top) shows about a foot of distance from seat to tabletop to be optimal for normal eating.  You'd think this would be easy to find on line but it was always vague.  Now I know.  26" stools on a 39" counter is great!  These are a little distressed/hammered/industrial looking so if you want clean, perfect surfaces, pick a different set of stools.  They are very sturdy and stackable so they can be moved right out of the way.
profile.summary: Cool distressed look and just the right height

profile.description: Our ingredient list is purposefully simple, made with ONE ANIMAL PROTEIN and ONE VEGETABLE, versus the mix of each youll find in most other dog foods. Guided by the purity and simplicity of raw, Instinct Limited Ingredient Diet Grain-Free Real Turkey Recipe is simple and essential nutrition your dog needs to thrive.
profile.reviewText: I like the ingredient list (for what's on it, but mostly for what's NOT on it), and the dog seems to love the taste (but can anyone ever really tell with a dog that inhales whatever you put in front of him?).  The consistency is a little soup like and I'm not sure that it's supposed to be.  The biggest issue I have is the SMELL.  After reading some other reviews about "bad batches" I'm starting to worry what we are dishing out might not be as intended.  The dog hasn't been sick or had any adverse reactions, so I was assuming that was just the way the food came.  But I can't think of a reason why turkey dog food should smell like FISH and really stink up the kitchen.  For now, I'm going to pay close attention to the next few cans to determine if they all smell similarly or perhaps a can or two was not quite fresh.  There are a ton of options out there, with more and more manufacturers getting the hint that pet owners don't want to feed their pets garbage, fillers, grains and preservatives.  This will be on the list of potential repeat buys, but to be honest, with all the competition, my choice will be highly price sensitive.
profile.summary: Dog inhales it, but I think it smells awful.

profile.description: Dyson received the highest numerical score among canister vacuums in the J.D. Power 2015 and 2017 Vacuum Satisfaction Studies. 2017 study based on 6,965 total responses from 9 companies measuring the opinions of consumers who purchased a canister vacuum in the previous 12 months surveyed in February-March 2017. Your experiences may vary.
profile.reviewText: I come home from work, and there they are again - my fiancee and D just dancing around the living room.  Sometimes I'll catch them in the bedroom 2 or 3 times a week!  He's so cute.  He's so dependable.  He's so versatile.  How can I compete with that?  Before D came along I never had to worry about her running off to clean drapes with that fancy trigger thingy that reduces suction so you don't suck up the drapes.  I never had to worry that the carpeted stairs would get more attention than me because of an extending handle with great attachments.  The retractable cord?  The easy to dump (although sort of small) canister?  It's all just too much.  I guess eventually everything will be too clean to need a thirtieth going over, so maybe I'll still get the best of this deal.  I'll have a clean house, a happy fiancee and get some attention again.  Maybe I'll even get to use the Dyson.
profile.summary: This Vacuum is a Homewrecker!

profile.description: The iDM15 is a compact portable stereo speaker solution with Bluetooth-enabled audio streaming and speakerphone capability. Speakers connect to a computer or other USB power source via the included USB cable to recharge the internal lithium-ion battery. You can pair your Bluetooth-capable device to enjoy audio, or listen to any audio device that has a 3.5 mm headphone jack. Perfect for laptops, cell phones, iPad, iPhone, iPod and other MP3 players, any audio source! Cables and a sturdy travel case are included.
profile.reviewText:
As I unpackaged these speakers, I couldn't help but think, "somebody has been studying Apple's attention to detail in design".  The box that comes with the speakers is compact and has several nice little features.  The inside of the lid of the box has a compartment to store the USB power cord and the cord that connects the speakers.  The whole lid itself has a groove that slides into the inverted bottom of the box to create a stand for an iPad (or other device). The speakers are small and shaped such that when placed together they form a rectangle that slides into this box for travel. The speakers have a "lock" switch to toggle when storing to ensure you don't accidentally hit the power button and drain them battery during travel.  This may all seem trivial, and would mean nothing if the sound was bad, but to me this was a huge indication of the thought that went into these speakers and I was optimistic it would carry over to the actual performance of the speakers.  Because, I'll be honest here, my experience with other iHome products has been the opposite!  Usually I find several design shortcomings and by the time I play the speakers it is no surprise the quality stinks.

So how did they SOUND? In a word: great! The pairing with my iPad or iPhone was simple and the sound was better than two other speaker sets I had to compare to (one Bluetooth one docked).  The sound was quite full and it held up the best under loud volume.  Now, of course, I am still talking about SMALL speaker sets and "loud" is for one good-sized room - not a dance party - but I was impressed with these little guys.  With the way these pack up for travel, I see them coming in very handy at the beach and in hotel rooms this Summer.  A rechargeable battery and a bluetooth connection that lets my phone stay out of the elements while cranking (again "cranking" for tiny speakers) the tunes is a five-star product.
profile.summary: BIG sound from a little package!

profile.description: Take your calls no matter where you are The VTechR Connect to CellTM Phone comes with a digital answering system and 2 convenient handsets so that you can go anywhere and do everything without missing an important call. This system is capable of making both landline and cellular calls and can expand up to five handsets for maximum efficiency. With message retrieval from the handset and conferencing between lines, this is the last word in efficiency and ease.
profile.reviewText: All the features I've come to love in a cordless phone set with satellite bases PLUS cell phone pairing.  A very good idea that helps our family a lot.  No longer do I have to sprint for the front door when my cell phone rings to ensure I get a signal.  The cell phone can stay somewhere with reception while I walk around with a much more comfortable form factor of a phone.  The speaker is better than my iPhone and it's easier to handle.  Set your # of rings, volume, answering system etc. and this phone is a good work horse.  I have had VTech for years and I've found that after several years the batteries go, but for the price, I usually upgrade the whole set rather than look into battery replacement.  Having Bluetooth pairing made this upgrade a no-brainer.  I've had VTech and Uniden and this brand would be a slight tick above the other for reliability (in my opinion).
profile.summary: A solid phone packed with features.

profile.description: Elkay accessories are designed to fit perfectly and coordinate with your Elkay sink. From drains and bottom grids, to cutting boards and magnetic sink organization accessories, we have the accessories you need. They help make your time at the sink more efficient and effortless.
profile.reviewText:
At first glance I thought the effort to "Install" a sponge holder was WAY too high.  Climb under my sink and stick a magnet strip to the outside of the sink?  Seemed like a lot of work for something that sticks to the sink and holds a sponge!  After removing everything from under my sink and laying on my back, the application was actually easier than I thought it would be.  And the end result is a sturdy sticking holder that doesn't sag down or pop off like the suction cup versions of these holders.

I was fortunate enough to receive one of these as a Vine reviewer so I can't speak to the "value" of this.  I can say I don't think this will need to be replaced like the suction cup versions and is way less aggravating.  It can be cleaned in the dishwasher so this will likely be the better version of something cheap that won't have to be replaced.  You'll have to make the call on how aggravated you are by the inferior solutions to decide if this investment makes sense.
profile.summary: Solves your sponge storage problems!

profile.description: 3x Higher Color Brightness and up to 3x Wider Color Gamut with Epson. 3200 lumens color brightness and 3200 lumens white brightness. Pro-quality; widescreen resolution; wireless, MHL.
profile.reviewText:
We've toyed with the idea of getting a projector for family movie night for a while and I can easily say having one has surpassed my expectations.  Obviously it's cool to have it BIGGER, but it's really awesome when the quality is great.  Kids are used to watching video on tablets and even phones, so to finally be able to break them out of the "small world" felt like an accomplishment.  Our first screening was Raider of the Lost Ark streamed from an HDMI connection from a laptop and projected on a sheet hung outside with a firepit nearby for marshmallow roasting.  The picture was clear and the less than optimal screen setup (OK it was downright crappy) barely detracted from the quality.  You definitely need some sort of sound system/speakers if you're going to do this and are looking for a movie experience.

I've also run PowerPoint presentations via HDMI and VGA and that worked as seamlessly as you would expect.  The wireless features are not that exciting, but I was able to get my photos projected from my phone and upload a document to their app for projection.  I don't see needing/using wireless at all since it doesn't support streaming video (which would have been amazing).  Overall this is a great quality projector that the kids have also used for sleepover movies and video games and it is a hit every time.
profile.summary: Great picture and great family time!

profile.description: Easily scrape leftover batter from bowls with the OXO Good Grips Bowl Scrapers. The Bean shaped Scraper provides a wide swiping area for large bowls, while the Paddle shaped Scraper is perfect for getting to the bottom of narrow bowls and mixers. The convenient size and shape of each Scraper keeps your hands clean and provides control for quick, efficient scraping. The Scrapers are also great for spreading batter in a pan or smoothing frosting over cake or cupcakes. The smooth, silicone Scrapers are easy to clean and are dishwasher safe.
profile.reviewText: The shapes are genius.  Removes every last drop of pancake batter from the bowl.  The one with the sharp angle gets into the corner of your larger yogurt container and nets an extra 1 or 2 ounces of creamy goodness.  It really is easier than the traditional rubber scraper and gives you a good grip (no name check intended - just stating the facts).  The two downsides are: 1) your hand will be right in close to whatever is being scraped.  There is a good chance your hand is coming out covered in batter/yogurt/dough/etc. and 2) they are fairly large.  Smaller bowls and containers will have to be left with the old school scrapers as these require a large working area.  BOTTOM LINE: certainly not necessary, but if you are a baker, soup maker or otherwise use bigger bowls often, these do a great job.
profile.summary: Scrapes bowls clean, but too big for general use

profile.description: Meer Wubbzy he is a fun lovable , curious little guy who is always looking to have a good time with his best friends Widget & Walden in the wacky town of Wuzzleburg, together they discover the importance of open-mindedness, honesty and friendship all while having fun.
profile.reviewText:
As far as the show itself - it is very cute, pretty educational, and entertaining to the kids.  It is "kooky" enough to present traditional lessons in a non-conventional way, so kids can get the message with silly songs and kooky premises instead of preaching.

My reason for docking this a star is around actually owning the DVD.  My kids have gone back to Dora, Blue's Clues, Cars, Nemo, (recently) Spongebob, and others OVER and OVER.  I can't explain why some things click.  Wubbzy is on TV a lot and while they will watch it and like it, it hasn't reached "repeat status", so I'm not sure the DVD will get much use.

Then again, maybe this will "click" with your kid and you'll have positive messages being reinforced - which is a lot better than some of the other stuff out there.  And for $10, I guess there's not that much of a risk!  The game and printables on the DVD do add some value, so maybe I'll go to 4.5 stars!

The songs are funny and addictive - so be warned...
profile.summary: The kids love it, but it may lack "staying power"

profile.description: The 12-Volt MAX* Cordless Lithium Drill/Driver from Black and Decker is the perfect combination of power and performance in a compact size. The powerful 550 rpm motor with 11-position clutch can tackle most projects, while the 2.18-lbs. design eliminates the struggle of fitting into tight corners and spaces. The LED work light, keyless chuck and ergonomic handle allow for convenience and enhanced user ability.
profile.reviewText: For standard around the house uses (putting up window shades, shelves, etc.) this drill is perfect.  It's a lot lighter and more compact than it's "big brother" version, which I also own, and that makes it the tool of choice for most jobs.  In putting up "between the stud" shelving in my kitchen, the Big Bro wouldn't fit between studs to screw in shelving brackets.  This drill fit the bill and had the compact form factor to fit and the power of 12V to still get the job done.  The LED light is a nice touch for those dark corners.  I'm not sure how drills in this category line up cost wise, but this seems like a good value and it performs as you would expect a Black & Decker product to perform.
profile.summary: Great for Standard to Light use

profile.description: Panasonic HX-A1MK Wearable Camera - Black
profile.reviewText: I am not reviewing this from the extreme athlete, thrill seeking perspective, but more as a dad of several kids who like to be active and capture themselves on various bike trails and other various activities.  Overall, the response was lukewarm.  This is partially based on the capacity and battery life of the A1 (less than expected/desired) and also due to the lack of real life applications.  After several mountain biking sessions, my son realized the video was cool, but ultimately the same thing the second, third and fourth times.  And, like the old vacation slide shows of yesteryear, nobody really wants to watch them.  That's not to say the haven't come up with cool shots and enjoy it.  It's just with the ubiquitous nature of video these days, this didn't afford anyone a fresh perspective.  Again - I must qualify - if you are kayaking or running an adventure race - this may well be the product for you.  But if you're looking to introduce a new gadget to the family for casual use, it may not be heralded as the cool toy you thought it would!
profile.summary: A fun, rugged little camera to capture your adventures

profile.description: Scotch(R) Multi-Purpose Fasteners are great for mounting items on walls. Grip and Release. For indoor use.
profile.reviewText: It's tough to review simple use items like this.  Do they work or don't they?  These fasteners (basically circles of velcro), work just fine for light use.  They held laminated forms to the wall for ease of retrieval (They aren't removed that often).  The softer side of the discs is also good for another use: furniture "foot pads".  As my dining room chair pad wore and there was a loud screech and a scratch on the floor, I noticed these are very close to the furniture pads you'd buy for the same use.  I figured I'd try them until I had a chance to get the "real thing", but these held up fine and I haven't yet replaced them.  So, for their dual purpose I give them four stars.  I withhold one star based on their size.  They aren't really suited for anything much heavier than my laminates (or I'd be worried about it falling).
profile.summary: Good hold, light use

profile.description: Expandomatic casual stretch solid classic fit plain front pant
profile.reviewText:
I went in thinking the "expando" part of the pants was specifically for the waist.  I've had a few different brands that give you a little more room in the waist.  These pants are "expando" EVERYWHERE though!  The stretch fabric is very neat/clean looking and gives you a little room when you need to bend, squat etc.  Let's be honest - If you're looking for "expanding waistband" pants, your proportions are probably not ideal, but that doesn't mean your belly has to rule your pants decisions!  By the time you ramp up to a 38" waist (enter your own number here) the rest of the pants are like a tent around you.  Instead, you get a 36" "expando" and you can get your shirt tucked in without looking like your smuggling bales of cotton in your pants.  The rest of the pants fit appropriately and all is well.  The only thing with these pants is - you need to go with the size smaller that you "wish you could be".  Call it vanity sizing or perhaps it the fact that they expand, but if you go with your usual waist size, these will be a little big. Which makes them hang lower.  Which means they will be longer than you expect also.

All in all - a nice looking and comfortable pair of pants that run a little large.
profile.summary: Clumsy name - nice comfort

profile.description: Square off for the ultimate Bot Shots Battle Game with this incredible Battle for the Matrix Set! Pit your Optimus Prime and Bumblebee vehicles against their Megatron and Decepticon Brawl enemies. With the push of a button, your Optimus Prime and Megatron vehicles trailers convert to a launcher that helps you roll into battle with extra force! Beat your opponent when your vehicle converts to robot mode while the other vehicle stays in vehicle mode. Use your launcher to win the next collision, then do it all over again! If you both convert, the vehicle with the stronger power is the victor: Blaster beats Fist, Fist beats Sword and Sword beats Blaster! Launch your figures into battle and watch them haul their trailers into the fray!
profile.reviewText: A good idea gone awry.  Set your weapon (Sword beats Blaster beats Fist beats Sword a la Rock, Paper, Scissors), close your Bot Shot to car form and crash them into each other to see who wins!  What could go wrong?  Unfortunately, plenty.  The pieces don't hold their car shapes and the launchers (with cars opening prematurely) don't really work well.  This got one use as a "game" and quickly gave way to just having a bunch on small action figures.  After all the hype from TV commercials and my son setting everything up, it was pretty disappointing.  Plus, how do you answer your kid when he asks you explain why a sword would beat a gun or a fist would beat a sword?
profile.summary: Rock, Paper, Scissors in a Transformer!

profile.description: This Round Bravo Fire Pit has open sides with mesh inserts for maximum light and effect. This sturdy fire pit comes in a classic black finish and includes a screen cover for added safety. This fire pit is perfect for a small cozy get-together on your patio or for adding to the atmosphere of a larger party or celebration. Protect your tub from rain and snow with the included vinyl cover.
profile.reviewText:
A good sized fire pit, with an open sided design that makes for easy fire starting and a nice fire.  With less than optimal starting materials (just some cardboard and logs), I was able to get a fire raging in just minutes.  I attribute this to the open sides letting air flow through.  I've tried starting fires in true "pits" where the lack of air flow stunts even the best kindling and paper.  After firing right up, the pit gives off a good amount of heat and allowed some quality marshmallow roasting.  The cover doesn't contain all sparks (the mesh isn't very fine), but it's a good precaution for the larger sparks/embers jumping.

There are no bells and whistles here.  It's just a metal "bowl" to hold a fire.  There are probably more impressive looking options, but for something to hold a fire while we hang out on the patio - this fits the bill.

Setup was easy - except for two missing screws (for the legs) in the packaging.  Easy enough to find a pair that worked among my tools, but a silly omission from the packaging.
profile.summary: Fire blazing in just minutes!

profile.description: The ultra-compact design of the Belkin N150 Micro Wireless USB Adapter makes it easy to connect to your laptop or netbook and go.
profile.reviewText: We have an older computer that the kids basically just use to surf game sites and school homework pages.  When I wanted to move the location of the computer I really didn't want to be tied down with a cable.  Enter this tiny adapter that allowed me to move the computer to a corner without wiring and quickly setup a wireless connection.  This is an older XP computer that they really don't do much video streaming or music downloads, so the speed of this adapter is fine.  In fact, I sort of like the fact that the "homework computer" can't play distracting YouTube videos!  For the same price (but larger footprint) or a few more dollars you could get a faster adapter, but if you want a low cost option for a primarily web browsing, email checking computer, than this is a good option.
profile.summary: A good option for getting a "browsing" computer on line

profile.description: 24k gold-plated connectors create precise contact for low signal loss. HDMI Connector to HDMI Micro Connector provides superior performance for connecting portable devices with HDMI Micro ports.
profile.reviewText: As I prepared to write this review I realized I don't think I've ever not liked a Belkin product.  They seem to see a need and either solve it in a creative way (iPod and iPhone accessories come to mind) or solve it by having their own quality version of a cable or a charger or whatever the product is.  The reason I bring this up is because this cable is another example of "the Belkin way".  They've made a quality, sturdy, snugly fitting cable that delivers video and images from your phone to your big screen TV.  The price has come down on this and even if it hadn't - the old "you get what you pay for" is true to a certain extent in cables.  Super cheap will not hold up.  Cheap will be fine for a while and for most folks longer.  Mid-range will almost always suffice (I am considering this cable in this category).  Pricey is almost always a waste of money (unless you have an ear/eye/system that really distinguishes between great and super great).  That's my opinion anyway, and I didn't notice anything but a clear picture on the pictures and videos streamed to the TV.
profile.summary: I might be becoming a Belkin Fanboy

profile.description: Dickies traditional work shirt is made with durable ring spun twill, rinsed for softness and comfort
profile.reviewText: I've seen Dickies clothes in retail stores and always thought I'd like to give them a shot.  They seem so well-made and durable.  Then I'd see the price, and I'd pass.  So when Amazon had these on a Lightning Deal, I grabbed one and was rewarded with a well made, good-fitting shirt that seems pretty darn durable.  Sometimes, I think taking price into consideration when rating an item is not a good idea.  If I'm ranking the quality of this shirt it's 5-stars all the way.  If I'm paying full price, I might knock it down to 4-stars as sort of an indication that there may be equal quality out there for less.  The shirt is comfortable and not as hot as I thought it might be.
profile.summary: Great shirt if the price is right

profile.description: Kids can discover playful trivia spanning decades of Disney magic, from animated classics and blockbuster movies, to television hits and dazzling theme park destinations. It's a game of teamwork--with a competitive twist! Along the way, are guess-my-answer questions that reveal how much kids know about the other players!
profile.reviewText:
Now that we've played a few times, I feel compelled to pass along a 5-star review on this game.  I was worried that "family days" of old were gone when I tried in vain to find something to interest kids ranging in age from 9 to 14.  Younger games and movies are "boring" to the older ones and most of the older stuff is frankly inappropriate for the younger ones.  Along came the Disney Edition of Pictopia and saved the family!  OK, I'm exaggerating, but everyone does love the game!  With properties as diverse as the Pixar movies, the Muppets, the Princesses, Gravity Falls, Phineas and Ferb, and so much more - there HAS to be something you know and love here.

Game play is a little clunky with the wagering process that is used before each question.  It's also hard to keep kids quiet about what is on the cards when they see them and get excited.  When the questions call for working together as a team it is a blast.  When it's supposed to be a solo question (where each player answers in secret), the blurting out of information can be a challenge!  Either way, the game goes fairly quickly and when played with ages 9, 11, 12, 13, 44 and 45 we had a great time.  And not coincidentally, we now have a list of Disney movies we need to see that we weren't that familiar with.  Genius marketing by Disney.  Once you realize how much you recognize and know about these movies/shows, you'll be shocked!
profile.summary: A huge hit with a huge family

top_5.description: Elegance, class and sophistication
top_5.reviewText: I still can't believe how this thing unfolded out of the box and had the arm rests zipped inside, making this quite a compact delivery.  The assembly was straightforward and the end result is quite comfortable seating.  The bottom cushion is nice and springy and provides nice support.  The varying levels the back rests ratchet to make for varied options to sit however is comfortable for you.  Having support bars that rotate out of the back of the couch for support when it's being used flat is a nice touch. Makes the flat position much more stable and avoids tipping.  All-in-all a very simple way to get a good value futon/couch to your home.  This isn't plush designer furniture, but it is functional, comfortable and a great value.
top_5.summary: This isn't plush designer furniture, but it is functional, comfortable and a great value.

top_5.description: Secure closure without using tape. Strong, durable hand holes for comfortable moving and lifting. FastFold quick and easy assembly. No tape required - lid locks into place for secure closure. Easy to break down and store flat until ready for reuse. All boxes constructed from strong 32 ECT C-Flute Kraft corrugated board.
top_5.reviewText:
How does one review a box?  Let's see:  does it take the shape of a box and carry things?  YES.  Does it do so easily with very little set up and no tape needed?  YES.  Is it sturdy and easy to carry?  YES.  Then I guess it is a 5-star box!

I have to admit, I have never priced boxes before - preferring to scrounge around and take whatever boxes were at work, the store etc.  But, when you get down to the several boxes worth of stuff you want to be sure are taken care of - it's probably a good idea to invest in a few quality boxes.  These are sturdy and easily break down to use again (or give to a friend who is moving).
