Our heroine had her throat ripped out protecting Zacarias years ago, She lived at the ranch under his families protection. I understand after reading 22 books in this series how the Carpathian mind works, but this book made me squirm.(did I say that before?) Where was the health, happiness above all other for his lifemate? I was uncomfortable that she was placed into this situation and abused by him, making excuses for him like an abused woman does. Where was the strength she had previously. The mate thing couldn't have taken that all away.

It wasn't until almost the end that Zacharius 'got it'. I would have loved a de la cruz get together as we only saw Dominic and Solange for a moment.

a 3 star just because I love this world....

I am new to Rhys Ford. Dirty Kiss, Dirty Secret, and Dirty Laundry was my first encounter with this author.  I loved them all as part of the Cole McGuinnis Mystery Series. Besides Cole and Jae  spicing up the story with hot sexy m/m romance, this author kept us busy solving lots of murders with many twists and turns.

When I searched for another book  from this author I found her writing  the Sinner Series and read another of her murder, mystery series with gusto devouring  Sinner's Gin and Whiskey and Wry starring Damien and Micki and meeting lots of Morgan's.

Now Ms Ford has released Fish and Ghosts. I just love it when an author is so talented that they can change their genre specific stories, write them well and cultivate another part of themselves for us to enjoy.

Fish and Ghosts brings us two unlikely people. Tristan Pryce; who is left Hoxne Grange. He has lived there since early childhood with an aging eccentric Uncle Mortimer who considers himself its caretaker, leading ghosts into the light. Since Tristan has seen these apparitions since childhood, he steps in to fill his uncle's shoes.

Dr Wolf Kincaid enjoys debunking charlatans and owns Hellsinger Investigations travelling with a team of Paranormal Investigators. He is hired by Tristan's family to prove Tristan bonkers so they can get their hands on the Estate.

profile.reviewText:
This is the second book in the Half Moon Bay Series written by Rhys Ford, and it is packed with as many thrills and chills as the first, Fish Stick Fridays!  In that story, we ventured with Ms. Ford to Half Moon Bay and met bad boy Deacon Reed opening a Body Shop after finally retaining custody of his niece, Ziggy. The body shop just happened to be close to a book store run by Mr. Mc Dreamy Lang Harris. Luckily for Zig and Deacon, Lang falls in love with the little girl who walks into his shop in a tutu and combat boots and steals his cat and his heart.

To begin this newest story Hanging the Stars, we meet Wes Harris, Langs brother returning to Half Moon Bay. Wes has been a loner for years, losing the love of his life. So wouldnt it be kismet that the said person is also back in town? Angel Harris returns to town after years of turmoil. Angel is the son of a grifter who taught him the slimy side of life, roaming from town to town, and cheating people out of their hard earned money. Angel finally broke free taking troubled young half brother, Roman, along with him.

Angel thinks he is doing well, making a living with a small bakery a few doors away from the Harris Book Store. Hes living in a small apartment out back with barely enough essentials,  but it is a roof and a bed for Angel and Roman.

When Wes and Angel bump into each other after so many years, the shock has them reeling in memories.  Ms. Ford then puts suspense into the mix by adding attempted murder, arson and putting enough fear into their hearts to have them crazy to protect each other.

This is totally a Rhys Ford book!  It kicks butt and pulls no punches. It also helps that she is the queen of writing smoking hot sexy scenes between Wes and Angel who manage the re-kindling between ducking and running!!!!

Needless to say, I loved every minute of this book and look forward to my next visit in Half Moon Bay.

Review by Gloria Lakritz

profile.description:
From the author of "The Haunted Hillerman House" comes Shannon Bailey's latest. 
Only this time the tales are true and the ghosts are real. * * * * * 

Samantha Morgan's husband had a secret.
One that was revealed only after his death.
One that left her more angry than heartbroken.
One that led her to the historic Mackinac Island in upstate Michigan.
To a dark house with a dark past . . . And haunted by a dark ghost. * * * * *

WARNING: Readers do not scour these pages for things that cause fear and fright. This is tale of subtle ghostly happenings and romantic delight.
profile.reviewText:
As a reviewer, you get to read many books from many authors, both new and old. I had the pleasure of reading a book by Shannon Bailey called The Haunted Hillerman House a few years ago, and I noted at that time, that although she was a new author, she was going to grow up and be a gifted mystery writer. She certainly had the `mindset'.

She switched gears and wrote a Vampire trilogy; Forever Davids, Develyns Tale and The End of the Order, now all three bound as The Unwilling. Still they all had that hint of mystery, that twist around every corner!

Three years later, I am the recipient of a submission for Shadowbrook Manor, and I see Ms. Bailey is all grown up. This book shows her growth as a writer and her talent for murder, mystery, and mayhem. This story is sharper, twisting and winding the reader down a path if no return.

Samantha was in a marriage that was falling apart. She learns her husband was killed in a tragic car accident along with another passenger, a woman, his lover. After dealing with this terrible treachery, she learns that his parents, through their guilt, have given her a house on Mackinac Island, Mi. This is where we find Sam, traveling there to fix it up as quickly as possible and get it sold.

We next meet Tobias, an older gentleman, who met her at the ferry, helped load her luggage into his horse drawn wagon and would taxi her to the Manor. During their ride, he elaborated on the families and the gossip of the island, along with the story of Shadowbrook Manor, the haunting story of Captain Alexandre O'Keefe and his beloved Leslie. Sam scoffs at the thought of ghosts. She definitely is a non-believer. As Tobias re counts the story, Alexandre comes to the Manor in the late 1890's. A year later, he meets the beautiful Leslie Faraday, her husband James and another couple they are traveling with, the Burtram's. Alex and Leslie fall in love over that summer and then tragedy happens. Alex was found dead in the Manor, and Leslie has disappeared. It is said the captain's ghost still waits for Leslie to return.

Ms. Bailey draws you in immediately with her wonderful pictures of the area and its ambiance. You can see the water, the bridge, and the winding paths. You can feel the sun and smell the flowers. Color comes bursting from the pages and a wonderful tale of everlasting love weaves itself into your heart. The sadness, the deceit, the lies, and finally the truth take the reader through a path that is mesmerizing.

I loved the story, I cried, I was shocked, I was angry. I ran the gamut of feelings throughout. It is a wonderful love story filled with mysteries that you will not solve until the last page. And when you do, you will feel fulfilled...

I await your next endeavor Shannon Bailey!

Review by Gloria Lakritz
Senior Reviewer for the Paranormal Romance Guild
profile.summary: Shannon Bailey- 'O' is for Outstanding !

profile.reviewText:

Book: Where We Left Off

Series: Middle of Somewhere - Book #3

Author: Roan Parrish

Publisher: Dreamspinner Press

Genre: M/M Romance

Rated: Mature

Roan Parrish has written a series that took my breathe away. I read the first two books, In The Middle of Somewhere and Out of No Where in a weekend. I Couldnt Put Them Down!!! So I was excited to see the third in the series ready for my reading pleasure And it was all I hoped for and more!!!

We knew Will Highland was a sexy hot mess, from the first book. But little did we know how bad it really was. Young Leo Ware didn't have a chance. He was smitten immediately and  through the latter part of the storyline of Daniel and Rexs story we waited for this tale.

Roan Parrish has written a strong contender of Best Series for 2016 in my humble opinion. This third book in the series Where We Left Off is a coming of age love story for two young men, for both Will and Leo.

Leo chances for following Will to NY immediately were scuttled by a Financial Aid glitch which kept Leo in Michigan for another year. Now on a bus to New York City to begin NYU University Leo has stars in his eyes for his plans that include he and Will and a happily ever after..

Will is beautiful physically, and has always doubted what people wanted, did they want him for him, or how he looked. Besides other big family issues, he steered clear of commitments keeping his heart all bundled away. Hook-ups were the best he would share of himself, not wanting anything more.

So what happens when a wide eyed romantic chooses an Ice King? Trouble with a Capital T! Roan Parrish has again written a heartwarming story of two young men coming together, learning, growing, loving and enchanting readers with tenderness, tears, hot sex and it is with a lump in my throat, a tear in my eyes and joy in my heart I say well done!

output:
Remember how everyone said Assassin's Creed 2 saved the Assassin's Creed franchise, and how they were hoping Watch Dogs 2 would do the same to redeem Watch Dogs?  They got their wish.  (Here I'll say I actually liked Assassin's Creed and Watch Dogs, but I cannot deny the sequel is far superior).

There is a twist of humor here.  There are a lot of options to get through a mission.  There are many side quests, and you can cause a lot of trouble.

For interface, it's by and large the same fare you're used to from Ubisoft.  You have an indicator to follow.  It tells you how far your destination is.  All that.  You can sneak up on guards and take them out.  Or you can sneak past them.  You can hack machines to lead them into traps.  You can hack phones or traffic lights or whatever for distraction.  There are a lot of options.

I found the story compelling enough for a game (or even a movie; it was really good) and the gameplay especially excellent.

I haven't had much experience with the multiplayer, but that's not really my thing anyway.  As a single player experience, it makes up for the lack of an AC game this year.

Loved it.

Hack the planet.

profile.description: Assassin's Creed Unity - Limited Edition - PlayStation 4
profile.reviewText:
When you first start the game prepare for a long install.  This game has been patched, re-patched, and patched again to knock out the bugs, and there are still bugs.  In the first section, before even the welcome screen (which is granted something like an hour into the game) I managed to crouch behind something only to have a clipping error trap me there.  I had to go in the world map then back out again to refresh the screen layout so that I can move.  But that's not that bad.  Most of the bugs are gone, and those clipping issues are a running part of the franchise.

There is a companion app with a whack of micropay transactions that is pretty much a required part of the experience.  Many chests won't open until you solve a ridiculously easy puzzle in the app.  Easy, because the things you're looking for don't move, so you can just remember where they are for the next try.  That's a little worse, especially because not all mobile platforms are supported.  At the time of this writing Windows Phone (tiny install base, granted) and the Kindle Fire (very large install base) are not supported.  If the thing is mandatory, it should work on all platforms.  The app also allows you to send out your assassin's on assignment, similar to what Ezio was doing in Brotherhood, except it made sense for Ezio to do that.  He was pretty much leading the assassin's at that point.  Arno isn't even an assassin when he starts.  Also, the forgot the initiation rite from Ezio's time or else it changed past all recognition.  The new one is really weird.

Also required is the multiplayer element built right into the single player story line.  I mean, you can ignore these things but not if you want to fully complete the game to 100%.

The upgrades are tied to helix credits that you can buy, more microtransactions, which can get kind of annoying especially since they start at $20 and go up to $100, but are, at least, optional.  Really optional.  Like if you don't buy air assassination, you can still perform an air assassination, you just have to guess when it will and will not work as the option doesn't show up in the UI.  It's as if they made the decision to implement the "you have to buy this" feature late in the development cycle, so the programmers just hid it from the interface.  You can also do leap of faith before Arno learns it.  In fact, you have to do it before Arno learns it.

If anyone was wondering if we lost the modern era stuff in this game, worry not.  It's still there.  Pretty interesting stuff too.

Arno is wanted, so much so that if he is seen in a restricted area, no matter how many other random people are loitering around, he'll be pursued.  So with this in mind, he walks into a police station and randomly offers to help with the crime problem.  The only cop on duty isn't all that concerned, neither with a most wanted fugitive standing in front of him, nor with such an odd request, but a bored prisoner sets him to solving murder mysteries.  Why?  Because they wanted murder mysteries in the game.  They're not bad murder mysteries.  They just don't fit in at all.

The worse part, is that Arno is the single wimpiest assassin in the entire brotherhood.  Eagle vision wears off in a few moments, and needs to recharge.  He can't escape battle and heal over time.  Like Ezio, he needs healing bottles. Unlike Ezio, he can't find doctors all over the place.  He can't counter and do an instant kill.  He just gets some extra blows in and if he does it wrong he's off balance instead.  His attacks do a lot less damage than any prior assassin.  What he gets instead is...he can crouch.  Yep, we're giving up unlimited eagle vision, healing over time, and a deadly counter-attack for crouching.  Oh, and he can pick locks.  So basically we're trading in an assassin for a cat burglar.

If you can, bypass this one and try Rogue instead.  Rogue is the real A.C. game out this year, a true successor to Black Flag.  This one...had potential for true greatness and gave in to mediocre gimmicks instead.
profile.summary: They wimpified my assassin.

profile.description: With write speeds of up to 150MB/s, the SanDisk Extreme Go USB 3.1 Flash Drive lets you quickly copy and go. Up to 35X faster than standard USB 2.0 drives, so you can transfer a 4K movie to the drive in less than 40 seconds. The design keeps the retractable connector protected when not in use, and the included SanDisk Secure Access software provides password protection of your private files while leaving the rest of the drive available for sharing.
profile.reviewText:
Fast, fast, fast.  It came formatted FAT (I think for Mac support), which means no support for files larger than 4 gig.  I changed mine to NTFS to use in Linux and Windows.  In Windows, the easy way to do that is with the convert command "convert <drive letter> /fs:ntfs"  In Linux, it depends on your distro, but then, if you're only using Linux, you won't be using NTFS.

I built an Ubuntu Virtual Machine on the drive, and have been running it across multiple machines, as swiftly and easily as if the VM were stored locally.  I can't think of a rougher stress test on performance, and it meets the challenge easily.  It's rugged, reliable, and comes with built in drive encryption for your protection.  Every OS I plug it into --Win 7, Win 8, Red Hat, Ubuntu, Debian -- recognizes it and mounts it with easy.  It's so convenient.  It holds my entire toolset.  I never go anywhere without it.
profile.summary: Super fantastic flash drive

profile.description: WD Blue WD10JPVX 1 TB SATA 6 Gb/s high-performance 8 MB cache 5400 RPM 2.5-inch 9.5mm internal mobile hard drive. SINGLE PACK
profile.reviewText:
I used this as an upgrade drive for the PS4.  It caused one reboot on installing a lot of software over a slow Internet connection (it was during the upgrade of the software, and might have been caused by that) but it has been running flawlessly ever since.

It is stable, reliable, and quiet.

Don't let the speed be an issue here.  Sony bullt at 5400 into the PS4 originally, so it will not need faster, and a faster drive could cause overheating. Two things to keep in mind when downloading the Sony firmware though.  First, the folder names are case sensitive.  PS4/UPDATE not ps4/update.  If you are going to use this to upgrade the PS3, a thing to keep in mind when installing the system software is that the PS3 has trouble reading larger thumb drives.  This nailed me when I tried a 120 gig drive.  I had to roll back to an 8 gig, that did the trick.

For a laptop or netbook, I would favor a faster drive, but for the budget conscious, this one is excellent.
profile.summary: Excellent for upgrading the PS4 hard drive

profile.description: The Alex Toys My First Sewing Kit will introduce children to the creative world of sewing. It's a skill that lasts a lifetime and can be used to make adorable stuffed animals,notebook covers and more. All the materials you need come in the charming carrycase that closes securely and has a handle for sewing on-the-go. Includes 28 pre-cut polyester felt shapes, 8 colors of embroidery floss (26ft/8m each), polyester stuffing(0.4oz/11g), fabric cloth (65% polyester/35% cotton), polyester ric rac(24in/60cm), scissors, measuring tape, 40 straight pins, 2 needles, thimble, cotton/polyesterpin cushion, polyester ribbon (12in/30cm), 6 buttons, pom pom strip (12in/30cm)and easy instructions. Recommended for children 7 to 12 years of age.
profile.reviewText: This possibly isn't the best starter kit for a child who has never sewn before. The instructions aren't that good. If the child has done any other sewing, or has anyone who can help (can be another kid) then this will provide a great deal of practice, which is where this really shines. There are quite a few projects here. There is a draw string bag, a stuffed cat, a stuffed dog, a stuffed elephant, and a book cover with pencil holder wrapper. For supplies, it has everything - scissor, tape measure, pins, pin cushion, button, even some extra stuff, like pop poms, that you won't need for any of the projects. There definitely is not even close to enough stuffing. It did not quite fill the cat, which is the first, and smallest, of the stuffed animal projects. You'll want to pick up something like Fairfield Poly-Fil Premium Polyester Fiber, White, 1 Bag, 12-Ounce. Any fiberfill will do, but this is a good one, similar to what is in the kit. While on the topic of stuffing, a double pointed knitting needle, or better http://www.amazon.com/Little-Foot-That-Purple-Thang-/dp/B001ELBCFG/ref=sr_1_1?ie=UTF8&qid=1464647654&sr=8-1&keywords=purple+thang will help get the stuffing into the tight areas, like the tails. Both the fiberfill and the thang will be useful items in a variety of sewing projects. For the embroidery floss, it says to cut the skein on one side to make lengths. That works, no issue, but it might be better to make a little yarn butterfly (really simple; instructions are online) so that you can pull the length you need for each section and the leftovers, and there will be plenty, can be used to make friendship bracelets. There is an excess of embroidery floss here.
profile.summary: Good practice.  Not enough fiberfill

profile.description: The stylish Logitech MK270 Wireless Keyboard and Mouse Combo is perfect for the home office or workplace. Ditch the touchpad for this full-size keyboard and mouse. Easily connect using Logitech's plug-and-forget receiverjust plug it into the USB port, and you're ready to work. There'sno lengthy installation procedure to slow you down. When you're on the move, the receiver stores comfortably inside the mouse. Both the keyboard and mouse included in the MK270 combouse wireless 2.4GHz connectivity to provide seamless, interruption-free use. Use the keyboard within a 10 m range without dropouts or keyboard lag. All of your information is securely transmitted to your computer using 128-bit AES encryption. Work for longer with the MK270's long battery life. Thekeyboard can be used for up to 24 months, and the mouse for 12 months, without replacing batteries. The Logitech MK270 keyboard includes 8 hotkeys that are programmable to your most-used applications to boost your productivity.
profile.reviewText:
If you download the software from the Logitech site, you can customize the buttons on top. I set the e-mail button to launch my e-mail provider's website.  Otherwise, it works right out of the box.  It works in Ubuntu and Windows, and is plug and play for both.

What I like best is that it's light, responsive, easy to set up, easy to turn on and off.

What I don't like is the mouse's responsiveness without a mouse pad.  With a mouse pad it's awesome.  Without one, it's uneven in terms of response speed.

I use it for presentations, when my laptop is sitting in the corner hooked up to a big monitor and I need to operate it from the meeting table.  It's perfect, and I've had excellent responsiveness at ten feet.
profile.summary: Long range, comfortable tool

profile.description: Founded in 1993, kate spade new york aims to inspire colorful living through their handbags and clothing to jewelry, shoes, stationery, eyewear, children & baby, fragrance, home dcor & tech.
profile.reviewText:
It's hard to tell by the picture, but this is a decent sized clutch.  I put an iPhone 6s Plus still in a folio case that was also stuffed with cards and a few bills in the phone compartment and it fit will, so I can't imagine what phone won't fit.  It's very large.  The phone compartment is in the middle (the smallest compartment), but honestly, you can pick either of the three and it's fine.  The back compartment has three card slots.  The front one is plain.

It's elegant.  It has a cute wrist strap that actually looks sturdy enough to handle reasonable use.  It's perfect for times when you don't want to carry too much with you.  Despite the glimmering appearance, the case looks more than sturdy enough for its intended purpose.
profile.summary: Beautiful, perfect size, and well made

profile.description: The fabulously famous dice game, introduced over fifty years ago, continues to delight millions of players! Same styling as the original game with aluminum rimmed dice cup, five dice, scorepad and bonus chips.
profile.reviewText: I loved Yahtzee as a kid, and have only recently rediscovered how much fun it is. You can play it alone (beat your own high score) you can play it with as large a group as you like. This kit comes with the dice and score sheets (naturally), the instructions, a shaker cup (metal, I'm guessing tin, and very cute) and Yahtzee bonus chips. I never knew there were bonus chips in Yahtzee, for if you roll a second Yahtzee, and none of my friends seemed to know it either. Or that Yahtzee could be used as a joker. The instructions cover all the details. I'd recommend picking up some Yahtzee 80 Score Cards as well, as there are only about 20 in the box. It's a great game that never gets old.
profile.summary: Classic game for all ages

profile.description: The five senses maxi mug, a small beautiful mug for those who wants to hold their mug with two hands. Whether at the breakfast table, on the desk or in the bathroom, the dark blue touch! band simply makes it elegant. The patented Kahla Touch! cup is food safe, dishwasher safe and microwave safe and is isolated from excessive heat. The Kahla porcelain mug is almost completely enclosed with different colorful soft coating. It keeps your fingers safe from the heat of the drinks and even cold drinks stay cool longer due to the soft coating. , Microwave safe , Dishwasher safe , Color: touch! dark blue Size: , Height: 11 cm , Diameter Ã: 8 cm , Volume: 350 ml Kahla article number: 394605A24120C , Pack contains:1 Kahla Touch! Five Senses Maxi Mug, Coffee Cup, Porcelain, Dark Blue, 350 ml, 394605A24120C
profile.reviewText:
This is slowly becoming my favorite cup.  I like the look of it.  It's simple yet interesting.  It's elegant.  The size is perfect both in what it can hold and the way it fits the hand.  It's longer and narrower, which means it holds temperature (hot or cold) longer.  Less of the surface of the liquid is exposed to air.  It is hand washable, machine washable, and I have put it in the microwave without issue.

I don't like the fact that, for a while after you get it, the felt sheds.  I don't like drinking felt.  If you think that felt is going to act like insulation for a hot drink, forget it, especially if the felt is wet.  It can get pretty hot pretty fast.  While I use it for coffee, I don't think I could comfortably hold a hot cup of coffee in it for very long.
profile.summary: Slowly becoming a favorite cup

profile.description: Parrot Mini Drone Rolling Spider - Bluetooth 4.0 Controlled Robotic Toy-Fly & RollWhite. For any further queries please contact Parrots Technical Support team at 877-9PARROT (972-7768) or online at http://www.parrot.com/usa/support/hotline.Parrot tutorial videos are available here:  Set up process: http://youtu.be/BsTvOozjcxg  Easy piloting maneuvers: http://youtu.be/YOcjtbAxzR4  Advanced piloting & wheels and ace mode: http://youtu.be/OxDhzyElL1s.We recommend customers to update their Rolling Spider to the latest firmware version to enjoy the new improvements brought for Rolling Spider
profile.reviewText:
I'm kind of them on this. It has its flaws no doubt, but it is a lot of fun.

The app you need is Free Flight 3. It doesn't say that anywhere in the instructions.  There are training videos on YouTube that are helpful in figuring out how to use this. Definitely worth watching. The app itself is unintuitive and hard to use. Once you get used tip it, though it's pretty cool.

The drone can handle crashing into just about anything, and I know this because we were so bad at this we crashed it  into just about everything except the cat. The cat didn't want to be in the same room with it. The blades can't break skin if you crash it into yourself. We had that happen too. The axle gets very hot from the friction though.

I like that is so tiny it can launch off your hand and fly or roll it indoors. I don't like the battery life. You get about five minutes of play time per charge. I like the appearance of the drone. It's very cute and comes with stickers.

Overall it's entertaining, but the battery life needs to improve before it's worth more than three stars.

The battery
profile.summary: Fun but needs better battery life.

profile.description: The Polk Striker ZX headset is the Xbox One solution for the way you like to game. Designed for Xbox One, the Striker ZX connects you with a high performance immersive audio experience that will take you deeper into games, music and movies. Moreover, its world-class design combines functional style with featherweight comfort to keep you focused on gaming. Polk has developed its own wireless headset adapter that connects you wirelessly to the Xbox One console and gives you complete chat functionality, as well as enables you to control both your game and chat volume mix. With a retractable mic and chat loop feature you will never have to scream to be heard in game. Any way you like to game, there's only one way to listen.
profile.reviewText:
It comes with a USB cable to update the controller.  I found that odd, but convenient.  I can always use extra cables.  The adapter has controls to increase game sounds, increase chat sounds, mute the microphone (it lights up if the mike is muted--a very convenient feature) and it can turn up and down the volume as a whole.  The audio cable is standard, so you can use it in anything else that works with a headphone.  The microphone retracts well enough to be invisible if you don't know to look for it.  I used it for a bit with my 3DS and it worked fine for that.  The audio cable is permanently attached, and I do not like that design choice.  The cable is the single most likely part to break (worse for me because my cat chews these cables, but true in general).  A port with a swappable cable would increase the lifespan of these headphones, and would offer choices in terms of swapping to a longer cable, a shorter cable.  A more modular design is always a better choice.

It's a good size for a female. The microphone is well places (more on that in a bit) and the headset fits well and is comfortable.  It's lightweight, comfortable, and easy to wear for long gaming sessions.  The padding was soft without being annoying or sweaty.  The ear cups don't annoy the ears the way some can after a long while.

As I said, the microphone sits well.  It sits exactly where other headsets I have used sits.  For me at least, position isn't a problem.  The problem is that the pickup is lacking.  If I speak at a normal level--and here I admit to being fairly soft spoken-- it doesn't fully pick up my voice.  It echoes in the headset, and does that very well.  It reminds me of the studio setup I had back when I was podcasting  It's that kind of quality echo back.  That's my largest issue with these, and the reason they lose a star.  They might have gone to three stars but for the sound field.

The sound field is astounding.  I had to keep taking the headset off to see if I was really hearing through the headset and not the speakers.  The sounds are directional and adequately distant to give the audio illusion of space and positions in space.  I have never heard audio this good from headsets in this price range.  That's where this headset truly shines.  The sound quality, the range of base and treble, and the sound clarity is impressive as well. In fact, if you're looking for a set so that you can watch shows or play without the noise bothering anyone else, and the mike isn't an issue (or if you naturally have a loud voice) you are going to be hard pressed to find anything better than these.
profile.summary: Pickup is weak, sound field is amazing

profile.description: With the sleek, high-performance Panasonic Immersion Blender, you can prepare everything from smoothies and salsas to baby foods and soups more quickly and efficiently than you ever imagined. Its soft-touch, non-slip handle fits comfortably in your hand. And a stainless-steel, straight-blade cutting system - powered by a step-less, variable speed 210W motor - delivers the precision and control to process virtually any food or quantity. For maximum convenience, the deluxe, stainless-steel blending shaft reaches easily into pitchers and deeper bowls and pots. Durable and dishwasher safe, the Panasonic Immersion Blender comes with accessories that include a food processor attachment and bowl, whisk attachment, gradated blending beaker and easy-mount wall rack for easy storage.
profile.reviewText:
I haven't tried the nut grinding component yet.  We have a friend with nut allergies, so don't often use them.  However the egg whisk is really nice.  Makes for fluffy eggs.  The main attachment does a great job with smoothies, and fits in the beaker with barely room on any side, which means it mixes the smoothie well, without fruit bits hiding in the corners.  I tried it on some pancake batter on a lark -- figured it can't do any damage -- and it's not quite up to that, but it never said it would be.  It just seemed powerful enough I thought it worth a try.

What I like best is that the immersed components detach, so you can easily thoroughly clean the blades without worrying about getting the motor or electronic parts wet.  They snap on security and go on and off easily.  I think that's a brilliant design choice.

The only thing I don't like is that it is pulse only, which is normal for the type given that you can easily overheat this style of blender by letting them run too long.  It's not suggested for ice or very hard items.

It's a lot quieter than our old one, which is really nice.  It's comfortable in the hand and easy to use.  On a lark I tried it left handed, and it works just as well that way for the southpaws.
profile.summary: Nicely designed immersion blender

profile.description: Learn-A-Craft: Counted Cross Stitch. Learn a classic art! This collection of needle art kits is perfect for beginners with their simple, yet fun designs. This kit contains 11 count white Aida, 3" embroidery hoop for stitching and finishing, cotton thread, needle, and easy-to-follow instructions designed for a beginner. Finished size: 3". Design: Dog: Perky Puppy. Designer: Todd Trainer. WARNING: Choking Hazard-small parts and functional sharp objects. Not for children under 3 years. Made in USA.
profile.reviewText:
Dimensions is fast becoming my go-to manufacturer for learning new needlecraft; they make it easy.

There are ample illustrations for everything, along with well-written text instructions.  The hoop that comes with the kit will double as a cute frame when the puppy is done. The chart shows clearly where to start and end every backstitch row (a technique that was my bane until this kit). The strands are stored in an organizer, where every thread is labeled by color code number.  This seems to be true across the board for Dimensions kit, as they do this in the Samurai and Geisha kits as well, and it makes more sense there, where you're separating beige from tan.

I suspect they listen to Amazon reviews.  An earlier reveiwer mentioned they didn't teach how to knot the beginning and end.  In my kit, it's explained that you start by trapping the end as you go (this is illustrated in the instructions) and you end by running the thread under the stitches on the back (again, this is illustrated).  I suspect this additional information was added in response to that review.

It comes with an embroidery needle, and if you're an old school needlepointer like me, don't worry that you can't find it poked into the canvas.  It's in a little bag folded into the instructions.
profile.summary: A fabulous introduction to a fabulous craft

profile.description: NEW MEGA MORPHIBIANS from Kid Galaxy! It's an animal, it's a 4x4, it's a speed boat........ no it's a Morphibian! These high-performance radio control amphibious creatures can go anywhere! Dirt, sand, pond or pool; No terrain is too tough or too wet. Featuring sturdy 4x4 turf digging tires for land and wake forming paddle wheel treads for ripping through the water. If you love racing, you'll love the Mega Morphibians Crocodile companion creatures; Mega Morphibian Turtle, Mega Morphibian Snake and Mega Morphibian Lobster, all available now! Easy to use and Fun for Everyone Age 3 years and up.
profile.reviewText:
This is a lot of fun and very easy to steer.  One thumb pad controls the left wheels and the other controls the right. Forward and reverse are both powered.  The detailing, like the eyes and mouth, seem painted on, not stickers, and they hold up to water very well.

It floats, but the bottom tends to fill up with water, and you have to turn it this way and that to get it to all pour out. It's surp how much water it takes on.  The battery compartment and the antenna are well above the water line when it is floating.  It moves somewhat faster on land than on water.

Check out the instructions on the box regarding the battery. IGetting into the case is not intuitive.  It takes 3 AA for the vehicle and 1 9V for the controller. Batteries not included.
profile.summary: Fun, and yes, it floats

profile.description: Cookie Monster brings home the fun of Sesame Street in a big way as an adorable oversized plush figure. Squeeze, cuddle, hug--little hands might not be able to put down this super soft 20-inch Cookie Monster plush! Collect them all for even more super-sized fun. (Each sold separately.) Sesame Street and associated characters, trademarks and design elements are owned and licensed by Sesame Workshop. Hasbro and all related terms are trademarks of Hasbro.
profile.reviewText:
It's a reasonably good representation of Cookie Monster, but how impressive is it to emulate a puppet?

I dislike the hands in that they are flat with no filling. They look unnatural and wrong.  I absolutely hate the eyes.  They aren't googly, as would be suggested by the picture.  They are like two pool balls glued together and painted.  They're really hard, so if your child hits himself/herself with it, it will hurt.  This coming from someone who managed to bonk herself in the nose on pulling it from the box.  If your child is in the bites on everything stage, you don't want them biting on those eyes.  The stitching is good, but I found a few snarls in the thread.  Not very noticeable, but enough to show a lower grade of craftsmanship.

For an adult as memorabilia or part of a casual collection, it's pretty good.  For a serious collector it has quality flaws that would suggest against it.  For a child, those eyes are enough of a problem I would advise against it.
profile.summary: The eyes are too hard

profile.description: The Siberia P300 High-Performance Gaming Headset is the ultimate choice for luxurious comfort and stunning natural audio on the PlayStation 4 and other devices. The iconic Siberia suspension headband comes to PlayStation 4 offering enduring, lightweight comfort for hours of gaming. Powerful, next-gen SteelSeries speaker drivers offer a rich soundscape - hear details other headsets miss. Noise reducing memory foam ear cushions aid in isolating the natural sounds and powerful bass while keeping out outside noise. A retractable, flexible crystal-clear microphone can be muted with the flip of a switch behind the earcup. The 3.5mm jack simply plugs in to your PlayStation 4 controller and works great on almost everything else too.
profile.reviewText:
As has been pointed out, they do not work on the PS3 as advertised.  They are for the PS4 only.  There is a separate audio cable that goes into microphone in and headphones out of a PC.  When I use that, I get sound in one ear only, so not recommended for that purpose.  I'm dinging it one star for lack of PS3 support.

They are very comfortable, and both the headset and sound quality are excellent.  Plug them in and the system immediately recognizes them.  I needed to go into the accessories menu and lower the volume, because the mike pickup is very good, and I'm excessively soft spoken,  The poor guy at the deli has to practically lean over the counter to hear me.  These were popping into the red zone for me.  They could easily pick up someone calling in from the next room.

The cable is very long, enough so that you can put the controller off to the side without taking off the headset.  This would be useful for a game like Final Fantasy: A Realm Reborn.  You could talk to your friends, while using a keyboard for emotes and the like (is mine the only group that likes dancing in the dungeon?)  The microphone too is fairly long and easy to properly position.

They work well with portable electronics.  I used them on an iPad Air and got stereo sound of respectable quality.  Pretty much anything with a 3.5mm jack can use them as headphones.

The mute button is easily reached, and one of the main reasons I wanted these.  I'm kind of tired of running co-op missions in Assassin's Creed Unity where the other player doesn't have a headset.  So they can hear everything on my end, and I can hear nothing on theirs, and I figure I'm probably annoying them with the meow of a cat interfering with the in game sound.  So the ability to rapidly mute and unmute depending on who I get paired with matters a lot.  It's really easy with these, even without taking the headset off.  Just slide the only button (and a fairly large one) on the left earpiece and you're either chatting or silent.  Easy.

They take no adjustment, but they need none.  They kind of adjust themselves.  They don't get sweaty, even in July.
profile.summary: No PS3, meh for PC, awesome for PS4.

profile.description: The OPOLAR desk, clip and wall mountable fan is one of the most versatile USB fans on the market. With two speeds, three options for use and a big air flow, the OPOLAR fan stands out while the others get blown down. At OPOLAR we offer the performance and customer experience. Why priced a little higher than the others? This is the biggest USB fan and has the most powerful airflow on the market. The size plus the different usability options means we've priced it just a little bit higher than the others. What other fans offer quality like ours? The fan is designed with 3 years' service life and one year limited warranty provided specifically by OPOLAR. What's the advantage? 1. Three different mounting options for setting it up at any place. 2. Omni-bearing adjustment for different wind directions. 3. Two fan speeds so you get the airflow that suits you. 4. Quiet operation never bothers you - ideal if used when going to sleep. 5. Durable casing protects the fan in case it gets dropped or knocked.
profile.reviewText:
This is surprisingly well designed.  I received a sample in exchange for a review, so I did not know the price at first and after using it a while I had it pegged as something much more expensive.

It clamps onto darn near anything.  I clamped it on the back of my desk.  It needs a large enough surface to clamp to, but once it's on, it's on.  It doesn't slide no matter how long you leave the fan going.

You can plug it into a USB hub, the computer, a USB charger. For amusement I plugged it into the USB port of my PS4. No trouble even with low power adapters.

It has two speeds, on and off, nothing in between, and on is pretty strong for a little fan.  I  need to be mindful the papers when I have it turned on.

The fan part adjusts up or down 360 degrees.  Angle it h however you like.  Put it in place and it stays there.

It's cute.  The colors are just a little retro.  It's effective.
profile.summary: Easy to position, surprisingly powerful

profile.description: Protect your Kindle Fire HDX 8.9" display from harm with the Marware Clear Screen Protector Kit 2-pack. This special film fits precisely around the device display. It guards against scratches and spills without distorting the viewing experience.  Application Instructions: 1. Use the cleaning cloth (provided) to thoroughly clean the display. 2. Peel off the corner of the BACK outer layer (Tab 1). 3. Align the exposed corner edge with the corresponding edge of the device display. 4. Slowly peel away the rest of the BACK outer layer (Tab 1) from underneath. Make sure the screen protector remains aligned with the display. 5. As you peel away the BACK outer layer (Tab 1), run your fingers along the top of the FRONT outer layer (Tab 2). 6. Slowly peel back the corner of the FRONT outer layer (Tab 2) until you peel it completely off. 7. Use the applicator card (provided) to smooth out any air bubbles. For best results, push the bubbles away from the center of the display. 8. Use the cleaning cloth (provided) to wipe away any remaining fingerprints or smudges. 9. **NOTE** some small air bubbles may require 24 hours to disappear.
profile.reviewText: It was very difficult to put these on.  For the first one I followed the scant directions on peeling as you go, using the enclosed little card to push out bubbles ... and push out bubbles ... and push out bubbles.  An hour later I pulled the first one off and started over.  This time I went my normal route of pulling the back off all at once and pushing the bubbles out from the center.  And pushing the bubbles.  And ....  you get the idea.  Ninety minutes after that I gave up.  I've used a great many screen protectors and these come with a generous supply of extra added bubbles.  I simply could not get the screen to look right with these on.  They most certainly do the job of protecting the screen, but the value of a glorious high definition screen is lost through all the distortions.
profile.summary: More bubbles than the average screen protector

profile.description: Hot on the heels of last years summer blockbuster, Dragon Ball Z is back in theaters. Dragon Ball Z: Resurrection F is the second film personally supervised by the series creator Akira Toriyama, following Battle of Gods. The new movie showcases the return of Frieza  one of the anime worlds greatest villains. Frieza has been resurrected and plans to take his revenge on the Z-Fighters of Earth. Goku and Vegeta must reach new levels of power in order to protect Earth from their vengeful nemesis.
profile.reviewText:
This plays with much of the plot from Dragonball Super (which needs to come to the US already!).  Frieza is resurrected with the help of the newly upgraded dragon balls of earth (now Shenlong grants two wishes, the second one used is sort of a throwaway, so no reason to introduce it here).  He trains.  The Z-fighters train.  They come together in an exceedingly predictable fight and kick the snot out of each other.

And it is so much fun.  Beerus is a trip the entire time.  Vegeta is at the top of his form, so much better than the last movie, Goku is that crazy combination of serious and funny that makes him so delightful and Krillian kicks it old school.  This is the movie for a grab a beer and shut of the brain night after a hard day of work.  This is pure fun, total brain candy, and absolutely worth it.  Fans will love it.
profile.summary: Fun, fluffy but fun

profile.description: New formula for enhanced root development. Why does Eco-Complete planted aquarium substrate outperform other products? For the same reason that Hawaii, Bali and Costa Rica are famous for lush, exuberant plant growth. The secret lies in rich basaltic volcanic soil which contains iron, calcium, magnesium, potassium, sulfur plus over 25 other elements to nourish your aquatic plants. Eco-Complete Planted Aquarium Substrate is mineralogically and biologically complete, giving you luxuriant aquatic plant growth without nuisance algae. Iron rich Eco-Complete eliminates the need for laterite. No artificial dyes, paints, or chemical coatings. Eco-Complete has highly porous spherical grains for optimum diffusion performance and contains live Heterotrophic bacteria to rapidly convert fish waste into natural food for your aquatic plants. It establishes a natural biological balance which makes cycling a new aquarium faster and safer.
profile.reviewText:
WARNING: Open this in the tank. I nearly screwed that up, but decided I was clumsy enough if I didn't, I'd have soil all over the floor. As soon as I got it open water poured out. It filled about an inch of my 20 gallon. Once all the soil was out, the water sat in puddles on top of it.

I put grass seeds on it, and within a week they were sprouting quite well. This seems a great foundation for a planted aquarium.

When I poured the water it moved, but didn't cloud things up, and I'm very happy about that. I thought I'd need to wait a while for it to settle, but there was no need. It did leave a little divot that three of the guppies like to play in. The guppies seem very happy with this. When I move the frog and cory in, I'll post how they seems to take to it. They will be the fussiest residents.
profile.summary: Bag comes with a lot of water. Soil is great.

profile.description: Test the creator in yourself  The Maker kit is our entry kit or a perfect gift for a birthday or Christmas party. It features 80 connectors in two random colours, 50 straws, and an instructions manual. Start exploring the Strawbees universe by building a bridge, a crane or your favourite animal. Our mission and promise at Strawbees is to ensure that our products provide a catalyst for you or your child to play in a smart, creative and collaborative way. By promising that, we ensure kids and grown-ups alike are challenged to grow as creative thinkers and collaborative problem solvers. Learning through play helps us to make sense of the world around us and provides opportunities to develop social and cognitive skills. Strawbees: Dream big, build bigger!
profile.reviewText:
These are so cute, I love them.  There are two larger kits at the time of this writing, but this is a good one to start with.

I was given a sample for review, and I wasn't entirely sure what this was going to be about.  Reading the instructions, the first two rules are have fun, and don't follow the rules and you can really do both with this kit.  I like to preview toys before giving them to a certain pair of children, because if there is a way to get hurt or hurt someone else with a toy, these two will find it.  I feel very confident giving them these, but I'll probably buy one size larger because it is for two children.  It's designed to let the kids play together, which is really cool.

The projects not only skill build, but if you're paying attention, you can start skipping bits of the instructions because it's easy to figure out, and that in turn develops the skills of figuring things out.  In fact the guide bemoans how often we mindlessly follow the guides and don't think.  Thinking is encouraged with this.  Experimentation is the game.

And you can make some silly things, some that actually do stuff.  I don't think the trebuchet will fire (it's not weighted) but even if the trouble twins find a way to get it to do that, it's straws, it can't hold that much weight.  I hope.

Overall, this is great for curious kids who like to build an experiment and the parents who want to let them do it safely.
profile.summary: A great introductory kit

profile.description: OurPets Hid & Go Squeak Interactive Cat Toy has random motion of three mice that bob at different intervals to catch the kitty's attention.
profile.reviewText:
The cats are just not amused.  My most adventurous little one considered playing with it, but the bouncing mice kept hitting her in the nose and she decided that wasn't much fun.  She refused to go near it after the first few minutes, at least not when it's on.  She'll sniff it a little when it's off, and she spent a few minutes trying to pull a mouse out before she got bored. Her sister will sometimes play with it for a few minutes at a time when it's turned off, but is also opposed to the nose-bopping action, making me think I should just take the batteries out.  She loves her toys, so it's unusual for her not to be captivated for quite a while once she gets involved with one.  My oldest sniffed it once and has not paid it any attention since.

You'll need 3 AA batteries.  You'll also need a small screwdriver to get at the battery component.
profile.summary: The cats don't bother with it much

profile.description: Create personalized blended drinks with the BLACK+DECKER FusionBlade Personal Blender. Perfect for single servings, the blender comes with a pair of 20oz jars with twist-on travel lids to keep your beverages in place no matter where you go. The powerful stainless steel FusionBlade makes customized beverages for any occasion. Its designed to crush ice and blend foods and liquids evenly so you can mix some drinks for a night in or create a protein shake to take to the gym.
profile.reviewText:
I used this to blend a diet shake and it did a great job there, but that I expected.  Then I used it to blend a smoothie, and following its directions of what to add first (I never would have thought that makes a difference, but it does) it does a great job of it.  Doing it my old way it worked about as well as any similar high grade blender -- I needed to keep stopping to mix things around, which I didn't doing it their way -- so I highly recommend following their instructions there.

You can either push the button in a little for a pulse type blend, or all the way and it stays on until you press it to turn it off.

The only thing that annoyed me, and it annoyed me enough to ding it a star, is the lids.  They don't get fully out of the way and sit on your nose while you're using them.  I really don't like that weird added loop either.  I guess it's to use to hook it off a clasp for a backpack or something, but It would tilt at a strange angle and I'd as soon not do that.
profile.summary: Great blender; hate the lids

profile.description: The research teams are outfitted and ready to embark on their adventures to find five forgotten cities. Who will lead the way to fantastic discoveries? Each player guides a team of explorers on up to five expeditions. To advance along an expedition path, a card in the paths color must be played for each step forward. The card must be of equal or greater value to the players card previously played on that path. After playing or discarding a card, the player draws a new card. Skilled team leaders assess when to play, hold, or discard their cards to move their own teams forward while at the same time preventing their opponent teams from getting ahead. Points are awarded based on how far the explorers make it along their paths. Each step earns more points than the one before it, and the first three steps earn negative points. Along the way, players can increase points by finding artifacts, victory points, and shortcuts forward. The player with the most points at the end of the game wins!
profile.reviewText:
You can move your five explorers (you don't need to use them all) on any of five paths.  You can move one square forward on each color if you play a card of that color that is higher than the last card you played.  So if you play a two, you can play a three or a four etc, to move forward.  You can't play a lower card, but you can discard it, and your opponents can pick it up.  Along the way you get bonus points and artifacts to raise your score.  Three rounds makes a game.

This game is supposed to take 30 minutes to an hour, but I have yet to find even a three player version go that fast.  There is too much strategy and planning involved.  You need to think about what cards you need now, what you need later, what your opponents might use if you discard a card, and how many "for later" cards you can retain.  You need to decide when to bite the bullet and take a big number jump (limiting your later moves) and when to hold off.

It definitely plays better with more than two players.  It's fast to learn, and a lot of fun.
profile.summary: Minutes to learn, but complex in its strategy

profile.description: fccc
profile.reviewText:
This is a very nice, basic cable.

I am surprised that the description does not mention Ethernet support.  That concerned me, as it just looks neater having one cable in place of two.  However, the cable is printed that it does support Ethernet, and testing it, this is the case.  I plugged one end into a receiver that has an Internet connection, the other end into a Raspberry Pi that has no WiFi dongle and it was able to download a file from my DropBox account.  I suppose that's such a standard feature, it's not worth mentioning anymore.

The cable seems sturdy enough, but I almost never put my cables through hard use.  I set them up and leave them alone.  The ends are stiff against bending, which means added support for the most fragile connection.  It's reasonably thick, doesn't seem prone to tangling, and does exactly what it should.  I am pleased with it.
profile.summary: HDMI cable with Ethernet

profile.description: GoWISE USA Ultra Air 42" Multifunctional Tower Fan  This sleek and stylish slim tower fan is designed to fit in the corner of any room and enrich room dcor. Its engineered to make less noise while producing high air flow. This noiseless multfunctional tower fan has 3 different speed controls and airflow patterns while oscillating. 90 degree oscillation for refreshing air circulation or cool relief on a warm day. The three different air patterns are designed to cater to your needs, whether you are sleeping or just need of some cool air. This tower fan comes with an LED screen that displays the room temperature and the fans current settings. Settings can be adjusted with the remote control that features a wide range options or with the built-in control panel. The remote control can be conveniently stored inside of control panel located at the top of the tower. This fan also has a programmable 12-hour timer function, that is can be set in 1-hour increments. It comes with a removable column to extend the fan's height from 32 to 42. GoWISE USA Ultra Air Tower fan has a built-in control panel at the top for access to the settings - fan speed, airflow patterns, and the 12-hour timer. This Ultra Air fan can be easily assembled, no tools required. It operates on a 120V AC outlet. Plug it in and instantly feel refreshed with noiseless cool air.
profile.reviewText:
It oscillates just shy of 180 degrees, as far  as I can tell.  It has three static speeds and two dynamic modes.  You can either have night or forest, and both do a decent job of replicating the wind patterns of those conditions,  it's very quiet most of the time, but you will hear the difference when it goes up and down speeds in a mode condition.  I find it soothing, as it sounds just like the wind.

I don't like that it does not have a reverse, say if I want to blow cooking smoke out the window.  I don't like that it doesn't remember the last setting.  It always starts, static, low, non oscillating, no matter what you had it one when you turned it off.

I like that it adjusts in size.  It's not easy to switch between the two sizes.  Pick one at assembly and stay with it, or you're basically redoing the assembly.  I like the different modes.  I like the power it has.  It can really cool the room.  I love the remote control.  It responds from anywhere in the room and it's really small and convenient.  There is a holder for the remote built into the fan, but if you have to walk over to the fan to get the remote, it kind of kills the purpose for the remote.
profile.summary: Quiet, feature-rich, powerful fan.

profile.description: Tea time, anyone? Steep your tea on-the-go with this removable stainless steel tea infuser for the AUTOSEAL West Loop Travel Mug. This top-rack dishwasher safe set includes three detachable parts: the stainless steel basket, the mug clip (which snaps securely into any West Loop lid), and the blue drip cup to make transporting a cinch once steeping in the tumbler is complete. We'll bring the biscuits.
profile.reviewText:
The biggest issue I have with infusers is when the mesh isn't fine enough, bits of tea leaves go floating into the water.  That is the one and only advantage of bagged tea.  The mesh here is perfect--nothing escapes.  It first firmly in the mug and has a nice blue cover to keep it from leaking after.  It's very easy to clean.  The entire thing disassembles.

It's a trick to get calibrated to it.  You need enough water to immerse the infuser, but not so much as to have it spill out due to displacement.  There is no fill line, so it takes a bit of doing to get used to it.

The only issue I had was that, with the auto-seal mug, it seems to thwart the release mechanism.  Basically, you need to press a button in the back to pull back a bit of plastic that covers the opening in the front, so to drink.  It works great, but with this infuser in place, pushing the button doesn't pull back the plastic, so you can't drink your tea.  I don't think this will be an issue with other mugs.
profile.summary: Well made, should work in most Contigo mugs.

profile.description: Wired keyboard and wired mouse bundle An Amazon Brand.
profile.reviewText:
I plugged them into the Raspberry Pi and they worked immediately.  If they work on that, they'll work on anything.  I've had some keyboards do some funny things on the Pi--it's known for some oddball compatibility issues.

Or rather, they did work, until the cat chewed through the mouse wire.  She's not a very bright cat.  She knows something about cats eating mice and figured she'd give it a go.  The keyboard is still intact, and it's doing great.

I found another Amazon mouse sitting around, so I popped it in (and I lock the entire thing in my desk now to keep it from being chewed) but if I need another set for the Pi, I'm picking up another of these.
profile.summary: Quality keyboard and mouse at a good price; works on Raspberry Pi

profile.description: ALEX DIY Knot A Quilt Kit is an easy way to instantly create a super soft quilt. There is absolutely no cutting, sewing or knitting involved! Simply tie the pre-cut fringe squares together one by one. The fleece squares come in 6 bright colors. Kids will be able to knot a 3.5 foot by 4.5 foot quilt in no time! Includes 48 fringed 9 inch squares. Recommended for children 6 years of age and older.
profile.reviewText:
I'm using this as an adult.  Don't judge.  At least it's not a coloring book.  It is weirdly compelling.  I knit.  I crochet.  I don't lack for crafting options, but sometimes it's nice to have something that's simple and relaxing and this fills that need.  It's a sort of quick craft -- I've been on it for a few weeks now, which is certainly less time than even a crocheted blanket, but not instant gratification -- and it's easy.  It's incredibly relaxing, so much so that I've already ordered the chevron version (which I will work on when I should be working on my Grandmother's Flower Garden quilt) and will probably pick up more.  The resulting blanket is very soft and comfortable.

There is a right side and a wrong side to the squares.  I realized this halfway into the second row (that could be because I started while watching a movie in the dark).  It's good to be mindful of that from the start.

I find that it's easiest to knot the first and last ties, then a few  spaced in the middle, to reduce the risk of skipping one and having to start over.  If you need to unknot, a double pointed knitting needing does a great job of opening the knot.

I also found some of the pieces not perfectly cut (thin strands hold them together) so keeping a scissor at hand is convenient.

Crafty people of all ages will adore this.
profile.summary: A great de-stress project for adults too

profile.description: CDN ProAccurate Quick-Read Digital Thermometer: NSF approved. 6-8 second response. Water proof and shatter proof. Data-hold. Big digit. Food-safe abs plastic. Recalibratable. On/off button. Temperature guide on sheath. Sheath can be used as handle extension. Mounting: pocket clip. Lr44 button battery included.
profile.reviewText:
This is my first standalone cooking thermometer.  I have always tried to sort of kind of guess if things are done or cook according to time.  Then I got a slow cooker with a built in thermometer and cooking to internal temperature makes such a difference.  I was hooked.

This little thermometer measures the temperature of food in seconds, has a hold button in case it's hard to read it in the over (I have a top range, so that can be a problem for me) and cleans easily.  It is so simple to use, I am in love.

The only downside is that the ideal temperatures are printed on the side of the container tube in a very small print.  I always have to look them up online.  But if you have really good eyes, having them at hand would be a plus.
profile.summary: Fast and easy to use

profile.description: A winner with audiences and critics alike, the Academy Award-Nominated DreamWorks Animation film, How to Train Your Dragon, rolls fire-breathing action, epic adventure and laughs into a captivating and original story. Hiccup is a young Viking who defies tradition when he befriends one of his deadliest foes  a ferocious dragon he calls Toothless. Together, the unlikely heroes must fight against all odds to save both their worlds in this "wonderful good-time hit!" (Gene Shalit, Today)
profile.reviewText:
First, this has little to nothing to do with the book of the same title.

Second, this is loads of fun.

Young Hiccup lives in a Viking village routinely raided by dragons (they don't leave because of "stubbornness issues").  He wants to train to fight dragons himself, but he's a skinny little boy, barely suited to the task.

When he finally does get his chance to kill a dragon, he learns very little is what it first seems, and that is true of himself as much as it is true about the dragons.

Thematically, this is about acceptance, and self-acceptance.  It's about using one's unique skills to succeed.  It's about looking deaper for the truth.

In tone, it's hillarious.  One character, on speaking of why they're going to hunt dragons, says "We're vikings.  It's an occupational hazzard."  It's suited to small children, even sensitive small children.  Adults will enjoy it too.
profile.summary: Great fun for kids and adults

profile.description: It's an 8-bit invasion when you build and collect your favorite pop-culture icons with kubros! now you can build your own Hunter figure block by block, complete with iconic details drawn from the original Destiny character class. Featuring the signature Hunter helmet, cloak, crest of Alpha lupi and gjallahorn weapon, this collectible figure brings it back to the old school with a blocky shape and retro-fied design inspired by the era of classic gaming. With its signature coin detail on the foot, and arms and head that move, you can pose your Hunter figure different ways for a showcase-worthy display. Collect all your favorite characters from movies, video games and more, and build your fandom with kubros! ideal for ages 10 and up.
profile.reviewText:
I can't resist comparing this to Lego.

First, the instructions aren't as good as I'm used to from any Lego model.  They are clear enough on their own, but only just.  Also, the bags aren't numbered so you can limit what you're working on at any time. It's also all but impossible to tell if you need the gold, maroon, grey, or black piece from the picture.  They look different on the pieces and way too similar in the guide.

Second, the pieces don't interlock quite as easily.  Oh, they stay together reasonably well, but they're sometimes hard to snap in.

The gun sits strangely.  He can't point it, only hold it across his chest.  I'd rather it be shorter and easier to articulate.

The ghost shifts around a bit, so that's cool.

It's on the easy side, so that's also a plus.

And it's Destiny. It wins a star just by being Destiny.  Destiny is cool.

Overall, not a first project, but not a bad one.
profile.summary: Not as good as Lego, but not bad

profile.description: High-Performance Vacuum - Great for Homes with Pets LET IT RUN. YOUR WORK IS DONE. While you do other things, Neato Botvac vacuums dirt, crumbs and dust bunnies from all floor types and every corner of your home. Ideal for pet owners and allergy sufferers.
profile.reviewText:
This thing is easy to use.  Literally, my cat can do it.  I woke up at midnight last night to find it merrily cleaning the apartment, with no human involvement at all.  That it finished two rooms, the first of which being my bedroom, before I noticed this should serve as a testament of how quiet it is.

You can program it to go off at set times (no, I did not set it for midnight) and it will take care of the house and then park itself on its charger.  You can trigger it manually with a single button on the top.  It will tell you when to clean the brush (I had to look on the website for instructions on how to do this -- it was a little atypical).  It will tell you when to empty the bin.  It comes with a giant roll of electrical tape to use to establish a "do not go here" zone.  Unlike Roombas, this will sort of plan its route, and then go back and forth as a human would.  Oddly, even though it always starts from the same spot, it does not always take the same path.  It does consistently find its way around an oddly shaped room.

It does an excellent job -- on par with any vacuum I have ever owned.  It digs into the corners with a ferocity.  It will go over the each area repeatedly, to be certain it didn't miss anything.  It has a powerful suction and two brushes, depending on need.

I love how easy it is to use, how convenient it is, and how great of a job it does.  Fair warning, if your pet likes to sit on it, you might have unexpected floor cleaning events.
profile.summary: So simple a cat can use it

profile.description: Chase! Scratch! Lounge! The Raceway Lounger will quickly become your cat's favorite spot. Prevue Pet Products Raceway Lounger 700 is a 3-in-1 compact activity center that is attractive, versatile and space-saving, designed for engaging play and kitty comfort. The motion-activated blinking LED light ball attracts and engages cats of all ages and the dense corrugated center pad is ideal for scratching or lounging.. Measures 24" Long, 14 1/4" Wide and 2 1/4" High. Lounging area measures 18 7/8" Long x 9 1/8" Wide. Our Raceway Lounger 700 includes a bag of catnip, sprinkle onto lounger pad for additional fun! Replacement corrugated Lounger pad (701) and LED Replacement Ball (702) also available.
profile.reviewText:
My cats love it, but each uses it for a different purpose.

Hikari uses it as lounger. At 10, he's not an old cat, but older yes. He loves his toys, usually and while this claims to be enticing to older cats as a toy, he's not into it. As a lounger, he loves it. I put it in the living room, and if we're in that room he's lying on it, at least unless one of the girls chases him off.

Shinta loves the scratching post. This thrills me because she's not good about scratching posts generally and I had all but given up trying to find one she'd use. It seems to hold up pretty well, and she's really digging into it, but if she manages to destroy it I plan to buy another. It was supposed to come with a bag of catnip, but there was no catnip in mine.

Aiko likes the ball, somewhat, and again surprising since she's never been much for toys. The battery is included, just pull the protective tab. There is a tiny hole on one side in which the ball sometimes gets a little stuck, but getting it loose seems to amuse her, so I'll call that a feature.

I've yet to see one cat use two of the features of this product, but each very much enjoys the one feature he or she uses. In the scratching pad and toy it has succeeded where other products have failed. That makes it a win with my group.
profile.summary: The cats love it

profile.description: Do you want to achieve a perfect creamy froth to create cafe-style lattes and cappuccinos? The Starbucks Verismo Milk Frother can create hot froth from your favorite milk (from dairy to almond to soy) and cold froth for the perfect iced beverage. Use with the Starbucks Verismo Brewer to create all the signature Starbucks Cafe beverages that you love. Plus, it's easy to use and easy to clean with auto shut-off, non-stick coating and dishwasher-safe parts. If you want to create high-quality, cafe-style beverages, the Verismo Milk Frother is for you.
profile.reviewText:
The thing has a bit of a trick. If you touch the button to turn it on, the indicator lights red and it froths and heats the milk. If you hold the button for three seconds instead, the indicator lights blue and it just froths the milk. There is no other way to set this. There is no other button on the entire device. It does not automatically shut off when done, or if it does, it's well past when I thought it was done and turned it off anyway.

I've tried it with nut milk and coconut milk and it froths both very well. Obviously regular 2% milk froths perfectly. I will advise against heat frothing coconut milk. It doesn't taste very good after that.

The cup lifts right off the motorized base for easy cleaning. It's fairly small and stores easily.
profile.summary: Unusual interface, but otherwise perfect

profile.description: Feed your herbivorous tropical fish a protein-rich diet scientifically formulated to promote healthy growth and cleaner, clearer water with API TROPICAL GREENS FLAKES Optimal Protein Food for Algae & Plant Eating Fish.
