profile.description: C.M. Johnson is a former teacher turned Accounting student in Tampa, Florida where she lives with her husband and write Tales of the Fifth Guardian in her spare time.
profile.reviewText:
It's the third book in the series and I can say that so far, this is the best one I've read out of the three. This is also the book that I enjoyed reading the most.

I don't know how far apart each was written and in as much as possible I don't comment on the author and focuses on the story but with this one, I can see how much the author grew. It's nice that as I read along, I can see that not only are the people in the book progressing and growing but that you can clearly see how the author improved her craft along the way. The long the narrations which I previously had a hard timing finishing was better on this book. There are still long narrations but I was able to enjoy them. And it is also the book in the series that didn't give me the urge to flip through the pages. Yes, that's how much I enjoyed reading this one.

I also like how the characters were now more mature in this one. You can see and feel that they grew as persons with the way they act and decide on things. There are still times when I get lost as to who is speaking to whom but not as much as it did before.

The character's adventure were something to look forward to just like the previous two books. And I think the part that I enjoyed the most is the fact that Kerrisha's visions don't bother me anymore. I don't know if I got used to how she is during the visions but I'd like to think that it's because that she now handles them better.

There are a few things that personally bothered me and it's all because of personal reasons and culture to. It was explained well by the author and I feel I should not comment on them but I still like to share.

One of them is the love scenes. Not all of them but some of them don't really sit well with me. Who ever read the book will know what I am talking about. I had a hard time accepting that this is happening and will probably still happen in future books. Who knows, maybe along the way I'd learn to get comfortable reading it too.

Second one was the way Kerrisha was crying at almost every turn of event. She's a strong character and I used to complain that she's too strong she's almost not human to me. And I guess crying made her more human but then maybe because I'm not the type of person that don't like other people seeing me vulnerable (a.k.a crying with an audience) I really really feel awkward when she does that, I almost want to yell at her to stop doing that. I blame it to the fact that she's pregnant in this book but still it was hard seeing her that way.

As you can see, I still gave it a five even if I pointed a couple of things that do not sit well with me. As I said I felt it's purely personal on my part as it was justified well by the author.

All in all, I'd say that I had fun, great adventure and even through the last part was very enjoyable for me even if I'm not the type of person who likes cliffhanger. I'd definitely read the next one.
profile.summary: Great read and definitely better than the first two.

profile.description: Ruth Cardello was born the youngest of 11 children in a small city in northern Rhode Island. She spent her young adult years moving as far away as she could from her large extended family. She lived in Boston, Paris, Orlando, New York - then came full circle and moved back to Rhode Island. She now happily lives one town over from the one she was born in. For her, family trumped the warmer weather and international scene. She was an educator for 20 years, the last 11 as a kindergarten teacher. When her school district began cutting jobs, Ruth turned a serious eye toward her second love- writing and has never been happier. When she's not writing, you can find her chasing her children around her small farm, riding her horses, or connecting with her readers online.
profile.reviewText:
My heart is still in my throat after reading Come Away with Me. I've been anticipating the story ever since word got out that Ruth is writing a new series about the Andrades. So here's my thoughts...

The way Gio and Julia met was kind of hilarious. With the meeting ending with Julia fleeing off the scene, I could almost see Gio's reaction to that and left my mouth hanging open. Right then, I know I won't be closing the book until I read the end.

Gio was one interesting character. The way he thinks, how he cares, how he wants to show he does not care, and a past that had him shut in his walls and me curious. I like the effect Julia has on him, the one that made him do the right thing even if it's something he would never ever thought of doing.

Julia on the other hand was all lovely. Not just with her looks but all the more with the beauty she is inside. I love the way she sees life, handles her road bumps and work her way through. I love how despite temptation she could held her head high and say no when it's wrong and even have the guts to walk away than just give in. The self preservation and honesty she has was refreshing and thrilling. It had me holding on waiting to what she's gonna do next or how she'll handle the next stone life's throwing in her way.

The two of them together was fun, heart melting, and hot as hell to read about. Their contrast complement each other making the story a wonderful ride to go through.

And much as I love the story between Gio and Julia, my attention was also hold up by his brothers. I think I fell in love with Nick. I ache for that smile of his that does not reach the eyes, the sadness that wanted me to give him a hug and tell him soon it's gonna be okay. Luke being the pacifier, made me curious of how he'll be if things get really out of hand he can't keep the cool anymore. And Max, he seemed like a ray of light in the darkness that is in the middle of them. The way he could smile amidst the tension made me feel that there's more of him inside than what meets the eye. And that journey to Isola Santos where I get a glimpse of how it felt like getting a chance to know the four of them was one of my favorite scenes.

One of the things I like best in Ruth's novel is the way she weave the character of each person in the story. Their personalities were created in such a way that everyone of them - whether they played a big part of the story or just a scene - mattered and you know that it wouldn't be the same at all without them. And, I'm really going with all of these because of that scene with little Anna. The innocence and enthusiasm girls her age have was a fine sight to see.

Of course, the fact that almost everyone from the Legacy series was in here was something I looked forward to. I see a lot of Dominic in Gio that I think once they get to know each other it could either be they become best pals or they'll be kicking each other's ass. I hope it's the former.

I love the way Gio conquered his past and chase for Julia. The proposal made me bleed for being overly romantic and over the top (all the expenses made me chuckle).

I also loved how things concluded with Julia's side of the family including her career. Atta girl!

All in all, this book is about romance that comes when you're not expecting it, about mending family bridges, and about chasing for dreams with all the fire that you have within you.
profile.summary: hot, sexy, funnny, romantic. I loved it!

I still don't like Jason very much nor care for him and Piper so much but they are okay. So is Hazel and Frank.

Percy and Annabeth will always have a special place in my heart. So I think it's a given that I like them.

Nico and Reyna's friendship touch so many feelings. It was a nice twist to the story. And Leo, I hope to read more of him in the next series too.

Uncle Rick did a great job in this last book to The Heroes of Olympus.

P.S.

Also, the audiobook version of the whole series which I borrowed from the library was great. The narrator did a wonderful job.
top_5.summary: I feel sad to see this series ends

top_5.description: C.M. Johnson is a former teacher turned Accounting student in Tampa, Florida where she lives with her husband and write Tales of the Fifth Guardian in her spare time.
top_5.reviewText:
It's the third book in the series and I can say that so far, this is the best one I've read out of the three. This is also the book that I enjoyed reading the most.

I don't know how far apart each was written and in as much as possible I don't comment on the author and focuses on the story but with this one, I can see how much the author grew. It's nice that as I read along, I can see that not only are the people in the book progressing and growing but that you can clearly see how the author improved her craft along the way. The long the narrations which I previously had a hard timing finishing was better on this book. There are still long narrations but I was able to enjoy them. And it is also the book in the series that didn't give me the urge to flip through the pages. Yes, that's how much I enjoyed reading this one.

I also like how the characters were now more mature in this one. You can see and feel that they grew as persons with the way they act and decide on things. There are still times when I get lost as to who is speaking to whom but not as much as it did before.

The character's adventure were something to look forward to just like the previous two books. And I think the part that I enjoyed the most is the fact that Kerrisha's visions don't bother me anymore. I don't know if I got used to how she is during the visions but I'd like to think that it's because that she now handles them better.

There are a few things that personally bothered me and it's all because of personal reasons and culture to. It was explained well by the author and I feel I should not comment on them but I still like to share.

One of them is the love scenes. Not all of them but some of them don't really sit well with me. Who ever read the book will know what I am talking about. I had a hard time accepting that this is happening and will probably still happen in future books. Who knows, maybe along the way I'd learn to get comfortable reading it too.

Second one was the way Kerrisha was crying at almost every turn of event. She's a strong character and I used to complain that she's too strong she's almost not human to me. And I guess crying made her more human but then maybe because I'm not the type of person that don't like other people seeing me vulnerable (a.k.a crying with an audience) I really really feel awkward when she does that, I almost want to yell at her to stop doing that. I blame it to the fact that she's pregnant in this book but still it was hard seeing her that way.

As you can see, I still gave it a five even if I pointed a couple of things that do not sit well with me. As I said I felt it's purely personal on my part as it was justified well by the author.

All in all, I'd say that I had fun, great adventure and even through the last part was very enjoyable for me even if I'm not the type of person who likes cliffhanger. I'd definitely read the next one.
top_5.summary: Great read and definitely better than the first two.

output:
Really, for most bathroom installations whether as a first time install or as a replacement unit, I can see how this set could reduce the amount of labor and time required even if there is a need to do a Houdini act inside a vanity cabinet to take out the existing fixture. At first consideration, I thought the required effort for a swap out with my pedestal style basin would be less since the faucet anchoring is all out in the openNot.

What I didn't factor into my initial time/effort analysis was yeah, the faucet anchors are out in the open but the shut off outlets are hidden inside the base of the pedestal which has about a three inch slot in the back that is just dandy for reaching in to turn off water flow but not so much for getting a wrench inside to loosen the water tube connections, and once clearance distance from the bathroom wall is brought into play, it wouldnt be any more accessible if I was Reed Richards.

While quick start instructions are clear and conveniently illustrated to indicate how it should be done, this is why there are professionals who get paid what I now recognize as a fair and just labor charge to do this stuff.

profile.description: Old Mother Hubbard Fruit Ins Natural Dog Treats, Honey Apple & Bacon Recipe are wholesome, all natural dog treats made in USA only and made with two unique textures
profile.reviewText:
So, I sampled three varieties of the Old Mother Hubbard treats:

-Old Mother Hubbard Gourmet Goodies Crispers Parmesan & Bacon Natural Crunchy
-Old Mother Hubbard Gourmet Goodies Soft Bakes Carrot & Pumpkin Natural Soft
-Old Mother Hubbard Gourmet Goodies Fruit'ins Honey, Oatmeal & Blueberries

No, really.

It should be noted with the 3rd listed treat, I was expecting to receive the Honey, Apple and Bacon (which I was personally looking forward to) but stuff happens. Anyway, I cant depend on the mutt to be a credible evaluator because so far as I can recall the only things hes ever turned down are green beans (classic cut), and pork or kidney beans. Hes not a big fan of salt and vinegar potato chips either, but he will reluctantly accept them if followed by a bowl of ice coffee, but I digress

As it turns out, just about the same time as I received the treats, my owner was also trying to convince me to substitute my normal breakfast fare of powdered donuts with some Belvita blueberry biscuits so it also seemed like the perfect opportunity to compare ingredients. She wasn't real pleased when I pointed out if you look at the sugar content of the human intended biscuit as contrasted with the absence of the same in the dog variety, the canine product is the winner of the healthier product ribbon by a wide margin.

Individually, the Parmesan & Bacon treat isn't bad, kind of reminiscent of a Zwieback teething biscuit (oh, come on. I got grandkids) but the bacon is not very discernible. The soft bake carrot and pumpkin however, is another story. Its neither soft nor is it all that tasty.

Now, the Honey, Oatmeal & Blueberry cookie; that one might become a regular. It looks like a fig newton with a considerably harder crusty exterior. It isn't particularly sweet which should be expected as apparently dog consumption of sugar is a bigger deal than my ingestion of sugar is for Belvita.

Doesnt seem to matter, though. Whichever treats I toss into my pocket as we (me and the mutt) go on our excursions, he lopes off to do what dogs do, then comes galloping back to await his reward.

Most of the time by the he gets back, I still have some of his treats left.
profile.summary: Um, that's not the cookie jar.

profile.description: Challenge friends and family to a friendly game of Atomic Jumpball Basketball Shootout. Including four mini basketballs and an inflating air pump, this game includes electronic, infrared eyes for accurate scoring and a timer for two players. The 1 " steel tubing offers stability. The Atomic Jumpball Basketball Shootout measures 106" L x 45" W x 89" H.
profile.reviewText:
No, not to cover it but to protect the car it has displaced in the garage, or it may serve as an entirely specious reason to move. For any indoor space with less than 10 foot ceilings, this thing is a no go. Needless to say, theres intellectual comprehension and then theres reality.  I looked at the dimensions, I knew there was no way it would work with low ceiling basement but all I thought about was my grandson would love ithe does and Id like him to love it at his mothers house where there is even less space to accommodate it.

 It is too cold right now in our garage to have any marathon arcade style competitions unless we also want to see how well the players do while attempting to beat the opposition and the clock under the effects of vehicle induced carbon monoxide oxygen deprivation but summer isn't going to a marked improvement for game play indoors because the overhang of the open garage door blocks shooting angles as well. But enough of my shortsighted problems

The game itself is loads of fun, although I do wonder how long the euphoria will last before I decide to deconstruct and restore the rightful fossil fueled occupant to primacy.  It took a while to put it together because its really a two person job and the only other immediately available body in my household was too busy carping about the silliness of it to offer any assistance (I guess I wasn't finished with my personal issues) but with some creativity in stabilizing it (think bungee cords) I got it done. Its actually sturdier than it appears when you first look at the configuration and support tubing and at this price point appears to be a good alternative to some pricier comparable models.

 The electronic controls are located on the rear panel which is somewhat of an inconvenience, especially for younger future hoop stars as a chair or step ladder will be required for resets/ restarts and I do have some concerns over that if they are allowed to play unmonitored. Youll probably need an extension cord which in some situations like mine might be an additional safety hazard, but obviously not the fault of the game. The set comes with four balls and an air pump but I would like to see if I can get a few more to reduce the jockeying to grab returns.
profile.summary: It should come with a tarp

profile.description: We love all things Scandinavian, from chefs to naturalists to cookbooks. Service for four includes four 10.5 dinner plates, four 9 salad plates, four 6.5 (16 oz) all purpose bowls and four 12 oz mugs. Includes a booklet of Food & Wine favorite recipes.
profile.reviewText:
Upon unwrapping, I was mildly surprised and at the same time pleased to discover the product page description of the porcelain flame colored dinnerware had planted an image in my mind not borne out by the actual color of the product. This set is much closer to my idea of a coral hue so I suppose if the comparison is to a malfunctioning natural gas flame, yeah, it is flame colored.

 Another misconception, this time brought about by sneaking a peek at other reviews, was the plates might present some dishwasher loading problems. Again, for some that might prove to be an issue due to the high lip on dinner and salad plates but I didn't have any problems as it appears the wider spaced prongs on our dishwasher rack allow for easy loading. It should be noted, the pieces are also microwave safe.

The plates are substantial, both in circumference and heft. Evidently, we lucked out again as our kitchen cabinets have  just barely  enough depth to accommodate these 10.5 dinner plates.  I don't think anyone will have to worry about having to overfill as your loading up for a holiday buffet dinner. We can easily substitute the salad plates for most meals. Another thing I like about this set is the 12oz. mugs were designed with real coffee drinkers in mind. With most of our china sets, the cups are good enough for a lungo shot but not nearly the size I need to get myself together most mornings.

The only minor negative Ive noticed thus far relates to the cereal bowls. Im sure for most potential buyers, they are sufficiently sized but if your morning routine includes half a box of frosted flakes sopping in whole milk, you're going to have to stick with a mixing bowl or adjust to having several refills of these bowls.

profile.description: Transcend the world around you and enter a truly immersive and interactive virtual reality experience. The NOON VR headset can transform any latest smartphone into a personal and powerful virtual reality device. Enjoy your 360-degree VR movies, stereoscopic 3D videos, and 2D videos with the dedicated NOON app tailored exclusively for your headset.
profile.reviewText:
This is my first set of moderately priced VR goggles and in comparison to the lower priced models Ive tried before, the difference manipulation of required controls in the VR environment is significant. However, that is not a pronouncement this specific set is without deficiences that tend to detract from an entirely enjoyable experience.

Head motion navigation of the downloadable apps menuing system (up to 5 devices can be authorized) in conjunction with the implication of an enhanced immersive experience seemed initially to be justification for the cost premium but the thrill of testing of this set wore off pretty fast and it ended up a somewhat disappointing adventure.  Uploaded VR content for the app is sparse, the compatibility of the headset with alternate content like YouTube video widely varies and assess to media resident on one's phone presented a repetitive challenge.

Of the smartphones I had available for testing, only one of the three was in compliance with the suggested minimal screen size of 4.7, although in my trials it seemed the efficiency of the individual phones gyroscope was a larger issue than screen size. My iPhone 5C worked fine but the FOV with any of the instruments and this headset was limited compared to two other headsets (of significantly lower cost).I expected better lenses and greater adjustment features with this set. The diopter variance for myopic vision is negligible and based on form factor I doubt most users who require corrective lenses would be able to wear glasses with this model.

As with many other competitive models, the NOON goggles employ an elastic band with velcro closures. Unfortunately, I have yet to luck into a comfortable fitting no matter what adjustments I attempted. The nose area foam padding isn't very effective and in most instances in order to achieve the best viewing angle with the elimination of ambient light seepage, I had to position the goggles in such a manner that I also became a full-time mouth breather.  The headband also lacks any type of padding at the rear cross intersection of the elastic straps.

Generally speaking, light seepage with smaller form factor phones isn't a big issue although more attention must be devoted to mounting in the goggles Side slots facilitate access to the mounted phones headphone port. One of my other sets includes a removable EVA mat and sponges that can be used to assist in positioning and deterrence of light seepage with smaller screened devices and a similar approach here would be a suggested enhancement.  One positive factor with the NOON set is the mounting mechanism (which might lose elasticity over time with regular use) will work with relatively thicker phone cases like the Otterbox defender.
profile.summary: Some fun, lots of frustration.

profile.description: I AM LEGEND
profile.reviewText:
With all of the adjustments to the original story incorporated by the screenwriters, maybe the title should have been changed with this rendition just as it was with two earlier movie versions. My choice would be "He was Legend" based on the ending of the theatrical version. In the book the title highlights the irony of Neville's existence and demise, here it makes little sense.

On individual merit, this version is worthwhile, bordering on above average in the genre of horror/zombie films, although in the original works the creatures pursuing - or alternatively pursued by - Robert Neville were vampires, and the movie's arguably cathartic, placebo of a conclusion is uninspired.  My difficulty is compartmentalizing the film and the book because knowledge of the source material rendered the film somewhat disappointing. While a few of the liberties or adaptations infused by the screenwriters are largely cosmetic, some can be attributed to the eras of the media as the novella was published in 1954. I did not find the change in locale from Los Angeles to NYC to be detracting even though it seemed to be a vehicle to substantiate an "Escape from New York" themed back story that is non-existent in the book. Altering the significance of the dog was a tender touch however I thought the role of the dog in the book conveyed Neville's conflicting senses of isolation and optimism much more effectively.  The introduction of the woman and the child to the movie, while in all likelihood unavoidable to tie this story together, unfortunately, resulted in a near complete loss of focus and direction.

The adjustment in his occupation and experience may have been necessary within the constraints of film however Matheson's depiction of Neville as an average man forced by the vagaries of chance to carve out his daily existence was engrossing. Here, Will Smith's character is a physically fit, militarily trained scientist doing only what he knows best, continuing the research he started before the infection overran humankind.  The panoramic views of sites in and around Manhattan were an homage to the cinematographer and the CGI effects may have some enticing effect for some viewers but they could have easily have used those opportunities demonstrate why Neville became legend in the original story.

I don't want to meander into the realm of spoiler, but there is a dichotomy in the book that fails to be addressed by the film.  One vehicle addresses competitive interests and survival while the other offers an idealized view of moral and ethical choice. Personally, the dystopian view holds more appeal for me.
profile.summary: How do you know?

profile.description: Today everyone's craving Mexican cuisine. The unique flavors and textures from the south of the border are delighting the taste buds in homes across the country. Now award-winning chef, cookbook author, and restaurant own Rich Bayless presents a collection of fine cookware and housewares designed to serve the unique needs of Mexican cooking. Created in partnership with GORHAM, The Mexican Kitchen Collection offers the right pieces for today's growing market of home chefs hungry to create their own fiestas of fabulous foods.
profile.reviewText:
I was reared that means indoctrinated- to believe no kitchen is adequately stocked without a supply of cast iron pots and pans and since I swallowed the cast iron mendacity I suppose I should add this sturdy, dual function cast iron grill/griddle to the list, despite my personal reluctance to purchase celebrity endorsed products.  However, as some Foreman products have also fallen out of the sky into the cabinets including a ceramic grill/griddle, I will say this traditional style item is far superior.

We have a ceramic electric cooktop so I did have some reservations about how well this two burner requiring grill would work, particularly in terms of heat disbursement over the center section which would not be directly over a heating source.  It did take a period of trial and error to adjust the temperature level on the burners to equalize the temperature on both sides of the plate but beyond that I felt the Bayless cast iron grill plate was outstanding.

It is received pre-seasoned, heats up fast, lays flush on the cooktop and will probably be equally appreciated by someone else after Im ashes in an urn somewhere. Obviously, you're not going to get that just grilled flavoring but you will get the seared look. The channels along on the perimeter successfully capture any grease produced in the cooking process.

 It is hefty so removing it from a relatively fragile glass/ceramic cooktop immediately after use does take a bit of manipulation unless the user just decides to let it cool down (not necessarily the first choice on an electric range if reduction of smoke is a concern).  It cleans up nicely although a standard size double well sink is not going to contain it.
profile.summary: If all else fails, it might work as a skid plate for your SUV

profile.description: Make All-Natural Juices, Soups, Baby Food, Sauces and more, Without Unhealthy Preservatives! The Big Boss 800-Watt Power Juicer allows whole fruit consumption with the large 3-inch feeder tube. It's large 2.5L/2.6Qt. Pulp collector allows for the usage of the remaining pulp to create sauces, soups, salsa and more.
profile.reviewText: I've used the Breville BJE200XL Compact Juice Fountain 700-Watt Juice Extractor extractor for the last five years, sometimes even with the intention of making juice. Although my impression is the Big Boss is competitively positioned as an alternative to the somewhat more sophisticated Breville 800JEXL Juice Fountain Elite 1000-Watt Juice Extractor as far as MSRP is concerned, the Big Boss is closer to the range of the former model and in many respects like build quality also more in line with the basic Breville model...and it's also the model I own so that's what I used for evaluation. I also have an masticating slow juicer Kuvings NS-850 Silent Upright Masticating Juicer, Silver and for anyone who is convinced they will continue to follow stick with a regimen, my experience has been in the long run centrifugal style juicers are not as efficient as a good masticating juicer but if there is a possibility the appliance is destined to end up on a shelf in the basement or garage, at least the money wasted on acquisition will not weigh as heavily on the psyche with the outlay required for one of the two centrifugal styles noted here. Plus, if you're like me and this thing is more of a toy than a device to genuinely intended to assist in facilitation of a healthier nutritional habits, when you're attempting to see how well it shreds just about anything you can push down the feeding tube when you destroy it (I couldn't be bothered with that whole peeling and pitting recommendation this is about inquisitiveness, not healthy eating) the level of distress is mitigated as well. That said, the 700 watt Breville has held up admirably. The 800 watt Big Boss has two speed selections, activated by a rather flimsy feeling front positioned plastic switch. An info card included with the packaging suggested using the higher RPM setting for hard vegetables like carrots but in operation I didn't notice a clearly distinguishable difference between the two speeds. The one piece blade/screen assembly is pressed onto the motor housing and seems reasonably substantial. The feeding tube is large so it is not necessary to spend a significant period on preparation although with the larger pieces being fed into the extractor if the plunger isn't kept in place you might find yourself cleaning the kitchen walls and cabinets as well as the components of the juicer you're finished and BTW, the removable parts that require cleaning after use don't appear to be any more dishwasher safe than the kitchen cabinets. A cleaning brush is not included as part of the packaging but one will be required to thoroughly cleanse the mesh screen. My preference for the Big Boss over the Breville is based primarily on how more effective the former unit pulverizes leafy products and in my estimation, its superior ability for extraction in general. The resultant pulp felt drier with every item I fed into the comparably sized 3 inch opening after about 30 seconds of operation. There is a higher probability of oxidation with centrifugals and the juice collection pitcher has a convenient insert to block the foam that will inevitably occur during the process. The juicer has a 3 year warranty which seems like a good deal as long as you don't tell them what you really did with it when making a claim. While build quality seems adequate for this price point, I do have some reservations regarding the long term durability of the plastic parts securing the blade assembly to the motor housing.
profile.summary: I'm bored. Let's watch some veggies shred.

profile.description: Bluetooth Standard: Bluetooth V4.0 Chips: CSR8645 high-end chip from CSR Plc Frequency Range: 2.4GHz Operation: Class2 Bluetooth Mode: Headset/handfree/A2DP/AVRCP Operation Range: Up to 30 feet Talk/Playing Time: Up to 4 hours Standby Time: Up to 100 hours Charging Time: 2 hours Weight: 0.02 pounds
profile.reviewText:
Okay, I have to say upfront I do not care for these earphones based entirely on wearability and comfort but your results may vary. Under given conditions, they may not be as irritating for the next person so I'm not going to lambast them based on my personal quirks. For me, they never seemed to fit well even after trying each of the three sets of earpieces. I'm not confident they would work well for those who intend to engage in exercise regimens while wearing them.

Regardless, the in the ear extensions seemed to shift and resulted in a degradation of sound quality, which was unfortunate because when I held the phones in place, the sound quality was beyond my initial expectations. In my opinion, clarity in the mid-range was above average for sets of this type, bass response very good with an absence of static and in the upper-range scale the set also performed well. As far as telephone calls were concerned, I didn't notice any significant static or snowiness and my contact felt the microphone pickup and transmission was good.

The headphones are Bluetooth enabled and pair easily with a host device. There is voice acknowledgement of pairing completion/termination.  Bluetooth range is unremarkable, reasonably stable in a straight line for about 15 feet or so. If you happen to walk away from the device, particularly in an area with other devices using the same frequency or in an area with thick plaster walls, you can expect signal interruptions or drops.

The headset employs a multi-function power button that is also used for pairing, play/pause, call answering and last number redial. There is a second button for volume and music track controls. Neither of the small buttons is easily manipulated on such a small form factor and both are rather hard to find by feel when wearing the headset without any consideration to the need to remember how long to depress each button to use the variable functions. Battery life between charges is represented as extending up to 7 hours although I haven't approached that as of yet and stated re-charge time is up to 2 hours.

The package also includes the three sets of silicone earpieces and a micro USB charging cable, all conveniently storable in a carrying case.

I received a sample for evaluation.
profile.summary: It's all about the sound.

profile.description: Western Digital Caviar Blue WD4000AAKS 400GB 7200 RPM 16MB Cache SATA 3.0Gb/s 3.5 Hard Drive
profile.reviewText: Due to impatience, I bought this drive to set up redundancy on my Netgear RND2150 ReadyNAS Duo 500 GB Desktop Network Attached Storage since the specifications are identical to the Seagate HD already in use and another Seagate drive was not available via Amazon when I needed it. Only after ordering it did I bother to check to see if this drive was on the approved hardware list for the NAS and naturally, it was not recommended, and just as naturally, I installed it anyway. One of the known problems according to Netgear was a propensity for erroneous overheating messages but I haven't encountered any difficulties thus far even though the NAS in X-Raid (basically RAID 1) configuration runs 24/7. In fact, when I check, this drive consistently reflects a temperature reading 3 degrees Celsius less than the Seagate drive that came with the NAS. As other reviewers have mentioned, it is an OEM package lacking instructions, software, connector cables or mounting screws, however unlike OEM drives from some other manufacturers it is securely packaged so the likelihood of damage in shipment is significantly reduced. As a swap out for a smaller drive or one that is failing, this looks to be a reasonable and economical option.
profile.summary: Might turn out to be one of my better mistakes

 It's cable. If it is the one you need it works and with 12ft in length, you can use it and move your device to a location where you actually do have an electrical outlet available

profile.reviewText:
For most users of tablets, notebooks or other smaller devices I can see how this lapdesk could be a useful item. As a creature of habit, impervious to any suggestion of modifying my habits, it doesnt work for me. First of all, I prefer a full size laptop and while this company has similar desks to use with larger devices this one is too small to meet my primary needs.

profile.description: Create professional, high quality, laminated documents. For use with thermal laminating pouches up to 12.3 inch wide, including menus, legal size, letter size and business cards. 3 to 6 mil thick. Premium design includes easy-to-use LED touch controls and light that turns on when machine is ready. Includes hidden built-in cord storage and foldable input tray.
profile.reviewText:
Once you acquire a laminator, you may surprise yourself with the wide variety of reasons you discover it is a useful and convenient device to have at your disposal. My primary needs for it are related to business uses but there are all sorts of keepsakes, photos or documents like recipes around the home you may want to preserve and protect as well. This Scotch model seems to be a very good choice. It is exclusively a heated element device, so for items that are heat sensitive (photo prints, as an example), some attention has to be devoted to determination of the viability of using it as compared to a cold lamination process.

 The 4 roller TL1306 is simple to setup and equally easy to use, even if youve never touched a laminator in the past. The footprint of this model isn't gigantic at 21.6 x 6 x 8.1 inches however it does need to be on a heat resistant flat surface. When not in use the power cord can be wrapped around recessed hooks on the bottom of the unit.  After depressing the power button, it is ready to go in less than a minute. One thing you will notice is how quiet it is in operation. Next, select the best thickness match (3, 5 or 6 mil) and insert the lamination pouch with the concerned item enclosed. The minimal (and largely unnecessary) manual indicates an 18 item will take approximately one minute. For the letter size documents I was working with it took about 30 seconds each.

About the only thing you could do incorrectly is feed the plastic pouches open end first. I thought about doing it just to test the never jam technology but then thought better since there were items I wanted to complete. Well, I suppose you could also feed the pouches out of alignment but if they're small enough to fit through the self-feeding slot even that wouldnt make a difference in getting a good seal.

 The rear feed opening with accommodate items up to 12.3 wide and 18 long. The packaging includes a few starter pouches (5- Letter Size 3 mil, 4- Photo 4 x 6 Size 5 mil, and 3 - Business Card Size 5 mil).  While I prefer to use Scotch products, Im confident comparable products from other manufacturers will work equally as well.
profile.summary: I wish the Seal-a-Meal worked as well.

profile.description: Versatile ink for great images and sharp text. Claria Premium 4-color dye and 1 pigment Black ink technology delivers great images, including stunning photos and sharp text, that last for more than 200 years.
profile.reviewText:
I have two Epson printers that use Claria ink and I am consistently pleased with the print quality especially in the case of photo prints on Epson paper. There's little value in me complaining about the cost of replacement cartridges, I'm not going to risk buying so-called compatibles or attempt to personally refill empties, so either I pay the price or look towards other printer manufacturers. I also have Epson models that use less expensive Durabrite inks and in side by side comparison for photos, the Durabrite prints simply do not measure up.

My problem with either type Epson ink cartridges is they tend to clog faster than I have experienced with HP printers if the printer is not used regularly so just to get a document printed I end up clearing nozzles and cleaning printheads resulting in non-productive cartridge depletion, so on that level the per page print costs to me with Epson is expensive.

But, it's what I have and either I deal with ink replacement costs or implement one or another alternative strategy that may have a downside I wish not to confront as well.
profile.summary: Like I have a lot of choices...

profile.description: SAVE THOUSANDS in Losses and Headaches: What takes seconds to destroy;BE SAFE AND PROTECTED from Electronic Pickpocketing: Safe, Secure, Blocking protection from all RFID scanners and readers.;ENJOY PREMIUM QUALITY: Enduring resistant material to minor tears and punctures. Designed to slip in and out of sleeve easily, no modifications like extra cutting, fits conveniently in wallet.;HAVE A PEACE OF MIND when Traveling: It is a must have when on vacations or traveling overseas - great for using on public transportation and crowded places - keep the worry away and be protected all the time.;BUY CONFIDENTLY with our 100% Money Back Guarantee: No questions asked and hassle free.
profile.reviewText:
Truth is, I have no idea how effective these sleeves may prove to be against chip and strip scanners, but then, I really don't know how responsive my auto insurance company will be if I ever have the need to file a claim. I don't have access to any testing mechanisms and I obviously can't comment on how much of a deterrent they have proven to be since luckily I don't know anyone who's participating in that enterprise...I hope.
In any case I `m not really interested in finding out. I'll continue to pay my insurance premiums and since I do have occasion to travel to areas where it has been reported scanners have been used by unscrupulous individuals, I'll take the rather benign defensive action of slipping my credit cards into one of these sleeves.

The ten individual card sleeves and two passport sleeves have a similar metallic based film inside as one will find with the sleeve issued with U.S. passport cards. Whether I could achieve the same effect by wrapping the cards in aluminum foil I don't know but these cases are a bit more subtle and won't cause others to look at you like you were wearing a tin foil hat to ward off alien mind invasion.

One downside however is, the sleeves are too wide to fit into the card slots in most wallets and trying to use the passport case is not unlike trying to slip .080 weed eater nylon string through the eye of a sewing needle.

I received a sample for evaluation.
profile.summary: May I never discover how effective this product has been

profile.reviewText:
But, in my opinion, placing raised embossed lettering and logos on the face of a sharpening stone is counterproductive and extremely irritating when one is attempting to achieve a fine honed edge on a utensil. Its not just this supplier as with just a quick cursory search of this site, numerable examples of similar practices will pop-up. Put your promotional info on the sides of the stone, please.

Anyway, although the printing does serve to impede the process and add to the tedium, this two-sided whetstone is adequate to meet the objective. It just takes longer than necessary to refine burrs raised while employing the 1000 grit stone when the stone is flipped over to the 6000 grit surface. The kit includes the two-sided stone, a nice looking bamboo base that will enhance decors but didn't prove to be very useful for me in the sharpening stage since the base doesnt slide but the lubricated stone does, and a non-skid rubber gasket type base that does provide a secure foundation even on a polished granite counter.

The package does not include instructions. From appearance, I don't believe this whetstone has any sort of pre-conditioning but in accordance with information here on the product page, it is represented to work well  either soaked in water or with an application of some sort of sharpening stone lubrication like mineral oil, which  happens to be my preference. I also like to use an edge angle guide and in consideration of the inability to stop the tool being sharpened from popping up when it is sweep across the finer grit surface, I think others may want to give a guide a try as well.

I received a sample for evaluation.
profile.summary: I never claimed to be the sharpness knife in the drawer

profile.description: Resolution: 1000 DPI for easy mouse movement Interface: USB 2.0, Plug and play Keystroke lifetime: over 8 million times Buttons:3 programmable Cable long including the USB slot: 135cm Compatibility: Windows 98 / 2000 / XP / 9X /ME / NT4.0, windows vista, Windows 7 Linux Mac OS X Package contents: 1 x Ergonomic Vertical Wireless Mouse Reminds: You may not get used to the product at the beginning, due to its innovative design. Please keep using the product for a few days, and you will enjoy its convenience
profile.reviewText:
I have to say my first impression after pulling this thing out of the box was I needed a bowl of borscht to dip this humongous wedge of black bread in. It's nearly twice the size of the Logitech wireless mouse I currently use. Yet, after inserting two AAA batteries (not included), placing the USB dongle in a port on a powered hub and a short period of adjustment to the differences in orientation, I could tell this device will be beneficial for me over the long term.

I didn't have to make any adjustments via the control panel (it doesn't come with any proprietary software, or for that matter any instructions beyond what's printed on the box) but the sensitivity settings seemed right on target without any need for modifications. While I'm a lefty who has been indoctrinated to live in a right-handed world, if I wanted to be a rebel implementing the required changes would be a non-issue. I like the feel of the composite plastic exterior and the two button/center scroll wheel arrangement seems easier to use with the vertical layout.

The optics work on both my laminated desktop and with a pad. In fact, contrary to the marketing pitch of the ergonomic benefits, this mouse may turn out to make my workplace seated posture even worse as I also discovered I can sit this mouse on my thigh and it works just as well. About the only flaw I can see with it was the failure to include a compartment on the mouse for storage of the USB dongle when not in use.

I received a sample from the vendor.
profile.summary: Point taken and even more given

profile.description: Speaker impedence 16 ohms, Weight 12 grams, Cable length 1.2 m, Wire core material enamelled copper wire, Headphone sensitivity 93dB, Plug Type - 3.5mm gold-plated, The maximum practical power - 5mW, Maximum acceptable power - 20mW
profile.reviewText:
I compared the SoundSoul M10 earphones to the Acoustic Research AR Performance Series Noise Isolating Earbuds - HP1000 and with an eye towards the price difference, the M10 earphones are unquestionably a price performer. The earphones have a very similar form factor as well as rated frequency response specifications. I found the M10 earphones comfortable with billets constructed with metal housings and three sets of silicone tips to accommodate variable user preferences and needs. The edges of the billets could have been machined a bit more as they are a little rough. The 4 ft. cord with flat tangle resistant shaping has a standard size 3.5mm plug. The zippered carrying case is crush resistant.

One advantage of this set is the built in microphone with an on/off switch to pause replay for incoming calls and although it is not remarkably sensitive it is sufficient for calls over a mobile phone with average to above average voice clarity.

While users will invariably have individual preferences regarding sound characteristics, I thought the AR earbuds were slightly better as far as reproducing mid-range responses from my source devices but the degree of superiority over the M10 set was not all that significant and for potential purchasers who desire enhanced bass response the M10s would be the way to go. I'm kind of obsessive about sound leakage since I occasionally find myself annoyed in public situations where I am forced to endure the muffled tones of another's musical pleasures. These earphones don't seem excessive in that regard, either.

I received a sample set for evaluation.
profile.summary: Nice set of modestly priced earbuds.

So, I sampled three varieties of the Old Mother Hubbard treats:

-Old Mother Hubbard Gourmet Goodies Crispers Parmesan & Bacon Natural Crunchy
-Old Mother Hubbard Gourmet Goodies Soft Bakes Carrot & Pumpkin Natural Soft
-Old Mother Hubbard Gourmet Goodies Fruit'ins Honey, Oatmeal & Blueberries

No, really.

It should be noted with the 3rd listed treat, I was expecting to receive the Honey, Apple and Bacon (which I was personally looking forward to) but stuff happens. Anyway, I cant depend on the mutt to be a credible evaluator because so far as I can recall the only things hes ever turned down are green beans (classic cut), and pork or kidney beans. Hes not a big fan of salt and vinegar potato chips either, but he will reluctantly accept them if followed by a bowl of ice coffee, but I digress

As it turns out, just about the same time as I received the treats, my owner was also trying to convince me to substitute my normal breakfast fare of powdered donuts with some Belvita blueberry biscuits so it also seemed like the perfect opportunity to compare ingredients. She wasn't real pleased when I pointed out if you look at the sugar content of the human intended biscuit as contrasted with the absence of the same in the dog variety, the canine product is the winner of the healthier product ribbon by a wide margin.

Individually, the Parmesan & Bacon treat isn't bad, kind of reminiscent of a Zwieback teething biscuit (oh, come on. I got grandkids) but the bacon is not very discernible. The soft bake carrot and pumpkin however, is another story. Its neither soft nor is it all that tasty.

Now, the Honey, Oatmeal & Blueberry cookie; that one might become a regular. It looks like a fig newton with a considerably harder crusty exterior. It isn't particularly sweet which should be expected as apparently dog consumption of sugar is a bigger deal than my ingestion of sugar is for Belvita.

Doesnt seem to matter, though. Whichever treats I toss into my pocket as we (me and the mutt) go on our excursions, he lopes off to do what dogs do, then comes galloping back to await his reward.

Most of the time by the he gets back, I still have some of his treats left.
profile.summary: No, you don't get a reward for emptying the dishwasher

profile.description: Logitech Classic Desktop MK100. Compact comfort you can count on from a space-saving keyboard with full-size keys and a full-size optical mouse.
profile.reviewText:
And now I'm doing pickup truck metaphors...

I guess classic is a euphemism for "Hey, it works like it's supposed to." This is a utilitarian standard key layout keyboard and mouse combo package at a very reasonable price. The keyboard connects only via a PS/2 port while the 2 button with scroll wheel USB optical mouse also has a PS/2 adapter.  The keyboard profile is somewhat compact although it is nearly identical to a dell unit I've used for the last few years.

What I really got a kick out of was the tri-fold "getting started" pamphlet that pretty much offers the following advice: Plug in this sucker, turn on your computer. If that doesn't work, repeat instructions "1" and "2."

Logitech highlights a spill resistant feature that I didn't try any more than I would intentionally attempt to find out how stain resistant the seats in the Ranger are but I'm sure with my clumsiness I'll be positioned to update this later...assuming I keep this keyboard in the loop since my personal preferences have gravitated towards wireless. The keys are quiet which is a big deal for me and although this unit is obviously new, my experience with the suspiciously similar dell unit has been over time degradation is not a major issue and I do a substantial amount of typing.
profile.summary: If you wanted F-250 capabilities, don't buy a Ranger

profile.description: Considered by many to be the greatest living jazz singer, Al Jarreau is an artist of stunning range. He's spent decades bending genres with his lithe voice, earning him the rare distinction of being the only artist to have won Grammy Awards in three different categories: pop, jazz and R&B. Rhino honors the superlative vocalist's musical achievements with a collection that spans his entire career titled AL JARREAU THE VERY BEST OF: AN EXCELLENT ADVENTURE.
profile.reviewText:
And yet, He remains an unknown commodity to so many. It was all I could do maintain a semblance of restraint a few weeks ago when during a get together at my house an acquaintance was checking the digital display on a networked music player I was using for background ambiance and he commented he didn't realize "Al Jezeera" had an internet radio station. He thought the singer had an infectious voice even though he couldn't understand the words (Roof Garden).  Put down the wine glass. You've had enough.

But that speaks to the anonymity of this exquisite artist who nearly all in western society have heard and applauded but failed to be perceptive enough to make the associations or attach a name to the performer they may have heard on tunes that have become ubiquitous,  a few of which (Moonlighting, Boogie Down, Spain) are included here.

 He defies categorization. I know when it was commonplace to go through the stacks at brick and mortar record stores, I would have to check multiple genres (jazz, pop, contemporary, soul, R & B) to figure out where this or that establishment felt his ` style" was most effectively accommodated and the reality is they were under no danger of getting it wrong.  A strong argument could be made for any of them.

This a nice grouping for the music lover who may not be familiar with Jarreau's discography since 1975's debut with the album `We Got By,' and includes one new cut, Excellent Adventure, that all long time followers will want to have available to them even though in all probability the original album versions would already be at hand.

Certainly, it is not likely all of the tunes one fan or another would place among his "best" is going to be on this collection. I have a special attachment to High Crime, as an example, however for the newer enlistee to the Jarreau bandwagon it could serve as a great first stop on one excellent ride.
profile.summary: A representative sampling of nearly 40 years of excellence...

profile.description: AFSH-R4F Features: -Innovative 360 degrees rotating design. -4 Functions: Rain, massage, waterfall and mist. -Fits on all standard shower plumbing. -Installs in minutes without tools. -Enjoy luxurious and sensational spa-like shower. -Manufacturer provides lifetime warranty.
profile.reviewText:
The AquaFlow 4 function showerhead is a reasonable option for cost conscious consumers who are interested in acquisition of variable flow fixture at minimal expense. Comprised primarily of hard plastic parts finished to resemble a shiny chrome finish, it is surprisingly lightweight and easy to install when replacing an existing showerhead installation with an extended arm and threaded ends.

In addition to the fixture which has a pre-inserted washer/screen combination, the packaging includes a roll of thread sealant tape and a small sheet of installation instructions. Some potential purchasers should also note this showerhead does not include a flow limiter.

While the product page information suggests additional tools are not needed for installation, it is likely most installers will need at minimum an adjustable wrench or pliers for removal of the existing showerhead and mounting of this unit.

Once installed, the showerhead can be rotated to create one of four flow patterns: rain, waterfall, massage or mist, as well as manipulated to a degree (but not as smoothly as I would prefer) to adjust flow angle.  I found each of the settings to be adequate but you're not going to mistake this device for a spa treatment or higher end home fixtures at any flow pattern.

Activation of the product's warranty requires registration at the manufacturer's website and with the preponderance of moveable plastic parts, that step seems like a good strategy.

I received a sample product from the distributor.
profile.summary: Maybe for the guest bathroom...

profile.description: Wolf Road
profile.reviewText:
Really, what else do you need to know? As Elka says, Anyone what tells you they don't like bacon is either stupid or lying. Either way that aint no one you can trust.

This is one intense, tension filled, first-person narrated, post- apocalyptic roller coaster ride with a feral heroine youll root for every step of the way, even before you adapt to the rhythm of her speech and actually understand what the **** shes trying to say. This isn't a narrative to be compared to some introspective exposition like The Road or quasi -environmental treatise like The Rivers.

 I think most will find it dark and periodically brutal. I rather liken it to a Sisyphean struggle that admirably doesnt end up in some cloying, uplifting conclusion where the protagonist sashays off into the sunset after braiding up loose ends and securing them with pink bows gently swaying in the zephyr breeze.
profile.summary: Theres a chapter titled Bacon.

profile.reviewText:
And not recommended for anyone who is serious about cookware and cooking. Lets face it, if you're looking for a basic set of pots and pans in this price range, expectations have to be minimized and based on that premise this set might exceed expectations  but its not likely to be in a condition to be passed on to anyone else when it comes time to step ones game in the kitchen. In fact, the first thing one might want to do is purchase a 12 skillet to complement this set but if enhancement of utensils is an intention I don't think using this set as the foundation would make sense. For students in an off campus living situation or someone just setting up a household with limited funds, its a decent alternative to the other inexpensive full sets one might find at a dollar store or discount store.

That said, over three months of somewhat frequent use in the multiple cook environment, the pans have performed admirablyfor what they are. Im not a big proponent of aluminum non-stick cookware however at the same time,  I haven't noticed any warping or deterioration of the non-stick surface even though most of the implements have been overheated, used in the oven at maximum recommended temperature and cleansed in a dishwasher. The external red surfaces have also maintained integrity far beyond what I anticipated.

BUT, this is an inexpensive set and therefore requires a degree of compromise. The handles do not offer a great deal of confidence they will stand up over the long term as they are screwed on rather than riveted and they get hotter than I would prefer. The pans are extremely lightweight and over time I fully expect some denting will occur in the battlefield of the kitchen cabinets.  The set has been used on an electric ceramic range top without incident thus far but I would not be surprised if there is some transference from the painted surface as the pans age.  The lids fit reasonably well although the lid handles scream cheap every time I use one.

profile.description: FEATURES of the Gregory Matia 28 Pack Laptop and tablet sleeve Side water bottle pockets Side compression straps Ergonomic foam harness and back panel
profile.reviewText: I've encountered an adjustment period with quite a diverse selection of products but I never thought a back pack would turn out to be one of them. Basically, I always looked at it as nothing more than a sack I threw stuff in and on my way I went. I intended to do the same thing with this one, transferring all the unnecessary "essential items" I carry around in my trusty Targus backpack, prove this one didn't measure up, criticize it in a review for failing to compare and toss it in the closet with all the unfortunate choices I've made. Now, without getting ahead of myself, it is important note while it hasn't won me entirely won my affections at this point my objections to it probably matter little to most in the market for a backpack geared towards users with plans to hike, bike or put spikes in the face of a rock, or just walk across campus. First of all, it has more straps, clamps and belts than I know with to do with including a couple of clasps I'm still trying to figure out what they're supposed to attach to but more than anything, I find all these flapping straps to be an annoyance. You have to wear it because it doesn't have wheels and a retractable handle like the Targus Compact Rolling Backpack for Laptops up to 16-Inch/MacBook Pros up to 17-Inch, Black/Red (TSB75001US) I currently use. BUT, when I started stuffing all the electronic paraphernalia I haven't used in four years yet just know I'll need when I don't have it, out of the old pack into the new, I kept finding places to put it...all of it (with the caveat over that time the assortment irrelevant electronic junk has evolved so the Targus backpack does hold more). I am lugging a laptop, tablet, portable scanner, external hard drives, full size audio headset, LED lamp, USB hub, two mobile phones, etc., and I found sufficient space to accommodate it all, (including a collapsible umbrella I finally had enough sense to add to the line-up) in one of the mesh side pockets. Eventually I had to accept it is more likely to completely fit underneath an airplane seat without me doing Cirque du Soleil contortions to get my feet underneath the seat as well. Overall, this is an appealing looking item (as long as the flapping straps will not bother you) that is water resistant, of superior construction and will most likely meet the needs of those looking for a roomy bag for everyday use with the ability to accommodate overnighters as well.
profile.summary: Pack rat's wet dream.

profile.description: Hand-crafted with care from genuine wood
profile.reviewText:
While the form factor of these wood grain earbuds is effectively identical to a host of competitive products, they do stand apart as a result of the very tasteful wood grain finish. Although I continue to prefer a set of over the ear headphones for nearly all occasions where private listening is desired, on aesthetics alone the F&M earbuds would be a contender if I have a need to use earbuds.

Fortunately, audio reproduction with this set is decent. At lower volume settings, a slight degree of distortion may be detected but does not seem to persist from a mid-point volume setting and beyond. At the upper settings, clarity and sensitivity while not remarkable, does tend to be above average for the price point. Three sets of cushions are provided in the package but you will need to obtain a carrying or storage case.

As a wired set, in my opinion overall performance exceeded most comparably priced wireless options and tended to be on equal footing with wired units Ive tested in the same basic price range. I also like the cloth braided cable with right side lead function control (volume, tracking, voice communications).

The set also features an angled 3.5mm gold plated plug that can be securely ported to a mobile device, including an iPhone in an Otterbox Defender case where the outlet covers tend to serve as an encumbrance to attachment of external devices. I did not test phone control functionality or effectiveness of the noise-isolating microphone.

I received a sample for evaluation.
profile.summary: Another pleasant surprise from Francois et Mimi

profile.description: HATCHET. unrated director's cut.
profile.reviewText:
If you have a hankering for a healthy portion of gore, guts and grotesqueness sprinkled with a smattering of gratuitous frontal nudity, your quest is over. Hatchet is certain to satiate the appetite.  The only purpose of this movie is to display the slicing and dicing of a gaggle of characters with an array of devices and it admirably succeeds in meeting the objective, however my attention span is not that short.

I prefer psychological horror and my leisure time is both limited and precious so this subset of the horror genre falls on the periphery of my interests yet for those who gravitate in that direction, it is not difficult to see how it could service as 90 minutes of fun.

What you have is a specious reason for a bunch of people to travel to a locale where they might serve as sacrificial lambs to the movie's malevolent force, the hideously deformed but tragically sympathetic Victor Crowley. In consideration of the hackneyed dialogue and distractingly over the top performances, I wanted all of the characters bludgeoned and the sooner the better. While it was clear certain scenes and exchanges were intended as humorous interludes, in the main I found them lacking. If it was intended as a parody of the most noticeable offerings of the category like Texas Chainsaw Massacre, Halloween and Friday the Thirteenth, I think it may have been an over-ambitious effort.

For me, the character of Marcus encapsulated my feelings when he railed against paying for the swamp tour he was about to take in the effort to support his buddy:  "No, I'm just not paying for this bull...."
profile.summary: I wasted more time in the past...
