profile.description: Protect your favorite electronics with ease and convenience with the Acoustic Research Swivel Surge Protector. It has 6 AC outlets with a 90-degree swivel for quick and easy access to the outlets no matter what angle. It's great for tight spaces. It also comes with 2100 joules surge protection with connected equipment guarantee.
profile.reviewText: If the idea is defense against an act of nature such as a lightning strike on your house or catastrophic failure of the transformer previously hanging over the roof of your car and now comfortably ensconced in the passenger seat after transmission of a 14,400 volt shot to your incoming lines make sure you read carefully the connected equipment warranty, keep receipts for all connected equipment in a secure location and under no circumstances plug in more than $200,000 of electronics and the Tesla into the protector...or when the storm clouds gather turn off your equipment and remove this device from the NEMA 5-15R duplex receptacle because neither this unit nor in all likelihood a whole house arrestor will save what's left of your possessions from a sad and tearful journey to the recycle collection site, in the other car. However, from another point of view, if I had and then entrusted $200,000 worth of electronics to a surge protector in this price range, I deserve to have it incinerated. Alternatively, if you have ever watched the dials on your electric meter when the refrigerator, freezer or a/c unit kicks into high gear, those customary operational actions are more likely to result in spikes that fry men's (and women's) motherboards. This 6 outlet (3 per side) 90 degree swivel unit, which as far as I am concerned is a net loss of six since it consumes two receptacle plugs (yeah, I know I had too many devices on the circuit anyway with the two six outlet surge protectors I was running off it before...and will again after this one is moved to a less demanding location) can offer a limited degree of security at a somewhat modest price point. However, in the same generalized range, I believe there are better choices, including the similarly designed Tripp Lite AVSWIV6 A/V Surge Protector Direct Plug In RJ11 Coax Swivel 6 Outlet, which also offers coaxial and telephone line connectors. For what it's worth, all of my protectors prior to this one were APC. The AR protector features two indicator lamps, green for grounded connection and red for protection status and of course the primary feature that distinguishes it from most other competitive models, the slim line swivel capability. There is a prong that can be broken off to enable use on a GFI outlet or a standard duplex outlet without blocking both plugs if one desires to live dangerously and challenge customary warranty limitations. However, without the stability prong if multiple devices requiring a wart type plug are connected the weight may cause this suppressor with its' lower center mounted electrical prongs to dislodge from the outlet. Some users may have receptacles where the ground input is on the top of the outlet. In that situation weight of plugs may be less of an issue since the protector has to be used upside down and that results in the electrical prongs being at the top so the protector will support itself without use of the plastic prong. I'm sure there are reasons unknown to me why it wasn't designed with the electrical prongs at the top to start with. As it is, the protector outlets are too close together to accommodate many wart type plugs anyway, but they can further reduce the number of useable outlets on this device. This a pretty much a basic unit lacking a power switch, a reset switch (possibly indicating this unit only absorbs and is likely to burn out faster), USB charging ports, outlets for coaxial cable/telephone lines and EMI/RFI filtering is rated to only 20dB but some level of protection is better than none...right up to the point a phone line surge blows up your desktop and all your valuable now not easily recoverable data that you were meaning to backup. Surge suppression is rated up to 2100 joules, also pretty comparable to other surge protectors in this price range. The product has a limited lifetime warranty while connected equipment is covered for five years. What I couldn't find was any documentation regarding the amount of voltage this unit is capable of dissipating rather than absorbing before it goes up in smoke in the event of a surge occurrence, or the suppression activation response time. Replacement of the protector with a burned out MOV is a heck of a lot less annoying than scrounging around to get a replacement for the 60" inch LED HDTV you managed to snag in a Gold Box lightning deal even if failure of the product could be proven to the manufacturer and if this thing fails to kick in gear in less than a nanosecond that remains a possibility.
profile.summary: For limited needs, a viable choice.

profile.description: Whether you're cooking pork chops or burgers, this grill is the just the right tool. Raised grill pattern lifts food away from fats and grease allowing healthier cooking. The heavy gauge, hard-anodized aluminum provides even heating - no hot spots! The patented TOTAL Hi-Low Food Release system protects the nonstick surface from abrasion, allows food to slide out easily, and, along with the nonstick exterior, makes clean up a breeze.
profile.reviewText:
Due to a confluence of circumstances four years ago when I was in the market for a new set of cookware I was able to try out 10" skillets from Anolon and Circulon classic. After using each for a few days, I felt the Circulon unit with its' ridged non-stick interior surface heated more efficiently and was easier to clean. After a price check, I decided to purchase the full set. However, when I saw the subtle changes in the beveled interior configuration of the Circulon2 cookware I decided to opt for this set. I have been pleased with performance ever since.

One of the sales points for me was the ready availability of open stock items, including this grilling pan. I also have the 11"griddle, so the biggest decision is which pan will be most appropriate for whatever is my fried item of choice. This pan has the raised grill pattern to allow juices and oils to drain off and not saturate your food.  But like other Circulon items it heats evenly and efficiently, is non-stick and a snap to clean. It's a sturdy and durable product, one that will continue to serve for years to come.  About the only complaints would be it's nearly impossible to get that striated grill look on your burgers because this pan makes burning or searing a tough act and the dishwasher is a no-no.

If you're not familiar with Circulon, give this pan a try and I would be surprised if you don't end up going out and purchasing a full set.
profile.summary: When in doubt, fry it.

profile.description: SPECIAL FEATURES "PLUG-N-PLAY", easy connectivity to your TV - set up in just minutes!; SYSTEM POWER HANDLING: 320 Watts (SOUNDBAR 160 Watts, Wireless Subwoofer 160 Watts); PINNACLE POWER PROTECTIONTM CIRCUITRY automatically prevents overload; 3 Year Warranty (three times that of the competition)"PLUG-N-PLAY" EASY HOOK UP ACCESSORIES INCLUDED IN THE BOX: 1 Meter Optical Cable for SOUNDBAR connection to TV; RCA Cable for alternate method of connecting SOUNDBAR to TV; Adapter Cable for connecting SOUNDBAR to TV via headphone jack; SOUNDBAR horizontal wall bracket for easy wall mounting; Remote Control (Power, Volume/Mute, Input Select, DSP Mode, Subwoofer Level & More160 WATT DUAL DRIVER WIRELESS POWERED SUBWOOFER: DOUBLE BASS WOOFERS in a compound compression configuration for very powerful bass output from this tiny footprint cabinet; Special Class D digital switching amplifier for high level output; Subwoofer On/Off power switch; LED subwoofer power indicator; Beautiful black gloss topped cabinet; Solid rubber isolation pads for added stability and enhanced bass response; Subwoofer cabinet designed with built-in pedestal base "lifts" woofers off the floor for maximum bass output and response160 WATT 8-ELEMENT POWERED SOUNDBAR: (8) Patented Digital Sound Processing Effects Modes to replicate a complete 5-channel surround sound system; Special Class D digital switching amplifier for high level output; MP3 compatible through headphone jack input; Perfect for Flat Screen TVs 42" & larger; SOUNDBAR feet for secure table top placement
profile.reviewText: Placed in context, which I failed to do out of the box, this soundbar/sub-woofer system should be a satisfactory choice for most budget minded users however not necessarily the direction I would take with mid to upper scale priced HDTVs. It's not going to compare favorably with higher end competitive units let alone 5.1(2)/7.1(2) Home Theater systems with a full-fledged A/V receiver. Regardless of the bloated MSRP, as an entry level soundbar system intended to supplant the typically under-performing internal speakers of economy to moderately priced TVs, or offer an alternative where space for external speakers is at a premium, the Pinnacle system can certainly meet the need although I would have liked to have seen HDMI and Bluetooth capability as features on this unit as it is with some other soundbars that fall within the entry level price range like the Sony HTCT260 Sound Bar Home Theater System. It is also represented on the manufacturer's website as an Amazon exclusive, which gives me a little pause yet with the 36 month warranty there does seem to be degree of security ALTHOUGH within the pages of the owner's manual I received and this system is not listed specifically, the limited warranty for other systems sold by the manufacturer is 24 months. The soundbar is 39 1/4" in width, has a 12V power supply and is recommended for use with TVs 37" or above. It can be attached to a source device by the provided one meter Toslink Optical cable, RCA cable or RCA adapter for use with a TV headphone jack. It is has one digital input and three auxiliary stereo inputs so a maximum of four devices can be ported to it at the same time if necessary. I tried all three connection options with the Toslink method proving to be vastly superior although if wall mounting is desired it is likely a longer cable will be required. The `in the box' provisions also include wall mount brackets, screws and a very convenient wall mount template. With the RCA cables and RCA adapter I encountered a low level background hum that was noticeable with in each input source I tried (two standard definition TVs, portable DVD player, iPod). If I didn't have the capability to employ the Toslink connection I would have lowered my overall rating because of the buzz or hum. So, although the system can be used with most video or audio devices, audio quality will be affected in some instances and if internal speakers cannot be disabled on the source device only the RCA adapter option worked for me although the quick start instructions state turning source volume to the lowest level is supposed to work with the Toslink connection. The LED front panel with clock has a mid blue illuminated hue and touch keys for power, pairing with Bluetooth sub-woofer, volume, mute, input source, listening mode. These selections along with the additional keys for adjustment of sub-woofer output levels and front panel display brightness are also accessible via the infrared remote control (batteries included). The system is compatible with Logitech Harmony remotes. There were other remotes listed but after seeing that my universal was included I stopped paying attention. Internally, the black matte finished PBAR features according to published documentation a 1" tweeter and three 1.75" woofers per side. I'm no expert so what exactly a 1.75 woofer is, I don't know. The soundbar is rated up to 160 watts total RMS. I don't know about the whole surround sound claim because while modulation over a 39" bar in synch with a detached sub-woofer might result in some aspects of sound immersion I don't feel it manages to achieve true surround sound. It is an improvement over internally housed TV speakers but with essentially two output locations it is not going to overwhelm more demanding listeners. The black vinyl finish with glossy top sub-woofer with 18V power supply is also rated to 160 watts RMS and features two 5 1/4" bass woofers in a push/pull compound compression configuration. As far as size is concerned the cabinet 7 1/8" Wide x 11 1/2" High x 12" Deep. The sub-woofer cabinet has a base positioned power switch with red LED indicator lamp, Bluetooth indicator lamp and pairing key although to this point it has paired automatically each time the devices simultaneously turned on. It has circuitry that will activate/deactivate the sub-woofer whenever soundbar power state changes, another nice feature. Recommended sub-woofer placement is a few inches from a wall in a left or right corner of the listening area or along a front wall near the soundbar to optimize blending so naturally I placed it in the middle of wall in the back of the room opposite but within broadcast range of the soundbar. FWIW, I am more impressed with the efficiency of the sub-woofer than the soundbar unit. While build factor is not on par with my present Home Theater system sub-woofer, in terms of output I would not be opposed to using it in my primary setup if the need arose...if it had wired capability (which it does not). Published specifications indicate it has a maximum SPL (Sound Pressure Level) of 112dB and to date I haven't encountered distortion even at maximum sub-woofer output levels as I have noticed at higher volume outputs from the soundbar itself. I didn't have a soundbar previously so in terms of audio quality ONLY, I compared the system to three similarly priced wireless speakers I have available: Boston Acoustics MC200Air Wireless Speaker System for AirPlay, Logitech UE Air and Pure VL-61998 Jongo S3 Wireless Speaker with Wi-Fi and Bluetooth. The first two speakers are single enclosures like the soundbar (not factoring in the sub-woofer) while the third unit is a dual speaker set. Individual perceptions and sensitivities will vary but for my preferences, the Pinnacle system was least impressive as in higher frequency ranges distortion was much more noticeable than with any of the other three units. Even with consideration of the wireless (Bluetooth) sub-woofer that I like, in my opinion the Pinnacle system was not a significant improvement over the single enclosure Logitech UE. For each audio or video source I sampled (streaming from Pandora , Netflix or Amazon Instant Video over Roku and/or Apple TV - Jazz channels or HD video; cable TV channels; standard DVD movies, CDs and MP3s) only one mode setting (sports) available on with the Pinnacle system resulted in composite tonality I was happy with. With the absence of a genuine equalizer function, the user is restricted to identifying which pre-assigned mode output is preferable for different sources and none of the remaining 7 choices were sufficient for me with any source as each selection seemed to require an overall higher volume setting to hear dialogue clearly, was deficient or tinny with treble or lacked requisite clarity. It also wouldn't hurt to put some kind of voltage output indicator on the top of the two power supplies as well as the underside label for the benefit of pre-emptors like me who rip open the box and start hooking up stuff since they look identical. As a result, if the primary objective is economically minded enhancement of the home theater experience, this system can meet the desire but if expectations are greater investment in a somewhat more efficient and most likely, more expensive mid-level sound system would be a better choice.
profile.summary: Worth the money, BUT...

profile.description: KING'S 12" Steel Toe Dipped Neoprene Work Boots offer 100% waterproof protection and good chemical resistance at a value price. Ideal for most wet and messy workplaces, these men's work boots have a durable fabric lining that wicks away moisture to keep your feet cool and dry. Featuring a seamless, dipped construction that is soft and pliable, these neoprene boots also have a tough, slip-resistant outsole that squeegees liquid and debris out from underfoot. A scalloped edge prevents chafing and rubbing against your legs.
profile.reviewText:
I acquired these boots for a single purpose, trekking through a nature preserve with a mutt who thinks hes a gopher. The marketing blurbs give all sorts of suggestions regarding work environments where these steel toed waterproof boots should be useful but I have no intention of ever involving myself in those endeavors and unless reparations are granted and I get 40 acres and a heck of lot more initiative, farm labor is not on the agenda either.

I customarily wear a half-size larger but despite the steel toe, this pair fits well although the upper boot portion is annoying to me, probably because wearing boots that rub just below the calf muscles isn't an everyday (or any day) experience for me. Whatever filmy substance is on the exterior appears to be there for a purpose so I didn't try to remove it and after one foray in the muck, its no longer an issue.

The boots are relatively comfortable for extended wear. The interior lining seems to retain heat which I expect will be welcome when I have to take said mutt out in less favorable weather conditions. I only hope the tread pattern works as well on ice as the manufacturer indicates it is supposed to work at wet, slippery work sites.
profile.summary: Also potentially useful for the stuff you step in while reading reviews

profile.description: Upgraded U8 Plus: Long Battery Life ,barometer, Dial, SMS, phone book, call history, BT notification, BT music, long-distance capture, pedometer, sleep monitor, anti-lost Alarm, power save mode etc. Android Supports Functions: Sync, Passometer, Calculator, Stopwatch, Alarm Clock, Anti-lost Alarm, Barometer, Thermometer, Sleep Monitoring, Music Player, Call History, Set Time/Date, SMS, MMS, Wechat, QQ, and Remote Camera. IOS Supports Functions: Sync, Passometer, Calculator, Stopwatch, Alarm Clock, Anti-lost Alarm, Barometer, Thermometer. NOTE: Do not support Text Message, SMS, Wechat, QQ, or Remote Camera. Support hands-free Calls / Answer or Dial calls from your wristwatch. Ring reminder when your Android 2.3 or above smart phone receive a message (including Wechat, Facebook, Twitter, WhatsApp, Skype,and so on).
profile.reviewText:
Lets preface this by fully admitting I accepted the offer for a smartwatch because;  a) Im curious, and b) Im cheap, so there was no way this anachronism was about to spend any real money to buy an expensive modelor, for all that it matters, a modestly priced one just to tinker with.  I used to only visit Wastebook/ Fritter/Instaslam/Feintinterest  to troll my kids;  I only own smartphones to stay reasonably up to date with technology I have little personal use for and my personal preference is NOT to be reachable 24hrs. a day.

That ranted, for the price this isn't a bad little gadget if you're enthusiastic about the types of utilities offered by this and competitive devices (Im not, see the previous paragraph). After downloading the BT Notifications app and pairing, the smartwatch  works pretty well with Android phones (I tested with a Blu Studio Mini) and works somewhat diffidently with iPhones (tested with an iPhone 5c), WHEN it manages to remain linked via Bluetooth. With both operating systems, I experienced disconnects  way more often than I found tolerable, even with the watch and phone(s) within a foot or so of each other.

The watchs navigation is similar to the functionality of an Android mobile device and users may use for text messaging, phone calls, as a music player (which I really don't understand- the speaker is horrific as might be expected with a device of this type),  a stopwatch,  a pedometer (which proved to be surprisingly accurate), thermometer/barometer/altimeter (although I cant figure out if it can be changed from Celsius to Fahrenheit) and a sleep monitor.

 Okay, I will admit the remote capture camera feature is pretty cool but as far as the sleep monitoring function, it requires more manual intervention than I would prefer (but not terribly unlike many other inexpensive trackers) and I didn't find the results credible. Most of the above-mentioned utilities work with iPhones as well with the notable exceptions of Text Messaging, SMS and remote camera.

The battery life is very good although I would not say that I have placed a great deal of demand on the device by streaming music or texting a great deal. With the flexible rubber wristband, it is comfortable for wear and quite lightweight. It is not water resistant. Even with very limited use, I have noticed the plastic faceplate is accumulating a bunch of scratches and it already a has bubble spot.

Yet, for the cost, for those who have a desire to join the smartwatch craze for minimal outlay, this unit might serve as a viable entry point.

I received a sample for evaluation.
profile.summary: What do you know, it tells the time as well.

profile.description: Buffalos LinkStation 220 provides easy to use shared storage and backup for all PC and Mac computers, tablets and smartphones on your home network with the security of RAID data protection. Simply connect it to your wireless router for access anywhere in your home. While on the go, Buffalo's WebAccess service allows you to create a free personal cloud for easy remote access anytime, anywhere over the Internet, and even on your iPhone, iPad and Android devices. With LinkStation 220, you can back up multiple computers simultaneously and enjoy uninterrupted access to terabytes of storage anytime, anywhere.
profile.reviewText:
I got this diskless enclosure in anticipation of replacement of NETGEAR ReadyNAS Duo 2-Bay 1 TB Desktop Network Attached Storage RND2110 I have had in operation since 2008 but based on maximum capacity limits I thought I could upgrade to a unit with enhanced scalability. With a represented maximum capacity of 8TB with two HDD in Raid 0 I hoped the Buffalo unit would fill the bill as most of the other basic services iTunes, DLNA and BitTorrent I use were also built in. There is additionally a backup utility I haven't had the opportunity to try yet.

Unfortunately, I think I will stick with the ReadyNAS and a Seagate Central 2TB NAS for essential processing until I can get a Greek translation for this unit, or maybe just eat the expense of purchasing two higher capacity hard drives to accommodate this unit. First off, the case itself does not offer a great deal of confidence with its' plastic components including mounting trays that gives me shivers every time I try to remove them, which I had to do since I didn't realize I would have to do external formatting before I could load the new drives on this device. That may have been my lack of knowledge or understanding however,  from what I saw checking Buffalo's website, there is an administrative option to format internal disks...and yeah it works,  since once I managed to get the new disks recognized (but not mounted, according to error messages) I was able to reformat them.

This unit has abysmal quick start documentation but the manual that can be downloaded from the website via the installation CD is a worthwhile (nearly compulsory) resource, although as I tried to interpret the front panel light patterns I seemed to encounter a couple of sequences I couldn't identify in the manual or find any information for on the website. What I ended up doing was resetting the device to factory defaults in accordance with instructions I stumbled across in the manual.

I don't know if there is some heuristic learning required here but for nearly two days each time I accessed the device via the Navigator application, I was advised my drives were not formatted and the device was operating in emergency mode. Finally, after downloading a firmware update (again) and reformatting disk 1 (again) I was able to eliminate the error message popups on my PCs (navigator must be installed on each PC on network were linking is desired) begin transferring data. That was 4 days ago.

With 500GB to be transferred from the Ready NAS and about a terabyte to be transferred from the Seagate Central both of which are Ethernet wired, I am seeing transfer speeds of less than 1MB/s, far under performance I have experienced with either of the two source devices for backups or copying.

This review is a work in process, one I will update as I have more opportunity to manipulate this unit but right now just getting the data available on it is a disappointing chore.  I haven't been successful in changing the array yet as it still informs me I don't have one defined so this thing may end up as JBOD for a while.
profile.summary: First Impressions...I've been Buffaloed.

profile.description: We usually roast beef, lamb, chicken, fish and other meat, that can provide our bodies with protein, fat and inorganic salts. But when in the process of cooking, fat in a high-temperature barbecue will produce benzopyrene (a common high activity indirect carcinogen), this substance is carcinogenic, which can harm the human body. The Famili OT007 Wireless Kitchen Food Thermometer will remind you of the temperature just in time, so you can enjoy your delicious food safely!Features: - Large, smart backlit LCD display that changes color during the cooking process (blue>green>red); - Programmed with preset USDA approved temperatures for different types of meat (Ground Beef, Ground Poultry, Beef, Veal, Chicken, Pork, Poultry, Lamb and Fish); - Programmed with preset USDA approved doneness levels for a different types of meat (Rare, Medium Rare, Medium, Medium Well and Well Done); - Program your own temperature settings manually; - Countdown and count up timer; - Alarm; - Temperature Accuracy: 1.8F (1C) from 32 to 212F (0 to 100C) - Temperature Range: 16 to 482F (-9 to 250C) Resolution :1 - Wireless Range: Up to 300 feet - Probe Length (not including cable): 6 1/2 inch (166mm) food grade stainless steel probe - Total Length of Probe including mesh cable: 47 inch (1200 mm) - Highest Sustainable Temperature: Probe and mesh cable can withstand up to 716F (380C) - Uses: BBQ, Oven, Smoker, Candy, Meat, FoodPackage Contents: - 1 x Digital Thermometer Receiver - 1 x Digital Thermometer Transmitter - 1 x Food Temperature Probe - 4 x AAA batteries - 1 x Manual For more details, please refer to the user manual right below this sentence
profile.reviewText:
A very useful gadget for barbequing enthusiasts who are regularly stoking the coals or those who only open the grill cover when tradition seems to demand it. This thermometer set touts a possible range of up to 300 ft with the transmitter/receiver set up and although I seriously doubt Ill ever approach those distances from the fire, I know once winter kicks in it will be nice not to have to keep running outside or opening the patio sliding door to see how things are processing.

This set has an audible alarm for both temperature and time settings and also a color flash feature to indicate detected internal temperatures of whatever is being cooked. As an aside, personally I find the consistent flashing of blue, green or red lamps at variable temperature ranges annoying but it does serve a justifiable purpose.

The transmitter and receiver are easily paired in much the same manner as with a Bluetooth device. The receiver unit has numerable available settings with an easy to read LCD display screen: Typical internal temperature range for variable meat products, serving preferences such as rare, medium, well-done, Celsius or Fahrenheit display, Timer mode from one minute to 24 hours, Auto shut off feature afer 30 minutes of inactivity. The transmitter unit also employs a LCD display screen for temperature display.

The braided cord stainless steel probe of this unit is identical to the probe I have with a Charbroil Smoker and turns out to be interchangeable which is probably another side benefit for me as these corded probes can be easily damaged in the case of accidental flare-ups. The probe has proven to be as accurate as my Taylor stainless thermometer.

The rubber casing of both the transmitter and receiver is marginally heat resistant but should not come into contact with excessively hot surfaces. Each unit requires 2 AAA batteries (included). The transmitter unit has a wire stand and the receiver can be worn via belt clip attachment.

I received a sample for evaluation.
profile.summary: Stick a probe in it.

profile.description: . New, redesigned smaller version of the original BOSU Balance Trainer and is constructed with the same rim and base style. The sleek, compact 20" design allows for easy transportation and storage, quick positioning for any type of workout and is ideal for fitness entusiasts and athletes of all ages. Includes inflation pump and owners manual. 250 lbs. maximum user weight.
profile.reviewText:
And thats just pumping it up. The provided yellow foot pump was fine for me along with the lead tube but by the time I detached the plastic nozzle and attempted to insert the plug half the air I had put into it managed to escape so I basically had to start overthree times. By then, after doing the leg extensions I was ready to call it a successful workout and push this contraption under the bed until another day, or leave it on the floor, on my side of the bed, next to the full size exercise ball clothing rack that someone else thought would be a good idea two years ago but hasn't used since. Anyway, with due consideration the flimsy plastic construction of the pump, I don't hold out much confidence its going to stand the test of time either but a bike pump alternative is always there, assuming I decide to add this trainer to my ongoing workout plan.

The trainer itself is well constructed, sturdy and relatively simple to use. The device is surprisingly heavier than I expected and seems unlikely to move unexpectedly or inconveniently during use.  It is suggested to inflate the half-moon ball no more than 8 inches and I think limiting to 6 might work well for those who might desire or need a few sessions to become acclimated.

Although I regularly do cardio reps I haven't done a lot with balance oriented regimens and even trying it out with the basic exercises illustrated in the booklet, it took a few attempts to feel comfortable with it. For those who are familiar with this device or others like it, more advanced exercise suggestions can be found online.
profile.summary: Nice alternative for cardio workout

profile.description: Ed Harris directs and stars in this Western, which co-stars Viggo Mortensen and Jeremy Irons. When Virgil Cole (Harris) and Everett Hitch (Mortensen) arrive in Appaloosa, they find a town suffering at the hands of villaionous rancher Randall Bragg (Irons). Their attempts to free the town from Bragg's tyranny are complicated by the arrival of beautiful young widow Allison French (Renee Zellweger).
profile.reviewText:
Appaloosa as directed by Ed Harris, is a western that will appeal to most fans of the genre regardless of one's preference for the traditional vein in the mode of John Wayne or the modern interpretations like 3:10 to Yuma.

Virgil Cole (Harris) and his long-time associate Everett Hitch (Viggo Mortensen) are essentially `cleaners' of a bygone era. Appaloosa is just another dusty town in need of their particular brand of expertise, establishment of a codified rule of law - as defined by the no nonsense Cole - and eradication of the human blight that has plagued the area for the last few years, Randall Bragg (Jeremy Irons) and his despicable crew of trail vermin. While it does not take long to ascertain there will be confrontations on the horizon, the arrival in town of a young attractive widow, Allison French (played by Rene Zellweger) immediately foreshadows complications that may irretrievably alter the dynamic between the complementary partners, Cole and Hitch.

There's plenty enough action and violence for the bloodthirsty viewer and well as refined cynicism for those who appreciate the contemplative portrayal of the new age intellectual cowboy (Mortensen's understated performance is a gem, somewhat reminiscent of Val Kilmer as  Doc Holliday in Tombstone, absent the addictiveness) but to the credit of Harris' direction and the screenplay adaptation of Robert B. Parker's novel, the film never seems to meander into the fantastical, where quite often the protagonists are seemingly invincible and infallible.
profile.summary: Walk softly and carry a big shotgun

profile.description: TomTom Golfer 2 GPS Watch
profile.reviewText:
Although appreciably less so once you recognize, you do have to manually enter putts and most likely soft chip shots. Or, maybe you read the manual before you ran off to the course and knew thatnot my style.

Anyway, this is my first meaningful relationship with a golf GPS and Im convinced it will be a lasting one. I had convinced myself I needed one with a color display, overhead shots of the layout and maybe remote connect to the beverage cart on resort courses. Well, that last requirement is still on the wishlist but barring that, this is one impressive game enhancement aid for me and not entirely because Im also too cheap to lay out the cash for the obvious suspect.

 Essentially, the Golfer 2 is ready to go out the box after charging (a full charge will last about ten hours, dependent on the frequency of use of backlighting which under most conditions has proven to be unnecessary to use). The soft rubber band is comfortable to wear, unobtrusive and has a secure adjustable closure mechanism. BTW, the watch is represented to be highly water resistant, which is a major point for me because I sweat like Tom Kite before medical intervention.

The watch can be updated/upgraded via a PC resident MySports connect program and syncs with a downloadable mobile device app (but not at the same time  if you try it you may think the watch is a brick) that is the primary utility of game analysis. There are two options for course updating and believe it when the instructions suggest using QuickGPS if you're anxious to get on the course. I failed to do so and the general update feature took nearly an hour to load. Once the watch is activated and navigated by a four-directional button, it searches for and displays the nearest course with the capability to scroll to other nearby courses. I should mention the button is not terribly sensitive so the possibility of accidental entries is minimized. The documentation states over 40,000 layouts worldwide are accessible. Once again, using the MySports Connect, I spent some time trying to search for courses Ive played over the years including rinky-dink cow pastures that don't deserve the recognition and the only courses I couldn't find are ones that have  to my surprise been converted into housing tracts.

But what about something that matters? Like how this thing works in play. Well, as soon as you start your round the TomTom begins to excel. You get an immediate display of hole information like yardage (front, back center of green), hazards, hole orientation, etc. More detailed information can be accessed by using activation of secondary screens.

The watch has an automatic shot detection sensor (its a voodoo thing) that records only actual swings and only one swing at any location so you can take practice swings to your hearts desire or consternation of playing partners. Theres a buzzer feature to let you know the swing has been recorded.

As you reach your lie, you can see the distance adjustments and screen information changes to provide information on layup distances (100/150/200 yards) and naturally, any hazards as well as the distance of last shot and so far as i can tell, it's pretty darn accurate, or both the distance measuring devices I now have are equally wrong. One thing I realized immediately was how helpful having the info right there was to trying to execute finesse shots. Once you reach the green, putts must be recorded manually. I don't know how this compares to most competitive models but for me, its not a significant factor. Any penalty shots must also be manually entered but its best to wait until you have departed the green because any entry at the green will be interpreted to be a putt.

After the round, there's all sort of information to obsess over after syncing with the mobile device app, including historical data on past rounds played at the same site giving the player insights to hits, misses, tendencies and even the mystical ultimate round for the venue.

Although I have no doubt the Golfer 2 will be beneficial on the courses I play locally, I think most regular players probably have hard coded imagery of home courses and in many instances, indelible memories of most courses theyve played. Where I think I will see the most benefit in play is when I play new courses. With this device, there will be no such thing as the blind shot.
profile.summary: I have a difficult time imagining how this device wouldnt be a stroke saver for players of any skill level

profile.description: white colors
profile.reviewText:
And that is merely an okay thing with these earphones even with consideration of price and the multiplicity of features.  They are passable as far as sound reproduction is concerned but not much better than the earbuds that come with most mobile devices, just Bluetooth 4.1 with a high visibility connector. Within the midrange, I felt like I was listening through a down pillow. Now, it should also be acknowledged all of the tracks were encoded at lower bit rates to maximize storage on the device  but performance was based on comparison of the same tracks with comparably priced earphones.

On the plus side, I did find them secure while jogging and pretty comfortable to wear for longer listening sessions.  They don't seem to mangle sound reproduction on either end of the frequency range; its simply a case where overall performance is only mediocre. Like most competitive devices, this set is represented to have an effective range of a little over 30 ft. although in unobstructed areas I found the Bluetooth connection to be relatively stable over modestly longer distance.  Charging time is around two hours although the set is delivered with a partial charge. An LED indicator lamp for charge is housed on the left side earphone. Conversation time is published to be around 5 hrs with a full charge. I really have no idea how valid that representation may be, or am I likely to ever find out.
Essentially, the right side earphone has two control buttons while the port for USB connectivity embedded in the left earphone. The multi- function power button is also used for pairing, pairing with two devices, music play/pause, call answering, call rejection and a whole lot of other options related to interface with a mobile device that may matter to some users.  A separate volume button can also be employed for track selection.

Unless this set is the only set of earphones you intend to use and they are used often enough that you memorize all of the press functions, you might want to keep the instruction manual in the hard shell case because I couldn't be bothered to trying to remember how many times I need to press the power button for each of the functions, not that I have any interest in answering incoming calls anyway, ever. There is additionally a voice notification feature that can be disabled.

The package includes three sets of differing size rubber ear pieces and ear hooks and with a 4 inch Micro USB charging cable.

I received a sample for evaluation.
profile.summary: I just want to listen to my tunes.

profile.description: The Logitech Wireless Mouse M325-a better mix of precision and comfort. With its designed-for-Web scrolling, now everything you love to do online is easier. Designed to improve your online experience, the wheel also helps perfect scrolling when you're using other applications, such as Microsoft Office or Adobe PDF. --Micro-precise scrolling: New designed-for-Web scrolling makes searches, shopping and browsing easier. --Feel-good design: Contoured shape and textured rubber grips keep your hand comfortable even after long hours. --Long battery life: Up to 18 months of battery life virtually eliminates the need to change batteries. Battery life may vary based on user and computing conditions. --For Windows, Mac and Linux: Reliable wireless connection with tiny Logitech Unifying Nano-receiver that can stay in your laptop.
profile.reviewText: Simply stated, I am extremely pleased with this mouse. This is my first wireless so I cannot speak to how it compares to others of the same type but I do know I will not be purchasing any more wired ones for any of the computers I use... although the cheapskate in me knows I will be reattaching some I have laying around if this mouse bites the big one. The streamline form factor appeals to me as the m325 appears to be 25 percent smaller than a standard size. I don't have particularly small hands but it does feel much more comfortable to me and presently I tend be at the computer at least four to six hours each day. The scroll wheel impresses me with its' precision pointing along with the forward/ back capability in switching web pages and is a true benefit in those instances where the user may have to rapidly search through long lists on a web site as I am certain other vine members can identify with. I have the mouse paired with Logitech Wireless Keyboard K360 (Dark Silver) (920-003366) via the unifying receiver . Together the two devices offer me more freedom and comfort at the desktop than I have ever experienced before as I can use each just about anywhere. This optical mouse has worked fluidly on every surface I tried thus far. A common major complaint with wireless mice is battery life. I cannot address that at present as I have only had this unit for a few months. While Logitech claims this mouse may have up to eighteen months with an AA alkaline battery, that may be based on assumption the user switches off the mouse when not in use and that is not my practice, so we will see. There is a battery indicator light that appears to be momentarily activated when the mouse is turned on or upon exiting sleep mode.
profile.summary: Scrolling through the Vineyard

profile.description: Coated inside and out with rugged nonstick, Circulon 2 cookware eliminates the chore of scrubbing pots and pans. This 11-inch square griddle is great for frying eggs and a rasher of bacon or making weekend pancakes. And the low sides provide maximum access to the cooking surface for easy turning. Circulon's patented Hi-Low system of concentric grooves creates narrow ridges to take utensil abuse, leaving low, wide grooves unscathed to readily release food and ensuring long life for the nonstick coating. Beneath the nonstick is harder-than-steel anodized aluminum. Pot and pan bottoms are left uncoated to conduct heat quickly and prevent hot spots. The slip-resistant synthetic grips on the riveted, polished, stainless-steel handle stays cool on the stovetop and goes safely in an oven up to 350 degrees F. Hand wash only. Backed by a lifetime warranty against defects.
profile.reviewText:
Due to a confluence of circumstances four years ago when I was in the market for a new set of cookware I was able to try out 10" skillets from Anolon and Circulon classic. After using each for a few days, I felt the Circulon unit with its' ridged non-stick interior surface heated more efficiently and was easier to clean. After a price check, I decided to purchase the full set. However, when I saw the subtle changes in the beveled interior configuration of the Circulon2 cookware I decided to opt for this set. I have been pleased with performance ever since.

One of the sales points for me was the ready availability of open stock items, including this griddle. I have a number of other options for preparing pancakes, fried sandwiches, burgers and the like but time after time I pull out this piece. It heats evenly facilitating lower cooking temperatures, never requires any oil, is fast and easy to clean and with minimal effort looks like it's brand new. If you're not familiar with Circulon, give this pan a try and I would be surprised if you don't end up going out and purchasing a full set.
profile.summary: I say if you can't fry it, don't eat it.

profile.description: CEL Robox 3D Printer Robox is a 3D printer that combines the best next-generation features at a fraction of the cost. Designed totally from scratch with performance in mind, it's an exciting and much-anticipated model. But it's not just hype - CEL has delivered a truly stunning product at an equally attractive price point. Precision Creating objects that are accurate to the software model requires extremely precise motion and the highest resolution possible. All Robox motors and axes are attached to a single stainless steel frame which is a reference surface for all motion; this is rigidly attached to injection molded parts which form the body of the printer to create a super-stable platform. Additionally, the Robox boasts a surreal 20 micron maximum layer resolution, allowing for the smallest details to be created flawlessly. The nozzle valve system created by CEL cuts off filament completely, eliminating ooze and contributing to a much smoother surface finish - meaning less time spent on finishing work. Forward-Focused CEL uses powerful custom-designed stepper motors in the Robox, meaning that your printer won't become obsolete just because there's an updated head available - the motors are equipped to handle it. SPECIFICATIONS: Print Technology; Fused Filament Fabrication (FFF); Build Volume: 210x150x100mm/8.3x5.9x3.9in; Best Layer Resolution; 20 microns; Filament Diameter; 1.75mm+/-0.05mm; Nozzle Diameters; 0.3mm (0.012") and 0.8mm (0.031"); Material Compatibility; PLA, ABS, HIPS, Nylon, PC, PVA; Internal Lighting; Full RGB; Print Bed: Tapeless Heated Polyetherimide; Power Requirements; 100-240VAC, 50-60Hz; connectivity USB 2.0.
profile.reviewText:
To be clear, let's start out with the caveats anyone considering purchase of a 3D printer should be aware of so far as they apply to my to-date experiences with this model and my breath of knowledge about the technology and anticipated use. This is my first 3D printer; I didn't acquire it with any specific uses in mind other than curiosity about the capabilities of such devices however I do have reasonably lengthy work and hobbyist histories with innovative technological developments.

 That said, although I read about other models from other manufacturers and did some cursory comparison of specifications/features the variables among models were not as significant to me as I was also afforded the opportunity to acquire this one at a very attractive price (It should be noted Amazon Vine is no longer a program where items are necessarily offered to reviewers at no cost).  AS one might expect, after reading some of the less enthusiastic reviews posted here, I wasn't sure what to expect once I did unpack this unit and placed it in operation. Fortunately, I haven't encountered many of the encumbrances or constraints others have noted here, including any need thus far to pursue assistance from technical or customer support.

As I played around with the printer, I my thoughts immediately brought to mind-  similarly to what another reviewer here noted - trying out a new DSLR camera. I found the printer simple to set up and use but to fully exploit all of the features and capabilities, time/effort and a period of trial/error with different settings is essential. It isn't a stretch to consider the Robox a plug and play device but progressing to levels of higher quality intricate builds will require learning the nuances and idiosyncrasies of this box.

The printer features two line feed slots although only one line of filament can be mounted and used at one time. With the Robox reels the type of filament, color, and amount remaining on the reel are recognized. The existence of two feed entry may be indicative of future enhancements where two reels can be mounted in tandem. Presently, it is feasible to pause a print, eject a line of filament and change colors but it is advisable to stick with the same material, e.g. not to switch from PLA to ABS in the middle of a build to avoid clogging issues.

I thought it would be helpful and informative to begin with a generic build of the provided but only minimally involved pyramid model across the full range of default setting with each of the included filament types, PLA and ABS. While I still haven't found a clearly visible way to change the default names of projects, I have found they can be reloaded for reprints directly from the default menuing of most recent projects.

Since I have the prototypical techie aversion to reading the manual (122 page PDF on included USB drive card) even though I frequently harangued others for not doing so, I was mildly concerned when the smaller .3mm nozzle began to emit orange filament so the first action after loading one of the filament reels probably should be to purge rather than jumping straight to a build.

This also alludes to another factor to obviate some degree of consternation, allowing the extruder and bed to pre-heat before commencement of a build. Although the bed and nozzle temperatures are displayed before commencement and during any build, it appears pre-heating greatly assists in filament adhesion. Another aside however, after cleaning the bed with the isopropyl alcohol wipes, make sure the fluid has completely evaporated before attempting a build. More sophisticated builds also demand creation of a brim layer and I tend to believe thicker is better, certainly less annoying to clean off the finished product than starting over when the build fails in the middle of the project.

As represented, the gantry is self-leveling and I haven't had any need to adjust it or any issues with nozzle alignment. From there I moved on to a larger build, the provided robot model which served to demonstrate the upper limit of build height (about 4").  What I have since discovered is, running the purge utility after each build whether or not filament material is changed is useful as is running the nozzle clean utility after longer term builds. I have found the larger nozzle (.8mm) tends to clog leading to some instances of frustration when commencing a new project. The larger nozzle has proven to be somewhat problematic with the draft setting, much more so than the smaller nozzle with normal or fine builds. Thus far, I haven't tried customization.

One small area of personal irritation with the printer is the need to consistently clean out filament residue that falls into the chassis slot for the Y axis. In the manual it is recommended to lift and shake the printer to move the filament to front end where it can be removed with the provided tweezers but beyond some inconvenience if the printer is set up in less accessible locations there is also a tendency for the door lock to engage resulting in the inability to open the front cover as the inadvertent locking is not recognized by the application and will not acknowledge any attempts to use the program icon for unlocking. Before I discovered how to get into advance settings (RTFM) where GC codes can be set to adjust settings like the door lock, I just ran another purge utility to get to the printer to recognize status of the door lock.

Without doubt, this printer and my proficiency with it will be a work in progress and as I discover new factors related to it, I intend to come back and update this review. At the moment, I am very excited about it and hope the problems others have indicated related to manufacturer responsiveness are immediately addressed. I can't say if it is a quality control or shipping issue but when functional this appears to be an impressive device for personal use.
profile.summary: It works for me.

profile.description: Zwipes new Ultra Plush and extra large microfiber towel makes all drying jobs a breeze. The top quality microfiber used in the towel is safe on all surfaces and absorbs 5 times its weight in water. Extra deep-pile material massages the vehicle's finish, grabbing any loose particles and lifting them away leaving a showroom shine. The convenient hand pockets allows to securely hold the towel while you dry. When it comes time, simply toss the towel in the washing machine. Avoid fabric softener and other articles that may lint as they can clog the fibers. Good for hundreds of washings this towel will be the go-to for years to come.
profile.reviewText:
I switched over to microfiber towels in lieu of leather chamois cloths a few years ago because with multiple uses the microfiber towels have proven to be more cost effective when durability is taken into account. No matter how much I tried to follow suggested care instructions for the chamois, at some point I would get oil or grease on them and in the attempt to cleanse, it would become stiff and less absorbent.

With the microfibers, as long as fabric softeners are avoided when machine washed, they seem to maintain the ability to soak up a whole lot of water however, if they come into contact with oil or grease they are just as susceptible to loss of absorbency, I just don't feel as irritated throwing it away.  One thing that anyone picking up this towel should do is wash it first because I haven't owned one yet that didn't leave little fur balls on the car finish the first few times it was used.

With the added feature of pockets on each end, it works as well as others I have used over the years, soaking up a rather impressive amount of water. I suppose the pockets are useful for some during the drying process but for me they don't add much value. If I need to stick my hand in the towel to get some leverage then Im  probably drying openings in wheel covers that have some oils and brake dust residue that I really don't want to get clumped into the microfibers of this towel anyway.
profile.summary: My car has a softer towel than I do

profile.description: Perfectly sized to fit in your kitchen or breakroom, this coffeemaker allows you to create cafe-quality beverages anytime. Impress guests and clients with your barista skills by preparing one of their favorites. Single-serve design lets you brew a fresh cup every time. Brews up to 5 different types of beverages with the push of a button. Makes Americano, lungo, cappuccino, latte and espresso drinks. Durable plastic construction and compact design for more counter space. 16" long power cord provides extended reach. Compatible with Nescafe Alegria 510 coffee. Pour-over, 2-liter water tank capacity.
profile.reviewText:
I received a product sample through the Amazon Vine Program.

As an avid coffee drinker who ignores the coffee connoisseur he lives with, I never considered myself much of a fan of most of instant varieties I have tasted and still harbor the delusion I am not an advocate of the less rich or flavorful quick fixes. However, over the course of two weeks at a Caribbean 5 star resort I drank a whole lot of lattes and cappuccinos prepared with Alegria coffee dispensed from a commercial sized Alegria machine. Now, as I think about it, maybe I should go to another site and revise my review of that resort because at their prices, if they're making a regular practice of serving me instant coffee those five stars may be a delusion as well but that's another review...

The Alegria espresso machine uses a blend of instant and fine ground supposedly expressly created for use with this machine. I'm not convinced there is a major difference between the Alegria coffee and some other varieties Nescafe sells; I do know the Alegria  is a heck of a lot harder to find since locally I looked around unsuccessfully but was happy to find it online when circumstances prevailed to drop this coffee machine at my  doorstep. I was also happy to discover the resulting brews of lattes and cappuccinos were equally as tasteful as what I remembered from my time in the Caribbean.

For those who are accustomed to and prefer a stronger blend like the above mentioned connoisseur who was not as enamored with the brews, the Americano, Lungo and Espresso options reflect the strength to meet expectations when compared to some coffee house concoctions, many of which also have a burnt flavoring or aftertaste I would prefer to avoid. Milk frothing for the latte and cappuccino settings is accomplished by dispensing a small amount of hot water into whatever milk choice has been added to the cup beforehand. So, since I'm not a fan of the burnt aftertaste brands anyway, all five options available with the 510 machine are great, and the machine itself does not require as much maintenance as is the case with most other espresso makers.

The machine itself is made of plastic components with a side positioned on/off switch, a five choice dial on the top front and has a detachable, refillable plastic water tank. It should be noted dispensed coffee tends to be a bit cooler than one might expect. It is immediately drinkable when dispensed and not necessarily conducive to travel cups, which at any rate, cannot be placed under the dispenser or is there sufficient clearance to accommodate most mug sized containers.

With a few compromises I find to be entirely reasonable when the cost and convenience of this coffee maker are factored into consideration, I think it would be satisfying alternative for potential buyers.
profile.summary: A vacation in every cup

profile.description: Experience widescreen entertainment the way it was meant to be seen -in the comfort of your own home. The Home Cinema 730HD projector boasts 3000 lumens of color brightness and 3000 lumens of white brightness 2, so images are rich and brilliant. Watch blockbuster movies and sporting events on the big screen, or play larger-than-life video games, all with amazing clarity and color -it's easy with 720p resolution and HDMI connectivity. Epson's innovative setup tools make it simple to experience exciting entertainment up to 300", on virtually any wall or screen -indoors or out.
profile.reviewText:
Well, I had to find something to criticize and I found a lot of silly irrelevancies to harp on, like for this kind of money I think Epson could have provided a carrying case or throw me a bone with at least one type of cable to connect it, or a replacement lamp because I have a feeling I'm going to burn out this one pretty fast (BTW, the replacement cost might get your attention-$99 at Epson).

Really, I know there are other projectors out there with more features such as 3D projection, higher lumens, enhanced audio and the like but for my needs and I suspect the average home user this will be a great addition to the Home Entertainment installation with the flexibility to be used in business settings as well. It can be ceiling mounted for front or rear projection or on a flat surface for the same.  I set it up via HDMI to my A/V receiver, plugged it in and was streaming an amazon instant video via Roku in minutes. In fact, I was so impressed with broadcast brightness for whites and colors on a cream colored wall I didn't even bother to set up a screen. At a distance of about five feet I reduced the projection size to about 50 inches and I was highly impressed with resolution even at 480p (and later 480i from a game system). It is published that projection size can be expanded up to 300 inches but I really don't have convenient location anywhere to test that claim. Other available connectivity options are: VGA/SVGA (which I also used from a laptop computer), RCA component, USB and S-Video.

During a daylight viewing session of a standard definition film in a naturally illuminated room, while the projection was somewhat washed out I felt the quality was still acceptable (and still to a light colored wall) in my opinion superior to the mirrored view on a standard definition 30" TV.  The projector has a front located tab for height adjustment and features manual lens adjustment knobs for image size and left/right positioning. There is a better than nothing speaker for audio but I don't think there will be any letters written home about how much anyone is impressed with it.

I like accessibility of all features/adjustments not only from the remote but also via buttons on the device itself. It does not require a cool down period, just turn it off and unplug which is a relief because the fan is a little loud.  Another exciting discovery - at first - was the existence of networking over wifi. Then, I checked at Epson's site for the appropriate software and adapters...and decided connecting to my PC or desktop by VGA and streaming from networked locations in that manner made more sense... Yeah, I'm cheap, and in that vein I also discovered an old 14" laptop carrying case I have sitting around will work just fine for this projector.
profile.summary: The case color doesn't match my other components.

profile.description: The Sentinel on guard 10 sheet micro-cut shredder with a PULLOUT bin. A 5mm x 10mm micro-cut shred for optimum security of your personal data. Auto start/stop means you simply leave the shredder on and simply feed the paper or credit card into the intake. A manual reverse function allows you to reverse the cutting blades in the event of a jam. Want to shred a credit card? no problem, the Sentinel 10 sheet micro-cut shredder can do that too. Simple to empty with a PULLOUT 3 gallon wastebasket. No plastic bags required; simply slide out the wastebasket, and dump the shredded material in the dumpster. Reliable, easy to use and easy to empty makes the Sentinel 10 sheet micro-cut shredder a must have for home or office.
profile.reviewText:
Pretty much an essential device in this day and age unless you have figured out how to create the paperless office and home. You didnt, you will not ever and the next best choice is to find yourself a quality shredder. I think this one fills the bill quite nicely and as my first unit employing the microcut design, it has quickly become my personal favorite for shredding options. Im sure somewhere some persistent someone could dump out the quarter inch size shreds and reconstruct a document but compared to the diamond and crosscut shredders I used in the past, theyll have their work cut out for them.

The shredding mechanism is weighty but sits securely in the included waste canister. Compared to other shredders Ive owned, it does seem a bit noisier, with a distinctly higher pitched whine when required to handle a larger feed load (10 sheet max in one feed) including credit cards.
 The unit has a three position switch (forward, reverse, off), a power indicator lamp which also will display in red if the device overheats. Credit cards can be accommodated as well. After 30 minutes of use, it is recommended the shredder blades be lubricated. My method to do so is to saturate a few sheets with a canola oil cooking spray and feed them through the blades.

The canister, represented to hold up to a little over three gallons of refuse, is conveniently removable for emptying.
profile.summary: Shredder residue parade just doesn't roll off the tongue as well.

profile.description: The Black Pearl Sterling Silver Heart Pendant defines true love. Gently seated in the open heart, the 9-10mm dyed black AAA button style pearl features an astonishing AAA luster that casts a mirrored glow off the 925 sterling silver heart. The shimmering effect adds an overall sparkle to the Heart Black 9-10mm AA Quality Freshwater 925 Sterling Silver Pearl Pendant. Sensually intertwined with its 17 chain, you can see the deeply rooted affection as it lies closely against your heart.
profile.reviewText:
Because me and the recipient of this pendant were quite pleased with it. Granted, it's not Mikimoto in quality...or price. However, the coloration and luster is even, there are no blemishes discernible to the naked eye,  the shape is good and the setting seems solid.  Essentially, the item I received was entirely consistent with the product page description here and in most respects exceeded my expectations.

The pendant may be a little weighty for the delicate white gold plated sterling silver chain so on occasion it has to be repositioned but at the risk of salaciousness that only draws more attention to the abundant cleavage the real pearl of my eye, not that that area needed any further assistance. The chain clasp tends to stick somewhat and I don't exclude replacement of the 18" chain in the future but that possibility doesn't diminish the value for me.

The pendant is attractively packaged in a tasteful velvet lined box. The vendor also provided a cloth storage pouch and a pearl care instruction card along with a certificate of authenticity. I only kick myself for not having the confidence to order matching earrings at the same time.
profile.summary: Hey, what do I know? My standards are probably lower...

profile.description: Sleek, durable, and dependable, the Rubbermaid Commercial Slim Jim End Step-On Trash Can offers a clean, hands-free waste control solution. The slim design and small footprint of this receptacle fits into the narrowest spots to provide maximum volume while using space efficiently. These garbage cans feature convenient foot pedals with increased pedal clearance for easy foot access and hands-free waste disposal. A tight-fitting, overlapping lid has a controlled close to reduce noise and an internal hinge design that prevents wall damage. Providing safe, sanitary waste management, these stainless steel trash cans are perfect for use in almost any area. It maintains reliable, puncture-resistant strength and stability, and will not rust or chip. Offering easy maintenance, this step-on receptacle features smooth contours with rounded corners for easy cleaning and a liner retainer band that securely holds garbage bags.
profile.reviewText:
Getting all effusive about a garbage can just feels wrong to me, almost as though I intend to pursue dumpster diving as a new avocation. But, I really like this unit, especially and not insignificantly because I didn't pay full price for it. While it is marketed as part of the commercial line, the brushed steel outer finish makes it a great match with our appliances and lets face it, who really wants to have an ugly garbage can standing out in the kitchen.

The product might be represented as having a slim profile however although it has less capacity than the container its replacing (7.9 versus 11 gal.) the actual footprint is nearly the same. Opening the  pedal operated lid reminds me of all the nuclear war movies where silo doors somewhere in mid-America spring for the security of the home front, even if I still have to lift out the inner plastic liner and manually deliver the payload to the garage.

The slow close lid will only remain open so long as the foot pedal is depressed. The product has a rear panel assess door in the event the pedal mechanism becomes temporarily inoperable. BTW, theres a convenient slot on the inner liner that assists in keeping the trash bags in place as the load increases.
profile.summary: DeLorean gull wings would have been interesting

profile.description: The Oreck Ultimate Vacuum Cleaner is ideal for those hard-to-reach spaces plus stairs, furniture, ceiling fans, molding, bookshelves, curtains, drapes, light fixtures, and more. Designed for effortless use, this handheld features a 20 ft. power cord that wraps around the bottom of the vacuum to stay out of your way, while a 5-ft. slinky hose lets you put suction right where you need it. It comes with an installed HEPA filter and the easy-on tool caddy puts tools right where you need them.
profile.reviewText: Who knew? My new personal vacuum cleaner and up to the point I pulled it out of the box I had no idea I wanted a personal vacuum cleaner. I'm still not sure I need one, but having the Oreck Handheld sitting on stand-by nearby is an easy way to act like I have a real interest in cleaning up the messes that seem to trail behind me. Sure, with the small capacity of the collection bags, it is not likely (or intended by the manufacturer) the unit could ever serve as a replacement for a full size vacuum for even the modestly sized living quarters but for less accessible areas that seem to be dust and dirt magnets this unit is up to the task. With the combination of limited capacity and decent but less than outstanding suction power, I wouldn't recommend attempting to clean carpets but for hardwood or tiled floors, upholstered furniture, stairwells and difficult to reach areas like crown moldings and ceiling fans, this unit has proven to be far more convenient than using the attachments with either a canister style or upright model. It should be noted it took me a while to figure out the only attachment for the Oreck that could be manipulated to reach the backside of the fan blades was the floor brush and while not optimal due to its size, it is still more effective than pulling out a stepstool and hand cleaning with a rag or duster followed by the need to vacuum up the dispersed dust particles, or attempting to balance one of the other vacuums on some stand and stretching out the hose. I also use it for cleaning electronics and vehicles with the Shop Vac Micro-cleaning kit. After trying toting it around with the top positioned handle I found the 20 ft. cord tended to get in the way more than I would have preferred and wearing the unit like a shoulder bag typically resulted in it slipping off or me unintentionally dislodging the attachments from the onboard caddy, so I find it most convenient to strap it on cross chest style and stuff the floor brush in my belt like a holster. After a moderate period of use there is a degree of heat build-up but a lot less than my lawn leaf blower backpack. With its' compact size, storage is not a problem and excluding the extension tube and floor brush other attachments can be housed on the unit. The caddy has slotted positions for two attachments and the flexible hose. I keep the upholstery tool attached to the flexible hose intake nozzle.
profile.summary: Quivered for a clean-up

profile.description: Griot's Garage11033 liquid protectant,glass sealant,8 fluid oz., Each. Living in the northwest,Richard griotexperiences lots of wet weather driving. This sealant dramatically increases your wet weather visibility making for a safer and much less stressful experience. Simply wipe on and buff off. It creates a hydrophobic surface that repels water instantly. It also helps you remove ice, salt, frost, and bug jerky more easily. Great for sleet and snow along with helping your wipers work better.
profile.reviewText:
Well, in my less than controlled test between Griots and Rain-X, the results wereinconclusive. Meaning, I cant see a difference in effectiveness or notable differences in application that would make one preferable over the other.

I did all exterior window surfaces on one side of the car with the tried and trusted Rain-X and the other with this product following the rather minor differences in application recommendations for each. After two months (with a whole lot of rain episodes and a bunch of highway road trips), I don't feel any significant differences in performance are evident.

In essence, I don't have any reservations about using the Griot Glass sealant in replacement of the Rain-X product I have used for years however based on comparative pricing, it will not be my first choice.
profile.summary: It's fine but after a couple of drinks I can't tell rot gut from top shelf either.

profile.description: Kanu Surf presents our newest swim trunks yet. Kanu Surf, a surf and swim lifestyle brand, is well know for great prints and colors along with high quality functional apparel for the whole family. All of our swim trunks are made with our comfort technology quick dry fabric with a UPF rating of 50+. all trunks have 2 side pockets. Some swimming trunks have 1 or 2 cargo pockets as well. Most trunks feature triple needle stitching at seams and rises for extra durability. These trunks are built to last. Our viper trunk is a great floral stripe print with 2 side pockets and a cargo pocket. Approximate inseam length is 11 inch
profile.reviewText:
These are my second pair of Kanu Surf Trunks. The most noticeable difference between this pair and the other pair is in attention to detail. On these trunks, alignment of the stripes at the seams is close to perfect whereas on the other it seems as though a bolt of fabric was run through a pattern cutter and stitched together without any concerns about the appearance of the finished product.. Now, what that really means is although I am pleased with the attention to detail with this pair, I have absolutely no confidence the same can be expected across the product line so ordering additional sets will remain a crap shoot.

In any event, the trunk seem true to size albeit slightly baggy with a tendency to balloon a bit in the water but that aspect doesn't bother me. There are side seam pockets as well as a cargo pocket which is useful to accommodate all of the junk I seem to carry around while lounging at the beach. The lined trunk have a fake fly front and are mesh lined.
profile.summary: Let's see if this pair floats.

profile.description: This lightweight, fortifying moisturizer taps into skin's protective powers to visibly reduce fine lines and wrinkles, and strengthen the skin barrier while delivering optimal moisture for firmer looking, more resilient skin.
profile.reviewText:
After a month or so of use in this household Im still not positioned to offer an informed and confident opinion on the effectiveness of this product.  Well, I am however the other member of the household who was also using it holds a contrasting view. Of course, shes also been convinced other purportedly magical elixirs have shown some benefits even though it doesnt appear to me she was so enamored with most of them that she was willing to continue to pay the freight.

I am not beset with a face that could be mistaken for a well-worn, dog-eared roadmap so my expectations of this supposed skin strengthening complex were modest to start with.  I do like how quickly it is absorbed, the relatively small amount required to treat target areas and the absence of any annoying fragrance. At the same time, on those rare occasions where I do find something smile worthy, the early stages of a crows feet trail are still there and getting more discernible all the time.

If you're interested in the other persons opinion, she needs to get her own reviewing account.
profile.summary: Thin lines of demarcation.

profile.description: With the help of this MP3/WMA Wireless FM Transmitter you can listen to MP3 and WMAfiles in your car via an SD or MMC card slot or USB flash memory! This 3 in 1 in-car cigar style FM transmitter supports 206 FM channels and has an SD/MMC card slot and a USB port so you can listen to your MP3/WMA files on the road! Simply plug into your car's cigarette plug, turn on your car stereo and tune to the same frequency! Plug in an SD/MMC card, USB flash drive, and even an MP3 playerand listen to your favorite music on the go! The LCD displays the volume and name of the song! Order now!
profile.reviewText:
I like to fancy myself as a discerning shopper with spendthrift tendencies... I'm cheap. I have one vehicle with a cassette player and I use a much pricier FM Transmitter to accommodate my IPod, but as someone who shall remain nameless(and still listens to cassettes)customarily drives that car it's not my most significant issue. However when the CD Changer  in my car began to spew error messages I stopped at the first store I saw which presumptively would have a transmitter available... And the cheap genes went into overdrive...

The good. I've used this transmitter daily for over three months and it has one of the strongest signals I've encountered on this type of device.  Even while driving through congested urban areas it has impressively managed to maintain frequency and will in fact overpower incoming signals. With either a flash drive or SD card, the quality of music reproduction is not going to overwhelm an audiophile but it is quite adequate, especially when the price point is factored into the consideration.  As advertised, if power to the unit is interrupted the memory feature will start at the beginning of the last song played whenever the unit is reconnected. Due to the compact size and flexible joint I can easily use the 12v outlet hidden in a console glove box rather than having the unit suspended in a dashboard outlet. In fact, it is compact enough for me to use a two outlet adapter in the storage box, but more about that under the bad...

The neutral. The device does not have an on/off switch so it has to be removed from an outlet or adapter in order to be shut down, which turns out to be a good idea in order to avoid blowing fuses, both on the device and the vehicle. I have the volume on the highest setting and that seems to create overloads when the car is cranked and the unit is left in an outlet. On occasion it takes a few tries to correctly position the unit's 12v adapter in an outlet to successfully power up. The included remote is flimsy and the function buttons on it are not particularly responsive: manipulation of the function keys on the unit itself isn't much better.  If one happens to be vision challenged...like 20/20... deciphering  anything on the LCD readout is near to impossible especially if you intend to keep your eyes on the road. The included audio cable for utilization of an MP3 is extremely short so positioning of that device becomes a challenge.

The Bad. The shrink wrap packaging is comprised of much stronger plastic than any part of this device. As noted, I have used it for three months but I've also treated it like a porcelain heirloom.  As far as I am concerned, any attempt to regularly use the external audio jack and an MP3 is self-inflection of frustration and annoyance. It works but the sound quality is horrendous. Obviously, the transmitter is not capable of recognizing any MP3 functionality so it serves only as a pass-thru. And, although it is supposed to charge that seems to be an specious misrepresentation meaning if one manages to get acceptable audi quality concurrent charging requires a direct connection and thus more cable and another outlet.

In sum, in a pinch or if you're price conscious and willing to limit utilization to flash drives or SD cards without any reservations about sequencing (in other words memorize your playlists) this device will get by.
profile.summary: Time for another reality check
