profile.description: Theres nothing better than a perfectly fitting pair of classic, blue jeans. Enter NYDJs Barbara Bootcut, which comes in Premium Denim in a rich, azure wash that gives you a vintage, all-American vibe, without sacrificing the innovative, shaping properties of NYDJs signature Lift Tuck Technology. Get a gap-free rise that fits just right, courtesy of a proprietary slimming panel with a patented criss-cross design. Features traditional five-pocket styling, zip fly and button closure.
profile.reviewText:
Im not wearing them but this is my opinionmostly. If I said what I really thought she would probably find the boot-cut style really useful while kicking me in the shins.

 First of all, these are not mom jeans (okay, that's not an indictment), or maybe they are in the new regime of momdom and mom dresses the kids from the discount stores to maintain her upscale clothing budget. My idea of denim and whatever these are don't seem to correspond. At 56 and one hundred and Im not that stupid pounds, they do seem to have slimming features and are somewhat form fitting, no doubt due to the spandex muffin compressor built into the midrise area, which evidently needs to be readjusted more often than a cummerbund.

Theyll work with boots or high heels but otherwise, a trip to visit the seamstress is the lead entry on the agenda because I haven't seen that sewing machine bobbin and weavin since the Carter administration. It is reported to me the jeans are comfortable if just a tad tight around the calves (thighs as well but thats my unsolicited opinion) and accurately sized (if spandex stretch is a normal part of the equation- again the observations of a soon to be member of the witness protection program).
profile.summary: Microsuede, PU Leather and stretch denim jeans...

profile.description: With the 128GB iCobra On-The-Go USB 3.0 Flash Drive you can quickly extend your iPhone of iPad's memory. The EMTEC iCobra is equipped with dual-connector USB 3.0 and Lightning allowing you to immediately free up space on your iPhone or iPad. With the EMTEC iCobra and the intuitive EMTEC Connect app you can easily transfer files between you iPhone & Mac or PC, run your favorite multimedia files and easily share your files via email, MMS or your favorite social network. Want to watch a movie, but don't have room on your device? Simply download the movie to the iCobra and plug the iCobra into your device. Or are you taking photos, and run out of memory? No worries simply connect the iCobra and keep shooting pictures. The iCobra version 2 also can be used as a cable for recharging your Apple Lightning devices.
profile.reviewText: I have two of these iPhone accessories, the other being the SanDisk iXpand Flash Drive (SDIX30C-128G-GN6NE) Newest Version. The two devices are very similar in form and functionality although there are a few differences in user friendliness that may result in one or the other being preferable for the individual purchaser. Both devices have lightning and USB 3.0 connectors and can also be used to charge iDevices when ported to a PC, Mac, mobile external charger or wall charger, The SanDisk drive is about the size of the EMTEC and due to compact design, the iXpand is somewhat more of a challenge to use with cases like the Otterbox defender series. The iCobra cable is longer and much more flexible so it is easier to connect to the host device but the docking feature is not likely to be much use with thicker iOS device cases. Each device requires download of an app from the app store. I find the iXpand app significantly easier to navigate without referencing a user guide. The iCobra documentation comprises about what ends up to be about 1/3 of a page and isn't all that helpful for what I consider to be a non-intuitive user interface. Comparatively, transfer of content from the iDevice to the iCobra drive requires more manual intervention than is the case with the SanDisk drive, especially when the decision is made to actually delete content from the iOS device which has to be done from the host device and cannot be initiated with the iCobra app. Essentially, the drives will facilitate transfer of photos, music files, contact files and some video content to free up space on the iOS mobile device but the app does not include an auto backup utility. The iCobra also seems to ignore more types of file extensions for audio and video content than the SanDisk drive. Although it should be self-evident, transfer of content with DRM protection is not supportedunless the user is highly motivated. Even then, if most user content emanates from Amazon, you're pretty much SOL as far as relocation of purchased product is concerned. I had hoped it would be feasible to move some larger apps but that functionality is not supported, either. One nice feature is the capability to take photos or video directly from the drive. Content can be backed up to a cloud site or shared in a diverse range of diverse services and social media sites. Overall, the device works as represented. For some users, that may be good enough. Personally, I don't think it provides much advantage over management of iDevice content via iTunes and only gives me one more gadget to wonder where I left it.
profile.summary: Well, it does take up less space than a case of CDs...

profile.description: There's a new you at your fingertips with the nuyu Activity Monitor. It works with the nuyu Smartphone app to track and upload your daily steps, calories and distance throughout the day and your sleep throughout the night. Whether you want to be more active, lose weight or just feel good, the nuyu Activity Monitor helps keep you focused on your goals. Wear it on your wrist or clipped to your waist band or undergarment. One quick glance at the display shows progress as you go. It has a battery so you don't need to charge it, and it's waterproof, too.
profile.reviewText:
Only slight problem is, I haven't worn it for the last two days. I didn't find the occurrence all that surprising as the tracker seems to regularly report nearly double the number of steps and distance of three other trackers and an app I have installed on an iPhone that has proven highly accurate over a two year period.

The Health o meter nuyu is attractively priced, offers what could have been a very useful array of appealing features found with many higher priced competitors and has a replaceable rather than rechargeable battery, a distinction some users (not me) might find worthwhile, and can be worn either as a wrist watch or tethered to a piece of clothing with a wraparound magnetized strap. All of those attributes are rendered rather pointless since the tracker statistics cannot be trusted, once you manage to activate the display since more time will be spent swiping across the face of this thing than I believe most would be willing to tolerate.

Similarly to a host of trackers, this one also has an uncomfortably intrusive privacy policy with the necessity to upload a bunch of personal information to some unknown storage site in the cyberspace but when the device doesnt work its difficult to rationalize any justification to agree to it.  I couldn't arrive at what I would consider an acceptable error tolerance range since the device was inconsistent in the areas of variancebut seldom anywhere near the results reflected by other trackers worn at the same time, including another bargain basement model I previously considered the baseline for uselessness.
profile.summary: Today, according to the tracker I finally achieved my sleep goal

profile.description: The 11 inch Crispy Steelux Comfort and 11 inch Protect Steelux Premium prepares a cook for any style of frying. The Crispy Steelux Comfort Novagrill surface creates a barbecue effect on food without the fat external crispy frying and generates a "non-stick" experience without the coating or need for fats and oils. Novagrill utilizes the grooved surface of the pan to allow steam to escape so foods sit on top of fats and oil without direct contact cooking food in a healthier and better tasting way. A laser engraved measuring scale inside the pan eliminates the hassle and mess of additional measuring jugs. While the Protect Steelux Premium's has the only really long lasting nonstick coating in the market the Protect Premium promises a frying surface coated with a three layer PTFE that creates the durable and abrasion resistant PFOA free Protectal-Plus nonstick coating on every pan. The fry pans share the premium features like the patented "Cookstar" all stove base, the fry pans create perfect stability for optimal heat absorption and distribution, cooking foods better and faster on every stove top making these pans "future-proof". Features like the security handle with flame shields and oven and dishwasher safe brings safety and convenience to the fry pan. An Extra-large rim creates a perfect no mess pour every time. Equipped with both style of fry pans any option of frying can be satisfied in your kitchen.
profile.reviewText:
Generally speaking, the Fissler Crispy Comfort & Protect Premium Fry Pan Set stainless steel pan set might prove to be highly serviceable although similarly to the non-stick stainless steel pans we already have, the sealed non-stick pan just looks weird to me. Without question, this a good quality set, if in my opinion somewhat short of great, especially when price point is factored in. I like the weightiness of the pans, the beneficial wide rims and appreciate the convenience of the comfort grip plastic handles. Heat distribution is good and the crisper pan does tend to emulate grilled effect with fried foods.

However, the handles are screwed on rather than riveted and the pans are not oven safe. At the price, I don't have any interest in a maintenance regimen where the handles have to be monitored and tightened from time to time. An inexpensive set from a discount store, sure but at these prices, I expect a sturdier attachment.

 Additionally, whereas it is safe to use metal utensils with our stainless steel non-stick skillets from another manufacturer, the brochure with this set specifically states the non-stick pan should only be used with plastic utensils. I recognize its a concern others may not have but I don't have much interest in trying to remember I can use a metal spatula with one set of our non-stick pans but with this one Im likely to damage the surface.
profile.summary: I'm surprised there isn't a Fissler screwdriver...

profile.description: Unlike traditional Electric tools, arrow's breakthrough T50AC Electric stapler delivers consistent Pro grade performance regardless of jobsite voltage fluctuations - even on a 100 foot extension cord. A motor drive replaces the traditional Solenoid design and frees the tool from dependence on a narrow range of Specifications. The result is maximum Pro power with every shot. The T50AC also features a convenient bottom-load magazine with quick release feature, a soft overmolded grip, contact safety, and an oversized trigger. Additional features include an integrated LED work light, indicator light to show when staples are low, and storage case.
profile.reviewText:
I am quite pleased with this stapler/nailer. Its not much of a surprise as a sometimes DIYer and even less frequent so it seems nowadays, furniture restoration hobbyist, I have found Arrow products to be both durable and dependable. From my admittedly superficial use of this one thus far, I think it will prove to be equally as useful.

I didn't have any projects in mind when I got it but who doesnt like stapling stuff just for the heck of it. I compared performance to my trusty old manual Arrow T50 and got over my laziness to even pull out an air gun tool with a variety of woods (pine, unfinished oak, treated oak, walnut, plywood, OSB, presswood).

As one might expect, ease of use of this electric stapler far exceeded the manual unit and was unquestionably equal to the air gun tool for stapling as well as brad nails (Arrow type 18GA 9/16). The Arrow T50AC also has some other features that lead me to believe it will be my go-to option over the air gun when a definite need arises. Plus, I don't have to try to remember to lubricate it.

The tool feels substantial while also being comfortable to manipulate with a secure composite type rubber grip. It has an insulated eight-foot cord and can be used with extension cords (#14 gauge or better recommended). There is a power switch on the bottom of the grip and the trigger is easily engaged. I didn't have any misfires or jams and staples were inserted flush  so long as the tool was aimed at the target at a 90degree angle  which is pretty much the case with any comparable tool of this type. I like the convenience of a LED lamp at the output slot and also the helpful low staple indicator light on the back end.

The package includes a box of 1250 T50 5/16 staples and the device will accommodate staple sleeve sizes from  to 9/16. A handy black case is also provided.
profile.summary: I think Arrow nailed it.

profile.description: Engineered for Business. Scan, save and send important data wherever your business takes you with the WorkForce DS-30 portable document scanner. Delivering full-function flexibility on the go, the DS-30 scans receipts, documents up to 8.5" x 14", plastic I.D. cards and more right into an e-mail, searchable PDF and more. Send your scanned files directly to the most popular cloud services with the included software. Included correction tools allow you to automatically remove punch holes from scanned images, auto-size documents, enhance text quality, and correct image skew so you can keep your business moving when you're out on the road. Perfect for busy professionals, this lightweight, travel-friendly single-side scanner is ready to perform whenever you are. USB powered, there's no external power supply required. And, it's Mac and PC compatible.
profile.reviewText:
This peripheral appears potentially most beneficial to users who have identified a need for a mobile scanning device for documents and images no larger than a legal size letter. The Workforce DS-30 is very similar in appearance and form factor the Neatreceipts mobile and Iris Express scanners although I believe robust differences in functionality exist between the Epson and Neatreceipts (I haven't tried the Iris).

Neither Neatreceipts nor DS-30 will accommodate on the fly scans of books and larger images as each requires front slotted feeds of documents no larger than 8  by 14, unlike wand type mobile scanners where small sections of text in can be segregated.

Like Neatreceipts, the DS-30 requires USB connection to a laptop or PC  for information storage and device powering. Frankly, I would have been more impressed if it employed rechargeable batteries and a wireless dongle similar to many of Logitech's mice and keyboards. The scanner comes with a microfiber cover with interior pocket for storage of the usb cable, along with callibration sheets, wet/dry cleaning sheets and installation CD.

Express installation from the CD took about 15 minutes . Acquisition of updated drivers, as recommended, from Epson's website added another 15 minutes to the process. The CD also includes Epson Scan software, Document Capture Pro, Abbyy Fine reader and Presto Biz Card 5 as well as a link to the online user guide. If desired, any or all of the supplemental applications can be excluded by opting to do a custom installation. Personally I found enough value in each of the programs to justify installation...as long as the user is willing to invest a bit of time to become familiar with what I also found to be rather convoluted interface designs.

Initial calibration (which may not have been necessary) added another 2-3 minutes. The device lacks a dedicated power switch and is active as long as it is linked to a computer. The top side positioned button is one way to initiate scans and can be customized to a degree.

One major deficiency is the lack of coordination with between supported applications. The user either has to access them via all programs button or potentially further clutter the desktop with short cut icons. And, while I noted I found some of the features of the applications useful (like mapping of addresses from business cards via Mapquest hyperlink) it will take a while to become comfortable with the non-intuitiveness of each. I don't use any cloud services so the capability of streamlined upload was of little importance to me.

I do use NeatReceipts filing system and Outlook contacts. I haven't to date discovered an easy way to transfer business card info to Outlook with the DS-30 nor would it accommodate receipt management anywhere near as impressively as the other unit. And I recognize it was not meant to.

I found the OCR feature to be above average and resolution for both grayscale and color were more than acceptable, definitely superior to the Neatreceipts scanner(s).  I did encounter a repetitive jamming problem where unless the document was fed perfectly square it would bind up. The device does not support two-sided copying and, not surprisingly, requires user intervention for each scan request. While not timed, I am confident the DS-30 is faster than my NeatReceipts desk model.

Essentially, if tasked exclusively for mobile scanning needs, I believe the Epson is better device for document and most definitely image, reproduction. However, if I'm going to carry around another device to really enhance my offsite needs, I'll stick with Neatreceipts.
profile.summary: Oh, calm down. This isn't my shredder.

profile.description: Super Fast Charging and Incredible 11000 mAh capacity (Input: 5V/1000 mAh, Output: 3 ports - 1A, 1A, 2.1A 4.1A total) Status LEDs keep you informed of remaining capacity. Grade A cells and premium chips ensure reliability Charge Tablet and 2 phones simultaneously. Can recharge iPhone 5S six times over. Stylish design and available in three rocking colors (Black, Purple and Turquoise). Package contents: 11000 mAh External Battery, micro USB cable, travel bag. Phone specific charging cables are not included.
profile.reviewText:
Thus far, Im quite pleased with the usefulness of this portable charger as I have used it to charge an external Bluetooth speaker and iPhone 5c concurrently while on vacation and may prove to be invaluable to a spouse who consistently forgets to charge her phone overnight.

I haven't completely drained the device so I cant speak to the time required for a full recharge as of yet. It was received partially charged and to reach full capacity took about 4 hours attached to a fast charge port on an external hub. Via a generic micro USB adapter, the device itself can be alternatively charged from a AC outlet.

The unit will accommodate up to three devices at once with one port configured for 2.1A output which should suffice for more demanding devices. The top positioned LED indicators show:  charge status of the charger, on/off power state, and the first lamp blinks when the charger is plugged in for recharge. An on/off power button located to the right of the front panel positioned USB ports.

One thing that should be noted, when the device itself is in recharge state, battery charge capability to attached devices is deactivated.

The unit comes with a grey felt like carrying pouch with cinch closure. I also like the teal color which sets it apart from the majority of my electronics hardware.

I received a sample from the vendor.
profile.summary: Very useful accessory for forgetful folks

profile.description: For centuries, the luxury of French-milled soaps has remained the gold standard of excellence. Each time you begin to lather a French made soap, you enter a time and place where quality and craftsmanship have stood still. Traditional French soap is triple-milled to produce a completely uniform and smooth soap, without impurities, thus lasting longer. Every bar of Pre de Provence soap is not only carefully made today by the dedicated soapmakers in Provence following their proud traditions, but quad-milled to be smoother and have a richer lather to create our luxurious feel. Using all pure, natural ingredients enriched with shea butter, you can feel the difference of our unique quad-milling process. Aromatic fragrances transport you to a moment of calmness, vitality, dreamin or well-being. This 150 Gram bar is a great value, the fragrance maintains until the soap is all used up. The soap creates a rich, creamy lather and rinses clean, leaving skin soft and hydrated.
profile.reviewText: The problem with this bar of soap is after showering, I have an inexplicable urge to go eat a bag of peppermint patties. Anyway, it is a french milled soap which I now understand means it should have fewer air pockets and therefore can be expected to last longer. From my perspective while it lathers up pretty well right it's way too big to fit in my travel kit soap dish and if I use it enough to sufficiently diminish in size, after eating all those peppermint patties I probably will not be able to fit into an airline economy seat, which no doubt would be my only alternative if I regularly pulled out the cash to buy this brand.
profile.summary: Huh. Even french soap can be fattening.

profile.description: PNY Micro Sleek USB drive provides the ultimate mobile storage solution for people on the go. Working on a presentation and need to take it with you? Want to share a new song, pictures, or video with your friends? Simply copy the file onto Attache and take it with you. It's ultra-compact design makes it easy to carry it in your pocket, wear it, put it in your backpack or briefcase and you're good to go, plus it's swing design means no more lost caps. To access your data, simply plug Attache into virtually any PC or MAC - without the need for bulky cables or adapters. Access your files. Anytime. Anywhere.
profile.reviewText:
But that's definitely better than looking for the drive to fit the cap. I guess this would qualify as a thimble drive and the largest problem with it is how easy it is to misplace.  I bought it for a specific use, transfer of music files from an iPod nano without using iTunes since the original music files are not currently assessable. Haven't removed it from the transmitter since it was inserted over six months ago  and it meets that purpose very well.  At less than an inch in length it does not protrude and can be stored, mounted in the transmitter in the car console glove box. Also a good thing since I dropped the cap between the seats some time ago and chances are it was also some time ago sucked up in the car wash vacuum.

At present the drive is within 74 MB of capacity and all 3.9GB + are music tracks (652 total tracks). It is accessed several times each day and to date I have not encountered any difficulties. I intend to buy a couple more for backup but I have nothing but positive comments about this tiny unit thus far.

Please note however, it is preformated FAT32 although in my situation it didn't matter and is easily readable on my NTFS formatted PC OS.
profile.summary: Hmmm. I bet there's a cap that fits this drive ...

profile.description: Light Angel  Stick Up LED Motion Sensor Light
profile.reviewText:
I suppose as a lighting source to provide a bit of illumination for a porch or deck, this product might meet the need, like to identify a key hole as long as you can determine the correct key by feel because any attempt to qualify this product as super bright is a complete misrepresentation. I don't have a high degree of confidence it would hold up very well to outdoor inclement weather conditions. As it is, it's closer in brightness to a customary hallway night light than anything else.

 It is accurate that it can be motion activated and that also includes falling off the wall when the adhesive patch provided with it fails...in my case after about a half-hour. I tried the light as a supplemental source in a hallway closet and while I could distinguish between a coat and a sweater - which I could have done by feeling the fabric without any light - determining a dark blue item from a black or dark brown wasn't going to be aided by this device. If I had any intention of using the product at this point I would use the included screws for permanent placement or opt for some Command Strips rather than attempting to use the meager sticky strip that comes with it.

However, it is destined to sit in a closet on a shelf until I accidentally knock the box on the floor and break it while groping around for something else that seemed like a good idea when I bought it.
profile.summary: I took a shot in the dark..I missed...

profile.description: The Vicks Sweet Dreams Cool Mist Humidifier creates cool, visible mist to help temporarily relieve your child's cough and congestion symptoms for better breathing and more comfortable sleep. The ultrasonic Vicks Cool Mist Humidifier has a built-in projector that transforms your child's bedroom with nine dream-inspired images in three themes: sea, safari, and starry night. Designed for small to medium rooms, this sleep humidifier has adjustable mist control and ultra-quiet operation that helps your child rest soundly. The 1-gallon tank allows up to 24 hours of operation, and the air humidifier shuts off automatically when the tank is empty. A large tank opening makes the humidifier easy to fill and clean. The Vicks Sweet Dreams Humidifier doesn't require any filters, and it accepts up to two Vicks VapoPads to provide soothing menthol vapors. A sample Vicks VapoPad is included.
profile.reviewText:
Compared to our old cool mist humidifier, the mere absence of the necessity to search the internet or local stores for replacement filters makes it worth the cost to me. That said, I really haven't tried to find replacement vapopads for it yet but as I don't think (and certainly hope) we will need that feature very often, its not a major consideration for us.

This unit is very quiet in operation and seems to continue to mist until the tank is fully depleted. I only filled it about 50% and with the humidity control switch set at the midpoint, the unit continued to emit a visible cool vapor for over 24 hours. The tank is easily detachable and has a spring load valve to deter leaking when removed for refill.  The device has an auto shut-off function but thus far Ive been too impatient to see if it works. While it is not what I would consider "quiet" in operation, the low drone white noise is not particularly disconcerting.

Fortunately (in my situation), the projection feature (which seems to work just fine) is not integral to operation.
profile.summary: Hum something for me...

profile.description: The easiest option for the road warrior, this versatile shirt does double duty; roll up the sleeves with khakis or layer beneath a sleek suit. Crafted in smooth poplin with a touch of subtle stretch for comfort, it's perfect when there's just no time for ironing.
profile.reviewText:
An approachable priced, classic cut shirt that will probably be highly serviceable for casual and business casual wear for many potential purchasers however not one that will be a frequent pick from the closet for me. The blended fabric seems as though it will be comfortable even in conditions of high humidity but due to other factors I don't find this narrow checked shirt as particularly appealing once worn.

This shirt is presented as a large but in my opinion, in comparison to most other similarly cut shirts I own, it leans more toward extra-large sizing. Okay, Ill grant I wasn't all that displeased by the capacious waist measurement but while overall stitching and construction are quite adequate, the labeled collar size is 16-16  and I think the manufacturer could just as well delete the references to the former number.

Due to the absence of any stiffness in the collar, I wouldnt attempt to wear a tie with it in impromptu situations regardless of knot style employed. Sleeve length is another concern as I measured it at 35 and thats a bit too long for my preferences, even for extremely casual wear apparel.
profile.summary: If your mom is dressing you.

profile.description: Arccos Driver Tracking SystemLive Stats. Global Competitions. Ultimate Bragging Rights.The Arccos Driver Tracking System brings fun to the golf course while providing the stats you need to improve your game. You can instantly capture and share you best drives with your friends and the Arccos community as a way to compete all over the globe with your friends and fellow golfers. Track all your driving stats so you see what to practice and where you're succeeding on the golf course. Instantly see your stats so you know how you're playing, righto n the golf course.Arccos Driver Tracking System features: * Includes a single sensor specifically calibrated to track driver statistics * Uses GPS and Bluetooth technology to map your shots to a bird's-eye view of the course * Capture and share your best drives with friends and the Arccos community * Sensor attaches easily to any driver grip * Pair directly to free iPhone or Android app for easy tracking * Ultra-light sensor has zero swing impact * Real time tracking shows specific stats and calculations after each drive * Review club averages right on the course where it matters most What's In The Box: * 1 Arccos Driver sensor * Starter guide * iOS and Android apps * 1-year Arccos Driver Premium Subscription
profile.reviewText:
I got this nifty gadget in the mail today and as might be expected of a kid with a new toy, I couldn't wait to get to the course to try it out. Im rating it very favorably because from what I could tell all of the purported performance features work well, as long as it is understood my observations are limited to personal statistics. I didn't investigate the social creature features and don't expect to in the future. In fact, Im not sure how much Ill refer to the individual data compilations although as unobtrusive the sensor is, I will leave it on my driver for a while.

As a single club appurtenance, for me the device and smartphone app combo might serve as an entertaining diversion or curiosity item but I don't see it as a significant game improvement aid without purchase of the full set of sensors unless the after swing thought I shouldnt sling an overpriced driver at my cart when theres a pricey fragile tracker screwed into the grip. (No, I don't throw clubs . often. I was once advised as a teen I wasn't good enough to get mad and decades later I still take that advice to heart and the sensor doesnt give me the impression its  all that fragile, btw).

Like most comparable systems (the sensor has to be paired with a near range smartphone), the Arccos app has data for an expansive number of courses worldwide and I found it to be comparable to my golf GPS watch as far as course layout and distance accuracy are concerned.

Overall, I think is could be a worthwhile acquisition for players who place more emphasis than I do on driving distance or group participation bragging rights, or potential purchasers who don't already have another gadget (e.g., a GPS watch) that offers much of the same data, and more.
profile.summary: What I could really use is a golf ball low jack system.

profile.description: No guy's casual wardrobe is complete without a favorite pair of cargo pants. Haggar's Stretch Comfort Cargo Pants live up to their name with fabric that gives a little  and a hidden expandable waistband that gives a little more. They not only feature cargo pockets on the thighs,but there's an extra tech pocket for your phone. A flat front and classic fit complete the look.
profile.reviewText:
A reasonably priced pair of casual pant of a soft and comfortable cotton/spandex blend that tends to suggest gabardine more than what I would typically expect with a pair of cargo styled pant.  I think some potential purchasers may find these classically styled flat front pant acceptable for business casual wear and in a pinch suitable for wear with a sports jacket but don't expect to wear them a second time without a  touch up with an iron.

 I also don't think theyll be my first choice for travel as I am not that adept of a packer I would expect them to come out of the suitcase ready for wear. The pant has a 12 rise and is true to waist size with a hidden expansion band that will offer a skosh of forgiveness when you stay at the dining table a bit longer than intended.  The right leg cargo pocket also has a separate top opening for a cell phone or other slender form mobile device.
profile.summary: What do you mean? Why is a crease just wrong?

profile.description: Cut the cord The 35-Mile Talkabout Bluetooth 2-Way Radio, Pair, by Motorola allows the pairing of a Bluetooth headset for tangle-free communication. Press the PTT button on the radio when ready to chime in. For complete freedom, pair the radio with a wireless Bluetooth PTT button. Its emergency-alert feature, built-in LED flashlight and NOAA weather-alert channels provide a total emergency-preparedness communication solution. The flashlight feature offers peace-of-mind during evening adventures or unexpected emergencies and power outages. The 11 NOAA channels provide emergency alerts including tornadoes, winter storms, severe thunderstorms, flash floods, emergency evacuations and Amber Alerts. Power it 2 ways with either alkaline or NiMH rechargeable batteries. Includes 2 radios, 1 wall adapter with Y cable amp;amp; 2 mini-USB connectors, two 1,300mAh NiMH battery packs amp;amp; 2 belt clips.
profile.reviewText:
I had such great plans for theseradios. I figured I could play combat with my grandson, teaching him about going on reconnaissance missions like I used to do, emulating Vic Morrow while I sat in the basement HQ like a command and control officer, getting surveillance reports on the movements of the axis powers of his grandmother, mother and Vichy French poodle but before we could even get started I was labeled free range grandparent (a jump on the bandwagon term I think they just made up)  and told to get in touch with this millennium. The kid wasn't much better either since he wondered where the 4G icon was and was I sure I didn't care about data limits. Hell turn seven this but it appears the battle is already lost; maybe if I get started with the newest family recruit once shes ambulatory Ill be able to turn her into a sleeper agent before the brain washing is completed by the potentially hostile parental squad patrolling borders of her nursery like Im some sort of anachronistic counter-productive influence.

Anyway, these Motorola walkie-talkFRS radios are a lot more sophisticated than the ones I used to play with. I like the capability to use three off the shelf AA alkaline batteries as well as the rechargeable NiMH battery pack (received partially charged) I don't know about the 35 mile range under optimum conditions or the maximum battery life 15 hours before recharge, Ive yet to get a set to work beyond a couple of miles but nearly all of my usage has been in urban/suburban areas and like past experience after about a mile and a half I couldn't get a reliable connectionme in my car calling back to one of the axis members who agreed to humor me, with the accompanying laughter and snark coming through with crystal clarity.

 I doubt Ill approach 15 hours of use at any point in the foreseeable future, well, beyond monitoring the weather based on whats happening currently where I live. The radios also feature the ability to pick up NOAA weather reports/alerts and the appropriate frequencies are listed in the user guide. That feature alone may justify these units for me despite anyone elses desire to play with me.  The supplied battery packs are chargeable via a y corded adapter and did take overnight to be initially fully charged. As the devices have a mini USB port, the battery is also chargeable via most generic charging options with that size connector.

Although the units feature 22 available channels, for personal use without a FCC license, you're pretty much limited to 8 FRS channels. I did get the units to link with a Motorola Bluetooth earpiece which may prove to have value for users who intend to use these communicators in sporting or outdoor activities, but following the procedure to get the earpiece linked to the radio unit does require the skills of a Navajo code talker.
profile.summary: Which channel gets on the internet?

profile.description: The P400 Air Purifier gives you highly efficient air purification at home. Insert the filter that meets your needs: ALLERGY (included), BABY or SMOG. Whether at home or at the office, the P400 will blend in effortlessly with your everyday surroundings  its quiet operation will never distract you. Enjoy fresh mountain air in every room. The P400 comes standard with the ALLERGY filter. The BABY and SMOG filters are sold separately. An Air Purifier filters out ultrafine particles, thus providing clean and healthy room air. With our special filter package (HEPA and active carbon filters), BONECO purifiers are capable of removing allergens, pollen, bacteria, dust, pet dander, dust mites, smoke and odors from the air. Our filter systems remove 99.79% of particles over 0.05 micrometers. Additional features: 5 fan level speeds, whisper-quiet operation, low power consumption (DC motor), filter change reminder, container for use of fragrances, and 5 year warranty.
profile.reviewText: Were fortunate that at present, no one in the household has any allergy problems, however, we do run air purifiers hoping to improve overall air quality because from what Ive read, that seems to be important to a lot of people. It also occurs to me I need to qualify the preceding claim because Im not sure if the mutt has any allergies unless an obvious aversion to usefulness counts. Anyway, I compared the performance of the Boneco P400 to the Holmes Smart Wifi-Enabled WeMo True-HEPA Premium Air Purifier, WAP532, a lower cost end unit available from discount chains and well known consumer retail establishments. Ease of product acquisition and replacement filters is a critical consideration as no matter how superior the Boneco might have been, if the replacements filters are a challenge to obtain, the unit loses a significant degree of appeal for me. While not particularly highly ranked or recommended by respected ratings organizations, over the last year I have been satisfied with the efficiency of the Holmes unit. The Holmes unit is represented as adequate for spaces up to 217 sq ft. and in our situation performed well- tasked for coverage of an enclosed area of about 250 sq. ft. Overall, while I believe the P400 performs well, absent many of the ancillary features available with the Holmes purifier I don't know absorption of the higher cost would be justifiable for me. Now, if it is still sucking dust years from now when the tacky simulated wood grain plastic case of the Holmes unit is sitting in a heap with the 70s era stereo speakers I longer use either, I might have a different opinion. The P400 is a solidly constructed unit (just under 17.5lbs with filter installed) with a dual filtering system (mesh type pre-filter and primary filter) and also has a rear compartment for the addition of scented fragrances. The unit is delivered with an allergy filter. Two optional filter choices are baby or smog. Boneco is a Swiss company and I found replacement filters listed on their website that at current conversion rates would cost around $90. As contrasted with the Holmes filter prices, CHF must be an abbreviation for congestive heart failure. Filter replacement is recommended whenever the filter reminder lamp is illuminated or minimally, once per year. Considering after ten months of reasonably regular use (about 8 hrs per day), our Holmes unit filters are still rated at 40% remaining life, I don't know if it can be anticipated the P400 will justify the higher cost via longer term savings with reduced filter replacement requirements. My immediate reactions upon unboxing the P400 were mixed as I found the streamlined design appealing but also realized Ive fallen victim to wireless wimp syndrome. It doesnt have wireless, Bluetooth or even a remote(there is a higher priced P500 unit with remote capability). They expect me to actually get up and press buttons on the control pad? Well, one of two buttons (power on/off/ filter check or fan speed). Five speed options are available. At the lowest setting, the unit is amazingly quiet (around 30-35 decibels, tested with dB10th on mobile device however as fan speed is increased at the highest setting is gets pretty loud (peaking at around 93 dB). According to promotional information, the P400 is suitable for spaces up to 600sq. ft. although most efficient in areas of 175sq. ft. Based on my experience, I doubt this unit would be sufficient for larger spaces unless the subject area was totally sealed off and the user was extremely patient during air exchange periods. The manual indicates for the smaller area per hour exchange will occur 5 times but in the larger area, expected performance will be about 1.5 times per hour.
profile.summary: My comparison results may have been more compelling if I had put them in separate rooms

profile.description: Klopotek 12''-17'' Laptop Cooler - Cooling Pad Chill Mat with 5 Quiet Fans, 2 USB 2.0 Ports and Adjustable Visual Angle Strong, durable but lightweight construction with metal mesh front. 6 point height adjustable tilt with anti slip design, your laptop can breathe easily with this ultimate notebook cooler. Powered by USB. Duel USB hub allows for connecting more USB devices. Also doubles up as a desktop stand for your laptop. 5 Built-in fans with blue LEDs, you can select 1 fan working, 4 fans working, or all 5 working together, and the independent control is the same for the LEDs. Features - Product dimensions: 380x300x35mm(14.96x11.81x1.38inch) - 4 Fan dimensions: 70x70x15mm(2.76x2.76x0.59inch) - Large fan dimensions: 120x120x25mm(5.9x5.9x0.98inch) - Net weight: 1145g(40.39 OZ) - Speed: 1000 +/- 10% RPM; 2000 +/- 10% RPM Package Included 1 x Folding Laptop Cooler
profile.reviewText:
Thus far, this lightweight 15x12 pad has performed well with a gaming laptop with a higher spec graphics card that has a tendency to run extremely warm when play is intense. The top side mesh panel of the cooling pad appears to be aluminum while the bottom panel is plastic. This device isn't going to completely counteract heat build-up but in my testing it reduced temperatures on average approximately 20-25% which I find to be significant.

The pad has four smaller fans arranged in a rectangular pattern and a larger center fan which can be activated in conjunction with the smaller units or activated independently by two switches on the rear of the cooling pad. The pad also has soft light blue LED display and is powered via USB 2.0 porting to a host device. There is also an auxiliary USB port on the rear plate. The ergonomic design allows the user to position a laptop at six viewing angles with front positioned device anchor tabs.

In testing fan noise with the dB 10th  app, even with all five fans running noise levels averaged between 58-62dB, so although noticeable in quieter environments the levels never seem to be an annoyance to me and during game play, tend to become virtually unnoticeable. I cannot address durability of the pad at this point. If problems develop or it ceases to function within a few months, I will update this review accordingly.

I received a sample for evaluation.
profile.summary: For once, tilting during game play might be a good thing,

profile.description: 3M flexible foam sanding sponge is ideal for sanding wood, paint, metal, plastic and drywall. The flexible foam sponge can be used for either dry or wet sanding and can be rinsed and reused. Extremely flexible, softback.
profile.reviewText: I received the super fine grade of the sanding sponge and used it for intermediate finishing of automobile rocker panels and door edges after application of a rust inhibitor/sealant, followed by sanding with a higher grade wet dry aluminum oxide paper for final finishing before application of an automotive primer coat. I then sanded the primer coat as well with the super fine sanding sponge followed by use of 3M(TM) Wetordry(TM) Sandpaper, 03006, 3-2/3 in x 9 in, Assorted, 5 sheets per pack to get as smooth and even a finish as I could before application of the color match automotive paint. Although in one area I was employing a spray application of paint and in another (because I was too lazy to remove carpeting panels) I used sponge brush application, I was pleased with the final results. I intend to purchase some of the coarser grain sponges as I was impressed with both durability and flexibility of the super fine grade, particularly on the door edges where crevices had to be sanded. Price wise, although packets come in 20 sponge sets, compared to a purchase of an equal amount of aluminum oxide sheets the difference in cost seems negligible. I wish the sponges were a tad larger because I could easily see where they could be used with some powered pad sanders.
profile.summary: Now I'm looking for stuff to sand...

profile.description: The Summit 6.5 inch utility knife features our intuitive, smarter handle design that guides your hand to the ideal grip automatically. We studied chefs and found they pinch the blade for maximum control so we sought to make that grip easy and intuitive. We did it by moving the chef's "pinch-grip" zone up and away from the blade to the handle where soft grip contouring guides and cushions your hand. Now the optimum grip is easy and automatic so you're free to enjoy cutting with precision and confidence. Of course Fiskars knife also boasts Fiskars' legendary cutting quality. An ultra-sharp, Japanese-grade, stainless steel blade ensures smooth, easy cutting, chopping and mincing of small- to medium-sized foods like onions and peppers. Both the knife and protective blade guard are dishwasher safe, making this a supremely convenient and reliable kitchen companion.
profile.reviewText:
While Fiskars' ubiquitous orange plastic handles shears are probably hard coded into my one track brain whenever the need for scissors arises, I wouldn't say the brand has ever made an appearance anywhere on my list of choices when I need any other type of kitchen cutlery. That's no doubt yet another of my personal foibles as it turns out I really like this utility knife.

The design of the handle tends to encourage a secure, comfortable grip with efficient finger positioning  I've found it very-boning  useful for dicing onions, chopping celery and even de-boning chicken breasts. The stainless steel blade has maintained a true, sharp edge although as a rather recent acquisition, that's to be expected. The locking sheath guard is a handy addition both for safely storing and maintenance of cutting blade integrity. Both the knife and sheath guard are dishwasher safe even though this creature of habit washes the knife by hand as is my preference with all preparation knives.
profile.summary: Even if it's not at the summit, it is still up there near the hill.

profile.description: Norton 360 delivers all-in-one security for everything the computer users in your family care about. Easy to use, it provides automatic and transparent protection from viruses and spyware, fraudulent Web sites, phishing scams, hackers, identity theft, and more. With a renewable subscription, up to three PCs in your household are continuously protected, safeguarding your family when they play games, send email, download files, chat, or surf the Web. And transaction security features allow you to shop and bank online with confidence. Norton 360 also keeps your PCs tuned for peak performance and protects the data on them by making it easy to back up photos, music, financial documents, and other files and restore them at any time. Flexible options allow you to back up your files to CD, DVD, and USB devices. For even more convenience, you can also set up automatic backups to an attached hard drive or a secure online storage service* to protect your important files in the event something happens to your PC. And for enhanced performance, a smart background scheduler automatically schedules key Norton 360 functions such as scans, backups, and tune-ups so that they don’t interfere with your PC activities. *Requires high-speed Internet access; 2 GB of online storage included, with option to purchase more.
profile.reviewText:
I bought norton 360 earlier this year as an upgrade when my subscription for norton internet security was about to expire, on a machine with 256mb memory, xp pro, with iexplorer 7.0 as my browser. Almost immediately after installation, the system when into catatonia. In order to get anything resembling response time, I had to fall back to iexplorer 6.0. Still, screen changes within a website exceeding one minute were not unusual.

I had to leave the system on constantly because after shut down or to reboot would consume anywhere from 15 minutes to over 1/2 hour. I was also disappointed to discover this "upgrade" meant sacrificing all of the functionality I had come to appreciate with Norton systemworks since the first action that is performed in installation is wiping out that product, not to mention the initial loss of any spam filtering.

But, let's fast forward to the present, after a full system replacement with two gig core2 duo running at 800mhz,vista ultimate and iexplorer 7.0... Norton 360 works like a dream, performing all the advertised background functions without any intervention, although it must be acknowledged I do not use the automated off site backup feature.

Bottomline, If you have over 1gig of memory and a fast processor, this product isn't that bad.
profile.summary: Usefulness is dependent on your configuration

profile.description: The polished details and slim construction make the 15.6 Mobile VIP 4-Wheeled Business & Overnight Roller our sleekest one yet. Its made for effortless travel, with four durable spinner wheels that roll in any direction and restraining straps that prop open the overnight section so that you can grab and go without opening the entire bag. And it has a separate, dedicated section just for your laptop. Strategically located pockets and dividers ensure you can easily find what youre looking for. The design of this roller is finished with leatherette and visible stitching for a tailored, professional look.
profile.reviewText: This backpack reminds me of when I realized the kids were gone and I no longer had to have a four door sedan. Then, they started to drop off the grandkids and disappear for dayssooooo.while I really like its sleek design with a passel of leather accents (at least I think its leather) , assortment of thoughtful features, quality construction that gives all indications the bag will prove to be sturdy and durable, it simply isn't likely this model will replace my workhorse backpack, the Targus Compact Rolling Backpack for Laptops up to 16-Inch/MacBook Pros up to 17-Inch, Black/Red (TSB75001US) despite the fact the seams on the old backpack are beginning to show the seam stress of being owned by me. I think is it a great backpack for the right purchaser as long as your tendencies are not to stuff every conceivable electronic item you can come up with specious justification to carry along with you into the bag AND expect it to hold a change of clothes (wrinkle resistance not essential). From first blush, it is apparent this one will not get it done, even if all you want to do is stuff that just in case medium weight jacket in it as well. It has nooks and crannies to store/hide a variety of smaller items like keys, cables, SD cards, pens, and pencils; the document compartment can be extended in length and most significantly, it has very impressive padding for protection of a laptop probably up to 16 in a separate, lockable zipper closure pocket. Im not all that invigorated by the checkpoint feature, which allows the bag to be flattened for security scans as it hasn't been a major concern for me with my corpulent traveler current backpack.
profile.summary: Lets take your backpack

profile.description: Take control of the tee box. Pink Guarantees are designed to give you the confidence needed to hit longer, straighter drives starting with a consistent tee height, every time. Made from recycled materials, Guarantees are USGA conforming and engineered to be up to 50 times stronger than wood tees. Our pink golf tees are a popular gift for women, charity golf events, ladies league and outings, and for breast cancer awareness. Try them the next time you tee it up and see the difference. New for 2016, we think you will agree that these are the best golf tees on the market. Your satisfaction is 100% guaranteed, or your money back.
profile.reviewText:
After playing a couple of rounds with these 2 3/4" tees, I'm impressed since I'm still using one of the first two I pulled out the sample bag I received. The one I lost was not due to damage but absentmindedness as I was more concerned with following the flight of a bad shot than picking up the tee. However, as they are a little pricey as tees go, you'll begin to pay attention. The imprint is also helpful for consistently placing the tee at preferred individual depths.

I've never been a fan of plastic tees because although any of them will last longer than wooden ones over time they tend to lose rigidity and become difficult to insert in harder pan tee boxes or do you end up searching around the tee box for the splintered detritus left by previous groups.  While that wasn't likely to be a problem this late in the season in the Northeast, after 36 holes, using merely two tees is a first for me. They are available in either pink or white, not that it makes much of a difference to me.

I received a sample for evaluation.
profile.summary: Now, if I can figure out how to play the same ball for 18.

profile.description: The Pivotal Tracker 1 (2nd gen) new membership bundle includes 12 months access to the Pivotal Living app, Pivotal Tracker 1 (2nd generation) activity and sleep monitoring band, and USB charger. Working in conjunction with the Pivotal Living mobile app, the Pivotal Living Tracker 1 uses sensor technology to track daily activities, such as steps walked, daily activity, calories burned, and the amount (and quality) of sleep. The wristband sends information wirelessly to the Pivotal Living mobile app to provide real time health and wellness reporting to help make smarter lifestyle choices. Life begins now. The Pivotal Tracker 1 and Pivotal Living companion app allows people to join as many different Teams as they like, and gives members full control over which data -and how much data- is shared with others. The Pivotal Living App and the Pivotal Tracker 1 both work with iPhone and most Android 4.3+ devices. The band syncs with the following devices running iOS 8 and above: iPhone 4S, 5, 5C, 5S, 6, 6 Plus, iPod Touch 5, iPad 3, 4, Mini, Mini 2, Air, and Air 2; as well as most Android 4.3+ mobile phones. Please make sure to visit our website for full compatibility list, as well as access to our user manual, troubleshooting guide and setup video tutorials!
profile.reviewText:
***Update 5/23/15***

As the manufacturer advised in a comment posted to my review, the device does in fact store up to three days of data before sync and transfer is essential. My difficulty seems to be the inconsistent ability to link with my mobile device and thereafter a tendency for the app to lock in upload mode.

***End of update***

Just ignore the attractive price point and accept it would be a far better decision to lay out a few more dollars and get something that works. I'm not even going to address the subscription fee that will commence after the first year, if for reasons unfathomable to me, someone decided to stick with this albatross.

The device and associated mobile app have a host of features that could be helpful for tracking a range of activities, if a) the band sensor was accurate, and b) the user isn't annoyed by the need to consistently manually update various app categories. I'm not disposed to carrying a mobile device in addition to wearing a tracker so for me, this combination is not practical.

Looking like a knock off vendor in Times Square, I evaluated the Pivotal tracker against two other trackers and a mobile device resident application and in each instance the Tracker 1 come up lacking, especially for recorded step count, distance traveled and burned calories. You don't have to be concerned about heart rate...it doesn't monitor it...Sleep mode also has to set manually, another inconvenience when two of my other trackers have sensors to determine modifications in physiological patterns to do the same thing.

This device doesn't appear to store more than one day's worth of data, making it incumbent to sync on a daily basis which is not always practical for me either, and despite representations, user manuals and instructional videos, the sync procedure is tedious, obligating internet connectivity rather than simple transfer to the host mobile device for some data. So far as I can determine, the sleep mode also requires setting an alarm, another requirement I could very well do without. The accompanying information card also emphasizes charging should monitored to assure the device isn't subjected to over-charging and possible damage. I don't believe I currently have any other Lithium based battery powered device where that ancient issue remains a concern.

Potential users with smaller wrists may find the band cumbersome as the display module is rather wide.  The display is in non-adjustable landscape format making it somewhat difficult to read, particularly if dominant arm is the southpaw side and the choice is made to wear it on the right wrist resulting in either the readouts being upside down, or the access button being exposed and potentially depressed by unintentional contact. Not that those factors matter, if you're outside in daylight, the display is virtually unreadable anyway.

I received this tracker for free. I got beat.
profile.summary: If you're thinking about this tracker, pivot to another alternative.

profile.description: Play any music through your car's radio from your phone, Ipod or MP3 player when Bluetooth or Aux ports are not avaialble. Featuring 20 different transmitting frequencies, you can listen to your music regardless of your location or signal strength. The TuneIn FM transmitter is designed to work with your car stereo and is compatible with all types of stereos with FM radio receivers. Just plug in the transmitter to your device, set the channel on the TuneIn device, set your stereo FM channel to match the TuneIn and hear your music play through your car stereo. This transmitter lets you add functionality to your car's stereo system and gives you the ability to play any music as you please. Requires two AAA batteries (not included). Included On/Off switch helps conserve battery life when not in use.
profile.reviewText: Let's get right to the bottom line: I'm cheap and lazy so when I say I bought this device two years ago at the retail price and remain happy with it you can take that as one of the strongest endorsements I can give. When my CD player decided to perform ritual seppuku my choices were to replace the unit immediately or take the expedient step of using a FM transmitter until I performed the research to determine which replacement stereo I wanted to go with. I started out with another transmitter, DLO 005-2120 TransDock micro for the E2xx, C2xx for iPod, I had been using in an older vehicle that only had a cassette player but obviously that had the potential to cause conflict with the customary driver of that car and I didn't care for it all that much anyway so I ended up picking up a unit from another manufacturer, SD/MMC/USB/MP3 Wireless In Car FM Transmitter with Remote (Black), I found on sale in a discount big box store. Now, unit "a" had frequency issues when traveling through congested urban areas and it turned out unit "b" just had issues, most critically the propensity to surge and blow out circuit fuses. Regardless, the lazy tendency was still in play so even if I took the logical step of replacing the stereo unit to finally resolve the problem, I still would have had to do the installation. Why not let someone do it? See the cheap reference we started with. But, then I came upon this unit and haven't looked back. I have a couple of mini USB drives PNY 4 GB Micro Sleek USB Drive, Blue P-FDU4GBSLK/BLU-EF that I have loaded up with songs to fit my moods as well as a couple of SD cards. Personally, I haven't attempted charging my iPod Nano or iPod touch as I have alternative methods to do that in the car. In fact, I didn't even realize the cord that accompanies this device has two different size plugs (2.5mm on one end and 3.5mm on the other) until I read the instruction brochure when I decided to write this review. I have only minor complaints with frequency separation as I regularly have to drive in areas where significant interference is likely and it is rare I have to adjust the station signal. While sound reproduction is basically good, there are instances where I will encounter static however that might be a function of sourcing for the music files I created. Location memory is limited meaning when the car is turned off, the device will not remember positioning in the music track but will restart at the beginning of the track. During daylight hours, the digital readout is near to impossible to read and with consideration to size and character space, most often not really worth the effort but in my opinion that is a small trade-off. The remote is IR line of sight and seems like it has to be within inches of the device before signal transmission is recognized, another annoyance that you simply have to learn to accept. After all this time, muscle memory lets me hit the right keys on the remote without thinking about it, anyway. Thus far, even with what I consider to be extensive use, I haven't had the need to replace the unit's fuse, the battery in the remote or more critically from my perspective, replenish my supply car fuses as this device is dependable.
profile.summary: What? no color screen. This is unacceptable...

profile.description: Sporty enough for the trails and streamlined for the city, this functional compact camera sling is a must-have for on-the-go photographers. Adjustable divider walls and blue interior make it a breeze to customize and organize your compact system camera or compact DSLR along with 1-2 lenses or flash and accessories. Sling design allows you to quickly access all contents of the bag without taking it off and you'll never want to with the comfort of a thickly padded mesh backpanel and shoulder strap that offer ergonomic support in each wearable position
profile.reviewText:
I use it to locate my phone in the camera bag, dependent of course on me not putting my keys in the bag as well, in which case now Ive lost both the keys and the phone.

Thats not intended as a criticism really, as the backpack has ample compartments to hold just about everything one might need for a photo shoot (at my level  over equipped mediocre amateur) and then some. Plus finally, Case Logic has marketed a product that appears to cater to those of us who play in the southpaw league and hasn't made a big deal out of it, like were lepers and society has resigned itself to our attempts to integrate. For once, righthanders have to figure out a way to adapt as the camera body/lens compartment is best suited for lefties if the bag is accessed while still being worn.

Based on size alone, at first glance I kind of assumed the bag could do double duty as an overnighter travel bag as well but with all of the specific purposed compartments and padding for photography equipment attempting to use it for a quick trip would require some real creative packing and still be a stretchliterally and figuratively. I use the bag for storage of a Sony A3000 and additional lens including a Sony E 55-210mm and the backpack accommodates equipment of that size very well. I can imagine potential purchasers with full size DSLRs may find the interior compartment a tad small.

Overall, I think Case Logic has developed another winner. I have three other camera bags from the manufacturer and I have been pleased with the features, quality and durability for each.
profile.summary: Finally, I have a use for my mobile device locator.

profile.description: The Corsair Gaming K95 is a fully mechanical, backlit keyboard with 18 dedicated macro keys for exceptional gaming performance. The built-in Cherry MX Red switches deliver smooth, linear response for ultra fast double and triple taps without the audible click. Every key is individually lit for brilliant backlighting and easy customizability to highlight important functions. The black anodized brushed aluminum structure provides rugged durability and a professional-grade finish. 18 dedicated macro keys with three banks give you easy, single keystroke access to up to 54 of your favorite presets and key combos. Plus the 122Key Roll-over on USB and 100% Anti-Ghosting mean that every key you touch translates directly into the game.
profile.reviewText:
And right now, not much else but the accountability for that lies entirely with me, not this exceptional keyboard. I got the K95 RGB for business applications rather than gaming as the vast range of customizable options is a great fit for use with proprietary software I have to use with one of my activities, book indexing. Im confident over time as I gain greater familiarity with the manual and acquire an enhanced level of comfort with manipulation of the features, the keyboard will be a nearly indispensable resource.

 Presently, its more of toy to play with as I quickly created multiple key illumination modes under a couple of profiles just to try to understand what capabilities are available. The 18 G keys can be programmed for a vast range of macros, including the ability to predefine separate functions on the separate monitors I need to use in tandem. Im a touch typist but like many others had drifted away from mechanical keyboards over the years. With the short time I have had this one available to me, I have to question why and how I ever allowed myself to join the herd and am already looking at how I could justify purchasing another one of these boards for use with another computer although with the software installed on the second unit it is possible to pick up this keyboard and use it on another box with the same profiles accessible as they are can be stored in the keyboards memory.

I really cannot speak to actual differences in feel and responsiveness of the other Cherry MX keys but I am enthused by how well the brown switches seem to work for me. Reduction in typos and minimization of key strokes is essential with my business use and I can already see where this device has been beneficial in both areas. As a mechanical, it is appreciably noisier than the filament keyboards but I kind of find the sound soothing and reassuring. Since I am typically working in a solo environment, there isn't often anyone else who might be distracted by the repetitive clicks.

One curiosity that I might be able to address as I find out more about the keyboard is to determine whether it can be reconfigured to shut down when the computer goes into sleep mode. Right now it remains illuminated until full shut down of the CPU. Ive also noticed some other reviewers have mentioned concerns regarding dead LEDs or accelerated burnout. While I have only had the keyboard for less than a month, I haven't had any problems in that regard.

Im not particularly rough on any keyboard and with the build quality of this one, I fully expect to enjoy it for years to come.
profile.summary: All the pretty colors

profile.description: JAP meets rap in "Marci X", a feel-good comedy that was filmed in 2000 and shelved for three years. Despite its lowly fate, this cross-cultural satire has a respectable pedigree, written by "In and Out" screenwriter Paul Rudnick (A.K.A. "Premiere" magazine columnist "Libby Gelman-Waxner") and directed with surprising vitality by Hollywood veteran Richard Benjamin, who seems doomed to a string of flops. Lisa Kudrow is perfectly cast as a Jewish socialite whose corporate mogul father (Benjamin) is being ruined by controversy involving a raunchy hip-hop star (Damon Wayans) on his payroll, and an ultra-conservative senator (Christine Barnaski) who demands censorship and public apologies. Aided by Marc Shaiman's catchy spoof-songs, Rudnick and Benjamin earn some big laughs when Kudrow and Wayans hook up for some color-blind synergy, but "Marci X" never quite hits a groove. It was stale before its release, and toothless when it should have had bite. Still, it's recommendable as Benjamin's most ambitious comedy since 1982's "My Favorite Year". "--Jeff Shannon"
profile.reviewText:
The problem with Marci X is in this era of ideological constraint identification of an audience base was an impossibility. However, if you liked Bamboozled, this satirical film lampooning the exploitive cultures of Rap Music and Corporate America while managing to lob a grenade or two at the uninformed arrogance of conspicuously consuming socialites will entertain you as well.

Lisa Kudrow is the over the top incarnation of the Upper East Side conveniently relevant Jewish socialite and Damon Wayans succeeds admirably as the up from the ghetto hip-hop icon. The unification of the two, if you watch the film, is not as implausible as some might think because while their nurturing  may have been diametrically opposite, by the time they meet the they have each become less than commendable representations of all that is wrong with inculcation of economic excess.

Richard Benjamin is the symbol of corporate management, where the only truly operative consideration is enhancement of the bottom line until orchestrated public outcry, in this instance lead by a self-aggrandizing Senator portrayed Christine Baranaski who naturally has her own private agenda, places superficial attention to social responsibility on the cusp.  Throw in some gems offered by Kudrow's sidekicks, most notably , Jane Krakowski, add a  J.Lo wannabe, and an assortment of caricatures  from both sides of the economic divide  and you have about ninety minutes of fun.
profile.summary: It's okay. You can laugh

profile.description: Play any music through your car's radio from your iPhone, iPod or MP3 player when Bluetooth or Aux ports are not available. Digital frequency adjustment allows for endless channel possibilities giving you the ability to listen to your music regardless of your location or signal strength. The FreqOut Pro FM transmitter is designed to work with your car stereo and is compatible with all types of stereos with FM radio receivers. The transmitter plugs directly into your car's 12V charging port for endless transmitting and listening. Includes a built-in 2.1A USB charging port to keep your phone fully charged while playing. This transmitter uses FREQTM scan technology to find the optimal transmitting frequency for better hands-free operation. The FreqOut pro lets you add functionality to your car's stereo system and gives you the ability to play any music as you please.The neck to the transmitter is flexible so you can adjust for optimal viewing. Also features a programmable 4 channel memory so you can quickly switch to your favorite channels for your area. To play music just plug in the transmitter to your device via the provided Ipod cable or aux port, set the channel on the transmitter, set your stereo FM channel to match the transmitter and hear your music play through your car stereo. Multifunction button give you control of the music; skip, pause, play, fast forward and rewind without having to access your phone.
