profile.description: Apple's MagSafe connector has saved literally millions of laptops from destruction caused by tripping over one's power cord. But with the introduction of USB-C on new MacBooks, this safety feature is absent. The BreakSafe Connector BreakSafe's patented quick-release magnetic connector plugs into your laptop's USB-C port and safely disconnects from the rest of the cable when under stress or strain, like tripping over the power cord. The streamlined magnetic connector is only 12.8 mm deep so you can leave it plugged into your laptop's USB-C port when not in use. BreakSafe is Designed to Protect your Laptop and You Because it is designed to carry power sufficient to charge your laptop's battery (up to 60 watts), BreakSafe incorporates four different safety features to protect you and your laptop from accidental or intentional misuse: Visual: Visual markings on the connector housing show the user the correct way to attach the cable and connector. Magnetic: BreakSafe's magnets only allow it to be connected the correct way, and ensure the cord's polarity is consistent with both the power supply and the device being powered. Structural: BreakSafe has two small keys molded into its magnetic connector that physically prevent the magnets from engaging, and prevent the cable from connecting incorrectly. Electrical: BreakSafe's central ground pin is the first conductive element to touch when joining the cable and connector. This ensures that any static electrical charges are dissipated before the cable begins passing power from supply to device. Using BreakSafe Use BreakSafe with the USB-C power supply that came with your laptop. BreakSafe is rated up to 60 watts (20 volts @ 3 amps), and has been designed and tested to meet USB-C power standards
profile.reviewText:
Received as a gift.

I wanted a USB C to USB C short, magnetic cable. I received this item and I hate it.

The connector (the part you leave in the plug) is MASSIVE. It is 2-3x the size of other breakaway connectors. Now, if it supported other stuff, I might understand but it is just for charging.

The connector sticks out so far that it significantly increases the potential of damaging the C port. Plus, it is an annoying eyesore. It's like a small planet orbiting your device.

What person at Griffin thought a HUGE connector that sticks a half-mile out of a device would be a good idea?
----------------------

I am going with either the Stouchi or the COMNDEX, 4.3amp, L shaped model.
profile.summary: Returned it ... it is MASSIVE.

profile.description: Made of a continuous loop of sturdy stainless steel, the big ring is perfect for those of us with more than the average number of keys. Large and roomy, yet lightweight and easy to carry, the big ring comes with 8 #.5-Sized stainless steel s-biners in two colors (4 stainless, 4 black) so you can easily identify keys at a glance. Or, use one of the s-biners to attach the big ring to a belt loop, purse strap, or zipper pull, or to hook to a second ring. The s-biners remove and re-attach quickly and securely, making it easy to share keys with co-workers, valets, babysitters, or for taking a single key with you when you're out for a run or ride. More s-biners can be ordered separately the big ring can hold plenty of them. Features:- 8 #.5 stainless steel strainer double gated carabiner key clips (4 stainless and 4 black)- the big ring combines the innovation and versatility of the s-biner to provide unique functionality and access to your keys- s-biners remove and re-attach quickly and securely, making it easy to share keys- 2 different color s-biners allow for easy identification of similar style keys - no more guessing!- product Dimensions: 3.3" x 2.2" x 5" - weight: 1.3 oz.
profile.reviewText:
I ordered this item based on the item description and the Q./A section above. Several responders state their S-biners are metal. The item description states the S-biners are stainless steel. On the item I received, mine are plastic -- not metal. There is absolutely no doubt whatsoever, they are plastic. When I removed the ring/S-biners from the card with the plastic tie, I immediately noticed the plastic. I returned to this product page to ensure I had not made a mistake in ordering.

Also, just to clarify, the large O-ring is solid, not split and it is metal.

The S-biners are black and grayish silver colors (4 of each color). The springs all function well. They appear to be sturdy enough to hold the lightweight items I need to carry. They are easy to open and snap back into place. I do fear if any significant torque is placed on any of the S-biners, they would break,

Maybe I have I received an item different from other purchasers or other purchasers are under the impression their S-biners are metal but they aren't. It is also possible Nite Ize has changed the S-biners from metal to plastic without changing the product description. Or maybe a different product has been stocked. No idea.

If I had known the S-biners were plastic before I ordered, and I had wanted plastic, this would be a 5-star product. I mean, it is ok but I really need metal. I can use the item so I am not returning it. However, I am not thrilled so I am deducting two stars.

Note: Amazon does not allow me to respond to comments.
profile.summary: My S-biners are definitely plastic, not stainless steel

profile.description: Pet parents know texture is just as important as taste for their cat. TEMPTATIONS Treats for Cats Seafood Medley Flavor features a unique pocket shape that is delightfully crunchy on the outside and scrumptiously soft and creamy on the inside. Your feline friend will adore the natural, savory seafood taste, which never contains artificial flavors. America's #1 cat treat* is also 100% nutritionally complete and balanced for adult cat maintenance. You will love that your cat is getting great-tasting nutrition, and at only 2 calories per treat, our delicious cat treats are perfect for playtime, snack time or anytime. (*Based on sales data)
profile.reviewText:
There is a nice 20% off coupon and I ordered these containers along with all the Mega bags. The coupon is good til the end of 2014. Same great treats in a bit more economical size. If your cats eats as many of these as my cat, it's worth the buy the larger container, especially with the coupon. I have been able to reuse the coupons multiple times.

The tops are double wrapped in plastic (outside, around the green top and underneath the green top, across the entire opening). I need a knife or scissors to easily open the first layer.

One corner flips upward in order to dispense the treats. Although the opening is fairly large, the treats don't always come out easily when full. Sometimes I must shake aggressively multiple times to get the treats to dispense.

The above issues are very, very minor. Five stars for my cat's favorite food.

ETA: Before you purchase, check for coupons on the Today's Deals' page under the coupon section. They are usually 15 to 20% off.
profile.summary: ^..^< loves Temptations' treats.

profile.description: Serial killer thriller starring Nicolas Cage and John Cusack. A ruthless killer has been burying his victims near Anchorage, Alaska for over ten years but local police are clueless as to the murderer's identity. When local stripper Cindy Paulson (Vanessa Hudgens) escapes a brutal attack by hunter Robert Hansen (Cusack), Detective Jack Halcombe (Cage) begins his investigation into the case. With Cindy as his guide and tension high in the community he must act quickly before another victim falls prey to the killer...
profile.reviewText:
This is your basic "catch a rapist/killer" flick where they must find enough evidence to arrest the suspect.

Honestly, I like the movie. No big special effects. No car chases, no big shootouts, nothing like that.

I have not enjoyed many of Cage's movies in the last few years. In fact, I have even been avoiding his movies. I really like John Cusack movies. I feel both actors did a pretty good job. I found the movie interesting and it kept my attention to the end. For me, this is the best Cage movie I have seen in a long time.

Many people may find this movie too slow paced and lacking in the action department. Because it was based upon a true story, I did not mind. I am pleased they didn't try to Hollywood the story.

Simple, interesting. It is worth a $3.99 rental. $6.99 is a bit much for this movie but I have no regrets.

My rating. A 5 star movie is outstanding. 4 is great. 3 is pretty good, it was ok. So, a 3.
profile.summary: One of Cage's better movies lately

profile.description: Streamlight ProTac 2L 260 lumens 88031 LED flashlight 0.77 inch diameter bezel. The ProTac 2L tactical flashlight is IPX7 waterproof, comes with an unbreakable pocket clip and offers three lighting programs: high, low or strobe.
profile.reviewText: When the batteries in this flashlight are fresh, the light is very bright. However, once the batteries get even a little wear on them, that brightness deteriorates significantly. Then you are left with this option. Do I toss batteries that still produce a light that is significantly lower? The batteries are very expensive and do not last very long. I am on my second set of Duracells that I have barely used and I can barely light the back fence. This light sucks up batteries big time. This light is far too expensive to operate. I returned this item twice. After three flashlights, I settled on a third, still not properly functional. On the video, I do not show the 'Lo' nor the "strobe' setting because the light will only do 'Hi' and 'Off'. This was the same with all three lights I purchased. Twice, when turning it on, the 'strobe' setting activated but I have never been able to get it to activate on purpose. The manufacturer states: "LED Solid State Power Regulation provides maximum light output throughout battery life." This simply is not accurate. The light looses strength quickly and the light does not maintain its maximum output. Click Full Screen for best viewing of video. Amazon compresses the video so it is difficult to read small print on objects unless you use Full Screen. I feel a rating of 3 is being generous.
profile.summary: Horrible battery hog and terribly expensive to maintain

profile.description: Searching for a treat your favorite feline cant resist? Look no further. Delectables is the first gourmet lickable treat to combine tender, real chicken and succulent, plump fish in three purr worthy textures: bisque (smooth), stew (hearty) and chowder (creamy). Each recipe boasts nutritious and flavorful ingredients delectably blended for easy-to-lap eating with items for kitten, adult, and senior life stages. The unique consistency, combined with our superior palatability technology, makes Delectables Lickable Treats so delicious cats lick the bowl clean! The purrfectly sized 1.4 ounce pouch is easy to open and pour for a quick snack or food topper to entice finicky eaters.
profile.reviewText:
My cat loves the Stew and Bisque. It is a 5 star product.

If your cat likes to lick gravy and nibble at a few pieces of meat, this product may be what you want. It is about a quarter of the weight/size/portion of normal pouches. The chicken appears to be similar to canned chicken bought for humans and a few veggie bits with a lot of gravy. There is as much gravy, if not more, than solids.

My cat, who is older, will only lick gravy from cans or pouches. I have never seen her eat any of the canned/pouch solids. However, she will actually eat most of the chicken from the Delectables' Stew. She also likes the Bisque product, which is all thick liquid, no solids.

Locally, I can purchase these for $0.94 to $1 per pouch. It is more expensive and less content, but my cat seems to prefer it. She is eating more than she has in years.
profile.summary: Great for older, finicky cats that prefer gravy.

profile.description: Simax 4 cup Cooking and Measuring Cup combines elegant design and transparency with excellent heat and chemical resistance. Heat resistant Borosilicate Glass is resistant to thermal shock, plus this glass will not chemically interact with your food in any way. Each piece is made of recycled glass and does not contain any Cadmium or Lead. The hard surface of the glass ensures hygienic and health conscious cooking and is dishwasher safe.
profile.reviewText: I have purchased a total of three 4 cup measurers. I broke one. I never use these as measuring cups. They are the perfect, large tea glass/coffee mug. My friends and family poke fun at my large drinking glass but I love it. If you can drink/eat a liter of coffee/tea/fluid/soup at one time, this item is for you. This item, including the handle, is quite sturdy. It can handle very hot liquids. I often stick this cup directly on the stove to heat the contents. I have also stuck it in the freezer for several hours. It has a wide mouth and the lip is smooth which makes drinking directly from the sides very easy and comfortable. This glassware will break but not easily. I have never had a measurer chip but I am very careful with my glassware. I had one 4 cup break. When it hit the concrete in my garage, it bounced three times and broke on the third bounce. The handle: My biggest issue with this type of glassware is the sturdiness of the handle. Simax has the best handle. Catamount has a smaller, thinner handle that I feel might break if not supported. The glassware is no where near as thick and heavy as Pyrex. It is oversized, so there is plenty of room after the 800ml/1.5 pints marking. There are measurements on the side for sugar, flour (dry ingredients are measured in grams) and liquids (measured in ml's and pints). I wash my current mug several times a day, never in the dishwasher, and the measurements are still easily visible. If you are searching for a large glass mug, this item is great. I am sure it also works great as a measuring cup. 5 star worthy. ======================== 6/29/13 Update ======================== So far, I have ordered these mugs for six different friends. I just ordered myself two more. Everyone is always asking where I got it. My glass looks as good as the day I received it, no discoloration nor degradation of the markings. I use it everyday as my main coffee and tea mug. ======================= 4/11/14 Update ======================= I am down to two mugs. A few months back I broke one by dropping a hot cast iron skillet on it while it was in the sink. Yesterday, one fell off my Jeep and hit the concrete driveway. I love these things. Honestly, they don't break very easily....thankfully. If they would fit in my cupholder they would be perfect. ============== 2/20/18 Still using my mugs and ordering them for friends. Over the years, the markings have changed since I made the video but the mugs are the same great quality with sturdy, thick handles.
profile.summary: My favorite X-large mug

profile.description: Maiden Woods is a remote and quiet town of decent, hard-working people, but something stirs in the dark woods surrounding this isolated community. After a logging company decimates an area of the forest, a rash of increasingly violent and unexplainable events transpires. Sheriff Paul Shields (Kevin Durand) and his deputy (Lukas Haas) struggle to confront their own personal demons while facing down a new breed of raw terror that is possibly older than humanity itself and much, much hungrier.
profile.reviewText:
This movie is an impressive little gem ... for a monster movie. The writing and acting were great and it kept my attention the entire time.

Two things I like about this movie. The lead actor did a fantastic job. He kept the movie from being a cheesy B flick. The other thing is that the movie has somewhat of a realistic feeling.

Two things I didn't like about the movie. One, some of the scenes were unrealistic (yes, I know I just stated the opposite). An example, a huge monster with cloven feet, walking on hardwood floors within a food behind a man but doesn't make a sound. The other, where are all the other people in the town? Honestly, neither of these type things are big issues.

Overall, 4 stars is a very high rating from me, espeically for a movie in this genre.
profile.summary: One of the better monster movies

profile.description: Secura turbo oven uses infrared heating and convection fan to cook food fast and evenly. No need to thaw frozen meat, no need to add oil, saves energy than traditional oven and cooks healthy food in half the time. The oven can broil, roast, bake, grill, barbecue, fry, steam. Manual dial switches Power, timer indicator lights Easy to operate: Just select and set both time and temperature Close to microwave speed with oven quality Thaws out frozen foods in minutes Self cleaning Seals your foods natural juices Cooks an entire meal at one time without blending of flavors Low fat cooking allows you to cook without excess fat or oil Power saving device Detachable power cord Weight: 15.2 lbs Rating: 1,300W Capacity: 11L Standard Accessories: Tong, Dual Rack, Low Rack, Extender Ring
profile.reviewText: I bought this oven about a year ago. I researched every brand and finally settled on this model. I consider this appliance to be one the best kitchen purchases I have ever made. In fact, both of my favorite kitchen appliances are made by Secura. My other favorite appliance is: DUXTOP 1800-Watt Portable Sensor Touch Induction Cooktop Countertop Burner 8300ST. If either of these items broke, I would order another without hesitation. I use both of these items daily and I have never had any trouble from either item. If either breaks I am sure it will be because I have worn them out. The oven has it's drawbacks. It is heavy, the cord is always in the way and it takes up a lot of space. This machine excels at cooking frozen foods and reheating leftovers. Baked fish is awesome. Most foods take less than 10 minutes to reheat and taste great. No preheating necessary. The fine mesh tray in the accessory package is worth the price of the accessories. Secura Turbo Oven Complete Accessory Set My sister owns a NuWave. My Secura kicks NuWave butt bigtime. Although I praise both of these items highly, I dislike Secura as a company. Their customer service is rude beyond belief. ============================ 6-18-2013 Second year update ============================ I have had this appliance two years now and it still works great. It is showing a bit of wear but I use it almost daily. Sometimes 3-4/more times per day. The timer dial, on the last few minutes, seems to not be working as before but the unit still works. When it gets to around 3 minutes, it sometimes completes the countdown. For instance, if I want to cook something for 5 minutes, I must set the dial for 8 minutes. However, considering I have probably turned the dial 1,000-2,000 times in the last two years, no biggie. Once you learn how to use this appliance, you will never want to be without one. The quality is superb, especially after you learn how to properly use it and adjust temps/times. Once you determine the best cooking time and temp for a food, write it in a notebook. It will help a lot.
profile.summary: One of my favorite kitchen appliances

profile.description: This silicone ring forms round shaped eggs ideal for breakfast sandwiches. Heat resistant up to 280-Celsius/ 536-farenheit
profile.reviewText:
I received two of these as a gift. I have metal holders but I don't want to use them in my non-stick dedicated egg pan. I wanted molds shaped like bread for making sandwiches.

One of the molds was 90% flat and only leaked a little on one side. Not a big deal. I simply put the spatula on that side when placing the eggs in the mold/pan.

However, the other mold was really warped with poor contact and major leakage. I placed the mold in a large deep frying pan and filled the pan with water (up to Eggman's neck). Then I placed my really big stainless butcher knife (it is very flat and heavy) on top of the mold (everywhere except the little Eggman). I had to try multiple objects that would create 100% contact with the skillet. I turned my induction burner to 10 and let it boil for 15 minutes then reduced to level 4 (adding water when needed). I returned the level to 10 for 10 minutes at the end. I wanted it as hot as possible when I moved it to the freezer.

After 3 hours of heating, I removed the mold from the skillet/water and placed it in a small flat dish with a boxed frozen dinner (eggplant parmesan) on top (continued pressure on all edges). I left it there half a day. It is almost 100% flat. I get a little leakage where Eggman is located.

Why 3 hours? I was watching movies and wanted to wait til the last movie finished, No other reason.

When they're flat, they work much better. Now, I know how to position each one and how to tilt my pan in the beginning. No leakage. Takes a little practice.
profile.summary: Work well if flat

profile.description: NOTICE: Polish Release, cover may contain Polish text/markings. The disk has English subtitles. A small-time magician is swept away to an enchanted land and is forced into a power struggle between three witches.
profile.reviewText:
I almost bypassed this movie until I read that it was directed by Sam Raimi. I am a big fan of Raimi's work and this time he has created a cinamatic masterpiece. I cannot believe I have never heard of this movie before today. I rented and watched on a projector at 720p.

The black and white intro: For those viewing on a small screen, I can imagine your frustration. I agree with the other posters and do your best to get past the intro, the rest of the movie is well worth it. I don't mean to suggest the intro is not worth watching, I was just addressing the people with small screens. The black and white is detail rich, and equally balances with tone, texture and visual appeal. The stark contrast from black and white to color gives even more emphasis to the color once it begins.

The actors: The cast is well chosen. James Franco, the Oz, is suppose to an annoying con-man with little redeeming quality and I found Franco fits this role perfectly. Rachel Weisz, Michelle Williams and Mila Kunis were great as the three witches, with Mila Kunis giving a great preformance. Honestly, I didn't think she had it in her.

The storyline: The story is about how the Great Oz became the Great Oz and how the Wicked Witch Of The West became wicked. The background of all three witches are presented in a basic way. Done as a prequel, the story blends both old and new well.

Cinematography: This is where the movie shines, or more appropriately, glows. When the black and white part ends and the color starts, each scene is like a work of art. I felt like a little kid watching the screen. All that color. I think Raimi's intent was to mirror what those viewers of the first techicolor movie must have experienced. This movie is meant for high definition and the big screen but even at 720p, my viewing experience was amazing. I wish I could view it in a theater.

There is no bad language, no nekkid people, a couple of fight scenes (actors land very hard after being hit by magic) and a few scary, flying monkies. There is a big tornado scene. The Wicked Witch does threaten to eliminate all the good people. However, the good vs evil is well balanced with good triumphing in the end.

If you are one of those people that could care less about nostalgia and just want to see a high action movie with a lot of special graphics, this movie is not for you. This movie is meant to reflect the original, almost a period piece with some enhanced graphics. I feel many teenagers and some of the 20-30/something crowd will not appreciate it. However, for me, I feel Raimi hit a home run with this gem.
profile.summary: Well done but not for everyone.

profile.description: A group of researchers led by Frank (Mark Duplass) and his fiancee Zoe (Olivia Wilde) have achieved the unimaginable: bringing the dead back to life. When Zoe is accidentally electrocuted in a horrific accident, Frank and his team use their experimental serum to resurrect her. But their attempt goes horribly wrong--unleashing terrifying powers within Zoe that put all of their lives in grave danger.
profile.reviewText:
Usually, I am very critical of a movie in this genre. This movie wasn't bad. I watched it til the end. When I left the room, I paused it to make sure I didn't miss parts. So, that means it had my attention.

This movie is about bringing someone (and a dog) back from death and the creepy things that follow.

It is well acted, with a decent script/storyline, which makes it a bit better than most in this category. It is also well filmed with special effects that are not overdone nor underdone. Well, in this genre, there is no baseline but the lead actress bordered on over doing it.

What makes this movie worth watching? The fact that it isn't bad.
Is it worth renting? If you are really bored and you have the money to burn.

It is available on Netflix.
profile.summary: Not a bad movie, better than a lot of movies in this genre

profile.description: The OXO Good Grips Mini Clips will help you organize your home or office. Functional and colorful, the Mini Clips feature sturdy plastic construction and soft, comfortable grips. The non-slip mouths hold items securely and each Mini Clip has a magnet for convenient storage or display on magnetic surfaces or Clips can stand upright to display recipes, place cards or notes. Pack of 8.
profile.reviewText: Arrived quickly, well packaged and easy to open. My first thought, I ordered the wrong size. These are very, very small. Not much bigger than my thumbnail. It is not always easy to tell the size on Amazon. Not a big deal, I can still use them. Like most Oxo stuff, they are well made, the clips have a strong spring, the magnet is also quite strong for the size. These are meant to hold single, paper thin items, such as photos. If you fold over the top of a potato chip bag, once, neatly, one of these clips will hold it shut. Sometimes I can get two folds to hold, sometimes I find the clip pops off the bag. My failed attempts to make the clips function beyond their intended purpose should not detract from the clips. It is my fault for ordering the wrong size. For their intended purpose, they work perfectly. Hope the video will give you a better idea of the size.
profile.summary: Very mini but work perfectly for their intended purpose.

profile.description: The Rada Cutlery R119 Quick Edge Knife Sharpener is a quick and easy way to keep your knives sharp, which is important for all chefs. A dull knife requires you to apply more pressure, which can be dangerous. The hardened, high carbon stainless steel wheels intersect so you can sharpen both sides of the blade at the same time. It comes with a black nylon base that is designed to be sturdy and durable. Measuring 3-1/2 x 2 inches, this knife sharpener is compact enough to fit into any kitchen drawer. For cooks on the go, this knife sharpener is portable fitting in most bags and packs up easily. Its also perfect for hunters and fishermen that need to keep their field knife sharp. Rada Mfg. Co. is located in Waverly, Iowa and has been manufacturing cutlery in the USA since 1948. Our mission is all about providing our customers the best value of kitchen knives for their dollar. We stand by our craftsmanship. Rada Mfg. Co. will replace any product manufactured by our company returned to us due to defects in material or workmanship. Although this knife sharpener is specifically designed for Rada knives it can sharpen any knife you own.
profile.reviewText: I love Rada knives. However, I don't know what Rada was thinking when they put this on the market. It is about the size of a credit card, the two wheels have a lot of play in them and knives do not go through the sharpener smoothly. When you pull a knife through this sharpener, it jumps and skips, both the knife and the sharpener. I feared the knife, or I, would be injured. In my opinion, get something more stable. I cannot believe Rada would market such an item. Horrible quality. It is possible I received a defective unit. ----Update---- On April 20, 2014, I purchased the Rada Cutlery Ultimate Collection 15 Pc Gift Set, Made in USA, Aluminum Handles which just happened to include another sharpener. The new sharpener works as it should. I can easily pull knives through the new sharpener without any jumping. Holding the two sharpeners close to each other, it is apparent the first sharpener's stem on the right wheel is somewhat bent or misaligned and does not create a stable 'V' in order to correct an edge. I am leaving the rating the same because this review is for the single sharpener I purchased. This item was defective and the rating and review is appropriate.
profile.summary: Tiny, flimsy and unstable (see update please)

profile.description: The Leatherman Raptor shears features the necessary tools for uniformed medical professionals to safely and quickly go to work in an emergency situation. Developed with the input of special operations medics, EMTs and fire professionals familiar with standard medical shears, the Raptor was crafted with just the right balance of multipurpose features for medical-specific ops without an overkill of tools to complicate sometimes life-threatening situations. When it's a question of survival, the Raptor answers loud and clear. Closed Length: 5 in (12.7 cm); Weight: 5.8 oz (164 g); Shear Length: 1.9 in (4.8 cm).
profile.reviewText:
I received these as a birthday gift however, I do not do field work and I am retired.

Anyone considering these as a gift should know they are NOT for people that work inside. They are meant for paramedics, EMTs, flight nurses, etc.

No one that works inside needs these. In trauma units, we do not break car windows, we do not cut seatbelts, we do not need oxygen tank tools,  that ring cutter is worthless and honestly, the ruler is the best tool on this item for INSIDE workers.

The reason I am giving this item four stars is because if Leatherman is going to offer a ring cutter, it should be a good one -- a quality item. The ring cutter on this item is for soft metals only and a potential legal issue. Use a real ring cutter

Even in a trauma situation, cutting clothes and rings should be a last resort and an absolute necessity. Every effort should be made to avoid destruction of personal items.

I own a lot of Leatherman products and like almost all of them. Unfortunately, this item is not meant for someone like me. Thankfully, the gifter is able to return this item and the thought was greatly appreciated.
----------------
profile.summary: These are not for hospital workers.

profile.description: 200 years after his shocking creation, Dr. Frankenstein's creature, Adam, still walks the earth. But when he finds himself in the middle of a war over the fate of humanity, Adam discovers he holds the key that could destroy humankind. From the co-writer of the hit supernatural saga, UNDERWORLD, comes the action thriller I, FRANKENSTEIN, written for the screen and directed by Stuart Beattie, screen story by Kevin Grevioux and Stuart Beattie, based on the Darkstorm Studios graphic novel "I, Frankenstein" created by Kevin Grevioux.
profile.reviewText:
Before renting this movie, I had two negative impressions. The first from the Amazon reviews. The second being that Aaron Eckhart in this type of role was not a good choice.

If you like this type genre, this movie is ok. It kept my attention from beginning to end. The storyline did not come across as rehashed and had some interesting new twists. The special effects were very good. The fight scenes were well done and two fight scenes were excellent. Everything comes to a nice ending and I was not left with an impression anything was incomplete.

Now to Aaron Eckhart. He did a lot better than I anticipated but he just didn't seem 'right' in this role. My biggest gripe with his acting was the constant scowl on his face and his anger mode. It looked forced and out of place. Unfortunately both the facial expressions and his odd anger preoccupied my attention more than it should have. It was just a bit over the top. However, it was not to the point that I did not enjoy the movie.

No bad words, no nekkid people. Lots of violence and death scenes but no extreme blood and gore. Most deaths were demons bursting into flames or the good guys dying by ascending into a light.

Overall, worth the rental if you can't find anything else to watch. I enjoyed the movie much more than I thought I would. I never considered stopping it nor did I feel regret about renting it. It didn't suck and it wasn't great but it's ok. This movie rates 3 stars.
profile.summary: Much better than expected

profile.description: Not content with his job as a bouncer, Doug Glatt (Seann William Scott) dreams of a more rewarding job and gaining his parents respect. When a chance encounter with an on-ice thug leads to a fistfight that Doug easily wins, the on-looking coach sees Doug's potential, in spite of his lack of any hockey playing ability. Joining the team and with the encouragement of his best friend (Jay Baruchel), Doug quickly becomes a rising star. Soon he'll have the opportunity to face-off against the infamous league thug, Ross Rhea (Liev Schreiber), perhaps finally land a girlfriend and stick to a job he enjoys. Now all he needs to do is learn to skate.
profile.reviewText:
I skipped over this movie so many times. The only thing that made me consider it is that I am Liev Schreiber fan. So tonight I gave it a try.

Leiv Schreiber actually plays a small role but does a great job playing the iconic hockey star about to retire. The main actor, Seann William Scott, really surprised me. He does an outstanding job. He really makes you like his character. Although this is a movie about hockey, it's more about a guy named Doug that is a little bit on the special side.

I will warn you, the script writers favorite word is the "F" word. It is abundant in this movie. Don't watch this movie if you are offended by cussing, bloody fight scenes or anything related to 'locker room' type behavior.

This movie is funny, well done with some great acting. I really enjoyed it. A great Prime find.
profile.summary: One of my favorite Prime finds

profile.description: The Havahart X-Small Professional Style 1-Door Animal Trap has a patented design that assures you of quick. safe catches and releases. This trap is ideal for trapping chipmunks, squirrels, flying squirrels, voles, weasels and rats. This trap's structure helps prevent injuries to you or the animal. This patented Havahart one door cage trap is constructed of sturdy rust-resistant wire mesh with steel reinforcements for long life and galvanized for maximum resistance to rust and corrosion. Mesh openings are smaller than competing traps of comparable size to prevent escapes and stolen bait. Its patented design consists of a gravity action door and sensitive trigger to ensure quick, secure captures that target the specific animal size, eliminating undesired catches. Solid door and handle guard protect the user during transportation, while smoothed internal edges protect and prevent injuries to animals.
profile.reviewText: Arrived promptly, well packaged. Less than adequate instructions. Had to watch several YouTube videos by customers to figure it out. The makers of this item present several videos and none of them give any instruction on how to set this trap. The trigger is based upon one metal rod resting against another. It is not easy to set and is too easily triggered. During the making of the video, the trigger released several times before I could trigger it manually. I had to redo the video five times. When I place bait in the back of the trap, critters claw at the back thru the cage and this triggers the trap. Also, when the trap door releases, it does not go all the way down, leaving a gap at the bottom that critters can get their paws, claws, or whatever under. I try not to be overly critical of a new product and give it a chance but I feel this item is going to get returned. It appears to have several design flaws that are unnecessary. Building a trap isn't rocket surgery nor brain science. A trigger dependent upon two round rods resting against each other is poor design. Having a door that leaves a gap at the bottom is poor design. A company thinking that the critter is not going to rub against the trap, walk on top, try to get at the food from the sides hasn't dealt with many critters. To set the trap: First, raise the door slightly by pressing the lever on the top of the door then lifting upward. After slightly being raised, lift the long rod in front til it catches. This should hold the door up without any help if you have done this correctly. One the rod is holding the door up, carefully slip the long rod behind the shorter rod. There is nothing other than slight tension holding the longer rod behind the shorter rod. See image #19 at the top with the red and yellow dots on it to see the rod positions. If you have trouble setting the device, watch the video carefully. Click Full Screen after the video starts, an X in the lower right hand corner. It will be much easier to see how to set the rods on full screen. Hope this helps. At present, I am using plumber's tape to see if this will improve the over sensitivity. I am try filing down the contact edges of each rod to flatten them out a little. ========= 6-29-13 ========= After using a flat bastard file to both contact edges of the outside trigger, the trap functions much, much better. It will set much easier and trigger properly. Plumbers tape was too slick and did not hold well. Also, wedging this trap between two items, like two cardboard boxes, will keep the rodent from turning it over to escape. The metal tab that keeps the door from being raised unless you depress it can be slightly bent to be more effective. They can still raise the door if they really try. I had to bend it several times before I found the "sweet spot" that allowed it to still drop quickly but made it much harder to raise from the critter sticking their paw underneath.
profile.summary: Two serious design flaws but can be improved with a little effort

profile.description: After conquering their enemies, a group of triumphant warriors return home to rejoice with their nation. What starts as a day of celebration, quickly turns to horror as the group discovers that the world they lived in has changed forever. Defeating their neighbors proves to be just the beginning of their fight for peace.
profile.reviewText:
Describing/reviewing this movie ain't gonna be easy. It's certainly not what I expected. Not even close. I watched it twice this morning in an attempt to comprehend it better.

The product page description is inaccurate. It states, "After conquering their enemies, a group of triumphant warriors return home to rejoice with their nation. What starts as a day of celebration, quickly turns to horror as the group discovers that the world they lived in has changed forever." They did not conquer any enemies and were not triumphant. No one returns home. No one celebrates anything and no group discovers anything. In part, this story details the journey of one soldier who is attempting to return a slain comrade to the land of their fathers in order to bury him.

Although the soldier(none of the characters have names) frequently encounters "others" in his journey, he is traveling alone (well, with a corpse) and there are some extended periods of silence. I think the first dialogue was spoken at just under 15 minutes.

A good portion of the movie is a view of the soldier's perspective which is presented in a surreal, dreamlike fashion. He appears to be confused as to what is happening during his journey and with those he meets.

The makers of this film included witchcraft, Satanism as taught by many Xtians and Druidism(suggested in two places but can you find the second?).

This film is told in a certain way and as a result, I cannot tell readers much more or it would spoil the one and only interesting part of the movie.

Some may want to call this a "B" type movie but in my opinion, it's not. Cinematography, sound, costumes and locale seemed professional, appropriate and well chosen. I think they shot the entire movie through a gray filter.

The writing dialogue/storyline is confusing, flat, ambiguous and (thinking) ... just plain terrible.

I liked the main character so I wanted to find some sort of explanation that provided meaning and closure to this movie. I didn't find it the first time watching it nor did watching it a second time bring forth any great revelations.

No sex nor cursing. There is a very brief battle and a couple of sword fights but nothing major. Even so, this is not a movie for kids. They will not enjoy it at all. Most adults will not like it.

The film maker's attempt to provide a clever reference in the title of the movie but in their ignorance they totally missed the "Mark."

The ending does offer a basic, crude explanation. Actually, no one explained anything well, including me and I watched it twice.

The lead actor gets one star.
profile.summary: The best part of this movie was the misleading cover art. At least it gave me some hope this might be a decent movie.

profile.description: The Roku 3 Enhanced Game Remote features a built-in headphone jack for private listening. It comes with motion-control and gaming buttons for hours of gaming fun. RF technology gives you control of your Roku player behind closed cabinets and walls. And just like all our remotes, this one puts you in the driver's seat to control movies, music, shows and more. Works only with the Roku 3.
profile.reviewText: This remote is the best of the Roku remotes for several reasons. 1. It is RF and no more finding the "sweet spot" to get the remote to work. 2. No dedicated channel buttons (like Netflix, MGo). No more accidental channel switching. Instead, it has the A/B buttons at the bottom which do nothing if you are streaming TV/movies. 3. The 3.5mm headphone jack can also be used for remote speakers (must be wall powered). So, no need to run additional speaker wires. 4. It has the Instant Replay button. I own a total of eight Roku devices and I have almost all the remotes Roku offers. Rokus come paired with a remote. That means if you want to switch to a new remote, you must pair the new remote to the Roku device. Once paired, only that remote will work with the Roku. You cannot pair two remotes to the same Roku and you cannot use one remote for two Rokus unless you unpair/pair the remote each time you want to use the remote with the other device. I also love the ability to attach self powered speakers (speakers that plug into an AC outlet) into the headphone jack. If you use the remote for additional speakers but want to sit somewhere away from the speakers and remote, you can use the phone app as the remote if needed. The speakers must draw sound through a single wire. If the single wire does not have a 3.5mm plug, you must get a stepdown adapter (such as stepping down from a 6.35mm which is the same as a 1/4" adapter). A 3.5mm jack is like the ones used for ear buds or smaller headphones (like to an iPod or smart phone) A 6.35mm or 1/4" jack is larger and used on bigger headphones or larger stereo components. Here is a link to such an adapter: Hosa MHE100.5 Right Angle 1/4" to 3.5mm Headphone Adapter/Extension (6 inches) I cannot speak for the gaming buttons at the bottom because I never use them. I don't play games. I am happy they don't do irritating things. Overall, the remote is nice looking and mine came with a wrist strap (not shown here). It is shiny black plastic and continues to look nice over time. It is easy to keep clean. The battery door removes/replaces easily. It takes two AA batteries which last a long time. The remote, except the gaming buttons, is intuitive and really doesn't need detailed instructions. In my opinion, if Roku wants to remain a leader in the streaming industry, they need to make more of the remotes like this one. The newer streaming stick has four dedicated channel buttons at the bottom and they are a frequent source of irritation. I must treat the remote delicately in order to avoid activating them. If you need help using the Roku 3 or the remote, or want more detailed info about this remote, I am posting a link to the easy to read and use online guide. It does include instructions on how to pair the remotes (pairing info is at the end of the pdf): http://wwwimg.roku.com/Roku3-QSG.pdf Love my Rokus.
profile.summary: Best of the Roku remotes (includes pairing info link)

Convection fan in TurboFry oven is more powerful than previous generation turbo oven. You do not need to turn over your food during cooking a whole chicken or a pizza. Traditional deep fryers soak the foods you cook with grease that contains high amounts of saturated fats. This is why the Secura TurboFry Oven is so different. profile.reviewText: I own a previous model of the Secura that lasted two years. Two glorious years. I loved that thing. I list it as one of my top 10 Amazon purchases. Those of you that own one know why. Although I could have replaced my heating element, my Secura 777MH was looking well worn. So, I decided to go with the newer model. Reviews are few at this point and kinda mixed. There are some changes from my older model, most notably the stirring element. ' Includes extender ring, tongs, upper and lower racks, measuring cup, instructions and cookbook. ' Three prong plug on new unit is NOT detachable. Goes into upper motor area. ' New locking lid. Works well. No more looking for a place to put a hot lid. ' Stirring element with side catch. Has tendency to break food and not work properly. ' Lower rack on rollers, seems easy for wheels to get stuck/gummed up. ' Upper rack with hooks. Works well, not always easy to hook. ' New glass bowl has hole in bottom for rotator. Hole is lined with rubber gasket. ' Old model about 12 inches high, 15 inches across. New model about 13 inches high, 19 inches across. ' More difficult to clean due to more parts. Must worry about leakage and gasket breakdown. ' New design is sleek, modern. ' Cannot use parts from old oven on new oven, such as cord and bowl. ' New model has loud wooooshing jet engine type sound. I can hear it 4 rooms from kitchen. ' The light on the new model is no where near as bright as the old model. ' The lid on the new model does not fit snug. There is a decent gap with a lot of play. ' Does it cook any better? Well, yes and no. I must say that they rotation does make things cook better/crisper/more evenly. I still have to turn food over half-way through because they light from the top will burn if I don't. The rotating device for fries sometimes works, sometimes doesn't. I have to fix the fries that get stuck. The side catch wants to turn sideways. Fries will break frequently, especially smaller ones. Tater tots will break into a mush once they start to get done. Note: All my fries and tots have been the frozen, store bought kind. ' Heat. I placed two oven thermometers in the Secura, set it on high for 10 minutes. At the end the max temps were 425 degrees and 429 degrees. The temp never fluctuated much in the last 4 minutes. Both thermometers set near middle on top rack directly under heating elements. 'Customer Service. I have noticed other reviewers commenting on CS at Secura. In the review of my first Secura, I discuss the horrible CS at Secura. Basically, they are rude and totally unhelpful. I knew this before I purchased this unit. I own another Secura product, the Duxtop induction cooker. Honestly, the over and induction cooker are my favorite two kitchen appliances. If either failed, I would not hesitate to order another. Secura CS totally sucks though. ' Overall, I am happy with the new oven for now. I like some of the new changes, some I am not that thrilled about. I am hoping the new oven will grow on me a bit more. I am going to buy the heating element for the old model and use it for the RV. Hope the video gives you a better idea of what the newer model looks like and a little on how it functions differently. Died on April 18th, 2016. I ordered Big Boss Oval Rapid Wave 17.5-Quart and bought the two year protection. This one lasted 2 years, 9 months.
profile.summary: Looks like a Zat from Stargate SG1 (snake gun)

profile.description: Sear, fry, bake, steam or simmer! The perfect size for singles, couples, students and travelers, the 8-inch Electric Skillet from Nesco is ideal for making your favorite dishes. With a deep, Premium Whitford non-stick interior, you can quickly and easily cook a small roast, sear steaks, bake casseroles and more. For convenient serving, select a low setting to serve from your electric skillet, which makes it perfect for using in dorms, offices, RVs/campers and or even at home. Easy to read, adjustable temperature control allows for great results. Unit also features a die cast aluminum pan, sturdy tempered glass lid, heat resistant and stay cool handles. Skillet and lid are dishwasher safe with the probe removed. 1800 watts.
profile.reviewText:
---------------
Updates:
Nov 2017 - Still work great after 6 months. Mom loves them (got her two). Bought me one.  So we have 3 now.
March 2018 - All working great. Non-stick fully intact on all. We use almost daily.
--------------
I needed an electric skillet that is lightweight and easy to manage. This one got the best reviews so it was the one I selected. I have owned many Nesco products over the years and this was a plus.

It arrived in perfect condition. I inspected the interior coating closely under light and there were no flaws, bubbles, damage. The entire coating was smooth to the touch. I cleaned it and oiled it prior to using it.

The problem with many electric skillets is uneven heating. They get hot zones closer to the heating element plug area. As it heated, I used a scanning thermometer to check temps. As expected, the area near the plug heated first but by the time the pan came to expected temps, the temps were fairly even all over the pan. For a smaller pan, I expected this to happen and was pleased.

The egg test: I wiped the interior with vegetable oil them removed the majority with a soft paper towel. On low-med heat, fried eggs cooked exceptionally well. No sticking whatsoever. I was also able to make pan toast easily.

This pan is great for an elderly parent. It isn't too heavy nor too big to clean. Most of the time, it can be wiped clean with a soft paper towel. The glass lid is also easy to manage/clean. In fact, using two of these instead on one heavier unit seems to be the best plan. A countertop oven has also been a great help.

So far, this pan has worked great.
profile.summary: Great for elderly that wish to be independent

profile.description: With the StufZ Ultimate Stuffed Burger Maker you can create the perfect stuffed hamburger. Start with your favorite ground meat whether beef, turkey, chicken or pork and then add your favorite ingredients to make the perfect stuffed burger. A Stufz made burger keeps all of the tasty goodness sealed inside. The even thickness ensures that your stuffed burger is cooked to perfection! Be the envy of your neighbors and fellow tailgaters at the next event!
profile.reviewText:
My sister ordered this from Amazon and totally hated it. She only gave it one try. After some practice, I got this thing to work fairly well but you are stuck making burgers the size of the unit. It is easy to use, sturdy and easy to clean. I am going to take a different approach to reviewing this item and discuss what has helped me make better stuffed burgers.

To make stuffed burgers, pre-cooked burgers MUST be packed very firmly prior to cooking and stuffing must be pre-cooked, free of liquid and cool/cold. Allowing the burger to sit in the freezer for a while (edges starting to freeze but meat not frozen) helps it retain its form but it's not totally necessary. If you are frying in a regular pan, the colder the better. If your stuffing will release a lot of steam/liquid, poke some small holes (smaller than straw hole size) in the meat prior to cooking and start cooking with the hole side down. If using a regular frying pan, make sure the burger is pretty brown on the bottom before flipping. Use a large spatula or two spatulas, one on the bottom and one on the top to help it stay together. Use gentle even pressure when pressing down in a frying pan. Too much pressure will cause the burger to split.

Binding agents for meat, such as oats/egg/both can be used and work really well. They must be thoroughly worked into the meat and the meat needs to be placed back in the fridge/freezer prior to cooking. The burger can be stuffed prior to placing back into fridge/freezer.

Non meat (what we call cereal burgers in the South) material can be used and works fairly well. I have not tried tofu because I feel it will not work.

Now, after some practice and using a George Foreman grill, I can make some pretty awesome stuffed burgers using this device. I can also use other containers and the bottom of a measuring cup to make stuffed burgers of almost any size. Hope this info helps.

One star deducted because instructions on how to produce successful stuffed burgers is lacking.
profile.summary: Making stuffed burgers takes some practice

profile.description: Disgraced former Presidential guard Mike Banning finds himself trapped inside the White House in the wake of a terrorist attack; using his inside knowledge, Banning works with national security to rescue the President from his kidnappers.
profile.reviewText:
For the most part, this movie is worth the rental.

 Plot: Although the plot is predictable, it is in most every type movie like this. It is pretty rare if this type movie alters the game plan. So, the big question is...how well does the movie deliver til the end and this movie does a pretty good job.

 Acting: Well done from all involved. A lot of top rated actors are in this movie. Biggest positive surprise was Melissia Leo who plays the Secetary of Defense, Ruth McMillan. She does an excellect job. Biggest negative surprise was Aaron Eckhard. Although I am an Eckhart fan, I don't think he had enough to do in this movie and overacted his part. Gerard Butler pretty much has the same role in most of his movies.....kick butt and swoon the ladies.

 Writing: They didn't waste a lot of time/money on scripts. However, I didn't expect great writing. I expected to see Butler beat up some bad guys and save the world all by himself. He does.

 Family friendly: This movie is intense. Lots of fighting, gun fights, stabbings, beatings, etc. A few of the gun shot deaths were fairly graphic. The "F" word is used a lot along with a few other cuss words. With that being said, this movie is a lot less offensive than many others I have seen. Nothing sexually explicit. Just fighting and cussing.

 Computer generated imagery: Appropriate for a movie of this calibur. Some of the gunfire special effects were pretty neat. One shot of the White House was obviously a minature model. So, decent special effects.

 Overall: Of the movies I have watched lately, this one is at the top of the list. It is not a thinking man's movie. It's an action packed thriller and on that part, it delivers pretty well. So, 4 stars.
profile.summary: Intense and action packed
