top_5.description: MODEL B,70X70 MW
top_5.reviewText:
Casing is all metal construction. The metal is much heavier duty than the screens I found locally. This applies to all the parts. Important areas, like those for hanging are also heavy duty. Item is about 15 pounds. A string pull is included but I am not using it. The screen itself is white with a black border, possibly black felt. New item smell is potent at first. No part of this item appears cheaply nor poorly constructed. Pulls down and retracts smoothly. There is nothing fancy about this item. Plain white painted metal, no logos, no stickers, no racing strips. Plain and simple. Its not pretty, its just well made. I find that a major selling point in most items.

Installation was fairly easy. I needed a drill, extra sturdy screw hooks (like for hanging plants from the ceiling, they look like a big 'question mark'), and a step ladder. I was able to hang this myself in a few minutes. Item is also easily taken down and put back up, especially if the loops are used for hanging.

 When you install this, make sure it is level. If not, you will probably regret it.

Projecting on a wall is ok but a screen makes a huge difference in picture quality.
Da-Lite has exceeded all my expectations. It is a high quality item at an unbelievably low price. Full 5 stars all the way around.

Update 8/18/13

This product has held up very well. No issues. One thing I have found out about screens is that it is mostly the width that matters, not the height. I have never had a movie fill up the screen from top to bottom but I often have movies go from edge to edge.

I will probably purchase a second screen for upstairs because moving the screen, although not too difficult, is not something I prefer to do. Basically, you just lift it off the hooks and move it, reset it on other hooks in new room. Make sure it is level.
top_5.summary: I am so happy I bought this

top_5.description: Quick Shipping !!! New And Sealed !!! This Disc WILL NOT play on standard US DVD player. A multi-region PAL/NTSC DVD player is request to view it in USA/Canada. Please Review Description.
top_5.reviewText:
After reading the varying reviews on this movie, I wasn't sure what to expect.

First, the review that states there is only about 10 minutes of total dialogue in the movie is inaccurate. The characters converse throughout the movie, except for the main character, who remains silent throuhout the entire movie. The script is not heavy nor complex and there are some periods of silence. However, the script and type of movie does not allow for understanding the background of everything that is happening nor the characters. You just kinda have to use your imagination. I don't feel this detracts from the movie much.

The main character has no name but he is given a nickname, OneEye. The movies details part of his life. We are told little about him. He is mean, he can fight and he is ruthless. Apparently he is known and people consider him evil. He also has another side but that would be too much of a spoiler.

There is a boy. His background is also not well explained. His association with OneEye is one of circumstance.

There are three groups of men. Two unfriendly, one so-so friendly. The story seems to revovle around OneEye's experiences with these three groups.

Honestly, I don't know how to explain this movie any better without it being a complete spoiler because this movie is very basic in its presentation of the story.

This is a movie with a moderate amount of intense violence. When OneEye kills someone, it is often gory. So, if that type of stiff bothers you, this may not be the movie for you.

Although I found things confusing and slow at times, I am glad I watched it til the end. Overall, I enjoyed it and the ending made me rethink my impression of OneEye. When I understood 'why he did what he did' I liked him a lot better.

Three stars for this odd movie is a good rating from me.
top_5.summary: Interesting movie (Contains no spoilers)

input: Generate the review text written by a reviewer who has a given an overall rating of "5.0" for a product with description "Rebekah Jones is first and foremost a follower of the Living God. She started writing as a little girl, seeking to glorify her King with her books and stories. Besides writing, she is an avid reader, songwriter, pianist, singer, artist, and history student. She also loves children. She lives with her family in the Southwestern desert.". The summary of the review text is "I couldn't imagine creating a book that was a retelling of the classic".
output:
I am a diehard Jane Austen fan. So I will always get my hands on a retelling of Pride and Prejudice. This was probably one of the best ones done. It has a Mr. Darcy (though I am more smitten with this one), Sidney. Eloise is our Lady Elizabeth and though this is the retelling it felt fresh and well plotted out in this author's own work.

I couldn't imagine creating a book that was a retelling of the classic, but Rebekah Jones took to the task and delivered a beautiful 1930's story of farm life in Arizona. I need to read the rest of the series, as I am hoping it is as delightful as this book!

I was given a copy of this book. I didn't have to read it but you know it is an Austen makeover, so I felt called as a fan to read it. I liked it but wasn't asked to like it, so I share my personal thoughts above.

profile.description: My 5 yr old daughter has developmental delays and was given this charming book as a gift. While the main character in the book is in a wheelchair, no mention is made of her disability and she is shown to be just as hardworking and independent as anyone else. Marie is a very empowering example for my daughter and the story teaches a valuable lesson that is helpful to all children. Amazon Customer Thanks to an engaging story, complemented by delightful illustrations, young readers will be so busy turning pages they won't even realize they're taking in some of life's most valuable truths. All sorts of important ideas pop up while Marie and her friends play and work in the forest: the power of choice, the treasure of friendship, the capabilities of "disabled" children, what kindness looks like. . . . Children, parents, and teachers will be glad to find that "Marie and Mr. Bee" confirms again the power of great story-telling to open up our world, teach us, and help us grow. KAB Loved this book. I would recommend this book to anyone. . . . The pictures are very vibrant and realistic and the storyline is written so that even young children can understand it. Amazon Customer Aimed at the 4 to 8 year old child, this is an excellent mix of picture book and storytelling to keep both children and parents reading it over and over again. Presentation is important, and especially so for this age group. Coralie Rycroft's illustrations and Margaret's narrative complement each other exactly. There is plenty happening on each page, yet the book has an open and airy feel to it-clean but not cluttered. In addition, Margaret has achieved a balance between entertainment and learning-the story in itself is a gentle tale about a wheelchair bound little girl who lives in a cabin in the woods. Her days are changed for the worse when a not-so-busy bee enters her world. But she realises she cannot behave like the bee as her friendships and home life take a turn for the worse. The learnings come in the form of positive attitudes towards work, the importance of friendships, and honesty and integrity. Values matter, but children's values matter most of all. It's never too early to develop positive values which form a strong foundation for later life. And of course, this book has a very tasty surprise ending both children and parents will enjoy doing together! James Minter The way the story unfolds is perfect for children about age ten and under. I love that the main character has a handicap, but doesn't allow it to get in her way. Lisa M. Prysock The illustrations in the book are vibrant and portray a little girl and her friends beautifully. My grandchildren, ages three and four, enjoyed the adorable characters. Michelle My eleven year old loved how Marie was in a wheelchair and related it to doing life with her seizures. Tammy
profile.reviewText:
Marie is content with her days, working doing chores then spending time playing with her friends. Until one day a new "friend" shows up and exclaims that Marie works too hard. Marie agrees! And soon the lesson begins. Each friend of Marie's have their own schedules and tasks to complete before play and soon Marie decides she was happier with having chores to do before play. She missed her friends, and her contentment. She soon comes across this new "friend" and the learning begins. Can she help Mr. Bee
Great pictures, story line is amazing and the lesson is teachable by parents and educators. I highly recommend reading and sharing this book with families and friends alike. We can use a reminded of the lessons in this book.
*I was provided a digital copy of this book in return for a fair and honest review.
profile.summary: A lesson worth reading

profile.description: Chautona Havig lives and writes in California's Mojave Desert with her husband and six of her nine children. When not writing or reading, she enjoys paper crafting, sewing, and looking forward to retirement as a homeschool teacher.
profile.reviewText:
Madeline is the girl I want my daughter to be. Curious, observant, and kind Madeline makes her way out of the social class she was born into and explores those around her. Showing her strength as a friend and character through out this book. I also loved her interactions with the elders in her life, for the time period she was certainly unique. A super sleuth like Nancy Drew, Madeline has a way of being the mascot for Curiosity Kills the Cat only, spoiler alert she lives. But she is just as charming as Nancy Drew, and is now my favorite sleuth. Chautonas style of writing become different in this book, I felt as though she was taking the time period she based the book in, and immersed herself into the style and language of the time. It is wonderful! Even if you haven't read any of Chautonas books before (trust me you are in NEED of reading them) this book will be a great starter into her world and you will quickly want to meet all her charming characters and stories.

I loved the twists and turns in this book, it compares to some of my favorite cozy mysteries. Madeline is a character that I cant wait to meet more of, she is certainly making this reader excited at the idea of more adventures. I cant wait  to see Madeline in her next adventure. Until then, I will be swooning my way through Chautonas other books.

**I was provided a copy of this book to review. I voluntarily chose to provide the review and these thoughts are my own.
profile.summary: I can't wait for the next one!

profile.description: Terri Wangard grew up in Green Bay, Wisconsin, during the Lombardi Glory Years. Her first Girl Scout badge was the Writer. These days she writes historical fiction, and won the American Christian Fiction Writers (ACFW) Woodlands Chapter 2013 Writers on the Storm (WOTS) contest and the ACFW 2013 First Impressions contest, as well as being an ACFW 2012 Genesis finalist. Holder of a bachelors degree in history and a masters degree in library science, her research included going for a ride in a WWII B-17 Flying Fortress bomber. Classic Boating Magazine, a family business since 1984, keeps her busy as an associate editor. Connect with Terri: www.terriwangard.com Facebook: www.facebook.com/AuthorTerriWangard Pinterest: www.pinterest.com/terriwangard/
profile.reviewText:
This book held such emotion for me. The time period is one of my favorites in history and to read it in a different author's perspective helped to connect me further to the book. Terri, writes wonderfully, the Lord surely knew what he was doing when he commanded this skill from her, she spins a tale of such beauty that a reader feels connected to the characters and are right there in the scenes with them. If you are looking for a book to read and not think about ever again this is NOT your book. If you are wanting a book that makes you need/want more, or a book that makes you enjoy thinking of what is next, this is the RIGHT book for you!

I was provided this book for a fair and honest review.
profile.summary: If you love reading this is the RIGHT book for you.

profile.description: Debby Mayne is the author of more than 60 novels and novellas. She writes family and faith-based romances, cozy mysteries, and women's fiction. She has also written more than 1,000 short stories and articles as well as dozens of devotions for busy women. She is currently an etiquette writer for The Spruce, one of the DotDash (formerly About.com) companies. Her parents were both from the Deep South, so Debby enjoys featuring characters with Southern drawls, quirky mannerisms, and a deep appreciation for down-home cooking. She and her husband currently live in the Charleston, South Carolina, area.
profile.reviewText:
Families are all unique, but I think the Bucklin family takes the cake. I really loved all the different characters and the way the chapters were from different character perspectives. I am not from the South but I felt like I was while reading this book, sweet tea and mason jars spoke to my soul, meeting this family will surely be a highlight in your reading year. So come settle in on the porch swing and meet the family. Each character will make you feel right at home, you will laugh with them and feel with them when it isn't sunny. Each moment made me feel closer to them and also to my own family. I think we all can say we have a Puddin' and Shay, maybe a Missy or Digger.
I really think any reader will find a reason to love this story, and will be ready for the next book!
I was provided a copy of this book by the publisher. I voluntarily chose to read and review the book. This is strictly my personal opinion.
profile.summary: What a neat read!

profile.description: used
profile.reviewText:
I got this pink one for my daughter and a blue on for my son.  The blue one is still working - thankfully - the pink one died two weeks after Christmas.  I thought these would be good tablets for the kids - inexpensive and functional.  I am an Android person so the OS worked out fine - when it was working it was really great - camera - youtube, Play Store - apps - games - all the goodness of Android.  However, it just died and would not power up or charge after two weeks of light use.  So we returned it for a refund.  My son however still has his and it works fine....for now.
Battery life is not very good -
Also, people comparing this to the apple line of products should be smacked in the head - this is not a $500 device so why compare it to one?  If apple has a $75 device then compare it to that ..... good luck finding one too.
profile.summary: Died after two weeks - wouldn't turn on or charge

profile.description: This Motorola DROID RAZR MAXX HD MOTXT926M mobile phone features 4G LTE speed and an Android 4.1 Jelly Bean operating system for fast Web browsing. DuPont KEVLAR fiber and Corning Gorilla Glass ensure strength and durability.
profile.reviewText:
I paid $699 for this phone - right out from Amazon Wireless - to keep my Unlimited data plan through Verizon.  This is the fourth Droid that I have owned.  I will not go to the other side with the sheep. NEVER!  However, this phone has one major flaw that, in this day and age, should never be an issue and also some minor flaws. So, I will point out the good first then the bad...

GOOD:
Construction - Kevlar, nano coating, Gorilla glass, etc....
1 GB RAM but I wish it had 2GB
Dual Core Processor - ?? - see bad as well
DLNA
NFC
4G LTE
HD Screen with good size 4.7"
HDMI out
Universal USB for charging and connecting to a PC (Drive)
SD Card
BATTERY - outstanding 3300Mhp - who cares if it isn't removable
9mm thin
LED notification light is nice & big and RGB multicolored!
Great radios - reception
Great speaker - speakerphone - sound etc

BAD:
1)Camera - I have tried third party apps and was hoping Jellybean would fix - it is just a terrible camera.  8MP is fine but every time I take a picture is is yellow, blurry, off hue in average lighting situations.  Outside it is better but then there is another problem - it gets darker or lighter back and forth until the moment is then gone.  I just can't understand this.  My Thunderbolt which I still have takes great pictures and that phone is not a great phone at all specs wise compared to the Razr - why is this?  Focus sometimes take minutes to adjust - even if you tap the screen.  The color - yellowish is just bad in all pictures.  Those of you out there will say it's a phone not a camera - well hello, I take photos all the time of my kids and my DSLR is not with me as much as my phone is you know.  It is just shameful and should be one of the finer aspects of a phone these days. Outside shots with plenty of light are not bad but not great either.  Indoors are terrible and dim light just not good at all. Others will say it isn't that bad of a camera but it is - I want this to be good but it just is NOT.

2)Lag at home screen - For a phone with a dual core processor the home screen lags and takes time to populate the screen.  The rings which I love will take time to appear some times.  Sliding from screen to screen there is a slight stutter.  Others have said it is an app causing this but the same apps were on my other Droids so why is it affecting the Razr and not the older ones with less power? I have hard reset the phone but it still remains.

3) APPS TO SD ----- NOT!
OK, this phone has 32GB internal but I still don't want to store my apps on it!  I can't believe I can't save apps to SD on this phone.  I have a 32GB SD card on board and all it stores are photos and video - nothing else. I have ZDBOX and I always get prompted to move an app to SD but it can't be done on the Razr.  If I knew this beforehand I may not have purchased this phone and I am surprised everyone is OK with this.

Final Thoughts:
I still have my upgrade with Verizon and when something else comes out I might sell this on EBay.  I am upset because I love the way this phone looks and feels - I just wish the camera and speed were up to par. There are many good Android things that this phone can do.  Also, with moderate use I can go three days before I have to recharge - that is outstanding and one of the reasons I did buy the phone.  I heard the camera was bad and I thought I could deal with it but I can't.
profile.summary: RAZR MAXX HD - Battery Good Camera BAD

profile.description: Enhance your entertainment area with this 670W home theater system that features multiple surround sound decoders and 11 soundfields for cinematic audio. The Audyssey dynamic volume control allows for optimal listening levels and dynamic range.
profile.reviewText:
I will try to make this quick.  First, about this seller, the items were packaged very securely and shipped and arrived in three days - stellar free shipping!  Thank you Cameta.  What a great deal - all of these quality items for this price.  Also, just to note, this package came with a 32GB class 10 memory card not class 6 - outstanding!

My whole life I have had point and shoot cameras - most of them Sony.  Now, married with kids, still have a point and shoot Sony but now have the A55 too!  Why pull the trigger?  You know when you are taking that shot and everything looks great, you press the button, three seconds go by and then the picture takes.....but the kids are now looking everywhere but where the camera is?  Yeah, the A55 just snaps away taking amazing quality pictures.  I am sure there are Canons and Nikons that are just awesome.  I wanted the Sony and I am happy to have it.  Just so you know, it really isn't that hard to work the camera even as a novice like myself.  There are plenty of 'AUTO' options/settings and the camera will take care of the rest after you snap the shot. However there is also the ability to learn what it is like to take professional photos and become the photographer you never knew you could be.  I tell my wife this is probably the last camera we will ever buy.  I looked at the A77 but couldn't justify $1300 for just the camera body.  I think the A55 is more for the consumer and the A77 for the professional.

With the A55 and this package you will have pretty much everything you need to get started.  The camera is fast, has tons of options like GPS, different shutter speeds and all of the familiar point and shoot filters like B&W, sepia, etc.  There is panoramic and 3D options as well as full HD video.  The built-in flash has different settings and there is the familiar timer setting and steady shot, etc.  If you have owned a Sony camera in the past you will identify the icons on the LCD screen and then just learn the new visuals that you see.  I would also recommend an 'A55 for dummies' book.  There are a few here on Amazon that are very insightful and great for beginners like myself. The camera is light yet smaller than I expected and can cramp one hand held operation.  The strap fits nicely and I ordered a hand strap.  The LCD swivels and is bright as well as the electronic viewer which, when you are up close to it the LCD auto shuts off - neat.  I really have so many good things to say but wanted to let anyone who is considering buying this package what to expect.  If you are even considering it then you already know that A55 is a great camera.

Your family will love the photos you take and you will love what you can do with this amazing camera.
Best of luck to you,
BOGY
profile.summary: My first DSLR  - The Sony A55

profile.reviewText:
I have the Acer C720P which already has 32 GB of SSD storage.  I purchased this USB 2.0 drive to add 32 GB of more storage.  When you look at the total amount you will only get 28GB of storage out of this drive - not sure what the other 4 GB are being used for.  The design is nice - very small and compact.  When inserted you won't even know it is there which is just fine.  I like the all metal design - no plastic and no read indicator light. Has a loop for a lanyard
No indicator LED/light
32GB but you will only get 28GB
Price not terrible
Can be used with zRam to help with speed

CONS
Some may find it is hard to remove once seated
USB 2.0 ... wish it was 3.0 then it would be 5 stars

profile.description: G-Shock Men's GR9110BW-1D Black/Digital Resin Watch
profile.reviewText:
I got this watch for fishing,  I only wish it had the temperature but I have other Casio's with that function.  The watch itself is comfortable, light and not as big as the others that I have.  It fits just right so when you can cast your rod you won't even know it is there.  My main reasons for buying this watch - rugged and can take abuse, tide chart, moon phase, solar powered & look and style.  For that it is perfect.  Also, other Casios that I have pinch and pull the hairs on my wrist - occasionally - this watch does not do this.

My only complaint is it is somewhat hard to read outside - indoors and in the dark (with light) it is easy to see and read.  The glow is light green/blue.

Size
Price
Moon and Tide chart
Rugged - strong
Solar powered
Comfortable on wrist

CONS:
Somewhat hard to read dial outside
No temperature sensor

profile.description: As seen on TV. Safe & humane. Stop annoying barking! Portable. Inaudible to humans. Includes wall mount. Uses 9 volt battery (not included). Works up to 20 feet away! Bark activated. Is barking driving you crazy? Now you can reduce your dog's (or your neighbor's dog's) barking safely and humanely with this revolutionary training aid. Simply place Bark Off in the area where your dog usually barks and turn it on. Bark Off is automatically activated when your dog barks. It emits a safe, high-pitched sound that only your dog can hear and safely trains your dog to stop barking. Your pet will learn to be quiet without painful shock collars. Bark Off has a 20 foot range, has 2 sensitivity levels and comes complete with wall mount. Works on one 9 volt battery (not included). Take your Bark Off home today and start living a more peaceful life. Power on/off. Sensitivity adjustment high/low. Safe. Effective. Humane. Made in China.
profile.reviewText:
I did not purchase this item through Amazon and I wish I had looked here first.  I went online and checked out the reviews which were mainly positive.  So, I trusted this and ordered the item online through the barkoff website.  Big mistake.

Ordering Process:
When you order it says $10 + $6.99 shipping for two units.  Well, then after you enter your information you proceed to the next screen which you are asked if you want to upgrade the units to the Premier Barkoff which has greater range and a DC plug so you won't need a battery.  Say yes or no then you go to another screen which is trying to sell you something else, and then another and another - this carries on and is annoying.  They try to sell you everything!  Finaly, when the order is processed you recieve an email confirmation.

Shipping:
My units arrived within two weeks after ordering and I was sent an email with a tracking number however the number given never provided tracking results.  One day I came home and the small box was in the mail - it arrived!  Quick shipping though.

Customer Service:
Good luck on this one.  My units arrived but it didn't have the DC adapter which I really want for outside.  I emailed twice and have not revieved a reply.  I can't imagine returning these things - who would you contact?  What would the charge/restock fee be?  Once you order you are forgoten.

Use:
I have three West Highland Terriers (Westies) and one barks like crazy at anything.  I used these units in the house and outside and they have not worked at all.  I think he barks even more when the barkoff unit is on.  I am upset becuase I wanted these at the $9.99 + $6.99 price but fell for the Premier thing so I upgraded for $19.99.  So, my order total was $36.97 total for two barkoffs that don't work and no DC adapter - I got screwed basically.

UPDATE: 08/13.2010
So I went to the barkoff website and they pleasantly say you can return your item just by sedning it to this address in Caldwell NJ.  Well I did and guess what?  USPS is trying to deliver it and they won't accept it so it is coming back.  Tracking through USPS: 9102 1501 3471 1289 0650 52
Frigg'n joke
profile.summary: BEWARE - buy at own risk

profile.description: Enthusiasts looking for the optimal in price performance PSU technology will find the Corsair TX series of PSUs will meet even the most demanding of required specifications. The Corsair TX850W power supplies are engineered using advanced technology and components typically found with high performance power supplies. With design features such as a dedicated, single +12V rail, the TX series offers the maximum compatibility with the latest system components. Energy efficient circuitry capable of delivering greater than 80% efficiency ratings across 20%, 50%, and 100% load conditions make the TX family of PSUs ideal for the value/quality conscious enthusiast. With a large 140mm on TX850W diameter temperature-controlled fan that is ultra quiet, yet still more than sufficient to cool the internals of the system, reliability and stability are no longer worries for the gamer, overclocker or enthusiast and high-end system builder. Each Corsair TX power supply is backed with an industry-leading 5-year warranty and 24/7 on-demand customer service.
profile.reviewText:
With another child on the way I had to move from a room that I was using as an office to the living room downstairs.  After the move my gaming PC would just shut down without warning after starting up.  I pulled the memory sticks one by one, checked the temp, cleaned out the dust, pulled the USB 2.0 bridge, checked with multiple power outlets - nothing worked.  My friend said it's either the CPU, the motherboard or the power supply.  So, in a desperate move I went to Best Buy and got this 850W power supply to replace my 500W no name brand APEX AL-B500E power supply.  I wish it wasn't an emergency because it cost about $20 more at the store than here on Amazon.  However, it solved my problem.  I was afraid it was the processor or mobo but now that I have changed the power supply the PC is running and running great.
First off the unit comes in a nice felt bag with band ties and screws.  Having an all black case this power supply is black and the many (and I say many!) wires that protrude from the box are lined in a nice black mesh.  Installation to the mount took about 3 minutes with 4 screws - done!  There is a very thick power cord that comes with this which is what I want to see having this much power running through it.  Compared to the 500W that I had before the power cords are like night and day - dental floss and rope!  Now, the connections - it took me some time and this unit has more power connections than I could ever want.  In fact I band tied a few and tried to tuck them away as they were not even being used.  The options are endless.  Having a new 24 pin connector on my mother board I was able to connect with ease however if you have a 20 pin you can use this as it is compatible.  Also, there is an 8 pin which can be 4 pin if needed depending on how old or new your board is.  There are a ton of SATA, IDE, 4 pins, and PCIE connectors.  I was able to connect two dvd players, a floppy drive (old school I know), ATI video card, case fans galore,  ALL with their own power plug in AND I had some wires left over to band up and tuck away in the case.  I will admit cable management in any case is not easy but the main thing here is the power supply is working and working great!  I have 850W of power that I will never really need but HAVE!  There is a 5 year warranty and a predicted 100,000 hour run time.  One last note, the 500W power supply that I had was equipped with an 80mm fan. The Corsair 850 has an 120mm fan.  Well that 120mm fan is quite as hell!  The old unit I had was louder!  I am glad such a large fan is there to cool the insides.
Overall I am very please with this unit.  It has been running three days now and i will update this post if I have any future problems.  Go buy one!!!!!!!
profile.summary: Solved my PC random shut down problem and is 850W baby!

Designed to fit laptop screens up to 16", this backpack features a padded laptop compartment front organizational pockets with key clip, pen loops, mobile phone pocket, headphone port and multiple document and accessory storage areas. Inside, the case features a dedicated iPad pocket with soft, scratch-resistant lining for protection against scratches, dust, and water. profile.reviewText:
If you are like me you travel everyday on a train or bus.  Take a look at everone else on the train or bus and see what type of bag they have.  Well this Miami Messenger bag will blow theirs away!  In the looks department it is just the right amount of black and grey with yellow lettering here and there.  Some have said the yellow is tacky - not so, I wish there was more in some areas.  Whether it is sitting on the floor or hung on your shoulder it just looks stylish.  Functionality has been supurb.  I have a 17 inch Acer laptop that fits perfectly as well as the power supply and cord.  I also have some CD's, cables, pens, business cards and paperwork all stored neatly and the case is still SLIM!  It is how the pockets are arranged that make them effective.  Also, there is a convienient water bottle holder on the side which can be zipped up and hidden if not in use.  I love this becuase my old bag didn't have this and the water bottle kept falling out - not any more!  Inside there is lots of padding.  This is my one complaint:  On the bottom of this bag there are NO stoppers or rubber feet.  The padding is there to help protect whatever is inside but it would be nice if it had small rubber feet on the bottom.  But this is a messenger bag and they do not have feet typically.  The shoulder strap is just right and adjustable.  The bag feels very nice and light weight as well as ballanced.  Overall this is a steal at $36 shipped!

PROS:
Light weight
Stylish
Conmfortable
Holds a 17" Laptop & accessories
Price great
Internal padding

CONS:
No rubber feet/bottom

One quick note: The bag never came with the Removable Mobile Phone Pouch but I probably wouldn't use it anyway as I have a carry case for that like we all do.  Also, one of the pictures above shows pen holders and memory pockets which is not on this bag however it does have pen holders and memory pouches.  They are just a bit different than the picture above.
GREAT BAG!

profile.description: A high quality, midweight and highly water resistant cover. The perfect travel cover whether you want to cover your bike at work or a cross country trip. This cover folds small and light yet gives big time protection against the elements. Our best selling model, we have sold tens of thousands of these around the globe and they really get the job done. Constructed of water repellant yet breatheble "Weatherguard" Polyester. Double top stitched for durability. Lower panel is heat resistant "Thermoguard". Clamshell vents prevent condensation and lofting. A chamois panel is stitched in where cover would touch windscreen and fuel tank areas to prevent scratches. Reinforced Poly grommets are at center and at front wheel area for security and a snug fit and will accept a cable lock. We are riders too and beleive this is the best lightweight cover on the market!! 2 year warranty.
profile.reviewText: The cover fits my 1995 Ninja ZX7 (750) perfectly.  I like how it is designed with mirror sockets as well as muffler space and there are two vents on the sides - very clever design.  The material is thin compared to the $250 cover that I bought years ago but that one has fallen apart now and this new replacement - though thin - seems stronger - nylon material which should last.  The bottom silver portion is stronger material and has the ability to use a security lock and wire.  Included are bungee cords with hooks so the cover wraps around the under carriage nicely. Hey, for $25 this is perfect!  I keep my bike indoors so this cover should last forever!
profile.summary: Great cover for my 1995 Ninja ZX7

profile.description: The Under Armour ColdGear Running Gloves technology offers double-knit ColdGear fabric which is designed to retain warmth and increase comfort. The form-fitting construction maximizes breathability and athletic dexterity while the Signature Moisture Transport System wicks your sweat away from your hands. The Under Armour ColdGear Running Gloves are weather resistant and works well in any conditions.
profile.reviewText:
Opinion:
Gloves are tight!  I have small hands and ordered the LG/XLG and they are tight!
These are tight fitting gloves which can be used under other gloves.  The index finger and middle finger stay warm - the other two fingers get cold as well as back side of hand.  Probably because of the fleece on the thumb and index finger.  It is nice having the nose wipe though.  The reflective logo is nice but the two stripes on the pinky finger really don't need to be there.  The grip is solid with the sticky feel.  These are labeled as a running gloves - wind does cut through it.

Summary:
FIT - tight fitted - Not bulky at all - slim - they can be rolled up into a ball and put in pants pocket
Warmth - medium to low - about 25 degree weather and will keep only a couple of fingers warm.  Wind and water passes through glove
Price - way to high for these gloves
Comfort - Tight and there is an annoying tag inside the left hand glove that you WILL cut off - it is about two inches long stitched inside the glove
GRIP - excellent - sticky palms not too sticky but enough to provide solid hold - can also be used for shooting not problem
profile.summary: FULL REVIEW - Under Armour Cold Gear Gloves

profile.description: NDZ Performance, Combo Kit (2 tools as listed) Delrin slide lock tool (LONG), tear down tool and our SHORT tool as well, you get both!! Long tool allows you to lock your slide rearward, SNAP this in place like shown for super easy (no pressure) slide lock lever removal. Made of Delrin, so no scuffing or wearing your expensive firearm finish. A must have item for any Kimber owner. "These fit only the 3" Ultra II Kimbers" NOTE: (Tool differences (short vs long)) - Currently we offer 2 tools for the Kimber 3" bushingless barrel pistols. A short tool that has a step and a longer 1" tool. Basically the short tool directly replaces your factory tool and will allow you to break down the recoil spring easier, and the long tool allows you to remove the slide stop lever with ease. To us they both have a place with the Kimber Ultra II series, the reason we are producing both tools. The long tool allows for an easy breakdown, however the spring is under more pressure if your looking to clean the recoil springs, if so then you would use the short tool, however lining up the half moon is done manually.
profile.reviewText:
I got this off EBay for my Kimber Ultra CDP II .45.  After having the person in the store show me how to do a take down of this gun and see him scruff the black coated metal with the take down tool that comes with the gun I was determined to find a better solution.  THIS IS IT.  You will struggle with field stripping the gun with the stock metal take down tool.  It scratched the black finish as well as the front of the gun just below the barrel opening.  Even with the stock take down tool inserted I struggled to get the slide lock pin out and when I did I dropped it and it too scuffed the black metal.

So, I sold the gun on Gunbroker for a FEW hundred dollars less than what I paid for it.  I then purchased another NEW non-scuffed Kimber as well as this plastic tool.  It seriously is the best purchase I have made for this gun.  With the slide locked just snap this plastic tool on then release the slide.  The slide lock will align perfectly to be removed - no fuss - no slide adjusting - no hassle!  Re-insert the slide lock pin, remove the plastic take down tool and then rack it - it is that easy.

Kimber - why do you not have such a tool that comes with this $1300 gun???

The only issue I have with the take down tool is the price - $20 for a small piece of plastic?  Really?  Well, if it protects my Kimber and makes it easy to take down I am sold.
profile.summary: Take down is now SIMPLE with this tool - Kimber Ultra CDP II .45

profile.description: The MicroStream is a compact single AAA alkaline battery powered LED pen light flashlight designed for use in all markets. It features a push button tail cap switch, momentary or constant on operation, a combination pocket/hat clip for convenience, and amazing brightness and run time for a light of its size and price. The aluminum housing with Type II Military Spec anodizing helps make the light extremely durable and abrasion resistant. Utilizing the latest C4 LED technology, this ultra compact and lightweight flashlight is optimized for output and run time.
profile.reviewText:
This light is small yet just the right size for your hand.  The entire light is black metal which is sealed water tight.  Big bonus is the light uses one AAA battery so there will always be a battery to use and always availability at the local store.  This thing is bright too!  At night you can see very clearly as it has a strong WHITE light - not yellowish.  Also, it shines far - at about 100 feet away you can shine the light into the trees at night and see the leaves.  This light comes with a lanyard that hooks to the pen like pin on the light so you can hang it around your neck.  I wore this when I went fishing and this light was a blessing to have.  Also the on/off button works two ways.  You can depress the button and use the light quickly or spot checking OR you can depress the button all the way until you hear a 'click' and use the light continuously. Overall price is perfect too.

Summary:
Can't go wrong here as you get an LED light that functions as well as it looks for a decent price.
profile.summary: The perfect light for any situation

profile.reviewText:
Great little pouch.  I use it in the glove box of my Jeep.  I would not put this on my belt as it would be really obvious what was on my hip.  It is small but not that small to have on your hip and go unnoticed.  It fits all of my gun including the Sig P229 Elite Dark 9MM which is a big gun.  My PX4 Storm 9MM and PK380 fit fin as well.  However, this pouch is for my Kimber Ultra CDP II .45 and I put two extra mags in the zippered pouch as well as my Pelican 1920 flashlight.  Fits them all perfectly.  The Velcro mag holder is tight on the single stack mags for the .45 so I couldn't imaging the double stack mags fitting easily.  The universal holster is nice and keep the firearm in place.  I just hope it doesn't tarnish the finish.  Inside the pouch is Velcro and nylon  nothing much else.  The quick zipper tongue is useless unless it is on your belt and even then it is not easily opened.

PROS:
Compact
Has a zippered pocket
Lockable zippers
Universal holster included
MOLLE or belt attachment
Fits most guns  sun compact/compact/full

CONS:
Magazine holder is small  single stack mags only
Not so soft interior
Quick open zipper tongue works only on your belt
Price a bit high  should be in the $20/$25 range
profile.summary: Kimber Ultra CDP II .45

profile.description: The Air light II series is a versatile line of liner-lock folders this one is .12 inche. It has a 30% serrated blade for the heaviest cutting challenge. Aluminum scales in black give the Air light II a classic, understated look that's appropriate whether the knife is clipped on jeans or tuxedo pant. They have Beretta's Sure Grip finish that assures your grasp in any conditio.
profile.reviewText:
Very nice knife - very sharp out of the box.  I love the look with the serrated blade and the open holes - this knife is very light in weight.  The only problem I have is this is made in Japan and not the USA or even Italy even though it is a Beretta knife.  :(
It's a bit stiff to open but with a good flick you will get it. Construction seems solid with hex screws holding it together.  I can't determine what the black sides are made of - seems like tough plastic.  Locking mechanism is solid and easy to unlock.
Price should be a lot cheaper - in the $20 to $30 range.

I think this knife being sold here is fake - also it is $72 when there is another listing for $59 here on Amazon.  That one has good reviews and they all say the knife is made in Italy.  So, this one here that comes with a Seki Japan blade is fake - too late to return it as I just figured this out some time after I have ordered it -
profile.summary: Great looking knife from Japan

profile.description: ACDelco GM Original Equipment HVAC Control Panels, or control heads, translate the users commands into mechanical, vacuum, or electrical signals to operate the blower fan and the blend, mode, and recirculation doors. Some systems with automatic functions have an integrated or remotely mounted computer module that monitors the control head inputs and the cabin and duct temperatures to adjust the blower speed and door positions to maintain the desired cabin temperature. This original equipment control panel is a GM-recommended replacement for your vehicles original components and has been manufactured to fit your GM vehicle, providing the same performance, durability, and service life you expect from General Motors.
profile.reviewText:
The hot/cold knob went out on my 2010 Hummer H3.  While the unit still functioned properly I could not live with a light being out.  OCD
I looked up online how to change the bulbs on these things and really don't have the time these days.  So I ordered through Amazon and I have to say it is working flawlessly  so far.  This item came in the ACDELCO box and was not open box  it was new.  Hopefully it will outlast the last one.
It will take you anywhere from 5 to 10 minutes to replace.
FIRST, insert the key then turn but don't start and pull the shifter lever all the way back.  Now, disconnect the negative battery terminal.  Put on some latex gloves if you wish. Open the two car charger covers just below the HVAC unit, stick your fingers in and pull out and up.  Once dislodged pop out the upper portion but do so with care so you don't break anything.  There are three wires/connectors leading to the back of the  HVAC unit  disconnect them.  Now remove the 4 screws holding the HVAC unit in place  use a small ratchet if you have one.  Save the screws, remove the old unit, replace the new unit, screw in, connect the wires and then push the assembly back into place with care.  Now reconnect the negative battery terminal, turn the key and place shifter into the park position.  Start the vehicle and test  it may blink a few times.  Lastly, reprogram the clock if you have the stock radio 
Done!
profile.summary: 2010 Hummer H3 Replacement

profile.description: Comfort is valued at a premium while paddling. Stop being uncomfortable while paddling with the YakGear Sand Dollar Seat Cushion. The 14-inch wide and 11-inch deep seat cushion offers an additional 1-inch thick EVA foam cushion to any kayak or canoe seat. It also has a non-skid bottom. For a complete seat, please see the YakGear Manta Ray Seat or the YakGear Sting Ray Seat.
profile.reviewText: I have the SunDolphin Journey 10ft Fishing Kayak.  It didn't come with a bottom seat pad - which is ridiculous.  I took a chance with this Sand Dollar pad.  It fits just right in my Kayak.  The padding is thick about one inch.  However what flaws this pad is the grey area in the center.  It is surrounded by a channel/gap that is about 3/4 of an inch wide.  I am not sure why it was made like this but that channel just pinches your bottom and in some areas it doesn't feel right.  If this was smooth - a one piece pad it would be 5 stars - excellent.  I am keeping it because of the return policy - would cost me more to return.  Other notes - The bottom is non skid - so it won't slide around on you. If you have a big butt this pad might be better - for people with a small butt this will be either hit or miss.
profile.summary: Decent for the price

profile.description: Unstructured technology takes this leather lace-up shoe to a new level of comfort. Ultra soft premium leather in brown, a padded collar and removable footbed, plus the innovative Air Circulation System of climate control combine to keep feet feeling fresh and comfortable all day
profile.reviewText:
This is a good shoe for the office if you are a tech or worker - not an executive.  You will not be wearing these shoes to your friend's wedding.  They are good looking and rugged but not very elegant and sophisticated for dress.

Comfort:
No break-in - these shoes are comfortable - and breathable with vents and breathable technology.  The sole is soft and the leather is soft as well.  Support on the arch is felt.  They run big - this is a somewhat wide looking shoe.  I usually wear size 8.5 which I ordered but then exchanged for the size 8.  Even the 8 is a bit roomy but I am keeping them regardless.

Material:
Nice soft leather and good stitching - the leather is also pre-rubbed by hand at the factory to enhance luster and durability - it is also recommended that you treat the leather occasionally.  WARNING - These are vented to in the RAIN you will get wet feet.

Price:
Very expensive - these shoes are over $100 and they should be in the $60-$70 range.

Style:
While I love the look of this shoe and the stitch patterns and lines this is not a dressy shoe.  It is for casual wear at the office - not an executive shoe.  The laces are clumsy and will protrude from the bottom of your pants - the shoe is wide.  You will not see anyone wearing a tux and these shoes - these are business casual ONLY.

I'll update as they wear down and let you know how they hold up......
profile.summary: Good shoe with high price

profile.description: The R9 provides premium protection for a great price! Crystal-clear optics combined with anti-fog / anti-scratch coatings allow you to feel like you're not even wearing a visor!
profile.reviewText:
I have the Reebok 11k helmet and this Ronin R9 fits perfectly.
I play in a few men's leagues.  I had the Oakley visor but that visor costs about $45 more than the Ronin.  I liked the Oakley but after two years it had a scuff, small, but right under my left eye and it was just distracting.  So I took a chance and went with the Ronin R9 and have been happy with it.  Doesn't fog up too much(just use anti-fog spray or shampoo works), fits nice, have not had any scratches (yet) and mounting hardware is top notch.

PROS:
Price - very reasonable
Nose/ Aviator cut
Anti-Scratch / Anti-Fog Coatings
MOUNTING HARDWARE INCLUDED!

CONS:
None so far

EDIT: 02/14/2014
I have only used the helmet in one game.  I have a game today and I was wiping down the visor and noticed a large smudge about the size of a quarter.  The protective film/coating is beginning to deteriorate.  This is crazy - I have not wiped the mask down with anything but J&J shampoo!  I am going to ask for a return but doubt I will get it now that the otder is over 10 days old.  Spend the extra money for a rear mask - I just got screwed.
profile.summary: Awesome Visor for Reebok helmet

profile.description: This pair of lightweight Mesh Shooting Gloves offers maximum comfort and sensitivity. Features include a mesh backing for air circulation and a textured palm for a sure grip during warm-weather shooting.
profile.reviewText:
These other reviews are mostly of wives who bought the gloves for their husbands.  My review is a review of the actual gloves.
I do not like these gloves and here is why..
The glove is half mesh and half leather.  The palms and fingers as well as the finger tips are all leather.  Here is where I am not happy with this glove.  The leather is soft smooth leather.  This makes for s slippery grip and not the type of grip I wanted for my firearm.  I have the PX4 Storm compact 9mm.  The gun practically slipped out of my hands after my first shot.  I will NOT wear these.  Plain and simple you will not get good grip with these gloves and that is what I had hoped for.
Other things to note:
There are two LARGE tags inside each glove where the back side of your hand is.  You can certainly cut these tags off but when you do watch out that you don't cut the stitching.  Also, cut it enough so that it doesnt leave a jagged edge which is what happened to me so it would irritate the back of my hand.  I also did this BEFORE using the gloves (stupid of me) so I was not able to return them.
The stitch above the thumbs really dig into the skin.  The glove itself is a good fit  not too loose not too tight but the thumb area when gripping will dig into the top part of your thumb.
The mesh is nice and breathable  the gloves themselves look really nice in the black and blue colors and the Beretta name and logo.  That is about all that is good about this glove.
profile.summary: I do not like these gloves and here is why

profile.description: Case and holster for LG G3. Compatible with all versions and carriers.
profile.reviewText:
This is a great case for your LG G3.  With some drawbacks it still is a plus and at a great price.

FIT & FEEL:
This case fits the LG G3 perfectly.  The phone snaps in and is very secure and protected.  What I liked about this case (besides the price) was the pattern.  Compared to the other brand which is basically the same this pattern on the plastic looks nicer.  The feel of the plastic is somewhat smooth/slick so hold on to that phone!  However the edges feel nice and give you ample grip. All of the holes line up - camera, mic, IR, power and even the slide out pen if you have the European model.  Also you can charge the phone with this case on which is nice. NOTE:  the back can't be removed unless you remove the case backing first.

PROTECTION:
Solid protection - with just a little lip on the edges you can place the phone down and the screen with not touch the surface. I feel that even if this dropped it would be protected.  All around accept for the top and bottom are covered as well.

HOLSTER:
The swivel works nice so you can have the phone at your side in either the horizontal or upright position.  However, sliding the phone in and out of the holster is somewhat difficult and while new requires two hands.  With use it may loosen up I hope. The clip is solid and also can be used as a horizontal stand.

KICKSTAND:
Can be used in Landscape/Horizontal mode only - trying to use the kickstand in portrait/upright position is NOT functional.  The phone is too top heavy and will fall over - no matter what you do it won't work.  I tend to also use the kickstand to hold the phone one handed while texting for stability.  I did notice the metal bar/hinge sliding out a bit and pushed it back in.  This is the hinge piece that makes it swing out and in.  I hope it never falls out or the kickstand will never stay snapped in place.  We will see.

PRICE:
At $10 shipped you can't go wrong.  Compared to Verizon selling this for over $35.
profile.summary: Encased Holster - FULL REVIEW

profile.description: Premium 8" x 10" padded pistol case / gun rug that fits 1 pistol and up to 5 mags
profile.reviewText:
NOT for your 1911- I have a Kimber Ultra CDP II .45 and while it fits loosely in the gun compartment the magazines slip and slide in the magazine holders.  There is no doubt the quality materials are here.  If the magazine holders were pouches and if there was an additional zippered or unzippered compartment this rug would be perfect.  Also, the gun compartment is made of nylon so over time I am unsure what the wear would be like on the finish of your firearm.

PROS:
Lockable zippers
Shoulder strap hooks
Velcro outside
Large gun storage compartment
Nice feeling handle
Size  8X10ish just right
Storage in the fold of the rug with straps

CONS:
Material used in gun compartment  ballistic nylon?
Magazine holders will accommodate double stacked magazines at best
Single stack magazines will slip through magazine holders
Velcro attachment section inside the rug is useless
No additional compartments
Price  should be in the $25 range not $35 range
profile.summary: Kimber Ultra CDP II .45

profile.description: Fishing Plier
profile.reviewText: They cut OK. Had an issue with 10lb test filament line which isn't much. Had to really squeeze to get it cut. Stainless steel is a good thing...no rust. The grips stink like toxic chemical. I can't believe not one reviewer mentions this. Not one just me! Left them outside in the sun hoping the stinky smell would go away.... Didn't help. Smell remains on hands after using. Fish can pick this up. Also the latch that holds the pliers together is tough to unlatch. You have to squeeze the pliers to loosen the latch and unlatch to open. I don't even use the latch anymore as I sometimes need one had operation. You get what you pay for I guess.
profile.summary: Stinky grips mediocre pliers

I now have a small Bluetooth icon on the task bar that I can right click and there are a ton of options to choose from.  I can pair up my phone or mouse, transfer files back and forth and do it fast and with ease.  Range?  How far away do you really need to be?  It works perfectly!  Also, it is so small that it hides under the lip of the computer.  It does blink Blue but I never see it.  And if I do look at it at least I know it is working.  I LOVE IT!  This thing is tiny and rounded so it won't snag on anythng.  But like I said, the lip of my laptop covers it so it doesn't stick out.  Acer 6920

top_5.description: used
top_5.reviewText:
I got this pink one for my daughter and a blue on for my son.  The blue one is still working - thankfully - the pink one died two weeks after Christmas.  I thought these would be good tablets for the kids - inexpensive and functional.  I am an Android person so the OS worked out fine - when it was working it was really great - camera - youtube, Play Store - apps - games - all the goodness of Android.  However, it just died and would not power up or charge after two weeks of light use.  So we returned it for a refund.  My son however still has his and it works fine....for now.
Battery life is not very good -
Also, people comparing this to the apple line of products should be smacked in the head - this is not a $500 device so why compare it to one?  If apple has a $75 device then compare it to that ..... good luck finding one too.
top_5.summary: Died after two weeks - wouldn't turn on or charge

top_5.description: This Motorola DROID RAZR MAXX HD MOTXT926M mobile phone features 4G LTE speed and an Android 4.1 Jelly Bean operating system for fast Web browsing. DuPont KEVLAR fiber and Corning Gorilla Glass ensure strength and durability.
top_5.reviewText:
I paid $699 for this phone - right out from Amazon Wireless - to keep my Unlimited data plan through Verizon.  This is the fourth Droid that I have owned.  I will not go to the other side with the sheep. NEVER!  However, this phone has one major flaw that, in this day and age, should never be an issue and also some minor flaws. So, I will point out the good first then the bad...

GOOD:
Construction - Kevlar, nano coating, Gorilla glass, etc....
1 GB RAM but I wish it had 2GB
Dual Core Processor - ?? - see bad as well
DLNA
NFC
4G LTE
HD Screen with good size 4.7"
HDMI out
Universal USB for charging and connecting to a PC (Drive)
SD Card
BATTERY - outstanding 3300Mhp - who cares if it isn't removable
9mm thin
LED notification light is nice & big and RGB multicolored!
Great radios - reception
Great speaker - speakerphone - sound etc

BAD:
1)Camera - I have tried third party apps and was hoping Jellybean would fix - it is just a terrible camera.  8MP is fine but every time I take a picture is is yellow, blurry, off hue in average lighting situations.  Outside it is better but then there is another problem - it gets darker or lighter back and forth until the moment is then gone.  I just can't understand this.  My Thunderbolt which I still have takes great pictures and that phone is not a great phone at all specs wise compared to the Razr - why is this?  Focus sometimes take minutes to adjust - even if you tap the screen.  The color - yellowish is just bad in all pictures.  Those of you out there will say it's a phone not a camera - well hello, I take photos all the time of my kids and my DSLR is not with me as much as my phone is you know.  It is just shameful and should be one of the finer aspects of a phone these days. Outside shots with plenty of light are not bad but not great either.  Indoors are terrible and dim light just not good at all. Others will say it isn't that bad of a camera but it is - I want this to be good but it just is NOT.

2)Lag at home screen - For a phone with a dual core processor the home screen lags and takes time to populate the screen.  The rings which I love will take time to appear some times.  Sliding from screen to screen there is a slight stutter.  Others have said it is an app causing this but the same apps were on my other Droids so why is it affecting the Razr and not the older ones with less power? I have hard reset the phone but it still remains.

3) APPS TO SD ----- NOT!
OK, this phone has 32GB internal but I still don't want to store my apps on it!  I can't believe I can't save apps to SD on this phone.  I have a 32GB SD card on board and all it stores are photos and video - nothing else. I have ZDBOX and I always get prompted to move an app to SD but it can't be done on the Razr.  If I knew this beforehand I may not have purchased this phone and I am surprised everyone is OK with this.

Final Thoughts:
I still have my upgrade with Verizon and when something else comes out I might sell this on EBay.  I am upset because I love the way this phone looks and feels - I just wish the camera and speed were up to par. There are many good Android things that this phone can do.  Also, with moderate use I can go three days before I have to recharge - that is outstanding and one of the reasons I did buy the phone.  I heard the camera was bad and I thought I could deal with it but I can't.
top_5.summary: RAZR MAXX HD - Battery Good Camera BAD

top_5.description: Enhance your entertainment area with this 670W home theater system that features multiple surround sound decoders and 11 soundfields for cinematic audio. The Audyssey dynamic volume control allows for optimal listening levels and dynamic range.
top_5.reviewText:
I will try to make this quick.  First, about this seller, the items were packaged very securely and shipped and arrived in three days - stellar free shipping!  Thank you Cameta.  What a great deal - all of these quality items for this price.  Also, just to note, this package came with a 32GB class 10 memory card not class 6 - outstanding!

My whole life I have had point and shoot cameras - most of them Sony.  Now, married with kids, still have a point and shoot Sony but now have the A55 too!  Why pull the trigger?  You know when you are taking that shot and everything looks great, you press the button, three seconds go by and then the picture takes.....but the kids are now looking everywhere but where the camera is?  Yeah, the A55 just snaps away taking amazing quality pictures.  I am sure there are Canons and Nikons that are just awesome.  I wanted the Sony and I am happy to have it.  Just so you know, it really isn't that hard to work the camera even as a novice like myself.  There are plenty of 'AUTO' options/settings and the camera will take care of the rest after you snap the shot. However there is also the ability to learn what it is like to take professional photos and become the photographer you never knew you could be.  I tell my wife this is probably the last camera we will ever buy.  I looked at the A77 but couldn't justify $1300 for just the camera body.  I think the A55 is more for the consumer and the A77 for the professional.

With the A55 and this package you will have pretty much everything you need to get started.  The camera is fast, has tons of options like GPS, different shutter speeds and all of the familiar point and shoot filters like B&W, sepia, etc.  There is panoramic and 3D options as well as full HD video.  The built-in flash has different settings and there is the familiar timer setting and steady shot, etc.  If you have owned a Sony camera in the past you will identify the icons on the LCD screen and then just learn the new visuals that you see.  I would also recommend an 'A55 for dummies' book.  There are a few here on Amazon that are very insightful and great for beginners like myself. The camera is light yet smaller than I expected and can cramp one hand held operation.  The strap fits nicely and I ordered a hand strap.  The LCD swivels and is bright as well as the electronic viewer which, when you are up close to it the LCD auto shuts off - neat.  I really have so many good things to say but wanted to let anyone who is considering buying this package what to expect.  If you are even considering it then you already know that A55 is a great camera.

Your family will love the photos you take and you will love what you can do with this amazing camera.
Best of luck to you,
BOGY
top_5.summary: My first DSLR  - The Sony A55

input: Generate the review text written by a reviewer who has a given an overall rating of "3.0" for a product with description "OUT OF PRINT". The summary of the review text is "Interesting idea that partly worked. Also, too disturbing and violent.".
output:
The idea behind this movie is almost brilliant and it looks as though Christian Bale was ready to bring some great stuff to the role, but at the end of the day, the screenplay was lacking and not a complete, compact story. As this was adapted from the book "American Psycho," it looks like what happened was that they wanted to stay true to the book, but couldn't fit everything in there for length and violence reasons, so they cut out pieces of the story and sewed it back together with some parts missing, and the whole thing wasn't totally coherent. With a book adaptation, what you are looking for is to capture the incredibly dry humor and the irony of these yuppies' lifestyles. They act incredibly self important but are so stupid and vain. Patrick Bateman is supposed to be worse than the others and the absolute pinnacle of all this. You need to capture the cerebral and ironic humor that is in there, and this movie did that, but it did it too slowly, and without enough poignant punch to the scenes. Cause was not immediately followed by effect and the movie lost its pace and meaning. I believe that they were trying to stay true to the book, but what works in the book doesn't necessarily work on film.

This movie also could have been a ridiculous slasher flick that is a parody of horror films. Couple that with the ridiculous, ironic lifestyles of these yuppies and it could have been funny, but like I said, the succinct meaning and lyricism of the book was probably lost in the translation to film. Bale was good but not perfect, and the movie tread into disturbing territory that was not over the top slasher fare, but too serious and realistic, and ruined the tone of the movie, making violent parts of it unenjoyable. Nobody likes to see people actually getting hurt, and if this could have just been an absurd sendup of the horror genre, it could have been good. If it made fun of horror movies it could have been good, but it made fun of people's suffering, and that's not funny. I applaud them for trying this movie, but it was kind of a swing and a miss. I read some of the non-violent parts of this book, and it was a hilarious parody of the yuppie lifestyle, but the abstract background of the book worked, while the specific visualization of the movie did not. This movie had elements that worked, but didn't totally work on the whole. The jokes were too subtle and drawn out, and the movie didn't build in a logical way, and end with a logical conclusion. Some of the absurd and philosophical elements worked, like when he says that there is no real Patrick Bateman, and some of the atmospheric elements and tributes to Alfred Hitchcock were actually pretty cool. On the whole, a very interesting idea for a movie that didn't totally work, and yes, the violence and darkness were too disturbing.

profile.reviewText: Sorry to say it, but this movie was tremendously bad. I love Olivier Assayas to death, but this movie was a huge swing and a miss that was just barely reminiscent of why Assayas is brilliant. Ever since "Irma Vep," Olivier is having a seriously hard time coming up with something brilliant. To sum it up, this movie rambled like crazy, and you just didn't care about the straggling loose ends and unrelated story lines. The main character, presumably Assayas in his youth, just seems depressed and unresponsive like a stone. I hated and totally disagreed with the violent left wing political message. This is a weird attempt at an epic Hollywood period piece about the 1960s and '70s, but it achieves neither that goal, nor the goal of being a great Assayas movie. This movie tries to capture the whole time period, and captures nothing. It goes on and on about uneventful, non-impactful things, and fails to capture the beautiful nuances and subtleties of human reaction and emotion that permeates "Irma Vep." Watch that instead. Unfortunately, with movies like this, I am starting to forget why Assayas is awesome, and thinking maybe "Irma Vep" was a totally accidental foray into awesome territory for him. Olivier, you need a movie that is an artistic hit to redeem yourself, buddy! I'm starting to lose faith. Sorry! One star.
profile.summary: Total Disappointment. Boring as hell.

profile.reviewText: This movie was straight up awful and boring. I guess there are movies that I hate worse than this, and ones that I would give one star to more maliciously, but this was indeed pretty bad and grating. It is absurdly slow and boring. Nothing really happens. I am really not one to bring up WWII and the morality blame game, but if I do see a movie that seems to assign blame, of course I'd want to see America be the good guy, especially after Pearl Harbor. This movie more or less comes down in favor of Japan and blames America as the bad guy in addition to having roughly zero plot and zero emotional payoff. I guess the Americans do act arrogant and vindictive, and I'm sure there was plenty of that during a time of war after watching their friends get killed by the Japanese. My problem is that this movie comes down so one-sidedly in favor of the nation that started the war and it is hard to watch this propaganda. This is in addition to the fact that this movie has zero artistic merit. The blurb states that the emperor "wanders around the palace in a child like daze," and they got that right. You just have no idea how painfully boring it is to watch him do that, though. I guess this movie taps into the Japanese sense of philosophical contemplation, but I really really don't get it. Perhaps this movie is genius in Japan, and fits their sensibilities greatly, and if so I apologize, but as an American, there is not much in there for me. I've got no real problem giving this one star. I was expecting a more beautiful yet robust movie, and I just got the tinkering of a strange and peculiar old man.
profile.summary: Straight up awful and boring

profile.description: A MOST VIOLENT YEAR is a searing crime drama set in New York City during the winter of 1981, statistically the most dangerous year in the city's history. From acclaimed writer/director J.C. Chandor, and starring Oscar Isaac (INSIDE LLEWYN DAVIS) and Jessica Chastain (ZERO DARK THIRTY), this gripping story plays out within a maze of rampant political and industry corruption plaguing the streets of a city in decay. J.C. Chandor's third feature examines one immigrant's determined climb up a morally crooked ladder, where simmering rivalries and unprovoked attacks threaten his business, family, and - above all - his own unwavering belief in the righteousness of his path. With A MOST VIOLENT YEAR, Chandor journeys in a bold new direction, toward the place where best intentions yield to raw instinct, and where we are most vulnerable to compromise what we know to be right.
profile.reviewText: At the end of the day, this was a really really solid crime thriller. There was something about it that was a little mundane though, and dragged it back down to 3 stars. I think it was largely due to the fact that I just sort of felt like I'd seen this movie before, and that it recycled elements of "American Hustle," and "Goodfellas" and other crime/gangster dramas out there. Don't get me wrong with a 3 star rating, there is a lot in this movie that is really solid: Alessandro Nivola, the production design (they did a great job at nailing the 1981 "look"), and probably most of all, the music. The music was excellent, and conveyed a great, grave seriousness in the background, although I think the music mustered more seriousness than the acting and screenplay. Props to this movie for incorporating all aspects of a business, from the sales to the executive maneuvering to the crime etc. There is not much else to say about this movie, other than the fact that I would actually recommend it. Sadly, it is probably the best movie I've ever given three stars to.
profile.summary: Really Really solid crime thriller

profile.description: Based on the bestselling novel by John King, this study of middle-class England, football violence and male culture introduces you to Tommy, a bored twenty-something who lives for the weekend, casual sex, watered-down lager, heavily cut drugs -- and occasionally kicking someone's ass! Tommy's life ambles along until a violent encounter with a rival starts a war, and a series of nightmares forces Tommy to question his way of life. Shot in documentary style with the energy and vibrancy of handheld, The Football Factory is frighteningly real yet full of painful humor, a drug-fueled adrenaline rush about friendship, revenge and violence.
profile.reviewText:
I'm not sure what to say about this movie. It was so close to being great and brilliant, but there were several things that knocked it way back down to 2.5 stars, which is what I give it. The script is near brilliant, but the directing, production design and budget were just too amateur. It had a low budget feel to it, and the movie suffered tremendously for it. I feel like I would have given this 4-4.5 stars (which I don't usually do) had it been high budget, and creatively done, and with a much more talented cast. I would just say emphatically that I would have LOVED to see this movie directed by Danny Boyle. It would have been awesome to see what he could have done with this. Even Guy Ritchie would have been great for this.

I rented this off of the strength of Danny Dyer in "Human Traffic." His performance there was one of the best of my lifetime. He was so talented and creative. However, he just gives a very average performance here. The thing that shines the most, as I said, is Nick Love's script, which is an adaptation of John King's book. The production value hurts this movie tremendously, and makes it limp along. It's kind of sad to think of what this movie could have been. It is in the vein of "Trainspotting," "Pulp Fiction," and "Human Traffic." The components were all there, it just didn't gel in the way that it should have, and that is a shame.
profile.summary: Could have been great, but was a near swing and a miss. 2.5 stars.
