input: Generate the review text written by a reviewer who has a given an overall rating of "4.0" for a product with description "Diana DeGarmo ~ Dreams / Don'T Cry Out Loud / I Believe". The summary of the review text is "Fantasia won the title, but Dianas got the better CD.".
output: Diana proves on her first single that she had every right to be in the top 2. This cd single contains Dreams, Don't Cry Out Loud, and I Believe. Her voice is stunning, and she sounds just as good on cd as she did on some of her best performances on American Idol. I do think Fantasia should have won based on the final performances,  but Diana is destined to be a star in her own right. Dreams is gorgeous pop ballad. A little corny, but it has beautiful orchestrations and Diana sings like a pro. I Believe is almost identical to Dreams, but once again Diana makes it her own, and gives a powerful vocal performance, and I do think Dianas version is better than Fantasias. Her voice is better suited for the song. Don't Cry Out Loud was Dianas best performance on the show, however something is missing on the recording. It's very quiet, and sweet, and a little boring. Her performance of the song was exciting, and she belted high notes that gave me chills, and unfortunately they are all missing from the recording. Still, Diana is a star and deserves to be one.

profile.description: Audio CD.
profile.reviewText: This is the most amazing pop album by one of the best pop artists to come into the music scene. The follow up to her smash debut is riveting, fun, exciting, romantic, and much more. Starting off with the funk Martika's Kitches the album starts off with a bang and does not stop. Next is Spirit-the best track on the album written by Prince. It is so engaging and build and builds to a climatic ending that will leave you breathless. Other fantastic dance tracks include the sultry Don't Say U Love Me and Temptation. The ballads are also worth taking a listen too. Martika shines on the gorgeous Take Me to Forever and the stunning Safe in the Arms of Love. Other noteworthy tracks are Pride and Prejudice and the sweet and enjoyable Coloured Kisses. Martika is a true talent that has not gotten the recognition she deserved. A must for pop music fans. Even if you have not heard any of these songs before you should still have it in your collection. Also included Love... Thy Will Be Done, the gospel tinged ballad co written by Prince.
profile.summary: Best Pop Album of the Decade!

profile.description: audio cd
profile.reviewText: There's no question that Jessica Simpson is very talented. She has a beautiful voice and can sing circles around Britney, Ashanti, and other pop stars. However, its the music which comes into question. I have enjoyed all of her previous albums. Filled with some great pop dance songs and soaring ballads. Her latest album In This Skin is another album filled with the same style of songs that were on here last 2 efforts. There's nothing new or groundbreaking that will make Jessica stand out and finally get noticed. With that said, I did enjoy this album for what it was. A typical by the numbers pop album. There are some great songs. The stunning ballad I Have Loved You. Certainly one of her best power ballads. Forbidden Fruit is a fantastic dance track and is destined to be a club smash with the right remixes. Underneath is another power ballad that is I Wanna Love You Forever part 3, just like on Irresistable there was For Your Love..which was Part 2. Underneath is by far the strongest, with its beautiful violins backing her up and her voice stronger than it ever was. You Don't Have to Let Go is another beautiful ballad about her father. Its stunning. Other than that MY Way Home sounds just like Jewels Intuition with its middle eastern feel, Sweetest Sin is sexy but not radio friendly and should not have been released to radio. In This Skin has a great message but is a little to radio disney for me. Jessicas talent remains in her voice. Sounding better than ever, she just needs some new and fresher material.
profile.summary: Jessica's Vocals Shine, Songs Don't.

profile.description: American Idol season 3 winner Fantasia Barrino releases her debut single 'I Believe'. It's backed with 'Chain Of Fools' & 'Summertime'. BMG. 2004.
profile.reviewText: Fantasia deservedly won American Idol. I would have been happy if either Fantasia or Diana won, but based on their final performances Fantasia earned the title. Fantasias cd single also proves why she won. Her unique, raspy, powerful voice is a welcome addition the music world. However, her voice does not fit well to the cornball pop song I Believe. Sure it's a pretty song, but her voice doesn't fit it, and Dianas version is the superior. Chain of Fools and Summertime is where Fantasia really shines. Her voice is perfect for these songs and she sounds just as good on cd as she did live. Let's just hope that Fantasia gives us a pure R&B soul album, and not some adult contemporary pop album.
profile.summary: Fantasia shines on cover songs.

profile.description: songs are from Musical's
profile.reviewText: While I admire Deborah's choice in choosing lesser known Broadway songs for her first Broadway Album Colored Lights, I can't help but feel something is missing. The production value is a little shotty, the arrangements are new and different but take away from the orignal making some songs unrecgonizable (I Enjoy Being a Girl suffers from this the most), and while Deborahs voice has always been more broadway than pop, her pop voice comes out a little to often, making some songs unbearable to listen to, and unfortunately when Deborah belts out a high note, she goes a little flat. The cd starts off promising with a sexy rendition of Let Me Entertain You from Gypsy, and pretty much goes down hill from there with a few bright spots along the way. Who Are You Now from Funny Girl is sung beautifully and the album closes on a high note with Anytime (I Am There) from Elegies: A Song Cycle. This is Deborahs best vocal performance I ever heard, accompanied by a piano makes it lovely to listen to. Her song Sex from Skirts is nothing memorable, and her version of On My Own should have been left off the album. I have always been a fan of Deborahs and have all of her albums, but this one is a big letdown.
profile.summary: Long Awaited Bway Album disappoints.

profile.description: Now ~ Now That's What I Call Music! 5
profile.reviewText: Now 5 has all the top hits of the year and they picked the best in pop, rock, and R&B. This is one album that you can play all the way through and know all the songs. It's like a full hour of commercial free radio. It starts off with It's Gonna Be Me by Nsync which is great way to start off, then hits like Jumpin Jumpin by Destiny's Child, I Think I'm In Love With You by Jessica Simpson, Lucky by Britney Spears, and Back Here by BBMak. It also includes some of the best pop songs to come out in a while such as Faded by the new group Soul Decision and Case of the Ex by Mya, probably the best song of the year. Also included are Show Me the Meaning of Being Lonely-the best Backstreet Boy song and the return of Janet Jackson with Doesn't Really Matter. This is a must have if you you want the best of 2000.
profile.summary: The Best of the Best

profile.description: With seven top 10 dance singles under her belt, Amber returns. ?Naked? is sometimes soulful, sometimes pop, and sometimes just pure non-stop adrenaline. Produced by longtime collaborator Wolfram Dettki and featuring remixes from Thunderpuss (Madonna, Britney Spears, Enrique Iglesias Leanne Rymes) and Hani (Sade, Michael Jackson, Deborah Cox).
profile.reviewText: Words can't describe how wonderful Ambers third album Naked is, but I will try. Sexual, Spiritual, Funky, Exciting. I didn't think it was possible she could come back with a better album than her previous, one of my favorites. Including 2 of the years best dance tracks Yes and The Need to Be Naked, Naked is filled with numerous songs that prove once again Amber is the best dance diva in music today. You're Sent From Heaven, He, Sex Without Sex, and Love On You, are all catchy dance pop gems that showcase Ambers strong vocals and sensual lyrics. My personal favorite which should be the next single released is a smash dance club anthem in waiting, is Sex and the City. Heart Pounding beats, clever lyrics, and fierce vocals make this track explode. Also included is a chillout remix of Sexual Lidadi, and the Thunderpuss Remix of The Need to Be Naked, which are nice extras to have. There is not one bad song on this album, and it should please all fans Ambers fans. A Must have for dance music lovers.
profile.summary: Ambers New Album Is Her Best!

profile.description: Audio CD compilation from the hit show American Idol.
profile.reviewText:
American Idol introduced the world to some of the hottest young talents in years and the compilation cd is a perfect companion for anyone who loved the show.
1. Natural Woman-Kelly-The reason she won this competition is right here. Her voice, her energy, and he power all shine through. Taking Arethas classic and making it her own, and when she kits that one note, "I Feel so Alive", is thrilling. 10/10
2. Respect-Kelly-once again, Kellys shows off her amazing vocals. So beautiful, powerful, and effortless. 10/10
3. For Once in My Life-Justin-one of Justins best performances. Shows off his charisma and nice voice. 9/10
4. Get Here-Justin-the reason why Justin got so far as he did. Proving he is an amazing talent with a very strong, lovely voice. 10/10
5. Piece of My Heart-Nikki-a great song for Nikki, and while I wan not the biggest fan of hers, I think she sounds great on this song. 8/10
6. A House is Not a Home-Tamyra-Incredible voice that was by far the one of the best performaces of the competition. One of the standouts on the album, and we all know Tamyra will be a star. 10/10
7. Lately-RJ-a nice song for him. His voice sounds great. 8/10
8. Ain't No Sunshine-Christinas best performance. She sounds beautiful. 9/10
9. If You Reall Love Me-Ryan-Not the best song for her but she sounds great, and the production is a bit cheesy on this one. Sounds like we would hear this one in an elevator. 7/10
10. My Cherie Amour-AJ-I never likes AJ or his voice, and I disliked this song by him. I thought he could have done a better song for this compilation. 6/10
11. I'll Be-Ejay-Great Voice and great song but he tries way to hard to show off, and his high tenor voice does not fit for a rock ballad. He should have done an R&B song. 6/10
12. Easy-Jim-nice song and Jim has a nice voice but its a bit boring and the production on it is cheesy. He sould ahve done When I Fall in Love-7/10
13. California Dreamin-All-They sound great together, and a nice bonus to have on the Cd-9/10
Of course A Moment Like This and Before Your Love is included, reminding us why Kelly was the winner. Her voice is stunning and make these bland ballads sound incredible.
Overall a great collection with some fantastic performances and some with bad production and a few reminders why certain contestants were voted off.
profile.summary: Reminding us all why Kelly was chosen.

profile.description: Sean (Kerr Smith) is driving cross-country to deliver a vintage Mercedes and attend his sister's wedding when he picks up a hitchhiker, Nick (Brendan Fehr), who just happens to be a vampire hunter, tracking down a group of youthful vampires that feed on unwary travelers. As the plot thickens, they run into Megan, (Isabella Miko) who has been left for dead by the vampires. As they use her as a lure for the vampires, Sean becomes attracted to her. Further complications ensue when Sean is infectedwith the vampire virus. He, Megan and Nick must race against time to kill the vampire leader (Jonathon Schaech) to stop Sean from becoming one of the undead.
profile.reviewText: Those of you who thought Hannibal was disgusting think again, The Forsaken starring Dawson's Creek's Kerr Smith and Roswells Brendan Fehr takes the prize for goriest film is recent history. Suprisingly well done the movie is about a guy who picks up a hitchiker who happens to be bounty hunter looking for vampires known as The Forsaken. Along the wya they encounter them so the whole movie is filled with their attempts to get away from them. The acting is actually good and the plot is exciting and it keeps you on the edge of your seat. Lots of gore, blood, feasting on humans, human hearts, and a schocking scene of a head of a vamp being blown off. Jonathan Scheach is perfectly evil as the head of The Forsaken . The only problem is that the vamps used guns to kill and I would have rathered they killed like regular vampires with their fangs, and too many chase scenes, but overall a disgusting, excting ride that all fans of horror will love.
profile.summary: If You Like Gory Then You'll Love The Forsaken!

profile.description: Tracks include: 1. The First Noel - Clay Aiken 2. Have Yourself a Merry Little Christmas - Ruben Studdard and Tamyra Gray 3. O Come, All Ye Faithful - Ensemble 4. Silent Night - Tamyra Gray 5. Silver Bells - Clay Aiken and Kimberley Locke 6. Santa Claus is Coming to Town - Ensemble 7. The Christmas Song (Chestnuts Roasting on an Open Fire) - Kimberley Locke 8. I'll be Home for Christmas - Justin Guarini 9. Winter Wonderland - Christina Christian 10. This Christmas - Ruben Studdard 11. Oh Holy Night - Kelly Clarkson 12. My Grown Up Christmas List - Kelly Clarkson
profile.reviewText: American Idol: The Great Holiday Classics by far surpasses any of the other American Idol collections. Taking the shows top talents this is the American Idol album to have. Each performer sounds wonderful. Clay's voice is perfectly suited for The First Noel. Tamyra Gray gives a stunning version of Silent Night. Kimberly Locke lends her sultry powerful pipes to The Christmas Song, and Justin has never sounded better on I'll Be Home For Christmas. The ensemble songs are beautifully song. The best is saved for the second disc. Kelly Clarksons O Holy Night is breathtaking and Grown Up Christmas List is lovely. I wish the album included alot more songs. 10 songs seems a little short, but overall a wonderful Christmas album.
profile.summary: American Idol: The Great Holiday Classics

profile.description: May never really fit in and growing up with a pirate's patch to cover her lazy eye did not make things easier. EVen as an adult, her best friend and sole companion is a doll given to her by her mother, until she sees Adam. In awe of his beauty, especial
profile.reviewText: I'm a huge fan of horror movies, and the more gory, the better. May is one of those films, but it made me oddly uncomfortable. Watching the last 30 minutes of the film literally made me sick to my stomach and cringe. Building up that point is a marvelously acted film about lonely outcast May, played remarkably by Angela Bettis (Girl Interrupted, TV Carrie). Angelas perfect performance truly makes this film what it is. Starting off as a shy, awkward girl who only wants to have a date with Jeremy Sisto(Six Feet Under, Wrong Turn), then turning into a crazy, creepy lunatic, Angela makes us feel sorry for her and then be intrigued as to why she does the things she does. This makes the final 30 minutes all the more exciting, and sometimes unbearable to watch. Jeremy Sisto gives a strong performance as Mays object of desire, and Anna Faris(Scary Movie, The Hot Chick) turns in a likable performance as Mays lesbian co-worker. This film is the Carrie of the decade.
profile.summary: May is this decades "Carrie"

profile.description: Asian edition of teen pop act's 2000 album with two exclsive bonus tracks 'I'll Never Stop' & 'If Only In Heaven's Eyes'. 14 tracks in all including the first hit 'Bye Bye Bye'. 2000 release. Standard jewelcase.
profile.reviewText: Nsync proves that they are more than just another boyband with their amazing second album. It hits you hard right at the beginning with the killer first single Bye Bye Bye and just keeps going all the way through.  They guys sound great, their harmonies tight, and their individual vocals  much stronger. Standout tracks include the funky It's Gonna Be Me, the  enjoyably strange Space Cowboy, with a cameo from Lisa Left Eye Lopez, and  the title cut No Strings Attached. The best songs have to be the ballads,  This I Promise You and That's When I'll Stop Lovin You are gorgeous and  this is where the guys prove they can sing and that they will be around for  awhile. This album does not disappoint.
profile.summary: Nsync proves that they are not just another boy band.

profile.description: O2
profile.reviewText: O-Town will not be able to survive is the reaction I had listening to their sophmore album O2. While their debut had some great pop songs, their second album sees them veering off into a new direction with mixed results. They guys can still deliver a great pop song. Highlights include the first single These Are The Days, the dramatic ballad I Showed Her, and the catchy I Only Want to Dance With You, which samples George Michaels Careless Whisper. Other than those songs, the rest of the album is forgettable. They try to be edgy and more rock oriented but they do it halfway. They try to play it safe. They still come across as a manufactured boy band. Thats the problem. It comes across that they guys are still not comfortable with each other and the music. Vocally they are much stronger but only Dan proves hes got real vocal capability. If you're a fan of O-Town then you will probably enjoy the album, but this album proves nothing except that we have probably seen the end of O-Town.
profile.summary: Say goodbye to O-Town.

profile.description: Jessica Simpson is best known as a dance-pop vocalist who rose to fame in the late '90s alongside teenage act 98. Sweet Kisses, is Jessica's debut album which reached multi-platinum status.
profile.reviewText: Jessica has the beauty and she has the voice. Yes it sounds like she is about to bust a nerve when she is singing her hit I'm Gonna Love You Forever, but she is only 19 and in time she will learn to control her voice  and when she does she will be amazing. This album delivers the same old pop  that has been selling millions. All the ballads sound the same and the  upbeat songs sound the same, but that's o.k because it's what we want to  hear. Highlights include the the upbeat number I Think I'm in Love With You  and the beautiful duet with Nick Lachey of 98 Degrees. Check this album  out. It's not the best but it won't be a dissapointment.
profile.summary: Jessica shines on her debut.

profile.description: BLACK EYED PEAS - MONKEY BUSINESS - CD
profile.reviewText: The Black Eyed Peas have once again put out one of the funkiest CD's of the year. An energetic, fun, and mainstream hip pop album that contains numerous hits. I attribute the peas recent success with the addition of Fergie. Her fierce vocals truly make each song come alive. The best parts of each of the songs are when Fergies soaring voice chimes in, especially on the opening track Pump It. The best song on the album is Don't Lie, a fun, reggae inspired song destined to be a radio smash. Dum Diddly is basically Hey Mama Part 2, but is still sounds just as fresh. My Humps is a silly song about female parts, but it's got a great beat, and could be the next Milkshake or Hollaback Girl is it's released. It's another great album with some excellent special guests like Sting, Justin Timberlake, Jack Johnson, and the legnedary James Brown. This is definitely the album of the year.
profile.summary: Peas Phunk it up Again.

profile.description: Out-of-print in the US. This import features the same 16 tracks that graced the US edition. EMI.
profile.reviewText: Before Britney,Christina, and JLO, Paula Abdul was the princess of pop with her catchy dance tunes, and hot and sexy videos. Turning out hit after hit, Paula Abdul was one of pop musics most beloved stars and this greatest hits collections proves why she was so successful. While never known for her vocal ability, she still knew how to deliver a song, in a sweet and sexy purr, just like Britney Spears does. She had some of the best pop songs of the past 20 years. Included are her #1 hits Straight Up, Cold Hearted, Forever Your Girl, and Opposites Attract from her Forever Your Girl album. From her Spellbound album, we get Rush Rush, Promise of a New Day, Vibeology, and Blowing Kissed in the Wind, and from her Head Over Heals album we get My Love is For Real and Crazy Cool. It's interesting to listen to because they go in order from her 1st hit to her last hit, and we can definetly hear the growth in her vocals and her songs. Why My Love is For Real was not a hit, is beyond me as it one of her strongest and funkiest songs. This is must have album for all Paula Abdul fans and anyone who loved pop music in the lat eightis and early nineties.
profile.summary: The First Princess of Pop

profile.description: Joy Enriquez - Joy Enriquez - Cd
profile.reviewText: Joy Enriquez has put together the perfect mix of pop,latin,r&b, and dance in one of the best decut albums this year. Reminiscent of Mariah Carey, Christina Aguilera, and Jennifer Lopez Joy will fit in perfectly with these atrists and hold her own. She has a truly beautiful and powerful voice that gives each song a great energy. Starting off strong is the Beyonce Knowles penned track What Do You Want, with its funky rythyms and edgy beats this song is destined to be a smash as well as Tell Me How You Feel and Uh Oh, but where she really shines is on the ballads. Her glorious voice hits each note with strength and power and ballads like Without You, Losin the Love, and With This Love are pure power pop ballads that could make Joy a star. Hopefully she will not get unnoticed. A true talent that will give Christina a run for her money. To think I no reason to buy this cd, just on a whim. I had never heard of her. Wonderful debut!!
profile.summary: Remarkable Debut for new pop sensation!

profile.description: 2-disc box set, 302 minutes or approximately 5 hours long, containing the top 10 best episodes and special features.
profile.reviewText: Friends is probably the best written and best acted television show in the past decade and this wonderful collection proves that. It contains some of the best episodes from the past 7 years. Included are when Rachel and Ross kiss, when the gang plays poker, the Thanksgiving flashbacks, and the best episode when the gitls lose the apartment to the guys. As you watch the episodes you can see each character grow and the chemisty build and build making them one of the best ensembles ever on tv. This is a tape you can watch over and over again and still find the same jokes funny, especially Lisa Kudrow who is hysterical and steals many scenes in almost evry episode. No disappointments on this box set, except I wish there were more, but Vol 3 and 4 will be coming out soon.
profile.summary: Proves why Friends Is The Best!

profile.description: Kate Hudson twinkles as the heroine of How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days. She's a magazine writer assigned to date a guy, make all the mistakes girls make that drive guys away (being clingy, talking in baby-talk and so on) and records the process like a sociological experiment. However, the guy she picks-- Matthew McConaughey--is an advertising executive who's just bet that he can make a woman fall in love with him in 10 days; if he succeeds, he'll win a huge account that will make his career. The set-up is completely absurd, but the collision of their efforts to woo and repel creates some pretty funny scenes. McConaughey's easy charm and Hudson's lightweight impishness play well together and the plot, though strictly Hollywood formula, chugs along efficiently. At moments Hudson seems to channel her mother, Goldie Hawn, to slightly unnerving effect. --Bret Fetzer
profile.reviewText: How to Lose a Guy in Ten Days is as predicatable as romantic comedies come but it also turns out to be one of the best based on the charming and likeable performances from its to leads, Kate Hudson and Matthew McConaughey. The duos onscreen chemistry is amazing and I could not stop smiling throughout the entire film. Kate Hudson is hysterical and proves she is a gifted comedian and while Matthew doesn't really do anything different than what he usually does, he still turns in one of his best performances helped by the energetic Hudson. It took a little too long to get them finally together, but the end is sweet and worth it. Forget other romantic comedies like Maid in Manhattan(boring)and 2 Weeks Notice(rediculous), How to Lose a Guy in 10 days is by the far the best romantic comedy of the year!
profile.summary: Kate and Matthew will you win you over.

profile.description: This movie will have you on the edge of your seat.
profile.reviewText: By my surprise, Frailty turns out to be one of the best films of the year. About a father and his 2 sons who are chosen by God to kill the demons in the world. One catch, the demons come in the form of humans. With incredible performances from Bill Paxton, Matthew Mcchonaughey, and especially Matthew O'Leary as the young Fenton, this film is horrifying. Director Bill paxton creates an eerie atmosphere that makes the film all the more creepy. I don't want to give much away about the movie and there are a  few surprises that will make you jump so all I can say is I loved this movie. Everything about it. I love horror movies and rarely do I get frightened  by them. This one did it!
profile.summary: One of the Years Best!

profile.description: Bill Paxton, Matthew McConaughey. The chilling tale of a religious fanatic who believes he is charged with killing demons in human form-and enlists his two young sons to help him. 2001/color/99 min/R.
profile.reviewText: By my surprise, Frailty turns out to be one of the best films of the year. About a father and his 2 sons who are chosen by God to kill the demons in the world. profile.description: Goldie Hawn & Susan Sarandon are two former rock groupies who reunite.
profile.reviewText: As much I love Susan Sarandon and Goldie Hawn, I foudn this movie quite boring with a predictable plot, unlikeable supporting characters, and slow pacing. Susan and Goldie trie their hardest, but even they can't overcome the bland script. Goldie is her normal silly outragous self, but she tries to hard and Kate Hudson did the blond, ditzy groupie role better in Almost Famous, which is a shame. Susan does well with what she can, but she seems bored. Geoffrey Rush should be embarrassed to play the role he played, and Erika Christenson and the other actress playing Susans daughter in the film, are so obnoxioulsy annoying, I wanted to fast forward all of their scenes. This could have been a better film, if it had better writers and better supporting actors, but all you get is a mess of a film that wastes the talents of two remarkable actresses.
profile.summary: More Like "The Boring Sisters"

profile.description: Fall in love with the sexy comedy The Oakland Tribune says has "more chuckles than The Wedding Planner." It's a wild blend of big laughs, high fashion and foul play. Ordinary single girl Amanda Pierce (Monica Potter) unexpectedly finds herself sharing an awesome Manhattan apartment with four sexy supermodels. Determined to bring Amanda into their world, the models give her the ultimate makeover. The plan works fabulously as Amanda connects with next door charmer Jim Winston (Freddie Prinze, Jr.). That is, until one night while spying on him, Amanda thinks she sees the man of her dreams committing a cold blooded crime. Life then unravels as Amanda and her four loopy roomies must take to the streets to try and solve this mystery with style!
profile.reviewText: Head Over Heels has it's ups and down all throughout the film but overall it is a funny and charming comedy. It's about Amanda who falls for Jim, who may or may not be a murderer. The whole film is trying to find out if Jim is actually murderer. Monica Potter is charming and cute in the role of Amanda, and givin the right role she could be the next Julia Roberts. Freddie Prinze Jr is also very charming and likeable as Jim, but it's hard for me to believe that Jim is a hot fashion executive. Freddie still looks like he's 18. The movie goes for the laughs by having Amanda be a klutz and it has it's moments, but how many times can you laugh at her falling down the stairs. Freddies character does not fair so well with the laughs. The writers deciede to for crude and disgusting. Do we really want to hear Freddie Prinze Jr going to the bathroom, and being very, very loud about it, if you know what I mean. This has no relevance to the story except just to get a laugh. The 4 models Amanda lives with are very funny and likeable. There is a hysterical scene where the girls get stuck in a resturant bathroom, that leads them to believe Jim is gay. This scene is also very crude and disgusting, but it has a something to do with the plot of the story(kind of). The movie moves along quite nicely but the ending scene is quite rediculous and not at all what I was hoping the ending would be. Most of you will enjoy this movie alot, but most of you will probably get bored and turn it off halfway through.
profile.summary: Crude and Sometimes Funny Comedy

profile.description: Christmas compilation in conjunction with MTV's TRL features X-mas tracks by Weezer -'Christmas Song', Blink 182- 'I Won't Be Home For Christmas', Sugar Ray - 'Little Saint Nick', N Sync - 'I Don't Wanna Spend One More Christmas Without You', Christina Ag
profile.reviewText:
What is the point of getting a bunch of pop stars together to make a Christmas CD that sounds nothing like a Christmas CD. There are maybe 3 tracks that will get you in the Holiday spirit.
Among them is Nsyncs I Don't Wanna Spend One More Christmas Without You, Christina Aguileras Angels We Have Heard on High, and Trans Siberin Orchestras Christams Cannon. Willa Ford is the worst thing about this album making a funky, sexy, inappropriate
song called Gimme Gimme Gimme. These songs seem out of place and don't fit on a Holiday CD. I would much rather hear these artists take holiday classics and redo them almost like the original versions. Instead they make a mess out of them.
profile.summary: Nothing Christmas about TRL

profile.description: Martika - The Best of Martika: More Than You Know
profile.reviewText: Martika is probably the most overlooked artist. She is truly a reamrkable artist who came out with the smash hit Toy Soldiers in 1989. Know one really knows waht has happened to her since and it's truly a shame she has not had an album out since 1991. This is an amazing album filled with some of the best pop songs ever recorded, such as the danceable More Than You Know and the slammin remake of I Feel The Earth Move. Other standout tracks include the Prince written tracks. The funky Martika's Kitchen and Spirit. Also included are remixes of some of her hits, including a stunning version of Love Thy Will Be Done. remixed by Prince himself. Martika is truly missed in pop music today and I know alot of people who are awaiting her return. Martika if you are reading this-you are amazing!
profile.summary: The Best of Martika

profile.description: Amber ~ Yes
profile.reviewText: Amber is back with another slammin dance anthem that will please all lovers of dance music. This track is one of her best givin the same sensual lyrics that she gave us in Sexual Li Da Di. Another powerhouse vocal performance and amazing remixes Amber proves she is the best dance floor diva out there. It's time to start giving this wonderful artist the attention she deserves. She gets hotter and hotter with each new song proving that there is no stoppin her! With lyrics like "I put my arms around him Yes and drew him down to me so he could feel my breast " she is one artist who is not afraid to take risks and pull out all the stops to give the music industry some incredible music!
profile.summary: Best Dance Floor Diva!!!

profile.description: VHS FORMAT. 2002, Paramount, item no. 335923, 82 minutes, color. Underground classic about a surf slacker who decides to get serious and leave Orange County behind, on his way to Stanford to study writing. Things do not go according to plan. Good cast, solid laughs.
profile.reviewText: I was very surprised to enjoy this move. If you ever want to watch a movie you can just sit back and enjoy then this is it. Sean (the very charmig and likeable Colin Hanks) wants to go to Stanford, but the school guidance couselor(a hysterical Lily Tomlin) sends the wrong transcripts, therefore Sean goes out of his way to get accepted. Of course the movie then has many differnt obstacles Sean has to face to do this, like his alcholic mother(the always great Catherine Ohara), his druggie slob brother(Jack Black, in one of his best and funniest roles, and his sweet and loving girlfriend Ashly(the very talented Shuyler Fisk). Many things go wrong which make for a very funny and entertaing movie. The ending is a little predictable but the cast is so wonderful that they pull off what could have been another by the numbers, gross out comedy.
profile.summary: Likeble Cast make it Worth It.

profile.description: ALIAS - THE COMPLETE THIRD SEASON
profile.reviewText:
While not as exciting and intense as the first 2 seasons, Alias's third season still proves it's one of the best television shows on the air. Boasting some of the finest actors working today, starting with the magnificant Jennifer Garner, who should have won the emmy this year based her performance in the season opener, it's truly heartbreaking.  Victor Garber, Ron Rifkin, Michael Vartan, Greg Grunburg, and David Anders are all phenomenal. The storyline this year isn't as "edge of your seat" like last year but it did keep my interest and it does build to an excellent climax. The beginning is all about trying to find out what happened to Syndey, and we finally find out in the amazing episode Full Disclosure, but the majority of the season is based on Lauren, Vaugns wife who is obviously not who she says she is, and the final episode gives us another shocking cliffhanger. I think the major disappointments was Melissa George who played Lauren. She's quite boring and was a sad replacement for the wonderful Lena Olin, so it was hard to get into any of her scenes, and she just didn't fit in with the remarkable cast.
Leno Olin, Bradley Whitford(Will), and Merrin Dungey(Francie) are also gone, with a guest appearance in a few eps from  Will and Francie. However, it still was an amazing season and I will can't wait for Season 4.
profile.summary: Not as strong as Seasons 1 and 2, but still amazing.

profile.description: VHS tape
profile.reviewText: American Pie was a classic and remains one of the funniest movies of the past few years. American Pie 2 is a step down from the original but it is still very funny. All the original cast members are back and it still has the same gross out jokes. They do get a bit old, alot of the jokes are the same jokes we laughed at in the first one. However the cast is so charming that you can't help but laugh at them. Alyson Haningan is by far the best of the bunch, and she gets twice as much screen time in the sequel. I do have to say THANK THE LORD that Tara Reid is not in it as much. She is by far the most annoying of the bunch and has a little to do. Overall I laughed out loud quite a few times and would definetly recommend it.
profile.summary: Not as Funny but still hilarious!

profile.description: VHS tape
profile.reviewText: Memento is one the most thrilling, intense, screwed up films I have ever seen. Besides that it is one of the best written, directed, and acted films I have ever seen. About a guy who has short term memory loss who is trying to find the guy who murdered and raped his wife, and the screwed up thing is that the whole movie is told backwards. An interesting, original idea that will blow you away. Guy Pearce is very intense and passionate as Leonard, and Carrie Anne Moss gives an equally convincing performance as Danielle. Full of surprises Memento does not disappoint, but one movie you have to watch  and listen to very carefully or you will get easily confused. Highly recommended and could be considered one of the years best!
profile.summary: Don't Miss one of the years best!

profile.description: VHS TAPE
profile.reviewText: Everytime I watch the tv show Jackass, I say to myself over and over again, these guys are morons, idiots, jackasses, but I still enjoy it for what it is. Therefore, I decided to check out the movie which is just an extended version of the tv show, but with alot of swearing and male nudity. I was a bit disappointed. For one thing, 90 minutes of the stunts get to be too much, I don't really need to see Steve-o bare bottom in almost every stunt he pulls, and some of them were just kind of dumb. I did laugh out loud quite a few times. My favorites are the alligator in Brams moms kitchen. She deserves her own show! The stunt where one of the guys puts a toy truck up his butt and goes to a doctor for an x-ray, and I loved the old man stunts. They cracked me up. Everything else is nothing new which is the main problem. They are variations on stunts shown on the tv show, so we have seen most of them already, either in the show, or in the trailer. The outakes and extra footage are great, so I recommend the dvd for that, but I wish there had been a lot more original stunts instead of the same ones we have seen over and over again, and enough with the naked Stev-O!
profile.summary: JackAss The Movie Could have been Better

profile.description: Tonya Mitchell ~ I Represent
profile.reviewText: There is absolutely no difference between Tonya Mitchell and Jessica Simpson, Britney Spears, Mandy Moore, and all the other teen pop princesses. But if you like all of these artists then you will like Tonya. She has a strong voice with great dance pop and sweet ballads. The production is very well done and not overdone which let her vocals shine. The first single is broken Promises, a killer pop song that should have gotten her some recognition. Unfortunately the song went no where. Other greta songs include the title track I Represent and You're the One That I Want. All great uptempo tracks. She sounds the best on the ballads. Stay, I Cry Real Tears, and Wasted Breathe are lovely. Tonya is very talented and it is too bad that she's just gonna get caught in the mix of all the newcomers in the pop world, considering she is one of the best of the bunch.
profile.summary: Yet Another Teen Princess

profile.description: Newcomers Scene 23 got their well publicized start on the TV show 'Popstars 2'. This diverse group includes Monika Christian, Laurie Gidosh, Donovan Green, Josh Henderson, and Dorothy Szamborska. Their debut album 'Popstars 2: Introducing Scene 23' was full of an eclectic choice of tracks. The first half of the album includes songs recorded by Scene 23, while the second half describes Popstars 2s experience including songs from R. Kelly, Mariah Carey, and Joe. 'He Said She Said' is a song that makes you just want to get up and dance. 'I Really Don't Think So', 'What She Got', and 'Respect Me' are also outstanding pop songs not to be overlooked. A taste of Europes two-step beats is brought out in the song 'Another Night'. 'The Greatest' is a sweet pop ballad with a soulful sound. And finally, 'All This Love' shows an R&B side to Scene 23. This album is also enhanced and when put into your computer, you to can learn dance steps, get singing tips, have fashion guidance, and a lot of other points essential to becoming a popstar. These young men and women are definitely talented and I am looking forward to their next release.
profile.reviewText:
The new popstars group is Scene 23, which consists of 2 guys and 3 girls. They are all very good looking and very talented. It is too bad that there is nothing exciting about the group. They haven;t gotten the hype that Edens Crush got. The only real problem is the music. The songs are pure teen pop from the 90's. Pop music has evolved as Britney and Nsync have proven and the writers of the songs seem to be stuck. Unoriginal lyrics and beats will unfortunatley take this group to no where. They will be lost in the shuffle of other groups. "I Really Don't Think So" seems to be the ony hit worthy song. A nice midtempo track that will grow on you after a few spins."Another Night" is the only other possible hit, has the two step thing going that will remind you of Craig Davids "Fill Me In" As I said the performers are all very talented, its too bad that their producers and management aren't taking them seriously.
Bonus material includes "I Believe I Can Fly" by R. Kelly, "I Still Believe" by Mariah, and "I Wanna Know" by Joe.
profile.summary: Talented group but nothing original.

profile.description: Stefan Grossman ~ American Idol Season 2: All Ti
profile.reviewText:
This years group of American Idol wannabes is a very talented group. All 11 finalasts have their own unique quality that makes them stand out in their own way. However, there is not one of them that has blown me way like Kelly and Tamayra did last year, except for Clay, but thats besides the point. Heres the lowdown:
Superstar-Ruben-Rubens velvet voice is in full effect on this beautiful ballad. Many predict he will win. 9/10
On The Wings of Love-Clay-Clay is the winner in my opinion. His stunning tenor sounds effortless. A cheesy song yes, but Clay makes it his own and he sounds incredible. Its nice to finally have his voice on CD. 10/10
At Last-Julia-What a disappointment. He basically ruins this Etta James classic. She should have done Breathe by Faith Hill and should never ever sing this song again. 1/10
Three Times a Lady-Josh-Josh is a very likeable performer with a nice, rich voice. Perfect song for him, and he sounds great. 8/10
Lets Stay Together-Treynyce-Her sultry powerful pipes are missing on this version. Her live version blew me away, but she still has star quality and I would buy her cd the day it came out. 8/10
Back At One-Ricky-I have to admit I was never a fan of Ricky Smiths, but he sounds wonderful on Brian Mcknights stunning ballad. He basically imitates every note and riff, but thats pretty impressive considering Brian Mcknight is one of todays most gifted vocalists. 8/10
Killing Me Soflty-Kimberly Caldwell-I've always like Kimberly Caldwell. Shes fun and funky with a great voice, but something is not coming across on this recording. Could have done better. 7/10
Open Arms-Corey-Clay sang this for his Top 12 performance and he did it 10 times better. Corey screehces through the whole thing 3/10
How Do I Live-Carmen-Shes sweet and young and got a very likeable quality about her. She may not have the best voice, but we all have to admit shes better than Julia. 7/10
Over The Rainbow-Kimberly Locke-Stunning. Her voice is magnificant when given the right song, and Judy Garland would be proud. 9/10
Overjoyed-Charles-Not Bad. Nothing to exciting. 6/10
God Bless the USA and What the World Needs Now are beautifully sung by the finalists. They don't have the same impact as they did when sung live, but still a great way to end the album.
profile.summary: Last Season was better, but there are winners!

profile.description: Ruben Studdard ~ Flying Without Wings/Superstar
profile.reviewText: While Rubens velvet vocals never really impressed me, had had such a presence on stage that he won me over by the end. Clay is clearly the more vocally talented and has the better songs on his cd single. Rubens single Flying Without Wings is a new version of UK boy band Westlife's hit. While it's a beautful song, it does not do Ruben justice. It's not as powerful as one would have hoped on CD as it was live on American Idol. Superstar is the superior track which is perfectly suited for his rich, soothing vocals. This is the song that should have been the focus. Ruben deserves to go straight to the top, but hopefully his album will stay clear of boy band covers.
profile.summary: Song Does Not Do The Idol Winner Justice

profile.description: The action gets even hotter in ALIAS' sensational second season. Double agent Sydney Bristow faces the greatest challenge of her life when her mother, an enemy long thought dead, turns herself in to the CIA. As family relationships change and Sydney's friends take on new roles, her life becomes even more tangled and dangerous. It's "like watching a 2,000-piece puzzle assembled before your eyes," says Entertainment Weekly. Experience all 22 scintillating episodes of season two with exclusive bonus features that take you inside the world of ALIAS. Your favorite characters are back, joined by special guest stars, as Sydney fights to reclaim her life and the action builds to a spectacular climax. "Think Bond with feelings, Dostoyevsky with smart bombs," says GQ Magazine. This comprehensive six-disc collection will have you hooked from episode one's incredible start to the season's stunning final minute.
profile.reviewText: I didn't think Alias could get any better than it's intense first season but it did. I never watched the show on tv, but thanks to the dvds I was able to check out what all the hype was about. I watched Season 1 in 3 days, and immediately watched Season 2. I was blown away by the second season. It's even more exciting and dramatic, with almost every episode revealing something shocking. Most of this is thanks to the brilliant Lena Olin who joins the cast as Sydneys mother. The storyline is brilliant and there were plenty of Oh My God moments. This season also gave more for Francie (Merrin Dungey) and Will (Bradley Cooper) to do. Their storylines were just as exciting and intense, and cultivated in a fantastic final episode that could go down as one of the best cliffhanger episoded in television. All of this though could not be possible without the amazing Jennifer Garner. Proving once again she was one of the best actresses on television today. How she manages to pull off what she does every week is beyond me. Emmy voters need to honor her very soon. Alias continues to provide some of the best hours on television I have ever seen.
profile.summary: Better than the 1st!

profile.description: Volume 1 features the episodes "Surprise" and "Innocence."
profile.reviewText:
Many changes happened in the fourth season of Buffy. First, there was no Angel. Second, no Cordelia. Three: Introduction of Riley, Four, intoruduction of Tara. While Season 4 was not one of the best seasons of the series it gave us some of the shows best episodes including the emmy nominated Hush, which to this day still remains one of best episodes in television history.
 Season 4 was basically about Buffy getting use to life in college. Its there she meets Riley who is part of an underground military operation called The Initiative. The focus of the season is Buffy fighting against Adam, who was created by Prof. Walsh, the leader of the Initiative and Buffys professor.
 The season starts off strongly with the hilarious episode Living Conditions when Buffy thinks her new, annoying roomate is a demon and Fear Itself, when the scoobies are trapped in a haunted frat house. The show tends to slow down the pace a bit as it starts to revolve more about Riley and The Initiative, but things pick back up in Hush, when we meet Tara and we get to see Alyson Hannigans Willow evolve into a woman and powerful witch.
Tara, played by Amber Benson, is a nice addition the cast who has a big effect on Willow in more ways than one. Marc Blucas as Riley is very blah, but you get use to him, and actually start to feel sorry for him.
 Things also pick up when Faith comes out of her coma and is intent on making Buffy pay for what she did to her. Who Are You? and This years Girl are two excellent episodes.
 The season ends on a high note as we get to a glimpse as to whats to come in Season 5, the most exciting season of the series. Although one of the weaker seasons, Buffy still manages to make us laugh, cry, and keep us on the edge of our seats. Sarah Michelle Gellar remains the heart of the show, but in this season we finally get to see the character of Willow blossom into something very powerful.
profile.summary: Not the Best Season but still Amazing!

profile.description: A mysterious driver in a muscle car with a demonic hood ornament hunts down a gang that has taken over a small town...
profile.reviewText: I have seen almost all of David Decocteaus films, and I am a huge fan of The Brotherhood Trilogy, Voodoo Academy, and The Frightening. However, his last 3 releases have been huge disappointments. Lacking all the pieces that made his first films so campy and enjoyable. His films starting with Leeches have gotten worse and worse. His latest is Speed Demon. His so called version of The Fast and the Furious with some horror, and barley clad men thrown in there. The plot is rediclulous. The acting atrocious. The charaters names are hysterical! Clutch, Wiper, all different parts of a car. The plot goes nowwhere, and the film goes along so slowly that you don't even care who the killer is. Let me tell you,there is a twist, but its pretty obvious who it is, if you can pay attention long enough. Fans of David Decocteau may find this film enjoyable, especially for the beefy men in their underwear, but they certainly won't make one of their favorites.
profile.summary: David Decocteaus worse film yet!

profile.description: FONSI LUIS ETERNO
profile.reviewText: I have been into latin pop ever since Ricky Martin and Marc Anthony came into the US market. Ever since then I have come to appreciate latin music. I don't even speak the language. I own Ricky Martin's Vuelve and Christina Aguilera's Mi Reflejo which are 2 of my favorite albums, and this is where I came across the extraordinary talent of Luis Fonsi who sings a duet on Christina's spanish language CD. His voice is a godsend, absolutely beautiful. The album is filled with gorgous ballads such as Imaginame sin ti and uptempo hip shaking songs such as Dejame o dame amor. He sings with such passion. The album also has these 2 songs in English which is an added bonus. Luis Fonsi is a remarkable talent and is better than Ricky and Enrique, so everyone who has their CD's should buy this one, and I can't wait until he crosses over into the US market. He will be the next huge crossover pop star. Truly wonderful.
profile.summary: What a Glorious Voice!

profile.description: FONSI LUIS PASO A PASO
profile.reviewText: Luis Fonsi is back with his strongest album to date. Vocally he is at his best, and some of the songs are the strongest he has ever recorded. Staying away from the more dance pop oriented music this time around, Fonsi delivers a more rock oriented cd but still giving his fans his signature power ballads that showcase his stunning voice. There are numerous highlights on this cd, including the beautiful ballads Paso a Paso and Vivo Muriendo. However, where Fonsi really shines this time around is on the rockin songs Estoy Perdido and Por Una Mujer, which are destined to be radio smashes. It is rare that you find a cd where all the songs are good. This is one of those cd's. Hopefully this will be the album that catapults Fonsi into superstardom where he belongs. With a voice like his, it's where he needs to be for all the world to hear.
profile.summary: Fonsi's Strongest Album To Date

profile.description: Children are hidden away in the attic by their conspiring mother and grandmother.
profile.reviewText: This is one screwed up fil that is chilling, eerie, and disturbing. It is a guilty pleasure that most people will either hate or love. Kristy Swanson gives a terrible terrible performance as the oldest daughter, and Jeb Stuart Adams is even worse as the brother. The marvelous Louise Fletcher is over the top and chilling as the grandmother and she seems more upset with herslef by taking this role than with the children. But even with all it's acting flaws this is one of the creepiest films ever made. The incestous relationship between the older siblings should have been played out more but it would have been too disturbing to watch on screen. I do recommend this film for the weiedness and creepiness of the plot, certailny not for the acting ablities. Could go down as some of the worst performances ever.
profile.summary: Terrible Acting But Still Worth It

top_5.description: Audio CD.
top_5.reviewText: This is the most amazing pop album by one of the best pop artists to come into the music scene. The follow up to her smash debut is riveting, fun, exciting, romantic, and much more. Starting off with the funk Martika's Kitches the album starts off with a bang and does not stop. Next is Spirit-the best track on the album written by Prince. It is so engaging and build and builds to a climatic ending that will leave you breathless. Other fantastic dance tracks include the sultry Don't Say U Love Me and Temptation. The ballads are also worth taking a listen too. Martika shines on the gorgeous Take Me to Forever and the stunning Safe in the Arms of Love. Other noteworthy tracks are Pride and Prejudice and the sweet and enjoyable Coloured Kisses. Martika is a true talent that has not gotten the recognition she deserved. A must for pop music fans. Even if you have not heard any of these songs before you should still have it in your collection. Also included Love... Thy Will Be Done, the gospel tinged ballad co written by Prince.
top_5.summary: Best Pop Album of the Decade!

top_5.description: audio cd
top_5.reviewText: There's no question that Jessica Simpson is very talented. She has a beautiful voice and can sing circles around Britney, Ashanti, and other pop stars. However, its the music which comes into question. I have enjoyed all of her previous albums. Filled with some great pop dance songs and soaring ballads. Her latest album In This Skin is another album filled with the same style of songs that were on here last 2 efforts. There's nothing new or groundbreaking that will make Jessica stand out and finally get noticed. With that said, I did enjoy this album for what it was. A typical by the numbers pop album. There are some great songs. The stunning ballad I Have Loved You. Certainly one of her best power ballads. Forbidden Fruit is a fantastic dance track and is destined to be a club smash with the right remixes. Underneath is another power ballad that is I Wanna Love You Forever part 3, just like on Irresistable there was For Your Love..which was Part 2. Underneath is by far the strongest, with its beautiful violins backing her up and her voice stronger than it ever was. You Don't Have to Let Go is another beautiful ballad about her father. Its stunning. Other than that MY Way Home sounds just like Jewels Intuition with its middle eastern feel, Sweetest Sin is sexy but not radio friendly and should not have been released to radio. In This Skin has a great message but is a little to radio disney for me. Jessicas talent remains in her voice. Sounding better than ever, she just needs some new and fresher material.
top_5.summary: Jessica's Vocals Shine, Songs Don't.

top_5.description: American Idol season 3 winner Fantasia Barrino releases her debut single 'I Believe'. It's backed with 'Chain Of Fools' & 'Summertime'. BMG. 2004.
top_5.reviewText: Fantasia deservedly won American Idol. I would have been happy if either Fantasia or Diana won, but based on their final performances Fantasia earned the title. Fantasias cd single also proves why she won. Her unique, raspy, powerful voice is a welcome addition the music world. However, her voice does not fit well to the cornball pop song I Believe. Sure it's a pretty song, but her voice doesn't fit it, and Dianas version is the superior. Chain of Fools and Summertime is where Fantasia really shines. Her voice is perfect for these songs and she sounds just as good on cd as she did live. Let's just hope that Fantasia gives us a pure R&B soul album, and not some adult contemporary pop album.
top_5.summary: Fantasia shines on cover songs.

top_5.description: songs are from Musical's
top_5.reviewText: While I admire Deborah's choice in choosing lesser known Broadway songs for her first Broadway Album Colored Lights, I can't help but feel something is missing. The production value is a little shotty, the arrangements are new and different but take away from the orignal making some songs unrecgonizable (I Enjoy Being a Girl suffers from this the most), and while Deborahs voice has always been more broadway than pop, her pop voice comes out a little to often, making some songs unbearable to listen to, and unfortunately when Deborah belts out a high note, she goes a little flat. The cd starts off promising with a sexy rendition of Let Me Entertain You from Gypsy, and pretty much goes down hill from there with a few bright spots along the way. Who Are You Now from Funny Girl is sung beautifully and the album closes on a high note with Anytime (I Am There) from Elegies: A Song Cycle. This is Deborahs best vocal performance I ever heard, accompanied by a piano makes it lovely to listen to. Her song Sex from Skirts is nothing memorable, and her version of On My Own should have been left off the album. I have always been a fan of Deborahs and have all of her albums, but this one is a big letdown.
top_5.summary: Long Awaited Bway Album disappoints.

top_5.description: Now ~ Now That's What I Call Music! 5
top_5.reviewText: Now 5 has all the top hits of the year and they picked the best in pop, rock, and R&B. This is one album that you can play all the way through and know all the songs. It's like a full hour of commercial free radio. It starts off with It's Gonna Be Me by Nsync which is great way to start off, then hits like Jumpin Jumpin by Destiny's Child, I Think I'm In Love With You by Jessica Simpson, Lucky by Britney Spears, and Back Here by BBMak. It also includes some of the best pop songs to come out in a while such as Faded by the new group Soul Decision and Case of the Ex by Mya, probably the best song of the year. Also included are Show Me the Meaning of Being Lonely-the best Backstreet Boy song and the return of Janet Jackson with Doesn't Really Matter. This is a must have if you you want the best of 2000.
top_5.summary: The Best of the Best

profile.description: With one of these kitties perched on your glass rim, you'll always know which glass is yours! These furry friends are always curious to see what's in your cup, whether it's wine, juice or milk. With six markers, there's enough attitude to go around.
profile.reviewText:
Sorely disappointed with this purchase. The item shipped does not have the "true zoo" logo on the cat's chest as in the images. If you are thinking it is a positive that the logo is not on there, you are mistaken. The logo served as a design element as well as positive branding. When you buy a pair of Levi Jeans or Nike Shoes you don't wish they had left the logo off. If they did then you might as well buy the $5 Jeans and $5 Sneakers. The same applies to these rubber cats.

This makes them look like 5 cent pencil erasers from the bargain bin after a Walmart Sale. There is no contrast. The features of the cat are muted and lost due to the lack of contrast which also accentuates an incredibly cheap feel to them. At $2 each, this is actually kind of insulting. Even with the total price making this not a huge deal it STILL feels like the absolute worst purchase I have made in years. I'll go spend $12 on a couple of cups of coffee in a few minutes but this $12 infuriates me. I had bought these as a gift for someone who just put in a home wine cellar and I would never in a million years give her this. I gave her a rubber chicken wine stopper so we are not snobs. But I am telling you, these look awful.

As I said, 5 cent, poorly molded rubber erasers is the perfect way to describe them. There are other feline glass markers. If you don't like the other styles just don't get feline glass markers. People who have cats and love cat stuff (me included) will NOT enjoy or appreciate this. Don't force them to feel obligated to use it by giving this as a gift. They will secretly wish you had passed.
profile.summary: You will NOT be getting what is in the images - I do not recommend this item

profile.description: The Gripperwood Gourmet Board is a beautiful non-slip cutting and serving board. Made from the highest quality Indian Sheesham wood available, this wood is extremely durable and has a natural resistance to bacteria. Although Sheesham has an exotic appeal, this wood comes from only controlled and sustainable forests. Appreciated for its rustic beauty, Sheesham wood produces a unique marble grain and no two boards are alike. A patented process permanently secures Gripper non-slip feet inside the wood without glue. The soft feet grip the counter while you work.
profile.reviewText:
This is one of those products I occasionally run into on Amazon that seem to defy all logic. This cutting board is the latest mystery. What is strange is the price. This board is gorgeous. I did some research and Sheesham is India's equivalent to rosewood. Rosewood it turns out makes a great board. It is not mahogany, but it is close! And at 1/10th the cost of mahogany - well - I can go mahogany free for life. I bought this board as a gift for my mother on her 80th birthday. Through a mutual friend, I discovered she was not using it. Long story short is that she was so happy with the look of the board she has been using it for cheese, cracker and fruit service. She would not dare use it because she did not want it scratched! sigh

When I confronted her she readily admitted it and asked me to please give her back the bamboo board I had removed when giving her this board. I am NOT a fan of bamboo as a cutting board. Yes, I know that 95% of all the boards sold and in use are bamboo. Just because something has attained critical mass does not mean it's a good thing. For starters, and I am sure this is not new information to most, but for those unaware Bamboo is NOT wood. It is grass. This is not my opinion, it is scientific fact. The very notion that the bamboo industry has mostly deceived people for 100+ years by touting their grass as a cutting board is objectionable enough. The fact that from a utility standpoint Bamboo, um, SUCKS compared to wood has been enough to sustain my personal 30 year boycott of all things bamboo.

As far as my mom, I just placed an order for a second, identical board and it will be here this afternoon thanks to this great, same day free shipping program.

I am baffled how a board so beautiful, THICK, and having a surface similar to mahogany when putting a knife to it is so incredibly cheap! There is no way that Amazon or any seller could be making money on this after the free same day delivery. Also, the feet that I was worried would limit the board to one side and be a drawback turns out to be a superior, high quality feature.

I'm not sure what my mom will decide to use THIS one for that does not include cutting, but as long as the price, quality and service remains the same I will keep buying them for her. I feel like I am stealing on this item. I feel like there was a pricing error. I feel confused why ANYONE would order a grass plank when this item is available.
profile.summary: Real Wood, Not Just Wood-ish

profile.description: The cozy and comfortable Ripple Board Scratch'n Massage Bed" is a bed specifically designed for cats it covers all of a cats everyday needs sleeping scratching and massaging. Your cat will never want to leave this comfy bed. Treated with organic catnip oil."
profile.reviewText:
There are notes on one of the images. I can't imagine how this is not one of the best sellers on the planet. It has lasted 5 months and I still have only removed one layer. As far as design, this trumps everything I have bought in 2 decades.

**edit**
I see that the image has been sized down, making the notes too tiny to read. The photos are showing close-ups of the rippled cardboard layers. Also noted is my observation regarding the superior durability and strength of the rippled cardboard vs. normal corrugated scratch boards. This cardboard is solid - no weave/webbing - making it inherently stronger than the corrugated counterpart.

However, like most reviewers here, I seem to have purchased a bed for her highness, not a scratch board. profile.description: Waring Pro Ice Crusher
profile.reviewText:
I have been patiently waiting for my unit to succumb to one of the many problems so many people seem to have. In fact, I was resolved to accept this inevitable catastrophic equipment failure, and have been fully calm knowing the day would come.

One problem, though. Five months later and it remains the best appliance I have purchased in my (long) life. I use it four to five times a day, using the large crescent ice made by a standard built in ice-maker. I have had 2 jams that I could not shake to correct. I pulled the cubes out with my hand in both cases and lost no more then 3 seconds.

If you are an ice muncher, THIS IS YOUR PARADISE!!

It does not make snow cone ice. If you want really fine stuff, run it through two or three times. I have never had the need.

Here's the deal - Do not fill the top chute and expect to walk away like some fancy pants caterer, Feed the ice into the top as it processes so there is never really anything in the chute. Doing it slowly fills a 64oz BUBBA in under 20 seconds. It is not like you will be standing there for long. Feeding it slowly, surprisingly, speeds the entire process up exponentially and hels assure your machine operates perfectly.

I love this inanimate appliance more then my 2 grown children and their mother. I actually love it nearly as much as I love my (evil)  cat!

That's high praise indeed!

Stop shopping for alternatives. I sat on the fence for months before pulling the AMEX trigger. That's months of perfect munch ice I lost out on and will never be able to replace. JUST BUY IT!

 And don't give me crud about not knowing how to blow bubbles! I am the bubble blowing champion of the Northern Hemisphere.

Buy a large bottle of Gazillion Bubbles solution. It is half the price at ToysRUs than it is at amazon but the money you will save means it is OK to overpay and get from Amazon.

Take the dried catnip and crumble/flake it to a powder with your fingers as you simply add it to the bottle of Gazillion Bubbles. You are basically making a catnip tea out of the bubble solution, but no tea bag. Then just let it stay there. If you use a wand, it will have all sunk to the bottom so it won't be an issue. If you use a bubble gun or machine just strain it as you fill the gun or machine so the fine particles of catnip do not block the hoses.

This will last 10 times longer and make vastly superior bubbles to any pre-mixed, catnip bubble solution that has ever been made.

profile.reviewText:
This review applies ONLY to puffs on Amazon sold under the CHASE'M brand!

I had purchased these puffs over a year ago. They were branded as Whisker City and sold through Petsmart.

My cat was indifferent to these for a few days, but considering I have box with 500 pounds of rejected toys that cost me well over $14,000,000.00, I did not worry about it so much. I picked up what I though were all the puffs I had tried to entice her with, I placed them into the abyss of the other worthless toys. I assumed they would never be seen again.

Flash forward a week. I went to bed one night and as I placed my hand under the pillow (part of my normal sleeping position for 52 years) I felt something soft and pulled it out to discover it was a puff. I tipped my head back to ask her how it got there. She is easy to find at night.  Her torso is on the top part of my pillow and her butt is directly propped against the top of my skull. She refuses to use her tail as a barrier at this contact point. But lets not get sidetracked from this product review with a dicussion regarding her 12 year refusal to adopt basic manners, or talk about her life long refusal to  exhibit any concern or consideration about MY hygiene preferences. Sure, she spends the entire 4 hours a day she is not sleeping incessantly licking every square inch of her body. When she finishes licking herself, she spends a couple of minutes on a seemed barbaric manicure where she looks like she is actually trying to pull her back nails directly out of the pads. It is frightening and disturbing to watch. Then, after what I know is FACT that she had never moved from the spot, so therefore it is impossible that she has become dirty, she will repeat the entire self-cleaning process just in case she missed a single, microscopic speck that might have been neglected on the first pass.  So, I am well aware of her personal hygiene obsession, and have accepted the fact that she is simply too selfish, or inherently evil, to extend me the same consideration by simply placing her soft and furry tail as a barrier between the crown of my skull bone and her, well, lets just refer to it as the only location on her body where no hair grows other than her actual eyeball orbs!  You would think that after rescuing her at 5 weeks old that she -- uh. .. I got sidetracked, didn't I? Sigh

Back to the discovery of the under pillow puff, and her mocking silence when i asked where it came from, I informed her she was rude and then tossed it on the floor to retrieve in the morning to place in the toy dump to reunite this puff with the rest of its puff family. Of course, I slept late and did not notice anything on the floor in the morning and frankly had forgotten about the entire incident.

At bedtime the next day I laid down to sleep.  I slid my hand under the pillow and was surprised to find the orphaned puff had returned. At this point there was only couple of scenarios I could devise. The first theory was that this was a puff that had been possessed by the devil and was now a living, evil entity that was placing itself under my pillow with nefarious plans to someday climb in my mouth to block my airway and suffocate me to death, then free his puff family from that box and wreak havoc on the planet.  The other possibility was that madame rude-butt had placed it there.

I carefully considered both theories. Yes, the demonic possession thing was clearly plausible. However, was it possible that lady pucker-bumm had been playing with it? Despite the fact she has an entire house, she has always had a proclivity to carry certain toys on my bed to toss and chase. I have seen the chase part result in her inadvertently wedging fur mice under the pillows or bedding. Many times that will give her an excuse to take a nap. When she wakes up the lick ritual starts and she probably forgets it is there.  So, in fear that the alien puff might choose that night to kill me, I decided it would be prudent to solve this mystery before any assault could take place.

I got out of bed and grabbed the bag containing the rest of the puff family and brought them to the room.  Since her butt shelf was not in place for her to assume her perch, she was awake and impatient. I took another puff from the bag and tossed it at her face.

What ensued is best described as what would happen if cats smoked crack. She was insane.  She tossed it in the air and chased it.  She would fling it off the bed and jump down and bring it back. She would hug it and kick it with her back claws in that alien ritual all cat owners know. Finally, she tossed, chased, and slid into it thus trapping it under the pillow.  She retrieved it from under the pillow and then spotted the original puff I had pulled out. I witnessed a true cat dilemma in her eyes that must be similar to someone realizing they had TWO bags of crack. So she abused them together and separate until the narcotic got the best of her. The puffs are packaged and infused with loose catnip that work their way into the deep fibers. She was exhausted and physically crashed at the foot of the bed. I went to sleep as well. She must have woken soon after because I soon discovered my cat hat was back in place like a creepy living wig.

The next night I could only find one puff. I went to get another. As a joke I kept tossing them at her until there was six on the bed. She absolutely loved this and changed from puff to puff and actually started placing them in a cluster for ease of access. In the weeks that followed i would constantly be switching them in and out of the bag so they could marinate in the catnip. Puffs would constantly go missing. I would find some by lifting the couch and other furniture I knew she would lose them and not be able to reach. Before long I was down to only a few from the original dozen in the Pertsmart package. Last week I was down to a single puff.  It was a pathetic puff at that. While it was 100% intact because they seem to be durable to the level I would classify as indestructible, it had the color tone of a civil war bandage or an old pillow after years of sweat soaking.

This was crisis time. Being a prime member I decided to check Amazon before paying $4 or $5 plus tax on a tiny bag of these puffs that she has NEVER tired of and I am sure never will. It is then that I discovered the wonderful world of puffs in bulk!

Couple of comments;

1. If you have never tried these with your cat buy a smaller pack of them to test.  Ill bet you will be happy you did.

2. If your cat does not take to them,  give it time! !

3. Most importantly, my highest recommendations here are based on this specific puff on this product page.  It is sold in different quantities by same vendor.  There are tons of puffs out there that range in size, density, material, and mass. I have found every other style of puff out there either is the wrong ergonomics or texture and she rejects them. There are some with the same physical properties that she likes but several brands are unsafe because they can be shredded quickly which presents a choking hazard. Once you try this product on this page you will know in the future if other puffs are acceptable, effectively entertaining, durable, and safe based on the fact you will have inspected and held these.

4. Lastly, I don't know how, but expect them to all eventually disappear. I don't care how much housekeeping you do, or if you think you know every single hiding place or gap they may have gone. They will simply vanish. Maybe there is a puff fairy that rescues them from the torture, maybe it is a mystery like the disappearing sock in the dryer. There are a couple of dozen puffs in my home that are forever gone - let's just hope they have not joined forces and are planning to snuff me out!

I'm not suggesting they add material, just remove some via a couple of drill holes. If they are willing to add something it should be some sort of eye loops that could be wrapped around the frame then screwed in to the door.

Sadly, as many of us know with respect to items sold and shipped by Amazon, I can't have them just send me the single proper hook so I can get it done. I have to box up the entire thing and ship it back to get a replacement hook. Well, in this case I am not going to order the same design as the entire manufacturing process is not tight enough. profile.reviewText:
I hate writing 1 star reviews. I love Amazon and have many great Cuisinart products, so it makes me hate this even more. However, I feel obligated to other potential buyers in making this review. I don't want to see other people making the same purchasing mistake and also hope that Cuisinart either fix this problem or yank the listing.

As other reviewers have noted, this grater has a propensity to just up and die after minimal use. In my case it was the very first time I used the product. I had received the product and put it on the charger for several days. When the time came to impress everyone with my new kitchen to, I beamed with self gloating/pride as the cheese grated effortlessly and beautifully. I had one of those "where have you been all my life" moments as I pondered the future of no effort cheese grating that remains at the top of most serious cook's dreams.

My gloat morphed into a cringeworthy moment of the sound of a dying motor. As opposed to some other reviewers that were fortunate to get a couple of minutes grinding before catastrophic failure, my pleasure was short lived. I got under 5 seconds then it quit. Thinking (hoping) that maybe it was not on the charger properly (though the red light was on, one can always be an optimist). I decided to charge it again. I carefully seated it in the charger and left it there for 48 hours. After 2 days I got nothing. Not even a groan from the motor. It apparently was an electric corpse with nothing at all to give. I don't know if that red light was ever supposed to go off because the poor documentation did not go beyond instructions for placing it in the charger. If the red light was supposed to have gone off at some point then I guess my unit has never worked properly considering it was charged for over 5 days total and the light never went out. Whether mine was defective or there is a problem with this product is moot at this point. With the defect rate reported in just Amazon reviews, this product has no business being on the market.

My quest for wrist and arm relief continues because it is back to the microplaner for me.
