profile.reviewText: This was mostly penned as a response to Lauren who had issues with the wire and electricity; however, it is also directed at the group that is displaying a level of overreaction, fear, uncertainty and doubt that is actually more harmful to cats than this (or any toy) truly is in reality. Proper supervision is paramount. If people don't get the toy+supervision thing right then they are not as responsible as they probably think they are. OK, @ Lauren - thanks for the review. I am not a very nice human I am told. I care much more about animals than people. The most traumatic experiences and memories I have from 60 years of life is the loss or injury of my pets. 50 years ago, my grandmother died when I was 10 years old. Emotionally, I was like - meh. 2 weeks later, a stray cat I had been feeding for only a couple of days got hit by a car. My uncle told me about it (I did not even see the body), I was devastated for days and literally wailing at the top of my lungs in sorrow. 50 years later I can picture the cat when I close my eyes - I remember her coloring and even her eyes. However, I can't conjure up any memory of what my Grandmother looked like unless I have a photo. I know I am not normal. It's my makeup though. I have no control over the abnormal emotions I have for animals, especially mine. I'm not proud of it; I am only mentioning it because I want to establish perspective on the following opinions I have. I want you to know that if there was anything inherently unsafe with a product I would not only avoid it but I would advocate for complete discontinuation of sales. In fact I have been a part of other toys that were pulled or modified. 1. Not necessarily directed at you, but to those mentioning that they are concerned because they fear the danger of their cat taking it back to their lair - This style of pet toy is in the class that it is mandatory the cat NEVER play alone! They can hang themselves; self-amputate in panic and really get caught in a life-altering situation with the most minor of incidents when they are unsupervised. This fact does not make it a bad toy or an unsafe toy. If all we let our cats do is play with puff balls because they are safe, then we are doing an awful disservice to them. There is/was nothing safe about wild cats on a carnivorous hunt. The cat family in particular has more perilous outcomes in natural hunting situations over the ages than almost any other species. Hunting was dangerous but it kept them alive, involved and sharp. The fact that your cats ancestor was pretty likely to die while hunting as opposed to old age is a factor that made the domestic cat the independent, brave and edgy overlords that is today's house cat. The excitement and danger of the hunt and play remains integral to a happy, balanced cat. 2. It sounds like you are unsure about how exactly the outlet fiasco went down. I can hopefully make you feel better by assuring you that had your kitty received any shock from the toy, the cat would *forever* be disinterested in this toy again. Cats don't get the 9 lives reputation by getting shocked by high voltage more than once. If the cat still has any interest in the toy, then kitty was never hurt. I won't "pile-on" in either direction whether the toy is capable of carrying a live charge - the only thing that matters is that kitty is OK. 3. All of the comments voicing concern have a common thread of mentioning the wire. That wire is there by design and the movement the wire creates is the point of it. If not for the wire then it is just a stick and a string. Most importantly, I think it is important to put this toy in perspective. This is not a new design that Jason and PM irresponsibly jumped into. I hope everyone is aware that the NUMBER ONE selling cat toy on Amazon - hence the NUMBER ONE selling cat toy on planet earth is this baby -- Go Cat Cat Catcher Teaser Wand with Mouse Cat Toy So this is a proven and effective design and the battle lines being drawn are 10 years too late. I can tell you that my cat freaks for this product (the original) and it has added to her happiness and our bonding. However, I would not let her carry it away even 6 inches from my grasp. If I accidentally drop the wand I surge toward it with great purpose and determination, which causes her to drop it and not try and keep running. Would you all like to know what a good cause is to rally around? Friskies new String Toy/treat is BY FAR the worst conceived and designed cat product in 100 years. Whoever thought that running cat treat through an extruder so it takes the form of string is an absolute idiot. Worse than his idea is a multi-national like Friskies actually developing and marketing this disaster in the waiting. MANY cats will die by eating deadly yarn and string when the treat runs out and they are hungry. We are training them to adopt a deadly behavior. SADLY, US courts consider pets to be property only - meaning there is no accountability on any company to make products that are safe. Nobody is legally liable for your pain and suffering or any compensation as long as US courts classify our cats as no different as a wheel barrel or a bag of dirt that we own. THAT's a fight we need to get behind with consensus. In 2015 it is time for the courts to realize how important our domestic animals have become and therefore they deserve some non-human, human rights if you get what I mean.

profile.reviewText:
Since my first amazon order in 1996, I have never had a reason to write a review with the tone I am going to use here. This item now has the distinction of being my worst purchase in nearly 20 years (not just on amazon  this is inclusive of everything except of course things like a bad dinner out etc). This is verifiable by looking at my profile. In life, I have always been a relaxed and generally very appreciative person. Im mostly a dream customer and I write about 1,000 jokes for every complaint I may have raised.

Having said that, I would like to report a couple of issues I have with this product and company, bidet4me. First, this 100-series bidet is built with a weak point that in an event of failure it renders the product completely inoperable. Those who experience this failure will immediately realize that this defect can cause extensive property damage. Second, the product is backed by inadequate support which is an insurmountable issue when trying to deal with the first problem of a poor product build.

I purchased this bidet for an elderly parent that is disabled and suffers from diabetes. Her range of motion is restricted. Her complete hygiene is a massive priority both medically and from her own personal perspective. A product like this offers an amazing benefit to people like my mother in that it allows her to remain independent without her having to give up her dignity. Being able to remain in her own apartment has been a major accomplishment of hers considering her health issues. So needing assistance after using the bathroom each time robs her of the pride she deserves after a long life of successfully raising a family. I am a working guy that devotes all of my spare time and resources to animal conservation and welfare. Consequently, though with full choice, I am not rich. I can't afford a "real" bidet for her. It is not even close. The cost of a hard wired bidet seat is more money than my entire net worth. I am about to enter senior citizen land myself so it is not like I can just go get a third job and buy her a proper bidet. The existence of affordable options like the 100-series are a godsend and helps people like my mother live a prideful existence that does not include her son or daughter in-law helping her clean her bottom (sorry to get specific but I am trying to convey the importance of a product like this and how it relates to her quality of life and happiness).

I recently moved my mom to our city so we could be close to her. Before she arrived I had this bidet already attached in her new apartment. She had one in her old city and it is an essential part of her mental and physical wellbeing. This past Wednesday at 4 in the afternoon, just 5 weeks since it was delivered, I got a frantic call from her telling me that her bathroom was flooding. I was relatively close by so got there quickly. The plastic tee-valve provided with this bidet which attaches to the toilet tank had sprung a leak. Her bathroom is carpeted and the water did not just stop there. It was a huge mess with an enormous amount of water damage. However, my only concern was getting her calmed down and relaxed. I quickly bypassed the bidet and returned the toilet plumbing to a direct connection and we set out to dry things the best we could.

At 9 pm I left my wife and mom and headed to Lowes to get a replacement for the plastic tee-valve. At 10:10 pm I was the last person out of the store but was empty handed. Not only did I learn that these valves are not standard plumbing parts, I also learned that no amount of creativity (short of your own injection mold) would allow you to rig something up that would work as a short term solution. I spent all night online trying to figure out other ways to get the bidet operational or at least to source a piece of hardware that I could get in the morning when stores opened. No luck. The closest I came was being able to get a replacement for the nut only - which was the source of the failure - but I could not get just the simple nut quicker than 2 days. When my mother woke Thursday morning she had to start what has been now the fifth day of the indignity of needing help. I am going to have to tell her later that there is still no solution. I hate to give her that news. I expected and promised her that the part would be in by yesterday at the latest.

This is where the awful experience I had with bidet4me comes into play. Instead of ordering a replacement for the nut via an online plumbing supplier I had decided to contact bidet4me to see if I could get an OEM part in the same amount of time it would take to just get a nut delivered. I went to their website and found a technical support phone number. I called the number and was forwarded through Google Voice to some third number which was eventually answered with a confused "hello?". This person clearly did not expect the phone to ring. I immediately knew this was a bad sign but after asking if I had reached bidet4me I (foolishly) proceeded. I explained the problem and IMMEDIATELY told him I was not complaining about the property damage, assigning blame, concerned with refunds etc. I just needed to get this bidet working ASAP. I was really VERY cool and nice considering the situation. He had at first told me that they sell the parts on their website and started to give me the URL. I explained that I was way ahead of him and found their number through the site and once again explained I needed a tee-valve quickly. I had decided if I could not get the part fast I would simply buy another bidet which Amazon Prime could get to me the next day for free.

When I explained this he said no problem and to send him my Amazon order number and a ship-to address. He PROMISED to expedite the plastic piece to me. I asked him if I should send it to the support email and he said no, then provided me with a different email. I explained that I was sending it immediately because I did not want him to have to search for it later. I told him to stand by. This was Thursday morning at 10 am his time in California. I sent him a fully scanned invoice/receipt from Amazon, my ship-to address and a short thank you note. I wanted him to know how much this meant to our family and how much I appreciated his receptiveness at offering a solution. Completely unsolicited, I included a full credit card number of a reloadable Visa card that had $8.50 left on it and encouraged him to run the card for the full amount and tap out the card value. He had never asked and had said he was sending the part free but I wanted to show my appreciation. I had it only 5 weeks, it is a 25 cent piece of plastic and it was supposed to have a 1 year warranty - so I really did expect it free, but still He promised to expedite it to me and I felt they deserved some sort of reimbursement for postage and thats why I sent the credit card number

As I mentioned earlier, I am a working guy that uses all my spare time and money on issues that really need full attention from people that are strictly volunteers. I work 9-5 for peanuts then another 40 hours a week donating my time  and all of my spare peanuts as well  so I am intensely busy. Also, being 60 years old I am not really from the internet generation that wakes up and checks email and Facebook and then again before I go to sleep. Having sent this man at bidet4me all the info he requested AND a credit card number, I assumed I was all set because I did not hear anything back all of Thursday until we went to bed. For the first time since then I signed on this morning to pay some bills (it is Sunday). I opened my email inbox and discovered this company had sent me an email after 11pm that night  nearly 14 hours later and way past normal business hours where I would expect to receive a message that contained information about a requirement for me to act in a time sensitive matter. I like a company that works late and hard like me, but how in the world could they reasonably expect someone to check emails that late and then take action just to begin a process that the customer thought had already been completed?

Here is what it said;
from: Hanna Lama bidet4me
Thu, Sep 10, 2015 at 11:16 PM
subject: Re: I called about the Tee-Valve
Hi, Rob
Below is the link for Tee adapter
(redacted)
I can offer you $12 with 3 Tee adapter ($4 each)...
If you accept, I will send you the credit card form to fill out and I will process the order after payment approved by accounting manager.

Sigh.
I am beyond disappointed in this company and their product. I had a lengthy conversation with their tech department and explained my issue and the importance of getting the part I needed to fix it. I was ASSURED that the part was being sent to me expedited. Instead of getting the product yesterday I instead got an email offering me a link to their online store with an offer to sell me three cheap plastic nuts for 50% of the cost of an entire unit. Then with shipping it would likely have come to > 100% of the cost of the original product since I needed it expedited to me. The bottom line really boils down to a poorly made bidet though. Adding insult to this injury is their actions in standing behind the bidet. Instead of providing what should have been a simple fix they countered with a proposal where they would *sell* me three of the parts that should have been redesigned long ago (and three? why three? I assume they think it is going to go bad again). Further, this proposal would not result in the quick fix I needed, but would come to pass only after some procedure that involves filling out some forms and then needing approval by an accounting manager! They sent this non-solution to me after 11pm on a Thursday. Even in the best of situations this would not have shipped until Monday at the earliest.

I replied with an email stating I was disappointed and would either return it to Amazon if possible or throw it in the trash. I informed them that their charge and service were egregious. I see many other similarly priced bidets offered on Amazon, all with Prime Shipping. The other companies have websites that are written in proper English and support channels that seem extensive. The general build quality on the rest of the bidet is a complete mystery. I cant speak for durability since we only owned it 5 weeks before this part gave out, rendering it 100% inoperable. You know what they say about the chain and its weakest link. In this case even if the main bidet was made to last 100 years  a wholly critical part is simply of unacceptable durability.

Considering the sheer volume of bidets being sold on amazon that seem superior in build and reputation I am pretty upset with myself for choosing bidet4me in the first place. It seems like a haphazard operation that is not capable of providing me with a quality product and support that I have come to expect on amazon. Therefore, I strongly recommend you avoid the bidet4me 100-series and likely all of their other models. Finally, a message to the bidet4me support person that talked to me on the phone -  I want you to know how much your 25 cent nut can actually impact 87 year old woman and her family. I hope you consider this before making promises to the next person that calls for help. That was not cool my friend!

profile.description: Patrice O'Neal is one of the funniest, most respected comedians working today. You know him from his recurring roles on The Office and Arrested Development, as host of VH1's Web Junk 20, as a featured guest on Tough Crowd With Colin Quinn. He also has a hugely-followed podcast and sells out shows across the country. 'Elephant In The Room,' filmed at the New York Comedy Festival, is his first full-length special and is being release extended and uncensored with 40 minutes of content not seen on TV. profile.reviewText:
I've just watched this for the 5th or 6th time. Set aside the fact that I first was introduced to Patrice through O&A (if the boys liked him, us pest were sure to follow) - and set aside the tragedy, hence emotion of his early death - and I still am rating this on my list as the funniest 1:17:00 of comedy ever produced. This is the ONLY routine I have seen in 50 years that I laugh out loud when watching this alone. There is simply no other comedian, film, or set that has ever amused me so much. Perhaps there is a set or two out there from others that had one, two, or even three LOL's for me. "Elephant in the Room" reduced me to the 'blithering idiot' level that I assign other people who LOL. It just is not me.

Except for this set.

I don't think this piece will ever get the attention it deserves where there is universal agreement that this is pure brilliance. I think that's due to Patrice being Patrice. Too many people - generally the stereotypical O&A demographic - never gave Patrice the respect because they only heard a loud black man talking over everyone. They felt he manipulated the show and many classified him as a thug. I too thought he was abrasive and loud the first time I heard him. However, I heard the authentic laughter coming from Anthony and realized I need to listen up. I was a huge Patrice fan from mt second exposure on. I'll step out on a limb and also credit him with the funniest bit in history on O&A - If you did not enjoy "NAZI vs SCHWOOGIE" then in my opinion you just were not listening.

"Elephant in the Room" is probably as good as Patrice was going to be. Sure, he could have produced many more specials just as funny as Elephant. But he was never going to exceed this by much. Perfection is a high bar to set. I'm happy that a guy that struggled for fame because he was simply not willing to be an asskisser, left the world this set as witness to the brilliant talent that was always there. I think a fair and accurate analogy would be if Heath Ledger died before the Joker role. Sure, he had some good performances, but it would have been a tragedy to his legacy if Batman's Joker was not on the resume. Elephant is to Patrice what Joker was to Heath Ledger.
profile.summary: There is Justice it seems that Patrice saw "Elephant in the Room" through completion and Release.

profile.description: The Cat Neater Feeder is perfect for all cat breeds. The Cat Neater Feeder includes two stainless steel 1 cup bowls. The bowls are shallow to accommodate cat-sized portions and allow your cat to eat easily and comfortably. Some cat owners with multiple cats have found the small dog model works better for them. The small dog model is the same size as the cat model, but has deeper bowls.
profile.reviewText:
This review is probably going to help a dog owner that's looking to save money, but it also should help cat owners that worried about all the negative reviews about bowl size. That group may actually decide to get this instead of eliminating it from their choice. And let's face it, there are not really any similar feeders on the market at any price point. It's almost as if the company understands this exclusivity and is taking advantage of dog owners by exploiting this relative shortage of other options. If I was a dog owner and read this review after spending double the amount for the dog bowl I would be very unhappy. The cost difference between a shallow vs standard silver insert bowl is nearly non-existent so does not justify the huge gap in pricing. However, I am not going to believe there is any nefarious reasoning in their marketing strategy, so don't read this as accusatory please.

I love this feeder, but not as it is shipped. It earned 5 stars because I had on hand what I needed to get it into proper working order. The star I removed for ambiguity in pricing was won back by the function of the product. So while one should be warned that this plastic feeder does not look like the image - which makes it look like deep gloss metal - you will love it. If you don't have such deep expectations on appearance alone, this really is a great unit! Don't get me wrong. It looks fantastic for what it is. Plastic can look like garbage or great high quality. This is for sure on the upper end.

I was very concerned that these bowls were not going to hold enough after reading some comments. It would defeat the purpose I had for this feeder if the bowls were not "standard". I did not want to go through the return process so I read the questions and answer section and noticed the Neater Feeder Company Representative had responded to a question about capacity with the suggestion to buy the "small dog" variation. At the time I bought this, the small dog in red was double the price! That's when I dug into the specs and saw that it appeared that the base housing on the variations were exactly the same. However, the food capacity of the dog unit was much larger. Hmm. How can that be? Then I realized it must be a different sized silver insert. As I mentioned, I did not want to have to return it but was much more comfortable that this could be hacked so i took the chance and ordered it.

Turns out my suspicions were accurate.. Therefore, if you are like many pet owners you probably already have extra, deeper silver bowls on hand and thus can use those with this frame. If not, you can find these inserts at Walmart or Dollar stores on the cheap. If you are getting a dog one, buy the cat bowl instead. The silver bowls they ship with the cat version are very shallow variations that I have never seen before. I simply put those in a drawer and used the silver inserts from the elevated bowls I was replacing with this unit. The size of all of these bowls are universal, and the space underneath this feeder is deep enough to accommodate the deeper bowls.

A caveat - when I ordered the red one, it was $20 and the dog one was $40 with the only difference being the size of the cheap silver insert. In that case then doing this hack is a no-brainer. But when I came online to write this review I saw a tan version of the dog bowl that was cheaper than this red cat bowl. In that case it makes sense to buy the tan bowl if you can live with that color. The point is that this hack can work either way so check out all the colors and price iterations of this feeder because you could end up saving as much as 100%.
profile.summary: Bowl capacity stinks! But, here's a HACK

profile.description: Fountain Filter Replacement 3-Pack by Pioneer Pet works in all pet fountains using the pictured filter. Pioneer Pet studies animal behavior and animal needs closely. Moving water attracts pets, encouraging them to drink often to stay hydrated & healthy. A charcoal filter will help remove odors and keep the cat or dogs drinking water clean and fresh. Routine maintenance of replacement filters will extend the life of a pet fountain. Change the filter every two to four weeks, depending on the number of animals using the fountain.
profile.reviewText:
I don't think I got counterfeits since the ones I ordered were sold and shipped by Amazon, however they are terribly defective.

I have been using these filters for over a decade and this is the first time it has been this bad. After getting excessive charcoal after doing my normal pre-rinse I have tried everything up to and including blasting them with an extremely powerful garden hose attachment that would hurt pretty badly if you sprayed it direct on your arm. Not the level of a professional pressure washing kit but pressure that is not found in a typical hose attachment. These are powerful jets in a commercial set up that would probably disintegrate the filters if left in a stream instead of being diffused as a shower. These hoses can strip cat poo off of any surface from 25 feet away..

No matter what I do the charcoal appears in the fountains in less than 24 hours. I have tried all the units in the kit and all are the same. I hope it's a bad batch and not an indication that a lower quality filter has been adopted. The pictures were taken less than 18 hours after extensive attempts at flushing. There is no user error in place here. I have maintained several Pioneer Ceramic fountains for a long time now. I am intimately familiar with the product.

In fact, I spent 3 years hacking these filters by opening them up and replacing both the charcoal and pre filter media with with pieces I cut from large sheets. Our rescue got too big so I did not have the time to keep up with it. However, since I won't use these any more I have already started cutting again so If I have to do it long term due to changes in manufacturing I most certainly will do so. I'm one of those freaks that think most cats are better than most people. Working with emergency rescue cats is a tough and tearful job. I'll be damned if I'm going to let a crappy filter become acceptable. These cats need pure, clean water that's free of particulate - ESPECIALLY visible particulate!

If anyone is curious, the cost of the hack is about 30 cents per filter. For 30 cents you get absolutely perfect filters that are more durable and generous than these OEM's have ever been. When you take the time to make your own - properly - you immediately realize what a complete rip off these replacements are. If we did not have an average of 15 cats at all times with about half being clinically critical at our facility I would never have gone back to these flimsy refill filters.

One filter case, if you are careful with the plastic, will last years. If you are a regular household cat owner or even multi-cat home, once you have a few filter cases on hand to dissect you can, and probably should, fire Pioneer with respect to this faulty replacement media. Your homemade filters will only cost a mere fraction of these, plus, the filler will both last longer and produce much healthier H2O for your kitty. Don't tolerate shedding filters. While not toxic, charcoal is an irritant and not something that people or pets should consume on a daily basis.
profile.summary: Make CERTAIN to check on your new filters within 24 hours or so - see images

top_5.description: With one of these kitties perched on your glass rim, you'll always know which glass is yours! These furry friends are always curious to see what's in your cup, whether it's wine, juice or milk. With six markers, there's enough attitude to go around.
top_5.reviewText:
Sorely disappointed with this purchase. The item shipped does not have the "true zoo" logo on the cat's chest as in the images. If you are thinking it is a positive that the logo is not on there, you are mistaken. The logo served as a design element as well as positive branding. When you buy a pair of Levi Jeans or Nike Shoes you don't wish they had left the logo off. If they did then you might as well buy the $5 Jeans and $5 Sneakers. The same applies to these rubber cats.

This makes them look like 5 cent pencil erasers from the bargain bin after a Walmart Sale. There is no contrast. The features of the cat are muted and lost due to the lack of contrast which also accentuates an incredibly cheap feel to them. At $2 each, this is actually kind of insulting. Even with the total price making this not a huge deal it STILL feels like the absolute worst purchase I have made in years. I'll go spend $12 on a couple of cups of coffee in a few minutes but this $12 infuriates me. I had bought these as a gift for someone who just put in a home wine cellar and I would never in a million years give her this. I gave her a rubber chicken wine stopper so we are not snobs. But I am telling you, these look awful.

As I said, 5 cent, poorly molded rubber erasers is the perfect way to describe them. There are other feline glass markers. If you don't like the other styles just don't get feline glass markers. People who have cats and love cat stuff (me included) will NOT enjoy or appreciate this. Don't force them to feel obligated to use it by giving this as a gift. They will secretly wish you had passed.
top_5.summary: You will NOT be getting what is in the images - I do not recommend this item

This colander is perfect for small kitchens, apartment living, camping and RV's. This colander is so versatile- strain hot cooked food like pasta and potatoes or veggies and all your leafy greens for the healthy salads you should be eating. Buy now!
top_5.reviewText:

I am sure I don't need to tell this to 99% or the regular Amazon base who pays for their items, but we all need to understand that when these people say they are giving an honest review thats not really true. profile.description: After four years of touring and developing "An Unforgettable Tribute to Nat King Cole," the legendary George Benson makes his most inspired album: Inspiration: A Tribute to Nat King Cole. The recording is one of the most meaningful of Benson's career and is a testament to the spirit of Cole's timeless body of work. Benson's heartfelt renditions of some of Cole's greatest songs with Nelson Riddle arrangements and the 42-piece Henry Mancini Institute Orchestra are complemented by duets with Tony Award winner Idina Menzel and rising star Judith Hill, along with a special collaboration with multi-GRAMMY and Pulitzer Prize-winning trumpeter Wynton Marsalis.
profile.reviewText: George Benson has always been a step ahead of the class, as he so cleverly combined Jazz and R&B in the late 70's winning several of his 10 Grammy awards.  This time he has returned to his jazz roots in a very classic way.  This tribute to our other King is simply stupendous. George's vocal talent is immeasurable as he projects Nat's style while adding his own personal nuances.  He is accompanied on several tunes which adds even more diversity to this interpretation of these classic tunes and will make this a much sought after addition to any jazz lover's collection.  George is just "Classic to the Bone" and we love his latest effort to display his creative talents for our enjoyment.
profile.summary: As Always In A Class By Himself

profile.description: 2009 album from the acclaimed French DJ/remixer/producer. Already established in Europe and beyond as a multi-million seller, Guetta has amassed a sizeable U.S. fanbase since his first global dancefloor hit in 2004. With each passing year, this talented Parisian dance music maverick plays to bigger and bigger crowds on the club and festival circuit. One Love is an ambitious ingeniously crafted album that sets forth nothing less than a bold and beautiful manifesto for the global Pop and Dance audiences. With the lead-off single, 'When Love Takes Over' (featuring Kelly Rowland) hitting the top of the Billboard club chart, Guetta has firmly planted the flag of success on the nation's Pop landscape.
profile.reviewText:
This joint is HOT! to say the least and David Guetta definately knows house, dance, techno with this offering with plenty of hot typically R&B artist who truly represent their craft.  First I must mention,  Kelly Rowland who truly has is making a name for herself in the genre.  "When Love Takes Over" which I first heard as she performed it at the 2009 Mobo Awards, which was spectacular,  amidst speculation there were difficulties with the vocals. However, that particular part looked scripted because the lyrics fit her body language, after which she But she ripped it, when she hit that high, long note as the song began to climax, it sent the crowd and me into a frenzy. Search Kelly Rowland MOBO 2009 to see for yourself but all I can say about the performance is "YOU SEND ME".  Choose a duo with Kelly and Neyo is reminiscent of Shalamar.  It is definately one of my favorite. Sexy Chic with Akon is #1 in the UK and Kid Cudi is yet another that will fastly move up the charts.  The title track "One Love" with Estelle.  Wil.li.am makes a contribution with Fire on the Dance Floor. This disc with certainly offer enough friction for any fire.  My biggest problem is that I can't get past the first 6 tracks to hear the entire disc without hitting repeat but in time I will get around to hearing all the tracks more than enough.
If you like to dance you will love this disc.
Enjoy!
profile.summary: Guetta, Now! "Strictly For Those Who Belong"

profile.description: The rapper responsible for the hits "Holla, Holla", "Between Me & You", & "I'm Real" feat. J-Lo returns with his sixth album. "I Wonder" the first single features none other than R. Kelly and Ashanti.
profile.reviewText: From the intro to the outro Ja and his collaborators are consistant with the hot beats, rhymes, vocals and flow.  I have to admit there is not a track on this one that I have to skip. That is truly a rarity. And that Lloyd is the next Usher if he is marketed & produced properly(U Heard It Here First).  Ashanti, Kelly & Rule certainly nice on the collabo. I look forward to her new joint. The cover is like that.  It is a shame that we have so many R&B diva's on the scene at the same time it is hard to stay focused but we feel you ma.  I am really feelin' this one, Ja.  Stay tru to da game soldier......... This is his best yet, then, Blood In My Eye,  Love is Pain, Venni.... in that order
profile.summary: Ja Returns with more flow

profile.description: The 2008 self-titled debut album of Jennifer Kate Hudson reflects her high-powered soulful style voice which is transcendent and timeless. Guests features on the album include Fantasia on "I'm His Only Woman", Ludacris on "Pocketbook", plus the highlights version of "And I am Telling You I'm Not Going" from Dreamgirls. Jennifer first gained notice as one of the finalists on the third season of the FOX television series American Idol. She went on to star as Effie White in the 2006 motion picture adaptation of the musical Dreamgirls for which she won numerous awards including an Academy Award, a Golden Globe Award, a BAFTA and a SAG Award. 13 tracks.
profile.reviewText:
well I really expected more from this CD in regard to collabo's.  The T-Pain is nice, the Luda is cute; pocketbook. But I wished there was a collabo with Dwele, Donnell Jones, Lloyd or even one of our more seasoned ballader's like Maxwell,Joe, Avant, Brian McKnight, etc. With Clive Davis, as executive producer, there should not have been a budget crisis  Her Dreamgirl's fame should have warranted big production credits to make the album a spotlight release.  There was enough publicity to make this a number one release.  Don't get me wrong I love Fantasia, but that the boy is mine, has been done, remember Brandy & Monica, then Whitney & Deborah Cox. Besides the arrangement didn't highlight any new technique.  You would think these CEO's could be a little more imaginative.  The song Spotlight is really the hightlight of the CD.

I think Jennifer deserves better, shame on you Clive.
profile.summary: Super Potential With No Support

profile.description: International version includes one bonus track, 'Spending Money'. First thing's first. The Black Eyed Peas are not breaking up. Will. I. am, frontman and producer behind the multi-platinum group, wants to get that out of the way right from the start. "We're not going anywhere," he says, by way of introducing his new solo album, SONGS ABOUT GIRLS. "I made the choice in high school to be with a crew and that's never going to change. It was just really important for me to try some things out on my own, with my own artistry and imagination. " That sort of adventurous spirit is what flows throughout SONGS ABOUT GIRLS. Will has previously released two compilations of production projects on British label BBE Records but SONGS ABOUT GIRLS is the first effort outside of the Peas to really harness all his creative energies. Indeed, the process of creating this album has re-ignited a lot of his creative spirit. "It really made me aware of how much is possible musically," he says. Will shot an accompanying movie for SONGS ABOUT GIRLS, set in Brazil. He has plans to do anther solo album that will serve as that movie's soundtrack. And he will soon go back into the studio with apl. De. # ap, Taboo, and Fergie for the next Black Eyed Peas album.
profile.reviewText:
Well when an artist has as much exposure through collaborations, associations and affiliations you sometimes wonder when and if they do a solo album what will be their focus. Well for Will.i.am, I think he stayed true to himself and crafted a well mixed collection of Pop, hip-hop and rock inspired selections that go from warm to hot by the time you reach the end of the journey. I am dubbing him Prince of Hip Pop & Soul because he is the only man on the scene who can rap, sing simultaneously as well as he does, not to mention writing and producing. This is a well orchestrated concept album that states true to form and explore a range of relationship oriented topics.  I Got It From My Mama, Donque Song and Get Your Money and probably the least tasteful of the bunch; from my personal perspective.  Yet still catchy, nice production and vocals for those who have a tolerance or preferance for those type of songs.  But tracks 7 through 15 are simply on fire and the last song simply verified why he is considered to be a musical genious.  Honestly, he did not forget about anyone on this project.  Love it or hate it but he has lived up to his reputation and still in the vain of the Blackeye Pea's.  "I Can't Wait", will definately be a hit in the House & Dance Club scene, as well as, "Make It Funky" in the Club Music & Hip-Hop Scene.  Invisible and Fantastic are just incredible lyrically, vocally and musically. As many Fly Girl songs as there have been over the years, he still manages to make it a fresh them, I thought the lyrics and production were clever.  She's A Star has that same kind of fresh appeal from a them that no doubt has been out there for a while.  And that is the novelty of a top notch producer, he is one who can take the old and make it feel new. SOS is like such a moving reflective piece that it opens the man up and lets you inside of who he really is.  BIG UP's to Will. I. Am
Don't Sleep.
profile.summary: Prince of Hip-Pop & Soul

profile.description: 2013 album from the R&B vocalist. With sophistication and passion, Donell Jones gives fans Forever, his sixth album, which features serenade-like songs about love, milestones and even matrimony. "It's a heartfelt album about where I am in my life right now." Donell started his professional career in 1992, making him a twenty-one year veteran who has written hits for everyone from Usher to Brownstone to 702. In 1996 he released his first album titled My Heart and three years later Where I Wanna Be, which went platinum. Four subsequent albums gained good positions in the Billboard 200 album charts, with 2002's Life Goes On reaching No.2. Several tracks have performed well in the singles chart, including his cover of Stevie Wonder's "Knocks Me Off My Feet" and "U Know What's Up", collaboration with Lisa "Left-Eye" Lopes.
profile.reviewText: This is a celebration for Donnell and it is very obvious from the title, Forever, and all of the subsequent tracks.  I have always found Donnell to be quite sincere in his delivery from his day beau, and the memorable verse, You Know that I Love You" comes to mind when I think of his discography.  He never disappoints and this addition is no exception.  "You Know" and "RIde This" shows a more current approach to his music and vocal style.  While Forever, Closer I get to you, beautiful, & Don't blame me are unforgettable and reminiscent of the style he is known to present.  "I Miss the King", a tribute to Michael Jackson, is a great honor for all of the people; especially young artist who he has inspired.  Step the F Off is a bit controversial and I can bet it is responsible for the less than 5 star collective rating, but I think it is good to express  the gritty side of love.  I'm So Gone" is an experimental tune that ventures into the pop realm; yet, Donnell makes it catchy and memorable.  He finishes with "A Mother's Love",  this will be a tune for memorable occasions; especially, Mother's Day, Birthday's and other holidays.
profile.summary: Donnell is still from Da Heart with Forever!

profile.description: 2009 release from the Soul/R&B vocalist, produced by the legendary Leon Sylvers. On this exciting album, N'Dambi ingeniously distills Soul-deep inspiration into a sensual style of elegance and power, making her a fundamental new addition to the Stax legacy. She originally began her career performing back-up for Erykah Badu, but over the years has built up a fiercely loyal fan base with her previous releases Little Lost Girl Blues, Tunin' Up & Cosignin' and A Weird Kinda Wonderful.
profile.reviewText: Despite the less than complementary reviews,  Pink Elephant has a funky soul feel with melodies that bring back memories and N'D AMBI displays her vocal power and range on tracks like Nobody Jones.  The release has a smooth mellow vibe track to track draws you into her world.  She balances uptempo, mid and balads very well.  Favorite for playlist at dinner parties or other social gatherings .  Like the track Mind Blowin', it is hard not to feel the vibe. "Take It Out" expresses vunerability and strength with lyrics meant to sooth. Daisy Chain is cross genre with the blues.  Can't Hardly Wait, is so raw and real that there is no denying has a message in her music. She finishes up the project with World is a Beat and Imitator; one uptempto pop and the other of a love gone wrong.  Last but not least Free Fallin' a bluesay number with a rump a tomp tomp.  I would highly recommend N'D AMBI.
profile.summary: I Beg To DIffer!

profile.description: Mos Def has proven he is truly the renaissance artist of the 21st century by using his multiple talents to achieve success not only in music but also crossing over into Film (16 Blocks, The Italian Job, Monster's Ball), Television ('Def Poetry Jam,' 'Chappelle's Show,' 'Something the Lord Made'), and even reaching critical acclaim on Broadway ('Top Dog Underdog'). Mos Def returns with his third album, True Magic Expliciy LP and uses his artistry to speak about the subject of hip hop, the feeding frenzy it generates and questions what its success has created.
profile.reviewText:
Man with this project as well as Talib out together it is like having two BlackStar projects at once and so it is.  Mos Def is truly a freedom fighter, prolific, outspoken and unapologetic.  He lyrically projects the recipe we need to begin to change our disposition. He has so much insight just think back to New Danger his last project he virtually predicted the type of murder suicide that we are seeing today at these schools but just check out the caption.  He is a true visionary an outspoken human being who is way ahead of his time, a prophet in the flesh, because it is infact the New Danger.  Everytime, I hear about these tragedies I see that caption an understand its significance.  When the children feel like their only way out is to destroy their fellow classmates, rolemodels and classmates; we realize how much we need to examine our values.  His message sometimes subliminal and other times forthright identifies the Fake Bonanza we all experience.  The last few tracks his portrays a town crier, when he chants about FREEEEDOM.  He mimics Bob Marley and I couldn't think of a better man for the job.  Thanks Mos Definately for all that you do and your portrayal as an African Immigrant working as a dishwasher in Journey Until The End of the Night was stellar.  Keep Doin' You, Def.  Hopefully you  will stumble upon this and continue to be inspired.
Peace
profile.summary: He Is Undeniably Untouchable

profile.reviewText: I bought this CD because I am from VA and wanted to show support.  And I got what I expected more of the same.  The highlight of this is no. 8.  A Woman's Hand.  I mean he gets 2 stars for that song alone. It is well written, sung and more of the type of lyrics we as artist and audiences should support.  But Just Wanna Cut is the type of language many seek.  And to be honest, I am growing more tired by these types of songs.  We all know of the pleasures of intimacy, sex and the like.  If not another song was made with that type of content it would be too soon. And why tell me, why drag the Queen of Soul into this.  She has a legacy, career track record that you could not attain in a million years.  So next time,  get a more logical, reasonable sponsor. Geezz. This 10 dollars I could have bought??????anything! I gotta make it? profile.reviewText: No matter what you think of her.  She is one of the greatest voices of all time. No one else that I have heard can SANG as many standards as she, can so poignant, pronouncing every syllable so clearly yet effortlessly with power and compassion.(ex. Oh Emanuel.  God Bless her she sends chills through my body and I really can't think of another artist who can do this maybe old school Aretha.  But God knows he surely put some powerful cords in that petite frame of her's.  And I can't think of anyone else who can honestly touch her to put it honestly and frankly (not even Mariah) yea Mariah  she can hit some high notes but sanging with the depth, power and passion that Whitney does is all together a different story.  And I think it is credible coming from me because I don't review music based on my personal likes or dislikes of someone's personal life.  I will say one thing I hope Bobby will take a GOOD Look at what he has next to him and wake up to a new day, BECAUSE WHITNEY HOUSTON IS ONE SANGIN B......(And I mean that with the UTMOST RESPECT but I got to keep it real.  WE LUV U WHITNEY. PLEASE, SANG IT FOR ME BABY GIRL.  I'M OUT..........JUST LISTEN TO OH EMANUEL and turn it up real loud.

profile.description: With lyrics that range from the classic battle rap to emotionally charged socially conscious commentary, Talib is an intelligent wordsmith who has the knack for bridging the gaps between hiphop fans of all types. With the respect of his colleagues and hip-hop fans around the world, this new release from Kweli will without a doubt be met with a huge buzz on the street garnering critical acclaim as a hip-hop classic. Koch. 2005.
profile.reviewText: Peace To Da Gods for letting use still be able to get some substance in our music.  Talib is helping us with that on this one.  Drugs, Basketball, Sex is one of my favorites, Ms. Hill, Supreme Supreme, and of course the callabo's with two of my favorite MC's Doom & Jean Grae (who are finally getting some recognition in the mainstream arena).  I think this one is his best being less abstract in concept.  "The Beautiful Struggle"  stretched beyond what some could digest, but personally I loved it.  If you liked this CD you should definately pick up the new J-Live,(The Hereafter)please support this underground artist because he is raising some poignant issues,get all his joints as a matter of fact, it has the same level of consciousness, beats, flow and greatness.  Peace Yall.
profile.summary: Kweli Back In "Rare Form"

profile.description: Explicit Version. NAS is back and more controversial than ever on his 2008 release, his 9th studio album. Nas studies and lyrically dissects some of the our most divisive issues: race, inequality, poverty, and power. And who better to stir up debate than the man most consider one of the top five emcees in the history of the game? From his brilliant 1994 debut to his mainstream success with It Was Written, to anthems like 'Hate Me Now' and 'One Mic' and his venomous lyricism on 'Ether,' Nas' ability to tell stories, educate, make you dance and make you look is the stuff of Rap legend. The outspoken Queensbridge rapper has sold over 15 million albums worldwide over the course of his storied career. Nas' Def Jam debut, Hip-Hop Is Dead, was released in December 2006 and debuted at #1 on the Billboard 200 with over 350,000 copies sold in its first week.
profile.reviewText:
Nas is as real as Ice Water and you better bring a life preserver if you think you can tread water behind him ask Jay-Z after Ether.  He soon reconciled and recruited this mad lyricist to his camp.  I could say many positive things about this brother and the most important I feel is that he has stayed grounded and been about the Revolution.  He is even much more prolific and resolute as he matures just like fine wine. And he is taking the news media to task as he should because that is the real purpose for rap music that has grown into Hip-Hop.  Nas is ole school, he is a Rapper, he is not looking for you to drop and pop it to his offerings he wants you to pay attention to his words of wisdom and carry the torch of righteousness/fairness and equality.
I was so pleased when I saw in the Baltimore Examiner' a published  story about his song Sly Fox, recanting their negative coverage of news regarding the Black community.  It shows that they are paying attention and that is the true purpose of this art form.  They stated that the protest outside of the New York station was unlikely to affect their feature articles in the future but I beg to differ.  Regardless, the news media responded when they were called on the carpet and that is the beginning to making young Rappers understand the strength and purpose of their music and lyrics, as well as to call them to task to be conscious of their lyrical content because it makes a difference.  NAS IS A LEADER FOR THE RAP/HIP-HOP COMMUNITY.  Much Love to the King Nas and his Queen Kelis.
profile.summary: Commericial Hip-Hop's Saving Grace

profile.description: Shanice, formerly Shanice Wilson, is a Grammy nominated artist with #1 singles and gold albums to her credit. Boasting a five octave voice, it's good to know she's back on the music scene after a five year hiatus. She brings a more adult flavor to this new set of sexy songs. Every Woman Dreams, is a solid blend that ranges from funky, uptempo grooves that feed the sexual palate, to beautiful full bodied ballads. Play Time Records. 2006.
profile.reviewText:
This is a black celebrity success story we who enjoy great R&B, as well as,those who appreciate love stories should applaud.  Every since I first had the pleasure of hearing "I Love Your Smile",her debut single. I knew that she was a very special young lady and always thought she might get hurt if she attracted the wrong guy because of her ultrasweet persona.  Despite the disappointment of her previous relationships, she took her vows with Flex, who is a cool bro, often times hilarious and seems to really appreciate the love they share. This album is dedicated to that union, as well as, her dear friend she mentions on the insert.  The writing is incredible, original style about everyday issues but not too complex.  That is a difficult task these days. All of the tracks on this joint flow and educate; Shanice has a lot to say, so listen up, listen closely.  The intro & outro are so profound. She is really standing her ground and her spoken word technique is elevating.  Anyone who really likes good music and not a lot of hype whould appreciate.  Two pop/commerical tracks and the remainder are uptempo contemporary R&B with a couple of love ballads.  The photo on the back of the insert, where she is setting down spells DIVA.  I mean when it is there it always shows.  A great formula.  And in the words of WENDY WILLIAMS (I believe that is her voice on the interlude) "YOU BETTER GO SHANICE KNOX".  Much love to you, Flex and the babies.
 Track Ratings  1-lowest  5-highest
Intro- I didn't know Shanice had such an incredible spoken-word
vocal presence but she shines from the opening and also on the outro.

 -Get Up- typical pop type single 3.5
 -Every Women Dreams- hot, hot, hot, lyrics, vocals superb. 5+
 -Things In the Movies- unique and true 5+
 -Keep It To Yourself- true, unique, hot track and vocals. 5+
 -Take Care Of You- reminds me of Destiny' CHild Cater to U, regardless her vocals, track and melody are just insatiable. 5+
 -So Sexy - is definately my least favorite track but I understand she has a track on her for teen appeal sounds alot like a Ciara type track. 3
 -That's Why I Love U- I just love the mystic of the track at the beginning just the music plays like a solo before the vocals and then it lays out so smooth--HOT 5+(Flex With Da Magic)

-Crazy 4 U- wow a top ten pop single-simple, straight-forward all about love, sang so sweetly  5+
 -So Free-Wonderful track and lyrics something just for Shanice and the joy she is feeling for being herself as expressed throughout the song.  5+
 -Chocolate- so sweet, special unique, track, hynotic and lyrics
 -Forever Like a Rose- such a special tribute to he love and an incredible song 5+
 -Loving U- classic Minnie Riperton track sung by Shanice beautifully,using that 5 octave range.  5+
 -Can't Imagine- another wonderful track expressed only the way a gifted artist like Shanice could do--she is sooooooooo special.
 -Joy-man, no words can truly express the essence of this song in compliation of all the other songs before it on this project which interconnects with them and is simply why this is such an exceptional R&B project.  Shanice is the primary writer on all of these tracks and it is simple a beautiful thing, since these experiences are coming from her heart. 5+ (Gifted Writer)
-Loving You- She loves that man and that is just that.  And we love you, Shanice. Do Your Thing...5+
Outro--Like she says built to last--PUT IT ON BLAST!!!!!!!!!!!!
PLEASE BELIEVE.
profile.summary: GROWN & EXTRA SPECIAL

profile.description: Japanese Release featuring Two Bonus Tracks: "i'm Here", and "Put Your Hands On".
profile.reviewText: First I have to say I love Janet topfull or less.  Okay.  But I wouldn't say she had a good CD just because I do love her.  But this product is so full of energy, excitement and full of passion that it would be very difficult for even the most pessimistic reviewer to ignore.  First is starts out with a personal statement from Janet about people, all of us, and leads into "Damita Jo" which is a hot banger and signature song, then Sexhibition in which Janet takes a light approach on the subject of sex, she ends stating "Relax its just Sex". I'm feelin you Janet, we do make more out of it than it is when it is only a human exercise to exert energy,  then La la la la la Strawberry Bounce with Jay-Z, who I sort of lost it for, adding the hook BOUNCE...( blazin' hot track), My Baby with Kaniye West( got's to give the bro his props, he is doing things in a major way and is a perfect addition to this hot mid-tempo number, the islands and Spending Time(easy and tranquil tracks), magic hour and island life (timing, flow and mood all so perfectly centered for this product), All Night (this is sick) according to Janet who is on point in her characterization of this track, R& B junkie and I Want You, Like You Don't Love Me on until the final track of this lengthy but well prepared CD will make you fall in Love with Janet all over again.  I was beginning to think that her best days with the dynamic duo Jimmy & Terry had reach their peek but this product definately make me recant my previous sentiment.  Definately better that All For You.........and it make be one of her most memorable productions yet.  We Love You Janet.........
profile.summary: Damita Jo is Janet's Intimate Signature

profile.description: On December 14th, Ashanti proves again that there is power found in her musical phenomenon. On this, her trinity release, CONCRETE ROSE. This is a creative combination of her freshman and sophomore albums. Ashanti merges her profound writing abilities, the stellar production of The Inc. Records CEO Irv Gotti and Seven, and collaborations with Ja Rule & Lloyd to create this masterpiece. The first single, 'Only U' is a high energy R&B/rhythmic crossover mix and impacts the first week in October. Ashanti is back to once again prove why she is by far one of today's most sought after and intriguing female entertainers of this decade.
profile.reviewText:
First off let me say that I waited to listen to this joint several times before writing a review because I knew it would be under intense scrutiny. So I listened to it until it was subconsciously mute to my conscious mind.  Well let me say that Ashanti definately represented for hip hop and R&B.  (1)The intro. is very smooth, inviting, explains and defines the title & concept of the project/CD.  The second track begins with a base line that immediately signals that it is a Banger, TI represents and Ashanti's smooth, soft & sentual voice proclaims "are still down for a girl like me" with so much definition and curiousity. And to answer your question girl, YES WE ARE STILL DOWN.  It is definitely off to a good start.  (3)Then message to the fans is so cleaverly crafted from the ambiance of the video which she is so effortless, breathless and states "I just want you to know.... so reminiscent of Sade "her looks and smooth disposition/style", I actually thought she was her daughter when she came out because of her cool demeanor and beauty (4) Only You..........is all that.....a banging track, base line, and Ashanti sanging with conviction, riffs, sweet melodies and burst of exclamations.  It is off da hook and will definately heat up the club scene.  (5) Focus- futurist beat, tempo with a catchy hook and a well defined message, a nice mid- tempo track (6) Don't Let Them is just another one of those R&B tracks done Princess style, Just HOT!(7)Love Again just stating her claim, In Love Again some sexy sh..t(8)Take Me Tonight w/Lloyd (the boy got pipes) he is the next Usher,  mark my word on that. Their voices blend together in perfect harmony just like on Southside (LLoyd's Joint) (9)U- Consistent with the flow of the project and furthering her life lesssons and feelings of love and ecstacy(10) Every little thing.... is just my joint for real though, I just love it and anticipate it whenever it is upcoming when listenin to this joint (11)Turn It Up- One of those party anthem's tracks with Rule and vocals by Ashanti just fire! (12) Skit Buck 3000 (13)So Hot typical type track for this artist(appropriate) (14)Don't Leave me Alone! We won't baby girl! I love this track,  OH MAN (15) Sister (16) Freedom - powerful track with nice vocals I love this one too. (17) Wonderful Remix Hot! Hot! Hot!

Shanti definately gets rave reviews on this one.  Chapter II was disappointing,  but I was still there and happy to see that the Princess recouped.  Regarding the Queen of Soul Award it was appropriate because a queen must be a princess first and what that award signify's was her, Ashanti, abilities as a song writer, vocalist and producer.  She possess all those attributes. So she deserves that title and Rule coined it right.  Princess of Hip Hop & R&B

Just a little INC. report card for the year 2004 three hot joints: Lloyd, Rule and know Shanti.  I stay parcial to all the drama and only look at it from a musical point of view.  And for all the haters, Just Hit replay.

I Quit.
profile.summary: Hip Hop Princess Dubbed Correctly

profile.description: One of rap's finest emcees, J-Live has been exemplifying greatness since his start when he was featured in The Source magazine's 'Unsigned Hype' column in the mid '90s. Now firmly established and respected in the underground community, and having worked with luminaries Handsome Boy Modeling School, Jazzy Jeff, Prince Paul, DJ Premier and Pete Rock. Penalty. 2005.
profile.reviewText:
J-Live has surpassed my level of expectations and has raised the bar for the hiphop community.  From my perspective, he is now the barometer in which I will rate forthcoming hiphop/rap CD's.  Its just that serious.  The brother has exponded on some serious issues with the depth that I have been seeking from this genre.  Just listen to what he is saying about our lives and realize that this artist has a level of commitment that is almost unthought of today.  The beats, tracks, flow, delivery and knowledge is TIGHT------. You know it from the onset of the first track.(BOOM-BOOM-BOOM-BOOM)

His first joint "Always Has Been"(almost killed him) set him into motion which had serious beats and tracks but did not get quite deep as his second offering "All of the Above"(almost killed him) we began to touch upon his devotion to what this genre is really supposed to be about: teaching,life lessons, past discretions and new directions.  You Get The Grammy.  I have been listening to Kweli, Haiku D'Tet, and this joint they are all on the level but you just went a little deeper.  Thanks J-Live. If you like real, authentic, organic hip hop you better run get this joint. On Second thought "Get ALL THREE" UNDERGROUND (underwater) CLASSICS.  I can't believe the reviewers who say they love J are rating this offering so low.  It really is his best All of the Above is running a close second. And for all of you reviewers who feels this offering does not suffice, maybe you need to go get some of that new dirty south, so you can come back to J- Humbly.  And for Saltzman(reviewer), you lack direction, how much do you really know about the life of the bonafide rap community, not the johnny come lately riders or lifelong suburbanite who suddenly moved to the city and listens to hip hop (commercially used terminology which is really RAP MUSIC)  because they are trying to be down.  But those who can go back to Furious Five(5), Fab 5 Freddy, Curtis Blow, Kool Moe D, Run DMC, or oldschool LL back in the day.  Make sure you know the history of this before you start to use words like direction.  Because J's direction is clear, listen to Brooklyn Public, Sidewalk, Audio Visual, and  Weather The Storm, (those are enough to get you started.  The rest of the joints like Here, Aaw Yeah, Do My Thing, Firewater, and Whoever just establish his presence, help to develop a visual portrait and outlines his philosophical perspective. (if that is not direction, then what is? Coming Home(which is a banger feature Dwele) and Thereafter just put the icing on the cake. And for those who feels that The Listening is there favorite track.  Well, I guess it doesn't take much for you.  I am feeling that selection,  but I put it on the level of an interlude.  Sometimes I wonder, if there is really more lead in the water than first suspected.  Go Get This Classic TruHop Music. To all of you 4 STAR REVIEWS stop cheatin J out of the credit he deserves for this phenonmenal project.  It really pisses me off as challenging as it is for an underground artist with substance is to get respect.  You all should be ashamed because I am.  If you should read this J-Live: U WAXED IT!
profile.summary: 10 Stars- UNDERGROUND GRAMMY CD - 2005- IT'S OFFICIAL

profile.description: The Love Experience showcases Devaughn's eclectic musical approach, with influences raging from classic soul (Marvin Gaye, Donnie Hathaway) to rock. From the old-school R&B groove of the first single 'Guess Who Loves You More' to the pop guitar of 'Cadillac' to the string-heavy romance of 'Breathe', the album showcases a hybrid of styles. Jive. 2005.
profile.reviewText: Yea Guess Who Loves You More and Just Wondering and Believe are nice but the problem with this is that all the songs sort of sound alike so it is hard to distinguish one melody from the other at time.  Like I could put the lyrics from one song into the other and it would not create a noticable difference.  I like his style and flow but he needs to work on creating tracks that have a different musical orientation, more variety. On two tracks in particular, You and Is It Possible, the hook is sort of the song and gets repeated excessively. For instance, like what Kanye is doing with he new CD Late Registration ( of course it is not out yet but if you look at the credits you can see that he has collaborated with a pop producer and many different types of artist. So you see he is attempting to have a variety of sounds/styles) A few of the tracks were sort of like fillers and take you away from the flow of the CD especially towards the end almost like he was running out of his good stuff(material).  Some mind wandering and then he hits you with one of the familiar tracks that we love.  I giving this a very solid 4 stars.  My favorites are:  Believe, Guess Who Loves U More and  Sweet Tooth.
profile.summary: Solid Debut Collectors Item

profile.description: Zion-I's new album, True & Livin, is the Oakland based duos third full-length release. Organic soulful compositions, conscious and insightful vocal wordplay and lush strings, horns and bass lines comprise the fabric of their best album to date. In the vein of OutKast and The Roots, Zion-I have successfully cultivated legions of fans equally impressed by their amazing live stage show as their superb recorded material. Composed of producer Amp Live and emcee Zion and featuring Talib Kweli, Gift of Gab (Blackalicious), Del (The Funky Homosapien) and Aesop Rock, True & Livin will continue to prove that quality, musical Hip-Hop will prevail!
profile.reviewText:
These brothers are so intelegent that their material could be the subject of books because their introspection is so clear, relevant and thoughtprovoking.  Mindover Matter was mindblowing and True & Livin is another head banger-lyrically and well as musically. I have the highest respect for brothers whose music is so evidently focused on the state of our community.  They are consistent track after track that you know some serious thought was put into the material.  As long as you keep making this kind of music you will always have a serious committed fan base.  The tracks are so progressive, accentuating the interpretation of the lyrics.  This is definately an asset because many artist in this genre have hard beats, and nice tracks overshadowing the lyrics, mostly because they aren't saying anything anyway and they know it themselves.  The fans then just focus on the track and tune out the message which is a blur.  Not Zion I, they enunciate, pronounce and showcase their lyrics to complement the track so your head can nod, with your third eye open,  all in unison.  They are phenomenal, complete and a complement to the Hip Hop Nation.  Truthfully they are the toast, butter and any flavor marmalade you could wish.
WORD
profile.summary: Consciously Focused Hip Hop Legends

top_5.description: After four years of touring and developing "An Unforgettable Tribute to Nat King Cole," the legendary George Benson makes his most inspired album: Inspiration: A Tribute to Nat King Cole. The recording is one of the most meaningful of Benson's career and is a testament to the spirit of Cole's timeless body of work. Benson's heartfelt renditions of some of Cole's greatest songs with Nelson Riddle arrangements and the 42-piece Henry Mancini Institute Orchestra are complemented by duets with Tony Award winner Idina Menzel and rising star Judith Hill, along with a special collaboration with multi-GRAMMY and Pulitzer Prize-winning trumpeter Wynton Marsalis.
top_5.reviewText: George Benson has always been a step ahead of the class, as he so cleverly combined Jazz and R&B in the late 70's winning several of his 10 Grammy awards.  This time he has returned to his jazz roots in a very classic way.  This tribute to our other King is simply stupendous. George's vocal talent is immeasurable as he projects Nat's style while adding his own personal nuances.  He is accompanied on several tunes which adds even more diversity to this interpretation of these classic tunes and will make this a much sought after addition to any jazz lover's collection.  George is just "Classic to the Bone" and we love his latest effort to display his creative talents for our enjoyment.
top_5.summary: As Always In A Class By Himself

top_5.description: 2009 album from the acclaimed French DJ/remixer/producer. Already established in Europe and beyond as a multi-million seller, Guetta has amassed a sizeable U.S. fanbase since his first global dancefloor hit in 2004. With each passing year, this talented Parisian dance music maverick plays to bigger and bigger crowds on the club and festival circuit. One Love is an ambitious ingeniously crafted album that sets forth nothing less than a bold and beautiful manifesto for the global Pop and Dance audiences. With the lead-off single, 'When Love Takes Over' (featuring Kelly Rowland) hitting the top of the Billboard club chart, Guetta has firmly planted the flag of success on the nation's Pop landscape.
top_5.reviewText:
This joint is HOT! to say the least and David Guetta definately knows house, dance, techno with this offering with plenty of hot typically R&B artist who truly represent their craft.  First I must mention,  Kelly Rowland who truly has is making a name for herself in the genre.  "When Love Takes Over" which I first heard as she performed it at the 2009 Mobo Awards, which was spectacular,  amidst speculation there were difficulties with the vocals. However, that particular part looked scripted because the lyrics fit her body language, after which she But she ripped it, when she hit that high, long note as the song began to climax, it sent the crowd and me into a frenzy. Search Kelly Rowland MOBO 2009 to see for yourself but all I can say about the performance is "YOU SEND ME".  Choose a duo with Kelly and Neyo is reminiscent of Shalamar.  It is definately one of my favorite. Sexy Chic with Akon is #1 in the UK and Kid Cudi is yet another that will fastly move up the charts.  The title track "One Love" with Estelle.  Wil.li.am makes a contribution with Fire on the Dance Floor. This disc with certainly offer enough friction for any fire.  My biggest problem is that I can't get past the first 6 tracks to hear the entire disc without hitting repeat but in time I will get around to hearing all the tracks more than enough.
If you like to dance you will love this disc.
Enjoy!
top_5.summary: Guetta, Now! "Strictly For Those Who Belong"

top_5.description: The rapper responsible for the hits "Holla, Holla", "Between Me & You", & "I'm Real" feat. J-Lo returns with his sixth album. "I Wonder" the first single features none other than R. Kelly and Ashanti.
top_5.reviewText: From the intro to the outro Ja and his collaborators are consistant with the hot beats, rhymes, vocals and flow.  I have to admit there is not a track on this one that I have to skip. That is truly a rarity. And that Lloyd is the next Usher if he is marketed & produced properly(U Heard It Here First).  Ashanti, Kelly & Rule certainly nice on the collabo. I look forward to her new joint. The cover is like that.  It is a shame that we have so many R&B diva's on the scene at the same time it is hard to stay focused but we feel you ma.  I am really feelin' this one, Ja.  Stay tru to da game soldier......... This is his best yet, then, Blood In My Eye,  Love is Pain, Venni.... in that order
top_5.summary: Ja Returns with more flow

top_5.description: The 2008 self-titled debut album of Jennifer Kate Hudson reflects her high-powered soulful style voice which is transcendent and timeless. Guests features on the album include Fantasia on "I'm His Only Woman", Ludacris on "Pocketbook", plus the highlights version of "And I am Telling You I'm Not Going" from Dreamgirls. Jennifer first gained notice as one of the finalists on the third season of the FOX television series American Idol. She went on to star as Effie White in the 2006 motion picture adaptation of the musical Dreamgirls for which she won numerous awards including an Academy Award, a Golden Globe Award, a BAFTA and a SAG Award. 13 tracks.
top_5.reviewText:
well I really expected more from this CD in regard to collabo's.  The T-Pain is nice, the Luda is cute; pocketbook. But I wished there was a collabo with Dwele, Donnell Jones, Lloyd or even one of our more seasoned ballader's like Maxwell,Joe, Avant, Brian McKnight, etc. With Clive Davis, as executive producer, there should not have been a budget crisis  Her Dreamgirl's fame should have warranted big production credits to make the album a spotlight release.  There was enough publicity to make this a number one release.  Don't get me wrong I love Fantasia, but that the boy is mine, has been done, remember Brandy & Monica, then Whitney & Deborah Cox. Besides the arrangement didn't highlight any new technique.  You would think these CEO's could be a little more imaginative.  The song Spotlight is really the hightlight of the CD.

I think Jennifer deserves better, shame on you Clive.
top_5.summary: Super Potential With No Support

top_5.description: International version includes one bonus track, 'Spending Money'. First thing's first. The Black Eyed Peas are not breaking up. Will. I. am, frontman and producer behind the multi-platinum group, wants to get that out of the way right from the start. "We're not going anywhere," he says, by way of introducing his new solo album, SONGS ABOUT GIRLS. "I made the choice in high school to be with a crew and that's never going to change. It was just really important for me to try some things out on my own, with my own artistry and imagination. " That sort of adventurous spirit is what flows throughout SONGS ABOUT GIRLS. Will has previously released two compilations of production projects on British label BBE Records but SONGS ABOUT GIRLS is the first effort outside of the Peas to really harness all his creative energies. profile.description: Zane Grey true story of his adventures roping Mountain Lions in the Grand Canyon.
profile.reviewText: I am looking at my G & D edition of this book as I write this review.  I have had it for more than 30 years.  Orange cover with black lettering and a mountain lion screaming as it looks over a canyon ledge.  In side the fronstpiece are two pictures of one of the cats they captured, Billy; and it is illustrated with many photographs which Zane Grey took himself.  Roping Lions in the Grand Canyon is Zane Grey's telling of his first adventure out west with Buffalo Jones in 1907 and the antecedent of the book, The Young Lion Hunter, which was fiction; this one is fact and uses information Zane Grey had written in The Last of the Plainsmen, the true story of Buffalo Jones. This book was dedicated to the Boy Scouts of America and ZG writes, "I am hoping that it may influence boys to a keener love and appreciation of all the wonderful outdoors of their native land." In this book you will find not only Buffalo Jones but the many other westerners who influenced ZG and instilled in him the "code of the west". The lion dog, Don, also plays an important role in this book. What a wonderful inspiration this book is to all of us who have grown up in a time in which we can still relate to what ZG is writing about. Perhaps if these books were made more available in school libraries today, our world would be a much better place to live--they instill values desperately needed today.

profile.description: George Reiger is a Stackpole Books author.
profile.reviewText: Originally published in 1972 as Zane Grey: Outdoorsman to celebrate the centennial anniversay of Zane Grey's birth this book contains some of the best of his outdoor and fishing tales.  All of them have appeared in other periodicals and magazine over the years, but as a whole have not been collected together such as they are here.  In George Reiger's foreward he goes into quite a detailed discussion of Zane Grey--heritage, publishing troubles, IRS fights, etc.  Overall this is a fine selection of stories for anyone to enjoy.  They are nostalgic, and warm hearted mostly.  There is an occasional outburst of opinion about some particualr fish which Zane Grey believes to be a certain way while most of the rest of the world believes something different about, and he gives you his opinion in rather blunt terms.  But that WAS Zane Grey.  If he thought it was this way, then that's the way it was; and it was almost impossible to change his mind.  But for the most part, this book reads like a travelogue of places he visted around the world, and there is one section of nothing but pictures--many, if not most, taken by ZG himself.  There is a bibliography of his hunting and fishing stories as well in the appendix.  This is a remarkable book.
profile.summary: The Best from the Best

The box had been treated rather roughly by someone in shipping and I was not sure what I would find, but all parts were fine except for the three piece backing which is held together with tape. For the price--half off--this bookcase is worth the money and is no more difficult to put together than others I have put together previously by other makers. profile.reviewText: The Ruff Weather Wall Kit was an expense I could have done without.  For six pieces of plastic and 8 long bolts, the price was too high, for no better than it fit.  It does not snap into the door frames, and mine was actually a bit small, so the flaps catch and do not go fully closed sometimes.  I suppose as the flap wears maybe this won't happen, I'll wait and see.  But I was disappointed in the fit.  One would think there would be grooves or slots forit to set in, but there aren't.  As to the door, it seems air tight until the wind blows and the flaps do fly open under what I call low to moderate winds.  When the solid door is put in place the seal seems very good.  But the whole point of a dog door is so the animal can come and go and you won't be bothered.  My advice for the Wall Kit is, forget it and fabricate something of your own.  If I had had more time that is what I would have done, but with winter approaching this had to be a rather quick install, and for the most part it was.  Getting the bolts lined up through the wall is tough.  I'll let you know later own how well it holds up.
