profile.description: Connect a Lightning plug to a USB port with the Macally Lightning-to-USB Cable. This high-speed cable is perfect for all iPhone, iPod and iPad devices equipped with a Lightning socket.
profile.reviewText:
...first of all, this Lightning cable does exactly what it's supposed to do: it moves data (and electricity) to the Apple device it's connected to (in my case, an iPod Nano (7th generation).

With this cable, you get a little more.

First, you get more length. At 6 feet, it will give you flexibility for where to place your Lighting device at a twice the distance of a standard Lightning cable.

Second, the USB terminal on this cable includes a permanently mounted velco cable management strap, answering the needs of neat freaks.

While you can buy cheaper Lightning cables, the extra length and cable management capability offer a good value at this price.

Select with confidence.

Note: this item provided for review purposes.
profile.summary: Works great. And sometimes: size does matter...

profile.description: Divine LEDs offers a lightweight headlamp with adjustable elastic strap for a snug and customized fit every time. A dimmer and multiple modes allow you to adjust the light strength to suit your task-at-hand. And speaking of hands, both are free for use when you rely on XE Series Headlamp. This automatically results in 50% greater efficiency when compared to performing the same task using a standard flashlight. Made from military-grade materials, this headlamp is guaranteed to work as hard as you do!
profile.reviewText: ...no matter how silly you might look wearing it, illumination from a bright headlamp is no laughing matter when you are working in tight quarters, have limited access to other light sources or can't spare a hand to hold a flashlight. This headlamp features three primary lighting modes ("distance" "flood" and "red beam"), selectable by cycling through the single control button. Each is further dimmable by continuously pressing the same power button. While I wouldn't call the operation especially intuitive, and I'm not sure how the manufacturer measured the claim of "200% more comfortable", the results give illumination options that range from 90 lumens (at 40 meters) to 4 lumens at 6 meters depending on the illumination mode and dimming setting. The obvious tradeoff for higher light levels is decreased battery life. The lamp is powered by three "AAA" batteries (included). Don't be put off by the derision of others; sometimes you need your hands to hold tools, not a flashlight, and this is the tool that can provide the light you need to finish the job (or at least figure out what's gone wrong!). Select with confidence. Note: this item provided for review purposes.
profile.summary: A must-have in the bag of every DIY-er or alpha geek...

profile.description: From easy and fast, to advanced and fun, Corel VideoStudio Pro X9 has everything you need to make your videos look their best. Make a movie in minutes with FastFlick or Instant Projects, or move up to more advanced editing on the multi-track timeline. Cover all the angles with the new 4 angle Multi-Camera Editor and align clips automatically with audio syncing. With instant fixes for common problems, over 1,500 customizable effects, titles and transitions, including NewBlue FX Video Essentials II creative filters, VideoStudio Pro X9 delivers high-quality results with style that's all your own. Plus, smart audio tools automatically balance levels and keep dialog crystal clear. Ready to share? Quickly burn to DVD, upload directly to social media or share on popular devices.
profile.reviewText: ...like most modern users of digital video and audio recording devices, I end up with images and videos captured in many different file formats (I'm at 11 with the devices I currently use). In testing VideoStudio Pro X9 (VSP X9), it accepted all of them readily.. While I found VSP X9 feature-dense and not especially intuitive, I was able to compile content from multiple devices and files already on my computer and assemble them (with titles and a music track) within an hour of installation. While it was hardly art, it worked. With time, practice and exploration of the 300+ page user guided (downloadable .pdf) and Corel's online guides, I anticipate improving results as I become more familiar with this program. This software worked excellently from installation through export of my compiled content in its project manger to multiple output formats. Installation on a Windows 7 machine (64-bit with 16 GB of RAM and a quad-core 3.4 GHZ Intel processor) took about 20minutes. The VSP X9 installer included a progress bar that accurately indicated the install status. The interface is based on a 3-part concept: capture (or import), edit and share (or output). In between are more options than all but the most proficient users will be able to appreciate. Output options are abundant, for both writing to physical media, creating many different digital file formats (of varying resolution) and sharing directly to multiple popular social media sites (including YouTube, Vimeo, Flickr and Facebook). PROS: -Works with many source file types (I didn't have any on my machine it couldn't work with) -Outputs to physical media, multiple digital file types (at multiple resolutions) and social networking sites (YouTube, Facebook, Flickr and Vimeo) -Includes a selection of audio files to populate soundtracks with the "Auto Music" feature -Includes an computer screen capture utility: awesome (since the most widely used of these can cost hundreds of dollars) CONS: -Interface is cluttered and not especially intuitive. -No included help files., "F1" takes you to Corel's website. OK only if you have persistent online access (and vendors should NOT assume this); user guide and quick start guide are .pdf files that you have to download separately. -Many of the effects and features (for both content and titling) could quickly tire viewers if over-applied. This is less a criticism of the software than of the potential for over-use of these tools by some users. This is especially true for the "FastFlick" quick video creator utility, which I felt did not do enough to let me know what effects were going to be present as part of the pre-authored templates. Finally: VSP X9 also includes tools for DVD authoring and 3D video creation; neither of these are part of my own regular user needs, so I didn't test them. Note: Also in Corel's stable (and currrently selling for the same price) is VideoStudio Ultimate X9. Ultimate X9 adds two additional multi-cameras to the sync/alignment capability (6 instead of 4) and a suite of features for special effects. The accompanying video shows the result of quickly capturing multiple video and still file formats, adding titles, audio files and capturing a PC screen. Overall: impressive performance and decent value for the price.
profile.summary: Works well with many source video types; some interface challenges

profile.description: SIMPLE SET-UP Make hands-free calls and play music from your playlist directly through your car speakers. CarAudio Connect FM Bluetooth instantly connects your smartphone to your car stereo - no need for professional installation. Simply pair with your phone using Bluetooth and connect to your car stereo using FM transmission. A nighttime light makes it easy to see at all hours. Plus, the power adapter with USB port lets you charge your smartphone while you drive. STRONGEST SIGNAL ClearScan technology finds the strongest FM signal for transmitting your calls and music to your car stereo. Set the dial to the suggested station and CarAudio Connect FM Bluetooth does the rest. If music is playing when a call comes in, it will automatically fade out and you'll hear the caller's voice loud and clear through your car speakers. LOUD & CLEAR The microphone - embedded within the Call/Play button - can go just about anywhere on your dashboard. Choose a spot that's convenient and close to you for the best voice pick-up, then attach it magnetically. ONE-TOUCH CONTROL Just one button does it all. Use the Call/Play button to switch between talking and playing audio files stored on your phone or streaming Internet radio. WIRELESS FREEDOM Bluetooth provides convenient wireless connectivity with excellent audio quality for calls and music. Even from your pocket or purse, your phone will automatically pair with CarAudio Connect FM Bluetooth. Plus, with built-in echo cancellation technology, Bluetooth ensures that you get optimal sound during calls. Streaming requires an Internet-enabled phone.
profile.reviewText:
Overall, this device delivers satisfactory basic functionality: it successfully connects with a Bluetooth device to transmit content via an FM transmitter. If the device is a phone, it will also permit you to take and make phone calls via the Bluetooth connection.

In practice, it has some quirks regarding its discovery of available FM frequencies. I live in an area with a crowded FM dial with signals from two major metro areas and parts of four states. Unused FM broadcast frequencies are few..and the F8M1217ttn does NOT agree with me about which ones are available. It's "ClearScan" automated frequency selector often bypasses idle FM broadcast frequencies in favor of ones that are in use.

In addition, the quality of the FM transmission quality can vary widely with the positioning of the this device. An arms-length of difference in where you locate it can mean the difference between loud/clear transmission and content that is overcome by static.

I'm also  not a fan of devices that expect you to use adhesive on a dashboard, which is the recommended use case for this model.

The market is crowded with offerings from many manufacturers at this price: this model is simply part of that pack...
profile.summary: Satifactory basic operation, but some issues with FM functions...

profile.description: Spot it! is played with 55 circular cards, each decorated with eight symbols varying in size and orientation. There are more than 50 symbols in all, including random yet universal images of hearts, snowflakes, dragons, and lightning bolts, and even words such as Stop and OK. The aim of the game is to be the first to spot the one symbol in common between two or more cards. Don't be fooled! It's not as simple as it sounds. A match is easily hidden in the array, especially with the pressure of racing frantically against your opponents. The cards change with every match made, so you have to stay focused to keep up. Every match will fuel your fire and agonizing over getting beat to the punch by a faster player only adds to the overall excitement.
profile.reviewText:
First, the disclosure:
Blue Orange (the game publisher) provided this product free of charge.

Spot-It MLB consists of 55 round, coaster-size laminated playing cards packaged in a colorful metal container (whose cover includes baseball seams).

Each card includes 8 baseball-related images (MLB team logos, MLB team mascots and generic baseball-related pictures/words). There are 50 total images. Any two cards from the deck will contain ONE matching image.

The players' job is to be the first to identify the one image that appears on the two cards.

The game instructions include several game and scoring variants based on this basic task.

So here's the deal:
-While this game won't stretch you intellectually, it's fun enough. And for rainy summer vacation days, long car trips or while waiting in your favorite family style restaurant, MLB Spot-it might just buy harried parents 10 to 15 minutes of that most precious commodity: the undivided attention of kids on something other than "are we there yet?" or "can we go play in the thunderstorm?". ALso, in group settings MLB Spot it might also become one of those unexpected areas of competitive endeavor.

This is one of several versions of the Spot it game: obviously players interested in baseball will have a greater interest in this version.

Finally, as somebody who is fundamentally math challenged, I would love to see the formula that results in the conditions where you have:
-50 images
-55 cards
-eight images on each card
-one matching image on any two cards.
Seriously: THAT problem makes my head hurt!
profile.summary: It's not chess...or even Uno...but add it to your road trip survival kit...

profile.description: The RIDGID Power-Spin Drain Cleaner will clean drain lines up to 1 1 / 2 " (40 mm) in diameter and up to 25' (7,6 m) in length such as bathroom and kitchen sinks, bathtub and shower drains. It features 25' (7,6 m) of durable 1 / 4 " (6 mm) MAXCORE cable that is positively retained in the drum to prevent cable pullout. It is equipped with an AUTO FEED that advances and retrieves the cable with just the pull of a trigger. The Power-Spin can be operated either manually or driven with a battery powered drill with a maximum speed of 500 rpm. The Power-Spin is not recommended for use with toilets.
profile.reviewText:
...you know the drill: a tub or sink starts draining slowly. First you go into denial, then you try drain cleaners (in my entire life, I don't think I've every cleared a slow drain with ANY brand) and finally you know what you have to do: either break out the snake or call a plumber.

I picked this up a nearby big box store (the one with the big orange signs). 45 minutes later after checkout my slow draining tub was running free again, freed from the constraints of large bundles of hair that had wedged in the drain pipe.

Compared with the cost of a plumber for draining cleaning, I'm way ahead.

Pros:
-The cleaning cable can be operated either manually or using a battery powered drill. I chose the drill (and can't imagine doing this job by hand).

-Good cleaning. Three passes in and out and the drain was clear.

Cons:

-Poor construction of the manual crank handle. The securing tabs broke on first use, which means the manual option is no longer available. Not a major problem for me (see comment above), but it would be nice to have the manual option as advertised.

-As far as I can tell, replacement cranks are not available from Ridgid.

Worth a shot before calling a plumber, but treat that crank handle with care!
profile.summary: Pays for itself with one successful use, but crank handle is flimsy...

profile.description: For powerful steam and professional-quality results, turn to the Rowenta DW9280 SteamForce steam iron. The handheld irons integrated electronic steam pump delivers a substantial burst of vertical steam (up to 210g) and pushes up to 30% more steam into material (compared to steam irons with no pump), ensuring fast, effective removal of wrinkles from all types of fabrics. A handy LED digital display illuminates for linen, cotton, wool, silk, or nylon to indicate when the soleplate has reached the appropriate temperature for the selected fabric. The irons Microsteam stainless-steel soleplate provides 400 steam holes for even steam distribution and includes an ultra-thin silicate coating for scratch-resistant strength and nonstick gliding to protect even the most delicate of fabrics. A smart steam motion sensor turns off variable steam when the iron stops moving, conserving water and electricity. Even more, the irons precision tip makes easy work of maneuvering over collars, along seams, and in between buttons, and the precision-shot function allows for a concentrated shot of steam at the top of the soleplate tip. For safety and peace of mind, the iron shuts off automatically after 8 minutes if left unused in the upright position and after 30 seconds if tipped over or left in the horizontal position. Other highlights include one-touch controls, a cool spray mist for extra-stubborn wrinkles, an integrated anti-calcium system, and a self-clean system for long-lasting performance. From household linens to personal wardrobes, make a good impression with help from the Rowenta SteamForce steam iron.
profile.reviewText:
...some people (including the *other* user of this iron in my house) enjoy ironing. Some people iron because it's sometimes necessary, but don't have a strong opinion on its merits as an activity. And others --like me-- avoid ironing at all costs (much to the delight of nearby dry cleaners).

But sooner or later, most folks will need an iron. Even with the wide range of opinions on both the joys --or not-- of ironing (and on what and when to iron), we're in agreement about this iron: depending on your point of view, it either enhances the pleasure or mitigates of the pain of ironing.

PROS:
-Fast heating: from plug-in to ready to create steam and iron in about a minute.
-Generous and easy to fill water reservoir. Holds more than a cup of water. Cap on reservoir closes with a definite click.
-Abundant steam output.
-Designed for regular tap water (in fact, the user guide specifically recommends NOT using distilled water or water other than tap water).
-Weighty without feeling too heavy

CONS:
-No separate power switch. This is an auto-on/auto-off iron when plugged in; turns off in about 8 minutes when standing on its heel and in about 30 seconds when resting on on its sole plate or side). This doesn't detract from the ironing performance; I just prefer the additional user feedback of a power switch.
-Handle obscures fabric/temperature settings on dial. This would be forgivable if not for the very small markings on the dial.
-These are essentially annoyances that most users will adapt to over time.

The Rowenta this iron replaced lasted more than 10 years. You can spend much less on an iron...and then prepare for lesser performance and  more frequent replacements.
profile.summary: If you MUST iron...this helps ease the pain...

profile.description: G7 Power introduces the LED answer to the standard 60W incandescent A19, and it comes without a bright yellow top. G7's new revision produces more light with less power (80 lumens per Watt) which reduces the bulb's overall heat output. At 800 lumens, it will replace a standard 60-watt incandescent bulb in nearly all fixtures. (A 60-watt incandescent puts out approximately 840 lumens.) This bulb uses 1/6th of the power of a standard 60 watt incandescent bulb, and like an incandescent, it distributes light in all directions. Unlike a CFL, this bulb turns on at full brightness and does not contain mercury. The bulb's warm white color temperature (3,000 Kelvin) falls between an incandescent' s light and pure white light. This bulb will pay for itself in energy savings after approximately one year when compared to a 60 watt incandescent used eight hours a day at the rate of 0.12 Dollars per kilowatt hour. This bulb is Energy Star and UL certified, does not emit UV light, and is RoHS compliant. Manufacturing quality control standards meet or exceed ISO9001. Notes: LED bulbs should be used in open luminaries to prevent overheating. They should not be used where they may be exposed to water. G7 is located in Reno, Nevada and is dedicated to efficient solutions. Questions, comments and suggestions are welcomed at support@G7Power.com.
profile.reviewText: This dimmable LED bulb has an 800-lumen output comparable to a standard 60-watt incandescent bulb. The light is generally softer and more diffuse than an incandescent, and genrates much less heat than an incandescent bulb. As the accompanying video will show, this bulb has the general shape of a traditional incandescent or enclosed CFL, but much of the similarity ends there. It has a four-section lighting element; each quadrant is enclosed with a metal frame. Between the lighting element ("bulb") and the base are what appear to be metallic radiator fins, which I assume to be for heat dissipation. The lighting tone of this bulb is warm and far more pleasant than what is emitted by a CFL. One thing to note is the weight. The shipping weight of the bulb is 6.6 ounces. Although I placed in ceiling "can" receptacle, if you plan to use it in a hanging, multiple bulb fixture, you'll want to replace all with the same model bulb, as it its weight will affect the horizontal level. Almost $20 may seem like a lot for a single bulb. However, G7 offers a lifetime guarantee, and the energy cost savings will make up this amount eventually (when depending on your use and electric rates; check out G7's site for excellent online and downloadable Excel calculators that can help you bottom line this). You might also consider a price comparison direct from G7's own website. Note: This item was provided for review purposes.
profile.summary: Nice, diffuse light; lifetime gurantee...

profile.reviewText:

profile.description: Total creativity meets surprising ease of use in Corel VideoStudio Ultimate X9. Start fast with Instant Project templates, or edit on the multi-track Timeline. Tell your story from every angle with the new 6 angle multi-camera editor and align clips automatically with audio syncing. Over 2,000 customizable effects, transitions and titles, and 11 bonus premium effects apps give you everything you need to correct common problems and enhance with stunning effects. And audio is crystal clear with automatic tools to balance levels and adjust background sound. VideoStudio Ultimate X9 makes sharing easy, upload directly to your favorite websites, create pro-quality DVDs or export and view on popular devices.
profile.reviewText: ...the digital video and audio recording devices in my stable capture their images in nearly a dozen different file formats. In testing VideoStudio Ultimate X9 (VSU X9), it never balked at accepting any of them. While I found VSU X9 feature-dense and not especially intuitive, I was able to compile content from multiple capture devices and files already on my computer and assemble them (with titles and a music track) within an hour of installation. While it was hardly art, it worked. With time, practice and exploration of the 313 page user guided (downloadable .pdf) and Corel's online guides, I anticipate improving results as I become more familiar with this program. This software worked excellently from installation through export of my compiled content in its project manger to multiple output formats. Installation on a Windows 7 machine (64-bit with 16 GB of RAM and a quad-core 3.4 GHZ Intel processor) took about 25 minutes. The VSP X9 installer included a progress bar that accurately indicated the install status. The interface is based on a 3-part concept: capture (or import), edit and share (or output). In between are more options than all but the most proficient users will be able to appreciate. Output options are abundant, for both writing to physical media, creating many different digital file formats (of varying resolution) and sharing directly to multiple popular social media sites (including YouTube, Vimeo, Flickr and Facebook). PROS: -Works with many source file types (I didn't have any on my machine it couldn't work with) -Outputs to physical media, multiple digital file types (at multiple resolutions) and social networking sites (YouTube, Facebook, Flickr and Vimeo) -Includes a selection of audio files to populate soundtracks with the "Auto Music" feature -Includes an computer screen capture utility: awesome (since the most widely used of these can cost hundreds of dollars) CONS: -Interface is cluttered and not especially intuitive. -No included help files., "F1" takes you to Corel's website. OK only if you have persistent online access (and vendors should NOT assume this); user guide and quick start guide are .pdf files that you have to download separately. -Many of the effects and features (for both content and titling) could quickly tire viewers if over-applied. This is less a criticism of the software than of the potential for over-use of these tools by some users. This is especially true for the "FastFlick" quick video creator utility, which I felt did not do enough to let me know what effects were going to be present as part of the pre-authored templates. Finally: VSU X9 also includes tools for DVD authoring and 3D video creation; neither of these are part of my own regular user needs, so I didn't test them. The accompanying video shows the result of quickly capturing multiple video and still file formats, adding titles, audio files and capturing a PC screen. Overall: impressive performance and decent value for the price.
profile.summary: Nice package for working with a variety of input sources; interface has some rough spots...

Choose the correct player for your MAC operating system, and download it. 3. Drag the VLC icon to your application folder. 4. Once your VLC player is installed, open up your WAV files from your recorder, it should give you the option to \"open with\". Choose to open with your VLC player, or simply drag the WAV files into the VLC player. 5. After you have done the above.Turning up the volume on your MAC, now you're available to hear everything you recorded. 6. If you want to convert the WAV files to MP3 or ACC video, you can use Emicsoft Video Converter for Mac.
profile.reviewText: The iGearPro 8GB digital audio voice recorder offers a compact, portable and relatively inexpensive stand-alone solution for capturing audio recordings. It performs this baseline function in a satisfactory manner, capturing recorded audio as a .wav file at variable sampling rates (user selectable from 32 to 192 kbps). It charges and transfers data through an included microUSB cable. In a step up from other similarly priced voice recorders, this one offers sufficient user interaction permit entering a system time, so that files created with this recorder carry true date/time metadata. Also included in the box are an external clip-on mic (external mic use is a selectable option), and an adapter for recording telephone calls (I wouldn't test this in my state, but it might be a good tool the next time you are confronted with a "this call may be monitored for quality purposes)" customer service experience and a pair of earbuds for monitoring audio directly from the recorder. The recording quality for (for each of the "long" "HQ" and "fine" record mode) is satisfactory. Recording can be started through selectable options for manual (using the prominent record button) or voice activated (VOR). While the VOR works fine, as with any voice activated device, you can expect some clipping at the start if the initial syllable. In addition to playback via your computer's file manager via the USB cable, this recorder has a small speaker and you can monitor the contents of recordings directly from the recorder. Be prepared to spend some time with the user guide, which is very well written in order to familiarize yourself with the recorder controls on both side panels. They are not particularly intuitive, especially in the absence of a ubiquitous 4-way control button that could have really streamlined navigation through the device settings. The display is small, and some of the menu displays have comically small fonts (the date/time setting, for example). The control button legend imprinted on the rear of the recorder would have been much more useful of printed on the same side as the display. The overall look and feel of the side controls don't readily suggest their long term durability...but time will give the answer to that. Overall, decent audio recording that will require some investment in mastering the device controls...but the user guide helps with this. Note: this item provided for review purposes.
profile.summary: Satisfactory audio quality;  some interface challenges...

profile.description: More than a pocket camera, the 24.3 megapixel NEX-7 exceeds expectations. Here’s performance that would give most DSLRs camera envy, including interchangeable lenses, a 2359K dot OLED eye-level TTL viewfinder, up to 10fps shooting, and outstanding Tri-Navi 3-dial manual control. HD movies are superb with Full 1920 x 1080 resolution at 60p, 60i and 24p.
profile.reviewText:
Before gushing about the quality of images this camera image captures, let's address the obvious --and surprising-- rough areas in a camera that comes with a big price tag:

(1) A user interface that can kindly be described as "non-intuitive". This includes three separate control wheels and three separate navigation/menu buttons buttons. While most basic functions aren't too deeply buried, the learning curve is steep for everything else. Be prepared to spend some quality time curled up with the camera's 211-page user guide. Much of this complexity is from built-in effects (sepia, posterization, black-and-white, tilt-pan, and more) that are easily accomplished in most photo editing applications; why they are included in a the user interface of a camera of this quality is puzzling.

(2) Strange flash assembly. Instead of flipping directly up from the camera body , the integrated flash is mounted on a telescoping hinge (think of a micro version of a scissor lift). This does not feel especially durable, and I can't help but wonder why Sony chose this design.

(3) The video record button is awkwardly positioned on the upper right rear of the camera body, and is easily pressed inadvertently.

(4) About that 211-page user guide: it's a .pdf file on an included CD. And the camera ships with NO recording media. These are unfortunate lapses in a camera with a 4-digit price tag.

So why is this a 5-star review?

These issues are *totally* mitigated by the quality of the still and moving images it captures. As an amateur, I seldom need the amount of fidelity that RAW format images offer: this camera's RAW images are where the full 24 MB resolution is revealed. The highest quality .jpg setting suffices for my needs, and at full resolution it yields 6000x4000 pixel images (at 350 dpi) of around 5.5 to 6.5 MB each.

The NEX-7 offers options for viewing through the eyepiece or its bright LCD screen (you can choose a preferred mode or allow a sensor to auto-detect your presence near the eyepiece). It also offers settings to reduce or increase the amount of photo information displayed.

It has several auto modes and the usual additional selections DSLR shooters are used to (shutter or aperture priority, manual, bulb and scene-based).

Video capture options include AVCHD 60i/60p, AVCHD 50i/50p or standard definition .mp4.

Included software consists of a simple RAW file viewer and .pdf manuals (quick-start guide a the 211 page handbook).

If connected it via its HDMI output to a Sony Bravia television, the television remote can control the image playback functions (for both still and video).

At this price, you can choose from many outstanding DSLRs. But if you want to travel (or shoot) lighter, this camera is an outstanding tool for doing that.
profile.summary: Still and video image quality trump flawed user interface...

profile.reviewText: This pair of RAM modules joined the 8 GB OEM configuration in a recently purchased Asus CM6870-US-3AC desktop. As with most electronics, RAM tends to work --or not-- from the beginning; this RAM did. Reasonably priced, and moved my motherboard to its maximum RAM capacity. I am not an overclocker, but a review of online forums indicates this RAM might tolerate a bit of tweaking from those who do...
profile.summary: Cheap, fast RAM: worked out of the box for desktop RAM upgrade

Like the miniSD, the microSD is ideal for use in storing media-rich files such as music, videos, and photographs in compatible mobile phones. profile.description: ASUS, is proud to release the GTX660 overclocked edition with 2 gigabytes of dedicated RAM. This card will enhance your gaming experience and render all the graphics smoothly. With the DirectCU II thermal design our patented all-copper heatpipes which makes the card 20% cooler. Pair this up with GPU Tweak and anybody can easily overclock their graphics card to their preferred performance level.
profile.reviewText: First: I am not a gamer. I am, however, a multi-tasker who frequently renders video while doing other productivity tasks. This card replaced a 14-month old OEM Asus card that had suddenly started introducing intermittent Windows 7 shutdowns. If you're considering this card, make sure: -you have an adequate power supply (this card has a 150 watt demand, and my 350 OEM PSU was not up to the task of running everything else and this card) -your power supply has an available PCI-e 6-pin power cord (mine had none; so a power supply upgrade became part of this task) -your case is deep enough to accommodate the length of this card (mine did..not through planning, but through dumb luck) -you have adequate clearance to accommodate the height of this card. Installation was trouble free. After installing the provided drivers and video utility (which includes an overclocking capability that I won't use), the utility acquired more recent versions from the Asus site. My random shutdown issue is resolved, this card runs very quietly and I can multi-task with confidence now. Good card.
profile.summary: Good evolutionary upgrade from an OEM card...

profile.description: ThunderLeash makes walking your dog a hassle free, positive experience for both you and your dog. Dog harnesses can be great tools for dogs, but they are difficult to put on, and the extra gear often gets left at home. ThunderLeash is the perfect combination of simplicity and functionality. For those times you just need a standard leash for a quick walk or for times when your dog is well behaved, simply connect the ThunderLeash to your dog's collar just like any other leash. But when pulling might be a problem, simply wrap ThunderLeash around your dog's torso and slide it into the harness slot. Now whenever your dog pulls, a gentle pressure is applied to his torso and the pulling will quickly cease. With the ThunderLeash, you will finally be able to walk your dog, instead of being walked by your dog.
profile.reviewText:
We share our house with a four-year old rescued Weimaraner ("Jacob"). Because of his rescue background, he arrived with some behavioral issues. Most of these have eased or disappeared with age and trusting pack...but sometimes they can emerge with stress, excitement or as he taps into his breed's natural exuberance (in fact, a Weimaraner is used to demonstrate this in the ThunderLeash YouTube video).

As a rule, he walks fine with a standard chain training collar when he's with one of his two alphas. With other members of the family, he'll press the boundaries. And even with alphas, of his line of sight should include any of a deer, a small white barking dog or a squirrel...he will engage in immediate and strong pulling behavior. The nearly bare spot skin resulting from the repeated corrections with the training collar are a testament to his exuberance even in the face of correction.

The ThunderLeash's riggging was relatively simple (unlike some other torso-mounted leads, there are no hoops or loops for front legs). Its hardware attaches to a standard leash, and is looped around the torso back tho the lead's mounting hardware, which rests at the top center of the dog's neck.

Jacob gives some immediate attention to the contact around his torso, but once we started walking, he totally disregards it. When he is distracted, becomes overly excited, or simply forgets his proper heeling position (gotta sniff them dandelions!), a gentle tug on the lead provides tension across the circumference of his torso, and he returns to track.

He's happy. The non-alpha walkers are happy. I'm happy. What's not to like?

If your dog is inclined to pull, select with confidence. ThunderLeash offers a money back guarantee; what have you got to lose?
profile.summary: Road-tested and exuberant Weimaraner approved...

profile.description: The hand-held Havahart Ultrasonic Basic Trainer is used to correct your dog's misbehavior such as jumping on furniture or counters, nuisance barking, digging and chewing. As the name implies, the Ultrasonic Basic Trainer works by emitting a loud, ultrasonic sound that, while inaudible to you, is heard by and distracts your dog. The trainer is effective with any dog 6 month and older, and any size and breed. However, it is important to realize that only about two-thirds of all dogs will respond to ultrasonic training. Some dogs will not be distracted by ultrasonic frequencies. The high frequency correction is silent to the human ear, making the unit truly ultrasonic. With Select-a-Sound, the trainer can be tuned to one of 5 different sounds to match the dog's hearing sensitivity. The dog obedience training device can be used in Manual or Automatic mode. In Manual mode, simply press the Correction button whenever the unwanted action takes place. In Automatic mode, the trainer can only be used to correct excessive barking. The trainer has been programmed to recognize a full range of barking sounds produced by all size and breeds of dogs. Set the trainer near your dog and when a bark is detected, the trainer will emit the pre-selected ultrasonic sound. If the trainer is being used in Automatic mode and is triggered six times within one minute, the trainer will go into time out mode and cease all corrections for five minutes.
profile.reviewText:
The same thing that makes this wireless fence an attractive alternative to an actual fence (or a buried wired/invisible fence transmitter cable) --the wireless transmitter-- is the principal downfall of this device.  Its coverage area is essentially circular (from the omnidirectional transmitter antennas), and my lot is essentially rectangular (well, wedge-shaped).

Bottom line: the coverage pattern is too wide too effectively contain my dog on my yard. Add to that the dog in question (a stubborn, sneaky, exuberant young adult Weimaraner generally unconcerned with corrections when he gets focused on his urges...) and this is a product that doesn't provide a worry-free alternative to positive control on a leash. Your dog and your experience may vary, but mine weren't so good.
profile.summary: If your yard is *round*...great; doesn't work so well with rectangles though...

top_5.description: Preserve your precious memories with this ideal combination of elegant, reliable storage and automatic backup features. Your baby's first step, your wedding in Bali, all your important milestonesall captured in digital photos and video. What could be more important? Store them safely and keep them backed up on My Book Home Edition external hard drives.
top_5.reviewText: This was a replacement for an earlier model Western Digital external hard disk drive (HDD) Western Digital 500 GB External Hard Drive that inexplicably bricked after 17 months (reviewed separately under the product link above...) So why chose WD again? Mostly for the solid reputation of their internal HDDs and reasonable pricing. This particular model added an eSATA interface option that allows faster data transfer rates (nominally about five times faster than USB 2), giving the user three interface options: USB 2, Firewire (fading fast on non-Apple machines) and eSATA. On my main PC, USB transfer speeds are around 14 MB/sec, and eSATA around 35 MB/sec). The inconsistent performance of the eSATA option is what drags this product to two stars. Installation was problem-free. It powers on and off with my computer (Vista first, then Windows 7, its styling is subdued, and it is very quiet (at least it's quieter than the PC it sits next to). 13 month update: The eSATA interface has been marginal at best. When the drive is reading or writing (I keep my digital music on it so it's active when iTunes or Windows Media Player is accessing content for playback) it works just fine. But, give it the chance to rest,and it randomly disappears from Windows. Replugging the eSATA cable, recycling the drive's power or restarting the PC will all remedy this, but...this shouldn't happen at all. Some online forums have suggested plugging it directly into a wall socket instead of a power strip due as a remedy. Not an option for me, and not something WD indicates is needed in its literature on online help. After more than a year of this, I've considered all the possibilities: -it's a Windows problem (nope: same behavior under Windows Vista and Windows 7) -it's a motherboard firmware/BIOS problem (nope; motherboard, chipset and video drivers ==along with BIOS firmware-- are all current) -or it's a Western Digital problem related to its eSATA interface. A modest amount of online researching points clearly at Western Digital, which is too bad. Connect via USB, and the drive stays steadily visible. This sacrifices both the greater eSATA transfer speed and a USB port. Generally --and certainly for music playback-- the transfer speed isn't an issue, but it becomes apparent when doing large backups. Bottom line:the eSATA interface, should just work, but doesn't with any consistency. My evidence, research and experience with this hard drive points to this being a WD hardware issue with its eSATA implimentation.
top_5.summary: on the basis of its internal drives, tried WD external again; mixed results...

With 20 waste bags on a single roll, you never have to worry about running out of bags again! The best part is that you also get 1 convenient blue bone-shaped dispenser, so you can attach them to more than just your leash and be sure to never run out! We include 17 rolls of the black-colored bags and 18 rolls of the blue-colored bags for a total of 35 rolls and 700 bags.
top_5.reviewText:
...but these do great at their primary function: picking up what the dog has left behind.

Our dog (Jacob the Exuberant Weimaraner) has three places he loves to take care of business:

-just over the property line on our neighbor's front yard (they keep their grass shorter and when it's wet outside he much prefers the shorter cut of their grass)

Select with confidence.

top_5.reviewText:
...and other instruments in your string band.

One member of our household is a long-term bass player, who has upgraded her main instrument as her skills have improved. Others in the house have history of dabbling in acoustic guitars and banjos (a history that is sadly spotty, and therefore requires a LOT of "stand time").

This stand is very stable, and easy to put up or take down. Height adjustment is made easy with a spring loaded lever (an improvement over models that require a knob to be turned). The top locking mechanism closes its grip at the headstock, secured by the weight of the instrument it holds.
