top_5.description: TP-Link ANT2405C 2.4GHz 5dBi Indoor Desktop Omni-directional Antenna
top_5.reviewText:
I had a Graupner MX20 laying around that I haven't used in a few years (Great Radio, when it was new and still to this day..  stopped using due to having a Futaba 18MZ, Graupner MZ24 and MC32) So I threw them MX20 in a FPV Hexa setup and flew to fail safe/RTL kicked in.. I did the test in 4 different areas and each area I went straight North, South, East and West so 4 different areas and 4 different paths in each area.. with the stock antenna I got a best of 2.6 kilometers and a worst of 1.3 kilometers (the 1.3k was in a heavy WiFi environment so that's dang good) with an average of 1.92K then I came home installed this 8dbi antenna with a Pci to Rp-sma adapter drilling out a spot close to the stock antenna at install the adaptor.. the next day was nearly identical weather so that had no effect on the test... With the new antenna installed I did the same 4 tests at the same time of day in each location and the results are amazing. My best was now 4.1 kilometers my worst in the heavy WiFi area was 3.2K with an Average of 3.7 kilometers... Not only a huge range boost BUT my signal was FAR stronger then before in the middle of those ranges... What I mean is normally when I would get out about a mile my signal would be around 15 to 25% but now at a Mile my signal is 85 to 90%... The packet error rate is 1/100th or what it is with the stock antenna at 1 mile (1.6 kilometers) out.. my signal would stay nearly 80% or higher until the last 15 to 20% of the max range, dropping off much quicker over the last 20% of the max range then it does in the first 80% of it.. these ranges are with a 6 channel signal antenna receiver.. in most cases a duel diversity receiver doesn't increase range a lot but I believe in this case it would add about 30 to 40% more range with this antenna mod do to signal being blocked by items on the quad shadowing the signal that I can't get around with a single antenna receiver. Going much more then 8dbi on a 100mw transmitter won't gain you much more other then bulk.. if you want to increase to a even higher dbi antenna then you will need a signal booster to really gain the max from the upgrade. The over all huge range gain to me is not the best part.. the massively increased signal density and hugely lowered packet loss at 80% of the max range is the part I care mostly about... It will allow you to safely fly in highly contested WiFi areas safely.. you will have much lower chances of having signal block out when flying around powerful WiFi signals even at VERY long ranges. Penetration through trees also is hugely increased...

That's very important to us racing FPV quad guys....I had a friend walk the quad in the woods swapping the pci back to the stock antenna and when I got to 20% rssi I stopped him, he was about 140 meters back in some fairly thick trees and under growth, I swapped the pci back to this antenna and was at 95% rssi... He started walking again and when we was about 1.2k back in the woods and I still had 60 to 75% rssi it was pointless to go any more... Your fpv system would not reliably get 1/4 that distance in that thick of mother nature. Would I drill a hole on my new high dollar units to install this antenna NO unless the stock antennas wasn't giving me what I needed reliably however they do... But now I have a med long range 2.4 system that I will use... However if you use a module based 2.4 system then this is 110% a must upgrade that cost hardly nothing AND will GREATLY improve the performance of your systems range and reliability and it's as easy as unscrewing one antenna and installing this antenna as most modules use a rp-sma antenna connection. If size is a concern then going to a quality 5dbi antenna will not to much larger then the stock antenna but will provide about 50% increased signal density and about 40% increased range over the stock 2.5 or 3dbi unit in/on your transmitter... If you have a Flysky I6 radio then get two 5dbi antennas (VERY IMPORTANT NOTE, ONLY USE A HIGH QUALITY ANTENNA NOT CHEAP CRAP UNITS) I have now done 3 I6 radios for friends, it's a cheap 50 to 60 USD radio that works well for newbis or just guys that are on a tight budget... You will need two 4 to 6 inch PCI to rp-sma connectors and two 5 to 8dbi TP link or other HIGH QUALITY 2.4ghz antennas I would go with 5dbi just for the fact of size as it needs two.. you then drill out two holes for the rp-sma connectors on top the radio case (use the front half it's wider and easier to mount the jack) pop off the two pci connectors to the stock antennas you can leave them in its fine, then after you have mounted the sma in the radio pop on the two pci clips and screw the radio back together... Screw on the two antennas (do NOT power on the radio without the antennas installed you will cook your 2.4ghz transceiver) and power on the radio.... Your range with the normal 6ch park flyer receiver will be in the 1.5 mile range vs stock it will be about 600 to 700 meters before the packet loss is so high you are getting glitches and signal drop out... With the full range 6ch or 10ch receiver we tested it out to over 4 miles and stopped and the packet loss was fair and safe at 4 miles I would say 5 to 5.5 miles vs stock 1.4 miles would be the max range in a clean 2.4ghz area or 3 to 3.5 miles in a heavy 2.4ghz area with FAR LESS packet loss then stock... So for less then 70 bucks with the cable and antenna cost added they now have radios that they can safely fly their fpv multirotors very long range on a safe and easy to use 2.4ghz system with very very good reliability and very very good range... Sorry for the long post just trying to help out anyone looking to greatly increase the range and signal density of their 2.4ghz radio system for not much money and easy to do... Well this is how to do it...
top_5.summary: Great 2.4ghz radio control range booster! For R/C plane

top_5.description: Crossman Corporation is an American designer, manufacturer and supplier of products for the shooting sports. The company has a long-standing presence in air gun design and a tradition of producing pellet and BB air rifles and pistols.
top_5.reviewText: I mainly shoot High end PCP and high end Springers with a few high end Co2 and duel fuel guns in there as well. H&N and JSB are my main stay in pellets but Crosman Brown box .177 and .22s dome/field target pellets have a place in some of my guns to. Now here's where the review for this pellet comes in, in 95% of my high end pcp and springers these pellets will shoot decently in BUT when you compare groups with these vs high end pellets the difference is night and day in most guns BUT... I have a Gamo Bull whisper bone collector that I got in a trade that was new (i HATE gamo guns, plain and simple they are trash unless they are the BSA built Gamos then they are nice guns) so I had no use for the BC but wasn't gonna waste my time to try and sell it SO I found a 65lb gas strut that fit and had a friend that owns a moulding shop custom mould me some piston seals and some high pressure breach seals that would stand up to the pressure. That would fit perfectly and handle the 65lb strut that was doubling the chamber pressure.. I could not find a pellet (I went through roughly 70 different pellet brands, makes and weights with this gun) that would group within 4 inches at 15 yards so another words really horrible accuracy.. I knew part of it was because the gun was massively over powered lol and the other part was it was a gamo and that says it's pretty much craps! Then I came across a few tins of these that I had in a different pellet case and tried them.. I was shocked, number one this pellet is way to light for that much horse power but it was shooting .30 inch center to center 5 shot groups at 25 yards with these and doing it over and over and over some more.  It is shooting 1360fps average at 32.4ftlbs of energy.. that's WAY AND I MEAN WAY to fast for accuracy but some how and some way these are very very accurate at insane speeds and stupid amount of energy for a break barrel .177, heck powerful .177 pcp guns don't break 35ftlbs very often.  I can say how these pellets stand up to that much velocity but they do it in spades and imho rarely shoot really good in any highly accurate gun, they shoot decently in a lot of guns but rarely even close to what the gun is capable of.  On high speed scope cam video I can see they start De-stabilizing after about 60 yards but fly very well until they start to cork screw but they don't do it until they are about 25 yards past falling sub-sonic as where most super sonic pellets start tumbling when they cross over from super to sub sonic. This gun/pellet combo is capable of 3/4 inch groups at 50 yards however that opens to 8 inchs at 65 yards lol, 3/4 inch groups at 50 yards are nothing to write home about in pcp or high end spring guns BUT in a 32ftlb gamo that's massively over powered it is something to write home about... Heck it's something to write you guys on Amazon about lol. The shots are loud, really .22lr loud or very close to it, as it's totally in the super sonic range not just right there close to it.. and this is a 7.99 grain pellet that's way super sonic and not a 4 grain pellet thats as good for your gun as dry firing and the super hard alloy they are made from are really hard on barrels. The 65# gas ram was 47.99 the seals 15 bucks and you have a 32ftlb .177 break barrel lol that's a monster of epic proportion.. it shoots so smooth with the hard custom seals but a lot of recoil but it's not the jump all over the place normal springer recoil rather a hard solid "thud" and a super sonic crack. The gun shoots amazingly well for what it Is.. if it shot H&N baracuda series pellets as accurate as it does these it would be sub sonic and likely 40ftlbs of energy, it just doesn't shoot them accurate. When I find a heavy pellet it shoots well this thing will be a 150 yard coke can capable gun.
top_5.summary: Decent pellet in a lot of guns but rarely a highly accurate pellet

top_5.description: 1x charging cable
top_5.reviewText: To the people who don't understand how this works. If you have a 600 mah charger and charge one 600 mah  pack it will take an hour for a fully depleted battery (do not run lipos below 20% remaining IE, 1000 mah pack run 800 or less mah out of it 50 mah pack run 400 mah out of it ect ect.) Now if you connect 5 600 mah packs to a 600 mah charger it will take 5 hours to charge. Now if you have a charger that has adjustable rate charging you would set the charger for 1c charge rate... meaning if you are charging 5x 500 mah packs you would charge at 2.5A and charge all batteries in 1 hour if you charged 5x 200 mah packs you would charge at 1A for 1C charge rate.. 5x 1000 mah packs you would charge at 5A to charge at 1C meaning you would complete all 5 packs right at 1 hour of charging. Good packs have no problem being charged at 1/10th there C rating meaning a 15C discharge rated pack can handle a a 1.5c charge rate a 20C pack can handle safely 2C charge rate 30 discharge rated pack can charge at 3C ect. I have been in the hobby over 20 years and have flew lipos since they first came out. 1c charge rate is not a rule it is safe and will make packs last the longest but charging at or below 1/10th the discharge rating is very safe and packs will last plenty long. I use a 5x jst jumper to charge 1s 150 mah packs for micro combat wings and with 30C 150 mah 1S packs that are high quality I charge them at 2.25A finishing 5 packs in roughly 18 to 20 mins charge time some packs have 200 cycles on them and fly almost as good as new packs so if you have good quality packs the 1/10th the discharge C rating is a very safe charge limit. On cheap or no name packs do not charge at over 1C.
top_5.summary: explaining how this unit works.

top_5.description: Want your shot to travel further? Super Point .177 caliber pellets get the maximum distance for your airgun. 500 per tin.
top_5.reviewText:
If you have a gun that most pellets fit a little loose in then these may be the pellet for you. The front drive band on these are larger then most pellets so the will fit a looser bore pretty tight but if it's a tight bore they won't fit.. you will damage the pellet trying to push it in if your chamber is on the tight side, but if it's on the loose side these may be 50 yard and in tack drivers. In most guns they don't shoot well at all and that's in top end PCP guns that shoot almost anything pellet on top of pellet.. however I have a Benjamin Armada .177 that shoots these with the best of them. They are a 50 yard max pellet, they will start to De-stabilize at about 55 yards in any gun I've shot them in. If you have a break barrel that most pellets fit losse in then try these you may just be shocked.

5 stars for loose chamber guns, 3 stars for all else.. they will not shoot good in 90% of guns. If you have a rifle barreled Co2 pistol that has a slightly larger dia barrel for mag feed reasons these will likely shoot well.
top_5.summary: Very VERY tight fitting pellet but thats not always a bad thing.

input: Generate the review text written by a reviewer who has a given an overall rating of "5.0" for a product with description "The OtterBox Defender Series case for Motorola Droid Turbo 2 provides heavy duty protection against drops, dust and damage without taking away from the usability of your phone's features. The Defender Series case offers triple-layer protection and is built from a high-impact polycarbonate shell, durable silicone slipcover and a built-in screen protector, making it one of the toughest cases on the market. Why else do you think we called it the Defender Series?". The summary of the review text is "Yay! It works with the wireless charger!".
output:
Let me start with my amazement.  I have a couple of thin cases for my Droid Turbo 2, and I forgot why I bought those thin cases.  Only after putting this case on, then I realized that I bought those thin cases so that I could charge the phone with my wireless (Qi) charger.  I have a wireless charger at home and one at my office.  "Darn it!" I thought.  Now with this tank wrapping around my phone, I would never be able to charge it wirelessly.  I ran to my charger and laid my phone on it. To my surprise, it starts charging!

As for installation, it took me a while to figure out how to take the case apart to put my phone in.  The instruction sheet just has a picture showing that you need to peel the rubber layer off, but nowhere could I find a place to start.  They are tightly sealed.  After a while, I figured it out by pulling one of the dust cover tabs and peel it off the case from there.  Then you have the hard case left.  Separating the hard case is easy.

The belt-clip holster is nice to have.  It will come handy during summer because, in winter, I always have a coat pocket to put my phone.  During summer, it will be on my belt.  One problem with the belt clip holster is that it's hard to get the phone off the holster with one hand.  I've to figure out a way to get used to it.

For a great protection of your phone, I recommend it!

profile.description: Max out your workout with your phone strapped to your arm to track every step and log every mile. Attach the flexible Armband to your arm and count on it to stay put through the toughest workout. Its sweat and water-resistant and when used with an OtterBox case, delivers added protection from the rough stuff. Stay active with the OtterBox Armband.
profile.reviewText:
This OtterBox UNIVERSAL ARMBAND for 4"-5" Smartphones is very soft, unlike the usual tough and sturdy OtterBox cases I have used, but it keeps the phone securely on your arm.  It also has a little pocket area for you to stick a credit card or a few dollars behind the phone.

The only issue is it covers the light sensor of the Samsung Galaxy 6s Edge, so the screen is off when you have it on your arm. You have to lift the edge to reach the fingerprint sensor.  But, it's not a big deal, since I can control the music using the BlueTooth headphones.  In general, the quality of this armband case is much better than I expected.

I recommend it.
profile.summary: Great Quality, Soft, and Secure

profile.description: You dont have time to precision pack your briefcase. So, pack along the sleep, slim Commuter Series case - easily fits any crevice in your bag. Featuring a tough two-layer construction, Commuter Series helps keep your phone safe from drops, bumps and life on the go. Plus port plugs stop dust from entering jacks and inputs, so your phone stays clean.
profile.reviewText:
I couldn't find a good case for Moto Z Play, but after hearing that Z Play has nearly exact dimension as Z Force I took a plunge.  To my pleasant surprise it fit perfectly, of course with the exception of the lack of the headphone jack hole, which I don't use anyway.

As always OtterBox provides the strongest protection for my phones. I have tried many brands over the years and always come back to OtterBox for maximum protection.  It does add bulk to the phone but it's your choice to decide whether the protection is worth the trade off.  Another trade off is I have Moto Mods.  However, I still want to have this case for traveling, to keep my phone in maximum protection.

I'm also getting one for my wife's Z Play.

I recommend it.
profile.summary: It also fits Z Play perfectly

profile.description: Made for all safety trades who appreciate good support, easy comfort and lightweight duty.
profile.reviewText:
I've three pairs of Stanley steel toe boots (Exploit, Outback, and Striker) before this pair, and they are all with high shafts.  As summer comes, I don't feel comfortable wearing high shaft boots, and Dredge comes to the rescue because it has low shaft and nylon ventilators on both sides.

The shafts are just high enough to protect my ankles.  This model is also cheaper comparing to the other three, but the quality and appearance is not compromised.

These shoes are very comfortable.  The non-slippery soles keep me sure footed.  I also wear them during yard work--lawn mowing, gardening, etc. to protect my feet.  I can wear them all day without discomfort.  It's also easy to take off and put on.

The only awkward part is the two pull straps on each shoe with Stanley brand printed on them in yellow.  They are thin and the added yellow color makes them look cheap.  It would have been very nice to come with leather straps.  However, in most situation, these straps are covered by your pants.

Another awkward thing is that if you walk on smooth surface, a polished tile floor, it makes a loud squeaky noise with every step you take. A little embarrassing if there are pretty ladies around. Well, these are just work boots, so no point deducted.

For those who need comfortable low shaft steel boots, I recommend these.
profile.summary: My Summer Steel Toe Boots

profile.description: The Buckshot Pro, 3-in-1, All Grown Up Bluetooth Speaker, Power Bank and Flash Light!
profile.reviewText:
I like this versatile speaker, flash light, and charger unit.  First of all, it's a great speaker.  Very easy to pair.  I like the voice announcement when pairing, "Connected!"  That eliminate confusion as to whether the devices are pair or not.  The the pairing is very fast.

The sound is great for the size of the speaker.  You just need to make sure that the speaker side, not the usb charger side is at the top to get the best sound. The water resistance feature is great to have, especially if you like to use it on the bike.  I wish it include a mic so that it can be totally hands free.

The flash light is not the spotlight type.  It is better used to read books because the light spreads out.

The charging feature is a plus for emergency power.
profile.summary: A Great Companion for Outdoor Fun

profile.description: The Case Logic huxton day Pack is a large volume day Pack with leathered fabric is perfect for transporting and protecting your laptop and other essentials
profile.reviewText:
The texture of the external material is quite beautiful.  You cannot see it on the picture but when you see it closer personally, touch it, and feel it, you'll love it.  Good quality workmanship is apparent both inside and out.

My 15" Lenovo ThinkPad Yoga fits perfectly in the well padded computer compartment. It also has a side zipped pocket on the outer section good for quick access for your phone.  The rest is for books, clothing, or whatever you need to put.

I wish it's a little bigger (thicker) to provide more room.  But at the current thickness, it seems to keep a good slim shape on your back.  I like the size and shape for the look, but I'd also like to have more room for practicality.

I recommend it!
profile.summary: A Well Made Daypack

profile.description: Trion air bear ; MERV 8 pleated HVAC filter; 6 per Pack ; low resistance to airflow and high dust holding capacity that reduces energy cost ; moisture resistant sturdy double-wall beverage board frame design ; White synthetic material
profile.reviewText:
I have been using 3M Filtrete over the years and happy with it. Trion T08-16251 is a cheaper alternative and I am glad to have a chance to try it.  First, the packaging is a disappointment.  The filters are not individually wrapped, unlike 3M.  They came in a larger box with filler paper.  The packaging person might have used too much force to push the filler paper down that caused the bending and twisting along one side of the filters.  It's not easy to reshape it back due to the wire frames.  I had to insert it into my heater with the twisted side up.

As for the quality of the filter, it looks comparable to the 3M I've been using, but I can't find the MPR rating for this product.  The cheaper price is a plus. I just wish they came individually wrapped in plastic so that they can be kept away from moisture and dust before being used.  And poor packaging is another minus.

profile.description: A fresh design with signature Dura Base protection make it easy to bring your camera and accessories on any location.
profile.reviewText:
This case is very well made, with good quality material and a hard plastic base both to protect impact from the bottom and keep it stand firm.

You can fit a DSLR (mine is Sony Alpha A580L) with an average zoom lens very comfortably, with a little room for a small second lens.  I wish it has more room for a wider lens that I have.

I also have a Lumix GH3, which fits well with a second lens.  For this it seems a little too deep.

Based on the shape, it is quite obvious that it is intended to be used for one camera and lens, without room for additional lens.  I always have a second lens, so it is a little frustrating.

I wish this bag is a little shallower and wider.

profile.description: Protect your phone from damage and express your personality at the same time with the Grip Max iPhone 5 case. Its durable polycarbonate body features shockproof TPU edges and interior AirShock pockets that evenly disperse impact forces to keep your phone working great. Available in a range of colors, there's a Grip Max to suit every taste.
profile.reviewText:
This case is thick enough to give good protection, and thin enough to keep iPhone 5s from appearing bulky.  I don't know the purpose of the spots inside the case.  The exterior has non-slippery surface, so the phone is unlikely to slip off your hand.  However, it does attract fingerprints.

The color is nice, but I wish the grey part is darker, or black, to make it look sharper.  However, it's eye-catching enough to make the phone easily locatable.  My daughter gets this case and she plans to put stickers on the grey area.  My wife likes the color combination.  So it's a matter of taste. When you actually put it on the phone, it really enhances the white front of the iPhone 5s.

All the buttons and holes are right on the spot, except the earphone plug, which seems just a little big off can makes it hard for the plug to easily slide all the way in. You have to wiggle a little bit.

Overall, it's a great case as far as protection goes without adding bulk, and the appearance is pleasant particularly if you like the color combination.  I recommend it!
profile.summary: Great Case if You Like the Color Combination

profile.description: Show your pride with this welded steel locker in your school colors. Showcasing the officially licensed logo of your favorite team, its the perfect addition to your garage, game room, den, home gym or anywhere you want to put your loyalty on display. Other features include a three-digit combination lock for added security and a hassle-free, lifetime limited warranty
profile.reviewText:
This locker is well constructed with heavy duty material and will definitely last a long time.  It will even be able to stand some rough beating of teenagers if it were used in such environment. The color scheme is also elegant.

The installation instruction is very clear, to make sure you install the closet properly to avoid injury to the users.  All the necessary hardware is included.  It comes with a combination lock that needs to be installed.  The small combination lock numbers might not be a problem for young people, but will surely a problem for older adults with weaker vision, but you can get used to it soon.  The only benefit of the small combination number is that your neighbor will not be able to see the numbers you push.

It's six feet tall with a fixed shelf, and you can hang a long coat or a lady's dress without problem.  The paint seems to be well coated and I don't see any possibility of getting rusted for a long time to come.

profile.description: Seagate Game Drive is a 1TB internal hybrid drive for PlayStation 3 or PlayStation 4. Store 25+ PS4 games and enjoy noticeably faster system boot and game play performance. Simple installation and easy configuration get you up and playing fast.
profile.reviewText:
I was curious about this Seagate "Grame Drive", and wonder what makes this special for PlayStation.  It turned out to be that this is just a smart marketing, targeting those who want to upgrade their PlayStation hard drive.  It's the same "Laptop SSHD" as it is clearly printed on the hard drive itself, but the box is labeled for PlayStation.

That being said, I think it gives the those who are not sure what drives are compatible a peace of mind knowing that they are buying a product that will work on the PlayStation for sure, as some information I found online said that they were not sure if SSHD would work with PlayStation.  Even thought this drive is priced a little more than other packaging, you are at least paying for a drive that is guaranteed to work on PlayStation.

As for the drive itself, I have exactly one like this on my ThinkPad for three years now, and it has been running beautifully ever since I put it in.  It's way cheaper than buying a 1TB SSD, and much faster than a regular 7200rpm hard drive.  The integration of SSD caching and magnetic hard drive is seamless.  So the quality of this drive is proven, at least for me.

As for using it on PlayStation, the upgrade process is reasonably easy, even for a non-tetchy.  Upgrade information is available readily on the net as well as on PlayStation website.  So I won't repeat it here.

In summary, I am glad the see that SSHD works for PlayStation.  It's a much cheaper option than SSD.  The quality of the driven is proven by my three years of using it.

I recommend it!
profile.summary: Taking out the Guesswork of Wondering whether SSHD would Work on PlayStation

profile.description: Building upon the sleek and sporty Luminosity photo line comes a streamlined holster for continuous quick access to your photo gear. Protect your Mirror less Camera or compact DSLR with standard lens in the easily accessible, top loading compartment. Interior pockets store small accessories and detachable, non-slip strap allow you to securely carry case across body or by the top grab handle.
profile.reviewText:
No doubt that Case Logic makes great camera holsters.  This one is no exception--secure, well padded, and easy to use.  This one is a little softer than I like, but it still serves good enough protection. It also comes with a rain cover and that is a plus.

The main problem is, it is not what it claims to fit.  This case will never fit any DSLR no matter how small it is.  It doesn't even fit Panasonic Lumix GH3 with a medium size lens.  It fits Panasonic Lumix DMC-FZ200, which is far smaller than any DSLR.  You can also fit small Micro Four-Thirds cameras such as Panasonic DMC=GF series with a longer lens.

So be warn of the size!

profile.description: General all-purpose waterproof safety toe work boot that features puncture proof plate that looks good after work too
profile.reviewText:
This is my second pair of Stanley's shoes and I am amazed at their quality and comfort.  They are a little large, so you might want to get one size, or half size down.  They appear quite fashionable too--who says work shoes have to be ugly.

They have well thought out combination of softness where it is necessary and strong protection front and back. I particularly like the soft neck at the top back of the shaft.  It makes my upper ankle very comfortable. These shoes don't have the pulling tab, but they are very easy to put on.

The rubber soles are also of high quality and non-slippery, making you really feel surefooted.  Like all steel toe shoes, it's a little bit awkward to walk in at the beginning, but soon it becomes quite easy and comfy.

====Update====

Now I own four models of Stanley steel toe shoes--Exploit, Dredge, Striker, and this Outback.  Among all these, I find Outback to be the most comfortable. They are a little large, so I would suggest that you get a half, or one, size smaller.

I recommend these shoes!
profile.summary: Great Combination of Comfort and Protection

profile.description: Improve grip and strengthen the wrist and forearms. Gaiam Restore's hand and arm therapy bar is flexible rubber and designed to bend and twist, equating to 5-10lbs. Of strength-building resistance. Prevent stiffness, alleviate soreness and help soothe tennis elbow.
profile.reviewText:
My right wrist hurts when I bend it back, for example, every time I do the Table Top Yoga pose.  It started when I injured my wrist from falling on an icy parking lot last year.  So I wondered if this Hand & Arm Therapy Bar would help.  So far it seems to do the trick.

The product comes with a list of suggested exercises.  The most helpful exercise for me is twisting the bar back and forth, like wringing a wet towel.  The problem is, other than that, I don't find any exercise useful.  the bending force is very weak for 180lb man.  I am trying to invent some exercises out of this.  I find shaking or swinging it, since it is a little weighty, helps a bit.

If you have hand or arm injury, you might want to give it a try.

Even though they are made in China, this set of tools doesn't look cheap at all.  The fact that a huge "Made in China" label was inscribed on the hammer seems to indicate that the manufacturer is proud of this product.  They are well made, with rubber coated handles for better grip.

profile.description: Light up a Tea light Candle and Keep Your Tea warm by this fabulous teapot warmer. Dimension: 5-3/4in Diameter x 3-1/2in H Material: Cast Iron Color: Black.
profile.reviewText:
This item comes in three pieces.  The warmer, the grate, and a kettle support.  The last piece is not in the picture.

The kettle support is to be put inside the warmer with the circle at the bottom and the three pillars at the top.  You might wonder why it is necessary.  The reason is the warmer is not supposed to be used with the grate on top of it (more about it later).  A tea light is to be put in the middle of the circle.

The grate is better set aside to be used as a cast iron coaster because if you put it on top of the warmer, it will make the kettle base too far from the heat that comes from the tea light at the bottom, and you would end up wondering if you need multiple candles to the tea warm.  And you will also lose heat through the side holes of the grate. (Please see the pictures I uploaded.) Using the grate is only necessary to be used on top of the warmer when you need a flat surface for certain flat-base kettles.

Without the grate on the warmer, the round kettle base can nest down a little bit into the warmer and keep the heat from being wasted. If your kettle is small, the kettle support pillars will keep it supported, keeping a reasonable distance from the tea light (now you know what the kettle support is for).  In this position I can keep the tea at the perfect sipping temperature.

I've also tried this warmer with Sterno canned heat, but it keeps the tea too hot to drink.  If you want to keep the tea very hot, you can use a Sterno can with the grate on the warmer.

One star is deducted for having no instruction for how to use the warmer and the functions of the pieces.  I had to figure that out from experience.  Hope this helps!  Again, please check out my uploaded picture for visual illustration.
profile.summary: Good Warmer, but it Comes with No Instruction, So Here's How to Use It

profile.description: The Misfit Shine 2 is an advanced, premium activity and sleep monitor that inspires you to live a more active life. Shine 2’s beautiful 12 tri-color LEDs, vibration alerts and capacitive touch introduces new ways to interact and motivate your to meet your health and fitness goals. Made from aluminum and water resistant to 50 meters, Shine 2’s minimalist, modular design will keep you motivated and looking good for any occasion, any activity. Compatible with most modern iOS, Android and Windows mobile devices, sync Shine 2 with the Misfit app to get easy to read information and charts on your activity and sleep patterns.
profile.reviewText:
I have both Misfit Ray and Shine.  They are both synced with the same Misfit app.  Each has its benefits.  Ray is securely attached to the wrist band and unlikely to fall out; Shine could fall out of wrist band but it's rare with the latest band design (2016). Ray allows you to wear your watch next to it because it's just like a bracelet and it doesn't show time; Shine takes the place of a watch, and it shows time using lights in different colors, but you need to learn the trick to read it, quickly before the lights go off.

The main problem I have is accuracy, but after using many activity trackers like this, I can say that this technology is still evolving and few are accurate including the expensive ones.

I like Misfits' sleep tracking of both light and deep sleeps.  The problem is I usually get up once at night to go to the bathroom.  Misfit doesn't recognize my sleep after the potty break.  So, as I usually get up around 3am to go to the bathroom, Misfit thinks I wake up at 3am and that's the end of my sleep recording.  I need to track my sleep because, as you know, good sleep is an important part of fitness.  When I tried clipping it to the waste of my pants, it shows I had more deep sleep, but still my potty break is where my sleep time ends.

Activity tracking during the day is also inaccurate, but fair enough.  For most people, this tracker would be a good motivator to be more active.  I have sports trackers for my workout activities for better tracking. But they are much more expensive.  In spite of the accuracy issue, Misfit Ray and Shine are still a great deal.

Shine and Ray have some other fancy features that you might like.  For example, you can set them to vibrate when you get a call or text.  This can be very useful if you happen to leave your phone in your bag in silent mode or somewhere you can't hear.  You can set an alarm clock to have it wake you up with vibration. You can even control the PowerPoint slides by tapping your Shine or Ray.

If you are not a fitness nut, but just want to track your daily activities and sleep condition, Misfit Shine or Ray are a good value.
profile.summary: Inaccurate but Good Value

profile.description: Light up any situation with 210 lumens of bright LED light, or use the dimmable, DuaLite Directional Lighting feature to extend runtime. Recharge from USB, or a Goal Zero external solar panel. The Lighthouse Mini includes a built-in USB port to power small handheld devices to keep you connected to the ones who matter most. The Lighthouse Mini Lantern & USB Power Hub is the only lantern you will need.
profile.reviewText:
I have many battery powered LED lights around the house for use during power outage (we had several serious outages in the Northeast in the past years due to the major storms including Hurricane Sandy) and of course for camping in the woods.  Most of them have switching problem after awhile.  This Goal Zero 32003 seems solidly built around the switch, and the design is very sturdy, cute, and creative.

It's much smaller than I expected because from the picture I expected it to be the size of a lantern, but this is just a little bigger than your fist.  However, it is very bright.  I keep it near my workshop area and use it when I need an accessory light to see what I'm cutting or drilling.  It's also small enough to keep it in your glove compartment for emergency use.

It comes with a charging cable built in so that you wouldn't have to hunt for the cable when you need it.  The phone charging port is also a bright idea.  The legs can also be folded up to make it every smaller to put it in your pocket or backpack.  This is the best LED convenient light I've ever seen.

I recommend it.
profile.summary: What a Bright Idea!

View larger WINBOT is safe & scratch proof WINBOTs dual suction rings, powerful motor, back-up battery, safety pod & tether keep the robot safely on windows, even above the first floor. The body of WINBOT is surrounded by extremely soft material that wont scratch window frames, and the material on underside of WINBOT is engineered not to scratch the glass. FAQs: Can WINBOT fall off the window during cleaning? WINBOT clings to a window with the use of a constant vacuum-suction powered by a normal wall outlet. In the event of power failure, WINBOT has redundant safety systems to prevent falling. Ecovacs robotics Winbot features award winning technology. Live smart. Enjoy life. View Larger additional facts & FAQs who is Ecovacs robotics? Ecovacs robotics, Inc. Is a global vacuum brand with more than 15 years of experience providing consumers with greater freedom and convenience at home. Ecovacs robotics is an industry leader in product innovation and design that is enjoyed by more than 30 million consumers worldwide. Ecovacs robotics is also the only brand with products in all segments of the home robotics category: (1) floor cleaning with Ecovacs robotics DEEBOT (2) window cleaning with Ecovacs robotics WINBOT (3) air cleaning with Ecovacs robotics ATMOBOT (4) entertainment/security with Ecovacs robotics FAMIBOT FAQS: can WINBOT clean any type of dirt or residue? Most cleaning solutions on the market today contain these ingredients and may damage WINBOT. Only the front cleaning pad should be sprayed prior to use.
profile.reviewText:
This is a fantastic invention.  However, it's for large widows.  I wish it's lighter and smaller so that it can climb on average household windows.

Out of the box, the set up is quite easy, but the illustrations are a little confusing.  I followed the Quick Start Guide.  Plug in the power, switched to charging mode, and let it charge until the green light stopped blinking.  It was supposed to take two hours, but it took only thirty minutes, maybe because it was partially charged.

The next part of the Quick Start Guide, "Safety Protection" is confusing.  I can't figure out where to connect the safety robe by looking at the picture.  It is mainly used for outside of the window. So for now, I skipped this step and went ahead to the next step to test out the robot on our large living room window.

It's fascinating to see this robot traveling around the window like a ladybug.  It goes to the edges and corners.  It shows no signs of falling possibility.  One problem is, it's quite loud.  I have to raise the TV volume to watch TV.  The noise might prevent you from forgetting that you have a robot on your window.

One star is deducted for a few cons:
1) Confusing illustrations regarding the safety protection set up, but this is minor.
2) Noisy when it is working.
3) Requiring an electric cable, which limits the length (height) this robot could travel.

Overall, I enjoy playing with this toy that does a house chore for me.  This is definitely a pioneer for the future improvements, particularly totally going wireless.
profile.summary: A Fantastic Invention with Great Potential

profile.description: The Flamelesss Safety Flare is a Battery-operated flare that provides a brightly illuminated, flashing RED signal that will be seen up to 1,000 feet away. Keep this handy device in your car in case of emergencies.
profile.reviewText:
It's always good to have a flare handy in your car for emergency.  I was happy to see this reusable Flameless Flare powered by two AAA batteries.  The pro is that it is flameless and it uses convenient size batteries.  The con is it is not a bright as the regular flare.  Another major problem is it easily lit up just by accidentally touching the button of the flare, result of a poor design.  If you are going to keep it in your car, you definitely have to keep the batteries out to avoid accidental lighting up by the movement of the car; of course it also help to avoid normal battery drain.

In general, it is good to have one like this in your car, you just have to make sure you always have a pair of fresh batteries along with it.  You might need a few of them in the car since it is not so bright.  Using a bunch of them is a way to compensate their dimness.
profile.summary: A great idea, but no so bright

profile.description: Trainer combines the freedom of wireless Bluetooth technology, a secure fit, and exceptional sound quality, to take your music and your workouts to the next level.
profile.reviewText:
The packaging is fantastic!  More importantly, what's inside is state of the art.  The Aero Flex rail is such a creative idea to keep the headphones stable on your head.  The material used in every part is of great quality, outstanding design, and elegant color selection.

The only thing I didn't expect is it weights a little heavier than I thought.  Maybe it's due to the quality of the material.  But, as long as it stays on my head, it doesn't matter.

The buttons are easy to remember and reach.  The weather proof and sweat proof features ares highly welcome in this hot summer.  The washable earpiece covers are what a clean idea. They are easy to remove and put back.  Eventually, you might have to buy some additional ear piece covers, but not for a long time.

The sound is very precise with perfect level of base.  No distortion or muffling.  If safe to run or bike with it because you can still hear the environment, such as a car honk.

I highly recommend it!
profile.summary: State of the Art

profile.description: Durable metal hand stapler with plier design fits snugly in hand and staples 60 sheets at a time. Features top loading and includes an integrated safety loop. Requires high capacity staples. For best performance use the heavy duty plier stapler exclusively with Swingline Optima high capacity staples. (S7035550) limited lifetime warranty.
profile.reviewText:
I was reluctant to try out this Swingline Plier Stapler because of the negative reviews before me, but I needed a stapler for thick stacks of paper at my office, so I decided to try it out.  It turned out to be better than I expected.  I can staple a 40 - 50 stack of paper easily, and I tried it on a stack of cardboard and it went through without effort.

Yes, it does have a clear plastic puller inside to pull the spring back for you to insert staples, but it feels stronger than needed to do the job, so I'm not concerned.  Those old staplers with a metal puller didn't work better.  Other than that plastic puller, the rest of the stapler appears to be of heavy duty.

I recommend it!
profile.summary: It Staples Thick Paper Stacks Effortlessly

profile.description: NOTE: The case only fits the Samsung Galaxy Tab pro 8.4(2014 released). It will NOT fit Galaxy Tab 4 8.0(2014 released) or Galaxy Tab 3 8.0(2013 released) or any other model tablet.
profile.reviewText:
Ha, the price dropped after I received mine at $5.99 (now it's $4.99)!  Anyway, these covers are good for the money.

I knew I needed a cover with a hard shell back because the Galaxy Tab Pro 8.4 has very thin borders, which might not take a sewn leather case well.  This case is the right one, the hard shell is perfect fit and the front cover is good enough quality; it might not last long, but you can't expect more for the price.  If it lasted a year, I'll be happy.

The front cover also shuts off the tablet when you close it.  I think the magnet for closing could be a little stronger, or the spine be a little stiffer so that the front cover wouldn't shift.  But, the current shifting of the front cover is not really problematic.

In any case, at this early stage, where Galaxy Tab Pro 8.4 cover is hard to find, this is as good as you can get, for the price.

I recommend it!
profile.summary: Good for the price!

profile.description: Invicta's Specialty collection delivers another bold and sporty design with this men's timepiece in a black, polyurethane strap and multi-function dial set inside a thick, stainless steel case. A 100M water resistance and screw-down case back make this watch ready for any adventure.
profile.reviewText:
I own a few big watches, but this Invicta 21403 makes them all look small and light.  It's a watch for the Terminator.  If you are 6'+ with a built of a NFL player, you would love this watch.  As for me, at 5'11" with 185lb, I can only feel comfortable if I don't wear long sleeves.  It doesn't get under your sleeve, but nice if you want to show off.

The built quality is very nice, but it's very heavy.  The design is very manly.  I love it as a specialty or collector's watch.  It's a good conversation starter among big boys.

I deducted one star because the three small dials are hard to figure out exactly where they are pointing, and part of the day, it's blocked by the hour and minute hands. I would say these interior dials are more decorative than practical.

I recommend it!
profile.summary: For Those Who Think Bigger is Better!

profile.description: SERENITY, Tiffany-style Victorian semi-flush ceiling is handcrafted with pure stained glass. Each glass piece individually positioned to create the perfect look and crystal gems to highlight the perfection. Exquisite touches create warmth and serenity. Expertly crafted with top quality materials.
profile.reviewText:
Only after installation, I noticed one little small piece missing, creating a hole.  Even though it's not immediately noticeable because it is buried among other colorful pieces, it's quite irritating once you know it's there.  Then I saw another tiny hole on a larger piece, caused by a bubble on the glass.  There are other glass pieces that have bubbles in it, indicating poor quality glasses.

The single sheet installation manual is very poorly produced--you can hardly read it.  Even if you read it, the order of installation doesn't make sense.  It asks you to pretty much assemble everything before you hang it up.  That means you have to hold the entire thing while you connect the wires.  I was replacing an old light fixture, so I just followed the reversed order of removing the old one.

I have two 60w LED bulbs on it and it looks okay, but it needs to be brighter at times.  I have 100w bulbs on the way and hope they will make a difference.

The only attraction is the price.  If I found that hole disturbing, I have to send it back.  I don't enjoy removing, repackaging and shipping it back.

I don't know why all others reviewers gave it five star, but this is definitely not a high quality product.
profile.summary: Good Price, Nice Looking, but Poor Quality

profile.description: One of the lightest and most durable spinner carry-ons on the market, this luggage features a padded front pocket that fits up to a 14" computer and a removable cable pouch in the bottom pocket perfect for electronic accessories or last minute items. Body dimensions: 20.5x13.5x9.5 inches; Overall Dimensions (including external components such as wheels, feet and handles): 22.75x14.25x10.25 inches. The size and weight restrictions for carry-on luggage vary by airline. Please contact your airline for more information. If your bag is overstuffed, it may not be approved for carry-on use by the airlines.
profile.reviewText:
This Delsey carry-on luggage is extremely lightweight to the point that it feels flimsy when I initially picked it up. After a close investigation, I fell in love with it's quality.  I don't know how they made it, but they manage to deliver quality without weight.  It has good quality interior lining and well designed compartments. The wheels are smooth. The bright color allows you to find your luggage faster.

In this day and age when the airlines are ripping us off for each additional pound of luggage weight, this super lightweight luggage would pay for itself in time. I have been using a Kirkland carry-on for years which is very well made, but it's has it's own weight that prevent me from stuffing everything I want to carry with me. Now I have this new traveling companion and I'm very happy with it.

I recommend it!
profile.summary: Lightweight and Well Made

profile.description: The Seagate Mobile HDD offers a thin size, huge storage and amazing value. Seagate's highest-capacity thin 7mm laptop drives, in capacities up to 2TB. Incredible value with best cost per TB and cost per millimeter for thin mobile/laptop customers. Light in weight to support portable computers without adding bulk. Enables drop-in 2TB capacity transition without the weight of traditional laptop drives. Stores up to 200,000 photos, 250,000 songs or 124 hours of high-definition video. Standard SATA 6Gb/s interface promotes ease of integration into an existing mobile/laptop design. Easy deployment for laptop upgrades while enabling the small 7mm form factor system design. Ideal for traditional laptops, convertible and detachable storage and slim consumer electronic devices.
profile.reviewText:
I put this hard drive in a USM bay and used Parkdale speed test software to measure the read and write speed.  To my surprise it's faster than one of my internal 3.5" 7200rpm drive.  It writes at 122.3 mb/s and reads at 135.3 mb/s.  I've another newer internal 3.5" 7500rpm drive which reads and writes at 166 mb/s.  All of them are made by Seagate.  So this drive is just in between, not fast, but not so slow either.  However, when you put it in a computer with 6GB/s SATA connection, the speed doubles (at 260 mb/s).

Considering that it's 5400rpm drive, which consumes less power and produces less heat, this drive is really a good value.

It's also pretty light comparing to older drives, so it doesn't add much weight if you put it in an ultra portable computer.  The only question is how it handles drops and impacts.  So far it looks quite well constructed.  I have it in my USM enclosure, carrying it around in my backpack with no problem.

I recommend it.
profile.summary: Very Good Value for the Performance

profile.description: The De'Longhi PACAN140HPEWS Whisper Cool Portable Air Conditioner with Heat Function is the smartest way to stay cool while saving energy. Portable but powerful, this 4-in-1 unit has cooling, dehumidifying, heat mode and a fan to circulate the air, efficient in rooms up to 600 square feet. Equipped with industry-first Real Feel technology to secure the best comfort level possible, combining temperature reduction and humidity control. Use the handy heat mode to take the chill out of cool nights and mornings. Sleep peacefully or watch TV with Whisper Cool technology, emitting 50% less noise than previous models. The PACAN140HPEWS is equipped with no-drip technology that automatically recycles condensation within the unit, helping to prevent any type of leaks. The BioSilver Filter helps to block the growth of mold and mildew on the filter to reduce odors. The Whisper Cool Portable Air Conditioner with Heat Function features a Sensor Touch panel with lighted display, an adjustable thermostat, 3 fan speeds and a 24-hour on/off timer. Its easy to move around to cool only the room youre in, so you can keep your household thermostat higher and reduce your utility bills.
profile.reviewText:
This is the best portable air conditioner I have used so far.  Here's why:

The first portable AC I've used was Honeywell MN12CES, which is a fine unit but comparing to this one, that's a bit ugly.  I also have two other units, but nothing compares to this one aesthetically.  It makes you wanting to brag about it in front of your guests rather than hiding it before they come.  This size is also a little smaller than comparable units.

Secondly, it is a four-in-one unit, which sounds nice, but all portable AC are three-in-one, so it has only one additional feature, but a major feature--heating.  This make it totally convenient to use in a room where you don't have both heating and cooling.  For me, now I am using it in a bed room, but after summer I can take it down to the basement where there is no heat.  So works for you at least two seasons in a year rather than being put in storage most of the year.

The packaging is a little better than the previous De'Longhi model, but it still can be better.  By better I mean, I want the box and packaging material reusable in case I need to ship it back or somewhere.  The box and packaging material of this unit barely survived careful unpacking.  I wonder if they intentionally does it so to discourage shipping back.

Installation is swift.  No screws need it--click, twist, and plug it in.  That's it.  The user manual is straight forward.

The best part of this unit is that you don't have to drain the water like you have to with most other portable ACs, unless you live in an extremely humid place, because the water is vaporized and blown out of the window along with the hot air.  To me, that feature alone is worth the price because I don't enjoy the chore of draining water from the portable AC.

Everything seems perfect with this unit.  The only thing left to observe is how long it will last.  Based on the way it is constructed, I am quite confident that it is built to last and I hope so.

If you are considering an indoor AC unit, I recommend giving this a try.

==== Update ====
It has been a year since I got this unit and it's still running strong.  The noise is the smooth type, meaning not as disturbing.  The quiet mode allows us to sleep undisturbed.
profile.summary: The best portable air conditioner I have used so far

profile.description: Introducing Seagate Desktop Solid State Hybrid DrivesSSD Performance. HDD Capacity. Affordable Price.SSHDs are now available for your desktop computer. Get the speed and kick of an integrated solid state drive (SSD) with the massive capacity of a desktop hard drive - all at a surprisingly low price! Solid state speed for fast, responsive system performance Up to 2 Terabytes of massive storage capacity Innovative use of solid state memory delivers affordable performance and capacity NAND Flash and HDD technology work better together to deliver improved reliability
profile.reviewText:
I have good experience with Seagate products, but this one was a shock.  I almost put the drive aside, considering installing it some time later after the busy holiday season.  I am glad I didn't.  I cloned the drive boot it up and was happy to see this new, fast, and spacious drive working, dreaming that I would be able to store a great deal of the videos I shoot.

The next day, I found the screen frozen.  Tried a cold boot, and the system told me that there is no bootable drive.  Tried many ways, checked the BIOS, nothing works.  Replaced with my old drive, left it there as the second drive, boot it up, the second drive is no way to find.  After various methods of diagnosis and attempts to resurrect it unsuccessfully, I had to declare it RIP.  Sad!

I don't enjoy repacking it and sending it back.  A waste of my precious time!
profile.summary: How could this bad thing happen to good people? :)

profile.description: The RIDGID 4-gallon wet dry portable vacuum cleaner with a 5.0 peak horsepower motor offers the powerful performance necessary to tackle even the messiest projects. The 20 ft. cord provides an extensive reach, and the 12 lbs. RIDGID shop vacuum cleaner design is lightweight and very portable. Its compact, portable design provides ease of use for transporting and storage, making it the ideal car vacuum cleaner or vacuum for your shop.
profile.reviewText:
Ridgid VAC4000 is very powerful and lightweight, and it's perfect for cleaning work areas about the size of an average garage or basement.  Even though the setup is simple enough, the instruction manual is not clear.  It comes with a diffuser for noise reduction, but the instruction doesn't show where to plug it in.  It says it is to be plugged in to the blower port, but there's no indication of where the blower port is located.  However there are plenty of Youtube videos available for figuring out the setup.  Otherwise, it's a very sturdy and great for heavy duty usage.

This model doesn't have enough storage area for organizing the hose and its attachments.  There's only one holding area at the top for one of the attachments.  I will have to buy a long tube attachment because I can't squat and get up easily.  This model doesn't have wheels, but the vacuum itself is very light, so I can carry it in one hand for a long time without a problem as I move about vacuuming.

Even though I don't have any reason to use it from wet condition, it's always good to have one just in case.  You can also attach the hose to the blower port to use it as a blower. The filter is said to last for a long time (more than a year) if you clean it regularly.  So it's a great value for a powerful and versatile vacuum.

I recommend it!
profile.summary: Powerful and Very Ridgid

profile.description: The Home Design wireless book / computer light comes with sixteen super bright white LED that last up to 100,000 hours. This light can be operated by plugging it into the usb port on a computer or other device, or by plugging it directly into the provided computer mouse base (which is battery operated). Light head adjusts for ideal lighting. This light has an 8" flexible neck for positioning at almost any angle. Perfect for school, home, the office, travel and much more! Makes tasks like sewing, knitting, writing, little household repairs so much easier on the eyes. Please have a look at our reviews! "This light is nothing short of awesome! It is very bright and is so versatile." J.Foster "In short, this is an awesome USB light." Terrance S.
profile.reviewText:
It's light weight, very flexible and bright.  It's too bright for using in the dark as a book light.  It's almost as bright as a small desk lamp.  I like the convenience of using the AA batteries.

When I turned it on for the first time, I found one LED didn't turn on and was disappointed, even though it was still very bright with one LED missing.  But, by the time I wrote the review, all LED turn on.  So I don't know what caused the initial problem.

Due to it's awkward level of brightness, it's hard to put it in the right use.  When I plugged it in to my computer USB port, it seems too bright to use it to shine either my keyboard or around the computer area.  I had to turn it away from my face.  If I use it as a desk lamp, it's not quite enough for the purpose.

I wish it has a dimmer so that it can be adjusted according to the need of the environment.
profile.summary: Nice Bright and Cute Little LED Light

profile.description: Everyone can ride in style with the Blackburn Limo.
profile.reviewText:
Update 5/3/2016: We have been enjoying this stroller very much and it trails very smoothly even through the paths full of twist and turns. So that I upgraded the rating to five stars.
---------------
It's the perfect season to take my bike out and have some fun with my little girl with this stroller in the park.  It is heavy duty and very roomy, and can handle up to 100 pounds, we put two toddlers in the stroller and they had a great deal of fun.  It's like riding on a horse carriage.  I got some good workout towing a big kid.

The assembly is a little challenging but carefully following the instruction would take you there in about an hour.  You can't easily fold it back for storage, unless you disassemble it.  For this part I'm deducting one star.

Overall, it's a great joy to tow this stroller with my bike.  I like the workout that comes with a lot of fun like this.  I recommend it!
profile.summary: A fun way to get some workout

profile.description: The Mr. Coffee K-Cup Single Serve 24 oz. Coffee Maker delivers incredible convenience thanks to our partnership with Keurig. That's rightyou can use your favorite K-Cup varieties to brew delicious, single-cup beverages whenever you want them. Simply add fresh water to the 24 oz. reservoir, insert your desired K-Cup Pod, and press the brew button. You can even choose between between 3 brew sizes: 6 oz., 8 oz., or 10 oz. No matter how you make it, you'll fall in love with every cup, thanks to this innovative collaboration between two of the most trusted brands in home coffee brewing.
profile.reviewText: One thing I don't like about machine like these is they are like buying an inkjet printer; you have to continue buying supplies for it. My solution is that I bought EZ-Cup for Keurig Coffee Machines By Perfect Pod and EZ-Cup Filter Papers by Perfect Pod- 3 pack (150 filters) so that I can use my own coffee powder and tea leaves on this machine. Other than that, this machine is easy to use and well designed. It looks good in your dining room too. All you need is just to add the water and learn to insert the K-cups and press a couple of buttons. It works fast and withing a few minutes you have a fresh cup of coffee or tea of your choice.
profile.summary: Like the machine, but...

profile.description: The Logitech Living Room Keyboard K410has a 10 m (33 ft) wireless range and large, built-in multi-touch touchpad to easily control your laptop when it's connected to the TV
profile.reviewText:
First of all, please note that this is NOT a keyboard for your TV.  It's for the PC connected to your TV.  So it's basically a Windows keyboard.  The product title is very clear but it could be misconstrued as a TV keyboard.  It might work with a TV directly, but it's not meant for such use.

This is much better made than the K400 (not K400 Plus) that I have.  Both the keyboard and touchpad works smoothly and are very comfortable to use.  The connection is easy and it's definitely plug and play using the dongle that comes with it.  I'm using it at about 20 feet away from my TV (with the mini-PC installed hidden behind the TV) and there's notconnection issue at all.

My old K400 feels so cheap, but there were no other better choices those days to find a full size keyboard with touchpad like this.  I feel so jealous to see the Apple keyboards of the same style that came out so sleek and high quality.  Now I am glad that they made K410 in a much better quality.  (It can still be better, but for the price, I guess I can't ask for more.)

I think the touchpad can be bigger, since there is an empty space under the touchpad, which is unused and wasted.  Just a thought.

For those who want a couch potato keyboard with touchpad, I recommend it!
profile.summary: A Nice Couch Potato Keyboard

profile.description: Sunlite 04364 LFX/WL/30W/W 30 watt 120 volt led portable work lamp fixture, black/red finish 2000 lumens, ul listed for damp location.
profile.reviewText:
LED technology has permanently changed the light industry, but I used to pay dearly to get one like this because traditional work lights are too hot to work with, especially during summer.  I still have a 200-watt work light that burns my fingers if I touch it.

This Sunlite LFX work light is light, bright, and cool.  2000 lumens is bright enough for most work, under the car, in a garage, or using it as a back light for photo shoot. The only feature I wish it has is a dimmer.

This light is well built and durable for a light LED fixture. It CAN be used in the damp area.  There is a label on the wire that says, not to "service" it at the damp area.  That's commonsense, but some people might think it means not to "use" it there.  In the back of the light, it says that you CAN use it at the damp area.

I recommend it!
profile.summary: Bright, Ligth, and Cool

profile.description: The BLACK+DECKER LCSB2140 40V MAX Lithium 21-inch Snow Thrower is great for snow removal for driveways, sidewalks and decks! This snow thrower offers a rubber auger with a 21-inch clearing path which allows for fast, efficient snow removal. The brushless motor technology provides the power and a long runtime. This unit includes (2) 2.5Ah 40V MAX lithium batteries so you can run the blower on longer clearing jobs. It offers a push button start for quick start up, along with a 180-degree rotational chute that throws up to 20 feet. Maximum initial battery voltage (measured without a workload) is 40V. Nominal voltage is 36. Includes: (1) LCSB2140 40V MAX Lithium Snow Thrower, (2) 2.5Ah 40V MAX Lithium Batteries, (1) Charger, (1) Anti-Jam Rod, (1) Safety Key.
profile.reviewText:
===Update===
I've a few chances to use this snow thrower this winter.  It works very well for snow up to 6".  It's light, quick, and convenient to get out and get the work done, comparing to my other heavy snow thrower with gas engine.  However, when one day there was 18" of snow, this machine keeps stalling every time I pushed it forward a few inches or so.

If you live in an area where over 6" of snow is rare, this machine would be good for you.  Otherwise, this can be used as a spare machine.

============

After frying two electric (corded) snow blower, I decided to buy a gas powered Honda snow blower last year. The reason I gave electric blower a chance first was because I hate maintaining an engine.  I rather use a shovel than a noisy gas engine.  But those electric ones just couldn't handle North Jersey heavy snow very long, and my back is getting old for the heavy Jersey snow falls in recent years.

Now, it's pleasant surprise to see a cordless electric snow blower, but my previous experience has made me doubtful that this would work well.  However, after seeing the product, I feel much positive.

The first thing I like is it comes with a rubber auger, which is similar to what I have in my Honda snow blower.  All my former electric snow blowers.came with plastic auger, which made them cheap.  Now the nice rubber auger tells me that this Black & Decker snow blower is a serious machine.

The second reason I like it is because it comes with 40v batteries that is interchangeable with my Black & Decker LST136W 40V Max Lithium String Trimmer, which has been the best trimmer I've owned. Since it also came with a charger, now I have two chargers to get the batteries ready for tasks.  I might consider buying other tools from this product family so that I can swap batteries among them.  My great experience with the trimmer gives me confidence in this snow blower.

I tried to set it up without reaching the manual, just to find out how user friendly it is.  I was able to set it up in a few minutes without the need of any tools.  The only place I got stuck was when I tried to start it.  Having used electric blower before, I should have remembered that you need to press the start button first before you pull the starter leaver handle.  Once I figured it out, I got the machine started in a snap.

I will update this review when the first snow falls in North Jersey.  So far the dry test of the machine looks impressive.  It even comes with an Anti-Jam Rod, which is very considerate.  I am not praying for snow since we had more than enough last year, but I can't wait to take this machine on a roll in the snow.
profile.summary: A New Impressive Member in the Max Lithium Family

profile.description: Whether you're playing volleyball on the beach or slaving over the stove in a hot kitchen, Ashland Chill makes it easy to stay hydrated throughout the day. Not only will your drink stay icy cold for up to 18 hours but you'll also have a free hand because of its simple one handed operation.
profile.reviewText:
This Contigo Autospout water bottle is impressively well designed and made of high quality material.  It fits the hands of both men and women as the upper part is thinner and the lower part is thicker, allowing more content (20oz) at the same time keeping it slim enough for smaller hands.  It also fit the standard bottle pocket on my backpack.

The mechanism of very part is very precisely developed and easily usable.  It also keeps the chill for quite a long time.  Washing it is not as hard as I thought as the straw is removable, unless you put some sticky drink.  If you use it as a "water" bottle, there is no problem keeping it clean.

I recommend it.
profile.summary: Every Well Made and Convenient to Use

profile.description: The thin and lightweight Belkin Ultimate Keyboard Case for iPad reinvents the tablet as an enhanced productivity tool. The keyboard's large well-spaced keys provide laptop-like typing, while its thin 6.4-millimeter profile makes desk or lap use very comfortable. Three neodymium magnets keep the iPad securely in place and automatically turn the keyboard on and off, so that the keyboard is only on when you're using it. When you're not using the keyboard, the battery is saved and the onscreen keyboard automatically reappears. With its 160-hour battery life and wireless Bluetooth connection, the Ultimate Keyboard Case travels well, giving you the utility of a laptop without sacrificing mobility.
profile.reviewText:
My daughter is quite picky when it comes to accessories for her iPad.  But this keyboard and cover has not come off her iPad since the time it was attached.

It has tasteful design, a light weight construction, and plug and play connection with the iPad.

The only question is why this case comes with a Micro USB charging port instead of the normal iPad charger.  Even though Micro USB is more common nowadays on the non-Apple devices, having this on this Apple product makes you having to carry two wires--one for charging the iPad and the other for charging the keyboard.  Fortunately, BlueTooth does not use much power, so you don't need to charge it often.

Over all, if you want to turn your iPad to a mini notebook computer, this keyboard will serve the purpose very well.  I recommend it.
profile.summary: My Daughter Loves It

profile.description: Our original cotton blend crew neck sweater is crafted from a stretchy cotton blend that gives it a heathered appearance.
profile.reviewText:
I normally wear medium size, but based on my past experience with Tommy Hilfiger's Cotton Blend sweaters, and other reviews, I decided to try large size this time, and it turn out to be a perfect fit, except the arms become longer than I like, but I can fold it to look good.

Material wise, it's a nice blend of mainly cotton with nylon and elastane.  It feels comfortably warm, strong, and elastic.  The color blend is also elegantly masculine.

For the first time I'm feeling that fall has arrived, after a brutally hot summer.  It feels a little chilly today with around 60F in the morning.  So I decided to wear this to work, feeling very stylish and comfortable.  I might have to take it off in the afternoon.  This sweater will definitely serve me well for fall and early winter.

I recommend it!
profile.summary: Nice Sweater, but Buy a Size Larger

profile.description: we like to think of this cute kate spade new york scallop tracker as a personal cheerleader: it links automatically to the kate spade new york connected app to provide bursts of motivation, celebrations with every success and the tools to stay stylishly organized. track your steps, sleep and other habits, set personal goals, count down to lifes merriest moments (big and small!) and get inspired every single day. your tracker alerts you with light notifications, controls music, takes selfies and never needs chargingand, with a black polyurethane strap, a bow closure and dainty scalloped gold-tone topring with cat ears, its as chic as it is functional.
profile.reviewText:
Update:
I changed the rating from the original 3 stars to 5, after calling Kate Spade Support and getting the problem solved.  The support lady was very knowledgeable, polite, and helpful.  Now the tracking feature is working properly.  As for other features, I'm still experimenting, but I know Kate Spate is working hard to improve the app.

--------- Original Review ------------

This Kate Spade Cat Scallop Activity Tracker comes with a beautiful packaging and the watch is very well designed and classy.

Setting up with my daughter's iPhon 5s went smoothly, but we can't get the "three taps" setting to work with her camera.

So I decided to try it with my Android phone (Motorola Moto Z). The app couldn't recognize the watch.  I tried every possible way suggested by the app: reinstalling the battery, restarting Bluetooth, etc.  Even though the phone found the watch and I could manually connect to the watch from my phone's Bluetooth setting, the app just doesn't recognize it.  I went through the entire process several times with different diagnostic steps, nothing works.

I have used and still am using several of these activity trackers and very familiar with its technology.  I am sure the app is premature.

For now my daughter can track her activity, except can't use some additional features.  Hope the app will improve and make it easier to use.
profile.summary: Classy Activity Tracker with a Premature App

profile.description: An Amazon Brand.
profile.reviewText:
This 7-Piece Bed in a Bag from AmazonBasics is a great value and very convenient set.  The color (in grey stripes with yellow interior) is not fancy but quite elegant.  The fabric is very soft and comfortable.  The wrinkle free feature make it always look neat and tidy.

The comforter is just thick enough to be comfy but a little lighter than my preferred weight.  It's about two inches thick and very even. The comforter is 86-by-90 inch, perfect size for queen size bed.  Other items include 90-by-102 inch flat sheet, 60-by-80 inch fitted sheet, two 20-by-26 inch shams, and two 20-by-32 inch queen pillowcases.

This set is not for showing off your bedroom to you guest, but it is very practical for daily use.  I recommend it!
profile.summary: Soft, Smooth, and Comfortable

profile.description: The Ravenna covers collection from classic accessories combines a striking style with durability, fade-resistance and convenient features. Reinforced padded handles make removal easy while double-stitched seams add strength and a stylish accent. Structured vents stay open to prevent wind lofting and mildew and are lined with mesh barriers. Water resistant backing keeps your grill dry while elastic hem cords move easily through a special channel for a snug fit. The adjustable webbing belts slide easily for a tailored look and four custom-colored buckles will keep your cover secure in any weather. Striped webbing adds an attractive accent and is unique to the Ravenna collection. With its adjustable hem cords and linked buckles, the Ravenna cover will fit snugly and will protect for years. 4-Year limited warranty.
profile.reviewText:
This grill cover is really thick, high quality, and heavy duty.  My previous cover (brand forgotten) deteriorated within three years due to sun wear. This one has UV-stabilized coating, so I'm sure it will withstand the sun beating much longer.  The exterior is made of waterproof material like that of tarpaulin and the interior is smooth rubbery material that will prevent scratching and also keep the cover in place.  The entire cover is quite heavy, so you don't have to worry about it getting blown away.

The design is very thoughtful.  There are two handles at the upper ends for easy removal.  The bottom end drapes all the way to the wheels and has straps to secure the cover.  It also has vents on two sides to avoid moisture accumulation that could cause rusting.

Overall, it's a well made grill cover to keep your grill stay new for years to come.  I recommend it!
profile.summary: This Cover Will Keep Your Grill Last Longer

profile.description: STANLEY STHT77343 - TLM99s Bluetooth Laser Distance Measurer; with a range of 100 feet and accuracy of +/- 3/32" (2mm) the TLM99s laser distance measurer makes measuring easy! This simple design is packed with functionality. Instantly calculate area, volume, distance and more with the intuitive touchpad design. Bluetooth Wireless technology allows you to connect your LDM with your smartphone/tablet. The Point and Click Measurements allows easier use and intuitive design, and allows you to calculate area and volume instantly. This tool allows you to take long measurements without assistance, with a range of 4-inches to 100-feet (10cm-30m). Take reliable measurements for estimating and space planning with accuracy of +/- 3/32" (2mm). Continuous measurement finds distance from a target quickly and easily featuring measuring units that work in English/metric and fractional/decimal modes. This is a Class 2 laser product, Power output  1mW
profile.reviewText:
I own two other laser measure made by Bosch, but Stanley TLM99s has set a much higher standard by having the Bluetooth connected Floor Plan app.  It makes me feel like I am a professional builder or an architect.  What could take you hours or days to measure and carefully draw, you can get it done in minutes.  Amazing!

I have no problem connecting this laser measure with the app on my tablet using Bluetooth. The manual doesn't help with how the Bluetooth connection works until I saw the video on Youtube (the company should put that video here.) All you have to do is to tap on the line you are measuring on the tablet and the TLM99s transmit the measurement to that line.  This way, you can adjust the floor plan to the precision in minutes.

This is a very serious and time saving tool for anyone who is trying to come up with an accurate floor plan, even a complex one.  It's not just a simple laser measure for those who want to replace a tap measure.  It does require you to be a little bit tech savvy. Not much, but a little bit, as to follow the video instructions.

This is the state-of-the-art technology on measuring, and it is cheap!  Yes, you have to pay a few buck for each floor plan, but it's still cheap.  This is a high end professional tool at a basic consumer price.

I recommend it!
profile.summary: It makes you a professional floor planner

profile.description: The Crock-Pot Programmable Casserole Crock Slow Cooker makes family dinners, potlucks, parties, and of course, make-ahead meals easier than ever.
