The fully-programmable control panel and digital timer sets cook time on Low or High temperature, anywhere from 30 minutes up to 20 hours, providing convenience for various recipes. The Casserole Crock's versatility means you can use it to prepare everyone's favorite casserole dishes, desserts, and more on the countertop or in conventional ovens, thanks to its oven-safe stoneware. This makes it easy to cook, warm, and serve, with the flexibility to slow cook and then brown or melt toppings in the oven, or bake first and keep warm in the Casserole Crock. Easily portable, the Casserole Crock uses the Cook & Carry locking lid system for easy transport without spills.
profile.reviewText:
This Crockpot slow cooker is very elegantly designed with nice color finish that enhance the decor of the kitchen.  The built quality is not top notch, but good enough.  I prefer to see a little smoother stoneware.

I like the sealed lid, which prevent heat lost and saves a bit of power.  The cook time can be set up to 20 hours, which is the feature I like most because it gives me a wider range of timing.  I also like the automatic keep warm setting after cook time is over.

The wide and shallow cooker allows a more even heat distribution.  I am used to using deep slow cooker because I love to cook lamb shoulder or leg.  Now I won't be able to cook them in this shallow cooker unless I figure out a way to cut them into smaller pieces.  But for most other dishes, this cooker is preferable because the food is spread out instead of piling up.

I also like to locked lid.  That allows me to transport the cooked food easily in this cooker.

The cook time and the result is pretty accurate according to the recipe books.

I recommend it!
profile.summary: Stylish and Effective Slow Cooker

profile.description: The Panasonic RP-BTS35-K wings sport headphones are ultra-light sport earbuds with 3D flex sport clips. Wings sport headphones sync with all Bluetooth* devices. After their initial syncing, your devices Connect to Bluetooth automatically when the rp-bts35 headphones are switched on. Wings sport headphones are IPX5 rated water-resistant to withstand all-season sports as well as your most strenuous Exercise routines inside or outside. From high-impact workouts to running in the rain, these rugged, stay-put sport clip headphones go The distance with high-quality sound. Dual, high-quality 9mm drivers deliver bright, high-end trebles and enhanced bass for dynamic music playback. Inline Microphone and call controller instantly adjust voice and music volume, change tracks and switch seamlessly from tunes to phone and back again. The rechargeable BTS35 battery keeps you in motion with up to 70 minutes of full-bore sound with a 15-minute quick charge, and up to 6 hours when fully charged. The rp-bts35 wing sport headphones come complete with three super-soft S/M/L earbud ear pads to comfortably fit every ear and a Micro-USB charging cord. disclaimer: * the Bluetooth word mark and logos are registered trademarks owned by the Bluetooth SIG, And any use of such marks by Panasonic Corporation is under license.
profile.reviewText:
These Panasonic Wings Ultra-Light Wireless Bluetooth Sport Earphones are fashionable, lightweight, and well designed to stay put on the ears. The sound is outstandingly clear and powerful, driven by 9mm drivers.  It is also well built and very sturdy.

They give you a great deal of enjoyment for sports activities, whether you are running outdoors or exercising indoors.

However, those 9mm drivers push the earpieces out quite a bit, making it impossible to listen to music or audiobooks lying down except on your back.  Sometimes I like to lie down rolling from side to side listening to music or audiobooks, and I have other headphones that allow me to do so because they don't protrude.  I understand it is intended for sports, but they do advertise it on QVC as leisure headphones for the elderly.

For its ruggedness, built quality, and powerful sound, I recommend it!
profile.summary: Powerful Sound and Great Built Quality

profile.description: Smiths 2-Step Knife Sharpener features two tungsten carbide blades with pre-set angles to ensure the perfect edge every time. Three or four strokes through the carbide sharpener have pre-set angles and provide a smooth finished edge to already sharp knives. It is lightweight, portable, comes with a lanyard hole, and has non-slip rubber feet for added safety. Excellent for use on all types of knives, especially fillet knives. Smith's 7" Fillet Knife and Sharpener Has Crossed Carbide Blades for Quick Edge Setting.
profile.reviewText:
This Smith's 50631 Fillet Knife is perfect for fishermen or sushi chefs. The handle is big and comfortable to hold, and there's some rubbery feel to keep it stable in the hand even when it's wet. The blade is long enough to fillet a big fish.

It comes with a sheath with a belt loop allowing you to hang it on your belt like a pirate! It also comes with a small sharpener to keep the sharp knife even sharper. However, the sharpener is a little too small for me to get use to it right away.  It's also so small that I'm sure I'll lose it before long, but it's a nice addition for this knife.

The price is very reasonable for a nice knife like this.  I recommend it!
profile.summary: A Knife for Eating Sushi on Your Fishing Boat

profile.description: Power your sleep with a temperature-ergo plus adjustable base. Sleep and relax in virtually unlimited ergonomic positions, to create a bedroom experience that restores both body and mind. Quick, electronic operation of the temperature-ergo plus adjustable base lets you choose an infinite number of ergonomic rest positions for your temperature-pedic mattress. The ergo-plus can raise head up to 70 and feet up to 40 for perfect support while sleeping, reading or relaxing. Store up to 2 memory positions for near-instant comfort adjustment. The wireless remote lets you control movement, with memory settings that keep track of preferred positions. Backed by a 3-year full, 3-year labor and 25-year frame warranty. Control the way you relax with the temperature-ergo premier adjustable base. Queen measures 79.9" L x 59.58" W x 5.7" h.
profile.reviewText:
This TEMPUR-Ergo Premier-Grey Adjustable Base is not as bulky and heavy as other adjustable based I have used.  It's also very easy to setup.  All you need is to screw in the legs and the retainer bar.  The only issue during installation is the head and foot of the bed is not clearly marked.  Even though it's not so heavy, you still feel annoyed to find out that you happened to place the head on the foot side and vice-versa.

The remote control setup is easy.  It also allows you to control with a smartphone app.  So, I downloaded the app and tried it out.  It requires you to initially connect with the bed's wifi to activate the app, and then you can set the bed to join the home network so that you can use the app when normally connected to the router, meaning without interrupting your Internet connection.  (Another reviewer wrongly said you have to switch from your home network to the bed's network in order to operate the bed. He just missed the additional step to make the bed join the home network.)

The raising of the head and leg is the feature I wanted most.  Even though the massaging feature is nice to have, it doesn't provide enough massaging force for me to really appreciate it.  I guess it might be because my mattress is thick (10"). If you use an 8" or even 6" memory foam mattress, you might get more massaging effect from this bed.

I recommend it!
profile.summary: Easy Setup and Controllable wtih You Smartphone

profile.description: Grill Timer by Little Griddle is the brand new wristwatch and recipe timer for people who love to cook outside and it is the world's first wristwatch designed specifically to time outdoor cooking. It uses a version of the "elapsed time" concept that was used to track below-surface time on the iconic diving watches made famous during the 1950s and 1960s. Grill Timer combines classic three-hand wristwatch styling with a unidirectional rotating "Grill Bezel" to time popular outdoor recipes. Here's how it works: Grill Timer's patent-pending Grill Bezel times recipes by rotating left to align the start of a recipe (the small silver dot before the recipe title) with the Grill Timer's minute hand. As the minute hand moves across the face of the watch, the recipe is timed and the bezel indicates when the food should be flipped and when it should be removed from the grill. The bezel contains a ratcheting mechanism that only allows it to rotate to the left, ensuring that the Grill Bezel never indicates more time remaining to the recipe than there really is. This "fail-safe" feature helps to reduce the chance of over-cooking food on the grill. The recipe timing on the Grill Timer Grill Bezel features a silver-to-red gradient that indicates degree-of-doneness and while grills and foods vary in respective heat outputs and thicknesses, Grill Timer provides a very good indication of when a specific piece of food has been cooked to completion.
profile.reviewText:
Do you get frustrated by having to constantly wonder whether your meat is over or under cooked on the grill?  This watch can help.  The watch is well made of both exterior with good quality stainless steel and design, and interior with Japan made Seiko quartz movement.

As we get old, we tend to forget when and how long we placed something on the grill.  And sometimes, we turn around to do something else and totally get confused with the timings.  Now, all you have to do is spin the bezel according to the type of food you put on your grill and go ahead to do other things with the peace of mind knowing exactly the right time to return to the grill.

If you use your smart phone to time your cooking, you will find out that spinning the bezel on this watch is much faster than setting your smartphone timer.  After all, the magnifier on the date seems to indicate that this watch is for the older BBQ lovers.

In any case, if you like to grill, you would find this watch very useful.  I recommend it!
profile.summary: Watch for the Foodies!

profile.description: 1800R curved monitor with 3000:1 contrast ratio provides a truly immersive viewing experience. Monitor has a tilt range of -2 ~ 20. Featuring a glossy black finish and ultra slim design, the monitor boasts AMD FreeSync technology and Game Mode which allows users to enjoy smooth images, even during the fastest moving scenes.
profile.reviewText:
First, if you are buying this monitor for FreeSync technology, you might need to take note.  To take the full benefit of AMD Freesync technology, you need to have the compatible AMD graphics card. The problem is this monitor only has HDMI input for Freesync feature.  (It does come with a VGA input, but Freesync technology doesn't work on VGA).  So you need to have an AMD graphics card that comes with HDMI output, which is quite new.  As far as I know, most AMD GCs older than a year don't have HDMI.  They have DisplayPort.  I don't know if you use a DP to HTMI converter cable, you will still have the FreeSync benefit.

Out of the box, you feel it's very light, thin, and somewhat flimsy around the edges, but after setting it up, I know I don't have many reasons to touch it until I need to move it somewhere. The visual performance is what's important, and it performs well.

Like my other Samsung curved monitors (32" and 27") the color of this monitor is a little washed out upon setup, but after tweaking the color settings, I got a satisfactory color saturation.

Gaming aside, as I'm not an avid gamer, I do enjoy the curved immersive experience of this monitor and it just makes you don't want to return to flat screens. I feel I'm doing more work with better focus and less fatigue.

I wish it comes with a built-in speaker because I like to have a clean desk. Both my ASUS and Acer Touch monitors came with speakers without adding much to the thickness. However, I appreciate the audio output that comes with it in the back. With my headset plunged in there, I'm in a different world.

After all, don't forget the sweet price point that makes this monitor a great value.

I recommend it!
profile.summary: For Both Productivity and Gaming

profile.description: The SensonicProfessional Plus Toothbrush features an advanced ergonomic handle, three unique brush heads, two speed settings for gentle cleaning or maximum plaque removal, and a deluxe recharge indicator gauge. It also features hygienic brush head covers, a premium travel case, and a 2-minute brushing timer with 30-second intervals to ensure adequate brushing time throughout the mouth.
profile.reviewText:
I have been using different water flossers and electronic brush for over a decade, but this Waterpik Ortho Care set is the best I have ever used.  It is a complete oral hygiene system, but it's so compact that it does not take up much space and well designed to prevent messy wires.

At my dentist's recommendation, instead of water, I use Accu-chek Compact Plus Act Alcohol Free Anticavity Fluoride Rinse, which gives me both flossing and protection effect at the same time.

The system is also very well made and every part feels high quality.  It comes with 4 different tips for both regular teeth and for braces. It also comes with two tooth brushes--one standard and one compact.

Most importantly, I feel very clean and fresh after each use.  Home technology like this has given me less frequent dentist visits.

I recommend it!
profile.summary: High Quality, Effective, and Complete System for My Dental Hygiene

profile.description: Xyron teamed with Teresa Collins to design this amazing combination of adhesive items. You'll fall in love the moment you flip open the pink reusable box with a magnetic closure. Inside you'll find a special pink mini X sticker maker. Immediately you'll be able to add edge to edge adhesive to any flat item up to 1 inch wide. This is perfect for those intricate die cut letters and other small embellishments. The kit also contains one 29 foot long roll of 1/4 inch double sided tape in a convenient dispenser. Premium foam squares allow you to add depth to your projects quickly and easily. There is also a disposable tape runner and Teresa Collins Clear Hold Adhesive in a handy little bottle. This unique adhesive dries clear with a strong hold. This kit contains all the adhesive you'll need for creating gorgeous cards, scrapbook pages, school projects, decorative mixed media projects and so much more. When the adhesive is finally used up, you'll find a myriad of uses for the beautiful, sturdy box. Additionally, the kit also contains a Xyron adhesive eraser, which quickly and cleanly removes any unwanted adhesive from your projects. You'll enjoy trying all the different adhesives and the box keeps them all within reach and easy to bring with when you head out to craft with friends.
profile.reviewText:
I don't know who Teresa Collins is.  A quick Google search gives me a little bit of information about her as a designer but nothing like a famous one.  So I don't know why I should buy this kit just because it carries her name.  I could be wrong but someone somewhere around the world might adore her and buy anything she recommends.

I don't like to give a one-star rating to anything, but have to be honest to the consumers.

So the name doesn't sell to me.  How about the product?  Let's start with the box.  It's made of cardboard!  You don't even want to keep it to store your jewelry or something else after the content is empty.

How about the content?  The box is half padded, meaning half of the box it empty, just like those chocolate boxes that look big but half of the interior is all air.  You call it art?  Maybe a different kid of art that is not quite honest.

Quality?  It says "a great way to sample various Xyron adhesives."  Again I don't know who Xyron is.  I picked up the first item, a 29ft double-sided High Tack Tape, and it comes with a "cardboard" dispenser.  It screams quality, doesn't it?  What's more important is the tape can't even roll in the dispenser.  Then, when I struggled to pull out the tape the length I wanted, I couldn't even cut it because the cardboard dispenser is too soft for you to put any force on it.  I had to throw the cardboard dispenser away and use the scissor.

If my daughter is still two years old, I wonder if she would be drawn to this box just because it's pink.  Yes, everything is pink and that's it.  The product treats you loud and clear as if you are but a two-year-old.  At the manufacturer suggested price, I would say, "Who are you kidding?"
profile.summary: Who are you kidding?

profile.description: With easy mounting design, PoE power supply, Cluster feature, Centralized management software, Captive portal, Auto RF management, and business hardware, TP-LINK EAP110 is specially designed for the high-density, most demanding business environments, including schools, hotels, and enterprises.
profile.reviewText:
I placed this in our church's large hall and was pleasantly surprised by its exceptional coverage.  We have 25mbps FIOS service and it gives me full speed without latency if you are within 20 feet.  In a room 70 feet away through a few walls, I still get 10mbps.  That's more than enough to stream full HD video. That's also better than most consumer routers I've tested at the same location.

Setting up was a problem if you followed the instruction. The instruction wants you to install the EAP Controller software to set up. After setting up, even though the software shows the correct information you entered, the EAP110 itself doesn't change.  It still shows the default SSID.  After over an hour of failure and frustration, I decided to login to EAP110 directly through the IP and changed the settings the conventional way.  In conclusion, the EAP Controller software is a waste of time.

For the hardware, functionality, and value, I recommend it.  But the controller software is immature. (By the way, I used the latest EAP Controller software (v. 2.3.4) downloaded from TP-Link website.)
profile.summary: Greate Access Point, Poor EAP Controller Software

profile.description: Arccos Driver Tracking SystemLive Stats. Global Competitions. Ultimate Bragging Rights.The Arccos Driver Tracking System brings fun to the golf course while providing the stats you need to improve your game. You can instantly capture and share you best drives with your friends and the Arccos community as a way to compete all over the globe with your friends and fellow golfers. Track all your driving stats so you see what to practice and where you're succeeding on the golf course. Instantly see your stats so you know how you're playing, righto n the golf course.Arccos Driver Tracking System features: * Includes a single sensor specifically calibrated to track driver statistics * Uses GPS and Bluetooth technology to map your shots to a bird's-eye view of the course * Capture and share your best drives with friends and the Arccos community * Sensor attaches easily to any driver grip * Pair directly to free iPhone or Android app for easy tracking * Ultra-light sensor has zero swing impact * Real time tracking shows specific stats and calculations after each drive * Review club averages right on the course where it matters most What's In The Box: * 1 Arccos Driver sensor * Starter guide * iOS and Android apps * 1-year Arccos Driver Premium Subscription
profile.reviewText:
This Arccos Golf Driver GPS Sensor is well made and extremely light weight.  The Arccos app is easy to install and pair with this sensor fast and smoothly.  It also recognizes 35,000 golf courses around the world.

The main purpose of this sensor is to add fun to the game by sharing and competing with your friends or the virtual community of the Arccos sensor users. This sensor is for the driver.  So if you want to have fun beyond recording the driving distance, you need to purchase additional sensors for your other clubs.  For that purpose there are complete packages available.

This device is a good introduction to Arccos golf sensors.  So far so good, but I haven't yet decided to move up the the complete set yet.

If you love to track your driving range, I recommend it.
profile.summary: Add a Little Data and Fun to Your Golf

profile.description: Scarlett 2i2 is the best selling USB audio interface in the world, and for good reason. It focuses on just three things; achieving the best sound, the fastest speed and the easiest experience. Our latest generation continues to improve in all three areas. It is compact yet versatile, with two natural-sounding Scarlett mic preamps, super-low latency* and the same class-leading sound quality and digital conversion as the rest of the latest Scarlett range. Take it anywhere, connect by a single USB cable to a computer, plug two mics or instruments straight in, and easily record studio quality audio. Focusrite is the perfect partner for Pro Tools. To celebrate this Scarlett 2i2 now comes with an exclusive version of Pro Tools | First Focusrite Creative Pack, as well as Ableton Live Lite. It is compatible with all major DAWs, on Mac 10.10 onwards and PC windows 8.1 onwards . MIDI IO is not a feature of Scarlett 2i2; check out Scarlett 2i4 for all of the same features of the Scarlett 2i2 with the addition of MIDI I/O and increased control over audio levels.
profile.reviewText:
Before this Focusrite Scarlett 2i2 (2nd Gen), I've been using Behringer U-Phoria UMC202HD, which has almost the same features and sturdy construction, at about half the price, but not as sexy looking as Scarlett 2i2.  The most important benefit of 2i2, in terms of appearance is all its lights, switches, nobs, and labels are very clear and easy to locate quickly. The only problem I have is the phantom power light seems unnecessarily big and bright for me.

I follow the instructions on the inside cover of the box to register the device and download the driver and software. I'm using this on Windows 10 computer.  I install the driver before plugging in the 2i2.  Everything went smoothly without a hitch.  If you are using this as a beginner music producer, you'll love the software bundle that comes with 2i2. The value of the free software would make up for the price difference between this and the Behringer I mentioned above.

I use these pre-amps mainly for vocal recording and not much for music. For vocal testing, using Marantz Professional MPM-1000 18mm Condenser Microphone, I get clear and professional voice recordings. I can't find any fault about it. Latency is also very low as promised by the device description.

Overall, it's a very compact and beautiful USB audio interface with a great deal of software bundle and plugins that you can enjoy hours and hours of fun to play with and make professional sounding audio products.

I recommend it!
profile.summary: A Solid and Beautiful Audio Interface

profile.description: Meet your new fitness companion. With Fit Smart, youll never miss a beator step. You can track your all-day activity and when youre ready to work up a sweat, fire up the built in heart rate monitor to get in the zone. adidas fit smart features continuous wrist based heart rate technology  no chest strap required. This fitness monitor provides simple to understand visual coached guidance for workout intensity and calorie burn to keep you on track, motivated and training smarter and more effectively. Our fit smart watch features a built-in accelerometer tracking speed, pace, distance and stride rate for walking, jogging and running. Sync your data, using Bluetooth smart on your smart phone, with the adidas Train & Run app to see your progress. With the adidas Train & Run app youll also have access to 100s of training plans created by the elite coaches at EXOS. Here are some of the key features of the new Fit Smart: Vibration and visual prompts that provide feedback and coaching : Set daily and weekly goals to keep track of your progress. : Stores up to 10 hours of workout data : Access free training plans through the new and improved Train & Run app. : Fit Smart is compatible with iOS and Android 4.3+. Who is the miCoach User? adidas created miCoach sports fitness watch because we fundamentally understand that every athlete can be better at his or her sport, no matter the level. We enlisted the help of world-renowned coaches to create sport-specific training plans to make athletes better at their chosen sports. miCoach offers both Cardio and Strength & Flexibility plans to improve your strength, power, speed, agility and flexibility. What type of workouts can the adidas fit smart track? Cardio, Strength & Flexibility: miCoach uses a unique form of heart-rate-based interval training for CARDIO workouts varying intensity between four personalized training zones. As well as tackling the guided Strength & Flexibility workouts that include weight, repetition and circuit training.
profile.reviewText: After much research on getting a workout watch with heart rate monitor for my P90X routines, I decided to get this one. I was reluctant to buy it at first because of the total rating was only around tree stars or less when I was shopping for it. However, when I read the negative reviews, they were all complaining about the initial set up process, rather than the quality and functionality of the product itself. So I took the plunge and, boy, I am so happy that I did. I have to thank the negative reviews because it drove the price down to far less than half, and now it's back up after I bought it. The set up is a breeze for me with my phone and tablets. I guess one must have the concept that this is not a watch, but a computer accessory for you to wear in order to let it monitor your activities. If you treat it as a watch, you'll be disappointed because it's not that simple, yet it's not hard if you treat it as a computer accessory. Even though I already own (adidas miCoach Heart Rate Monitor which is to be worn around the chest, I like this Fit Smart because it's rechargeable and the other one needs button type batteries, and I hate button type batteries because they are not commonly used like AA or AAA batteries that I have a lot of them (rechargeable) at home all the time. As for usage, it takes a little bit to get used to, but nothing unreasonable. For example, I tend to start the workout and think it has begun but later I found out that it has not started recording because I forget to press "Go." After the exercise, I tend to forget to press stop, which requires you to push the button for 3 seconds. Within a few days, I got used to it. After exercise, all I need is to open the miCoach app on my phone or tablet and click sync to retrieve the data from the watch (note: it won't sync if the watch is not on, i.e. not showing time.) Wallah! All my workout results are transmitted: every heart rate, calories burnt, etc. Please note that I only use it for P90X and mainly for monitoring heart rate. For that purpose, this watch is perfect for me. I am sure this watch is also good for running, but there are many devices made for running. Only this one gives me accurate heart rate with much lower price range. I recommend it!
profile.summary: The Best for My P90X workouts

profile.description: Stunning 70" monitor elevates office collaboration. Upgrade your conference rooms with the reliable, easily managed and expansive Dell 70 Conference Room Monitor -C7016H. Large display for conference rooms: Easily collaborate thanks to a wide viewing angle, sharp text and consistent color. Easy to connect and manage: Quick wireless connectivity1, convenient access to DP, HDMI and VGA ports makes setup quick and easy, while the RS232 interface allows for easy manageability. Reliable with best-in-class support: Trust the world's No. 1 monitor brand with the protection of 3-Year Advanced Exchange Service.
profile.reviewText:
First of all, this Dell C7017T is heavy (122.4lb).  It's made of solid metal frame and durable glass (I wonder if it is the Gorilla Glass) as the top layer.  It's meant to be wall mounted and used as a permanent fixture in a class room or a conference room.  It takes two men to lift it.  The packaging has easy to remove clips to open the box and the padding inside is very secure.  But still, the XPO shipping company managed to deliver it with the box torn.

I wanted to mount it on a cart so that I can move it from room to room. Due to the weight, it's very hard to find a cart that can handle this weight because most TV today are light weight and, as a result, carts are no longer made of heavy metal.  But I happen to have an old steel cart that is strong enough to mount this monitor on.

The instruction fails to mention that you must connect the USB 3 A to B cable (included) to make the touch screen to work with your Windows computer.  It took us a long time to figure out why the touch screen was not working, until I remember I used to have a touch screen monitor that required a USB 3 A to B cable to get it working.  Other than that, the setup is easy.

The color is brilliant, the screen is anti-glare, and the viewing angle is very good (not great).  The color begins to wash out as you move toward the sides, but, since this is a presentation monitor, it's unlikely to have people sitting too far out to the sides because the presenter would create a space between the monitor and the audience.

The touch screen is quite responsive, almost like the touch screen of your smartphone or tablet, but I still need to get use to it.  I installed a Lenovo mini computer on the back of this monitor.  I am sure the processor power of the mini computer has to do with the response speed of the touch screen.  I would recommend at least an i5 computer to enjoy to smooth touch screen.

Writing on it with the pens that come with it works very well.  I use Microsoft OneNote, and it turns out to be a perfect combination as OneNote has great handwriting features.  The package also comes with a license key for the DisplayNote software which allows you the share your screen live with remote participants.

In most cases this monitor will be professionally installed for use in classrooms, churches, or conference rooms.  If you plan to invest in a solid piece of equipment for teaching and presentation, this monitor is definitely built to last.

I recommend it!
profile.summary: A Classroom or Conference Touch Screen Monitor Built to Last

profile.description: Red laser wireless presenter. The Canon pr1000-r is a compact presenter with slideshow and volume control.
profile.reviewText:
I give presentation frequently, sometimes at different locations where I have to take my own equipment with me. Sometimes, the venue would provide the computer and projector, but they don't provide a remote (maybe they keep losing them).  So I have several small presenter remotes and always carry one with me in my brief case or pocket.  Now, I'm so glad that Canon, one of my favorite brand, has caught up with producing small remotes at a reasonable price.

At a glance, this remote is good looking, but it feels a little flimsy in my hand.  As for the shape, I agree with the other reviewer, that the thick side is better for the holding and the thin side should be for the pointing, like a few other brands have made them.  Allowing the battery compartment on the holding side would make it much more comfortable, even though it may not look intuitive appearance wise.

The volume control is what sold me because my presentations often include video clips.  The laser pointer is bright and far reaching.  The on-off button is important for me because I don't want the battery to be drained when it is in the pocket where buttons could be accidentally pressed. The launch button is appreciated because not all brands have it.  And it works well with MS PowerPoint.  I don't use Mac, so I can't tell if the launch button works well with Keynote.

The setup is easy.  As soon as I plugged in the usb dongle for the first time, the computer is hocked up immediately.

I recommend it!
profile.summary: Good Features and Value

profile.description: The Corsair Gaming K95 is a fully mechanical, backlit keyboard with 18 dedicated macro keys for exceptional gaming performance. The built-in Cherry MX Red switches deliver smooth, linear response for ultra fast double and triple taps without the audible click. Every key is individually lit for brilliant backlighting and easy customizability to highlight important functions. The black anodized brushed aluminum structure provides rugged durability and a professional-grade finish. 18 dedicated macro keys with three banks give you easy, single keystroke access to up to 54 of your favorite presets and key combos. Plus the 122Key Roll-over on USB and 100% Anti-Ghosting mean that every key you touch translates directly into the game.
profile.reviewText:
This keyboard is well built with high quality materiel. It will definitely survive some serious banging.  Every part of it is manufactured to prevent easy damage, and even the wrist rest has screws to keep it securely attached. It reminds me of the IBM keyboards of the 90's, which were built like tanks.

Typing on this keyboard take a little time to get used to because of the key height, especially if you have been using today's soft touch keyboards.  But it doesn't take long.

The LED lights add moods and fun and you can program it to your likeness.  They are beautifully designed to shed the lights without effecting your sight and functions.

I am surprised that there is no USB port on the one I received.  There must be different sub-models within K95, as I've seen another K95 that comes with a USB port.  Since this keyboard takes over two USB ports from the computer, having USB ports on the keyboard would be very useful.

Overall, this keyboard will be a great fun to use for a long time to come.  I recommend it!
profile.summary: Well Built and Fun!

profile.description: Bring new intensity to your high-intensity interval training. The Weighted Jump Rope's patented swivel-8 design engages core muscle areas for an unmatched workout.
profile.reviewText:
I've used many jump ropes with WEIGHTED HANDLES including one made by SKLZ, which I use most often.  This set comes with WEIGHTED ROPE, which obviously gives me more exercise than weighted handles. The quality of the rope is good, but it is not so flexible. It doesn't straighten immediately if you store it coiled it up.  So I keep is hanging when I don't use it.

I removed one star because I'm not quite sure about the 90 degree angle handle.  It feel awkward to jump in varying positions, or swinging your arms wider to get more exercise. Maybe it takes some time to get use to it.

The handles are easily removable so that you can buy other ropes of different weights to be used with the same set of handles.

For those who like to try new and innovative jump ropes, this is the one worth trying out.
profile.summary: Jump Rope with 90 Degree Handles

profile.description: The proven, portable projector for compelling presentations. 3X higher color brightness and up to 3X wider color Gamut with Epson. 3200 lumens color brightness and 3200 lumens white brightness. Fast setup; HDMI.
profile.reviewText:
This Epson EX5240 projector is another great portable projector in the EX series.  I also own EX5250 Pro (XGA), EX7235 Pro (WXGA) and VS240 (SVGA).  You can go wrong with any EX series projectors.  I also have a few other brands and older Epson models.  Now Epson basically dominates the projector market with their brightest and most vibrant color technology.  And they are very light, compact, and very portable.  The only issue is that they are all plastic, but they are at least good plastic.

The lamp life is also very long at 10,000 hours.  Over the years, I only used up one lamp on portable projectors before they become too old to keep.  On stationary projectors, that's another story.

This one doesn't come with the WiFi dongle, but it is WiFi ready.  All you need is get the Epson WiFi dongle and plug it in.  But I don't find the WiFi so useful as it doesn't project video, but pictures only.  That means when my PowerPoint slides include a video clip, especially if it is HD, I can't show it through WiFi.

If you are choosing between XGA and WXGA, I would say XGA turns out to be more useful for presentation because I still have many 4:3 slides and I found them fitting more information vertically than 16:9.  WXGA is better for videos only, so if you are buying it for watching video on a big screen, you might want to pick WXGA.

It's nice that Epson continues the tradition of packaging the unit with a carrying case, but unlike the old ones, the case is very cheap and flimsy, and there's little room for additional wire or necessary accessories like a presenter's remote control.  It's a half-hearted gift.  I still have to buy a good case for this projector to carry it securely with room for some accessories.  The case that came with the old models are much better.

In spite of these minor annoyances, the projector is still the most vibrant in the market.  I recommend it.!
profile.summary: Another Geat Portable Projector from Epson

profile.description: The proven, portable projector for compelling presentations. 3X higher color brightness and up to 3X wider color Gamut with Epson. 3200 lumens color brightness and 3200 lumens white brightness. Fast setup; HDMI.
profile.reviewText:
Before EX5250 Pro (XGA), I own EX7235 Pro (WXGA) and VS240 (SVGA).  I also have a few other brands and older Epson models.  Now Epson basically dominates the projector market with their brightest and vibrant color technology.  And they are very light, compact, and very portable.  The only issue is that they are all plastic, but they are at least good plastic.

The lamp life is also very long at 10,000 hours.  Over the years, I only used up one lamp on portable projectors before they become too old to keep.  On stationary projectors, that's another story.

Wireless functionality is a great feature.  However, it's not so useful for me on portable situations because the projector is always close by the computer.  If I were to hang this projector up on a ceiling, then the wifi feature is a plus.

Recently, I carry EX7235 (WXGA) with me most of the time, but I think I might carry XGA with me for now because I still have many 4:3 slides and I found them fitting more information than 16:9.  WXGA is better for videos only, so if you are buying it for watching video on a big screen, you might want to pick WXGA.

If the projector is so great, then why I deduct one star?  First, I don't like the WiFi dongle stretching out in the back, with a screwed on bracket. That means every time I need to use it, I have find a screw driver to secure it.  When I finish my presentation, I have to unscrew it and take it out because you can't put the projector in the bag with the USB dongle stretching out.  It's quite an annoyance.  They should either build the WiFi device inside the projector or create a space so that it doesn't stick out.  Furthermore, being small, the WiFi dongle and the bracket can easily get lost.

I also don't like the case that comes with it.  Unlike the old ones, It's so cheap and flimsy, and there's little room for additional wire or things like a presenter's remote control.  You can easily lose the WiFi dongle if you keep it in this bag.  It's a half-hearted gift.  I still have to buy a good case for this projector to carry it securely with room for some accessories.  The case that came with the old models are much better.

In spite of these minor annoyances, the projector is still the most vibrant in the market.  I recommend it.!
profile.summary: The Most Vibrant among the Portable Projectors

profile.description: The Day & Night Wi-Fi Camera (DCS-933L) delivers high-quality video for remote viewing on the mobile devices you already own. And with a built-in ICR filter and IR LEDs, youll also get clear images in complete darkness to provide you with the ideal 24-hour monitoring solution. Integrated sound/motion-sensing technology detects changes within the cameras environment, triggering instant email alerts. Round the clock notification delivers an additional layer of security and confidence.
profile.reviewText:
I followed the instruction manual and downloaded the setup software to start setting up.  You have to first connect to the router using a network wire that comes with the device.  It works nicely with the wired connection.

However, when I tried to switch it to wireless connection, the disaster began.  I started with WPS connection, the device couldn't detect the router.  Then I changed to the manual connection, the software couldn't find my network.  I had to start over several times and it seems that I was able to connect it completely out of luck, meaning, even as a technology wizard (that's what people call me), I couldn't figure out why the previous times it didn't work and why now it works.  So I can't help anyone who have the same problem with a specific method to get it connected.  You just have to try it several time using several ways, including deleting the device from MyDLink account and starting over.

Now it's connected.  I want to try email alert, so I tried to set it up.  It was a clumsy process, but when I click Save to save the change, it tells me that the wireless network name and password cannot be empty.  The network name field doesn't allow me to enter anything and it's not showing the currently connected network.  The camera is already working on the network, but the network name field is empty and since it is empty, MyDLink.com asks me to enter the information, or I wouldn't be able to save any changes.  But IT DOESN'T ALLOW ME TO ENTER ANYTHING, or choose from a list.  I tested with FireFox, IE, and Chrome, but they all showed the same problem.

It's a nice camera with great pictures, even though the lens angle could be wider to cover more area.  But DLink failed on the software part.  Reading other people's reviews, it seems that this problem is not with everyone.  So if you are lucky, you will get a smooth ride.  I wish so much to give this nice camera a good five stars because of the price, but it just disappointed me with setup and configuration.

Good luck!
profile.summary: Easy to Setup for Wired but Hard for Wireless

profile.description: The AirLine Micro Camera Wireless System utilizes the latest in lithium-ion battery technology and high-quality audio and RF components, representing a breakthrough that is ideal for all video camera applications requiring outstanding audio, including DSLR video. The result is our smallest wireless system ever.
profile.reviewText:
I've used Samson's AirLine products for at least ten years and like it very much.  While they are not top quality, they are enjoyable for the money, providing above average sound quality and built quality.  I also own other top quality wireless systems made by Sony and Sennheiser, but their price just made me reluctant to use them often, and think twice before I purchase another one.

Now the Samson AirLine Micro Earset Wireless System totally amazed me with the price.  It's sound doesn't disappoint me either.

When I saw the picture of the ear piece, I thought it must be heavy and uncomfortable to be worn for a long time.  But it turn out to be very light weight and I forgot about it right away. Like wearing glasses, you don't remember you are wearing it after a while.

One of the problem is the on/off/mute button takes a little bit to get use to.  Furthermore, the sound doesn't come out right away after pressing the button.  It seems as if it is trying to connect with the receiver each time you turn it on or un-mute it.

During the initial test, I kept the antenna (as you see in the picture).  It worked perfectly well, with the receiver located at about 40 feet away.  So on the day I used it to speak, I kept it set up the same way.  However, the sound dropped occasionally for a couple of seconds or so.  I learned the lesson, and at the next speech, I pulled out the antenna and there was no more dropping of sound.

Note that the receiver is about the same in length and width of credit card and it's rechargeable.  That means you can attach it on a camera for video shooting without the need of a power cord.  Most video shooting wireless microphone systems are at least three or four times as expansive.

Even though this item doesn't look as solidly built as those made by the top brands, I give it five star because it's the best for the price.

I highly recommend it!
profile.summary: Best for the Price

profile.description: The iPong Mini is the ideal table tennis training robot for beginners. With no assembly required and a simple on/off switch, just add 4-AA batteries and get ready to play table tennis! It holds up to 25 balls with a sheer shell to let you see when youre running low and casts 30 balls per minute with its new no-jam spiral gravity ball feeder. At 12 x 7 and 1.5 lbs, the iPong Mini is perfectly portable for any player. The iPong Mini has endless possibilities from playing with friends to playing solo, eliminating the need to fold up the other half the table. This simple, affordable, and fun table tennis robot brings recreational table tennis to a new and higher level of competitive play.
profile.reviewText:
It's hard to find table tennis buddies in my area, and finding a buddy with matching level is not so easy. So this iPong Mini Portable Solo Table Tennis Server becomes very convenient for practicing.  I bought 100 iPong balls for less than 20 bucks and the balls are here the next day.  Using iPong balls in iPong server eliminate the possible size problem.

The exterior plastic is good quality, but the interior feel flimsy.  However, it doesn't affect the functions so far.

I can put 25 balls at a time comfortably in the iPong Server.  I can also put up to 30 balls, but the top balls tend to get jam at the entrance and not follow the funnel down.  But you can carefully arrange them to prevent that.  Having to pick up 20-30 balls every few minutes gives you quite a bit of exercise too.

Since the balls don't shoot out uniformly, you have a chance to practice without predictable direction.  You can also point the shooting direction to where you are weak and want to practice more.  My left hand side is weak, so I let it shoot to my left and now I am getting better with my backhand.

I wish it will pick up the balls for me.  Other than that, I recommend it!
profile.summary: My Ping Pong Buddy

profile.description: This amazing app controlled 400-Lumen Bluetooth LED Lantern not only keeps you illuminated, it also keeps you informed. With continual updates of environmental and weather conditions, this state of the art lantern gives you the information you need to stay safe. Plus, with the Dorcy SMAP APP you can control the entire operation of the lantern from your tablet or smartphone using BLE (Bluetooth Low Energy) technology to communicate your commands to the lantern and vice versa.
profile.reviewText:
The main selling point of this Dorcy International lantern is the Bluetooth wireless control through your smartphone app. It works very well once you are able to connect.  The first time when I tried to pair the app with the lantern, the app said it didn't find the lantern.  When I made a second attempt, the blue light (the pairing light) doesn't turn on, no matter how long I press the main switch.  I had to remove the batter cover to disconnect the power to "reboot" the lantern.  Then I was able to turn on the blue light for pairing.  The second attempt was successful.  I hope that's just a small glitch that happens only to me.

As for the design of the lantern itself, it's not so intuitive.  The battery compartment cover is big.  It will be a little hard for a woman to tighten it.  During tightening the cover, it's a little hard to align it properly.  The top lid for removing the headlamp is also not intuitive.  I still can't figure out a comfortable way to open it.  The headlamp is the same, you have to stick your nail into a small slid to press down the latch to open it, and it's not easy.  Nothing is easy.  Even the Pull Out Hang Hook doesn't come out easily because there's not place for your finger to pry it up.

At this size and with so advanced technology being used in this lantern and app, I expected the lantern to be rechargeable and have a charging port for cellphones.  It's quite annoying to have to buy D cells, and it's not good for the environment. I thought the headlamp was rechargeable, but it's just sitting at the top compartment.  It uses two AAA batteries.  It's quite irritating for me to have a device that is "not quite there."

The app is well developed and works very well to compensate much of my complaints about the not-so-intuitive design of the lantern.  The light is bright and adjustable to your need.  And there's a night light for the convenience.  It's also has a flashing mode to be used as a warning or emergency light. The app also has a setting to automatically tun off the light automatically at certain time.

For its functionality, I recommend it!
profile.summary: Very Nice, But Could Be Better

profile.description: Nothing will stop you from getting the job done in the Stanley Boots Wellington Exploit ST workboot. Designed with a wider ergonomic fit to provide excellent comfort, it is also crafted with a waterproof membrane and 200 grams of Thinsulate insulation to keep you warm, dry and able bodied.
profile.reviewText:
My dress shoe size is 10D.  But I ended up fitting comfortably in 9E of this Stanley Men's Exploit Steel Toe Work Boot.  I would suggest choosing a half a size down from your dress shoe size.  Other than that these booths are very comfortable.

The construction of these shoes are outstanding.  The quality of the leather and the soles are very strong but not awkward to walk in like many other work boots.  The hard rubber soles touch the ground softly and surely, and there is no slippery feel.

I do have high instep, so the only part that is pushing the boots a little bit is the instep area, but as I wore them and walked around for about an hour or two, they began to break in and feel like a pair of old comfortable well-worn boots.  If you have very high instep you might want to just pick the normal size.

I recommend it!
profile.summary: Outstanding Quality and Comfort

profile.description: The hl-4150cdn is a high-performance, network-ready color laser printer ideal for offices or small workgroups. it produces brilliant, high-quality output at an impressive print speed of up to 25 pages per minute in color and black. it features automatic duplex printing for two-sided documents and produces impactful color business documents at up to 2400 x 600 dpi resolution. also, high-yield replacement toner cartridges are available.
profile.reviewText:
This is the 4th color laser I've owned.  The first two were Konica-Minolta.  They were among the first affordable ones in the market (still expensive) and one of them, Magicolor 2300dl, does a decent job considering the technology of its time.  The second and smaller one, Magicolor 2400, died in a couple of year and was slow.  The third one is HP 2025, which is much smaller (of course still much bigger than color inkject printers.) and it prints duplex.  But it takes an hour to print a full page double-sided color brochure.  Even though the color output is vibrant, the speed is miserable. So if I want 10 copies of full color image, I have to let it print over night.  I will use these printers until their drum lives end, and will sell or give away instead of spending more money on them.

One main feature I want out of a color laser is duplex printing.  I decided to try Brother HL-4150CDN because it was sold for $250 on Amazon.com (surprised to see the price went up to $370 after I bought).  It has duplex printing and claimed to be fast.  Well, it is fast, the fastest of all color printers I have every owned.  Even though it is loud when it prints, you hear only a few seconds of noise and then it's completely quiet.

One star was removed because of the color.  It is dry, unlike the shiny output from the HP.  I don't really mind the dry color.  The real problem is the colors being too dark.  I tried some adjustment on the configuration and it has improved but still darker than the original, or HP output.  That also means I am consuming more toner.  I've got it for a week, and I don't think I have printed so much, but the yellow toner is show half left.

I am trying to figure out color calibration, which I've never needed to do with my previous printers.  I hope it helps.  There is a toner saving mode, I can't find how to set it yet, but I hope that helps.  Maybe at the toner saving mode it will give me a lighter but correct colors.

--Update---
The yellow color showing half full was not correct.  It shows that way when you look at the printer admin page from the browser, but the digital window on the printer shows full.  I did a calibration, but it appears to be perfectly calibrated from the factory. I set the printer to "Toner Saving" mode and set the frequency to "Low" (I don't know what this means). Then the color has lightened but still a little darker than the HP out put.
profile.summary: Greatest Value in Color Laser

profile.description: Performance in its purest form. Misfit ray is our most minimal and versatile tracker. It delivers the fitness and sleep tracking you need to stay motivated, including steps taken, distance traveled, calories burned, activity tagging, and sleep duration and quality. It also never needs charging and is water-resistant to 50 meters, so it can be worn constantly. That means more data, better insights, and more powerful motivation. Rays clean lines create a form that is as much about fashion as it is about function. Wear it stacked with a smart Watch and cuff, or Customize it to your style - it features hidden 8-mm spring bars that allow it to be worn with almost any standard accessory, including Watch bands, bracelets, or necklaces.
profile.reviewText:
I've worn many trackers, but the technology seems still far behind from reaching perfection.  This one is no exception, but good enough to motivate me to hit the goal.

This is a low profile tracker that looks somewhat like a rubber bracelet that people wear to make a statement. It runs on three button batteries that last about six months, so you don't have to worry about charging it all the time.

I've found two problems in wearing it for three days.  The same activity was recorded as Intense Activity one day and Moderate the other. I don't mind.  But, yesterday, when I double tap on the tracker, it tells me that I've met my daily goal (and I believed so), but on the app, I got 65%. I synced it a few more time to make sure they are in sync.  I did more workout to get the app shows 100%.

On the sleep tracker.  The first day, I got up at 4am to go to the bathroom and go back to sleep.  Ray recorded my sleep only up to 4am.  Last night I got up at 3am for bathroom.  This morning when I checked, it shows that I slept at 3am.  My sleep before the bathroom break wasn't recorded.

I like the sleep tracker being able to tell me the light sleep and deep sleep periods.  Unfortunately, it doesn't track my sleep time accurately.
profile.summary: Nice Tracker with Accuracy Issues

profile.description: Countertop cooking made easy. The BLACK+DECKER 6-Slice Stainless Steel Convection Toaster Oven with Broiler Pan is great for baking 9 pizzas, making toast for the whole family, and reheating leftovers into hot, crispy deliciousness. This versatile toaster oven bakes, broils, toasts, and keeps food warm, at up to 450F. The 60-minute precision timer ensures ideal results for all of them. Plus, this convection toaster oven comes with a baking and broiler pan that fits perfectly. When its time to eat, trust the #1 brand in toaster ovens*BLACK+DECKER. Large viewing window keep an eye on food during cooking. The durable glass window gives you a clear view of food throughout the cooking process. Dual position rack high and low rack slots let you position food right under the broiler, or accommodate larger portions of food.
profile.reviewText:
This Black+Decker 6-Slice Convection Toaster Oven is quite sleek in appearance; looks good in the kitchen.  Functionally, it heats and cooks faster than I thought. You need to get used to its fast timing because before you know it, the food is burnt.

The three setting dials are clearly marked and easy to work with, except the bottom dial (Timer) is a little tough to turn backward (counterclockwise).  For example, in order to toast a piece of bread, you have to turn the timer past 10 minutes (dark toast) and return it to where you would like it to, but it's a little hard to turn back, especially for my 75-year-old mom's weak fingers.  I hope it will become looser after some use.

Other than the tough timer dial, everything works better than I expected.  I recommend it!
profile.summary: Nice Looking and Fast Cooking

profile.description: Save yourself monthly rental fees and enjoy reliable Wi-Fi in your home with the TC-W7960. The 2-in-1 device works as both a cable modem and a router, replacing your ISPs rental modem while also creating strong Wi-Fi for your home. The TC-W7960 sets up easily, and its 8x4 channel bonding keeps your connections reliable so you can game, watch movies, and download files without slowing down your network.
profile.reviewText:
Our cable Internet service (Optimum) gives us free modem and router, but only for the first year.  It's soon due to be charged and this router modem combination came in time.  I like the combination because the previous separate two pieces required a sequence of power recycle every now and then, making you think which one was problematic.

Following the instruction, TP-Link N300 DOCSIS 3.0 replaces the original two pieces smoothly.  Optimum Internet service is compatible with DOCSIS 3.0 modems.  I had to call them to register the modem.  Within a few minutes, it starts working.  The speed test shows full current subscribed speed both for upload and download, and a little more.  So far so smooth and no reset has been needed.
profile.summary: Works Perfectly with Optimum

profile.description: We like playing in water and we love to film this, but watching your camera sink isnt much fun. U-Float by Series is perfect for capturing your story in, on or around the water. The silicone grip retains its tackiness when wet, while the adjustable neoprene strap holds it tight against your palm. The 1/4" universal screw mount means you can use any type of action sports camera. The hand-formed ergonomic grip means you'll always know which direction your camera is facing as soon as you grab the handle. And the vibrant orange/white color combination means even if you drop your U-Float, you'll be able to quickly spot it and retrieve it. The U-Float is perfect for capturing all of your water adventures.
profile.reviewText:
This is a pole for action cameras, not really for GoPro because it doesn't come with a GoPro adapter.  It has the standard 1/4" tripod screw. Maybe they assume that you already have a GoPro adapter.

The product is very well made.  Even if you don't use it on the water, it makes it very comfortable to hold the GoPro or any action camera because they tend to be very small to hold with normal size hand.

The pole floats well, and the color makes it easy to find.  You can use it in a pool, but not in the ocean unless you tie a string and attach it with your body so that it won't be carry away by the wave if you happen to lose it.

I wish it can be extended so that the camera could be lower in the water white it is floating, so that you can take a picture of yourself diving or snorkeling near the camera.  Having an extension would also allow it to function as a selfie stick.  However, it's just a wish list; this pole is good by itself.

I recommend it!
profile.summary: Good Quality Floating Pole

profile.description: Selfies are great for capturing a moment, but unfortunately it's usually just your head that can fit in the photo. The XSories Big U-Shot extension pole greatly expands your selfie capabilities, allowing you to place your camera in hard-to-reach locations to get shots from unique angles. Your selfies will never look the same.
profile.reviewText:
The U-Shot is very good in quality, but it's a little too short and not so useful without buying the accessories.  Because it's short, it can handle a heavier camera without getting your arm tired. I could put a small video camera, such as Canon Vixia.

I have two other selfie sticks and they are much longer and they came with a smartphone adapter, while this one doesn't and you have to buy it separately.  You can also buy other attachments to make it more useful, but after having all, it becomes expensive.

I have mixed feeling about this stick.  It's sold as a monopod, instead of selfie stick.  I've never had a monopod so short.  The only thing that I am happy about this monopod is the made quality.
profile.summary: U-Short!  Not a Misspelling

profile.description: The black decker HSV520J01 18V lithium cordless 2-N-1 stick + hand vacuum features a 2-in-1 design which provides for cleaning on and above your floors. This vac offers lithium technology. The on/off powered brush bar allows you to thoroughly clean your carpets and area rugs with a motorized brush roll. The self-standing design lets you stand this vacuum upright where you need it, so it's always ready when messes arise. The detachable brush bar is easy to clean in between pick up Jobs. It has an led indicator that provides a constant update on the battery charge level. Smooth pivot steering provides plenty of maneuverability to get around furniture, with a low profile design that allows you to easily reach under furniture while cleaning. It also has a translucent, bugless dirt bowl that makes it easy to see dirt and easy to empty. Includes: 2-in-1 vat, Jack plug charger, crevice tool, brush attachment, wall mount, pleated Pre-Filter, washable filter.
profile.reviewText:
Right out of the box, this B+D Cordless Hand Vacuum looks impressive both in quality and design.  The titanium finish provides a classy appearance.  After plugging in the battery and giving it a try, I'm even more impressed.

I have several other Lithium tools made by B+D, from cordless drill to snow blower, and most of them work very well.  Lithium power technology has created a lot of freedom and power for household tools.

This vacuum maneuvers well under tables and chairs.  The handheld piece also is light enough for an elderly, like my mom (75), to feel comfortable using it.  The suction is good our need.  We have two cats and this vacuum keeps the furs disappeared.  I also use it to clean my van and it allows me to reach almost everywhere.

I recommend it!
profile.summary: Powerful, Light Weight, and Convenient

profile.description: With the adidas adjustable bench, you can Vary your workout with 3 position options. Sturdy foot placement and soft foam rollers for safety and comfort. Increase your agility, build strength, and improve your endurance. Bench weighs just 25 lbs. A great piece of equipment for a home gym with limited space.
profile.reviewText:
In setup was not very hard but took me more than half an hour because the instruction is a little hard to understand immediately.  The instruction for setting up is very condensed, in four steps.  It could have been broken down to more steps to make it much easier.  You have to stretch your imagination quite a bit to understand the instruction drawings.

The construction is strong enough for me to do what I need.  I am 180lb, 5'11".  The bench is also light enough for you to move it from room to room or floor to floor if you need to.  The user manual also gives you a few sample exercises to get started with.

Overall, it's a light weight, good quality, utility bench made by a reputable brand at a very reasonable price.

I recommend it!
profile.summary: Light Weight, Good Quality, Reasonably Priced.

profile.description: The JAM Plus wireless Bluetooth speaker is the only JAM speaker that lets you pair two for true stereo sound. The JAM Plus speaker offers you high-quality, high volume sound that will have your friends wondering how a speaker so little produces sound so big. It pairs easily with your Bluetooth devices, streams music up to 30 feet away, and even offers an integrated speakerphone that instantly transfers from music to conversation. Best of all, you can double the sound output and get true stereo sound by pairing two JAM Plus wireless speakers to your device  and play them both for up to six hours between charges.
profile.reviewText:
*** Update September 06, 2013 ***

I've got another one, so I am able to test the stereo setting this time. Boy, what a blast!  They sound like a pair of expensive Bose speakers.  With it's size and price, and being wireless, don't think twice; it's alright to own a pair!

*** End Update ***

Not that I've ever held a real hand grenade but when I connected this to my Android phone and turned on a song, it shocked me with its sound.  I happened to have my volume on high, but still didn't expect the speaker to come up with such a huge sound, like a bomb exploding in front of me.

It's not only the loudness but also the clarity of the sound that impresses me.  This little speaker could fill a 1000sqf room easily.

As you see in the picture, it's also well designed with colorful cases.  It looks like a fragrance bottle if you put it in the car.

Once you paired it with your phone, it connects with it as soon as your phone is near the speaker and ready for you to entertain.

One problem I had was to re-pair with with another device seem difficult and confusing.  You can't enter the pairing mode once the speaker is paired with one device.  There is no instruction for it.  You can switch it to a stereo mode (even if you don't intend to use it) and then you are ready to pair again.  That would overwrite the previous mono pairing.  Then you switch it back to mono to re-pair it with the new device.  A guess another way to wipe the current pairing is to press the reset hole with a pin.  I just think there should be an easier way.

(I own only one of this HDMX Jam Plus speaker so I haven't tried the stereo mode.  If you own two, you can pair one of them for each of the stereo channel.)

Again, most people won't be using this speaker on multiple devices and that's just a minor inconvenience considering the overall quality of this speaker.  You'll enjoy it!
profile.summary: Like a hand grenade!

profile.description: Connect your laptop and other devices to the Thunderbolt 2 Express Dock HD for lightning-fast file transfers. Operating at 20 Gbps, the connection lets you transfer music, movies, and other data files at twice the speed of the previous Thunderbolt. Connect up to eight devices to your laptop using the included cable, keeping your workspace organized and streamlining your setup. Dual-display compatibility lets you attach two additional monitors to your laptop, and the dock supports vivid 4K cinema resolution on one display. The slim, low-profile design won't monopolize space on your desk. Compatibility:MacBook Air 11 inch,MacBook Air 13 inch,MacBook Pro (2014),MacBook Pro 13 inch, MacBook Pro 15 inc, MacBook Pro 17 inch
profile.reviewText:
The Belkin Thunderbolt 2 Express Dock HD comes with no instruction.  There are some descriptions on the box that gives you some idea, but if you are wondering about what other things it might be able to do other than what you think you know, you wouldn't find it anywhere.  Not even on Belkin's website.  The system driver download link on Belkin's website is also confusing because it just leads you to the product page and no download link is found.

Even though it can connect to 8 devices, some of them are not useful for most people.  There are two usb ports for connecting a keyboard and a mouse, which is not useful for me because I use wireless keyboard and mouse.  A Ethernet port for connecting to the router, which I don't need either.

As attractive as the appearance of the device itself, the power adapter brick is extremely bulky.  I guess this device is only intended to be used at home or work on your desk and not to be carried around.

The good features are that this device uses the Thunderbolt 2 technology that allows you to transfer data twice as fast as the regular Thunderbolt and it supports dual displays and 4K cinema resolution.

If you are using a Macbook or a PC Notebook that has a Thunderbolt 2 port, this device can be a time saver because you can set up all your connection to this device and just plug in the Thunderbolt cable to have everything else connected,
profile.summary: Speedy Connection to Desktop Devices

profile.description: Small doesn't mean modest in a laser measure with functions that include area, distance, length, volume, continuous measurement and addition/subtraction. Simply press the measure button to activate the laser and begin measuring in real time. Backlighting allows user to see information in dark areas with better resolution. Handy pocket-size design makes unit easy to use anywhere. The GLM 35 measures to 120 feet. Class IIa laser product, <1mW power output
profile.reviewText:
I own a Bosch GLM 50, which as bigger built with longer distance (165ft), and it comes with a belt pouch.  This model is has shorter distance (120ft) but much smaller, thinner, and lighter to carry.  Cheaper too. It doesn't come with a belt pouch but it quite small to put it in your pocket like a small flat cellphone.

Unless you are a commercial constructor that constantly work with structures beyond 120ft, I think this is a great laser measure.  The usage is quite intuitive for basic measurement, and learning to use it for a more complex calculation is not that hard at all.

I also like that it uses AAA batteries.  I avoid tools with those flat (button) lithium batteries which are a hassle to buy.  Built wise, this model doesn't appear to be as durable as GLM 50, but it's good enough.

I recommend it!
profile.summary: Small, Sleak, and Time Saving

profile.description: TheNEWRokinon 16mm Ultra Wide Angle T/2.2 Cine Lens is Rokinon's newest addition to its assortment of high quality, affordable, prime lenses. The new 16mm lens is designed for cameras with APS-C crop frame sensors. Its build and construction are superb!Like all Rokion Cine lenses this lens features a de-clicked aperture and is follow focus compatible. The lens is constructed of 13 elements in 11 groups and features 2 aspherical lens elements.All of these lens elements combine to minimize distortion and chromatic aberrations. The lens also features a removable hood and takes a 77mm filter. Your pictures are sure to come out razor sharp and clear, even at the corners! The Rokinon 16mm Cine lens features a remarkable 83.1 angle of view on APS-C cameras and 67.6 on 4/3 cameras. The lens is available for the following mounts: Canon EOS, Nikon, Sony Alpha and NEX, and Micro Four-Thirds.
profile.reviewText:
This is a very sharp and bright lens of great build quality. I bought the Micro 4/3 version for my GH3, but found it not quite a good match due to the heavy weight and size.

If you use Lumix GH series cameras because you enjoy the light weight, you might be disappointed with the weight and bulk added by this lens.

For my GH3, I found out that I can get LEICA SUMMILUX 15mm/F1.7 for about the same price, from the brand of Leica, with a little wider angle and brighter aperture.  Of course it's feather weight also matches the camera to save your shoulder.

Still Rokinon CV16M-MFT 16mm T2.2 Cine is a great lens. I recommend this lens if you are not looking for a light weight one.
profile.summary: Great Lens, but MIGHT not be for Micro 4/3 Camera Users

profile.description: The MP230L Performance Mouse's unique track-on-glass sensor uses a high-definition laser that will follow your hand movements on a wide variety of desk surfaces. The 2.4GHz wireless connection via a USB nano receiver means there are no cords to clutter up your desk. The mouse is full-sized, offering complete comfort in an ergonomic design. In addition to the traditional two-button and scroll wheel top, side buttons offer quicker browser navigation. DPI adjustment buttons allow you to control the cursor tracking speed. And with Plug & Play installation, you'll be up and clicking almost the instant you plug in.
profile.reviewText:
This is a very practical mouse.  I was expecting a little more sleek design and classy finish, but it appears a little crude and clumsy.  Other than that the functionality is unquestionably great.

It works on all kinds of surfaces I tried on--light, dark, with or without mouse pad, on a plastic or glass table top.

I like the fact that I can adjust the resolution of the mouse by just pressing the + and - buttons on the mouse next to the wheel.  When I need it to move fast, I use higher resolution, and when I need to draw a detail graphic, I use the lower so that it moves slower.

There are also two additional buttons on the right for forward and back movement on the browser.

After all, it's a very practical mouse and it does the precise job I need it to do.

I recommend it!
profile.summary: A Very Practical Mouse

profile.description: The Pfister Clarify filter faucet delivers healthy, great tasting water on demand from your kitchen faucet. The faucet is equipped with the trusted GE 2X Highflow Filtration System. This high-performance filtration system reduces contaminants such as pharmaceuticals, chlorine, lead and cysts from your drinking water. Pfisters seamlessly integrated Xtract feature allows you to activate the filter mode simply by using the faucet handle. Clarify delivers filtered water 2X faster than conventional drinking water dispensers while completely eliminating the need for a bulky filter pitcher, filter attachment or separate drinking water spigot.
profile.reviewText:
Out of the box, the Pfister Clarify Xtract faucet appear to be quite well made, except the supply lines are plastic and they are not so flexible.  Only the center hose is flexible (it has to be because it's a pull down line).  Even though the plastic lines are tough and sturdy, they are hard to be positioned to meet the water outlets since they are not so flexible.  I wish all lines are braided flexible lines like the middle one.

Installation is much easier than removing my old corroded faucet.  The handle turns smoothly.  The sprayer also has plastic parts inside that makes me feel a little uncomfortable.  I just have to trust today's advanced plastic technology.

The filtered water tastes better than that of my current drinking water filtration system.  It's a nice combination and space saving.

I recommend it!
profile.summary: Perfect Combination and Stylish

profile.description: HP PageWide Pro 477dw delivers stunning speeds for up to 40% lower color cost per page than color lasers. Get professional-quality color and fast two-sided scanning, plus best-in-class security features and energy efficiency. HP PageWide is designed with fewer moving parts. The stationary, page-width print bar enables unmatched speeds, improved reliability, and fewer replacement parts, all with professional print quality at the lowest total cost of operation in its class. 40% lowest cost per color page claim applies to devices that are not sold under contract: Comparison of HP PageWide A4 Pro and Enterprise class devices with the majority of in-class color ink/laser MFPs ($400-$2,999), and color ink/laser single function printers ($300-$999) with >1% market share and print speeds >20ppm as of February 2017; market share as reported by IDC as of Q4 2016. Cost per page (CPP) reported by gap intelligence Pricing & Promotions Report January/February 2017, comparisons for devices/supplies not sold under contract are based on published specifications of the manufacturers highest-capacity cartridges, inclusive of long life consumables and page yield. Average HP yield based on ISO/IEC 24711 and continuous printing in default mode. Actual yield varies based on content of printed pages and other factors. For more information, see hp.com/go/learnaboutsupplies and hp.com/go/PageWideClaims. Input voltage - 100 to 240 Volt
profile.reviewText:
This model HP PageWide Pro 477dw has everything a small to medium size company would need, multifunction plus WiFi connection.  I have the opportunity to play with three models, 452dn (without scanner unit), 477dn (without WiFi), and 477dw (has everything).  They are all great.  The choice is yours depending on your need.  The 500 series is the same except about 20% faster, but these 400 series is already lightning fast.  As the mentioned description, they are not for home use because no home would need such speed and ink capacity.  Ink cartridge would sound expensive for home use, but they are for office use.  The print cost is really cheap (I'll talk about this later).

The HP PageWide Pro series printers are state-of-the-art.  You might wonder why they named it "PageWide Pro" rather than the usual "OfficeJet Pro" or something you used to hear.  Even though HP hasn't told me, I know that they want to emphasize their new inject printhead that is a page width long.  That means there's much less mechanical movement in the printer, and that means these printers are less likely to break and much faster to print because the printhead doesn't have to move.

That said, this pagewide technology was debuted with their OfficeJet Pro X series and I have them both at home and in my office since they came into the market.  I've also recommenced it to a few companies and they bought it and they are very satisfied with it. The OJ Pro X series were not perfect at the beginning but the support was outstanding.  One of mine started to malfunction about a year later, and they shipped me a new one the next day, and took the old one, after a short diagnostic call on the phone.  That kind of support makes businesses happy.

Now they have refined the technology and came up with these new models called PageWide Pro series, targeting small to medium size companies. I have a small office, but I love to use more powerful and reliable machines to avoid headache and ensure productivity.  This model, 477dw, is for those who want a multi-function printer (Print, Scan, Copy and Fax).  It hooks to the wired network, but there's also WiFi on itself, so you can keep it totally wireless (except the power cord, unfortunately).

The set up is easy, the printing is amazingly fast, and the color is acceptable.  It's not a photo printer, but the pictures are very pretty on the documents.  I do use HP 22lb All-in-One paper.  Believe it or not, it turns out to be cheaper or about the same as regular 20lb printer payer when I buy it at BJ's.  It prints brilliant color documents on this paper.

You can also print from you smartphones and tablets using HP Print Service app.  Very smooth installation and works like a charm.

Most importantly, the print cost is cheaper than my laser color printers.  So I had to donate away my laser color printers--those extremely heavy machines. With this model, it cost you about 5 cents for a color page and less than 2 cents for a black text page.
