So for average documents that has a mixture of black text and pictures, I would say the cost is about 3 to 4 cents.  At that cost, I can print color documents all day long and give away color brochures instead of black and white.

With this latest printer technology, HP has regained my trust that has been lost a few years ago.

I recommend it!
profile.summary: The Ultimate Workgroup Printer

profile.description: Triangle Bulbs Energy Saving 9W LED R20 Indoor Flood Lights, with their beautiful, soft-warm, white color (3000K), are ideal for residential use in kitchens, living rooms, and dining rooms, and for commercial use in offices and retail spaces. They provide a soft, white light spread in a wide beam, perfect for general room lighting, or highlighting and accenting decor. These E26/medium base flood lights can be used in recessed cans and track light fixtures, and provide 800 lumens. The body of the bulb is ceramic, which expands the cooling capacity of LED bulbs, helping to substantially lower costs from the previously used aluminum or copper bases. Ceramic bulb bodies require no special recycling or disposal, making them safe for the environment. Unlike aluminums, which conduct electricity and can potentially create a shock hazard, ceramics add an additional element of safety for consumers due to their lack of conductibility. With their elegant and classy look, these bulbs will give any room a great finish.
profile.reviewText:
I've gradually changed all my home light bulbs to LED since a couple of years ago, but they were much more expensive then. The dimmable LED bulbs are even more expensive.  But the price has come way down these days.

These Triangle Bulbs appear okay.  Comparing to all other LED bulbs I've bought they don't look the highest quality in appearance.  But, I am also careful with light bulbs, so nothing has fallen apart when I put them on.  Once they are put on, it's unlikely that I will have to touch it again, at least not so often.  What's important is they work, and they do.

If you want to use them for photography lighting that you need to move them around often, I'm not sure they are good for such purpose, and they are not made for such purpose.

For dimmable flood light bulbs, I recommend these.
profile.summary: Good Value Dimmable Indoor Flood Lights

profile.description: Combining high-resolution audio with increased connectivity options, the AT2020USBi cardioid condenser microphone adds a new level of sound-quality and convenience to Audio-Technica's USB microphone line. Modeled after the critically acclaimed AT2020, this digital output mic features an A/D converter with a 24-bit/96 kHz sampling rate to deliver high-resolution articulation and intelligibility that's perfect for home studio recording, field recording, podcasting and voiceover use. The AT2020USBi works with both USB and Lightning cables (included), so you can use it straight from the box to digitally capture audio on the device of your choice: PC, Mac or iOS. The integrated gain control adds to the convenience, allowing you to adjust the input level directly on the microphone. AT2020USBi cardioid condenser: state-of-the-art sound for the on-the-go lifestyle.
profile.reviewText:
Audio-Technica AT2020 has established itself as the top podcasting microphone for years, and the company wisely continues its production with added features in response to users' comments, and named them AT2020USB, AT2020USB+, AT2020USBi, etc. accordingly.

In AT2020i, Audio-Techinica has ramped up the high-quality A/D converter with 24-bit/96 kHz sampling rate for superb, high-resolution audio, as apposed to 16 bit, 44.1/48 kHz in the previous versions.

Another feature is the use of Lightning cable for powering and connecting with Apple products, such as iPhone, iPad, etc.  Maybe that is the reason for the (i) at the end of the model.

The built quality is solid and the sound quality is superb.  Even though it doesn't look as cute and is more expensive,, I would pick this microphone over Blue Yeti anytime.

The accessories for this microphone made by Audio-Technica is a little pricey, but there are third party accessories that are reasonably priced.  For example, a shock mount and a windscreen is a necessary to complete my setting.  For the shock mount I picked "Weymic Black Universal Microphone Shock Mount for Large Diameter Condenser Mic Metal".

For those who love high quality audio, I highly recommend it!
profile.summary: Solid Built and Superb Sound

profile.description: Avocent sv240h desktop KVM switch simplifies access to essential business systems. Each switch supports a wide range of peripherals and up to four different systems.
profile.reviewText:
This Avocent 4-Port Dual-Head HDMI KVM Switch is the most heavy duty KVM switch I've ever seen.  It's built in a durable metal box that I stand my 32" monitor on it with out problem. Unlike the previous one (DVI-I version) I've used, this one allows dual monitor setting from all four systems, through HDMI.  Now I can get busy in a smaller workspace.

The setup is easy.  All you need is to plug the cables in.  Unfortunately cables are not included.  While I have HDMI cables lying around, having to hunt for USB 3 A to B cables is a little annoying, but not a big deal. At this price point, throwing a few cables in would make the customers very happy because it will eliminate their frustration.

Wow, I have to say wow, because it comes with both speaker and microphone pass through.  That allows me to record on any system unit I want to using one headset. This is a video audio production friendly device.  It also has three extra USB 3 ports on the front.

The switch between systems is fast and easy with just a soft touch on the buttons. The buttons also lit to indicate which system I'm connected to.

So far everything is solid and I haven't yet found a glitch.  I recommend it!
profile.summary: A Solid KVM Switch

profile.description: Friedrich Chill series air conditioners are energy efficient and easy-to-handle. The programmable timer plus the MoneySaver setting helps manage energy use and reduce costs. With capacities from 5200 to 23000 Btu/h and the Auto Air Sweep feature, Chill can evenly cool a single room or a large open space. All models include a remote control. To determine the appropriate cooling capacity, see our sizing guide and model specifications.
profile.reviewText: I recently bought SPT 12000 BTU Window Air Conditioner WA-1211S,Frigidaire FRA106CV1 10,000 BTU 115-Volt Window-Mounted Compact Air Conditioner with Temperature Sensing Remote Control, and Honeywell MN12CES 12,000 BTU Portable Air Conditioner with Remote Control - Black/Silver. Seeing this Friedrich CP12G10A being sold at a much more expensive price then the other ones I personally bought, I had higher expectations. First, packaging: The packaging is inadequate for the size and weight of this AC. There is an instruction in the packaging saying that I should save the packing material in case I need to ship it, but it didn't survive the initial unpacking. The padding Styrofoam pieces are very thin. They were already cracked and fell apart as I unpacked the unit. The shell is dented in the rear, but it didn't affect the cosmetic because that part stays outside of the window. Comparing to the other AC units I bought (e.g. SPT 12000 BTU Window Air Conditioner WA-1211S) which came with two layers of boxes, this unit is poorly packaged. Further more, it is bigger and heavier. So it should have been packaged better. Installation: You have to install the shell first. To me, that's traditional, but a little outdated method because both other widow units mentioned above came in one piece. They are also smaller, lighter, and took me ten minutes to install. This unit is huge and heavy, so having to install the shell makes sense. However, the product description says, it is "Sleek, Stylish & Efficient." At least it's not sleek at all. Installation took me an hour. The screw holes are not well aligned. The most astonishing part is when I tried to install the last part--the front grill--the two screw holes are not well aligned there either. I had to do my best to compromise the alignment and force the screws in. You would think they should at least have made these two important screw holes in the front perfectly aligned. I would describe the installation "old fashion." It's not terrible if I have never bought and installed the SPT WA-1211S and Frigidaire FRA106CV1. After installation: The appearance is not bad, but I have seen much prettier designs nowadays. So design wise, it's traditional at best. I turned on the unit and the noise level is acceptable to both my wife and me. We put this in our bedroom, replacing a smaller LG unit that makes scratching noise that kept us awake at night. This is the first day of installation and the NJ weather is not hot enough to test the performance of it yet. I will update the review at a later date. Considering the higher price than other comparable units, I have higher expectation on it's performance. I hope it will not disappoint me, as I was a little disappointed with packaging and installation. ==Added 05/02/2014== This unit performs very well so far. The cool air is sensed immediately around the room. The noise is bearable to sleep with, particularly if you set the fan to the lowest speed (F1). The noise is the smooth type rather than the rough type--more like the ocean wave than a lawnmower. ==Added 07/01/2014== Now we are well into summer. This AC turns out to be the one that we enjoy most. It's powerful, it cools the room fast, and it's noise is not disturbing. If you ignore the poor packaging, this unit deserves five stars. I recommend it! ==Added 08/14/2014== Both my wife and I have never enjoyed a window air conditioner so much. We've always regarded them as an annoyance and unwelcome necessity. But this unit is an exception. Even the electricity bill came much lower than the same month in previous year.
profile.summary: Good but didn't meet my expectation

profile.description: The Quartet Glass Easel gives a modern twist to traditional presentation. The sleek frameless glass dry-erase board will add contemporary style to your office space. Non-absorbent glass lets you write, erase and rewrite on a clean surface every time. The durable glass surface resists stains, ghosting, scratches and dents. Easily move your dry-erase easel from one room to the next on the wheeled base. The smooth-rolling wheels allow for quick mobility and have locking casters to hold the easel in place. Adjust the easel up to 77" tall to optimize viewing. Whether youre presenting on the glass dry-erase board or using the flipchart holder, you will always present at eye-level. The multifunctional magnetic glass is great for meetings and presentations. Easily hang papers and documents instantly with high-power glass board magnets. The strong durable glass surface resists scratches and dents. Designed for long-term performance, this board is ideal for heavy use and comes with a limited 15 year warranty. Board measures 2' x 3'. Comes with adjustable flipchart hooks, 1 dry-erase marker and accessory tray. For best results use Quartet Glass Board Accessories, sold separately.
profile.reviewText:
This Quartet Infinity Glass Mobile Presentation Easel is very classy and high quality.  The box came a little torn and I was concerned about the glass material inside, but the product inside is well padded and the glass whiteboard seems very strong and it is coupled with a metal back.

The installation was easy.  Even without looking at the instruction, I was able to put it together in three minutes. The only place I got stuck was putting the two screws in because there's no pre-drilled holes at the place.  I had to use a powered screw driver to push the screws in.

The whiteboard cannot be turned sideways.  What you see in the picture is the way it is.  You can adjust the height easily.  The casters are smooth and the stand is stable.

The writing surface is perfect, except if you are shooting a video using this board to illustrate your ideas, you might have to angle the lighting to avoid reflection since this is a shiny smooth glass surface.

I can't stick a magnet sheet on it.  Maybe it requires strong magnets.  The magnet pieces I have can stick in the back, but won't do it through the glass. So using this board as magnetic bulletin board, as advertised, might not be easily possible.  Maybe I haven't figured it out yet.

It also comes with two hooks to be put at the top to hand newsprint pad over it.  That's convenient when you need to use newsprint and you don't have to look for another newsprint board.

Overall this is a high quality product. If it does function as a magnetic bulletin board, I definitely deserve five stars.

This board would make your office look classy and it will also last for years.  I recommend it.
profile.summary: A Classy Whitebaord Well Made

profile.description: This stunning upholstered platform bed by Zinus will transform your bedroom. It ships in one carton with the frame, legs and ten wooden slats conveniently located in the zippered compartment in the back of the headboard for easy assembly. This classic upholstered platform bed features a detailed headboard and low profile footboard style frame, with wood slats and exposed feet for support. The taupe detailed upholstery adds softness and provides a classic framework for your mattress. Another comfort innovation from Zinus. Pioneering comfort.
profile.reviewText:

profile.description: The Honeywell MP Series 8,000 BTU portable air conditioner with front grille design cools, ventilates, and dehumidifies up to 250 square feet. Featuring 3-in-1 technology, it is an air conditioner, fan and dehumidifier all rolled into one compact unit. The front grille design provides powerful air flow. The full-function remote control allows you to operate each feature from across the room. Unlike a fixed AC, this unit requires no permanent installation and four caster wheels provide easy mobility between areas. Plus, the auto-evaporation system allows for hours of continuous operation with no water to drain or no bucket to empty. This model comes with everything needed including a flexible exhaust hose and an easy-to-install window venting kit. The window vent can be removed when the unit is not in use.
profile.reviewText:
The shipping box arrived torn, with the bottom about the fall out.  The nylon ribbons that secure the box are no longer there (the reason I know there should be nylon ribbons is because I have another unit that comes with them.)  It's a good thing that nothing inside seems damaged.  The unit is much smaller and lighter than all portable AC models I've seen.  I see some large plastic parts looking from the bottom, which I don't like, but I guess that's what makes the unit lighter.

I have used many portable AC, but this is the first one that comes with front grille.  Since cold air stays down and hot air goes up, this means your legs and the lower parts of the body will get more cool air with this unit (since the unit is smaller, the air blows even lower).  A couple of benefits that I can think of: first, when your lower body is cool, you feel cool; second, if you have a room with high ceiling, you don't waste the cool air that has to go up and then comes back down, which is usually the case with the top grille.

We use two of these in a large room (650sq. ft) with tall ceiling and they serve the purpose reasonably well.  The noise level is a little lower than average. At first, I thought the front grille will look ugly (like in the picture), but it's not in reality. You don't really see through behind the grill like in the picture because they are smaller and lower from your direct view.  You see only the front part of the grey grille which is not ugly at all.

I recommend it!
profile.summary: Smaller, Lighter, but Quite Powerful

profile.description: Ergonomic manager's office chair features padding and fit in all the right places. Lumbar support is provided by an adjustable lumbar pillow that can even be removed for certain users. The head rest is defined by additional padding for extra support. Flip-back arms allow the chair to roll up close to the desk when needed. Arm rests are comfortably padded. Rich black, bonded leather upholstery enhances the executive performance and look. Whalen designs, develops and delivers quality home furniture that are rich in the value, trend and innovation. Our manufacturing expertise is highlighted by time-honored construction techniques using quality wood materials, metal, glass and upholstery. Every Whalen product incorporates industry-best features at a cost that provides today's families freedom and options when decorating their home or office. Designed for today and built for tomorrow, each piece of furniture is created for the way you live and work. Whalen products deliver.
profile.reviewText:
The big plus is that it comes with the tool and extra nuts and bolts for foolproof assembly, with a clear instruction manual.

Well designed.  I particularly like the lower back support.  The leather is soft.  Normally bonded leather should last for five years. The back leaning is just far enough but I prefer a little farther.

The seat height can be raised pretty high, but I wish it can be raise a little further so that it will function like a tall chair to be used next to a tall counter.  However, I won't complain about the height; it's a manager chair anyway.  The height adjustment is very smooth.

The only gripe is that this chair is not so large as they claim in the description: "Large manager's chair with rich bonded leather."  I am 5'11" and weigh 180lb, and the chair look small according to my kids.  It looks just fine, but not grand.  It's not large enough to give you the "boss" look.  So I was surprised to see the description a little misleading.  Maybe they are not using Americans to measure this size.  It maybe large for Asians and Europeans, but not for the Americans.

However, the price is right for the quality of the chair.  If you are looking for a very comfortable manager chair, and size doesn't matter, this is a great chair for the price around a hundred fifty bucks.  I recommend it!
profile.summary: Comfortable Chair but Not Large

profile.description: The ultimate update for your legacy VGA devices, the Universal HDMI to VGA Adapter allows you to seamlessly stream content from HDMI devices like Chromecast, Apple TV and other HDMI-capable devices to your projector or VGA display . Unlike other VGA adapters, it adapts to both HDMI-M and HDMI-F connectors without skipping a beat. Whats more, it includes an audio cable, to bring sound to your VGA device, perhaps for the very first time. Please note some HDMI devices require additional power to convert to a VGA signal. If devices are connected correctly and you still have no picture, plug a micro-USB cable into the adapter and connect it to a USB power supply (cable and power supply not included; 500mA suggested minimum output).
profile.reviewText:
This is the device I've been waiting for a long time.  It is a very complete and versatile set of HDMI to VGA converter with sound.  I've bought a HDMI to VGA adapter from another brand (Cable Matters) previously for connecting my computer to a projector using HDMI.  However, that adapter doesn't adapt my computer's 1080p resolution to the projector's resolution, so it keeps projecting off the screen, and it's impossible to make it work properly.

This adapter, however, tells the computer that the connected projector is a different resolution (mine being SXGA) so the computer automatically sends the right aspect ratio to the screen, and the PowerPoint and videos appears nicely as if it comes right out of VGA cable.

The best part is that now you can wirelessly stream video audio through Chromcast or Apple TV to a projector.  This is a fantastic feature that I didn't expect.

I recommend it!
profile.summary: A Complete HDMI to VGA Adapter Kit

profile.description: A thermostat that adapts to your life. You can control the Lyric Round Thermostat from anywhere, or let it manage your comfort and savings automatically, so there's no learning curve, no rigid scheduling - just comfort when you're home, and energy savings when you're away.
profile.reviewText:
Out of the box, this Lyric Round Wi-Fi Thermostat looks very attractive with a very nice taste of color combination.  Installation is easy following the instructions on the app.  It connects to my home wifi network without a hitch.  The temperature detection is accurate.  It's quite smart as to adjusting the temperature with consideration of the outdoor humidity.

Both Lyric and the app have some nice features, but missing some major ones that I believe everyone would expect a thermostat should have.  There's no way to setup a schedule for it to turn on or off at specific times. My previous cheap, non-smart, thermostat could do that.  The geofence technology also works erratically, sometimes it works and sometimes it doesn't.  You can't turn off home heating/cooling system from the thermostat itself. You have to use the app to do so.  It's annoying to have to look for your phone when you are actually standing in front of the thermostat in order to turn that off.

It's nice that it works with Alexa (Amazon Echo), allowing you to make temperature adjustment with voice command.  However, without the scheduling feature, all other features becomes superfluous.  It might be useful for a single person living alone or maybe a couple, but not for a family with children that prefers a fixed time table.  I hope the future release of the app and firmware will have the scheduling feature it it.
profile.summary: Nice but Missing some Important Features

profile.description: This GREEN portable air conditioner is extremely mobile and can be easily setup in almost any indoor location and are most commonly used in computer / server rooms, bedrooms, classrooms and garages / workshops. This Whynter GREEN ARC-110WD portable air conditioner features the ECO-FRIENDLY CFC free GREEN R-410A refrigerant and lead free RoHS compliant components. The leading attribute of this model is its compact size and dual hose system which facilitates greater space utilization and more efficient cooling. With 11,000 BTU of cooling power, the Whynter ARC-110WD is an ideal solution for the warm spots in your home or office. Portable and easy to set up, this is one of the few portable air conditioners that offers cooling relief for any area where excess humidity and heat cannot be remedied by traditional air conditioning.
profile.reviewText:
The packing is sturdy, unlike a couple of other brands that I installed recently.  It has two layers of boxes.  I always love two layers of boxes when it comes to heavy items like this.  The main concern is that in case I need to return the item or ship it somewhere, I don't have to hunt for another box.  Some brands shipped with thin boxes that are not reusable after unpacking.

The design is elegant and the color goes well with any room decoration.  However, the two hoses model makes it appear messy, even thought they are supposed to be more energy efficient. I've heard that you can do without the intake hose, if you choose not to install it.  It is even advisable not to connect the intake hose if the outdoor air is polluted and humid. What I don't like about hose installation is that it requires you to screw the hose to the window slider kit.  The other units that I've use just need you to snap them in.

The unit is easy to roll on the hard floor but not quite on the carpet, but no one really moves them frequently once it is install.  The size is smaller than other portable units I've used.

What I like most is the additional drain port at the middle of the unit.  I dislike using the bottom port because I can use only a shallow pan with it and you know that it's hard to walk with a full pan of water without making a mess on your way to the kitchen.  The upper port is also big enough for you to connect a garden hose to it, so that you can set it up to never require manual draining.  However, the hose cannot go higher than the port.  It can only go lower.  So even if you don't have a lower place to let the water how, simply letting it drain to a bucket should save a lot of hassle.

The best part is the efficient cooling. I compare it with another 12,000 BTU unit and this one is a little smaller but cooler.  It's also cheaper than the other unit.  The only difference is yo can see the cheaper plastic appearance at the top air outlets if you look closer.  The sound is bearable.  If you live in a city, you might not even notice it because of the outside noise.  Since I live in a quiet neighborhood, I can only live with the low fan speed.

I recommend this unit because it's a dual hose system, cheaper in price, and efficient in cooling.
profile.summary: Efficient, Elegant, and Economic

Omni directional means the bulb emits light 360 degrees all the way around the bulb identical to the light distribution of an incandescent bulb. These illuminate a soft white color when lit that is similar to that of an incandescent bulb. Start saving energy and money today with TCP RLAO7527D.
profile.reviewText:
This TCP 75 Watt Equivalent Single-Pack, LED OMNI A21 Light Bulb, ENERGY STAR Certified, Dimmable, Soft White light is equally bright as the regular 75 Watt light bulb.  I have replaced all my home lights with LED bulbs and many of the are TCP.  These new lights appear to be outwardly cheaper in plastic quality, but it doesn't affect the functionality since LED don't produce much heat and therefore the outer shell doesn't need to be glass.  So out of the box, they don't appear smooth and glassy as the old versions used to be, but most of us won't touch it after installation, so it doesn't really matter, as long as it produces good light and last long.

profile.description: The Honeywell hl Series portable air conditioner combines 3-in-1 technology into one luscious and sleek body, cooling and dehumidifying areas 450-550 square feet. This AC comes in good packaging. The size of the unit is a little smaller than most portable AC of this capacity because I own several other portable AC made by Honeywell as well as other brands. profile.description: Get the power, creativity and control you need to edit like a professional with Pinnacle Studio 20 Ultimate. Edit with precision on unlimited tracks in 4K, HD and 3D, and fine-tune sound with sophisticated audio tools. Create dynamic, engaging videos with pro-caliber tools, including new Stop Motion Animation, new controls for 360 Degree video and a 6 angle multi-camera editor. New Motion Tracking lets you add moving text, graphics or a mosaic blur to people or objects. With 2,000+ effects, titles and transitions, and new high-quality effects from New Blue, unlimited creativity is at your fingertips. And when you're ready to share, enjoy 100+ new menu templates for DVD authoring. You've got the vision, now get the results with Pinnacle Studio 20 Ultimate.
profile.reviewText:
I use Adobe Premiere (CC) for my video editing, but it allows me to put the license on two computers at a time, and I have four computers.  Even though I could disable the license on the other computers to use it on the third one, I don't like the annoyance as I switch computers quite frequently.  Sometimes, I just need to do some simple editing, and Pinnacle Studio 20 becomes a friend.  It doesn't "call home" and annoy me with license check every time I open it.

The user interface of Pinnacle Studio is generally similar to Premiere, with sources at the top left, output at the top right, and timeline at the bottom.  In fact, it's more intuitive than Premiere--it well known that the learning curve of Adobe software beats anything else.  Without having to dig into help and tutorials, I was able to start editing in no time.

With version 20, we have 4K UHD support, which means Pinnacle Studio is stepping into the professional video editor competition.  Shooting 4K gives me freedom to crop, pan, and zoom to produce a more refined 1080p video.

Allowing up to 6 cameras is wonderful.  I normally use up to 3 cameras, but having 6 cameras capability is a plus.

So far the software has crashed only once.  It was at the end of installation.  It froze without declaring installation was finished.  But it was finished, so I force closed the installation window and start using the software.

For those who are considering Pinnacle Studio 20, the encouragement is that it has quite a lot of tutorial videos on YouTube, even though this software is still new.  I'm sure many more tutorials will be found in the near future.

I recommend it!

This 120 volt, 7.5 watt, par20 reflector he series features a medium base, produces a stunning warm white light at 400 lumens, and can fit right into your living room or into the most cutting edge, state of the art, lighting design project.
profile.reviewText:
I've been waiting for a PAR20 dimmable LED warm light for a long time for use with photography, as a cooler and more economical alternative.  This Sunlite PAR20 works perfectly for the purpose.  As the weather becomes warmer, I don't want the lights to produce additional heat in the studio.  LED doesn't produce heat like the regular photography lights.  If you use CFL lights, they are usually long and often protruding outside of the light shade, and they are not environmentally friendly.  The dimmable feature is also important to refine the correct lighting out put.

Of course this is also a prefect replacement for PAR20 recess lights.  It's solidly built and appear to last a long time.

I recommend it!
profile.summary: Great PAR20 Replacement and also for Photography Use

profile.description: Room for a whole family's worth of bikes with access to everything inside the vehicle. The Schwinn 4-Bike hitch mount rack has strong tie downs and a cradle system that individually secures bikes and protects cables. The arms fold out of the way when not in use and the whole rack tilts back for easy access to the back of the vehicle. A black powder coat finish will keep the rack looking great for years. The Schwinn 4-Bike hitch mount rack is easy to assemble, operate, and super secure for up to 4 bikes. Constructed with steel tubing, the Schwinn 4-Bike hitch mount rack is Backed up by a lifetime warranty and made in the USA with domestically Source parts.
profile.reviewText:
I have 2" hitch and this Schwinn 4-Bike rack is made for 1.25" and came with an adapter for the 2" rack, which fits tightly and sturdily.  The installation is easy and straight forward.  The bikes hang on securely.  I also own Allen Sports Deluxe 4-Bike Hitch Mount Rack, which is at the same price, but I like this one better.

I use it form two adult bikes and two kids bikes without problem.  I haven't yet traveled very far with this rack, until summer, and I'm quite cautious when I have bikes in the back of my van.  I haven't test it out by driving wildly.  So far it's hanging on very well.

For family vacation and recreation use, I this rack is quite antiquate and I recommend it.
profile.summary: Strong and Sturdy Rack

top_5.description: Max out your workout with your phone strapped to your arm to track every step and log every mile. Attach the flexible Armband to your arm and count on it to stay put through the toughest workout. Its sweat and water-resistant and when used with an OtterBox case, delivers added protection from the rough stuff. Stay active with the OtterBox Armband.
top_5.reviewText:
This OtterBox UNIVERSAL ARMBAND for 4"-5" Smartphones is very soft, unlike the usual tough and sturdy OtterBox cases I have used, but it keeps the phone securely on your arm.  It also has a little pocket area for you to stick a credit card or a few dollars behind the phone.

The only issue is it covers the light sensor of the Samsung Galaxy 6s Edge, so the screen is off when you have it on your arm. You have to lift the edge to reach the fingerprint sensor.  But, it's not a big deal, since I can control the music using the BlueTooth headphones.  In general, the quality of this armband case is much better than I expected.

I recommend it.
top_5.summary: Great Quality, Soft, and Secure

top_5.description: You dont have time to precision pack your briefcase. So, pack along the sleep, slim Commuter Series case - easily fits any crevice in your bag. Featuring a tough two-layer construction, Commuter Series helps keep your phone safe from drops, bumps and life on the go. Plus port plugs stop dust from entering jacks and inputs, so your phone stays clean.
top_5.reviewText:
I couldn't find a good case for Moto Z Play, but after hearing that Z Play has nearly exact dimension as Z Force I took a plunge.  To my pleasant surprise it fit perfectly, of course with the exception of the lack of the headphone jack hole, which I don't use anyway.

As always OtterBox provides the strongest protection for my phones. I have tried many brands over the years and always come back to OtterBox for maximum protection.  It does add bulk to the phone but it's your choice to decide whether the protection is worth the trade off.  Another trade off is I have Moto Mods.  However, I still want to have this case for traveling, to keep my phone in maximum protection.

I'm also getting one for my wife's Z Play.

I recommend it.
top_5.summary: It also fits Z Play perfectly

top_5.description: Made for all safety trades who appreciate good support, easy comfort and lightweight duty.
top_5.reviewText:
I've three pairs of Stanley steel toe boots (Exploit, Outback, and Striker) before this pair, and they are all with high shafts.  As summer comes, I don't feel comfortable wearing high shaft boots, and Dredge comes to the rescue because it has low shaft and nylon ventilators on both sides.

The shafts are just high enough to protect my ankles.  This model is also cheaper comparing to the other three, but the quality and appearance is not compromised.

These shoes are very comfortable.  The non-slippery soles keep me sure footed.  I also wear them during yard work--lawn mowing, gardening, etc. to protect my feet.  I can wear them all day without discomfort.  It's also easy to take off and put on.

The only awkward part is the two pull straps on each shoe with Stanley brand printed on them in yellow.  They are thin and the added yellow color makes them look cheap.  It would have been very nice to come with leather straps.  However, in most situation, these straps are covered by your pants.

Another awkward thing is that if you walk on smooth surface, a polished tile floor, it makes a loud squeaky noise with every step you take. A little embarrassing if there are pretty ladies around. Well, these are just work boots, so no point deducted.

For those who need comfortable low shaft steel boots, I recommend these.
top_5.summary: My Summer Steel Toe Boots

top_5.description: The Buckshot Pro, 3-in-1, All Grown Up Bluetooth Speaker, Power Bank and Flash Light!
top_5.reviewText:
I like this versatile speaker, flash light, and charger unit.  First of all, it's a great speaker.  Very easy to pair.  I like the voice announcement when pairing, "Connected!"  That eliminate confusion as to whether the devices are pair or not.  The the pairing is very fast.

The sound is great for the size of the speaker.  You just need to make sure that the speaker side, not the usb charger side is at the top to get the best sound. The water resistance feature is great to have, especially if you like to use it on the bike.  I wish it include a mic so that it can be totally hands free.

The flash light is not the spotlight type.  It is better used to read books because the light spreads out.

The charging feature is a plus for emergency power.

top_5.description: The Case Logic huxton day Pack is a large volume day Pack with leathered fabric is perfect for transporting and protecting your laptop and other essentials
top_5.reviewText:
The texture of the external material is quite beautiful.  You cannot see it on the picture but when you see it closer personally, touch it, and feel it, you'll love it.  Good quality workmanship is apparent both inside and out.

My 15" Lenovo ThinkPad Yoga fits perfectly in the well padded computer compartment. It also has a side zipped pocket on the outer section good for quick access for your phone.  The rest is for books, clothing, or whatever you need to put.

I wish it's a little bigger (thicker) to provide more room.  But at the current thickness, it seems to keep a good slim shape on your back.  I like the size and shape for the look, but I'd also like to have more room for practicality.

I recommend it!

input: Generate the review text written by a reviewer who has a given an overall rating of "3.0" for a product with description "This 3 port HDMI switch (a.k.a switcher or selector) receives signals from up to 3 HD sources, and outputs to an HDTV/monitor. You can connect up to 3 HD sources to this switch at the same time, such as your: a) Blu-Ray or HD-DVD playerb) PS3, Xbox360c) Computers with HDMI output) HD video cameras) HDTV boxes (DVR, PVR) The switcher then connects to your HDTV/monitor, occupying only 1 HDMI connector. Best for HDTVs/monitors with only 1 or 2 HDMI connectors left, yet still many HD sources to be plugged in. HDMI Switching Features:1) Connect up to 3 HDMI devices to 1 HDMI port on your HDTV / monitor;2) Auto-switch to the device that is powered on first;3) Avoid frequent plugging and unplugging of HDMI cables;4) Video support: 1080p FullHD, 1080i/720p, with 12-bit deep color, retaining crispy clear images;5) Audio support: DTS/DTS-HD, Dolby Digital / Dolby TrueHD, and Linear PCM (LPCM);6) Support all 3D Blu-Rays, TV programs and games: anaglyph (2 colors) and Multiview Video Coding (MVC);7) No downsizing nor conversion, no compromise in quality;8) HDMI 1.3b compliant, HDCP v1.0/1.1 pass-through; Specifications: a) Video: 1920 x 1200, FullHD, 1080p/i, 720p/i, 576p/i, 480p/i; b) Audio: LPCM, DTS/DTS-HD, Dolby Digital (AC-3)/Dolby TrueHD;c) 3D Support: Yes, fully;d) HDMI Compliance: HDMI v1.3b, HDCP v1.0/1.1 pass-through) HDMI Connector: Type-A 19pin Female;f) No. of HDMI Input: 3;g) No. of HDMI output: 1;h) External Power Supply: Not needed.". The summary of the review text is "HDMI Switch, supports 3D use.".
output:
Gotta admit I was skeptical based on the price, but it does work. I plugged in my WD media player and my Fujifilm 3D camera into the switch and it changes the inputs without any problems, although it takes time to see which one is active and make the switch. It is powered by one of the HDMI devices.

There is a hugely bright blue LED on the front to let you know it has been powered by one of the HDMI devices. This LED is bright enough to read the newspaper at five feet away in another wise dark room. I have no idea why the manufacturer decided it needed an LED bright enough to be seen from thousands of feet away. I'm going to place a piece of electrical tape over mine soon.

So it just works. Oh yes, this HDMI switch is tiny. Stiff HDMI cables make placing this somewhere hidden almost impossible.

profile.description: Moonrise Kingdom is the new movie directed by two-time Academy Award-nominated filmmaker Wes Anderson (The Royal Tenenbaums, Fantastic Mr. Fox, Rushmore). Set on an island off the coast of New England in the summer of 1965, Moonrise Kingdom tells the story of two 12-year-olds who fall in love, make a secret pact, and run away together into the wilderness. As various authorities try to hunt them down, a violent storm is brewing off-shore  and the peaceful island community is turned upside down in every which way. Bruce Willis plays the local sheriff, Captain Sharp. Edward Norton is a Khaki Scout troop leader, Scout Master Ward. Bill Murray and Frances McDormand portray the young girls parents, Mr. and Mrs. Bishop. The cast also includes Tilda Swinton, Jason Schwartzman, and Bob Balaban; and introduces Jared Gilman and Kara Hayward as Sam and Suzy, the boy and girl.
profile.reviewText:
The story of two young teens running away from life and drawing together in a puppy love type affair. One runs away from family, the other from a scouting encampment. Top notch cast, script, and acting. Very artistic camera work with tremendous attention paid to every detail in every shot, even the stuff in the background. The film is highly yellow tinted for emotional effect. Probably not suited for viewing by pre-teens for promoting running away, dancing in public in underwear, and lots of smoking.
This film would have been much better without the constant smoking promotions as product placement through out the entire film. Perhaps a good idea to teach your kids how product placements in movies work so they can grow up to be aware of them. I think this was one of the best movies of 2012.
profile.summary: Top notch movie for 2012, not suitable for young kids

profile.description: SPARC HD Radio SHD-TX2 Portable Radio with AM/FM & HD Radio Tuners, Built-in Speaker and Emergency Alerts - VOICE PROMPTS FOR THE VISUALLY IMPAIRED - Incorporates HD Radio Technology - Emergency Alerts, delivers critical public messaging - Passive radiator technology for superb sound - English, Spanish and Portuguese Language Support - International tuning support - Daylight readable display, ideal for outdoor use - 20 Programmable Presets - Headphone Output - 3xAA Batteries (Not Included) - AC Adaptor 110/220V (INCLUDED) - No Subscription Required. Not broadcasting in all areas.
profile.reviewText:
AM FM battery powered radio, runs on 3 AA cells. Receives regular old AM and FM analog, analog FM stereo, appears to also receive analog AM stereo. Also receives AM and FM HD (hybrid digital) radio. Reception is decent on both FM and AM. I own a first generation radio shack HD table radio, this radio outperforms it easily on receive sensitivity.
Non-dimmable display shows frequency, battery, signal strength, and any scrolling text from the station. All controls are push buttons, there are no knobs to turn. The telescoping rod antenna only swings side to side, not front to back. The radio is smaller than it appears in the photo here on amazon. It's case shape makes it prone to falling over, it does not want to stand upright, but can on a flat surface, but the case is rounded, standing upright is difficult. There are inputs for headphones and power supply (included).
Sound quality is decent for the size of the speaker. The AM receiver is not as good as an Amax standard AM radio but it does receive CQUAM AM stereo. The radio does not reject adjacent channel noise very well, the AM design is below average but they intended that you would be listening to digital AM radio (which seems to be partially abandonded by many stations).
This radio easily stores pre-sets on both AM and FM, then use the side to side buttons to step through them in order. Press power briefly to switch between AM and FM.
One thing you should know about HD Radio, it was intended to allow radio stations to place ads on the screen of your radio, in addition to one or two additional digital channels. There is also the capability for radio stations to change which stations you have memorized in your receiver. I  do not know if this receiver supports those features, nor do I know if those are still being done in some US cities.
All in all, this is a decent performing radio, FM is way better than AM. I get most HD stations on FM without even pulling out the rod antenna.
Update: Been using this radio for a while now. I recently went camping in central-southern AZ. I was listening to AM, to 1070khz KNX from Los Angeles. I thought all AM stations running HD radio shut it off at night but my radio went into digital mode a few times listening to this distant station. The point here being, the tech works and the receiver on AM is well designed.
profile.summary: Decent performing HD receiver for AM and FM.

profile.description: Diners, drive-ins and dives are popular again! Join Guy Fieri as he visits some of these classic ''greasy spoon'' spots, from a shack on the side of the road to a Vegas sports bar with stellar stromboli. ''Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives: The Complete First Season'' lets you travel along with Guy to the unique places he visited during the first season of his hit show. The three-disc set includes all twelve episodes from Season One as well as additional footage from Guy's travels.
profile.reviewText:
I don't have cable-TV, just a TV antenna. I learned about this series from a friend after we talked about a similar set of shows on PBS by Rick Sebak.

I was a tiny bit put off at first by the California looks of the host. I was also on guard because I have seen hosts of similar shows act rude towards people asking embarrassing questions. This guy comes close a couple times but is mostly respectful, rather funny and probably well schooled in the restaurant business.

He travels the USA covering restaurants from hole-in-the-wall places to well established eateries with long standing reputations. The program is mostly filmed inside kitchens and shows little snippets of how the best of them became the best, their magic, and their enthusiasm.

Don't watch this just before heading to the grocery store. But it is great for planning trips to distant places or searching for home cooking ideas. Well worth watching over and over. I didn't give it the highest reviews because the video quality is not very good.
profile.summary: Foodie visits famous restaurants nationwide

profile.description: If you are having cable TV picture problems this may be the product for you. It is NOT compatible with satellite TV, and will actually block satellite reception - so do not order it if you have satellite TV. This product will improve your cable TV picture and reduce pixilation, snow, and audio drop-outs that are caused by a weak signal level. It is compatible with all cable TV systems and services. You may or may not notice a difference in cable modem speed when using the amplifier. A number of factors influence cable modem speed, and there is no guarantee a booster will improve modem performance.   If you are boosting an HDTV antenna signal, you should get the best HD antenna you can afford BEFORE using a booster. This signal amplifier IS NOT a substitute for a good antenna. If you are using an indoor antenna or are having HD reception problems with just a single TV attached to your outdoor antenna, this product will likely not improve your reception.   If you are uncertain if this product will work for you, contact your retailer before purchasing.
profile.reviewText:
This is a basic functioning amplifier for people using a regular TV antenna to receive over-the-air digital TV signals. It features a small white box with 3 connections and a tiny green indicator lamp. Power comes from a "wall wart" style supply that runs warm. You provide the connection to the amplifier module using an ordinary length of 75 ohm coax, like a short coaxial jumper. Then it is inserted in-line between your TV antenna and TV or DVR.

Despite only having 3 connectors, hook-up is not intuitive. Few guys like to read the instructions, with this one you need to. The label on the block features tiny type and may require reading glasses to make-out.

I understand it could also be used with cable tv and can allow passing of return signals, like for a Tivo or PPV box if used with a cable system.

Gain, or signal amplification is not huge. I gained one channel. Prior to buying this I was using part of an indoor RCA digital receiving antenna device, I took that amp and used it first. This block performed a bit worse than that cheapo amp.

In order to use this device you will need to provide a short coaxial jumper to provide power to the amp block. Considering how it performs, I believe this amp is somewhat overpriced. I would put it's value based on performance around $10.
profile.summary: basic TV signal amplifier for TV antenna systems

profile.description: Free yourself with Seagate Wireless mobile storage. Enjoy your media and access your files without wires or the Internet. Seagate Wireless broadcasts its own Wi-Fi network, so you can wirelessly stream your media and files to up to three mobile devices. With 500GB of storage at your fingertips, choosing which files to sync to your mobile device before a long trip is a thing of the past. Seagate Wireless lets you carry hundreds of movies and thousands of photos, songs and documents. Seagate Wireless streams your media and documents to all your popular tablets, smartphones, computers and connected devices. The free Seagate Media app available for iOS, Android tablets and smartphones, Kindle Fire and Windows 8/RT tablets and computers makes it easy to navigate and enjoy content wherever you go. Share your content with everyone on the biggest screen in your house-the TV. The Seagate Media app can cast your content to a Chrome cast, LG Smart TV or a Roku player with ease when on the same network. Are your photos and video eating up all your space? With Seagate Wireless, you can now offload or back up full-resolution pictures and video from your smartphone or tablet using the Seagate Media app. Windows 8 users can access all the content on Seagate Wireless directly from their desktops using the Seagate Media App for a truly wireless drive experience.
profile.reviewText:
The wireless interface is horrible. I've had to re-delete files many times to get them to disappear. Sometimes you can rename files, others not. You change the settings to show directories as a list rather than a collection of large pointless ugly icons, but the moment you do anything, the settings revert back to large icons. Files upload and vanish, then later on triplicates appear.
You cannot rename folders, so your MP3 sound files must be stored as Music.
When you scroll down the alphabet bar to jump into parts of a directory, some letters cannot be selected.
It does not load the entire directory, just a small portion. You must pull up the bar at the bottom to scroll further down the list of files in a given directory.
The response time to various commands is poor.
All in all, the worst part of this wireless storage device is the horrid interface. I have never used any smart phone app to operate this drive, just Mac and Win desktops via wireless and wired. Via wired, many of those problems listed above disappear but the wireless interface is a total failure, very very poorly designed, almost painful to use. Downloading and installing the latest firmware did nothing to improve the wireless interface bugs. I have never before seen such a poorly designed and bug ridden interface.
profile.summary: Great concept, very very poor wireless interface, inconsistent responses, wonky.

profile.description: Watch and record hi-definition ATSC digital TV or cable TV on your PC or laptopWinTV-HVR-850 hybrid TV stick featuresDigital ATSC over-the-air TV tuner built-inAnalog TV features
profile.reviewText:
Been using this for years now on both the Mac OS and Win 7.x and 8.x. There's a world of difference between the software and performance for the two versions. The USB receiver module itself is the same and fully inter-changeable.

The Mac version of WinTV is far far more graphic and user friendly than the PC version. Aside from being slow converting recorded TV shows to mp4, my experience with the Mac would get this device a 4-star rating.

For the PC in 7.x and 8.1 I would rate the performance and software a 2-star rating. The interface locks up easily, slow to respond, just simply quits working, takes a while to change channels, the interface is awkward, counter-intuitive and looks very old. The PC version is unreliable and unstable.  I am currently running it on three machines, two are 8.1 one is 7.x, the performance is the same, poor.

For the Mac this device works very well but slow, otherwise it's fine. I would recommend it for Mac OS but not PC. The software for PC and functions very differently from the mac version.
profile.summary: I own two of these, mac and  win 8.1

profile.description: Garantie L'étroite collaboration entre High-Tech Place et ses fournisseurs nous permet de vous proposer une garantie commerciale de 1 an.
profile.reviewText:
I have the brother model of this player too. The reason I like this more is something I blame Apple for. My biggest complaint with any MP3 player is how much of the display is wasted with album artwork but leaving the text display very tiny, mostly unreadable. I have no interest in seeing album artwork whatsoever, I want to see controls and time displays instead. This is why I like this model over the brother version because it doesnt try to display pictures. Although it could be better. There are actually people like me who are far sighted and cannot see the displays on these devices easily.

8gb isn't enough room for all my music but I don't need to have all that with me all the time either!
