profile.description: Hasbro is a global company committed to Creating the World's Best Play Experiences, by leveraging its beloved brands, including Littlest Pet Shop, Magic: The Gathering, Monopoly, My Little Pony, Nerf, Play-Doh and Transformers and premier partner brands. From toys and games to television programming, motion pictures, digital gaming and a comprehensive lifestyle licensing program, Hasbro fulfills the fundamental need for play and connection for children and families around the world. The Company's Hasbro Studios creates entertainment brand-driven storytelling across mediums, including television, film and more. Through the company's commitment to corporate social responsibility, including philanthropy, Hasbro is helping to build a safe and sustainable world and to positively impact the lives of millions of children and families every year.
profile.reviewText:
My 3-year-old loves this toy, and she loves showing it to our 6-month-old. I like that it appeals to a seemingly broad range ages from infants into toddlerhood and then some. Overall, I think it's a really cute & fun toy. It would make for an excellent gift for the 1-year-old or even maybe for a baby shower.

It's an easy toy to set up and get going, although you will need to purchase your own D batteries, just a heads up. As some other reviewers have pointed out, it is a somewhat noisy toy, but it comes with an off switch so I can't complain. It provides some really good entertainment for the little ones who are endlessly charmed by the popping balls flying and floating around the elephant. It's a pretty unique toy that way, throwing balls into the air.

I'm hoping we don't lose any of the balls, it's not like the elephant works with just any ball, and they can easily run under the sofa and hide for a while, making this toy not as fun. I wish there were settings to make the popping last longer, and your child has to quickly keep replacing the balls to keep them moving. So even though the balls are easy to lose around the house, I wish they'd included more of them.

I keep this toy closeted and pull it out when my girls need a distraction for a little while, it's good for that type of use. And as I said, I think it makes a great gift for a little one. Overall I can recommend it!
profile.summary: Cute, makes a great gift

profile.description: Office 365 comes fully loaded with the latest and greatest versions of Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneNote, Outlook and more, downloaded directly to your favorite devices. You can keep working even if you are not online. All the tools you know and love, now built for even greater productivity and collaboration.
profile.reviewText:
I'm sure this software subscription would be just fine for many folks with basic or temporary needs. However, I fail to see the worth in this subscription for one year, as it works only on ONE PC and a tablet. I honestly haven't used Office in years, as I've enjoyed using the Open Office programs (for free) that work nearly the same as Windows Office.

Despite never having any issues with Open Office, Windows Office seems a bit fickle, running slow at times. I just can't see how this is a good effort or quality software, especially not compared to the easier, cheaper alternatives. However, if you're in need of a temporary, light use of Office software, this might be worth it for you.
profile.summary: I still prefer Open Office...

profile.description: Please Read Notes: Brand New, International Softcover Edition, Printed in black and white pages, minor self wear on the cover or pages, Sale restriction may be printed on the book, but Book name, contents, and author are exactly same as Hardcover Edition. Fast delivery through DHL/FedEx express.
profile.reviewText:
First of all, let me tell you to be VERY CAREFUL of reading reviews here on Amazon in regards to this book. One ill-thinking reviewer posts a major spoiler to this book in the FIRST LINE OF THEIR REVIEW. If you read it, first let me say I'm sorry. What a bad review. Second, I am happy to inform you that it's a serious spoiler, but only the penultimate one. There's an even bigger twist lying in the final chapter. And no, you WON'T guess it. I don't care how good you are at these things (and I'm pretty good, The Girl on the Train was obvious to me from halfway through).

Second, I'm honestly surprised that this book has some 1-star reviews. But I guess all the books honestly have their bad reviews. Trust the good ones when it comes to Behind Her Eyes, that is IF you like an edgy psychological thriller. One professional reviewer compared Behind Her Eyes to something Hitchcock. I'd like to highlight that for you. This book doesn't necessarily go supernatural, I wouldn't say that at all. But there is an edgy psychological thriller part to the plot. That's all I want to say, but I think you should consider if you're going to read this book...you might not like it if you're that person who can't watch/read the Hunger Games without ranting, "That could never happen in real life!" Then this book isn't for you. But Sarah Pinborough spins a deliciously devious web of a plot here, and I THOROUGHLY enjoyed it. But she goes no where as crazy as some of Stephen King's thrillers have. I don't get the "hate" I see on Goodreads about how this one strays a *tad* supernatural. It's the slightest tad, but took away nothing from the thrill for me.

Without spoiling anything, I'll say this: we hear stories about near death experiences ALL the time. The concept is not that out there. It was a creepy ending, in fact, especially reading this as a mother! So the few 1-star reviews that are saying the ending was too out there. I'm sorry, but I'm rolling my eyes. It was SHOCKING, but fantastic. It was the type of ending that makes you want to re-read it right away again because it will read totally different now that you KNOW.

Finally, I actually listened to this book on Audible. I love a British-narrated psychological thriller. This is exactly what I want in an audiobook and now I'm sad because I figure there won't be another quite like it in a while. It usually takes a while. But if you're considering the audiobook, this makes a great listen while on the road or cleaning house. The narrators are WONDERFUL (and I'm VERY picky about my narrators) and it was wonderfully produced.

I rarely recommend books on social media or write such enthusiastic reviews right away, but Behind Her Eyes was one of those rare few books that makes me just HAVE to share it with the world. If you can handle a truly edgy psychological thriller, DO IT! Get this one.
profile.summary: BEWARE other reviews! You don't want to spoil this SHOCKING plot twist ending!!

profile.description: Ice Cream You Scream We all Scream for Ice Cream. Great for parties, summer time fun or any time gifts...Grab a scoop today! Crystal Necklace Product Features Include: * Genuine European Crystals * Layered In 18 Kt. Gold * Adorable "Ice Cream" Keepsake Box. profile.reviewText:
I bought this little necklace for my 4-year-old daughter for her birthday party (which is ice cream themed). Though I wish I could have picked which color we received, when it says "assorted colors" they simply send you one of four colors. There's blue, pink, purple, and green. profile.summary: Very sweet and cute, random color choices though!

profile.description: Six figure set! Includes three SPECIAL EDITION figures. Each figure is approximately 11 1/2" tall. Individual weapons included *Finn, Chewbacca & Poe Dameron *Kylo Ren, First Order Stormtrooper Officer & First Order Tie Fighter Pilot
profile.reviewText:
This product really irritates me. My daughters just discovered Star Wars on their own account, watched the first three movies (Machete style, of course) and are now requesting light sabers for Christmas. Fine by me! As a child of the 80s, I grew up with Star Wars culture too. It's fun, and my kids like it. Specifically, my daughters. My son isn't into it yet.

SO WHERE IS THE FEMALE CHARACTER IN THIS SET??? This is a "The Force Awakens" set, so where is the female lead, Rey?! This set contains TWO generic figurines, including a stupid Storm Trooper that you can get anywhere.

Doggonit this is 2015, HASBRO, and girls have liked Star Wars just as much as boys for the last nearly FOUR DECADES. I'm really frustrated and disappointed because I would LIKE to get my daughters some Star Wars toys for Christmas, but this one is missing a MAJOR character from the new movie and I just can't even with you right now, Hasbro. They also did this with the Avengers set and the Guardians set, no major female characters to be found when it comes to HASBRO.

Get with the times. This set is lame because it is still 100% male and it's no longer 1977.
profile.summary: Six figurines, two generic, and they can't find room for REY!?!?!

profile.description: Keep appetizers chilled during parties with DII's crystal clear acrylic iced appetizer 12 piece set. Food such as fruit, vegetables, sushi, cheeses and dips should be kept cold for the enjoyment of your guest. With this serving tray you can fill the bottom tray with ice and set the four compartments on top to keep food cold, especially if you're hosting an outdoor event. Each container has a tight fitting lid for easy storage of leftovers or to keep pests away while outside. If you are serving chips and dip then the lower tray can be used and you can still place ice in the center for the dip to easily rest on while the other containers can be used separately. Perfect for Holiday parties, BBQ's, potlucks, weddings and so much more, easily blending in with any tabletop setting with the simple, clean design. DII's iced appetizer set is 16.5x4.5", includes: 1 lower serving tray, 4 food trays, 1 dip bowl, 1 dip bowl riser and 5 lids. Serving set is dishwasher safe, top rack only, BPA-free and 100% durable food-grade acrylic.
profile.reviewText:
I wasn't expecting much when I ordered this, so I was very pleasantly surprised when it arrived and I took a closer look, how nice it is! This tray serving set is very versatile, portable, and quite handy! It is also sturdier than I expected. This isn't the same as the thin acrylic trays and serveware you might pick up at a party store for a one-time use sort of thing.

I can see myself using this over and over, especially as I love to host parties and bring yummy treats to church functions and BBQs and things. I'm so glad I ordered this set! It arrived nicely boxed, has an ice tray, lids, dip container. The whole deal! Definitely recommended.
profile.summary: So handy, I'll use it over and over!

profile.description: This collection is minimally constructed with the thinnest yarns to help shape without bulk. Delivers the perfect compliment to a woman's everyday wardrobe.
profile.reviewText:
This is my new FAVORITE shapewear product! It should be noted, I'm a stay at home mom and thus most days I'm in yoga pants and run errands in the most casual clothes. I like to be comfortable more than anything else. But I've also had THREE c-sections, which are known for causing a slacking "fat apron" in the front due to such loss of muscle tone and control after surgeries.

This shapewear is not the type I'd wear for a night out or a Christmas party. This is the shapewear I'd wear daily just to be comfortable and to keep my jiggle under control in the front. These are SUPER sleek and very breathable. They are thing and lightweight. My favorite part? They slide on nicely and aren't caught by any dry skin on your feet (so many shapewear items do that!). They slip right on and provide SOME, not super, but some control while being just SO comfortable. The price is also just right. I'd definitely recommend these in a heartbeat. I'll probably be buying more in different colors.
profile.summary: The BEST! Sleek, breezy, casual, & COMFY!

profile.description: NaturVet GrassSaver Soft Chews Plus Enzymes Helps Rid Your Lawn of Yellow Spots. Contains Healthy Ingredients to Help Diminish Yellow Spots When Fed to Your Dog on A Daily Basis. Unique Formula with a Synergistic Combination of B-Complex Vitamins, Amino Acids and Added Enzymes. Also Contains Yucca to Help Reduce Stool Odor. Tasty Soft Chews 120ct for Dogs Only, Do Not Give to Cats. Instructions: Water Yellow Spots Heavily for Two Weeks. After Feeding GrassSaver for Two Weeks, Reseed all Yellow Spots. Guaranteed Analysis per Soft Chew: Moisture, dl-Methionine, Alpha-Amylase, Lipase, Cellulase, Protease and Bacillus coagulans. All NaturVet Products are Veterinarian Formulated and Manufactured in the USA in an FDA Audited, cGMP Compliant Facility with a 100% Satisfaction Guarantee.
profile.reviewText:
After several weeks, we can finally see the result and the yellow spots (in our BRAND NEW SOD, thanks dog!) are finally clearing up. That said, she ate them suspiciously the first couple times, but then she rejected them after that. We started wrapping them in a slice of lunch meat and voila! That finally did the trick to get her to take it. My dog is a fussy eater, though, so it might be more her than the treat itself.

My best advice is to give this time to work and prove itself. I'm sure it works right away, but it takes so long for the grass to regrow that it might FEEL like it's not working. Our dog is small, maybe 30 lbs, and we give it to her once a day.
profile.summary: Give it time...it works...fussy dogs might not like the taste?

profile.description: Our elegant crib shoes are handmade from the softest mercerized cotton and feature a delightful satin ribbon bow fasten. A perfect gift for that special occasion. 100% Mercerized Cotton. Hand Wash. Imported.
profile.reviewText:
We just had my son baptized at just 5 weeks old last weekend and I purchased these booties to match his heirloom outfit.

I could not have been happier with these booties! I ordered the pearl and the ribbon was just the right off-white color to match his vintage baptism outfit. The quality of the stitches are wonderful--and I say this as a crochet hobbyist myself. The ribbons come undone and re-tie which made it really easy to tighten them a tad so that they did not fall of the tiny baby feet.

I think they're the most beautiful things I've ever ordered off of Amazon and I will keep them in his baby memento box from now on. I was surprised at the few reviews here that said these didn't fit their older, bigger babies. It was obvious to me when I was ordering them that these are meant for newborns, and they fit my average (8 lbs) 5 week old's feet just perfectly. If you have any other questions that I didn't answer, feel free to leave a comment and I'll do my best to reply.

I would definitely recommend these! They make a sweet gift or addition to any baptism/christening outfit. They looked beautiful in pictures, they came nicely packaged, and they were just what I wanted.
profile.summary: Sweet and PERFECT for a newborn!

profile.description: Scotts EZ Seed Dog Spot Repair Tall Fescue: Neutralizes and repairs even the most damaged pet sports & Specially designed for repairing the lawn damaged by a dog
profile.reviewText:
We have a dog who does pee in the yard, but she's a smaller dog and so we haven't noticed the need for spot repair due to her pee spots. That said, we also have backyard chickens who we've let out over the last summer to "free-range" in the yard. Thus the area around our chicken coup was in dire need of a re-seeding, and so we used this Scotts Spot Repair around that area and kept the chickens in their run over the last few weeks to allow the grass seed to take. I tried to find a urine spot to use this on, but that was in vain, so I can't comment on whether it works well on heavily urinated spots--sorry.

I must say that it's finally coming in nicely and is starting to blend in with the rest of the grass in our backyard. We did work up the soil a bit before using this seed, especially as our old lawn is very compacted and here in Colorado we tend to have dry, clay soil. So far I'm pleased with the results, and if that changes I'll update soon...
profile.summary: Filling in our chicken's coop lawn nicely!

profile.description: The Body Silk Seamless Nursing Bra provides you with a luxuriously comfortable seamless experience. It is a great maternity and nursing bra choice for every day, at-home, on-the-go or simply anytime. The super soft fabric molds to your changing shape, so that you can wear it from maternity to nursing and beyond. All Bravado Designs nursing bras have our proprietary, easy open and close, one-handed bravado designs 'B' nursing clips. In addition, the full drop-away cup design allows for maximum skin-to-skin contact. A bra conversion kit is included so you can convert your nursing bra to a 'regular bra' once your nursing journey is complete. All Bravado Designs styles are tested and certified in accordance with Standard 100 by Oeko-Tex requirements, which ensures products are free from harmful substances.
profile.reviewText:
I'm hugely pleased with this bra, so much so that I ordered more once I'd had the chance to try the first one out.

The fabric is soft and so comfortable, yet thick and durable. There are extra pads you can insert into the bra for added coverage but I find them unnecessary even when wearing thick breast pads. The snaps that allow the breast panels to lower for feeding have held up wonderfully, even though at first I was worried they would break. I think their design is perfect, making it quick and easy to get started during a feeding. The strap stays in place even when the breast panels are lowered which is a nice touch, I've had other nursing bras that just allow the strap to fall back behind you where it's hard and awkward to reach - this is especially important when you're breastfeeding in public.

I am more busty than most women yet I find this bra provides great support, especially considering it does not have underwire. It is still comfortable enough to wear even when lounging or even sleeping.

I prefer the butterscotch color as it does not show up under light colored tops.

Very happy I found this nursing bra! I definitely recommend to nursing mothers who prefer comfort but need support.
profile.summary: Great comfort, great quality

profile.description: Strada Series Folio for Galaxy S9+ is the only leather smartphone case backed with OtterBox Certified Drop+ Protection. Featuring a folio cover, Strada Series Folio closes securely around your device, and opens to reveal a convenient slot for a bank or ID card. And on the inside, it cradles your device to help protect it from drops and shock.
profile.reviewText:
For years, I have never understood why people have the flip cover cases until today. I recently upgraded my phone case from an Otterbox Symmetry case (which is excellent by the way) to the new Strada series case from Otterbox. Let me tell you, this is a nice case. It features all the drop protection that Otterbox is known for (on a side note, I have never had my phone damaged from a drop while inside an Otterbox case), while being able to cover your screen and hold some credit cards. That last part is key, I can fit my ID, and a couple credit cards inside my phone case. Now I don't need to carry around my wallet any longer.

The case has a nice premium feel to it, has a magnetic clasp to keep the cover closed and has button impressions on the outside of it so I can still press the volume buttons when the cover is closed.

If you are looking for a case with a cover, look no further. The Otterbox Strada series is the one for you.
profile.summary: No more need to carry a wallet with me

profile.description: Commuter Series is the compact case that keeps your phone safe while you live life on the go. Its two tough layers come together to protect your Galaxy S9+ against drops, bumps, dust and fumbles. Slip Commuter Series into your pocket and never miss a call, tweet or text.
profile.reviewText:
This phone case arrived as expected, in an OtterBox package, colors as described and looks just like the photo. The fit is extremely tight! This is the first time I have ever struggled a bit getting a phone case on. The lip of the edges wanted to fold in a bit and I had to work the edges a bit to lay flat and properly. It has a bulkier feel than my previous, clear phone case. But I suppose you get used to that. The buttons are nice and responsive. There is a cover for the charging port and the headphone plugin...not sure I like that. But it does protect it from debris much better than being open. I see the point, just not as much of a fan.

This case seems to do a better job of protecting those curved edges on the sides of the Galaxy S9+. Those are definitely the most vulnerable parts of your screen if dropped. The case edges don't completely cover the curves, but it's better protection than my previous case for sure. I don't have any real complaints about this case, if you're a fan of OtterBox and like the look, I can't not recommend it. Due to the bulk and the covered ports, it's not my absolute favorite, but it's definitely good quality, typical of OtterBox.
profile.summary: Typical OtterBox quality, not sure about covered ports...

profile.description: Georgie Beauty The Ultimate Lash Curler. With the added benefit of cushiony conditioning pads that soothe your lashes, the Georgie Lash Curler gently curls even the tiniest lashes without crimping or pinching. Those little green pads are loaded with USDA-certified organic blue chamomile. Just like conditioner for your hair, our exclusive conditioning pads are designed to keep your lashes healthy while creating lasting curl.
profile.reviewText:
Lash curler? Sure. Ultimate? Eh. I can't see what would set this lash curler above the rest. Oh, don't get me wrong it's definitely better than the cheap one I got out of desperation once at a cheap chain store for a few bucks. That lash curler was truly worthless. However, I've used a variety of other lash curlers from the beauty store over the years and most of them work just as well as this one.

Comparing this one to my Emite lash curler that came recently in an Ipsy bag, I actually think the Emite one curled a bit better and also felt less wobbly because the handles are wider. That said, this Georgie curler was almost just as good and cost a few dollars less. It does come in a nice box for packaging and they include a few extra cushions--which are nice as they can get worn out or fall off after much use.

All that said, there is nothing "ultimate" about this lash curler, I'd say it's quite average and does it's job fine but it is not THE ultimate lash curler,no.
profile.summary: Works fine, "Ultimate" is a stretch, and compared to the Emite curler...

profile.description: The Disney film Frozen introduces a cast of characters who tell a story of epic adventure and nonstop magic! Join sisters Anna and Elsa along with Olaf the snowman for an enchanting bike ride on their new tandem bicycle! Featuring 2 seats, 2 sets of pedals and 2 sets of handlebars, Anna and Elsa can ride in unison. Olaf enjoys the view from inside the basket at the front of the bike. Press the button on the basket and the hit song from the movie "Do You Want To Build A Snowman?" will play! The center hub of the bicycle adds an element of icy cool as it's shaped like a decorative snowflake! These princesses and their silly snowman are ready to pedal to their next adventure! This dynamic toy encourages friendship, adventure, and sisterly love, all themes from the hit Disney film Frozen. Includes Tandem Bicycle with Anna doll, Elsa doll and Olaf figure.
profile.reviewText:
This set is a sweet one! It's not our first Frozen doll, but this one is the favorite, I think. One major plus for moms and dads--it comes out of the box fairly easily! Just a scissors handy to unsnap some rubber bands holding the toys in position (I mean, any seasoned parent who's had to wake up to new toys first thing on Christmas morning knows what I'm talking about). There is some very minor assembly, in that you have to snap two of the bike pedals on as well as the kickstand, but once that's done you're good to go! The way these sisters pedal in sync is absolutely adorable.

Olaf rides happily in the basket to be attached at the front of the tandem bike too. He's very cute and a button on his basket provides a little musical feature straight from the feature film. Anna and Elsa have loosey goosey joints in their legs, perfect for bike riding, not necessarily so much for dancing with Hans or Kristoff or each other, but that's okay. The tandem bike is adorable and well created. It has doll holders to keep Anna and Elsa in place, the kickstand is a good solution that makes the bike either ride or stand, and it has a real rubber "chain" that circulates.

Anna and Elsa come with painted bodices  and real fabric skirts. Their shoes snap into the pedals, so this is one doll you will hand to keep shoes on. Their crowns are banded in place, but like most modern princess dolls they can be removed, once removed they don't stay on easily again.

Overall I think this is a lovely toy and the perfect present for the Frozen-loving child. Very cute! My 4-year-old adores it, her eyes lit up when she saw the package.
profile.summary: A sweet set of sisters!

profile.description: Don't get caught in the cold! Maxic's high quality car jump starter and mobile electronics power bank battery charger will take care of all your emergency charging needs.
profile.reviewText: This is a fantastic product! Where to start with this review. First off, it is extremely portable, tucking nicely into a compact case that can easily fit in any car or backpack.  The whole package fits in my glove compartment in a clean and sturdy carrying case. The product is obviously well designed, it is a very versatile product. Not only can you use it to jump start your car, but you can also use it to charge any USB device (think cell phone) and it also has a convenient flashlight attached. Finally, it is so high-tech, it tells you whether or not you have it hooked up properly to the car and when you should try to start the vehicle. Great Job Maxic, keep up the good work. I'm so grateful to have a product like this to store in my car, and the peace of mind it offers is priceless.
profile.summary: Peace of mind! Great design!

profile.description: Welcome to the Fisher-Price Little People Surprise & Sounds Home. Its one busy, happy home  and it's filled from floor to ceiling with great learning & fine motor activities for your toddler! The day starts when you press the alarm clock to flip Emma out of bed and hear fun sounds like Rrring! and Time to get out of bed, sleepyhead! Slide the bluebird to see the kitty pop up in the window on one side  and what the weathers like on the other. Lift the toilet lid to hear it flush (whoosh!) & activate other silly sounds & phrases. Open the oven & refrigerator doors  see the lights go on & hear fun phrases. Press the music player for 4 fun songs  feel free to dance along! And when its time for bed, put Mom, Dad and Emma in their beds, close up the house (everything stores inside) and say goodnight until next time. With the Fisher-Price Little People Surprise & Sounds Home, you can bring all the fun, sounds and joy of a real home right to your house. Or grab the handle and take it with you on the go-go-go.
profile.reviewText:
This little dollhouse is a perfect starter set for toddler! It's a cute white house with a pink roof, a handle, and just the right amount of accessories. It comes in a big box, all open and displayed, making it a nice presentation if this is to be a gift. Upon unpackaging the dollhouse, you do have to assemble it together at the hinge, placing two long screws into the hinge to keep the two sides together. That's it, and you're ready to play!

I love that there is so much detail, yet so few pieces to get lost. Experienced parents *hate* toys that come with millions of tiny pieces to be lost...and found by the vacuum. But those little details are what makes toys so fun to play with when you're a kid! Fisher-Price takes care of this conundrum by adding lots of details that *aren't* in the form of little pieces. For example, the dinner table has plates, food, drinks, napkins, and placemats all molded onto the table. Mom has a mom haircut and a cup in her hand, which is awkward for trying to put her in the dollhouse bed, but more realistic because most moms really never sleep. They make it look like a generic coffee cup...but let's be honest, there's probably some wine in there.

Throughout the house are similar details: books on nightstands, comb on sink, eggs on counter, notes on fridge, cookies in the oven--but without all the freely moving little pieces! Good design, especially for little ones.

There's lots of cute toddler-pleasing actions around the house. Push the alarm clock to make the Little People pop out of bed. A bird at the front of the house switches back and forth to chance window scenes. The oven opens, lights up, and chatters about how good the food smells. The toilet flushes when the lid closes, the radio on the kitchen counter plays music when pressed.

The set is simple in that it comes with three blue chairs, a green dining table, and three characters--mom, dad, and daughter--which all settles in nicely inside the house which snaps closed. It's a cute, simple toy with lots of thought and details put into it. Makes a fantastic gift for a child ages 1 through about 5. You can certainly get more mature doll houses as they grow up, this is the perfect starter set. A good one from Fisher-Price.
profile.summary: Tons of details, but with out all the lost pieces!

profile.description: Comes with a built in kickstand that is perfect for hands free use of your phone.
profile.reviewText:
The best part about Caseology phone cases is that they never discolor and stain like all the other similar versions I've had! My mother has the same phone case that I used to have on my old Galaxy phone, and it started out the same "mint" color as this Caseology brand. After a few months of use, however, the color is completely TARNISHED with oil and dirt. I'm not sure what makes the Caseology brand plastic different, but it is clearly superior quality because it has never discolored on me. (And I've had more than one Caseology for more than just one phone.)

Aside from that, the price is good, the customer service is excellent, the products come beautifully packaged and their shipping is swift. This is one company that knows how to do it right.

Case fits my LG G3 *perfectly*.
profile.summary: Caseology never stains or discolors like other brands!

profile.description: ALEX Discover Ready, Set, Cut! teaches kids to use scissors! Follow and cut along the dotted line with the easy squeeze scissors. Make fun crafts, learn how to cut circles, spirals, strips and more. Great for young children beginning to craft. Each of the 8 projects comes conveniently individually packaged, so you're ready to begin when you open the kit! Includes easy squeeze scissors, glue stick (1.4oz.), 303 stickers, 11 cutting activity sheets, 1 activity sheet, 1 practice sheet and picture instructions. Recommended for children 4 years of age and older.
profile.reviewText:
This was my first experience with Alex brand craft sets; I have to say, I'm impressed and will be looking into buying more. This set is a great price point and includes hours of fun inside, as well as some learning when it comes to using scissors. My children, ages 5 and *almost* 3, had a blast when we opened up their Ready, Set, Cut! boxes that Santa brought.

We homeschool, so teaching kids to use scissors falls 100% on me, and I consider this craft set to be both fun and very educational for little ones. There are 8 different cutting crafts packed inside, as well as a practice sheet for cutting techniques (i.e. a circle to cut, a square, wavy lines, etc.) and a bright, colorful picture-instructions sheet that shows how you can make all 8 crafts. Each craft is individually wrapped--making this kit the sort of thing you can spend a whole rainy day on OR spread the projects out over time and do a craft every week or so--with cutting sheets and stickers inside each bag. The kit is very organized, in this way.

Of course, also included is a pair of safety scissors and a glue stick. The glue stick is nice and big, the glue goes on bright purple and dries clear rather quickly. The scissors are true safety scissors: there is no metal blade, and they won't cut hair (I tried). The blades are plastic and not even really sharp. They are tightly assembled to help them cut, though I noticed after 2-3 crafts that both of my girls' scissors were dulling and becoming looser. Suddenly they were having a harder time cutting. That said, I LOVED the special little spring attached that pushes the scissors back open after cutting down--what a brilliant idea! My little ones got the concept of cutting much faster because of this design, I think, and it made little hands cutting paper just that much more easy. Since we homeschool and will get a lot of use out of safety scissors, I went looking for a safety scissors with both a metal blade AND the special spring that helps little ones cut. Here on Amazon I found the "Westcott Preschool Training Scissors", so I think I'll be ordering those.

Scissors aside, this inexpensive craft kit makes for a fantastic gift and hours of fun. I can't recommend it enough. Even my almost-three-year-old loved it and she was a little young to be learning cutting. I helped her by holding her hands hand cutting with her, I can tell she's catching on. The crafts are all so cute and original--a princess crown, a monster mask, a snake to cut out and decorate--I think this kit is wonderful and I definitely recommend it!
profile.summary: This kit explained...such fun, great gift!

profile.description: Get ready to discover a world of surprises with this Furby Connect friend and the Furby Connect World app (see app details below). This Furby Connect friend has a light-up antenna that glows when there's something new to discover in the app -- including music and videos! This Furby Connect friend has lots to say! Even when Furby speaks in Furbish, it's not hard to figure out what Furby means. This Furby Connect friend has colorful eyes that display more than 150 animations to help express what Furby wants. Interact with a Furby Connect friend by petting, tickling, or shaking Furby, turning Furby upside down, or even moving its antenna like a joystick -- then see how Furby reacts! When this Furby Connect friend syncs with the Furby Connect World app, there are more physical and digital ways to interact and more surprises to discover. Does Furby need some beauty sleep? This Furby Connect friend comes with a sleep mask. Just put the sleep mask on, and it's good night Furby! To wake Furby up, remove the sleep mask -- Furby will be bright-eyed and bushy-tailed for more fun! Get the Furby Connect World app to explore a world of surprises with a Furby Connect friend. Watch videos together, feed Furby with the app, and raise virtual Furblings in the app. The Furby Connect friend gets updates and new content by connecting to the app! Furby and all related properties are trademarks of Hasbro.
profile.reviewText:
I had my first Furbish experience in 1999 when I was on vacation in London. We were at a touristy gift shop and I had birthday money to spend, and I saw Furbies for sale. Of course he came home to the States with me, thus beginning what would turn out to be a long life with Furbies. Now an adult, married, with three kids, I get to enjoy the happiness brought forth by these animatronic little things through the eyes of my children. So I had an original 1999 Furby, and my kids have had the 2013 Furbies, Furby Booms, Furblings, (...I might have bought a new-in-box original Gizmo Furby of the Gremlins variety on eBay...) and now THIS: Furby Connect.

Furby Connect is THE ultimate Furby. It is 2016, this is what Furbies now look like. Unlike the 2013 and Boom varieties, the new Furby doesn't change personalities every so often. This is a relief, after Christmas 2015 was ruined by my daughter's Furby brought by Santa (via Amazon) when it turned evil after 2 minutes and wouldn't change back and my 4 year old spent the entire day with a complex about how the Furby didn't like her, while her siblings Furby's remained nice and sweet. Every time we'd reset, it would quickly revert to the MEAN Furby. Add to this the fact that it was my middle child's Furby...the child who already feels left out. Now, her Furby hates her. Great. Santa sent an apology letter for the defective Furby and we ordered a replacement Furby Boom. After reading reviews of the specific Furby sent to her, it seems he had come from an entire batch of angry Furbies. All that to say: Hasbro has ditched the multiple personality disorder feature, and now Furby just has one cute personality that won't mess with your kid's impressionable self-image.

Furby Connect is a delight. Just beware that they have somewhat immature senses of humor. Hope you like burp and fart jokes. In fact, I was just pranked a few minutes ago by this little guy when he said, "Squeeze me and I'll sing for you!" They're adorable when they sing, especially in groups! So I enthusiastically squeezed him only to be rewarded with a fart song instead. Ha. They also say quirky, silly things like, "Yeah that's cool...you know what else is cool? GYMNASTICS!" And "Smell kafee???" to which the other Furby (yes, we have TWO Furby Connects) replied, "Uh, hold that thought!" *FARTS*

This is also the first Furby to have colored animated eyes. This allows Furby to have a lot more communication skills and fun. When you feed him, donuts and pizzas bounce across the eyes. He is very expressive. The feet are now plastic, previous models have always had fabric sewn feet, which get dirty quickly. The ears are all plastic loops now and larger than ever. Furby employs his ears when dancing--and again, when you get two or more Furby Connects together they sing in unison, even harmonizing, and their ears move in sync. My favorite thing with the Furby Connect is to watch them interact with each other. If you have multiple children, for sure get each kid a Furby!

Also new, they come with eye masks which make putting to--AND KEEPING--Furbies asleep easier than ever. They go to sleep quickly with the eye mask and won't wake up even when you bump into them. This gets rid of those awful parenting moments when you finally get the kid to sleep, only to bump into Furby on your way our of the dark room, and suddenly everyone is awake again and you're frantically trying to get the little thing to shut up and resort to shoving into the back of a closet under piles of old clothes.

The most impressive part, however, is the app and Furby's new ability to upload new content to itself. Let's be honest, as cute as all the previous models have been, you can only hear the same Furby phrases so long before you let its batteries run out and "accidentally" keep forgetting new batteries at the store. Furby Connect has an antenna that lights up when there is new content--songs and such--to download. Meaning, Furby will often have something new to say and sing. I think that's brilliant.

The app world that Furby Connect uses is great. Unlike Furby Boom--which we could NEVER get connected--this app connects easily and works seamlessly with Furby. We've had zero problems so far, and our kids (8 and 5) easily navigate. Meanwhile, there don't appear to be any in-app sales or ads. Which is, I think, why this Furby is more expensive than the Boom variety. It comes with a full blown Furby world app, uploading new content, and the best Furby personality--with matching cute eyes--to boot.

It's taken them a long time, since my first Furby in 1999. But I finally feel like they've perfected the little guy. I expect this dude to be a hot Christmas item for 2016.
profile.summary: The ULTIMATE Furby is here! ...and we've been with a lot of Furbies!

It's sort of hard to grip, but more important, the spaces where there are buttons are not merely holes--like with other good cases I've owned. Instead, the button spaces are covered by this case, and so incredibly hard to push. Yes, the buttons are still there even on the case, they didn't forget them all together, but you have to push through the whole thick plastic case in order to trigger the actual button on your cell phone. It's very frustrating. One little design detail fails this case altogether. Too bad.

Luckily, I have another case for this phone which works just fine and has holes for the buttons, instead of buttons...for the buttons. From here on out, I will only buy cases with holes for the buttons, and I recommend you do, too. I can't recommend this product for this reason. The power button is the most important of all, you need to be able to use it with ease.

profile.description: Kuhn Rikon Auto Safety Master Opener, Red
profile.reviewText:
I just celebrated my 9 year wedding anniversary and realized the other night, after nearly breaking my wrist trying to open a can of kidney beans, that our can opener was a wedding gift. It's your typical can opener, the basic kind that cuts a jagged lid off, very hard to use--literally the world's worst can opener. I hate it.

It's really stupid that it took me 9 full years of a horrible can opener to finally purchase a GOOD one, but at least when I replaced my evil can opener I picked the WORLD'S BEST can opener! The Kuhn Rikon--a brand I've never heard of--seemed to have the best reviews on Amazon as far as can openers go. When I slammed down my half-opened can of kidney beans with my sprained wrist the other night, I headed straight to my computer and made the most impulsive purchase of my life--within 60 seconds I had ordered this one (after very quickly scanning reviews).

It arrived today and I've opened several cans with it already. Wow! What a difference it is to use something that is not only a total piece of junk, but a genius product!

Let me say, after reading the very few negative reviews, I am absolutely certain that most negative reviewers did not read the directions before trying to use this Kuhn Rikon can opener. This can opener functions a bit differently than any other one I've ever seen, but once you read the instructions thoroughly, it's a dream to use.

It locks on top of the can (not onto the side) after a twist to 3 o'clock clockwise. From there you just make the round once on the can, turning the handle clockwise. Once you get all the way around, you twist the handle COUNTER clockwise just a bit to release the can. From here, it's hard to pry off the lid just with your fingers, but no worries, the Kuhn Rikon has it figured out for you: a little addition to the side (looks like a bird's beak) easily grips the lid and pulls it right off.

You'll have to give it a try to see how clever this can opener is, but what I love so much about it is that:
1. The edges on both the can and the lid are cut smooth, I would let my 4 year old use this can opener. No worries about cuts here! I can now also scrape my silicone spatula in a can without it being sliced up. (Going to be buying a new spatula now too.)
2. The can opener never touches any food, making cross contamination and filthy, rusted can openers a thing of the past.
3. Your fingers also don't have to get messy, touching the lid once detached is never necessary. The Kuhn Rikon does it all for you.

There is also a pointy part at the other end of this tool for opening up ring-top cans with ease, a beer bottle opener, and an opener for twisting lids off small bottles. A multi-tasking tool to be sure.

I wish I had bought this can opener 9 years ago. I can't believe I've spent all this time injuring myself over a stupid can opener when here the Kuhn Rikon cuts my cans open like buttah. Recommended to anyone and everyone. LOVE this product.
profile.summary: I'd give it a hundred stars if I could--best product I've purchased in a while!

profile.reviewText:
What a fantastic idea! Maybe I'm slow to get with the program, but I previously wasn't aware these sort of leaf shredders existed. This electric leaf shredder from Sun Joe was well packaged and easy to set up and use. It's very loud! But it does a good job of making mulch out of the leaves. They are MUCH more useful to us in our garden than trash bags stuffed with dried leaves would ever be.

We have four large trees in our yard and the clean up come autumn is always a handful. We can never keep up with it. But using this leaf shredder with all the leftover leaves in early winter was a dream. Here in Colorado, we're usually very dry with leaves that crunch under your feet. I'm not sure and can't say what it'd be like to use this leaf shredder with wet leaves. I used to live in Washington during college and the leaves never crunched, they were always soggy. I can say, if it works as well with wet leaves, then there is sure to be less dust than what we got.

This shredder also packs away pretty nicely. Which is great since it's a once or twice a year type of thing. We're having a much better time shredding leaves, making mulch to use in our garden! If you're in the market for a leaf shredder, this one comes recommended by me.
profile.summary: I never even knew these existed...

profile.description: Ultimate 11-Cup Pitcher with LED Indicator. Maxion Filter Technology. Clean drinking water is the foundation of good health. With the help of PUR, you can enjoy clean, fresh-tasting drinking water from your tap.
profile.reviewText:
We've been using a Camelbak filtering water pitcher for the last couple years and we've loved it, specifically in that it is a "fast filtering" pitcher. So it was great, no leaving it out on the counter forgetting about it while 1/2 of the water filters through just so you can fill it again. In fact, the Camelbak filled so fast that I could just hold it under the faucet and fill it once, all the way to the top, in one fell swoop.

These PUR and Brita filters seem so much slower. You fill up the reservoir. Wait five minutes. Fill it again. Wait five minutes. THEN you have a filled pitcher. Of course, I've learned, filters get faster as they "break in", but still. Nothing beats the speed of that Camelbak.

So that aside, I'm perfectly satisfied with this slow pitcher in every other way. The electronic filter timer on the top is a nice touch. It works. It produces great tasting water. It's large. It fits in the fridge well. The filters are cheaper to replace than the Camelbak. But they are 1-2 month instead of 4 month...so...break even?

Either way, there's nothing I hate about this filtering pitcher, it's just one of the typical, slower, larger ones. Can't not recommend it, if this PUR brand is your thing. It does the job and does it well.
profile.summary: Slow but mostly satisfying!

profile.description: Get ready to take off and fly in style on the Private Jet. While cruising above the clouds, passengers can relax in the jets spacious seating and let the pilot handle everything from the cockpit. This sleek black and gray aircraft can seat two passengers and their bags, while still having plenty of space to accommodate a table and cup holders. The jets wheels fold up beneath the aircraft for easy takeoff and landing. Set includes three figures, jet, briefcases, and cups, and other accessories. Recommended for ages four to ten. Dimensions: 16. 1 in from nose to tail. Playmobil, Germanys largest toy manufacturer, is headquartered in Zirndorf, Germany and has been producing and distributing toys for more than 36 years. The miniature worlds of Playmobil encourage children to explore and learn while having fun. Children's imaginations are transported to medieval times with the Playmobil castle, to the adventurous seas with Playmobil pirates, and many other themed playworlds. The figures can bend, sit, stand, and turn their heads to make realistic role play possible. Brand Story By
profile.reviewText:
I'm starting to really love Playmobil toys. I remember playing with them when I was a child, here and there at a friend's house. Now that I have a six-year-old, I'm learning once again how great their toys are.

This private jet toy by Playmobil is a lot of fun. My daughter LOVES flying it and playing with the little people. It was very easy to put together. I think older children who also like Legos would love the assembling aspect to the Playmobil toys. Seeing as my kids are 3 and 6, they still need my help to get it done. But assembling this private jet is, literally, a snap.

It was a matter of snapping on the wings, the tail, the wheels, putting the handles on the briefcases, and snapping in the windows. I love the little clear windows on the plane. A lot of kids toys would just leave them open. It feels like a pretty realistic toy! My daughter loves taking it on trips around the house.

This set comes with three little people, a pilot and two passengers. The pilot's hat and the hair of Playmobil characters are often removable and can be switched from person to person. There are little coffee mugs so the business people can sip while they fly, and there are cup holders in the plane. Their breifcases also fit nicely. I do worry about losing such little pieces, but oh well. That happens.

The top of the plane is made to be easily removed by a child. So it stays in place for realistic looking flight, but comes off with little effort in order to play with the inside of the plane. It's a decent sized toy plane, and comes in a large box. We gifted it to my six-year-old for her birthday and she was immediately smitten with it. I also got her some other Playmobil sets, and I love how the sets can be played with together. All the Playmobil people have the same curve to their hands, so the private jet folks can visit the horse ranch and ride the Playmobil horses before asking the horse lady to carry the briefcases onto the plane for them. You know? The more Playmobil sets you own, the more versatile your child's play can become. It's fun!

I'd definitely recommend this toy for a child as a gift or a fun surprise. Children who have parents who travel for work might especially enjoy it. As for us, my children have not yet been on a plane--believe it or not!--so I think they were so excited to get to play with one at home. Great toy, typical Playmobil.
profile.summary: Typical Playmobil perfection, a favorite toy in our house

profile.description: Logitech Harmony Home Hub integrates control of connected lights, locks, blinds, thermostats, sensors, home entertainment devices, and more--turning your smartphone or tablet into a universal home remote.
profile.reviewText:
My husband is in the "smart home" industry and works closely with home automation companies such as Control4, so I am well aware that home automation is nothing new! It's been around for a looong time, actually. What products like this Harmony by Logitech are changing, is they are making this technology affordable for average Joe and not just the Joneses. My husband has designed home automation systems for wealthy people, his biggest one being about $100k for a wealthy client. So THIS price goes to show us: home automation is now affordable. It's a MUCH more simple system, obviously, but the same concept is there: ease and versatility of use throughout the house via remote. Whether you're home or not! You can control your home. Again, the PRICE!

So knowing the types of hundred-grand systems you CAN get out there, I know that this Harmony is very simple. That's good though, for those of us who just want a little something. It's so easy to set up and get going out of the box. It connects to and controls up to 8 devices. You must control the system via smartphone--so keep that in mind. Android or iPhone works. The app is easy to download, works well, and is very simple.

Anyone can learn how to use this simple system. It can connect to your Nest thermostat and smoke alarm, your satellite or cable receivers (given that they're newer models), TVs, surround sound receivers, gaming systems, and is basically like a fancy universal remote control. It does NOT connect to security systems, lighting (with the exception of Philips Hue lights), or other similar systems. You CAN be at the store and think, "Shoot, did I turn off the TV when I left?" and then shut it off with your smartphone, just in case. The Harmony can also use sleep timers, for those of you who like to wind down with the TV in the evening.

As I said, for the price it's a great starter system for the home. It's becoming more simple to control our home these days, and this is one of the first affordable products that pretty much anyone could make use of. We're entering a new era, that's for sure! This Harmony and products like it are sure to be a step along the path of progression as far as home technology goes. If you have any questions I didn't answer, feel free to leave a comment and I'll do my best to answer!
profile.summary: The affordable home automation system has arrived!

Panasonic's ultra-soft, ergonomic earpieces fit naturally into the ear to stay comfortably in place while relaxing, working or travelling. And no matter where you are, they also fit snugly enough to block ambient noise. For precise comfort and fit, a set of S/M/L earpads is included. Drops 360 LUXE also incorporate direct audio ports and high-end OFC (Oxygen Free Copper) audio cords to channel high-quality sound directly into the ears for exceptional listening enjoyment. At the same time managing music and calls is quick and simple with an inline mic and remote. They work seamlessly with iPhone/iPod/iPad, Blackberry and Android devices to adjust volume and let you switch effortlessly from music to calls and back again with one-touch ease. An included travel case keeps your headphones safe and sound when not in use.
profile.reviewText:
These ear bud headphones are big, black, and bulky, but they do produce some quality sound. I'd describe the sound quality as crisp with a good presence. I don't feel the bass is heavy on these headphones at all, which is interesting as they tout them as having powerful bass. They're not weak on the bass, but I wouldn't say these phones stand out in that area either. They are a *tad* tinny, but that can resolve as they break in and I've heard much worse as far as tinniness goes. The sound is honestly some of the best that I've heard out of ear buds. They are pretty good at cancelling outside noise, too. Something I'm not sure ear buds are ever really well known for doing?

That said, these are large ear buds that stick far out my little ears. I prefer this style of ear buds, and I find it helpful to put them in while pulling my ear backward. I definitely had to change to the smaller size tips--which isn't the easiest either, took some work getting them on & off--and these headphones come with three sizes so most users will be good. Like most all ear buds, they are not very comfortable for me. I'm not sure if I have small ears in general, or if it's like wearing high heels--they're supposed to hurt most everyone a bit--but I only use ear buds when I really have to for this reason. The cord is quite thin and not too long. I think the quality is really pretty good, they're just really BIG, so take that into account before ordering.
profile.summary: Good presence & noise cancelling, big though!

profile.description: Mega Bloks Ride On Caterpillar with Excavator
profile.reviewText:
We're fans of Mega Bloks in this house because they are the type of toys that kids don't get sick of after two days and discard to the toy chest for the rest of their lives. Blocks are great toys to have around because you can keep going back to them and doing different things. My girls have tea parties using Mega Bloks, no joke.

This Mega Bloks Caterpillar is adorable, and my 18 month old son loves it. It's a great ride on toy for around the house. They only include 10 building blocks, which at 18 months is actually enough but you really should supplement this toy with more building blocks for kids 2 and up. But kids older than 3 are honestly getting too old for ride-on toys, and are ready for tricycles, so keep in mind this toy has a more narrow age range, in my opinion at least.

The sounds make it even more fun for toddlers, the steering wheels and buttons are a definite hit! If you're looking for a good gift from Santa this Christmas or a fun birthday gift idea, this is a great one! Mega Bloks are well loved in this house.
profile.summary: We love Mega Bloks in this house!

profile.description: “The Eifel Tower” was painted in 1889 by George Seurat in France, and is regarded as a quintessential example of Neo-Impressionist style of painting. Now you can recreate this timeless classic with our Paint by Number series! This kit is perfect for individuals who want to learn the basics of painting and the Neo-Impressionist style. It has all the supplies you need to get started, and it comes with an easy to follow guide. Whether you’re getting this kit for a child interested in taking up the arts or you want to learn something new yourself, our Paint by Number series is ideal for teaching any beginner the basics. Faber-Castell, established in 1761 by the cabinet maker Kaspar Faber, is one of the oldest industrial companies in the world. They’re the world’s leading manufacturer of wood-cased pencils with a varied range of products for writing, drawing, and creative design, as well as decorative cosmetics. Faber-Castell is renowned for its high quality, innovative products, commitment to tradition, and environmental awareness.
profile.reviewText:
I had so much fun doing this little art project! I know it's geared toward kids and younger artists, but for the sake of needing to review this {and being a total art lover myself} I went ahead and spent an evening doing this paint-by-numbers version of Edvard Munch's 'The Scream'.

This kit comes with two brushes, five oil pastels, seven paint pots, a canvas, a practice sheet, and a cardboard easel. I did watch Faber-Castell's short video on this project, but I must say it was minimally helpful. Still, if you read the paint key and study the picture they include, it's easy enough for an adult to do. I wouldn't get this for a younger child under 8.

I started at the top and worked my way down. I did not use the easel they included, although it's a nice touch, I found it easier to hold or lay flat on the table. It was a very fun little evening art project to do! I completed it in under 90 minutes. I could continue to mess with it and perfect some areas, but that's the thing about paintings: you have to stop somewhere. I especially like that this kit has a mix of mediums. The acrylic paints along with the oil pastels give the project more complexity, more variables, and makes it easier to build up texture which is part of the fun for a young artist.

If you're looking for a gift for the young artist, or would like a fun Munch-related project for yourself, I'd definitely recommend this one! I'm even tempted to do more Faber-Castell paint-by-numbers now. I really enjoyed it. Faber-Castell is a well known art brand, I'd love to see more of this sort of stuff from them to inspire young artists.
profile.summary: What a great gift for a young artist or even yourself!

profile.description: Dog waste management has never been easier! Our Grass Wire Rake Dog Pooper Scooper allows you to conveniently remove outdoor waste. Our ergonomic rubber grip and sturdy scooping wire will help you keep your yard clean without getting your hands dirty. This pooper scooper is rust resistant, so you can trust its durability with confidence! Intended for backyards, this dog poop rake works best on grassy and sandy areas.
profile.reviewText:
For the price, it's really a decent poop scooper. It arrived with a couple of the tines every so slightly bent, but they go straight again easily. With use, and in thick grass, they may become bent again. But not in a bothersome way, and I certainly don't want to put my hands on the tines now that they've done their job!

We ordered this poop scooper from inside a Petsmart where we had gone to buy one, but found about 4-5 options there--all at least $35! To scoop up poop?! Should things cost that much when they just need to grab poo for a brief moment? So we said, "To heck with you, Petsmart." And we ordered this one instead. Considering how much money we saved, and the job it does, I'm glad we saved our money and went with this bare bones model. It works perfectly fine! Especially good with dry poops. Fresh ones are a little harder to get up completely.

Anyway, definitely recommended considering the price, and I'm going to go wash my hands now.
profile.summary: Ordered this after walking into a Petsmart...

profile.description: The T.S. Shure Daisy Girls Horse Pals Wooden Magnetic Dress-Ups Set provides hours of imaginative pretend play. Have fun creating many different outfits for Poppy and her horse Clover! This expansive set includes 40 wooden magnetic outfit and horse themed pieces. Each wooden magnetic piece is beautifully illustrated. The magnetized pieces allow for creative play options on a range of magnetic surfaces. This set also includes a clear carrying bag with a colorful feather trip and a snap closure pocket, perfect for travel and storage at home. Dress-up set includes wooden magnetic Poppy and her horse Clover, and 40 wooden magnetic outfit and accessory pieces with a horse theme. Have hours of imaginative pretend play fun creating many different outfits for Poppy and her horse Clover. A clear, glamorous carrying case with a snap closure pocket and a stylish feather trim is also included! This interactive set promotes imaginative play and storytelling. Perfect for ages 3 and up! Dress-up set includes wooden magnetic Poppy and her horse Clover, and 40 wooden magnetic outfit and accessory pieces with a horse theme Have hours of imaginative pretend play fun creating many different outfits for Poppy and her horse Clover. A clear, glamorous carrying case with a snap closure pocket and a stylish feather trim is also included! This interactive set promotes imaginative play and storytelling. Perfect for ages 3 and up!
profile.reviewText:
This set is like a modern paper dolls set, just like the classic paper dolls from over half a century ago, except updated to be more durable. All pieces are one sided and the accessories and clothes stick to "Poppy" and her horse, "Clover", via magnet. As a mother-of-three with way too many toys around the house already, I really appreciate that this set comes in it's own, nice, cute, pink feather boa lined bag for storage and also travel. This is a nice set to tuck into your mom-bag and take with you when you know you might end up somewhere that you'll need to occupy your child quietly for a while.

I notice that T.S. Shure has several different "themes" of these wooden dress up sets, so be sure to shop around. If you have a horse-loving girl in your life, then this one is sure to please. We also recently acquired another T.S. Shure horse girl set (Emily & Freckles) which is a few dollars less, however it doesn't come with a storage bag, and it is a little more mature than this set (illustration wise). I've been pleased with the quality and durability of both sets so far.

If you have a little one, especially who enjoys her horses, then I can't think of a reason not to recommend this cute set.
profile.summary: Another horse-lovers hit by T.S. Shure!

profile.description: The My Mini MixieQ's world is just like ours except it's totally cube-ular! Get ready for new collectible figure excitement! Includes 12 blind packs, each with 2 mystery figures. All figures have interchangeable Pop and Swap hair and outfits to share with other characters and customize your My Mini MixieQ's, your way! Have hours of fun and when you're through, fold it up and take it on the go!
profile.reviewText:
I don't know what it is about 2016 and the fascination with tiny toys that come in blind bags. My Mini MixieQ's are cute and fun, but they don't do much. But my girls (8 and 5) love to open them and mix and match their hair and clothing. We're going to get some house sets that match so they can have fun with them, not unlike what they already do with LEGOs.

This set arrived as described, in a store display style box with twelve boxes of series 1 MixieQ characters. We opened them all and I did not notice any duplicates. If you need bulk MixieQ's, then I can't think of a reason not to recommend this purchase. Great stocking stuffers or treats! And if your kid is going to want you to buy them a ton of them anyway, might as well buy a bulk set like this.
profile.summary: Nice bulk set of MixieQ's!

profile.description: This Yellow Swallowtail Butterfly in a Jar gives you all the joys of butterfly keeping -- without having to actually catch anything! This fake butterfly toy looks and moves like a real yellow swallowtail, but it's actually driven by patented animatronics technology. All you have to do is tap the jar in certain rhythms, and the butterfly flutters and flies in true-to-life random patterns. Kids will adore the "magical" motions of the butterfly, and adults will enjoy being fooled. This Butterfly in a Jar ensures a good time for all!
profile.reviewText:
I found this on a total whim at a gift shop and I was so charmed by it that I had to take one home with me. Now I want to get more for all my friends to enjoy, what a clever idea! I'd feel too mean to keep a real butterfly in a jar, but this one is surprisingly lifelike.

It looks just like an old canning jar, which makes it just that much more realistic. The sides of the jar are textured like a Ball jar is, with the "brand name" and measurements. At first I thought that was a shame, maybe you'd be able to see the butterfly better without the raised textured parts in the glass, but then I realized this helps make it more real and also distracts the eye from the tiny thin wire that propels the butterfly.

Just like you'd tap at a real insect in a jar to get it to move, you tap this one to start the butterfly's animation. Like I said - so lifelike! It has several different rotations of movement: it flutters, it flaps it's wings, and it also sits still sometimes while slowly opening & closing it's wings. Just like a real butterfly would vary it's movements, this one does also. You even hear it clink against the glass.

When you first receive your butterfly, do be sure to switch it from demo mode to fully on by unscrewing the lid and switching the switch. You can change the batteries when necessary, but as warned by the manufacturer, never attempt to remove the animation module under the lid (which you can see if you hold the jar up over your eyes, but generally remains well hidden underneath the metal screw-top lid.) Mine did come with batteries already in place, no need to buy them or install them myself.

Not only do *I* adore the butterfly (right now it's part of my springtime centerpiece on my dining room table, ready to charm guests when they come over), it's also been so much fun to show my two year old daughter, and also my cats have gotten so much entertainment by just sitting and watching it! I think this makes a very creative and perfect gift for almost anyone! I'm excited to introduce this fun little idea to more of my friends & family, it's just too cute & sweet.
profile.summary: Charms everyone - even the cat!

profile.description: Ottomanson Ottohome Collection offers rugs and runner rugs that are both functional and decorative to contribute a trendy compliment to your space and home decor while preserving your floors from dirt, scratches, wear and tear. Our Contemporary Bordered Design Modern Area Rug features an intricate and elegant design in chocolate brown and mainly tan hues with a definite beige border for a neat look. Resistant to fading, stains and shedding, this durable rug offers a fuss-free maintanence and can be an ideal choice for homes with kids and pets as well as heavy traffic areas like hallways, kitchens, entryways, living rooms. Machine-woven loop texture with 100% nylon low-pile for long-lasting quality makes this rug easy to lay flat and feels comfortable under your, your kids' and pets' feet; while the non-slip rubber backing helps with grip so your rug stays safely in place without moving even when you vacuum. Convert your house into a home with a finishing touch by simply setting one rug from this collection under your kitchen table, in your living room or by your foyer to greet your guests in a gracefully welcoming manner.
profile.reviewText:
This low-pile runner rug does a really decent job of staying put with it's non-slip backing. Look, the price here is actually unbelievable to me! It's not the prettiest runner I've ever owned, but it does it's job and is very functional. It looks good against my dark wood floors and I think it will really help keep the house feeling clean as we go into snow season, with all the mess that comes with it.

Due to the color, it doesn't stain easily or show spots. Pets running by, or even my kids, don't disrupt the placement of it. But I still just can't get over the prices. Clearly, these rugs are meant to be basic and affordable, they are definitely both of those things. If you need something basic like this, I can't not recommend it.
profile.summary: Basic and affordable! Stays put!

profile.description: On-Ear Headphones
profile.reviewText:
This is my second set of Monster headphones, I also have used the Lady Gaga Heartbeats, and I must say I'm pleased with this brand and it's quality. These headphones arrived well-packaged, they would make an excellent gift for the young music-lover especially. They're mostly comfortable to wear, except the very top of them where it sits on my head will bother me if I don't extend them further. (However, my husband said the top part didn't bother him at all, so go figure, I guess it's just me. And no, I don't have a large head.)

But when it comes to sound quality, I'm really not the person to ask. I don't have "an ear" for those sorts of things (I'm Little Miss Visual, not Audio) so I took these headphones to my husband--who just happens to work in the audio/video industry and has designed sound systems for famous musicians (yes, you've heard of them, no I'm not naming names). My husband has a pretty good ear for sound quality and knows the terminology so I had him listen to some different songs and give me his opinion as to what he'd say about them. He said the following, "Over all the sound quality is very good. The bass is strong [which he says is typical of Monster], but there isn't a heavy boominess. They have flat tone response [which is good, according to him, not too much bass], and are soft on top [which supposedly is talking about high notes not being too bright and such, and this usually means the sound is not as "fatiguing" as "bright" headphones/speakers would be]." Since he works in this industry, he says these headphones seem to be very much geared toward teens and young adults, they have an urban feel. Other things my husband noted was that they are comfortable for being "on ear" headphones and they have pretty good isolation, especially considering they're not over the ear style. I have to agree with this, they block out noise pretty well!

The control talk feature is pretty cool, it also pauses and has a few extra features. The cord can be removed from the headset which is great if it gets damaged, you won't have to buy a whole new pair. The design is a little hip and youthful for me, they stick out a lot and are a pretty glossy black with a few red & silver accents.

I would definitely recommend these headphones, especially if you're looking for a pair to gift to someone, I think they'd be a great choice.
profile.summary: Monster brand delivers again!

With 2 themed rooms, 2 exciting playsets, 18 figures (8 visible and 10 mystery figures), this special bundle is packed with creative storytelling in compact size! Each figure features interchangeable Pop and Swap hair and outfits, too, so you can customize your My Mini MixieQ's, your way! Enjoy day and night adventures in the Neon Arcade deluxe playset. Loaded with lights, music, and cool games, you will want to rock 'til you drop! Practice your dance moves to real music on the light up dance floor, then grab a lane and bowl or play some arcade games next door. Fill up on refreshments at the snack bar and chat with your My Mini MixieQ's pals in the lounge. Next, rest up or dress up in the Apartment! This playset folds into a cube that fits in the palm of your hand! Open it and discover multiple indoor and outdoor play areas, including a backyard with a hammock, a TV room, dining room, bedroom, kitchen and furniture! Invite all your My Mini MixieQ's pals over for a house party or hop over to the Candy Shop for a range delightfully sweet treats! This bright room has sugary accents, a service counter, candy bins, a standing dispenser, display table and more!
