Other mini rooms and playsets sold separately, subject to availability. Colors and decorations may vary.
profile.reviewText:
I'll start by saying that my daughters (8 and 5) got to split this set 50/50 and they already each had many MixieQ's figures. They are IN LOVE with this set. They haven't stopped playing with it since we opened it a couple days ago. They are really into the cube rooms that fold up, and linking them together to create "malls" (their word for it) for allllll the MixieQ's. If they alone could rate it, they'd give it 100 stars.

My take on this set? I'm glad the kids are enjoying it, truly. They have given it a lot more attention than many new toys. I, personally, like the Shopkins and LEGOs we're also into these days a lot better than MixieQ's. The price?! Yeesh. For a bunch of tiny plastic parts...I don't know. You can get a much larger LEGOs set for the same price...and LEGOs are expensive...aren't they?! I don't know anymore. My world has been turned upside down by tiny pixilated people.

This set also came packaged in a plain brown box, no exciting packaging. It had dividers and in each section of the box was bundled up a tightly plastic wrapped are of MixieQ's, accessories, or rooms. Was tedious to unwrap, and not exciting to present (think about whether this would make a good gift that way) but as we struggled to get past the tightly wound plastic to get to the tiny plastic pieces rolled up inside, my daughters' excitement grew.

Again, THEY love them. I think they're fine, if not overpriced. We'll see if the collection grows and continues to be a favorite, maybe I'll update and let you know?
profile.summary: No exciting packaging, but the kids are head over heels!

profile.description: Enjoy everyday control with these women's Maidenform shape wear briefs, featuring a stretchy, seamless construction. In a convenient 2-pack. Same as Maidenform retail style 12586.
profile.reviewText:
I really like these shapewear knickers! Having had three c-sections, my belly fat and stomach muscles are certainly not what they used to be. I struggle to find underwear that doesn't irritate my incision scars and thus rides higher over the hips and far away from where I've been cut into (three times!).

These work beautifully as shapewear underwear. I'd definitely recommend them. These XL fit just right, and I typically wear a pant size 12/14 or L/XL yoga pants. The elasticity is strong, it definitely helps hide some jiggle and smooth lines while not being uncomfortable. (And trust me, I've worn uncomfortable shapewear.) If this sort of thing is what you're in the market for, I definitely recommend these. If you have any questions, feel free to leave a comment and I'll do my best to answer.
profile.summary: Holds in my post-c-section belly perfectly!

profile.description: 17N4 Features: -Easy to use. -Dual DirtLifter power brushes. -Patented HeatWave technology provides two sources of constant heat to maximize cleaning. -Cleans better with less effort. Color: -Silver/Green. Material: -Metal/Plastic. Number of Items Included: -1. Dimensions: Overall Height - Top to Bottom: -45 Inches. Overall Width - Side to Side: -13 Inches. Overall Depth - Front to Back: -19.5 Inches. Overall Product Weight: -32 Pounds.
profile.reviewText:
This Bissell carpet cleaner arrived well packaged and was easy to put together, a matter of simply attaching the handle and a few parts, nothing complicated. It comes with a small sample of their cleaner, which we got about 2 tanks worth out of.

The cleaner is simple to operate and easy to understand. It works almost the same as another Bissell carpet cleaner we owned in the past. It's hard to tell a difference between the pet models and the regular models, I wish Bissell would clarify a bit more. I will say, even after vacuuming my carpet 4 times over with our Dyson before using the cleaner, this Bissell cleaner still worked up a lot of pet hair. It sucked some of it up, and left a few clumps of pet hair bunched up on the floor. Not a big deal, it's easy enough to pick up a few clumps of pet hair after cleaning--we're talking 3-4 clumps in my entire living room.

Some hair did get caught in the suction portion of the cleaner, the clear part on the front which I removed for cleaning. The suction space is understandably small, still, the pet hair got caught in it and I had to use a butter knife to work some of that out. I suppose I COULD just leave it there, it is a hassle to clean out, but I believe leaving the clumps of hair in there would reduce the performance of the cleaner. Using this cleaner on our carpets in the house, I was pleased with the performance. It won't magically remove stubborn stains altogether, you need a special treatment for such things, but it did get up quite a bit of dirt from our carpets. Definitely seems to do it's job! We live in a dry state, and so our carpets didn't seem to take long to dry. Humid climates might require more time, but the suction seemed strong enough to get up the bulk of the moisture before leaving the carpets to dry.

Where I really felt this cleaner performed was in our CAR! We have three little ones, and have made the mistake of letting them have food in the car in the past (not any more!) and so the carpets in our car were in need of a HUGE deep cleaning. We took this Bissell cleaner out to our drive way, and the long hose attachment was GREAT for working on our car's carpets! We removed the ones you can take out and cleaned those outside the car, but also cleaned the carpet still left behind in the car. It made our car feel like new. The hose attachments function really well.

The tank is easy enough to fill and dump, you just have to learn the ropes of what goes where. I do recommend taking the time and effort to give the tank and parts a full rinse down after EVERY use. I believe cleaning out the hair and grime is crucial in keeping these carpet cleaners working over the years.

I've use Bissell cleaners before, and now this one, I can say that I'm perfectly happy with them and would recommend one for someone looking for a carpet cleaner in this price range.
profile.summary: Was fantastic on my car's carpet!

profile.description: Enjoy crystal-clear sound from this go-anywhere mobile speaker. Wirelessly connect and stream music from your Bluetooth-enabled device from up to 30 feet away. Easily manage phone calls and volume control from your mobile phone. Enjoy five hours of continuous play without recharging. Recharge the built-in lithium-ion battery with the convenience of the included micro-USB cable. Connector/Port/Interface: Bluetooth Depth: 1 5/8amp;quot; Height: 6 1/2amp;quot; Width: 5amp;quot;.
profile.reviewText:
I am impressed with how simple and nice this mobile speaker from Logitech is! Right out of the box, it is easy to set up and appears to be of good quality. It's a simple, small speaker that can pair with your devices via bluetooth. Setting it up and getting it working was a breeze, and the speaker comes with it's own charger.

On the side is a power button as well as two volume buttons--up or down. The device beeps when you reach maximum volume. A power light can be seen through the screen when you first turn it on. Look, the sound quality is good considering the size and simplicity of this speaker! It's nothing fancy, probably won't please a die-hard audiophile. A bit tinny, if you ask me.

That said, those in need of a simple mobile speaker for work or home, to pair with their smartphone or tablet, and for those who are not "sound snobs" (no offense, as my own husband works in the a/v industry and is quite fussy about his speakers! I get it!) then this is a great choice. I give it 4 stars only because the strap is so-so and the volume/power has no indicator. Aside from that, I'm completely satisfied with this portable, small speaker.
profile.summary: Perfect for those in need of a portable office speaker to use with smartphone!

profile.description: DIIs 100% cotton tablecloths come in a variety of colors & sizes. These tablecloths are perfect for picnics, parties, showers, dinners, everyday use and more. DII offers a variety of prints and patterns, giving you numerous options for your next event or dinner party. All of DIIs cotton tablecloths have a 1 inch folded hem and mitered corners. These tablecloths are machine washable for easy clean up and use. Find DIIs full selection of tablecloths by searching for DII Cotton Tablecloths.
profile.reviewText:
These are pretty, affordable, wash nicely, and attractive at first glance. I'll give them all that. But these placements have their flaws which I also must mention.

First of all, I was supposed to get the red...and they sent me the white striped ones. So there's that. But I like them anyway, and they still match the tablecloth.

Second, they are imperfect. They are not perfect, even little rectangles all the way around. They are wonky, imperfectly sewn. When I stack them all on top of each other, it's obvious some are a tad crooked when it comes to the seams. They are thin, and while they wash nicely they will wrinkle something awful if you don't remove them from the dryer right away! So be prepared to iron.

Overall, I really do like them. They are casual, classic, and affordable. They're just not blowing me away with the quality standards here.
profile.summary: Pretty, lacking in quality

profile.description: Lionel Trains Megatracks Cork Screw Chaos with green engine Train SetLionel is expanding beyond model trains with the introduction of Mega Tracks, a revolutionary rail system where kids can use their imagination to design and build their own race courses! Lionel is expanding beyond model trains with the introduction of Mega Tracks, a revolutionary rail system where kids can use their imagination to design and build their own race courses! Utilizing a new clamp and construction system, kids can build anywhere, including on the floor or attaching to furniture, to create one-of-a-kind race courses. In addition to building their own track, kids can also create their own stunts by twisting the TwisTrack, a new flexible track system. Once the layout and stunts are built, kids can send the rail racer vehicle into high speed action, using a handheld RC controller to adjust the speed of the vehicle and keep it on the track. This master set includes 20 feet of TwisTrack, 55 construction pieces to build customized track layouts, Rail Racer vehicle and charger, handheld RC controller and includes track clamps and connectors, Red and green engines are sold separately and are on different frequencies. Set includes: 20 feet of TwisTrack 55 construction pieces to build customized track layouts Green Rail Racer vehicle and charger Handheld RC controller Includes track clamps and connectorsFeatures:Enjoy the flexibility of MegaTracks and experiment using your imaginationCreativity to build the track of your dreamsHours of endless funDimensions: 22.5 Inches x 5.25 Inches x 5.25 InchesRecommended Age: 8 - 15 years
profile.reviewText:
I was not previously familiar with Lionel or even the classic Hot Wheels track building sets. But that's okay, I think, as I've read some other reviews here that seem to lament that this set isn't enough like the classics, but I think I might have a previously untainted view of such track building and racing toys, yes? Oh well. Suffice it to say that when this set arrived I was a little overwhelmed. All the pieces! I gathered my kids (8, 5, and 3) and set out to build the track that the manual shows. It took up the whole dining room table!

I sent my husband to get a 9v battery at the store for the remote (it says battery included, but we couldn't find it) while I clamped and pieced together this thing. The kids were no help at all. This set isn't for little ones, necessarily. The blue track pieces are so flexible that I wasn't certain it would hold the rail car. But it did! That is to say, not without some bouncing around on the track. The car is heavy and when you add in momentum, it can really throw some heft into the flexible tracks--hence the table clamps!

We all ooh'd and ahh'd over it for a good 40 minutes while all the kids had their turns going backward and forward and moving the track around a bit. It strikes me that this set would be a lot of fun for an older kid 8 to kidult, and offers a lot of track building options. Once you get the track set up, it does the same old thing--speeds around the twists and turns, occasionally falling off the track when it comes to certain degrees and angles (did not happen with the manual's basic track set up). We thought it was pretty neat and then put it away and went to bed and I forgot about the set.

Until the next day after my husband went missing for 30 minutes, came upstairs with a gleam in his eye and announced that he had something to show us in the basement. He was quite proud of his track, set up in the air between the treadmill, the weight machine, and our futon. No table necessary, apparently!

So I think this is a fun, original sort of track building racing toy that can be built upon and added to (I hope) that will excite those like my husband, who has an engineer's mind. I think it's well designed and can provide hours and hours of track building and race testing. I'd be interested in expansion packs to make this set even more elaborate. I'm also thinking of setting it up at my son's birthday party next month along with the other yard games for guests to play with.
profile.summary: My husband sneaks off to play with it...

profile.reviewText:
Pancake Pile-Up! is definitely an educational sequencing game, not necessarily our favorite for breaking out on family game night. We like it more for fun during homeschool. It comes with a bunch of plastic, puffed up plastic pancakes, cards, spatulas, plates, and the box acts as the griddle. It's a decent game for practicing sequencing and motor skills. profile.reviewText:
These are certainly the strongest, most durable white tall kitchen trash bags we've ever come across. We usually buy a decent brand from the grocery store, and they work just fine. profile.description: Control your lights, ceiling fans, and other fixtures from anywhere with the Kasa Smart Wi-Fi Light Switch. The smart switch replaces any standard light switch, and connects to your home Wi-Fi in no time through the free Kasa app. Kasa also lets you manage connected fixtures with your smartphone or tablet, including setting schedules, timers and countdowns. For added convenience, you can use your voice to control when paired with Amazon Alexa, Google assistant and Microsoft cortana.
profile.reviewText:
It does what it says. The Kasa Smart Wifi Light Switch is an affordable way to add smart-switch capability to your home.  The unit was fairly easy to install, however, I am pretty familiar with electricity so your mileage may vary. The unit has two clamp-down style terminals for Hot and Neutral and two pig tails for ground and load. It is a fairly deep switch so make sure your wiring inside of your J-Box is fairly clean.

Once installed, it is setup using the Kasa app downloaded onto your smart phone. The guided setup makes connecting the switch to your Wi-Fi simple. Once connected, you can either control it using the Kasa app, or you can like the Kasa app to other Smart Home control providers such as Google Assistant or Alexa. I connected my system to my Alexa system. Once connected, turning it on and off or even to a certain light level is just a phrase away. One other very nice feature is that the switch has visual dimming indicators on the top of the switch (to know what level you are at) as well as a illuminated spot on the button that comes on when the switch is off. This makes the switch easy to find in the dark.

The dimming feature of this switch is excellent. You can not only dim from 0-100% but you can scale that dimming according to the light bulbs you have. I am currently using Philips 60-Wall Warm-Glow LEDs which gave me excellent dimming capability with absolutely no flicker.
profile.summary: Clean, easy to install, and affordable.  Excellent features for the price.

profile.description: Scotts Turf Builder Grass Seed Tall Fescue Mix provides superior heat, drought, insect and disease resistance to lawns. The mix contains Southern-bred grass seed that thrives in harsh conditions like sun, shade, and high traffic. The exclusive WaterSmart PLUS Coating absorbs 2x more water than uncoated seed, feeds with essential nutrients and protects seedlings from disease. Grow Quicker, Thicker, Greener Grass. Guaranteed.
profile.reviewText:
We applied this grass seed to our lawn in an area that has become patchy and used hard by our kids and animals, but is also shaded by a large tree in our backyard. Our Colorado soil in our backyard is often dry during the summer, as well as compacted and clay-like. To be honest, our climate isn't a friend of grass here in arid Colorado.

That said, I'm quite pleased with how this grass seed has filled in this shady area so far. It's finally coming in nicely. We've had a lot of rain lately which has surely helped. We worked up the soil a bit before applying and also had our yard aerated before we put down new grass seed. So far so good, though it's still short, so I'll update this review over the next couple of months to say how the grass stays. Or doesn't. Hopefully it does! We're hoping for a lush, healthy lawn once again to be enjoyed throughout the summer. We've only been in our house a year, so one of our goals has been rehabilitating the compacted hard lawn of our backyard. It's better in some spots over others, but this shady area specifically needed help so hopefully this grass seed will do the trick. So far, I do recommend it.
profile.summary: So far so good!

profile.description: Reduce organics, wastes & excess nutrients caused by fish, wildlife, & water pollution with Orb-3 Water Garden Enzymes. In man-made ponds this is often not the case - wastes accumulate supporting algae & aquatic weeds. Formulated for use in small backyard ponds, fountains, & water features, Orb-3 Water Garden Enzymes naturally speed up Mother Nature's process of cleaning water. It efficiently removes organic material & suspended solids to naturally inhibit cloudy water & sludge accumulation. Orb-3 Water Garden Enzymes promotes effective biological remediation by rejuvenating existing bacteria, quickly emulsifying organics, & supplying a fortified nutrient package. Enjoy the Orb-3 60-Day Satisfaction Guarantee: if you are not completely satisfied, return it within 60-days & we will refund your purchase price. Initial dose is 4 ounces per 500-gallons of water; thereafter apply 2 ounces per 500-gallons of water every week. Do not over apply. For larger bodies of water use Orb-3 Lake & Pond Enzymes. Dilute recommended dosage with a minimum of 1-gallon of pond water. Disperse product evenly over pond surface using a hand-held or mechanical sprayer. For Best Results: Apply when ambient temperature is 5090 F; pH is 6  8; alkalinity <100ppm. Treat consistently using an automatic feed system such as the Orb-3 2000 peristaltic pump if possible. More dilution upon application & consistent long-term use will enhance performance. This product will stimulate the natural beneficial bacteria. Proper aeration is extremely important to maximize its performance & ensure safety of fish. For best results, use within 12 months of purchase. Made in USA.
profile.reviewText:
This product is truly helpful and handy, but best for small ponds. On our family's land, we have an 18k gallon pond with a couple hundred koi and our ducks live there! There are lily pads and some good aquatic plants established there, however, we still fight the algae growing out of control! This product is safe to use and hasn't harmed anything--that goes for koi, plants, and ducks!--but the only problem is, to treat a pond our size it will take LOTS of this product, especially with the continued use as the directions recommend.

While we did notice a difference in water appearance and smell within days of use, it is unfortunately just not practical for us to keep up with this treatment, due to the ongoing costs.

That said, for those of you with smaller backyard ponds, this is a good product and I can't say I wouldn't recommend it!

profile.description: The Targus Executive Stylus & Pen combines the functionality of a stylus with a built-in roller ball pen for traditional note-taking. Featuring a soft, durable rubber tip, this stylus makes it easy to take notes, draw, play games, or simply turn a page. Leaving no smudges or finger prints on device screen, this stylus provides typing comfort, accuracy and efficiency. Users can use the stylus with note taking applications, like Penultimate, for the ultimate high tech note taking. For traditional note-taking, stylus has an integrated roller ball pen for smooth writing. The tip of the stylus works with iPad, iPhone, iPod touch and other capacitive touch devices. With an elegant finish and a professional design, it is the perfect tool for any executive.
profile.reviewText:
Honestly I've never used a stylus before. I've tried out a few of my friend's in the past but never liked the thin, weightless feeling of them. This stylus/pen has changed my opinion on the idea!

The packaging is attractive and high quality, this product would make a nice gift. Upon opening it for the first time I was surprised to see that the stylus feature is actually a rubbery ball on the top of the pen. I wasn't sure what to think about it, and figured it would skid across my Kindle Fire screen and be to grippy. This was not the case--at all! The stylus moves effortlessly and glides across the screen with ease. It felt really good to use, and I quickly came to love using this stylus.

The actual pen itself is equally impressive. This is a quality pen and it marks and glides well along paper. The black ink didn't smear but flowed well, just the way I like my pens!

Finally, I'm a fan of the overall style. This pen is unassuming and elegant without being flashy. I like the charcoal color of the finish and the silver accents. It's weighty enough to feel secure and at home in my hand, but not too heavy to where it'd be considered cumbersome.

I think this product makes an excellent gift for the businessman or professional who uses their tablet on the job, though regular tablet users who frequently need to make notes will appreciate it, too. There are absolutely no complaints on this product here, I'm very pleased with it and would definitely recommend.
profile.summary: Very nice tablet accessory!

profile.description: Easily connect the NODE 2 to your home Wi-Fi network to breathe new life into your traditional hi-fi set-up, giving you access to countless sources of high-resolution audio options. To experience your hi-fi library in other parts of your home, simply connect the NODE 2 to other Bluesound products on your home network and just press play. The NODE 2 and other Bluesound players are easily controlled with the BluOS Controller, a free app for your iOS or Android smartphones and tablets. Filled with an array of analog and digital inputs and outputs in a compact, beautifully minimalist design, and the power to create playlists and access all sources of music, the NODE 2 puts you in control of your own hi-res sonic domain. Certified as a High-Res Audio (HRA) player by Japan Audio Society, the NODE 2 is the ultimate hub for a true whole-home hi-fi experience. As an HRA player, the NODE 2 supports FLAC, ALAC, and MQA, as well as other conventional audio file formats.
profile.reviewText:
To the average user, this Bluesound NODE 2 is like an alternative to Sonos. To an audiophile, this Bluesound NODE 2 is a step up because it plays hi-resolution music files without the help of a computer or other device. What does that mean? Think of it like high resolution photos we can take with nice cameras and lenses these days, verses the pixelated photos you got with your first camera phone. It's like that. The Bluesound NODE 2 allows more information to be sent to your speakers. To the audiophile, this sort of thing can make a world of difference.

But to the average Joe Schmo, this product might actually fall below the well-loved Sonos system. Why? Mostly because Sonos players usually don't require separate speakers (except the Sonos Connect) and because the Sonos app pretty much sets the standard, what all other similar products strive for in an app. The Bluesound app, as other reviewers have pointed out, has lots of room for improvement. The user interface experience isn't impressive with the Bluesound app.

Still, the Bluesound holds its own with it's superior hi-res quality sent to your speakers. Speaking of your speakers, if you don't have a pretty nice set of speakers to pair with this product...well then, it's like...what's the point of getting a Bluesound? You know what I mean?

And so while I'm impressed by the quality of sound this Bluesound NODE 2 renders, it is up to you to decide if this is the right product for you. And in my opinion, that comes down to one question: which user are you? The average listener? Or the sound snob?

If you're an audiophile and have a nice set of JBLs or B&Ws to pair with this baby, then despite the clunky app, this will be a great product to add to your system. Definitely hook it up with a Tidal subscription.

However, if you have neither an impressive set of speakers nor an attuned ear for quality premium sound, then you might be better off with something like a Sonos with the speaker built in.

I suspect, if you're even browsing Bluesound products, you're probably the former. Or maybe you haven't developed the ear yet, but you have audiophile goals (which is to be admired). This will help you, yes, if that is the case. I can tell you this product delivers and works well, I'm just not a huge fan of the app, but you can live with that for the sake of hi-res sound coming out of your speakers, right? Thought so.

Not that this currently doesn't play well with Google Play or Apple Airplay. But again, if you're a true audiophile or wannabe, you should be using Tidal and you know it. If you're going to spend the money on a Bluesound and good speakers, then you also need to spend the money for a premium Tidal account, as it is the best streaming quality out there.
profile.summary: Comparing to well-loved Sonos, the big question is are you an average listener or an audiophile?

profile.description: The Roomba 770 Vacuum Cleaning Robot provides a concentrated clean, all at the push of a button. The 3-Stage Cleaning System with Dirt Detect Series II identifies dirtier areas in your home and focuses cleaning, ensuring Roomba tackles even fine pet hair, dust and dirt. Just press 'Clean' or schedule Roomba to run up to 7x per week. Roomba works on all floor types, and at just 3.6 inch tall, is specifically designed to fit under most furniture, beds and kickboards.
profile.reviewText:
When the Roomba was first delivered to my door step, I was not only over-the-moon excited as I've wanted one for years, I was so eager to try it out and put it to work. My first impressions were that it's larger than I'd expected and yet much simpler than I'd expected as well. I'm used to finding lengthy, thick, multi-lingual manuals in the boxes of such big ticket items as this. Instead, Roomba came with a short and sweet quick guide for easy set-up, as well as an informational DVD. At first I wasn't sure of that, so I set up Roomba's charging station and set it up for a full charge while I sat down to educate myself with the DVD.

The DVD, to my relief, was simple, short, and complete. (And yes, you can select your language.) It was worth one of those lengthy manuals except all condensed into a very easy, short explanation of the product. Kudos to iRobot there, I was unsure at first, but in the end your easy set-up was a breeze. Inside the box I also found two virtual walls (which did require me to purchase four C batteries), a couple cleaning tools for getting hairs out of the Roomba's brush, a couple extra filters for a couple months down the road, and a remote control.

Once the Roomba was fully charged (mine took about an hour) I pushed the "CLEAN" button and set it off to work. I LOVE IT! We've been using it now for a couple weeks and I can't get over how much I love this product being around to help. I call it my new maid. I'm a stay-at-home-mother of two, we live in an older 1940s ranch home with 1/2 original hardwood flooring and 1/2 carpeting, and tile in the kitchen. It felt like I was constantly sweeping my floors. With two little ones and pets, the sweeping jobs and messes were never-ending. Enter Roomba: now my house get's a basic clean through every day and it's not MY job!

Considering it's a small thing (for a vacuum) it picks up an extraordinary amount of dirt! It cleans for a while, but it lets you know when the canister needs to be dumped, and oh my! I thought my floors were cleaner than that with how much I'd been pulling out our Dyson. It's obvious that this little robot does pick up it's fair share of dirt, pet hair, crumbs, and all kinds of things. It moves easily from our carpet to our hardwood and vice versa. It even usually climbs the little 1.5" ledge to get into our kitchen. Yet whenever there is something in it's way, Roomba knows to back off and head in another direction. It's a pretty intelligent little vacuum. The canister is small enough and see-through on the bottom, too, so if it were to pick up something important like a ring I think I'd still find it and that gives me some peace of mind.

As far as quality goes, I am impressed. Everything from the packaging, to the technology and durability have impressed me. Though it does already have some light scuffs where it's met my base moulding--it hasn't done any damage, however. It even survived my naughty one-year-old trying to ride it down the hallway. It's also not as quiet as their informational videos seem to lead you to think, but hey--it's a vacuum. Some noise should be expected.

I am truly impressed with how much this thing picks up everyday, and I have to believe this would be a worth-while investment to those who have issues with dust and dander allergies. My family has no such issues, except for the crumbs and dirt that drive me nuts. Now instead, I keep walking into my living room and surprising myself, "Who vacuumed?! My carpets have that freshly vacuumed look...Oh yeah, Roomba did!"

The DVD also gives instructions on how to maintain your Roomba, which I think is important to watch and take notes. Wipe off the sensors regularly and clean the brush. All vacuums need maintenance here and there.

I still do my own sweep & vacuum jobs here and there, Roomba does a good job but it doesn't always get *every* thing--often because a chair was left in it's way or something like that. Still, it's made the in-between time a lot longer. I'm pulling out my broom and wiping crumbs off my feet a LOT less than I used to, so I'm happy. In fact, the Roomba also goes where I don't usually clean--like under the couch and beds.

You can schedule Roomba, or simply push the button to set it off at any time of day. As another reviewer said, I would also recommend trying to be nearby when Roomba is cleaning. Sometimes they can get stuck or wrapped up in something (the drawstring from my pajama pants, for example) though not very often.

I think this is a great, intelligent product, and definitely a welcome helper around the house! I love it and would absolutely recommend it, although I know it won't fit into everyone's budget, it is sort of a luxury item. Still, those with pets and little ones, and those with allergies, will especially appreciate this vacuum robot.

UPDATE 7/22/12 - Just shy of two months of use, Roomba is still going strong and a loyal member of our household. I've done a little maintenance, as suggested by the DVD, and cleaned the sensors and brush. This Roomba has also taken plenty of abuse from our two little ones (ages 3 & 1) and yet she's still doing her job. We're very happy with this product!

UPDATE 10/18/12 - Roomba is running in my kitchen as I type this, I've set up the virtual wall to keep it in there. I really like the virtual walls and I use them frequently. Roomba runs almost daily in our household, and I'm continually impressed with how much it picks up. Also, I have two little ones at home, and Roomba has taken a bit of a beating from them during the last five months of use. But it keeps going and works just as well as the day we got it! I was worried this product would give out after a couple months of almost daily use, but we're still going strong...
profile.summary: We LOVE Roomba--with updates at 2 & 5 months of use!

profile.description: Screen protection from daily scratches and scuffs. Clear visibility and complete functionality to the touch screen. Two Screen overlays, cleaning wipe, and smoothing card included in package.
profile.reviewText:
The matte finish is new to me, and I have to admit, on our family Galaxy tablet I am not too much of a fan. We use it mostly for smart home uses and with our kids, so I'm okay with this screen guard. If this were the cover on my personal tablet that I use much more, however, I wouldn't tolerate it well.

While the protector seems very durable and the sensitivity is still excellent on our Galaxy, the clarity is horrible. It makes the resolution horribly grainy and cloudy. My husband dislikes it even more than I do, as he's in the a/v industry and can't stand a bad picture on TVs.

Not everyone is as picky as we are, so if you think you wouldn't mind the dulled resolution from this screen protector then I think it would be just fine for the typical user. Application was simple and easy, though you must be sure your screen is 100% clean and spot free before applying. I like that Belkin includes a card for smoothing air bubbles as well as a micro-cloth for cleaning your screen. There is also a second screen protector should we need one, if the first gets damaged.

I think we'll keep using it since the children sometimes use the Galaxy and it's mainly for household use, but this screen protector definitely is not for those who are picky about their resolution. Aside from that, this is a decent product, it simply doesn't appeal to us much when it comes to clarity. The protectiveness, sensitivity, value, and ease of application--however--are all great.
profile.summary: It's ok if you're not picky

profile.description: This charming dessert play set of nine HABA Biofino Petit Fours is sure to delight. A perfect play food for pretend play and pretend tea parties. These petits fours look as though they were made by the finest European bakery, but they are made of soft fabric materials with assorted beaded and embroidered embellishments, boxed in a cheerful, polka-dotted gift box with clear window cover. Each petit four is nestled in a paper petit four wrapper.
profile.reviewText:
These petit fours are really cute, especially to go with a tea party set in a little girl's room! If you've ever had real petit fours, you know they are mini, bite-sized cakes that are decorated to look lovely. That's exactly what these are, only fake. Each one of the 9 treats is different, and constructed with a different fabric. While a couple have embroidered-on sprinkles, another has a felt rose topper, another is topped with a delicate little pearl. It's just like having a beautiful selection of treats from the pastry shop to serve at your tea party! Each one is cute in it's own right.

While the paper cups they are "served" in is a cute touch, they aren't really very practical and didn't last long with my toddler. Think of that part just as a packaging element. These cute petit fours are an excellent match to my daughter's new play kitchen & tea set. Mine came looking just like they do in the pictures, except that they are so small that they don't all have such perfectly square shapes. This is to be expected with small, plush toys, however. I would recommend these for the girly-girl in your life, or anyone who likes the plush food trend that's been popular recently.
profile.summary: Adorable tea party treats
