profile.description: The FLIR C2 is the world's first fully featured pocket-sized thermal camera designed for building industry experts and contractors. Keep it by your side and find hidden heat patterns that signal energy waste, structural defects, plumbing issues and more. The C2's must-have features include MSX real time image enhancement, a high sensitivity, a wide field of view, and full radiometric images that clearly show the completion of repairs or locations where problems are still located. IMAGE MODES: MSX adds key details from the on-board digital light camera to the IR image adding detail and clarity; "Picture-in-picture" overlays a fixed Section of a thermal image onto a digital photo to clarify problem locations and enhance documentation.
profile.reviewText:
This is an excellent compact thermal imaging camera! Right out of the box it was easy to start using and functions beautifully. We recently had out 1950s home insulated. While our home was well-built, back then they didn't put insulation in our walls and there wasn't much in the attic, so having that done to our home has made all the difference. Even then, this camera has helped make it obvious where our home is still lacking in spots and where it isn't.

Considering the price, I'm not surprised it works so well. I would expect an excellent product at this price point, and I feel FLIR delivers. Each time you power on, it takes a moment to calibrate. Then you're ready to start shooting and viewing. This would be a particularly excellent product for someone in the home building/insulating businesses and similar industries, obviously. We are a DIY family whenever we can manage, and don't mind getting our hands dirty with home projects. As we work on making our home more energy efficient and replacing the old windows, I expect this thermal camera to be a gem of a gadget to us. We've already noticed the difference in our home's energy efficiency since the insulation was done. In that way, I think this camera could be especially helpful to those focused on creating lock tight seals and weatherproofing.

It is about the size of your average smartphone, the outer plastic has good grip and seems like it could survive a drop (though I won't test that theory), and finally has a nice long strap so you can keep it convenient and safe. They seemed to put a lot of thought into this design. I'd definitely recommend it.
profile.summary: Get a grip on this great gadget!

profile.description: Inverter technology, 1.2 cu. ft., 1200W, Inverter Turbo defrost, 1 touch sensor cook and reheat, menu action screen, keep warm setting, 12 levels of auto cooking, popcorn key, quick minute key, more / less control, 12.25"H x 20.7"W x 15.9"D, white.
profile.reviewText:
We purchased this microwave to fit in a small cabinet of our new home, as our home didn't come with a built in microwave and then one the previous owner left behind was decrepit and disgusting.

This microwave fits in the cabinet very well, it's just small enough but certainly large enough to handle a big plate of food. What I will say is--WOW is this thing powerful! Almost TOO powerful. I've found I've had to reduce my regular cooking times by at least 30 seconds, and sometimes I have to turn down the power. I mean, I'm glad it works. My last microwave was spot-on: if the Hot Pocket said 2 minutes and 30 seconds to cook, the microwave would cook it perfectly in 2 mins 30 seconds. With THIS Panasonic, however, if I left the Hot Pocket in for 2.5 minutes, it'd probably be charred when I took it out. This isn't necessarily a problem, however, because I like how it heats a mug of water faster and seems efficient.

Other than that, we're well pleased. The clock isn't easy to read unless you're directly in front of it, and as ours is raised up in a cabinet we can almost never read it. It doesn't have too many features or buttons (our last microwave actually had a "Hot Dog" button) but that's okay. It's simple, affordable, and gets the job done.
profile.summary: VERY powerful, great small size, clock is hard to read

profile.description: Hollywoods favorite Esthetician, Makeup Artist and Author, Scott-Vincent Borba is the leading Inside-Out beauty and Nutraceutical authority in the superfruit-fueled skin care, cosmetics, and enhanced waters categories.Used by Scott-Vincent on his celebrity clients, this Corrective Concealer Anti-Wrinkle CC Cream infuses skin with Citrine Diamonds to deflect skin imperfections. Scott-Vincent Borbas InvisiVeil Technology is armed with Rapeseed Sterol and color-building mineral pigments that color match all skin tones and skin types. Black Algae and Sustainable Red Palm Oil increase cell turnover, minimizing pores and wrinkles. Designed to work with all cosmetic and skin care systems. For the gentlest and smoothest application, use with Scott-Vincent Borba's Anti-Fatigue Corrective Concealer Tool Line Smoothing Tear-Drop Blending Applicator. Made in USA.
profile.reviewText:
I was very interested to try this thirty-five-dollar concealer as I've been searching for one that met my needs. I'm disappointed by this one, unfortunately, although I had wanted to like it.

This is a generous pot of concealer, it will last a long time for the average user. The texture of the product is what got me, in that it does not apply well to under eye areas--despite the claim that this product is great for under eye areas and reduces winkles in said areas. I tried this concealer out in a variety of ways, using fingers to apply as well as a concealing brush. Note that the product suggests using a brush to dole out the product onto the back of your wrist, then from there to apply with the brush to your face.

I will say, I was pleased with how this product covered blemishes, quite well, when using a concealer brush. As for the undereye area? Which is big for me, as I'm a fair skinned lady of Swedish descent who has dark circles to cover, this product did not meet my expectations. It was hard and too dry to apply easily to the under-eye area well. Worse, I'd apply then move onto my foundation (which is quality product, Vincent Longo's Water Canvas Foundation) and this concealer would then gum up under my eyes. It didn't "play well with others" so to speak. When looking close up in the mirror, this product was OBVIOUS and easily seen on the eye. It didn't crease, but it "gunked up" on top of my skin and that I just cannot stand.

Also, it has a warm, yellowish tone, which is great if you're Asian but for a fair skinned Swede (with pink skin tones, not warm) it was just awful. This is what I can't understand about the beauty industry: every "fair" skinned product is made for warm skinned people. Meanwhile, there is a world of cool toned, Scandinavian skinned people out there needing COOL TONED products that the beauty industry is completely ignoring.

The texture was a miss as well, this product was just hard to apply well in that it is a hard creamy yet chalky consistency, like what you might find in a concealer stick that you twist to use. You can scoop it up on a brush, but as soon as it hits skin and air it starts drying and becomes difficult to smooth, I felt like I was smudging it onto my skin and this is not a pleasant thing when you're messing with delicate, under-eye skin. I really hate the texture of this concealer, overall.

However, I must say it did do well in covering up small red blemishes when applied with a small concealer brush. Unfortunately for them, but fortunately for ME, I do not get small red blemishes very often. So this product is very unhelpful overall, in my opinion. They would do well to 1) make a shade for cool toned fair skin and 2) create a product that is easily applied, this thick cream isn't cutting it and does not work--especially considering the claims they make for this product being good for the under-eye area as well as good for hiding tired, wrinkled eyes.
profile.summary: OK for blemishes, not a good concealer overall, NOT for fairskinnned

profile.description: Keep lunch fun, easy and mess-free with OXO Good Grips Lock Top Lunch Sets, which combine a spill-proof seal with sizes perfect for lunch. Lock Top Lunch Containers were designed with leak-proof, airtight lids that snap on easily and confidently. Just push the outer frame down onto the lid to engage the inner locking tabs and silicone ring for an instant, secure seal. A removable divider keeps foods separate until lunchtime and stops soggy lunches once and for all. Durable, BPA-free Tritan Container bodies resist warping and staining and are crystal clear to reveal contents inside. The lids are also clear to make contents viewable from above. Set includes one 5.5 Cup Lock Top container and one 2 oz. Mini Lock Top, ideal for salad and dressing. Containers safely go from the freezer, to the microwave, to the dishwasher. Lock Top bodies nest inside each other for convenient storage. Containers stack neatly without toppling, to optimize space in the refrigerator or freezer.
profile.reviewText:
I like this little set, simple though it is. The triangular container is very handy when needed, but it comes out too, to make one big container. The small container is the perfect size for sauces, dipping, dressings, etc. The lids fit securely and the plastic feels sturdy and not cheap.

The price point seems a little high to me, but I suppose if you took a lunch to work every day and could get a lot of use out of this one, then maybe it's worth it to you? The system is versatile. I think you'll have to see for yourself if this set will meet your specific needs, though if it does, I can't think of a reason not to recommend it.
profile.summary: Nice, adjusts to your needs

profile.description: Orb-3 Lake & Pond Antifoam reliably knocks foam down quickly and makes this type of upset in lakes, backyard ponds and water features easy to control. The fast-acting formula is environmentally responsible and is safe for people, fish and other wildlife when used as directed. The water-based emulsion that provides natural, long-lasting defoaming persistence. Food-grade active ingredients in Orb-3 Lake & Pond Antifoam deflate the gases dispersed in water, simply making foam go flat. Best of all, this product carries the Orb-3 60-Day Satisfaction Guarantee: if you are not completely satisfied with your purchase simply return it within 60-days and we will gladly refund your purchase price. Dosing: Apply as needed: 1 tbsp. per 500 gallons or 1-gallon per acre-foot. To Use: Shake product vigorously before use. Dilute recommended dosage with a minimum of 1-gallon of pond water. Disperse product evenly over pond surface using a hand-held or mechanical sprayer. For best results, use within 6 months of purchase. Made in USA.
profile.reviewText:
Unlike the other Orb-3 products I've used lately (and liked, but just wait...) this one I can finally vouch for even for those with BIG ponds! As stated on the bottle, this 1-quart size treats up to 80k gallons. Whew! We have a very large 18k gallon pond out on our ranch land. It has 200 koi, two ducks, and lots of plants. Foam is an occasional problem for us.

Many of their other products are really only cost effective for those with small backyard ponds. But this anti-foam treatment does the job, and fast. And you don't have to buy 3-4 bottles to make it worth it if you have a LARGE pond. I really like this brand and the quality of their products, will definitely keep an eye on their line as we work with our pond.
profile.summary: Yes, it works! Good for even large ponds!

profile.description: This Sabatier 15-Piece Cutlery Set with Concave Acacia Block keeps essential everyday knives at your fingertips. The knives are expertly crafted from superior quality high-carbon stainless steel and feature triple riveted handles that are perfectly weighted and balanced for control. The round acacia storage block keeps knives organizes while adds elegance to your kitchen counter. 15-piece set includes 8-inch chef knife, 8-inch slicing knife, 5-1/2 inch serrated utility knife, 5-1/2 inch Santoku knife, 4-1/2 utility knife, 3-1/2 inch paring knife, six steak knives, angled sharpening steel, all purpose kitchen shears and acacia wood block. Hand-wash with warm water and a mild detergent; rinse and dry immediately.
profile.reviewText:
This product confuses me. Reading the reviews here I started to get the impression that these are Sabatier knock-offs. A China company coat-tailing on the reputation and name of the real French knife company Sabatier, known for their lion insignia. Confusingly, the lion logo is missing from the blog, but printed on the knife blades. So before reviewing this product I took to the Sabatier Facebook page, copy & pasted the link to this Amazon listing, and asked them straight up--"ARE THESE YOURS?" A few days later they replied, "Yes, they are."

I thought..."Huh." Then it occurred to me, how do I know this isn't a Sabatier knock-off Facebook page? I mean, for a reputable company FB page...they only had 91 likes. So I'm still confused to be honest. Here's my points:

1. Either these are low quality knock-off "Sabatier" knives and the company producing them is sort of seedy for stealing a brand and logo.

OR

2. This is a legit Sabatier product and they've really let their quality standards slide.

Because these aren't great knives. Not even at this price point.

The block is pretty and the completeness of the set on the kitchen counter is impressive, but that's about where it ends. They are sharp enough, but they're brand new knives. This isn't my first rodeo, I'm a housewife of 12 years, I know the life expectancy of good vs bad knives. My expectations for these knives longevity isn't high. But I will update this review if they surprise me.

For example, my very favorite go-to kitchen knife is my Victorinox chef's knife I got as a gift (right here off Amazon) about 5 years ago. I use it several times a week, have never sharpened it, and it still does the job. I've gotten two new knife sets since the Victorinox and neither included chef's knives have ever outlived the Victorinox. And I repeat: I've never even sharpened it. Guests come to my house and help cook are always fawning over my knife and how well it cuts, like buttah. So the Victorinox, understand, has set a precedent. This set arrived and it's brand new and already the chef's knife takes more work than my old trusty Victor.

But there's more. The set is a curious one to me. The steak knives have no serration, which is completely new to me. Steak knives? Not serrated? The bread knife is cute, and very short. It's okay to cut a bagel but not a loaf of rustic bread when you're having it with soup. Certainly not long enough to do my favorite bread knife task: level off cake layers. Nope. So just know that in advance, the bread knife is dwarfed. The rivets aren't always flush with the knife, the knives are very light and feel cheap, and my biggest bone to pick is that they came out of the dishwasher with a hazy film on the black handle. (And no, it's not me. I use Finish and have a great dishwasher.) I know they say don't put knives in the dishwasher, but guess what? I do. (And the Victorinox has never had a problem with it.)

It's nice they include a sharpening tool and kitchen shears. I like that.

But if you need a so-so set and are an occasional cook this will work fine. However, if you are in the market for a GOOD quality set of knives you expect to get lots of quality use from, keep looking. As you know, I already recommended my favorite chef's knife. My favorite steak knives are Laguiole, which are French and sometimes also expensive but they have a great all-metal FlyingColors set here on Amazon for an amazing price.

Sorry Sabatier! You need to be more clear about your identity and connection to the French company, and this set just isn't a win for me.
profile.summary: Unclear branding and low quality - why I didn't like these, and what my favorite knives are!

profile.description: The dusk-to-dawn photocell automatically turns light on at dusk and off at dawn for convenience and energy savings. Tool-free adjustable heads allow for easy aiming up/down or side to side. Rugged cast aluminum, corrosion-resistant housing in bronze. LEDs maintain 2, 067 lumen output at 50, 000 hour life.
profile.reviewText:
You can order this light fixture either with or without the motion sensor, depending on your needs. The price difference between the two is negligible.

The installation for this fixture was quite simple, anyone who has done a light fixture before should be able to figure out how to mount and install it just fine. The quality of the hardware seemed pretty good, I've definitely seen worse. As for the light itself, it is VERY bright, white light and--having three lamps--covers a very large range with it's brightness.

I have to say, at night I'm not a big fan of the glaring, bright white light. It'd not a very pleasant ambiance, if you ask me. This won't matter if you're looking to light up for security or safety, but if you're looking for lighting for outdoor, night life--then I would personally go with a warmer light. Other than that, I can't say I wouldn't recommend this item if it seems to fit your needs.
profile.summary: Without motion sensor, still a decent floodlight

profile.description: For every mission, there's a vehicle. Battle the blaze like a real firefighter with a rugged large-scale fire truck that blasts water up to a whopping 25 feet! Fire has finally met its match with the Matchbox Aqua Cannon Rig and its easy-to-fill water tank that shoots up to 75 shots per tank. Simply pump, aim and shoot to knock out the "fire" and save the day! Kids can perform realistic rescues with a toy suitable for indoor or outdoor play that has durable styling, rolling wheels and awesome firefighter deco's. When the adventure is over, the water tank is easy to drain and store until the next real-world mission. Each sold separately, subject to availability. Batteries not required. Ages 3 and older.
profile.reviewText:
This is a great water toy for the firefighter loving kid, or any child who is into trucks and cars. It is a large toy, there is a water compartment in the middle which is easy to fill and even my 2 year-old has master the pumping action. The water stream is more impressive than I had expected. I love that it doesn't require batteries or anything, you just fill with water and it's ready to go. This is a wonderful toy to have for backyard play in the summer. My son loves rolling it around, but all three of my kids fight over the water shooting capabilities. It's a decent match in a squirt gun fight!

This toy would also make an excellent gift. Again, for a Matchbox product it's an impressive size and a fun looking toy. It IS a lot of fun too, so expect a happy child if you decide to gift this.
profile.summary: Happy toy and great gift!

profile.description: Franklin's Light-up Bocce revolutionizes a long time fun family game by creating a new element that's been lacking in the sport. Each bocce ball comes equipped with a recessed power button that helps maximize the length of play. The easy twist design is the first of its kind that allows the user to replace the batteries over time. This new feature that's not seen amongst the industry keeps the family playing for years! When not being used for nighttime play, this set is still great for any family backyard event with its differentiating color scheme. Grab your set and come join the party. The etched outer design of the ball provides maximum grip and feel. You will receive 8 light-up bocce balls (4 green & 4 blue) and 1 light-up easy on/off switch and replaceable battery compartment.
profile.reviewText:
I have never played bocce before, and so maybe that's why I'm cool with this untraditional set of bocce balls? I am no purist because I'd had no experience. But I certainly have been hearing a lot about bocce lately on the neighborhood forums and such, so I was intrigued by this cool light up set. Something I definitely hadn't seen before.

The balls were heavier than I'd expected! So when I read other reviewers saying these balls are not quite as heavy as a traditional set--whoa! But playing outdoor on the grass, I honestly found the weight to be just right, at least for us beginners. The light up feature is pretty cool, especially when you find yourself play at twilight or in the backyard during a late-summer BBQ with friends. My kids especially love the light up features, and they make up their own games to play with this set. I'd say this is a very beginner friendly set, perfect for families with kids, perfect for outdoorsy people like we are here in Colorado. I even had a fun thought, as we are blizzarding here today. These would look cool in the snow! However, I will not try it, as snow melts and makes water and I worry it could mess up the light features. Maybe something to keep in mind if playing outdoor on the grass too? If it's damp grass at all, take care.

This set gave us a fun, light hearted, not-too-serious was to learn a fun new family game. I'm going to take it over to church and have the youth group try it out too. It's a fun set!
profile.summary: Fun for us beginners!

profile.description: The Night Therapy Spring 13 Inch Deluxe Euro Box Top Spring Mattress by Zinus is an exceptional mattress that offers both customized support and luxurious comfort. This mattress features reduced motion transfer from a sleeping partner, while maintaining customized spinal alignment. The Pressure Relieving Comfort Foam and Fiber Quilted Cover of the Euro Box Top, additional layers of High-density Foam and Pressure Relieving Comfort Foam add exceptional comfort to this mattress. The 7.5 Pocketed Springs provide the support and a comfortable and healthy nights sleep.Please open your mattress package within 72 hours of receipt and allow 48 hours for your new mattress to return to its original, plush shape. Worry free 10 year limited warranty. Another comfort innovation from Zinus. Pioneering comfort.
profile.reviewText:
This tall mattress is firm! I never thought I'd care for this sort of mattress, I like a cushy and cozy bed. But apparently, firm mattresses are cozier than you'd think!

The mattress arrived in a large, heavy box. But it was rolled up into a compact thing for a mattress. When you unbox it, make sure you're not alone. It springs open and takes its shape as a large mattress. It's a one-sided mattress, you won't be flipping it. Coils topped with foam and cushions make it a firm mattress. It's the sort of mattress where your spouse can turn over next to you and you won't feel it. It's not noisy or creaky. It's also very tall! Thirteen inches is taller than your average mattress of the past, but fitted sheets still fit. But it's much higher to get up on than my previous one, a Serta a couple years old.

My husband and I've have both remarked on how much we like the mattress and the firmness of it. Plus, the price! Our first mattress we bought when we were married about 12 years ago was over a thousand! This is progress! Enjoy.
profile.summary: Great price and great firm mattress!

profile.description: One of the gooiest science kits you can imagine. Get ready to mix up a perfect batch of Slime and then stir in your favorite additive from styro-beads to glitter your hearts content. Or create the most disgusting slime concoction to surprise your friends and family. Then, use the worm squirter to make up a batch of multi-colored, slimy worms!.
profile.reviewText:
This slime kit is cute and fun, my kids (8 and 5) had fun doing a few of the projects with me one afternoon. The supplies for making the slime products are a bit small, so don't expect tons of projects out of this kit. We basically used it in one sitting. We could pull the box out and maybe make one more project with it.

It includes supplies and ingredients to make slimy balls/lumpy slime, slimy "worms", and clear or colored or glitter slime. My kids' favorite project was the slime worms. They come out rainbow style and that was pretty fun. Although I'm not sure they gathered much "science" knowledge from just making the worms, and there wasn't much left to do with the worms once we were done making them. So just keep in mind with this kid, that it is not something you'll keep going back to and do lots with. Once you've made 4-5 batches or projects, you're done and the slime gets old and thrown out.

I'll also say that the directions pamphlet did not impress me. It was not orderly, but rather verbose and a bit confusing. And I'm an adult! Kids might have a rough time if they try and jump right into a project. The directions are best read in advance from the very start to the very finish before starting ANY of the projects. I wish they'd simplified it and organized it better, and made the labels on the ingredients more clear and less confusing (two different ingredients can easily be confused with each other the way the directions are worded). Whoever they had write out their instructions, was perhaps a better science student than they were English students.

But it's overall a fun little kit for the kid who likes slime, which is all kids. Not just the sciencey ones.
profile.summary: Fun, despite verbose and disorganized directions

profile.description: Let your music loose with the powerful, clear sound of EXTRA BASS and freedom of Bluetooth connectivity that lets you cut the cord, while pumping it up in style. Never miss a beat with 30mm drivers engineered for today's bass-heavy tracks and up to 30 hours of battery life. Even take hands-free calls. They're ready to hit the streets with bass that hits.
profile.reviewText:
The fact of the matter is, you could easily spend thousands of dollars on a really swank set of headphones. I know this because my husband works in the audio video industry, and sold high-end speakers and headphones for years, sometimes even to famous musicians. This set is just under a Benjamin, and has some impressive features.

Pairing them up with my Samsung Galaxy S7 was an absolute breeze. Tapped my phone to one ear piece and boom. Done. It was literally that simple (this setup will vary from device to device, obviously, and bluetooth must be turned on). The headphones are lightweight and non-bulky. I've had so many bulky headphones lately, this pair is sleek and refreshing. Simple in design, really. The on-ear cushions aren't the best I've experienced, but they're far from the worst. They are soft, just not as cushy as I prefer. My husband, however, the official audiophile in the family, is QUITE fond of these headphones. He's been wearing them all week while doing housework all over, enjoying the cordless design.

Don't get me wrong, his best pair is actually the AudioQuest Nighthawks {love those cans to death} but there is a place for less expensive, get it done type of headphones too. He has much more of a distinguished listening ear than I do. I was satisfied with the sound quality from the start. My husband says they have a nice clean bass and sound really good for bluetooth headphones. He wears glasses, however, and remarks that these headphones aren't his favorite in that area, some are more comfortable than others when wearing glasses.

I was just impressed with the ease of use and the good quality for a relatively inexpensive set of Sony bluetooth headphones. If you have questions I didn't answer, feel free to leave a comment and I'll do my best to reply asap. Thanks!
profile.summary: My audiophile husband approves!

profile.description: Inspired by the lynx, a carnivore who thrives on meat, Wilderness Crunchy Cat Treats provide a delicious taste in a crunchy treat that cats crave! 100% grain-free, Wilderness Crunchy Cat Treats feature the finest natural ingredients, and never contain any chicken (or poultry) by-products meals, corn, wheat or soy, or artificial preservatives, colors or flavors. BLUE Wilderness Crunchy Cat Treats are the perfect way to cater to your cats wild side.
profile.reviewText:
Two out of my four cats love these "treats" so I can tell you it depends on the cat. We have had a good time with Blue Buffalo, their kibbles have been great for our dogs and cats, so I was excited to try these treats. Two of my cats turned their noses up at these, but the other two gobbled them down. So, it apparently is hit or miss.

They are very small, and I find myself wondering...is this just overpriced kibble? The pieces are about the same size as their kibble, so don't expect your cat to get a nice treat feast. They're small bits.

They had no negative effects, however. No upset tummies or anything after consumption. Again, I really like Blue Buffalo brand. If your cat does also, these treats might be just the ticket!
profile.summary: Hit or miss with my cats--but we love Blue Buffalo!

profile.description: The Doodle Magic Color Mat delivers BIG color fun for everyone! The huge 2ft. X 3ft. surface is big enough for kids to color together and included stencils help make perfect pictures. Soft design rolls up for easy storage and a hang loop lets you hang on a door or wall for stand-up coloring. Large exterior storage pocket keeps all accessories together.
profile.reviewText:
I'm giving this product a 3 star, "It's okay", review because it's truly just "okay". It has its pros and it has its cons.

PROS
- HUGE mat to color on, and it seems high quality with good stitch quality and durability.
- Markers don't stain or color on anything but the mat
- Mat wipes clean very easily
- It's plush and soft, making it nice for kids to lay on the floor and draw
- Mat can be hung so kids can color "on the wall"
- Comes with a wipe cloth and a wipe wand
- Rolls up and stores quite nicely, with pockets to store wipes & markers, as well as velcro straps
- This will travel well

CONS
- Comes with a mere four markers in unexciting colors: dark green, red-orange, pinkish purple, and yellow
- Markers marks take time to react to the mat and darken with time, so little ones (mine are 5 and 3 years old) can get impatient and lose interest
- Marker colors show up faded, there are no bright bold colors here. I like that they don't stain, but I'd chose crayons and paper over this if I only could pick one.
- Only four markers? I feel they could have added more. This is Crayola here...we can't have just four colors.
- Markers are very small and short and I fear they won't last long and replacements could become expensive
- Stencils that come with this set are unexciting. A few plastic stencils might have been better, as opposed to a strip of flimsy paper stencils that are easily ripped and lost by little ones.
- Despite saying it will travel well, it's useless in the car because it's a flexible fabric mat. And huge.

Now, I've read some reviews elsewhere on similar Crayola products, and they say that using Crayola's dry erase markers work beautifully on this mat. I might just have to try that. I can't see the price for this item yet, but due to the marker quality, I'm unimpressed so far. This mat didn't hold my 3 & 5-year-olds attention too long either--and they're exactly the age this product is aimed at.
profile.summary: Marker quality and lack of color is iffy...

profile.description: Read the amusing story of two inquisitive kids and build simple models of the aircraft they discover on their hilarious family vacation. Along this roundabout trip, the kids build various flying machines to help the people they encounter solve problems and complete tasks. As you follow the story, you can build models of the 10 vehicles in the story. Large, colorful plastic building pieces make it easy for small hands to put the models together. The kids start out by building a passenger jet to bring their family to a tropical island. After they arrive, they construct a helicopter to help some scientists studying sea turtles reach a remote island, and then a seaplane to bring them back. As they continue along their trip, they also build a biplane, space shuttle, prop plane, hang glider, supersonic jet, and other airplanes to help their friends out. From each humorous segment of their silly adventure, the kids learn something new and collect a funny souvenir. This 71-piece science kit combined with the beautifully illustrated storybook provides an engaging way to teach simple engineering concepts to preschool-age kids. Start laying the groundwork for strong STEM related skills and comprehension. This kit helps develop fine motor skills, science and math skills, visual-spatial skills, and reasoning and concept development skills.
profile.reviewText:
There are kids who enjoy engineering and building things, and there are kids who don't. You've got to decide if this will be your child's type of toy, or risk them playing with it once, maybe twice, and abandoning it. Out of my three kids, I have one who is super into building robots. This toy is perfect for her type! Unfortunately, she's a bit above the age range of this kit--which is more targeted to preschool age--and she is into building robots with actual wires and batteries now. But a couple years ago this would have been EXACTLY her thing.

My other two enjoyed this set, but the enthusiasm didn't last long after building a couple robots, and their interest has since waned. If you're looking for an educational engineering/building toy for a child ages 3-6, then I think this is perfect. It comes in a really nice clear box with a lid that snaps shut. I LOVE when toys come with their own storage. YES to that!

There are many pieces and building the robots will challenge the younger child, but will be lots of fun for the older child. And of course, while there are lots of suggestions and directions for different robots in the booklet, your child can also be really creative and come up with their own sorts of robots. The booklet is a nice addition, and I like that they added stories.

I wish they'd included a couple sets of eyes to make robots with more varying expressions (like LEGO does) but this set makes many very cute and friendly looking robots. If you have a child who is just into this sort of thing, and seems the right age for this set, by all means get this set!
profile.summary: Perfect for the builder/engineer aged 3 to about 6!

profile.description: Press to refresh - stop, drop and Chug - it's easy with the Contigo AUTOSPOUT Chug water bottle! with the press of a button, the Chug spout opens for convenient on-the-go one-handed drinking. You'll love the wide spout because the water flows quickly into your mouth (perfect for chugging when you need to Hydrate in a hurry). when you're finished drinking, simply press the spout under the protective cover to fully close for help protecting against leaks and germs. Rule #76: no excuses, Hydrate like a champion with the AUTOSPOUT Chug.
profile.reviewText:
This is a nice, lightweight but large water bottle. The spout is quite large compared to my other Contigo water bottles, and I wouldn't say it's necessarily conducive to "chugging" because somehow the flow doesn't just keep coming. Still, I do like the larger spout.

The water bottle is a very pretty lilac color, feels sturdy, and meant for on-the-go use. It has a clip to secure it to your gear, as well as a lock to prevent the spout from opening up when you need to it stay shut. With the press of the purple button on the lid, the spout flips up. You can push it back down to close it. Pretty simple and straight forward. It's definitely a good large size! And I liked that the neck is large enough for ice to easily get inside. There are measurements to track your water intake, and this bottle washes very easily--with no removable parts that might get lost.

Definitely recommended!
profile.summary: Another hit from Contigo!

profile.description: Featuring all the functionality and portability of the Chant BT, but with bigger, bolder sonic strength, the CHANT BT Sport works with Bluetooth enabled devices and many more through the auxiliary input. 2 x 4.5W, 1.75" and 2 x passive radiators assure a maximum listening experience. Plus, it's water-resistant for enhanced outdoor use. Take it with you everywhere, and build your own wall of sound.
profile.reviewText:
I'm pleasantly surprised by this little portable speaker. It sets up quickly and nicely, I had no trouble connecting it to my Galaxy S6. My phone bluetooth was already on, so it was a simple matter of powering the HoM speaker up and it instantly connected itself. The sound was impressive, given that this is a tiny little cylinder speaker. I played it for a few hours straight to break in the drivers. Putting it in a corner was especially helpful, as well as setting it on a sturdy table {I could tell a sound difference when I placed it on a stack of books}.

I will say that the sound quality is really very good, however it is light on the bass. That's fine by me, but if you like heavy bass on your music then consider that. I really love that this speaker fits in a cupholder! It also comes with a little carabiner that you can use to bring it on-the-go. It's lightweight and very portable. The charge also lasted a long while--I listened to a 5 hour audiobook all the way through!

If this is the type of speaker you're in the market for, look no further. This on is great. If anything changes I'll be sure to update my review accordingly. But so far, I'm quite pleasantly surprised.
profile.summary: Great portable--light on bass--bluetooth speaker!

profile.description: This Anolon Advanced 9-Piece Hard-Anodized Nonstick Cookware Set plus 2-Piece Bake ware Set features revolutionary Anolon Sure Grip handles, a combination of silicone rubber and durable stainless steel. The handles not only provide a comfortable grip, they are also oven safe to 400F. The cookware's heavy gauge, hard-anodized construction ensures efficient, even heat distribution for exceptional gourmet cooking performance. Restaurant tested by professional chefs, DuPont Autograph 2 inside and out delivers superior durability that stands up to the rigors of a professional kitchen. It's also metal utensil-safe and offers easy cleanup for added convenience. The break-resistant, dome-shaped tempered glass lids allow foods to be monitored during cooking without sacrificing heat or moisture. The two dishwasher-suitable cookie pans are oven safe to 500 F and provide the same exceptional food release, comfortable wide rims and Anolon Sure Grip handles for a comfortable grasp. Anolon Advanced cookware and bake ware offer a sophisticated professional look that will complement every kitchen. Bring the family to the table with delicious meals created with the perfect combo: locally sourced food and this efficient Anolon Advanced 9-Piece Hard Anodized Nonstick Cookware Set plus 2-Piece Bake ware Set. Enjoy chicken breasts browned on the stove and finished in the oven, paired with sauted vegetables from the garden. Use the generous stockpot to create homemade chicken stock or vegetable soups. Cook turkey meatballs and marinara in the covered saut pan. With the two cookie pans, finish up meals with hot-from-the-oven oatmeal raisin cookies that slide easily off this bake ware that is also a breeze to remove from the oven thanks to the wide rims featuring Anolon Sure Grip silicone handles. Create delicious meals with the exceptional even heat distribution of professional quality Anolon Advanced 9-Piece Cookware Set.
profile.reviewText:
This is my second set of Anolon pots & pans, I also have their Advanced Bronze set, and have been using that for a few years now. These pots and pans are nearly identical in function, just a few minor differences in shape.

Anolon's Advanced cookware is a delight to use in the kitchen, the non-stick surfaces are great and so easy to clean. Their pots and pans hold up well over months of use, in my opinion. I like the comfort grip silicone handles a lot, I never have to use a hot pad to lift lids. The glass lids are high quality, break resistant, and great to be able to see your food cooking.

These pots and pans are not recommended for dishwasher use, though I'm sure some people do, we have always hand washed them and all of our Anolon pans have remained in great condition. Again, they clean up so nicely, I've never had to really SCRUB or scrape at them.

This set comes with two baking sheets, which are heavy and slick. I've already used them several times and they still look new. I like the silicone handles, though you will still want to use hot pads to remove from the oven--obviously!--it makes it nice for moving still-hot pans around the kitchen after baking on them.

Again, this is my second set of Anolon Advanced pots and pans, and I think they're great. They're attractive and easy to clean, they function well--what more could we want? I personally prefer the look of my bronze Anolon set a bit more, but this is a matter of personal preference. They all function great, which is the important part! I would definitely recommend this set to someone looking for a new set of cookware in this price range. If I didn't answer your question, feel free to leave a comment and I'll do my best to answer!

UPDATE: 11/21/2013 I just wanted to pop in and say that I was really impressed with the baking sheets a couple nights ago. After baking some acorn squash on them, some of the butter & brown sugar boiled over into the pan while baking. The result was a horribly ugly looking black spot of baked on goo. I moaned and set to work washing it after dinner--as these sorts of baked on spots usually take a LOT of work to get off. TO my surprise, after about 10 seconds under hot water, the entire spot just SLID right off! There is a discoloration, just ever so slight, barely noticeable where the spot was, but I don't really care. It cleaned up so nicely! I'm still a fan of Analon pots & pans. Love them.
profile.summary: Anolon's Advanced are my favorite to use & clean

profile.description: The Bissell Lift-Off Deluxe Pet Upright Deep Cleaner features two machines in one: a full size deep cleaner for whole room cleaning, plus a portable spot cleaner for hard to reach areas. This 12 amp deep cleaner thoroughly removes deep down dirt and leaves your carpets beautifully groomed. The portable spot cleaner easily removes to clean stairs, upholstery, or car interiors. The powerful cleaning system includes a Built-In Hot Water Heater which heats water and cleaning solution to maximize cleaning effectiveness, 12 row Dual DirtLifter PowerBrushes which loosen and remove deep down dirt, and Surround Suction for edge to edge cleaning. EdgeSweep brushes clean along baseboards for full width cleaning. The convenient portable spot cleaner has a 5 foot flexible hose and two cleaning attachments. Use the Pet Stain Eraser Tool or the Tough Stain Tool for removing spots and stains and use the crevice tool to access narrow spaces or tight corners. Also comes with an 8 oz. Pet 2X chemical and the Pet Stain & Odor 22 oz. Trigger to help with your cleaning needs!
profile.reviewText:
This Bissell Lift-Off Deluxe Pet cleaner is the second Bissell 2-in-1 cleaner I've had the pleasure of using now, and I'm nothing short of impressed with both. The set up of this machine is simple, lift out of the box and secure the handle to the machine. Fill the tank according to the directions. Just like that, you're ready to get cleaning!

I was excited to test the spot cleaner first so I started with that on my first use, and just like the other Bissell 2-in-1 machine (the Lift-Off Deep Cleaner 94Y2) it performed perfectly. You simply lift it off the rest of the machine, the power cord, hose, and brush all come with it. Filling the tank is simple enough, too, and I've found I can easily spot treat several spots with half a tank. The suction on the little spot cleaner is great, too, very strong and I can see the dirt coming up through the clear portion of the head. With two small children, two dogs, and two cats--I have to say, having the spot cleaner AND a full upright cleaner is wonderful! We whip this thing out all the time when drinks get spilled or cats throw up and such.

What a great product, instead of renting those beasts they carry at the grocery store we now have our own carpet cleaner for those few times a year we completely clean every square inch of carpeting. But this product isn't a waste since, despite only doing a thorough cleaning a few times a year, we're using the portable spot cleaner part ALL the TIME! And boy, has it saved us a lot of heartache since we have two little ones and four pets.

The spot cleaner's scrub brush is manually operated, so running and moving this machine does take a certain amount of physical fitness (I wouldn't pick this as a gift for my 90 year old grandmother!) but it's also a lot more compact than those rentable machines we had been using for years--during which time we probably spent way more money renting those machines than we would have just buying our own, too!

As for the upright carpet cleaning function, I've again been nothing but impressed with the Bissell Lift-Off. First you run the machine applying cleaning solution and hot water (yes, it heats the water!) and then you go back over the wet carpet as the machine scrubs and suctions up the water. Of course, your carpet will still be damp after use, that's to be expected. However, the suction on both the upright and spot cleaner portions have been excellent. We live in Colorado, so it's naturally dry here and our carpets seem to dry within an hour or two. In more humid climates, I guess it could take longer.

Also having the portable cleaner for furniture and car interiors is absolutely fantastic! I've already used this on old upholstered chairs we've inherited and it's been a dream to have around. I have yet to try this one in the car, but our other Bissell Lift-Off performed excellent there as well.

I think this company makes a great carpet cleaner, we've been so happy with it. It removes stains with ease, even some I was convinced would never come out, and leaves our carpets smelling fresh and looking great. The 2-in-1 feature, however, is the final straw with this Bissell that makes it so worth it! I've been surprised at how often I've found myself using it, and every time I pull it out I am reminded of how thankful I am to have it.
profile.summary: These new Bissell 2-in-1 machines are the way to go!

profile.description: The Hoover Air Cordless Hand Vac powers through every day messes with fade-free cordless convenience. Pick up around furniture and stairs with the Powered Turbo Tool, then use the crevice tool to get into tight spots with ease. For advanced versatility, simply fit the lightweight hand vac into an Air Cordless 2-in-1 to cover carpets and hard floors. And you can even use the interchangeable 20V Lithium Life Battery with any product powered by Lithium Life Battery Technology.
profile.reviewText:
This little vacuum impressed me in that it was able to pick up a coin, a cotton swab, a large piece of Easter candy foil (darn kids!), and lots of other stuff that I wasn't sure it would. It sets up easily and the lithium battery seems to last a long time. The canister is easy to see into and empty easily. It comes with two attachments as well as the battery and charger. The filter needs to be rinsed every 4-6 uses, and that's printed right on the filter so you see it every time you empty it. This handy little vacuum has been so helpful with cleaning the couch and ceiling fans, as well as all the other crazy messed you end up with when you have kids and pets. I like to use it at the end of the day just to touch up the house on days where I don't do a detailed cleaning of the floors. But it's a handy device to have on hand for those unexpected messes, for sure. Oh, and cleaning up the car a bit! The narrow attachment helps with that, and the spinning carpet attachment is great for the mats. If you have any questions I did not answer, feel free to leave a comment.

I think it's great, it works well, and seems to be well designed. I honestly cannot think of a reason not to recommend it.
profile.summary: Simple, strong little vacuum!

profile.description: Desk top aquarium kit featuring a seamless, contemporary look and LED lighting technology and includes Tetra' s whisper filtration.
profile.reviewText:
This is a really decent starter aquarium. After I bought a betta and put him in a 1/2 gallon tank - research on bettas quickly informed me that 1/2 gallon is WAY too small for a betta to thrive. 1.5 gallons is pretty much the accepted minimum (although some fish enthusiasts say 5 gallons!) My fish, after a month in the 1/2 gallon tank, was clamping his beautiful fins and spending all day facing a corner - obviously he was stressed. Already, after a few hours in this bigger tank, he's already showing signs of improvement.

I like the clear lid,as my smaller tank was partially open and my cat drank from it, which is not good and can give your betta diseases. Upon setting the aquarium up the air pump didn't work, and I read several reviews on other sites with the same complaint. Luckily, my technical minded geek of a husband was able to fix it by taking it apart (somehow he "took the motor housing apart and fixed a gap, hard to explain"). But hey, it's working now so I'm satisfied. It's also really quiet.

For bettas, I would recommend not using the plastic plants that come with this aquarium. Plastic plants often rip their beautiful fins, so you really should go with a live plant and they love to hide with live plants so this is important. Also, purchase some gravel for the bottom of the tank.

This aquarium is attractive and basic, as far as aquariums in this price range go. I really like the storage compartment which is perfect for keeping the food in. I also wouldn't recommend keeping the light on all day. For a betta 8 hours would be good, as they like some light but they also like to sleep at night, so give them a break.

Overall I would recommend this as a great starter aquarium, it would be a very good set up for one fish for a child's room, the office, etc.

UPDATE: January 2011, upon cleaning this tank we noticed a crack in the acrylic that was indeed leaking. While we were disappointed with the crack I admit this may have been my fault as one time during that water change I lifted from the top. This tank has grip handles on the bottom, and so I must suggest you life this tank ONLY from the bottom grips so as to not stress the acrylic! I was very pleased to receive a hassle free exchange for a new tank, no questions asked.
profile.summary: Great Starter Aquarium - Notes for Bettas
