profile.description: Were hooked on lemon water, but not so keen on letting the chemicals or bacteria that could be on the peel mix in with the good stuff. Just use the removable juicer to add the refreshing, mouth-puckering, healthy zing we all love.
profile.reviewText:
I think this water bottle might really be a hit for someone looking for a specific type of water bottle. For me, there are some draw backs, but I'm still using it and liking it for a few reasons.

First, let me say, the idea is that you use the built in reamer to squeeze in fresh lemon in a sanitary way. You are NOT supposed to just leave the lemon IN the water bottle, that would make it incredibly hard to drink from this water bottle since water flows back through the reamer portion when you drink from this water bottle.

The yellow reamer is removable, the first time removing it is the hardest and there is a clear band that can come off--but I suggest leaving it there and just removing the yellow reamer. To put it back on, it fits in a specific spot so twist it on until you feel it engage. The reamer also means you have another piece to clean. BUT, another nice feature is that you can use more than just lemons in your water, as the reamer acts as a filter in both directions. Keeps lemon seeds out, or keeps other water flavorings in! I like that I can add cucumber, mint, raspberries, etc. into the water bottle and the reamer will keep those things inside. This makes this water bottle highly versatile and perfect for those who want "spa water" on the go.

The cap is nice and solid, twists on and off, and has a handle portion that makes this heavy water bottle easier to carry with you. Yes, it is a heavy water bottle, as the cup is made of solid thick glass. Add water to it and it's even heavier. But those who are anti-plastic will really love this glass bottle.

There is a rubber bumper at the bottom, which is removable for cleaning, but provides a nice cushion to protect your glass bottle. It's glass, of course, under the right circumstances it can break.

Drinking from this bottle is great when there is fresh lemon involved, I've never been one for lemon water but I'm trying to eat healthier these days and I find that lemon water really does help curb my cravings! That said, this water bottle is a little annoying to drink from because...

1. Water does not flow quickly due to the reamer and the small spout. This is a water bottle ideal for sipping from, not chugging. It's not a fast, satisfying flow, but a great sipping bottle. There IS a vent for allowing air in, however it's quite small.
2. The lid is sort of domed in shape in order to allow room for the reamer. This gets in the way of my nose and so I have to tip my entire head back to drink water, which makes swallowing harder. This might sound silly the way I'm wording it, but it really does hamper the drinking experience (especially while driving) since you have to tilt your entire head and can't just take a swig with the flick of a wrist like any other small water bottle. Again, ideal for sipping, not chugging.

This water bottle is fairly large, and just *barely* fits in my car's cupholder. It fits so snugly that sometimes the removable bottom piece comes off when I'm pulling it out of my cupholder.

I still enjoy the lemon reamer feature and will continue to use this water bottle. I like the idea, I like the glass and the design, I just wish it were a little easier to drink from.

This water bottle is ideal for those who don't need a lightweight water bottle, it's ideal for sippers--not chuggers--and obviously: it's PERFECT for people who have to have fresh lemon in their water. The nice little built in reamer means you can add lemon in a clean way, without seeds and without tossing an entire, dirty wedge in your glass. Feel free to leave any questions in the comments below, I'll do my best to answer!
profile.summary: How it works... 3.5 stars--perfect for "spa water"

profile.description: The Fi-Shock Portable Paddock is a portable electric fence that can be quickly set up to contain up to five horses at a time. Use it at horse shows, polo matches, wagon trails or any other situation in which temporary fencing is required. Enough fencing is included to set up a 50 ft x 50 ft single line enclosure or a 25 ft x 25 ft double line enclosure capable of containing your horses for a short period of time. The battery-operated Fi-Shock Portable Paddock packs up into a lightweight canvas shoulder bag for ease of transport to your next event. Batteries are not included.
profile.reviewText:
I haven't owned a portable fence for horses until now, but I am impressed and liking this product very much. Upon opening the package I was happy with the portability of the carrying bag, and shocked at how lightweight and compact this system is. It's a great accessory to throw in the trailer when taking the horses out, or just to have around in the event that we need a temporary corral for a couple horses. Once set up, it won't hold more than two of our horses comfortably. I don't think we'd ever try and manage to get 4 inside like the product advertises!

The instructions were surprisingly simple and it set up easily between myself and my husband working on it. I can see how this would be great to have for other animals as well (such as alpacas), but we only have need for it with the horses and have had success in containing them.  The step in posts are fantastically designed, the overall design makes the fence very versatile, setting up easily pretty much anywhere your horse an go.

We're very happy with it's design and portability and will get a lot of good use out of this system, I think!
profile.summary: Easy Setup, Nice Design

profile.description: Barbie delivers a new twist on hair! With extra long locks -- 9 inches of hair -- and an easy-to-use tool to twist and style with ease, Barbie doll is ready for a new fabulous look created by you! Barbie doll's long, pink and purple streaked hair includes four pieces with colorful beads attached. Snap the beads into the included hair tool, choosing two or three beads, and press the button on the tool to twist the hair in an instant. It's so much fun and adds to creative hairstyling expression! The possibilities are endless. Get even more creative with the included accessories that include a brush, tiara and three barrettes. Decorated with signature details, the wear-and-share hair clips can also be worn by you! Create a fabulous look -- play out a storytelling moment -- then take the hairstyle down, brush out and start again. There are endless ways to style Barbie doll's hair to match the endless stories to be told. Barbie doll is ready for anything in a sparkly pink dress with a detailed statement necklace, ombre bodice, hi-lo skirt, glittery overlay and matching shoes. For even more hair-play fun, collect all of the dolls and pets from the Endless Hair Kingdom (each sold separately, subject to availability) -- the hair tool sold with the Snap N Style Princess Doll works with hair beads across the line. Set includes Barbie doll wearing fashion and accessories, the styling tool, one brush, one tiara and three wear-and-share barrettes. Doll cannot stand alone. Colors and decorations may vary.
profile.reviewText:
I got this for my daughter's 5th birthday and she seems to love it. She's that pink-princess-loving type and loves doing hair (helps that mom is a hairstylist) so this is right up her alley. It comes with lots of accessories for styling her super long hair!

That said, I'm a little disappointed this doll arrived--and I mean still in the box, unopened, never played with--with 5, YES FIVE, black smudges on her face. They're very small, but noticeable. Like she's been scuffed up and yet never played with. Magic Eraser helped a bit, but honestly it takes away a bit from the unwrapping birthday gifts experience to see your toy is ALREADY damaged/defective, and you haven't even played with it yet! If it weren't for her fancy dress, this Barbie would look like a street urchin.

Quality control, Mattel, please.
profile.summary: Great except for the SMUDGY FACE!

profile.description: The Serta Perfect Sleeper Manford Plush features Sertas exclusive SmartSurface, which works to provide pressure relieving comfort and a balanced sleep temperature right at the sleep surface. This model features a layer of our exclusive Cool Twist Gel Memory Foam; an exclusive liquid gel-enhanced memory foam designed to help move heat away from your body, helping to promote a balanced sleep temperature. In addition, two layers of our Serta PillowSoft Foam, an extra-soft foam which gently contours the body to provide enhanced cushioning, provides additional support. Support is provided by our Free Flex Innerspring with Custom Support and Total Edge Foam Encasement. Patented and exclusive TrueSense coil design helps promote undisturbed sleep by adjusting to support you while reducing motion transfer. Our Custom Support promotes proper back support with up to 25% more support in the center third of the innerspring, where you need it most. Finally, a custom designed version of our Total Edge Foam Encasement system provides the flexibility needed to use the mattress with an adjustable foundation, while also helping to prevent roll-off or sag at the edge of the mattress.
profile.reviewText:
So I'm a member of the Amazon Vine program, and I got this mattress for free, which was great. I feel like this was meant to be, in a way. See, my husband and I have been married for 10 years, and we'd been on the SAME mattress until recently, we knew we really had to update for the sake of our backs--BUT, we really didn't have much to spend on a new mattress. So, we went to IKEA and checked out their mattresses. The sales lady at IKEA talked us up about how their mattresses were great and the best in consumer reports and all that jazz. In the end, we bought an inexpensive, and what I felt was comfortable, queen mattress for ourselves. And that mattress was just fine!

Then, a  few months later, I learn that I am to have the pleasure of reviewing a SERTA mattress for Amazon. I am thankful and feeling blessed for the opportunity, let me tell you. The IKEA mattress was fine and a good upgrade from our 10-year-old used mattress we had prior. It was about $300.

Enter THIS Serta Perfect Sleeper mattress. Okay, so honestly we weren't coming from much, having a 10yo mattress followed by a cheapo IKEA mattress. That said--and make of this what you will--the Serta mattress is heaven on earth! The memory foam and coolig technology has definitely made for some comfortable nights. We've enjoyed it very much. It is one-sided and VERY soft and plush.

In a way, going from a bad to a so-so to a GREAT mattress over the course of a few weeks helped us see what we were missing out on. This mattress is VERY comfortable. It's high, our bed is higher to get on than before. It's not too firm, not to cushy. My husband likes firm, and I like cushy. This is the perfect in-between for both of us. I like it very much, can't think of a reason not to recommend it!
profile.summary: I feel spoiled on this mattress!

profile.description: Being a Mom is a full-time job. You're the queen of budget tracking and meal planning, juggler of multiple schedules and deadlines, and an all-around miracle worker. Designed with busy households like yours in mind, Mead Organizher products help bring all of the hats you wear together under one coordinated system that allows you to organize, track and plan, so keeping up with the pace of family life is easier and less stressful. The Organizher Expense Tracker is an undated, reusable planner that allows you to keep track of what's coming in and going out, with 12 monthly pockets, Tech Lock rings and folders for bills and receipts, bank statements and other printouts. 8.5 x 11 inch page size with a .5mm durable pink poly cover.
profile.reviewText:
This sort of pen & paper budgeting system is becoming obsolete for some, with the availability of apps and computer programs to help us do this without the use of pen & paper. However, if you are one who likes to have it written down, and you need a simple expense tracker, then this should work just fine.

Personally, I wasn't too big of a fan of it's design. It's floppy and I found the two closure straps to be annoying. (I know it sounds lazy to complain about two closure straps, but when I was using this organizer it just bothered me.) It's a very simple expense tracker too. If you have a LARGE budget system that requires lots of details, this one isn't for you. If you have a simple budget, a few monthly bills and a handful of receipts, then this should be the right size.

I can't say I love this product, but I won't completely write it off--some folks might find this one to be just perfect for their needs. For mine, it's so-so.
profile.summary: Either you need it or you don't

profile.description: Fellowes, the leader in laminating products, delivers the best performance and quality to preserve and protect important documents. Fellowes laminators can be used in the home, office, or classroom for creating quick, long-lasting professional and fun projects. You can make menus, signs and posters durable. Quickly and easily laminate photos, business cards, picture cards, and certificates. Create bookmarks, calendars, flash cards, or jewelry with ease. Fellowes laminators feature robust roller systems for quick, consistent lamination and quality throughput at high speeds. By providing the best laminator technology we ensure smooth, high quality laminating results.
profile.reviewText:
I've owned laminators before, but this baby is BIG! It takes up significant space in my studio. It should be noted that I am a professional artist/crafter, and I work in a studio in my home. I frequently use laminators, not just for my work but also because I homeschool and so laminating is a BIG thing for me. Homeschooling three kids means I can laminate every important worksheet and paper without having to worry about it getting ruined and ripped while it's being used between child one, child two, and child three.

This Venus 2 laminator by Fellowes is larger than my other Fellowes laminator. Both work perfectly well. They do regular as well as "cold" laminating (which involves pressing a laminating pouch without heat, just sticky pouches).

THIS Venus 2 laminator can laminate large pouches for large projects. it heats up a LOT faster than my other laminator (Fellowes "Saturn") and that's really nice. If this is for a school or business, I highly recommend this one over my other laminator just due to how fast it heats up. The other one takes several long minutes. It's a very sleek machine, and impressive quality--though heavier and bulkier to store.

I do wish they would include a feed tray for laminators. I know it'd add bulk, (though a pull-out one would be ideal) and the extra tray for holding items that come out the back that's included is great! But holding laminating pouches steady and wrinkle-free while manually feeding into the laminator can put me on edge!

Overall, I think this is a great lamintor. Definitely more of a heavy duty machine in comparison to other Fellowes laminators. I can't think of a reason not to recommend it.
profile.summary: Heats up fast homeschool buddy!

profile.description: The Nighthawk X8 AC5300 Smart Wi-Fi Router is the next wave in Wi-Fi. With Tri-Band Quad Stream performance, delivers combined wireless speeds of up to 5.3 Gbps. Four external Active Antennas combined with four internal antennas amplify and maximize Wi-Fi range. X8's Powerful 1.4GHz Dual Core Processor gives you a high-performance networking engine for faster connections. Aggregate 2 of the 6 Gigabit ports to double your wired speeds to network attached storage. Quad-Stream with MU-MIMO support allows you to enjoy simultaneous streaming to your devices for speeds up to 4x faster than traditional Wi-Fi.
profile.reviewText: This router is the real thing.  It is an awesome 802.11ac Wave 2 router.  It features 6 gigabit speed ethernet ports (most routers only feature 4), two of which can be aggregated when connected to supporting equipment (NAS, servers, etc).  For setup, you can use a browser or a handy-dandy app.  The app features wifi analytics to look at channel usage, overhead, etc as well as has a speed test to test the wireless speed to the router from various rooms (extremely helpful).  Finally, it has all the other bells and whistles you could ask for USB port for printer, storage, etc, built-in VPN, advanced wireless settings.  All in all, it has great speed, excellent performance, and is a worthy investment.
profile.summary: A wifi router worth getting

profile.description: Iceberg Maxx Legroom folding table. Extreme quality in a table that meets every commercial and institutional need. Innovative open corner leg design eliminates the need for a cross bar - providing maximum leg room and seating capacity. Single cam, one-hand leg fold release, saves set-up time. Folds flat for compact storage. Bumpers protect tables when stacked. Extremely durable table. Non-mar feet. Table surface is made of thermal fused melamine laminate. Measures 60-inches length by 18-inches width by 29-1/2-inches height. Available in gray finish.
profile.reviewText:
This table is very sturdy and stable. It would make a perfect table for a small printing area in an office, I could think of many uses for it. A drink table at a party, a small desk for office use, a homeschooling table for up to two students, a temporary buffet at a large holiday meal. A table this narrow yet sturdy has many possible uses!

You could not really sit people at the ends, note that as desk use this table is really only good for up to two people, and even then they wouldn't have much room to spread out papers or anything. It arrived intact, though it is surprisingly heavy for a folding table! That's okay, it is obviously quality made and can hold a fair share of weight. I think I'll move it into my studio office and use it to hold my laminator and printer. It's tall enough for my small filing cabinet to fit under too.

If you're in the market for this type of small folding table, I can't think of a reason not to recommend this one!
profile.summary: Quality and useful size!

profile.description: The Ottomanson comfy throw is elegantly made with soft cozy high filament micro-plush. This creates a luxurious feel of velvet that will leave you feeling like royalty during your rest or sleep. The 49 inch x 61 inch inches throw comes in 7 vivid colors: chocolate, teal, Cappuccino, gray, red, and Lavender.
profile.reviewText:
This throw blanket is among the softest out there, and very cushy and plush for the price. You get what you pay for, it's true. You can get similar, larger soft throws at Walmart for about the same price, but this doesn't have that sherpa backside that balls up with washes.

It is not the largest throw, pay attention to the measurements before you order, but it is large enough for one adult to get cozy under. It has a velveteen look to it, and a super soft warm texture. For the price, and given the pretty color and quality, I think it is quite nice. Would make an excellent gift especially for the elderly person in your life. They're always cold.
profile.summary: Very soft, plush throw but on the smaller side!

profile.description: Give bakery flair to your homemade muffins, cupcakes and more. These trendy tulip-style pleated baking cups add elegance to any baked treat with no added grease. Includes 15 baking cups. Fits standard muffin/cupcake pan.
profile.reviewText:
This is a good, well priced set of four Wilton products for cake decorators or home bakers. Wilton is a well-known brand for cake decorating supplies. About a decade ago, I took all of the Wilton cake decorating courses at a craft store. It was so much fun to learn, and I've saved a ton of money by being able to create my own kids' birthday cakes, as well as impressive tiered cakes for friends and family. I don't do it as a business, but I am a skilled cake decorator.

That said, 3/4 of these items are nice to have but not crucial to the baker. The cake tester is nice, I suppose. But weren't we all used using a toothpick to test cakes? This tool replaces a toothpick. So it is sort of...silly? It is thinner than a toothpick, I'll give you that. It is also the best thing to reset electronic devices that have gone on the fritz. Ha.

The "baker's blade" is a glorified bench scraper. You can scoop with it, and the blade is sharper than your average bench scraper. But that's about it, and I have yet to find it especially handy.

The parchment paper is very good quality. Opening it is a little frustrating. But it's good parchment paper. I've never found the need to buy a special brand of parchment paper, however. This stuff is as good as the generic parchment paper I buy regularly at Kroger. But it makes a nice addition to this bundle, I suppose.

Now the true joy of this bundle is the cake lifter. Yes, you should get one of these if you bake layered cakes regularly. Sure, you can use (waste) an extra cake board to do the same work of lifting. And this cake lifter will only go so far--for example, not as helpful lifting a 9 x 13 sheet cake, due to its size. But most smaller round or square cake layers can be lifted with this cake lifter to help you construct your layers. This is the item in this bundle that I'm most excited about.

Wilton makes good quality, affordable cake decorating and baking supplies. I can't think of a reason not to recommend this bundle, if you're in the market for these things. It would also make an excellent gift for the young, new baker in your life.
profile.summary: The cake lifter is the true star in this bundle. Great gift for the new baker!

profile.description: The Pineapple has long been recognized as a symbol of hospitality and warm welcome. Welcome others to your home with this two-piece brass Pineapple tumbler, a unique serving piece for a well-crafted cocktail.
profile.reviewText:
This arrived and I unboxed it, examined it, made observations, and put it back away until I went to review it. That's when I noticed some of the other reviews, and apparently quality has been an issue for this in the past. So I got it back out for closer inspection, curious to see if my piece had some of the same flaws or perhaps they've been updating, improving the quality after initial reviews?

My golden pineapple appeared to be an improvement from what I saw in other people's photos. No scratches on the bottom, just a stamped pineapple image. The gold is in good shape, no chipping or scratching. And the leaves seemed more polished and refined than the duds people photo'd. So I'm not sure if I got lucky, or if they actually improved their manufacturing of this product?

That said, I'm surprised they pitch this as a tumbler for cocktails. I like it much more as a decoration, possibly a nice candy dish (if it weren't for the smell, more on that in a sec) or keep for cotton balls or something in the bathroom. Drinking out of this? No thanks. The thing smells! I washed it to see if that would help, and it did take away the strength of the smell, but it still smells. Like, plastic chemicals or something, not sure how to describe it, but something tells me not to each or drink out of this. Also, the lip for holding on the lid in place makes it not such a great sipping edge. And who buys a $25 cocktail tumbler for each person they plan on serving? Not practical, unless you're loaded. Most party stores have affordable plastic drinking pineapples.

As I said, I like this much more as just a decoration or a storage decoration. Candy dish, great, maybe for wrapped candies so the smell doesn't permeate the candy. It would make a charming little hostess gift for the pineapple-lover in your life. It comes in a great box with tropical leaves and a gold pineapple and logo.

I don't hate it, I like it, but it's not perfect and I don't think it's for food and drink! You'll have to decided if it's the right decor or gift for your needs.
profile.summary: Great for decor, not so much for eating/drinking from - hostess gift?

profile.description: The premium grain pigskin leather gloves by Dickies offer a fleece lining as the glove's interior providing a warm and cozy insulation. This glove also features a comfortable extended knit wrist with a continuous pull strap making it a breeze to slip on! Size: Large
profile.reviewText:
What is not to love about these? They are soft, seem well made, and the price point is perfect for me! They make an excellent gift or stocking stuffer. I love the soft, warm lining on the inside, some gloves just leave you to feel the jagged inseams. Not these. The cuff is soft but not loose. The pigskin material is also soft and very pliable. They also seem pretty durable, though if something changes I'll update my review. I got these for my husband and he likes them a lot. But I tried them on myself and might just have to buy myself a pair as well? Though my husband has larger hands than mine and these were a great fit for him.

If I buy myself a pair...does that mean I'll have to help out more with the yard work and such?
profile.summary: Perfect! Search no further.

profile.description: The Rainbow 20 Piece is a great starter set with more square. All MagWorld sets offer learning that's cleverly disguised as fun so play promotes important S.T.E.M. skills. Kids are intrigued and engaged the moment they see and touch these 3D magnetic tiles and play develops critical math concepts, geometric shape recognition, geometry skills, special awareness, and early engineering skills. This Set includes twelve (12) small squares, and eight (8) equilateral triangles, plus and Idea Sheet is included to get you started. Built for safe play, from top-quality, high resistance plastics that will not break or crack. Each shape is sized proportionately allowing the tiles to adhere magnetically on all edges. Creative play flows naturally from two-dimensional designs to complex three-dimensional structures. Children discover how squares and triangles can be composed to form pictures, complex shapes, and imaginative buildings. MagWorld Magnetic Building Sets provide parents and educators with a concrete, manipulative S.T.E.M. tool. Equally engaging for kids from pre-K through later elementary school, the basic geometric shapes included in MagWorld sets allow children to build 2D (flat) patterns and designs, as well as to create 3D (solid) forms, thanks to magnetic attraction. Manufactured to the highest quality standards. Every magnet is kept safe and secure in Sonic welded, BPA free, HQABS plastic, and secured with grommets for the utmost security, providing a safe, long-lasting play experience. Appropriate for children age 3+. Engaging for children of all ages. Tiles stack one on top of the other so cleanup is a snap!.
profile.reviewText:
These are great! There is a huge set of these at our local natural history museum in the children's exhibit, and my kids have always loved them. This is a nice set you can bring home, not too large, but I notice they make other boxed sets so you can always expand.

The colorful plastic pieces are square or triangular, and they snap together with magnets. You can create all sorts of things, my personal favorite being houses and castles. This is such a great sensory, building toy for little ones. As a mother of three with a basement full of toys, let me tell you that THIS is exactly the sort of thing you want to bring into the home. This is the sort of education toy that kids will keep going back to day after day. So many toys these days are practically one-time-use before kids are bored and move on. But creative, ever-changing things like this set are golden. A+
profile.summary: This is the sort of education toy you fill your house with!

profile.description: Incipio impact absorbing Octane case is precision engineered with a rigid Plextonium polycarbonate back Shell and a shock absorbent TPU textured bumper. Finished with a frosted transparent back and contrasting colorful bumper, the Octane case takes protection to the next level.
profile.reviewText:
This case is a nice, slimmer version. You can really bulk up and get chunky protective gear these days, but this isn't that. It's not the sleekest I've seen, but it's closer to that end. Not bulky at all. The sides are bright blue and have nice grip due to the geometric pattern in them. The buttons work just fine with this case, I had no problems whatsoever.

My one and only qualm is that the backside--which looks grey but is really a frosted clear--isn't very grippy. The frosted texture means it's slippery on the backside. This contrasts with the good grip on the colorful edge. If you don't like slippery cases, maybe think twice about this one. But overall it's a great case for the price.
profile.summary: Great case, grip, and buttons--but slippery backside

profile.description: Introduce a whimsical note on your kitchen table, dinner space, patio, porch and picnic tables with our charming polka dot design round tablecloth with decorative white polka dot motif popping on the red base to create a stylish contemporary foundation for every meal as well as visual appeal. Available in a rich assortment of sizes and shapes for an ideal fit to your space, this multi-purpose tablecloth is great for Thanksgiving Gatherings, Christmas Holiday, New Years Dining, Parties, Babyshowers, Picnics, Happy hours, Potlucks, Barbecues, Camping, Trips, Restaurants, Cafeterias and Caterings. Suitable for everyday usage as well as indoor and outdoor dining activities, this practical yet attractive piece will add extra joy and touch of delight to the taste of your meals and fun times. With large scope of application, these lovely and budget-friendly tablecloths also make great gifts for birthdays, holidays and new homebuyer visits. Durable and super easy to clean with minimal effort, this cozy tablecloth preserves your table from damages and stain while offering a carefree maintenance feasibility. Just wipe clean using mild soap with damp cloth or sponge on vinyl surface of this tablecloth for best results, which will help it remain attractive and serviceable for a long time. Laundering and ironing is not recommended. This premium-quality robust and reusable tablecloth covers worn and dated tables with spill and waterproof performance and keeps your tabletops free of spills and stains. As a protective layer, slippery and smooth vinyl surface promotes a breeze-like cleaning and a crisp look. All these exclusive features and designs will make this tablecloth the envy of your friends!
profile.reviewText:
This is a cute tablecloth print, but it's not my favorite vinyl tablecloth. I have a few basic complaints:

- Out of the package it was stinky in the vinyl sort of way. I buy other vinyl/plastic seasonal tablecloths at Walmart regularly, and do not pick up on any smell from those.
- The edges are unfinished. This really is a basic "tablecloth" or rather, cut piece of fuzzy backed vinyl. The edges are raw, there is no edging, hemming, or trimming. The corners are not curved. It is very basic in that sense.
- Spaghetti sauce stained it. I feel like the whole point of having a vinyl or plastic tablecloth is so that things just wipe off and stains don't happen. But right away mine became stained with spaghetti sauce. I used Dawn, magic erasers, and elbow grease, but the stain won't budge.

Isn't that the whole point of plastic/vinyl tablecloths!? To wipe clean and not stain?!

Anyway, the print is cute, the material is thick, and the price is good. But I won't really be holding on to this for long because I have three kids, and we eat spaghetti regularly.
profile.summary: Stained, Smelly, and Raw

profile.description: Unique creme to powder foundation formula uses Vincent Longo's patented process to deliver flawless, breathable coverage, while hydrating and nourishing skin. Ultra lightweight and refreshing liquid or powder texture. Contains 75% micro water and seaweed extract to hydrate and nourish skin plus vitamin E to protect skin from free radical damage that causes lines and wrinkles. Oil free. Good for all skin types.
profile.reviewText:
First thing I noticed about this foundation was the price. Wowzers. I haven't spent that much on one beauty product in forever. Or maybe even never. The second thing I noticed was the rave reviews, and so I was really excited to try this. I'm no newbie to makeup, having started wearing heavy makeup as a pre-teen and now being a licensed cosmetologist.

That said, I'm also on a budget, a stay-at-home-mom now with three kids, so I don't have the money to spend on department store brands. I've been using mostly drugstore makeup, or the makeup I can buy at professional salon supply stores, for years now. My go-to foundations have ALWAYS been liquid Covergirl or L'Oreal. I always also use the very lightest shade. When I was a teen, my mom liked to spoil me with nice department store makeup, but brands like Clinique and Lancome never had a shade pale enough for me that wasn't also yellow/orange in the natural daylight. So, I've always been content with the liquid foundations from drugstore brands. I've always worn heavy foundation too.

I have extremely PALE, pink, Swedish skin. My skin is dry, I have had a handful of hormonal pimples over my entire life. My biggest struggle is exfoliating and moisturizing my dry skin, especially in my dry state of Colorado. I wasn't sure this "cream to powder" foundation would be right for me, but after reading the reviews I was eager to give it a try.

When this foundation arrived, the first thing I noticed was that the shade was just not right. I'd read the reviews and heard that Bisque was good for fair skin, but MY extremely pale Swedish skin would not have it. It looked orange to me, and I would have looked like an oomp-loompa wearing this shade. I've used enough makeup in the past to know immediately that this was not my shade. I was so disappointed but still wanted to try this product out in my shade! I'd been intrigued by the awesome reviews. So I took it to my local Vincent Longo counter to try out the other shades. Sure enough, the makeup artist helped me find that the lightest (of course) shade called Porcelain was the best on my skin. Before purchasing, you might want to go to the actual local Vincent Longo counter to have them test the shades on you before settling on one. Bisque was far too dark on me. Upon hearing my plight and seeing I had an unused product in the wrong shade, the Vincent Longo makeup artist insisted on an even exchange do that I could use and review this makeup properly. I ended up taking home the Porcelain shade to use--same product, different shade. On that note, can I also say that this company's customer service was above and beyond?

I am so happy to have found this foundation! My only concern is that my budget had previously allowed for a $10 Covergirl foundation. But this Vincent Longo has knocked my socks off!

Though you can apply this foundation with a foundation brush, I like heavier coverage so I use a sponge applicator. I circle the sponge over the foundation pot--the product description says to never puncture the surface!--and then wipe it in a downward motion on my face. I use a drugstore brand primer first, of course. I also make sure my face is well exfoliated and moisturized too.

This foundation applies like a dream! It's cool to the touch and feels like air! It's made me re-think how heavy I wear my foundation. Liquid foundation is a thing of the past for me now, I think.

I don't know HOW they made this foundation, but it amazes me. It glides on, giving me coverage, reducing my redness in my nose and cheeks, but it feels like I'm wearing no makeup whatsoever. Then, when I hold my magnifying mirror up to my face, I swear I can't see anything on my skin. They made this foundation to look just like skin on your skin. It's amazing! It doesn't shift, it doesn't settle into fine lines and creases. It just gives a nice, sheer coverage. Surprisingly, this light coverage is just enough coverage for me--and I was previously the type who liked to cover my skin well for a even-tone look. This product evens my tone without being heavy or making me look like a fake porcelain doll. It lets my natural skin shine through, giving a weightless, even coverage over what I don't want seen.

I use a translucent face powder--oh so lightly--to set this foundation. It lasts all day (though I have always made a conscious effort not to touch my face much during the day). My only complaint? I don't know how--or if--I can ever go back to my $10 foundation again. I can't! I'm hooked on this Vincent Longo. I also had the pleasure of trying out their blush--and I love that product too.

Here I've avoided department store makeup for a long time, but this is one brand where--if you have the budget--it really is better than drugstore brands. I'm not at all surprised at all the other glowing reviews. I've been using this foundation for a couple weeks now, and I still keep looking closely in the mirror to marvel at how it just looks like my SKIN.

Highly recommended by me! And the Bisque shade seems to make a lot of people happy. My best advice, however, before ordering, is to go to your local Vincent Longo makeup artist and test out those shades first. Once you find the right one, you're bound to be happy.
profile.summary: How will I ever go back to my $10 drugstore foundation???

profile.description: The Music Alley 3 Piece Kids Drum Kit is the ideal drum set for aspiring rock stars. This affordable, high quality kit is scaled down to perfectly accommodate children from 3-7 years of age. The set comes with everything you need to get started, including three different drums to jam on. The bass is the largest drum of the collection, and its low tone is perfect for playing together with the foot pedal. The hanging tom-tom drums add an extra bang. In addition to the drums, the crash cymbal is great for adding a different type of sound. The lightweight drumsticks and the cushioned chair (also known as drum throne) add extra comfort for any young prodigy to rock out for hours-the perfect buy for a child's first percussion instrument!
profile.reviewText:
This little drum set is the real deal. Or, at least, it feels like it. It's definitely made for LITTLE ones. Toddlers and small children (maybe ages 2-6) is the ideal size. The price seems really good for all that you get. It's a complete little kid starter drum set. It's cute too!

It goes together pretty easily, took me about 20 minutes to assemble it all. It includes drumsticks and a little stool. There's a tom-tom, a snare drum, a cymbal, and a bass drum. All the drums arrived safely and worked well. You do have to assemble the bass drum, which is putting on the front and back and screwing everything down. Once it's all set up, you've got a legit little noisemaker!

If you're in the market for a drumset for a little one, this is a great inexpensive set.
profile.summary: Great little noisemaker for the child ages 2-6

profile.description:
Elevate your art and craft with charming vintage-inspired rubber stamp sets. These beautiful rubber stamps in style are perfect for personal correspondence (thank you, get well notes), scrapbooks, journals, classroom projects, homework grading, and everyday embellishments. 

Great gift for teachers, graphic designers, bird lovers, the writers in your life, or some with a creative mind!
profile.reviewText:
As a professional crafter with a business of my own, I often use rubber stamps. Cavallini's are beautiful stamps in a charming tin case mounted on lovely wood blocks. The problem? Any crafter with rubber stamping experience will take one look at Cavallini's stamps and see the problem: they lack the foam portion between the block & the stamp itself. The foam is an important detail, necessary to create a stamp that distributes pressure evenly. In layman's terms, it can be very difficult at times to get the entire image stamped. When I use Cavallini's stamps, often the center of the image doesn't imprint. Very frustrating. I also have found the ink pad included to be equally worthless, mine was dry and useless when I got it.

Cavallini & Co., you need to redesign your stamps to be like the ones they sell in craft stores: they need the foam! Otherwise half the time they're worthless.
profile.summary: Beautiful but BAD stamps

profile.description: This classic princess dress includes a glittered purple and white velvet bodice with beautiful silver sequin lace and purple criss cross trim, along with fancy mid-length sleeves. The hip draping accentuates the fullness of the skirt.
profile.reviewText:
We were REALLY pleased with this costume! We purchased this for my 2.5 year old daughter, who wanted to be a princess for Halloween. Not only is the price great, the product is so soft and washes up so nicely. I thought I was just ordering your average dress up costume, but when the package arrived and I unwrapped it, I saw the tags explaining the story behind this brand. Apparently two moms decided to create dress up clothes that were comfortable and washed up easily.

Mission accomplished and well done to these moms who started this brand! This costume was noticeably soft! I'm used to those itchy, scratchy, cheap dress up clothes--so when I first unwrapped this dress I definitely noticed the soft feel immediately. It's also a cute dress and style! Just a step up from the trashy, cheap, thin costumes we see every where we look. It's not TOO fancy and the quality isn't hugely better than the cheap gross ones, but for this price point, I think it's perfect. How could you not?

I'd definitely recommend this brand, and I will definitely consider it again in the future.

Oh, and the "medium" for 3T-4T fit my 2.5 year old perfectly with maybe a tad of growing room. It wasn't too long or too short. My 2.5 year old measures in about the 75th percentile in height, so I'd say the sizing is just right in our experience.
profile.summary: What a fantastic brand! Glad to have discovered Little Adventures

profile.description: JAPONESQUE Radiance Primer. Inspired by backstage makeup techniques, Radiance Primer is the ultimate remedy for a complexion that radiates beauty and light. Its weightless and silky texture glides onto the skin and offers a pearlescent optical imperfection blurring effect. Skin fatigue is swept away. Radiance and luminosity are restored. Reflective pigments attract and diffuse light to add a hyper-real youthful beauty to the skin.
profile.reviewText:
While I really like this product overall, it's not what you'd call a heavy duty primer. This primer by Japonesque is mostly an illuminating base that can be worn under foundation or can also stand on it's own as a product that brings out a healthy glow. That said, it's really only going to give a healthy glow for those with fair skin. Those with darker skin I think may find that this is really best only used under other makeup, as a primer. It has a lightening effect, which I really like since I'm fair skinned, but others won't.

It smooths on nicely, and the bottle is a decently large size considering that a little goes a long way with this product. It has a shimmery look which can help make dry skin like mine look fresh and dewy. On the other hand, I'm not sure this is my favorite primer. While it's a nice fresh, illuminating base, it doesn't have that silicone feel my other primers have had. I've also noticed this product doesn't make makeup stay put the way my other primers have. So if you're looking for a good fresh base--whether it is to stand alone or to go under makeup--this is good, just don't expect this to be one of those primers that makes your makeup invincible throughout the day.

Again, with this product a little goes a long way. It is also scent free, which I like. It has not caused any breakouts or rashes. I would definitely try other products from this brand. Any questions? Leave a comment and I'll do my best to answer!
profile.summary: Great for radiance! Not my favorite primer.

profile.description: Cook up a family favorite with the George foreman 6-serving removable plate grill. The premium ceramic-coated plates are 5x more durable than previous George foreman plates, and they remove easily for fast cleaning in the dishwasher. Variable temperature controls let you find the best heat for grilling steak, chicken, veggies, and more! plus, the 1" adjustable hinge makes room for thick sandwiches and larger cuts of meat.
profile.reviewText:
I have owned and used various small size George Foreman grills for...gosh...at least ten years. They are helpful for weight-loss regimes, during times when you're doing cooking for one or two, and you need to be able to quickly cook up a protein inside and just get down to business. That is what I would recommend a George Foreman grill for: quick, light, protein cooking.

This George Foreman grill is the largest I've ever owned and used. Tonight I was able to cook about 5 small, thin cut chicken breasts on it. It took about 15 minutes from plug in to serving time. The chicken cooked nicely!

This grill works on a countertop, but doesn't always open all the way when upper cabinets are involved. Our standard kitchen, it scoots right to the edge with the drip tray underneath, and the upper lid lifts up and stays up (just barely!) enough to not fall on you hands. I like that the cord wraps up nicely in back, and this stores nicely in my under counter cabinets. I won't allow it to take up precious counter space, but it's there when I need it so I'm good.

The first time we washed and heated up the grill plates, we ended up with a smell and smoking from inside the grill. This wore off after the first 10 minutes or so. Makes me a bit nervous, but nothing came of it during future uses.

The hinge is flexible, so you can cook a thin sliced chicken breast or a 1 inch steak and not have to worry about the tilt of the top half not cooking thoroughly. The drip tray is a nice addition to help keep things clean, however, I wish they had created a place to store it on the grill (like the wrap-up power cord) so that it is not easily lost. I've lost GF drip trays before...

What I love most is the ability to just pop those ceramic grill plates off and wash them (handwash or dishwasher) instead of the older GF grills that included an (often lost) plastic scraper and you had to basically just scrub with a damp sponge to get cooked on gook off. This removable plate idea??? Brilliant.

While I think this grill makes good high protein, low fat/carb food quickly and easily, just know it's a diet product. It does not produce ideally cooked food, but rather lean, grilled food. I wouldn't buy a nice cut of ribeye and put it on a GF grill. However, I would buy frozen chicken breasts, or those pre-made burger patties and put it on the GF grill. Sprinkle a little of McCormick's Grill Mates seasoning on it and it's a good, lean meat.

You'll have to decide for yourself if this product is right for you or not, but I was pleased with it.
profile.summary: A nice counter top grill for the lean eater

profile.description: Blow the whistle and chime the bell as your rugged 0-4-0 steam engine approaches Lionel Junction! With realistic railroad decoration, authentic locomotive sounds and announcements, and three freight cars in tow, this ready-to-run train set will fire the imagination of any beginning train engineer. Set includes everything you need to get started, including track, remote, and power supply.
profile.reviewText:
This is a starter set for a simple little train set! Not much has changed about it from the sets we had 30+ years ago, except that there is more plastic. Out of the box it sets up very quickly, and this set alone (without any additions from extension packages) makes just a simple 40" circle track. You plug it in, get the train wheels on the track, get the cars connected (arguably the most tedious part of setup), put batteries in the remote control--and you're good to go!

Forward or backward that is. At varying speeds. It's a fun set, especially for kids, to set up and play with quickly. This set also makes the perfect Christmas tree train! It's just the right size, I think to go around under the Christmas tree. Just keep in mind that this set is remote-operated, there's no on switch to keep it going when you're not right there with it.

If you're looking for a basic, nice starter train set for a little one--or for your Christmas tree!--then I can't think of a reason not to suggest this one.
profile.summary: Perfect train for a Christmas tree!

profile.description: The OXO Knives were thoughtfully designed to provide the perfect balance of feel and function. The shape and contours of the handle encourage you to hold it in a way that is both comfortable and efficient, no matter where you grasp it. This set includes an 8" Chef's Knife, perfect for chopping, mincing, dicing and scooping vegetables, herbs and more; a 6.5" Santoku Knife, perfect for chopping and scooping; a 5" Serrated Utility Knife, perfect for cutting and slicing tomatoes and other soft fruits; a 3.5" Paring Knife, perfect for peeling and paring fruits and vegetables; an 8" Bread Knife, ideal for cutting breads and bagels; and a set of 4 Serrated Steak Knives. The Knives feature a comfortable handle to ensure a safe, non-slip grip, even when wet, a streamlined design to provide comfort for repetitive tasks and sharp, hardened Japanese stainless steel for precision and durability. All of the Knives fit perfectly in a slim wood Knife Block, for space-efficient knife storage.
profile.reviewText:
The price and quality of this set sets it apart in two ways: First, it's too inexpensive to be trusted as top-of-the-line, you cannot expect a FANTASTIC chef's set here. That's typical for OXO, a trusted--but affordable--brand. We all know, you get what you pay for, and anyone shopping for long-life professional knives knows to look in a budget above this. Second, the quality sets it a step above the actual "cheap" products. All this to say, I suppose, I see this as a great middle ground option.

This set is perfect for the newlyweds or those setting up in their first apartment. It's a good choice for the occasional cook who just needs a functional set. It is perfectly functional for now and for a while, probably. Just don't expect it to be a long-lasting set.

These knives are incredibly light. They are easy to handle, and I like the grip. I prefer a set without kitchen shears, but that might be something for others to consider, that this set doesn't come with one. There are four steak knifes, a utility knife, a paring knife, a bread knife, a santoku knife, and a chef's knife. Considering my first several uses, they work just fine, no complaints, but they don't blow me out of the water. Examining the blades alongside my favorite chef's knife, I feel there is a noticeable difference. I don't expect these knives to stay sharp for long, honestly.

I compared these alongside my favorite chef's knife, my Victorinox that I got on Amazon. I've owned and used my Victorinox chef's knife for years now, and it's a true work horse in the kitchen, even family and friends who end up chopping away with it when visiting always are impressed when they start working with it...and here's the kicker: I've never sharpened it.

I do now discount this OXO set as poor quality, however. I'm saying: you get what you pay for. And this is a decent set, if your expectations of a set in this price range are reasonable. If this is the price and quality you're looking for--as many people are--then absolutely, I can't think of a reason not to recommend this set.

I do have one minor complaint--which is just cosmetic--but I do find that the blades get a weird haze on them after some uses. I've tried polishing, scrubbing, rubbing with lemon. Of COURSE you should ALWAYS handwash your knves, I know this. After hand-washing the bigger knives a few times I noticed that while they are clean, they don't always appear clean due to a strange haze pattern that appears sometimes. And no, it's not me or my water, my other knives don't do this. That is one reason why I also conclude that these blades are a bit lower on the quality scale.

Now, with price and level of quality and brand (I generally think well of OXO, personally, and still do) all in mind you'll have to decide for yourself if this set is a good fit for your needs. I will continue to use them and enjoy them for now. I'll be updating this review with time to tell you how they hold up!
profile.summary: Is this set right for you?

profile.description: Theres no need to put up with endless barking. The PetSafe Spray Bark Collar gently and immediately conditions your dog to stop barking using a harmless burst of spray. The collar uses a microphone to pick up your dogs bark, which triggers a harmless burst of spray. The spray distracts your dog from whatever he's barking at, letting you redirect your dog's attention. This spray collar is safe for all dogs, including puppies. Soft spray stops barking. 25-30 sprays per refill. For dogs of any size. Sound sensor detects bark. Water-resistant. Collar uses 6-volt alkaline battery (included.) To refill the collar, make sure the unit is turned off. Hold the refill spray can upright and firmly press the nozzle down into the refill port. Hold for 15 seconds or until unit is full, then remove the can. If spray leaks out, you may need to press harder to complete the seal. System includes: Spray bark collar with adjustable collar strap, 1 refill can of stain-free hypo-allergenic spray, 1 6-volt alkaline battery, Product manual. If youre not sure which bark control product to choose, contact our Customer Care team Monday through Saturday and we'll gladly help you decide. If this product is not meeting your needs, please contact PetSafe Brand. PetSafe brand has been an industry leading US manufacturer of pet behavior, containment and lifestyle products since 1991, helping millions of people and pets each year. Call, chat or email the PetSafe US-based customer care specialists six days a week. How do I refill the unit with more spray:Turn off the unit, Hold the refill spray can upright , Firmly press the nozzle down into the refill port, Hold for 15 seconds or until unit is full, Remove the can.
profile.reviewText:
I almost gave my rating 3 stars instead of 5 but I figured this would be unfair to the product and the manufacturer as this product worked well and did everything it promised! It arrived safely and in great packaging, it set up easily, and it does work very effectively. The little "spray box" is easily loaded with the citronella spray. There is a switch to turn it on or off. It is "one size fits all" (except for the tiny teacup dogs, this would not work on them) and fits my Italian Greyhound, although being only 18 lbs and a skinny breed, it is large and slightly heavy on him.

I just also want to give a word of warning to those who might have a similar dog/situation to me. This bark collar works almost too well! I can recommend it, but just not for high strung little dogs.

I have a 6 year old Italian Greyhound who is a happy, healthy dog. But a year ago we moved to a new neighborhood and our street gets about 10 pedestrians walking by an hour (moms with strollers or young kids, others walking their dogs, kids on bikes), it's a high traffic street for pedestrians. And my dog barks at every single one of them. AND we don't have a back yard, just a fenced, huge front yard. IGs are high energy dogs and both of mine like to spend their days basking in the warm sun so they are outside quite a bit. But the constant barking at every single passer-by was getting SO OBNOXIOUS. I've been worried that animal control will come inform me of noise disturbances (it's happened before) and I also have two little ones who nap for a couple hours each day, which is precious time for me and I cannot have my dog waking them up!

So I decided to purchase this bark collar for my male Italian Greyhound who was the main offender. It works great, just like it's supposed to! Two barks and he got the idea. Unfortunately, he also got pretty stressed out over it. So I have to give a warning, this bark collar - even being humane and non-pain inducing, is still to be used carefully on high-strung little dogs. My dog is a happy barker, he does not bark at the pedestrians out of stress, he's always happy and just saying "hi". So i do feel bad trying to shut him up. We used this collar for about two days, but took it off after seeing he was under stress. He was so spooked he didn't want to go outside anymore and would pee on himself when we tried to force him out (poor guy). Clearly this is not the solution for us...

Before you spend money on this product, which I can assure you is high quality, evaluate your dog. I've worked with animals in the past at animal shelters, I know every breed is different. Just do some research first. I think this bark collar would be an excellent fit for a Labrador or working class dog. In fact, I think it's a good fit for most breeds. But if you have a skittish dog, especially if it's a small dog with high energy and sensitivity to loud noises - consider these all warning signs that this collar is probably not the best fit for your dog.
profile.summary: Works BUT - works TOO WELL?

profile.description: Adding to their legacy of top-of-line sprinkler timers, Orbit is pleased to announce the addition of their most intuitive, feature-rich timer to date. The Orbit B-hyve Smart WiFi Sprinkler Controller is made in the USA with global materials. The perfect timer for new installations or for replacement, it is available in both 6 and 12 station models with indoor/outdoor-rated locking cabinet. Control it with an Android or iOS device, computer, or at the timer with the super-intuitive interface millions of customers know and love. WaterSense and SWAT labeling provide assurance that B-hyve uses advanced weather data to deliver just the right amount of water to plants and turf, and postpones watering whenever rain is in the forecast. The Orbit B-hyve Smart WiFi Sprinkler Controller makes saving water, time and money easier than ever.
profile.reviewText:
This is a great addition to the smart-home loving consumer. It's an affordable sprinkler system controller for your home, featuring wifi access that allows you to bring your sprinkler system into your growing number of smart devices and apps. My husband did the installing, and said it was a breeze, with all the set up being done via your smartphone. Installing the controller itself seemed to give him no problems either, and was done in a mere 15 minutes or so. He's quite proficient with such things around the house, and is a system engineer, so this sort of thing comes naturally to him. But I am led to believe that most people would be able to manage the installation just fine.

How does it work? It works great! We are especially impressed with the features that allow the sprinkler system to know when it's not needed (like when it rains). You set it to know what type of soil you have, and what zip code you live in, and so on, so that it calculates and works with weather forecasts to give your lawn just the right amount of sprinkling time! The wifi and app features are especially brilliant. You can go on vacation and not worry about overwatering or underwatering your lawn, you can adjust your sprinkler system from anywhere should you need to. I feel like these sorts of smart home products will just become more and more prevalent, so this is a great, well designed one from B-hyve. The water-saving features are pretty amazing, and simplifies your life.

My husbands one and only complaint was that it didn't come with measuring cups. He felt those should be easy enough to include and would have completed the system. Measuring cups can be purchased and placed in your different sprinkler zones so that you can dial in how much water each zone is getting and adjust from there. But that's it. Not a bad report here or anything, we're both quite happy with the B-hyve. And I even find myself less paranoid about making sure my husband stays on top of the lawn - because here in arid Colorado our lawns go dry FAST - because I know the B-hyve controller has got us covered.
profile.summary: I don't have to worry about our lawn anymore!

profile.description: With whimsical flowers and playful butterflies, our new Blossoms and Butterflies Collection is as fun and as refreshing as Springtime. Hand-painted accents make the cheerful pattern come to life and the attention to detail throughout ties the items together. Pink, purple, yellow, and white make these new items a delight. Bursting with color and joy, they create a focal point in any childs room or collectors home. This preciously-painted Doll Crib suits Dolly at bed time and includes a nice sized storage cabinet to keep her things organized for the day. Bedding includes light pink mattress with attached bumper, a pink blanket, and a pink pillow. Six sets of white ribbon ties hold the bumper in place. Also includes a real, working Musical Mobile. Wind-up the mobile and it slowly rotates to soothe your baby doll into dreamland. Interesting shapes dangling from the white, mobile add to the realistic look. Mobile does not require batteries. Plays a happy nursery or lullaby tune (tunes vary). Mobile can be attached to either side of the crib and can be detached if you don't want to use it. The two cabinet doors with knobs open to reveal ample storage room for your doll clothes and accessories. Concealed magnets hold the cabinet doors closed. Round knobs make the doors easy to open. Smooth rolling casters allow the Crib to be moved from room to room during play. Door panels feature some detail carved in. Height from top of crib rail to floor measures 21". Designed for dolls up to 22" tall.
profile.reviewText:
First of all, we got this crib from Costco for only $30, and having put it together I can't say I would spend the $40-60 that it's going for online. I probably would have searched for a cheaper model instead.

But for what we paid, I'm very pleased with this doll crib. It's cute & pretty realistic. We wanted a realistic looking one as our 2 year old is about to become a big sister and this is similar to our bassinet which is also on wheels. The mobile & bedding are a cute touch. The wheels make it easy for a child to move around, but beware that they don't lock. The cabinet is very nice for storing doll supplies & keeping organized, plus my 2 year old loves to open and shut them all day and puts her things in there. This has been a hit with us as my daughter loves to put her "babies" to bed.

This took me about an hour to put together by myself, you just need a Phillips-head screwdriver. It would definitely be easier to assemble with two people, however, and I found it better to do the assembly a little backwards from the directions. It was difficult to put the sides on while holding everything in place. Or, put the wheels on last, that would definitely help make it easier. Be careful not to over-tighten the screws or the wood can crack. Once I had it all assembled this crib seemed very sturdy. I hope it stays that way!

The paint does chip easily, so handle it gently and beware that with use it will probably suffer a little wear and tear. The bedding is a nice addition but a little flimsy - though I doubt my toddler cares much about that detail.
Overall I would say this is a nice little crib for a toddler or young child, especially if your little girl loves dolls & babies. We will certainly get a lot of use & fun out of it!
profile.summary: Great Little Doll Crib

profile.description: We meant it when we said wed build a revolutionary line of stylish headphones. For those who know authentic elegance when they see it -- and hear it  meet our new JBL S300 Headphone. Its precision boldness and rugged good looks come fused together by a steel headband thats both lightweight and durable. Its premium leather ear cushions provide your ears with more than just perfect listening. For the fearless interloper within us all, the JBL S300 demands seeing - as much as hearing  to be believed. Score another instant JBL classic.
profile.reviewText:
These JBL headphones have excellent build quality, they do not feel flimsy or cheap. They have an on-ear design but are pretty comfortable during extended listening sessions--I've had more comfortable headphones, however. It does a good job of blocking out outside noise, one reason why many choose them--along with sound quality. Although around-the-ear headphones, obviously, offer the most noise reduction, this set does a good job.

These JBL headphones also come with a nice carrying case, and they fold up fairly small for being big on-ear headphones. The cord is a great length for listening with mobile devices, and it's also detachable which is a plus. The three button universal remote will work just fine with Android and iPhones.

I had my husband help me think this review through and use the headphones also, as he is actually a professional in the audio/video industry and has more of an ear for audio quality and a finer taste when it comes to...ahem...headphones! He designs sound systems and sells many expensive products such as headphones and speakers as well, he has even designed systems for famous musicians--so I figured he'd have more to say than I would! His comments were good ones, as for sound quality the sound is nice and even, not too bassy or bright. His one complaint when wearing the headphones, were that if his head were any bigger, they would not fit comfortably. My husband has an average man's head, it's never been described as large--so I'm guessing someone who does have a larger head *might* not like the fit as much?

JBL is also a reputable brand, my husband knew of this company and says they've been around a long time and make good professional speakers. He also says this price point is competitive for retail, the quality matches the price very well. As for me, I have a much less distinguished ear and taste for headphones, but I have enjoyed listening to music with them. I don't like how bulky they are but I've never liked how bulky ANY on-ear headphones are. Still, I understand the benefits of on-ear headphones and if you're in the market for a new set and this one is in your price range, then I can't see any reason not to recommend them.
profile.summary: No question of JBL's standard of quality--nice cans!

profile.description: Looking for high-quality wireless performance, ease of use, and high-quality low-cost ink in an affordable printer? Meet the KODAK ESP C315 All-in-One Printer. A big, beautiful 2.4" color display and effortless Wi-Fi connection to your wireless home network1 make printing simple. And with low cost total ink replacement our expanded line of KODAK Pigment-Based, 30 Series Inks help you save on everything you print. Of course, legendary Kodak quality means crisp, sharp text documents, brilliant graphics, and photos that dry instantly and last a lifetime. For easy excellence at a great value, look no further than Kodak.
profile.reviewText:
This is our second Kodak printer, I also recently added the Kodak ESP 2170 All-in-One Printer to my office for heavier use with my crafting business. This printer I setup with our family desktop for lighter duty printing tasks, and we've been happy with it overall. The set up was easy and painless, it easily connected to our wifi and installed with our Mac (our laptops are PCs, both Kodak printers have installed easily with both).

The first thing I decided to try and print with this printer was a large photo of my daughter on glossy photo paper, and it came out perfectly! I was impressed with the quality after considering it's low cost, though printers are in general getting better quality for a better budget as technology improves.

This Kodak has also handled all our other printing needs so far (mostly coupons!) with ease and has preformed well. The small screen is a nice addition (especially, again, considering the price of this printer) and since it sits on the shelf above our desktop, I like the feature that allows it to tilt upwards so that we can still see it up there.

I would recommend this printer for light duty home use, I'm not sure it's what I would pick if I needed one for frequent, high quantity or high volume printing jobs, I'd probably go with something that had a few more features than this printer. That said, I think this one makes an excellent printer for the basic home office, for the student, or for someone who needs a low-cost but high quality photo printer (and by quality photos I don't mean professional photographer, here, I mean the scrapbooking mom). I have really been enjoying Kodak's low ink costs and ease of use, and now having owned two newer Kodak printers I think they're really fine tuning their machines to be good, competitive name-brand printers featuring low prices and low ink costs. And that's definitely something I can appreciate!
profile.summary: Great light-duty printer for home office or student

profile.description: The Apex EM1000 is a Beginner level microscope designed for starting at home scientists. This compound microscope comes with 300x, 600x and 1200x magnifications with both LED and mirror illuminations. The metal frame is designed to last. profile.reviewText:
This microscope set has made an excellent addition to my homeschooling curriculum! My kids love it and were super interested from the get go. They are 8, 5, and 3. profile.summary: Great addition to our homeschooling room!

profile.description: With the over-sized JJ Cole Beach Tote, there's no need to lug multiple bags to the beach. profile.reviewText:

profile.summary: Cleverly designed and perfect for beach/pool use!

profile.description: Send your little one off to school or play with this sweet and adorable backpack friend. profile.reviewText:
This backpack is adorable! It should be noted that I got it for my 4-year-old daughter and we homeschool, but still my kids love having their own school supplies and backpacks. This is the perfect size for a little one (ages 2-5 perhaps?) but might be too small for an older child who has more school gear and homework to lug around.
