profile.description: Mount your smartphone or GPS device to your windshield or air vent , free your hands of fumbling the mobile phone while you are driving. Just need 1 minute you can easily assemble the phone holder and mount your device firmly to the windshield and air vent. 360 swivel ball makes you can angle the phone in practically any position for optimum viewing. Compatible for all types of devices from 21.7 inch to 33.5 inch wide and suitable for all cars.
profile.reviewText:
I was worried that this mount would not accommodate my phone, but it does! I have a Samsung Note 5 with an Otter Box protective case, which makes the whole thing humongous. Most phone mounts won't work. This one does and I'm ecstatic about it.

The kit comes with 4 pieces (forgive me in advance if I get the terminology wrong):
-- Suction cup assembly for the windshield. The suction cup has a protective film on it; remove this before using
-- Vent clip spring clip
-- Vent spring clip attachment assembly
-- Phone cradle, which can clip on to either the suction cup assembly or to the vent assembly

I chose to go with the windshield suction cup assembly. This assembly features a vacuum clip, swivel arm adjustment, and cradle adjustment (uses a ball joint). You can move the swivel arm up or down as needed and you can also rotate the cradle as desired. To assemble this, simply snap the cradle on to the mounting plate. Moisten the suction cup and place it on your windshield. Once you have it where you want, push the vacuum clip (located just above the suction cup) all the way back towards your windshield to seal the assembly to the glass. Adjust the arm and the ball joint as desired.

To use the vent clip mount, you'll need to snap the vent spring clip on to the back of vent assembly. Once you've attached the two pieces together, pull back on the spring clip so that it will fit around one of the vent pieces (make sure that the foam feet are at the bottom since these will protect your dashboard). Then  you'll snap the cradle into the assembly.

The cradle features spring loaded side arms and 2 swiveling feet. To adjust the side arms, push the two plastic tabs located on the bottom half inward until it locks to desired position. To release, press the round button on the front of the cradle. To adjust the feet, manually move them to where you want them.

I've included pictures, which hopefully will help you decipher how to put everything together - unfortunately there are no instructions! By the way, that's not my phone in the mount, it's my wife's (explains the color scheme of the Otter Box :-P ). And please forgive us for how dirty the phone is.

Overall, I'm very, very happy and excited to finally have a mount that fits my phone. I really like that I can switch from windshield mount to vent mount should I desire. And having 2 ways to adjust the windshield mount is really great.

I hope you found this review useful.

profile.description: Thai Tea Filter Stainless Steel Traditional Thai Style.
profile.reviewText:
Wife and I love our Thai tea. The problem with brewing your own from the leaves are the leaves! Before buying this we struggled with how to filter out the smallest bits of the leaves. Prior to buying this we ended up using paper coffee filters, but that method didn't work out so well, especially when dealing with larger batches (we usually brew enough for about 6 to 8 good size glasses at a time).

A couple things of note. Don't expect this thing to stay white, Thai tea stains and it will stain this filter. Also the filter is very long in length, about 10 inches long. As you pour your tea leaf mix into this for straining, the liquid will want to slosh out to the sides, so make sure that the container you're pouring into is tall enough so that all the liquid is filtered into the container.

This is a must have item for anyone brewing Thai tea (or any kind of tea using leaves). It's the most effective way to trap all the bits of tea while allowing the liquid to pass through.
profile.summary: Must Have for Thai Tea Brewing

profile.description: KNOX ARMOR Galaxy Note 5 Case - Rugged Case for Samsung Galaxy Note 5 Features Dual Layer Protection With front cover + four corner cushioning Hard PC shell + TPU inner for protection; Special Improved Features:Dual Layer Protection; Hard shell + TPU inner core; Appearance with contemporary design : snug sleek lightweight; Signature front cover and built-in screen protector; Easy access to all buttons, ports, camera, sensors, speakers and features; Impact resistant bumper design.
profile.reviewText:
First things first - there is no front cover. Aside from that, this is a good case. I already have an Otter Box; however, I wanted to get another case in all Black to replace the colored Otter (everyone gets bored eventually with the same ole, same ole).

This case is rugged and can take some abuse on the corners and sides. The weakness is in the front since it has no protective front shell. No front shell means there's virtually no moisture protection and debris and dirt can easily get in.

There's a total of 3 pieces: holster, plastic front insert, and a back shell (please see picture showing the 3 pieces). With regard to size, this case is nearly the same size as an Otter Box (it's slightly less wide and just a tad shorter. Thickness is virtually the same, I've included a picture showing this case side by side with the Otter case). The holster does incorporate a kickstand function within the belt clip (see picture). Kickstand works well even on fairly slick surfaces like kitchen counters and wood desks / tables. The belt clip / kickstand does swivel 360 degrees. When put together, the phone was easy to grip and comfortable to hold. Had no problems with getting it in and out of the holster.

Getting the case on to your Note 5 is somewhat difficult. The back shell is very stiff but the silicone / rubber sides are able to stretch.
-- Step 1: Place the plastic front insert on to the screen side of your phone
-- Step 2: Squeeze your phone including the plastic insert into the back shell. Start with a corner and work your way around the phone. Make sure you have the back piece right side up by lining up the camera cutout
-- Step 3: Insert your phone into the holster face in. This holster does not allow you to put your phone in with the screen out

Key differences between this and Otter Box:
-- No front screen
-- The buttons are flush with the back shell. There's no small rubber pieces that stick out for the Power, Volume Up, and Volume Down buttons, which can make them easy to miss

Overall, this case will not work for me as I'm not comfortable with not having a front shell. I'm disappointed as the seller's listing states that there is a front cover. Also the lack of prominent nubs to indicate the locations of the Power and Volume buttons will end up annoying the heck out of me.

--- Main body

The main body / assembly has plastic stubs on the sides for the compartments - the compartments slide down behind the stubs. Be very, very careful when moving this storage unit around when it's fully assembled or when you've got it fully loaded. Quality / Build on this is very good. The plastic is clear throughout even on the compartments. We didn't find any hazy or dull spots and more impressively, no air bubbles.

***NOTE*** This item will come with a protective plastic sealed with masking tape. It's very likely you'll end up with tape residue. If you remove the tape carefully (try to remove it as one piece instead of a bunch of tiny strips / pieces) you can then reuse the adhesive side to remove the tape residue left on the plastic. Place the tape sticky side down over the problem areas, rub firmly over the problem area with your fingernail, then pull the tape back up quickly. Rinse and repeat until all the sticky bits are gone. Alternatively you can use a specialty product like Goo Gone if you already have it or feel like spending the money to buy it. What you DON'T want to do is to use a scrub sponge or anything abrasive (even with soap & water) because you'll scratch the plastic.

Overall, wife is loving this product. As you can see by the pictures, she's putting it to great use.

profile.description: Whiskey Stones make a fantastic gift for the whiskey lover in your life. They are not however strictly used for whiskey. They can be used in any drink that would be improved with a slight chill such as wine or cognac. Add about one stone per ounce of whiskey and it will drop the temperature between ten and fifteen degrees. This will cut the harshness of the drink without destroying the complex flavors like normal ice. Easy returns of verified purchases if you are not 100% satisfied.
profile.reviewText:
I wish that I had gotten these much much sooner than now. These are so useful - I can enjoy cocktails without worrying about my drink getting diluted. Especially now that it's summer, drinks just don't stay cold for very long; have to keep adding ice to keep it chilled but then the ice melts, completely throwing off the flavor of what I'm drinking.

There's a total of 9 stones that come in a good looking box (come prepackaged in something that is gift worthy). Inside the box are the 9 stones as well as a velvet drawstring storage bag. Each stone is rounded on the corners and edges. The stones are a marbled pink in color - elegant and classy.

With regard to effectiveness - these are not going to get your drink super cold. They will however chill or cool your drink down substantially (in my mind that does make these perfect for simple mixed drinks such as bourbon & coke, whiskey & coke and vodka tonics. I wouldn't recommend these for iced teas or other "regular" drinks.

Please note that you want to freeze these stones inside of their bag (for at least 3 hours). I made the mistake of just throwing these stones into my ice maker compartment - the stones ended up sticking to the ice cubes, which negated the whole point of having them.

Overall, these are really good for chilling your drinks but not good for those of you who want really cold drinks - they just won't cool the liquids down that much. I do really like these and will be using them (3 cubes at a time) in my mixed alcoholic drinks.

profile.description: Dr. David Baboulene is a published author and academic, and a story consultant for publishers, corporations, film production companies and private clients.
profile.reviewText:
Amazing...and I have read a LOT of books on how novels/fiction writing works...or should work. This is in my top 5. Probably my top 3.
There are other reviews that mention the way he covers subtext, Knowledge Gaps, dialogue, etc., so I shall just add that if the whole "index card" activity never seemed to work for you....then read this. Not that it explains the same old thing that you've heard of before. No. This book explains a tweaked system that actually MAKES SENSE, not just from the perspective of using the system to navigate your story, but how to structure the exercise so that it means something to the story structure besides deciding if Aunt Jemima put syrup on her pancakes before she puts the cat out or afterwards.

He also uses this system to show you how to approach a new project in a constructive sense...so that you can either build it properly or bail on it before you spend more time on a clunker. And he doesn't include any cute little sections that cover vast areas of plot structure with: "And now you just decide when Aunt Jemima puts the cat out." He actually guides you through the decisions that can make or break you, by telling you the purpose of those decisions to the story. And how to be brave and kill them when they are no longer relevant.

He dissects the structures of scenes and sequences, so that you can actually see how the pieces are intended to fit together, why they work that way, and what questions to ask your material to whip it into shape if it feels all limp and aimless.

And as for his clarification between a dilemma and "something very difficult"...NOT the same thing (who knew?!)...and the effect they have on plot....that little section was worth the price alone.

Good writing style, easy to grasp and even though the cover of this book screams "scriptwriting", novelists and fiction-writers will have no trouble using this. When there is a distinction between the formats, he clearly explains the difference between the way the information can be used for each and why.

Probably the best $3 I have ever spent on Amazon!
profile.summary: Script writers, fiction writers, novelists, "armchair writers"....this is for you.

Assembly was fast and easy with good directions and the requisite tools are provided. The sisal is holding up well and the carpet is a good shade of cream...it blends in well and is the go-to space for the cat. He especially appreciates the different scratching heights provided by the sisal-wrapped posts.
profile.summary: Sturdy, high, entertaining...just measure the spot you're planning to put it in....

profile.description: Sterilite high quality products 16 qt stacking drawer.
profile.reviewText:
Bought these ages ago and I love them. They work so well that I need to get some new ones to match the original set...BUT... watch the 3rd party seller prices here...(the single drawer should be under $8 each, under $40 for a 6-pack ... and there is free shipping on the larger orders). I'll be getting mine directly from the local big-box store that we all love to hate (big W), or, if I have to, I'll order directly from their online store. I should have grabbed them today when I saw them on the shelf!

Incidentally, I use these for my off-season clothing storage: keeps dust out, but easily accessible if/when the weather shifts unexpectedly. This size is good for underwear, socks, athletic gear, beach-bag accessories like sunglasses/goggles/sunblock/swimsuits, winter-sports accessories like ski goggles/gloves/scarves/balaclavas/sunglasses/sunblock, etc. And I love that you can get an idea of what is inside each bin, but it's not crystal clear.

For some drawers I'll put a sheet of decorative paper on the inside, facing out, so that I can keep the contents more private...and it makes the drawers look a bit fancier.

There is a larger size that would work better for t-shirts, pants, etc. and best of all, both sizes stack together! The big box location also had a 3-drawer unit (same drawer design) that has 2 bigger drawers on the bottom and then one of this size on the top. You can then stack higher if you like, and it makes the configurations really flexible.

To make sure that you're in the same Sterilite drawer "family" (which affects the stack-ability' of the units), pay attention to the drawer pull detail (small, center, bottom edge of drawer)...some Sterilite "families" are outrageously priced...it's like the world is running out of plastic!
profile.summary: Drawers are excellent BUT watch the third-party seller prices here....

profile.description: Free Shipping to Worldwide and Register mail with tracking information!
profile.reviewText:
Some other reviewers have commented that these figurines are "green" not grey. And yes, I would have to agree. The grey colour is actually a sort of teal with a greyish tinge. Now, had I read this before ordering, I might have hesitated, but now that I have them, I must say that even though I loathe the colour teal, these cats are as cute as they come. The colour doesn't bother me in the least, probably because they are just so darn cute. (And I think the mind sort of fills in for the green, making it seem normal).

Most of the figurines are about 1" high, but two of them are noticeably smaller: the top-right one with the red, and the bottom middle one are more like 0.75."

These were a gift, and the child loves them. They are very cute, not good for very small children (choking hazard size, and the edges of the ears are apparently quite sharp). But they are very cute, well-made and the details are good enough for the price. The stripes across the backs are the most "haphazard"...they do not match cat to cat...but that is really being a nitpick. The stripes are stripes and each cat has the look of Chi. If you're a serious collector, not just a cat-loving fan, then you probably shouldn't be bothering with this price range anyway.
profile.summary: Teal cats? Yes. But still SUPER-CUTE.

profile.description: This listing is created by Tokyo Japanese outlet. Thank you for loving our product . Authentic Iwako from Japan. All erasers are brand new in original bags.
profile.reviewText:
Awesome. These were offered for the outrageously irresistible price of $7.99 and you could not ask for more. Each item was sealed in it's own original Iwako bag and was the expected Iwako epitome of cuteness. Excellent quality of eraser animal: perfect for the collector, since, let's be honest...no one actually USES them, do they?

Since there has been some interest as to the exact mix one might get, this is what we received:

Two of the following (always different colours): dolphins, unicorns, hedgehogs, koalas.
Three of the following (different colours): monkeys.

You just can't go wrong, but note that the shipping time longer (for that price you can't have everything!).
profile.summary: Great mix, great price, cannot beat these perfectly cute little animals.

profile.description: This day bag has all of the makings of a fast getaway. Chic styling whether you are strolling the Champs-Elysees or en route to noonday Pilates, this is the perfect companion piece.
profile.reviewText:
Wow. This is my new favourite travel bag/purse. It's much roomier than it looks (that already makes it a winner), has ton of pockets (again, a winner), comfortable (and adjustable!) shoulder strap, ans all the zippers zip together so they can be tied shut.

The inside zippered purse pocket is large and deep, making it a perfect foil for pickpockets. That being said, in both pick-pocket locations, I could easily fasten the main zipper to the metal adjustment piece on the strap, which kept the main compartment closed. The versatility of being able to secure the bag in different ways was perfect.
There are probably better locking solutions to mine, but I found the bag functioned beyond my expectations, was versatile and could hold almost too much stuff without making me feel like I was carrying a backpack.

The strap shortens and lengthens easily, and is comfortable to wear. The fabric is a herringbone-style weave and tougher than I was expecting (points there), and the quality of the craftsmanship was very good: I had no fears of unravelling, breaking zippers, etc., which goes to show why it costs what it does. It is worth it.

It went from day to night very well and the strap could shorten enough to hang it over my knee under a restaurant table. The pocket size and variety is very useful and met all the needs that I had.
profile.summary: Perfect travel purse / bag on every level.

profile.description: Book by Ann Cleeves
profile.reviewText:
I have not read this series "in order," but I find them addictive: the atmosphere of small-town Shetland Islands is effortlessly invoked and the characters are well-rounded and happily lead you off the beaten track into the tangle of lies and deceptions that most people are made of. A "cozy" series with brains, heart, and a thriller-instinct, without the gratuitous violence and graphic crime scenes that have become the "norm" for the thriller genre. There are no car-chase / gun battles here; is it the game of wits and survival at its most basic form, where even known secrets can have depths beyond the obvious.
The romance thread is realistic, not overpowering or superfluous, and it doesn't distract from the plot or function as an add-on. The main sleuth, though jaded and hardened, has a soft center that makes him credible in his flaws and - finally! - doesn't need to express his masculinity by objectifying women.
profile.summary: A "cozy" series with brains, heart, and a thriller-instinct (but none of the gore)....

profile.description: Pencils, 12 ea. graphite #2 wood pencils. Made from 100% wood. Attractive blue and white barrel. Pre-sharpened with latex free eraser.
profile.reviewText:
In the recent quest for a decent pencil, these were one of the top two (the other was the black Paper-Mate Mirado ones).

I know there are Dixon Ticonderoga fans out there: waste of my time...I have never sharpened so much pencil to get to a point (Hah, pun) where the lead didn't immediately slide out as I have with the Ticonderoga ones. I've had better luck with the cheap seasonal nasties that teachers give out in treat bags. I won't bother mentioning the no-name brands.

The new Bic brightly-colored pencils with the "hard-to break" leads started out being a favourite, but the lead is not dark enough to really read well (no, my eyes are not failing: comparatively, the Bic pencils are too light).

So, on to these ones: dark enough to read easily, easy to sharpen, holds the point well, sharpens the first time without "fallout lead" and distinctive enough so it's easy to know which pencil is yours.
profile.summary: One of the best pencils to survive an extensive search...

profile.description: Thin, medium or thickyou choose how your cheese is sliced! Stainless steel wires effortlessly glide through even the hardest cheeses. Cuts 1/16", 1/8" and 3/16"-thick slices . . . perfect for anything. Weighted, easy-grip handle is easier to use than a knife. 8" L.
profile.reviewText:
Several years ago I owned one of these. It was the best. Really. I have never had such a great time cutting cheese. (Even my European cheese enthusiast friends have never used anything better).
After several years of service, the wire finally broke. That was a very dark day, since no one (even amazon) had these available and I was forced to use sub-standard cheese cutting devices since then.
Then one day, I just happened to find these on Amazon. I ordered FOUR.

Pros:
Unlike the usual cheese slicers, the cheese does not stick to this slicer: the center piece revolves, allowing the wire to slice through the cheese with almost no drag.
Easy to hand-clean (I love mine too much to chance the dishwasher).
Light, easy in the hand.
Effortless cutting (gouda, hard goat cheese, cheddar...not sure how it would do on the harder Romanos and Parmiggianos...those are usually grated, though).
These were about $5 each.

Cons:
When the wire breaks, you're done...but this is more than made up for by the fact that it is easy to cut cheese with it: give me effortless cutting with a breaking point over a fight every time but the cutter lasts a lifetime.

Quite frankly, this is the best cheese slicer EVER. Accept no imitations.
profile.summary: The Best Cheese Slicer EVER!

The storage solution I have been after for years!
Bought several to mount in the doors of my lower bathroom cabinets for the quick-grab items that otherwise never get put away. works like a charm. Just check the sizing of the unit and measure the inside of the cabinet: you want the screws to go through the thickest part of the cabinet door (the frame around the central panel). The unit "hooks on" to the screw, so you can easily unhook them to clean. The shelf surface is smooth, so things don't tip around, but make sure that the shelves are either "packed snug" or do not have lots of tall items...otherwise the movement of closing the door will cause them to tip over.

The high sides are also solid, so no lipsticks are going to roll out or get jammed while trying to. And the height of the sides mean that many cosmetics (lipsticks, deodorants, nail polish) can be stored vertically or horizontally.

profile.description: The Franklin Adjustable Soccer Rebounder can be set to return your shots either on the ground or in the air for practicing a variety of skills. The all weather 4-in by 4-in netting features a contrasting color center target zone.
profile.reviewText:
Firstly, it rebounds. It really rebounds. Gets kids to stand back so that they have a chance to re-intercept the ball. And while it has then standing further away, it also forces them to focus on where they are kicking the ball, since, if you miss the rebounder, you have to run to get the ball.

The 4ft x 6ft is large enough so that an adult can play, too. We haven't used a regulation soccer ball on it yet, since kids like to play barefoot, but those cheap $1 grocery store balls (about the size of a soccer ball), work well too (and no one gets hurt).

Also excellent for a small yard where there is not a lot of room for setting up a true goal shot: this keeps the ball out of the neighbors' yards (mostly) and you can play alone if everyone else has other stuff to do.

Appears to have taken about 30 minutes to assemble, not reading the directions: I did not participate, but no one was grumpy about the experience.
profile.summary: Even better than I expected

profile.description: Petmate Two-door Top Load Kennel offers easy access for your beloved pet. Your furry friend will enjoy superior ventilation and visibility. This kennel is great tool for crate training and housetraining. Features also include secure wing-nut and bolt design, steel front door with secure latch, comfort carry handle, and water cup. Constructed of sturdy yet stylish heavy-duty plastic, the steel wire and plastic combine for strength, safety, and visibility. Petmate kennels meet most airline travel requirements. Pet parents should always confirm the airline travel requirements for each trip.
profile.reviewText:
I had to replace my standard cardboard cat carrier after my new (very sweet and gentle) kitty went ninja in it and ripped it in half during the first ride to the vet.

DURABILITY:
He still doesn't like being in a box, but he couldn't rip through this (he tried a bit, but there is no evidence of it) and actually resigned himself to lying down during the return trip. I was dubious about the "dinky-looking" little carrier handle attached to the top opening, but the handle works well and once I lifted the complete cat-in-carrier package, I never thought about it again.

SIZE:
It is roomy enough for him: he's 11 lbs and very tall for a cat (and I've had big cats before, but he is the longest cat I've ever seen). Would have worked well for my last cat (big-boned 17 lbs), too.
It fits across the front seat of my Honda, hanging over the edges a it but it does not interfere with driving, and then he can see me through the door.

AIR-TRAVEL APPROVED:
Although the packaging states that is is an approved carrier for airlines, I only use this for vet trips, not for flying or cross-country travel. I would want more space for a cat if I used it for long journeys.

WATER/SNACK TRAY:
The "water" tray is a joke for water - too shallow to put much in and then one bump and there's nothing left - but it can hold a few treats and clips onto the front door wherever you choose. "Kitty" ripped that thing off in the first two minutes, but it's fine (undamaged) and can be reattached another day. He just doesn't care to be bribed during the indignity of being put in a box.

TOP DOOR / SKYLIGHT-DOOR:
The top door - the best thing ever - actually allows me to get him in with minimal fuss. I cannot imagine trying to shove a cat headfirst into a box (he has all his claws), and this allows for a very quick and easy grab-and-go. The top opening is about as big as they can make it and still have the box hold together, so it is definitely enough room to get a cat in. The spring latches are firm without being impossible to open; they slide easily and can be opened with minimal effort by creatures with thumbs. Cats, not so much.

CLEANING / ASSEMBLY:
I think with the two doors it also feels less boxed-in for him, and I put it together in 5 minutes, no tools required. It also can be taken apart very easily if you need to wash it out, store it or whatever. And kudos to the manufacturer: they provide a couple of extra metal bolts and plastic nuts in the package, in case you need another one down the road.
The front door can be installed to swing in either direction and since it only takes 5 minutes to take it apart, you can change your mind as often as you want.

I was never planning to spend $40 on a cat carrier, since my last cat used the same $7 carrier for 3 years, but I am really happy with this one.
profile.summary: The top entry option wins a prize!

profile.description: Join the Time Cube revolution! Since 2010, our Miracle Time Cube has helped organize the lives of thousands of happy customers. The simplicity of this uniquely designed clock makes it easy to stay on schedule - whether its for timing kids with their homework, brushing teeth or taking a shower, it a fun way to teach them to establish routines. Around the house, it makes a great kitchen timer - perfect as an egg timer, baking timer, frying timer - anything that needs to be tracked in blocks of time. For those customers looking for a time management tool or office tracking tool, the Cube Timer is perfect for staying on task, maintaining focus and improving productivity in strategies like the pomodoro method. For those customers who are interested in improving their effectiveness in High Intensity Interval Training (HIIT), theres a Cube Timer for you. No more setting a stop watch or digital timer, just turn to the desired time setting and let the workout begin. Increase the time for cardio burn, lower it for fat burn and you can now focus on your workout routine instead of your timer. No more buttons, no more switches, no more dials, the Miracle Cube Timer allows you to manage your time with simplicity and in style. The four sides of the cube simply state the minutes that you would like to start timing. Merely turn it on the side needed and it will immediately start timing. When the time is up, a loud, unmistakable alarm will ring. Simply turn it back to its upright position to silence it. Its that easy! The Miracle Cube Timer is a fun, practical gift for you, a friend or a loved one as an easy, attractive way to manage time.
profile.reviewText:
So I know I can set a timer on my phone, or the stove, or the microwave or the kitchen timer....but this is so easy that I actually USE it. In clearing out the garage (where you can't hear the kitchen timers), when your hands are not the cleanest, instead of putting dirty paws all over your phone, you just flip a cube. Done.

It's so easy that it removes the procrastination factor to many chores - you flip the cube. Done. There's no getting sidelined into missed texts while navigating the phone to the timer option. There's no snacking while setting the stove timer.

My favourite part is that I now almost flip it before I know what I'm doing and then that's the end of the world-wide-waste-of-time. Until the beep.

As per other reviewers comments about the abrasive noise of the beep...I don't find it loud, jarring, abrasive or displeasing. It's a beep-beep-beep similar to the one that you used to get out of your clock radio alarm before we got all fancy-pants with waking to endangered bird-calls, Zen gongs, burbling brooks or other sounds that try to deceive the fact that they are actual alarms.

It's an alarm. Not particularly loud or soft - hard to hear if it's in the garage and I'm in my kitchen (one outside door separating the spaces), but if I'm in a closed garage - often an echo-y space - it's fine.

It turns off after you ignore it for about 10 seconds. Mine has a little fidget where I sometimes have to tap it gently when moving it from a time to "0" to get it to register that it's now off...but I have also dropped it, so I can excuse that. There is something very rewarding about actually flipping it off, too.
I hesitated over the price, but now I don't regret it for a moment.
profile.summary: Up against the clock was never so easy....or immediate.

Cat loves it, but definitely cheaper at my local Co-Op ($2.19 per can and 10% off for buying a case of 12 = $24 or so), and it's local. Cat also loves the Wellness Core Beef Venison & Lamb flavour, but this one made him very chatty and excited. I will probably alternate them.

Hoping that it will stay fresh in the fridge with the silicone pet lids. Usually the 5.5oz cans are eaten in one and a half days and the larger can should take around 4 to finish. Will try to update when I know.
profile.summary: Cat loves it, but cheaper at my local Co-Op ($2.19 per can and 10% off for buying a case of 12).

profile.description: Our Cool Pup Mats provide pets with a cool spot to rest on hot days.  Innovative cooling mat keeps pets cool during the dog days of summer  Pop the entire mat into the fridge for extra cooling effect  The mat stays cool even when it's not refrigerated, due to its innate cooling properties  Made of durable poly-nylon; wipes clean in a snap Cool Pup is approved by Dr. Katy Im a big fan of Cool Pup products because they help to keep pets cooler than any other products Ive tried on my pets. The portable bowls are great for travel and help keep our pups hydrated. The cool mats are an excellent choice for summer travel. I keep a cooling vest and cooling mat in the fridge for when were about to head out the door on a hot daythey make a great combination for dogs prone to overheating!Dr. Katy Dr. Katy Nelson is a veterinarian at the Belle Haven Animal Medical Centre in Alexandria, Virginia, and the host and executive producer of The Pet Show with Dr. Katy. Material: Nylon taffeta Care: Wipe clean with a damp cloth. Do not wash in a washing machine. Sizes:  Small measure 16"L x 12"W  Medium measures 20"L x 16"W  Large measures 35" x 20"
profile.reviewText:
Disclaimer: I did not test the product since the product information on Amazon did not include this significant restriction. My need is for a product that offers a cool option to a pet who does not have air conditioning. UNDER 95 degrees F. is still a tolerable day. Because of this, I feel that a review is necessary for other potential buyers to make an informed purchasing decision. I shall probably return this item, since it will not meet my needs.

I gave the product three stars because all-in-all, it seems awesome. I subtracted 2 stars because (as a cooling pad) I did not expect it's use to be limited to UNDER 95 degrees F. (especially since there was no warning of this in the product pages).

I was so excited to receive this product: I have an outdoor cat who has access to a garage. In the summer, it can get really hot and sometimes the heat index even makes the garage a cooler option. I purchased this to use on these days, since I am currently using a  cold pack from the freezer that I wrap in towels for him. Since several reviewers remarked that this mat was the location of choice for their pets even without refrigerating, I was thrilled.

Unfortunately, the first thing I see on the package before I open the box is:
"This product is to be used in temperatures under 95 degrees F."

UNDER 95 degrees F.

Meaning that on those really hot days, you should not use this product, so I'm back to the (currently "free") freezer icepack. Effective, but inconvenient if I cannot be home all day on ice pack duty. Luckily there are not many of those truly nasty days.

Should I decide to keep this, I shall update my review. However, I do feel that if a cold pack designed for pets cannot offer relief at "normal" summer temperatures (for some states, anyway), it should specify. Especially as this was the ONLY sentence on the box NOT listed on the product page and there were only about 5 sentences pertaining the the use of the product anyway. There are no additional instructions included inside the box.

Hope this helps. Otherwise seems a great product.
profile.summary: * * * *  to be used in temperatures UNDER 95 degrees F. * * * *

profile.description: The naot etera is an extremely comfortable sandal with a padded backstrap. This style features a hook and loop closure at the instep and gore at the middle strap. Naot's removable anatomic cork and latex footbed is wrapped in pampering suede and molds to the shape of the foot with wear. The koru collection features a 1" polyurethane sole which is extremely lightweight durable and slip resistant. This collection uses a hand-sewn strobel construction making it strong and extremely flexible.
profile.reviewText:
Really wanted to like them...but, (as another reviewer said) they would probably be truer to size if they weren't so narrow. The narrowness didn't bother me, but it made the shoe shorter than I needed. Basically, as the shoe curves around in the front, I had one toe that kept catching just the raised edge a bit. If I had gone up a half-size it would probably have been perfect, but they were out of that size, and, frankly, having to pay to return these was already galling enough.

I think if I had a location that I could go to to try them on until I found the necessary size, I would have kept the pair that fit. As it was, I've resolved to never buy another pair of shoes online that does not come with free return shipping. It's just not worth it.

They were sophisticated and could easily do a wedding if you needed a more supportive shoe or just hate your feet hurting (maybe not at the Ritz in Paris, but then again, everyone should be looking at the bride).
profile.summary: Narrow enough to affect the size you need to purchase...

top_5.description: Dr. David Baboulene is a published author and academic, and a story consultant for publishers, corporations, film production companies and private clients.
top_5.reviewText:
Amazing...and I have read a LOT of books on how novels/fiction writing works...or should work. This is in my top 5. Probably my top 3.
There are other reviews that mention the way he covers subtext, Knowledge Gaps, dialogue, etc., so I shall just add that if the whole "index card" activity never seemed to work for you....then read this. Not that it explains the same old thing that you've heard of before. No. This book explains a tweaked system that actually MAKES SENSE, not just from the perspective of using the system to navigate your story, but how to structure the exercise so that it means something to the story structure besides deciding if Aunt Jemima put syrup on her pancakes before she puts the cat out or afterwards.

He also uses this system to show you how to approach a new project in a constructive sense...so that you can either build it properly or bail on it before you spend more time on a clunker. And he doesn't include any cute little sections that cover vast areas of plot structure with: "And now you just decide when Aunt Jemima puts the cat out." He actually guides you through the decisions that can make or break you, by telling you the purpose of those decisions to the story. And how to be brave and kill them when they are no longer relevant.

He dissects the structures of scenes and sequences, so that you can actually see how the pieces are intended to fit together, why they work that way, and what questions to ask your material to whip it into shape if it feels all limp and aimless.

And as for his clarification between a dilemma and "something very difficult"...NOT the same thing (who knew?!)...and the effect they have on plot....that little section was worth the price alone.

Good writing style, easy to grasp and even though the cover of this book screams "scriptwriting", novelists and fiction-writers will have no trouble using this. When there is a distinction between the formats, he clearly explains the difference between the way the information can be used for each and why.

Probably the best $3 I have ever spent on Amazon!
top_5.summary: Script writers, fiction writers, novelists, "armchair writers"....this is for you.

top_5.description: Model No.: X6001; Covering Material: Ultra Thick Faux Fur; Covering Color: Dark Seagreen; Board Material: Pressed Wood; Post Diameter: 3-1/2-inch; Overall Dimensions: 33-inch (L) X 25-inch (W) X 60"(H); Max Holding Weight: 50 lbs;
top_5.reviewText:
I needed a sturdy tower with a "room" that would be big enough for a long cat of 14lbs, high enough to satisfy a cat who LOVES climbing trees (real ones) and robust enough to handle wild play.

This is it.

I will say that he LOVES the dual opening in the "room" which allow him to either stick out, or to have a paw out each opening during "catch the string" game time. He can fit into it if he balls himself up tightly, but he tends to like spreading out onto the ledges in front of the openings.

He ignores the second shelf (from the ground), but one day when he is old and less spry, I think he'll appreciate it more. And the upper pedestals? LOVES them. Great view. Taller than most people. Big enough to fit on. And he likes sleeping on the roof of the "room"... One caveat: measure the space you think this will fit in and apply the overall dimensions of this cat tree...is is bigger than I thought it was.

Assembly was fast and easy with good directions and the requisite tools are provided. The sisal is holding up well and the carpet is a good shade of cream...it blends in well and is the go-to space for the cat. He especially appreciates the different scratching heights provided by the sisal-wrapped posts.
top_5.summary: Sturdy, high, entertaining...just measure the spot you're planning to put it in....

top_5.description: Sterilite high quality products 16 qt stacking drawer.
top_5.reviewText:
Bought these ages ago and I love them. They work so well that I need to get some new ones to match the original set...BUT... watch the 3rd party seller prices here...(the single drawer should be under $8 each, under $40 for a 6-pack ... and there is free shipping on the larger orders). I'll be getting mine directly from the local big-box store that we all love to hate (big W), or, if I have to, I'll order directly from their online store. I should have grabbed them today when I saw them on the shelf!

Incidentally, I use these for my off-season clothing storage: keeps dust out, but easily accessible if/when the weather shifts unexpectedly. This size is good for underwear, socks, athletic gear, beach-bag accessories like sunglasses/goggles/sunblock/swimsuits, winter-sports accessories like ski goggles/gloves/scarves/balaclavas/sunglasses/sunblock, etc. And I love that you can get an idea of what is inside each bin, but it's not crystal clear.

For some drawers I'll put a sheet of decorative paper on the inside, facing out, so that I can keep the contents more private...and it makes the drawers look a bit fancier.

There is a larger size that would work better for t-shirts, pants, etc. and best of all, both sizes stack together! The big box location also had a 3-drawer unit (same drawer design) that has 2 bigger drawers on the bottom and then one of this size on the top. You can then stack higher if you like, and it makes the configurations really flexible.

To make sure that you're in the same Sterilite drawer "family" (which affects the stack-ability' of the units), pay attention to the drawer pull detail (small, center, bottom edge of drawer)...some Sterilite "families" are outrageously priced...it's like the world is running out of plastic!
top_5.summary: Drawers are excellent BUT watch the third-party seller prices here....

top_5.description: Free Shipping to Worldwide and Register mail with tracking information!
top_5.reviewText:
Some other reviewers have commented that these figurines are "green" not grey. And yes, I would have to agree. The grey colour is actually a sort of teal with a greyish tinge. Now, had I read this before ordering, I might have hesitated, but now that I have them, I must say that even though I loathe the colour teal, these cats are as cute as they come. The colour doesn't bother me in the least, probably because they are just so darn cute. (And I think the mind sort of fills in for the green, making it seem normal).

Most of the figurines are about 1" high, but two of them are noticeably smaller: the top-right one with the red, and the bottom middle one are more like 0.75."

These were a gift, and the child loves them. They are very cute, not good for very small children (choking hazard size, and the edges of the ears are apparently quite sharp). But they are very cute, well-made and the details are good enough for the price. The stripes across the backs are the most "haphazard"...they do not match cat to cat...but that is really being a nitpick. The stripes are stripes and each cat has the look of Chi. If you're a serious collector, not just a cat-loving fan, then you probably shouldn't be bothering with this price range anyway.
top_5.summary: Teal cats? Yes. But still SUPER-CUTE.

top_5.description: This listing is created by Tokyo Japanese outlet. Thank you for loving our product . Authentic Iwako from Japan. All erasers are brand new in original bags.
