input: Generate the review text written by a reviewer who has a given an overall rating of "5.0" for a product with description "Jay Bell led a quiet life in Kansas until the day he met a handsome foreign exchange student named Andreas who swept him off his feet and carried him all the way to Germany. Much to their delight, marriage awaited them when they got there. While living so distant from friends and family, Jay began writing in an effort to reconcile the mixture of devotion and alienation he felt. This resulted in a Lambda Literary Award and a film option for his best-selling novel Something Like Summer. Jay and Andreas have since relocated to Chicago where their adventures continue, as do those of the characters in their emotionally driven Something Like series. Jay pens the stories and Andreas provides the cover art, making them books about love, forged by love.". The summary of the review text is "A "Must Read" sequel to "Something Like Summer" and "Something Like Winter"".
output:
5-stars for "Something Like Autumn" as well as for the entire series!  Jay Bell has taken something great and made the series incredibly better.

I won't leave a lengthy review as the first review by Galateo stand on its own and all I can say is dido.  If you haven't read it, I encourage you to do so.

What I would like to add is my appreciation for the care that Jay puts into creating such "in depth" characters that become like friends to the reader.  Jay has a wonderful way of creating dialogue between the characters that is witty and intelligent.  This series is about love and romance and does not rely on sex to fill the pages.  There is a lot of life experience, love and care that Jay has provided in this series.  Lessons so eloquently summed up and well written that I found myself saying, "I wish I had said that!"

I highly recommend this sequel to anyone who has read the first two books in this series.  As Galeteo stated in the earlier review, this book provided me with answers as to why Chase acted in such a gallant way, seemingly always in control.  Now I know and I am so thrilled I read Something Like Autumn.

I recommend this series to anyone that loves to read a great love story.  This series has many levels.  When everything is put together and I sit back and think about the experience, all I can say is Wow... I am so impressed.  As I read this series, the characters captivated me.  I laughed, I got pissed, I argued with them, I cussed them out and I felt their frustration, their sadness and I shed more tears than I care to admit.

profile.description: Jay Bell never gave much thought to Germany until he met a handsome foreign exchange student. At that moment, beer and pretzels became the most important thing in the world. After moving to Germany and getting married, Jay found himself desperate to communicate the feelings of love and alienation that surrounded this decision. He's been mashing laptop keyboards ever since. Jay is a Lambda Literary Award winner and a fairly bad dancer. He also thinks that you're really cool. Seriously.
profile.reviewText:
5-stars for Jay Bell's Something Like Thunder.  It is difficult to single out any one book from the series as greater than another. Jay has put so much creativity in developing characters as well as their relationships one with another.  I am so entertained experiencing their lives as they cross paths, come together, drift apart and come back together again.

Like many of readers' of Jay's books, I have become a fan of Jay's work.  Unlike other books that seem to be written to meet the expectations of the market, Jay provides the reader with the perception that they are being allowed to see into a dynamic whirlwind of activity that leaves the reader with a feeling of awe for having experienced Jay's creativity.

Jay has developed a special relationship with his readers. Plots and the characters are carefully crafted in a way that the reader experiences tremendous emotions along with the characters within the stories. Life is complicated and often harsh. Happily ever after isn't a foregone conclusion. Though the lives of the characters are tumultuous, the reader is never left in a dark place of hopelessness.

I highly recommend Jay's books to readers who like well developed stories with robust characters. Each of the books in the series are lengthy in contrast to many of today's novels written for young adults. Reader's willing to invest the time will be well rewarded for their time.

Reader's be warned, it is hard to set any one of the books in the series down and caution should be used if reading before bedtime.
profile.summary: Higly recommended a must read!

profile.description: Ashley John lives in the North of England with his fianc Reece, and his cat Jeremy. Ashley is a lover of love and a lover of life, and that's why he writes Romance novels. He's a sucker for gripping love story. His characters are fighters, strong and complex, and they'll do anything to get the happy endings they deserve (and there are usually a lot of tears and heartache along the way!). Ashley is best known for his best selling George & Harvey series and The Surf Bay Series. When Ashley isn't writing, he uses his creativity to paint and draw, and when he's not being creative, he's usually taking a nap.
profile.reviewText:
5-stars for Ashley John's "George & Harvey"

I recommend this M/M romance to readers who like M/M romances that are atypical. This is a fast read with numerous twists and turns along the way.  There is enough angst and drama to definitely keep the readers interest.

Personally, I enjoyed the story and I found it a worthwhile and entertaining story.  I especially find Harvey to be someone that I greatly admire.  George, however, is a little too good to be true.  That said, every book presents characters that we either like, are critical of or love to hate.  Ashley does adds depth to the story by making the main characters more complex than in typical romance novels.  I have read several of the books Ashley has written and I appreciate his storylines, writing and the twists and turns he takes his readers through as they read his books.  I paraphrase Ashley's approach to M/M romances.  There is a "Happy Ever After" but the characters go through a lot of challenges along the way.

Thank you Ashley John for providing me with many hours of enjoyable entertainment.
profile.summary: Great M/M romance story with all the twists and turns you would come to expect from a gifted writter.

profile.description: Fruit blend flavor with natural flavors provides healthy and delicious nutrition for everyday Feeding for birds that prefer this pellet size. Fruit colors, shapes and flavors with the essential nutrients your bird needs every day for good health.
profile.reviewText: I really like the Zupreem products. I had the food in a low dish and my canary would pick and chose throwing the rest over the side and were wasted. Put them in a bigger deeper feeding dish and he leaves the yellow pellets in the dish.  I don't know if it is a color or flavor issue with the yellow ones. I would imagine if they are like the children's cereal Fruit Loops with only a color difference with no difference in flavor between the colors, it would just be the color.  I am not going to do a taste test to find out.  This food is pricy. I still buy it, but I hate to see any of it wasted.  There are starving birds in China after all! or does that only pertain to children? You may want to try the smaller size first.
profile.summary: Great food and my bird loves it except for the yellow colored pellets.

profile.description: First published in 2003, The Other Side of What is Shannon Yarbrough's first book. Shannon published his second book, Stealing Wishes, in 2008. He lives in St. Ann, Missouri and is currently at work on another novel. Visit Shannon online at www.shannonyarbrough.com.
profile.reviewText:
4-star rating for "The Other Side of What" by Shannon Yarbrough.  The characters within this story are all part of an intricate dance of discovery. The storyline, as some have commented, may not be masterfully crafted. It is, however, only a story. The way the story unfolds as each of the characters deals with their own self-doubts and shame is a theme that most of us can relate too.

I recommend "The Other Side of What" to readers who enjoy stories of human experience and development.  This is not so much a love story as it is a story of the struggles we all go through as we develop and mature.  Sex is left to the imagination and those looking for erotica will not find it here.  What you will find is an interesting story of friendship, trust, acceptance, forgiveness, sacrifice and love.

Personally, I like the story and found it worthwhile reading.  I haven't put my finger on it, but I find it to be truly unique from other books I have read.  I particularly like that the characters were human beings with faults and challenges. Ethan, though a minor character in this story, especially touched my heart given the physical and emotional challenges he faced. Yes, some of the coincidences were a bit stretched, but this does not take away from the resulting experiences and growth achieved by Mathew, Ethan, Jacob, Vance, and even Seth and Zoe.
profile.summary: Coming of age isn't a smooth journey

Reader's be warned, it is hard to set any one of the books in the series down and caution should be used if reading before bedtime.
top_5.summary: Higly recommended a must read!

top_5.description: Ashley John lives in the North of England with his fianc Reece, and his cat Jeremy. Ashley is a lover of love and a lover of life, and that's why he writes Romance novels. He's a sucker for gripping love story. His characters are fighters, strong and complex, and they'll do anything to get the happy endings they deserve (and there are usually a lot of tears and heartache along the way!). Ashley is best known for his best selling George & Harvey series and The Surf Bay Series. When Ashley isn't writing, he uses his creativity to paint and draw, and when he's not being creative, he's usually taking a nap.
top_5.reviewText:
5-stars for Ashley John's "George & Harvey"

I recommend this M/M romance to readers who like M/M romances that are atypical. This is a fast read with numerous twists and turns along the way.  There is enough angst and drama to definitely keep the readers interest.

Personally, I enjoyed the story and I found it a worthwhile and entertaining story.  I especially find Harvey to be someone that I greatly admire.  George, however, is a little too good to be true.  That said, every book presents characters that we either like, are critical of or love to hate.  Ashley does adds depth to the story by making the main characters more complex than in typical romance novels.  I have read several of the books Ashley has written and I appreciate his storylines, writing and the twists and turns he takes his readers through as they read his books.  I paraphrase Ashley's approach to M/M romances.  There is a "Happy Ever After" but the characters go through a lot of challenges along the way.

Thank you Ashley John for providing me with many hours of enjoyable entertainment.
top_5.summary: Great M/M romance story with all the twists and turns you would come to expect from a gifted writter.

top_5.description: Fruit blend flavor with natural flavors provides healthy and delicious nutrition for everyday Feeding for birds that prefer this pellet size. Fruit colors, shapes and flavors with the essential nutrients your bird needs every day for good health.
top_5.reviewText: I really like the Zupreem products. I had the food in a low dish and my canary would pick and chose throwing the rest over the side and were wasted. Put them in a bigger deeper feeding dish and he leaves the yellow pellets in the dish.  I don't know if it is a color or flavor issue with the yellow ones. I would imagine if they are like the children's cereal Fruit Loops with only a color difference with no difference in flavor between the colors, it would just be the color.  I am not going to do a taste test to find out.  This food is pricy. I still buy it, but I hate to see any of it wasted.  There are starving birds in China after all! or does that only pertain to children? You may want to try the smaller size first.
top_5.summary: Great food and my bird loves it except for the yellow colored pellets.

top_5.description: First published in 2003, The Other Side of What is Shannon Yarbrough's first book. Shannon published his second book, Stealing Wishes, in 2008. He lives in St. Ann, Missouri and is currently at work on another novel. Visit Shannon online at www.shannonyarbrough.com.
top_5.reviewText:
4-star rating for "The Other Side of What" by Shannon Yarbrough.  The characters within this story are all part of an intricate dance of discovery. The storyline, as some have commented, may not be masterfully crafted. It is, however, only a story. The way the story unfolds as each of the characters deals with their own self-doubts and shame is a theme that most of us can relate too.

I recommend "The Other Side of What" to readers who enjoy stories of human experience and development.  This is not so much a love story as it is a story of the struggles we all go through as we develop and mature.  Sex is left to the imagination and those looking for erotica will not find it here.  What you will find is an interesting story of friendship, trust, acceptance, forgiveness, sacrifice and love.

Personally, I like the story and found it worthwhile reading.  I haven't put my finger on it, but I find it to be truly unique from other books I have read.  I particularly like that the characters were human beings with faults and challenges. Ethan, though a minor character in this story, especially touched my heart given the physical and emotional challenges he faced. Yes, some of the coincidences were a bit stretched, but this does not take away from the resulting experiences and growth achieved by Mathew, Ethan, Jacob, Vance, and even Seth and Zoe.
top_5.summary: Coming of age isn't a smooth journey

input: Generate the review text written by a reviewer who has a given an overall rating of "3.0" for a product with description "Compatible with Mobius Action Cameras (Regular or Wide) or any camera with a standard 1/4" - 20 Tripod Thread. Will clip on to most vehicle sun visors and hats.". The summary of the review text is "Great idea, just needs a little tweaking, and possibly shortening the clip a little (OOPS) Please read P.S.!".
output:
I should've read the reviews before buying this, but I was just too damn exited at the prospect of being able to mount my "RunCam 2" to the top of my baseball hat!

Well, now that I have it, I'm going to make some 'adjustments' to it, since it's 1.5" (38.1 mm) wide, x 4" (101.6 mm) long. That's wide enough to be reasonably stable (unless you're VERY active) but too long, (as it pushes it loose, the closer I get it to my forehead, attempting to make it tighter). That's another thing, even if you have a light camera attached to the tri-pod mount (on an adjustable ball-joint) it still tends to pull the clip off, since it's not very strong.

(P.S.)
I just realized after reading some other reviews that this clip was meant to be for a visor IN A CAR!!!! MAN do I feel silly! Oh well, I'm good a jury-rigging, I'll figure out some use for it.....

Other than those obvious flaws, it's a great idea, just need some stronger material. I'm afraid if I tighten this to where it's needed, it'll break, since the entire clamp is made of plastic; great choice for making a light (in weight) clip, but a bad choice for grip! Only suggestion I can think up right now, is to make a hole where a threaded rod goes at the part where the clip comes together, and make it clamp together with 2 flat pieces of plastic, so you won't have to put a hole in your baseball hat, and you can remove or tighten the screws to hold the camera on, or loosen them to remove it, and wear your hat without the camera!

profile.reviewText: I LOVE the fact that this camera is so small! The time/date stamp function that it has (that can be turned off if wanted) is WONDERFUL! I wanted to get an in-depth look at the functionality of this camera before I got one, seeing as how on my budget, $199.00 is a LOT of money, and I wanted to be sure of what I was getting (I'm certain others can agree with me!) All I can say is, save up your money and get one! This camera is GREAT! (In fact, I think I'm going to get another one soon!) If you want to see the video I watched that helped me make up my mind to get this camera, look for a review for this camera on "Youtube" done by a person named "Techmoan". It convinced me, and not only is this camera small, and has a 2 1/2 to 3 hour battery life, it's also very light! When my "Metroflash E360" that I purchased here on Amazon.com 3 years ago, finally 'gave up the ghost', I got this camera to replace it, and didn't realize how much heavier the "Metroflash" had been (especially since I have it mounted on my bicycle helmet!) Also, I had thought my "Metroflash" had decent 'low-light' performance, the "Drift Stealth 2" even beat it in THAT respect! On a scale of 1-10, I'd give the video a 10, the audio a 9.3, (the only reason it loses .7 of a point, is because of a whistle from wind noise) and the rain resistance a 10! (It can supposedly be submerged 2 meters [or 6.5 feet] without a waterproof case, but I haven't tried that, nor do I plan to!) I am planning on curing the wind whistle with a product sold here on Amazon.com, called "Micover Stickover-Mini Universal Windscreen for DSLRs, Phones, Laptops, Small Video Cameras" I'll see how it works. I just really enjoy the camera, and would not fail to recommend it to any/everyone! (UPDATE 7-1-2015) The "Micover Stickover" I mentioned in my review, is excellent for cutting out that pesky wind noise I was getting, (even though I only get up to 30mph, seeing as how I'm on a bicycle) and I would recommend it to anybody who wears this as a helmet-cam on a bicycle,(but can't speak for a motorcycle, or motocross racer). (UPDATE 7-20-2015) I now have 3 of these cameras, as well as the "DRIFT GHOST REMOTE CONTROL" and the remote DOES work with this camera. I was able to pair all 3 with that remote, and though you still have to turn each individual camera on by itself, to start recording all I now have to do, is push one button.
profile.summary: This camera has everything I want, and more!

profile.description: The New Mini Action Camera From WCI Is The Ultimate Accessory For All Outdoor Sports Recording. Attach the Camera Securely With The Included Strap And Mounts, and Record It All In Real Time. Upload The Video File To Your Computer with The USB Cable, And Store those Memories For A Long, Long Time. Easy, Affordable and User Friendly, It Is a Great Alternative To Other Pricier Models Out There!
profile.reviewText: I really like this camera, and it has it's drawbacks, but for the price, it beats the living snot out of a GoPro! I have noticed that it has a "flashing" effect when I go outside,(possibly due to the sudden change in the amount of light) but it has great sounding audio! However; once you put it in the waterproof case, that audio is all but non-existent! Maybe when I mount it to my helmet and go for a ride on my bike that'll all change, but when I first tested it, it sounded fine, until I put the case on it. Then the sound lost about 95% of it's clarity. The other thing I noticed, was that the color went from full spectrum, to paled, back to full spectrum, but did so ONLY when a shock occurred, and then, only for a VERY short time. The last thing I noticed, was that it's low light performance was pretty bad, albeit it uses any/all available light sources, just doesn't have any illumination of its own. If you're looking for a starter camera, or if you just want a decent camera for active use, and you don't want a really expensive one (like me) then this is the camera for you! One more thing, the growling/whining noise in the video is not the camera; I have an electric kit on my bike to help me up hills, as there are many where I live, and I'm going up a particularly steep one in the video. Just wanted to show the performance of the camera. (Update 6-26-2014) I got a chance to use it more, and I found out the 'flashing' I mentioned earlier, doesn't happen in the 'HD' mode, and neither does the color instability. Those were both only in the 640X480 resolution. However, the battery life in 'HD' mode (using the video recorder) is shorter than that of 640X480.
profile.summary: My first helmet cam, but a great choice!

profile.description: The MetroFlash e360 Wi-Fi Extreme HD Action Camera is designed to capture your everyday most exciting adventure and ventures! Designed for surfers, skaters, motorcyclists, bikers, base jumpers, snowboarders and anyone else who want to capture high definition videos of their most extreme moments, MetroFlash e360 Wi-Fi Extreme HD Action Camera is capable of recording in the most extreme conditions. Attach it to your helm, to your surfboard, on your bike's handlebar or strap it around your waist and shoot your breathtaking action from up close. Armed with Low-Light Performance CMOS image sensor, F2.8 Ultra Wide Sharp lens (170-degree coverage) and built-in Wi-Fi, MetroFlash e360 is always ready to capture and share the action anywhere!.
profile.reviewText: This is the best camera I have yet seen. It has (not surprisingly) lasted me almost a year, and looks like it will last another with no problems! Even when I was riding in 5 degree temperatures, the battery life was 2 hours on 1080p, and waterproof (without a case) as well! (I found this out the hard way, enough said) Also, since it's mounted to my helmet, it has received its fair share of bumps, knocks, falls, and scrapes, and hasn't shown the least bit of it, (aside from some marks on the housing itself) and continues to work like the day I got it! Another good thing, is that since it doesn't have a display screen to speak of, and it has 'Wi-Fi', I use my "iPhone 5c" as my display screen! The video I put up is just to show the performance of the camera, and albeit, it has a very sensitive microphone, and wind noise is very prevalent, on auto, it switches from bright sun to lower light rather quickly, and as you can see, I went into my basement from a sunny day, and it adjusted almost instantaneously. (P.S.) Amazon lowers the quality a tad, but the video (and audio) quality are excellent when they come directly from the camera! (Update) I like this camera so much, besides being able to take whatever I may dish out, and the clarity of video and sensitivity of the microphone, (along with being waterproof without an external case) the only other thing I would wish for, is the option to add a time/date stamp to the video. Just an OPTION. If you don't want it, don't activate it. I just want it to be available. If it were, I would buy at LEAST 3 more of these cameras (possibly more!) Other than that, this is THE best camera I have EVER had! I've seen tests of the GoPro Hero Black Edition, and this camera wins HANDS DOWN!!!! At LESS than half the price, believe it or not!
profile.summary: The Metroflash E360: No GoPro, But Just As Good (If Not Better); And Cheaper!

profile.description: Package included: 1 x Aluminum Case with LOGO 1 x Strap 1 x Base Mount and Bolts 1 x Lens Cap. Designed for GoPro Hero 4
profile.reviewText:
Though I see many good reviews of this mount, mine seemed to have come with stripped-out threads, and therefore, I can't use it as it was intended. I was going to use it to mount a "Cycliq Fly12" (which has "GoPro" style mounts, and can be placed upside-down on your bars) however, being that said camera/light/alarm (read my review on the "Fly12" page for further details) is quite expensive (like many "GoPro" cameras [the LEAST expensive one is $129.99, which is rather inexpensive, actually; but as for most others....]) with that stripped thread (that came like that from the manufacturer) I didn't want to take the chance it would 'give way' while I was driving down the road, and even though the camera has a safety tether, I STILL don't want to risk a $350.00 camera/light/alarm! Anyway, I'm glad the mount arrives with an Allen wrench to tighten the screws (it fits them, but I can only tighten 1) The mount is geared to fit a 31.8mm  (1.25 in) handlebar, but I used it on a smaller one, a 25.4 mm (1") one, which required I use a thick rubber spacer from one of the lights I didn't require any spacers for (In other words, I did a bit of jury-rigging). Now, to answer the question I had when I first ordered this (that being "how far does this extend from the handlebar?") first off, the length of the entire mount, is 4" (101.6 mm), as far as how far from the handlebar it actually extends, that answer would be 2" (50.8 mm). Also, at the widest point in the area where the "GoPro" type mount is, it's a little over 0.5" wide (12.7 mm). But as I first said, 3 of the 4 screws were stripped out when it arrived, so be careful when you order this, and just be aware that this is possible, yet I hope
you don't have to deal with it as I have.

(UPDATE 11/22/2016)
 I was going to return this mount to get my money back, but it seems they have an exchange policy, and the company (as well as Amazon) were both VERY easy to work with, and they sent me a new mount for no charge, as well as not requiring me to send the other one back! (Actually, what are they going to do with a stripped-out mount, anyway?) They also had it ship VERY fast, (it got here in 2 days, when the original took around a week and a half!) while it worked great, and wasn't stripped at all! I guess the first one just snuck by quality control, and unfortunately got shipped to me! Still, the fact that the company had such great customer service, and replaced the mount so quickly, without a single question, made me VERY happy, along with making another loyal customer! I added 3 stars, since I was so pleased, and they were so easy to work with! Like I said in a previous review, customer service means a LOT to me!
profile.summary: Good mount extension, just hope the threads aren't stripped out when it arrives! (UPDATED)

profile.description: Capture it all with Gear Pro! Re-live all of your action-packed experiences at home or share them with your family and friends. This Mini Hi-Resolution Digital Camera & Camcorder is easy to use and allows you to upload your videos for everyone to see. The lightweight and compact size will allow you to position it just about anywhere and will make you feel like the director of your own action movie! You'll see all the details - every monster jump, every tight turn and every heart-pounding second thanks to the Fully HD 1080P 12.0 Mega Pixel High-Definition Capability. profile.reviewText: I used to have an old "Gear Pro" action camera that lasted for a year (I admit, I didn't think it would last that long!) and is just now dying, hence the reason I (mistakenly) got this "Gear (not) Pro". I was luckily able to get it turned on (from what I've read, others didn't even get that far!) and enter the time and date stamp, (which I realized was only viewable in the 'car' folder) which was helpful, since I can't turn it off, (due to a 'file error' message) I now know the exact time, day, and date this camera 'gave up the ghost'! Exactly 15 minutes after it was activated for the first (and last) time! I got a couple test videos off it before the end, and from what I saw, it wasn't too bad. Wish they could stop the 'file error' message, and make a better overall camera, so these reviews would be much better! Also, as another reviewer put it, "It seems like buying these cameras is like flipping a coin; you may get one that works, or you may get a piece of junk". Sadly, I got the latter of the two.
profile.summary: How Can They Sell These Things, Then Sleep At Night?

profile.description: Halo Belt Company is a San Francisco based company, with a goal of saving lives. Over the past two years we have expanded our business in safety all over the globe. Our conception of the Halo Belt was brought to life with the help of the Kickstarter community. We have learned a tremendous amount about safety patterns and where Halo Belt safety can be applied. We are in markets such as law enforcement, cycling, running, children safety, skiing, hiking, motorist, roadside safety, airport traffic safety, extreme sports, and military. Halo Belt is a reflective and LED illuminated running belt for general visibility increase.
profile.reviewText:
This 'slap band' is great, and visible to anybody about half a football field away (either behind, or in front) from you, (provided it's relatively flat land) and the closer someone is to the wearer, the easier the wearer can be seen! When I drove a car (not anymore, because of my 'condition') I realized that a flashing light got a drivers' attention faster than a solid light, and the flashing light didn't have to be as bright as the solid one. Hence, it's best to set this band on one of the 2 flashing settings. It has a bright solid setting, a bright flashing setting, and a dim flashing setting. The bright flashing setting would be good in low light and dusk, and the dim flashing setting would be good in darkness. Otherwise, if you have either of the bright settings in use in the dark, the bright solid setting might make the driver think you're a a lot further away than you are, (hence, not slowing down when they should) or if you use the bright flashing setting, the repeated flashes may dis-orient the driver, they could lose control, and you know the possible outcome from THAT. So in the dark, the best setting to use is the low flash. The only reason I gave this a 4 star, instead of a 5, is because the band is NOT rechargeable, yet in the product description, they say it is; well, as of 3-2-2016 they say that, but they will most likely change it soon.

*I received this product at a discount in exchange for a fair and unbiased review* and had I paid full price, I would have given it the same review I just did, as well as bought 2! In fact, I think I WILL buy another right now!

(UPDATE 3-13-2016) Well, they haven't changed the 'fully rechargeable' claim as of yet, let's see how long it takes...

(SECOND UPDATE 4-2-2016) Well, I see they STILL haven't changed the 'fully rechargeable' claim, and now I'll start deducting stars for their impudence. It has now gone from 4 to 3 stars. PLEASE remove that claim from the main page, it's VERY misleading!

THIRD UPDATE (4-21-2016) I REALLY like this 'slap band', but the "Halo Belt Company's" continued refusal to remove the 'fully rechargeable' CLAIM, (when they know FULL WELL it IS'NT) is VERY misleading to anybody who reads their false claims! I'll give them a few more weeks, then I'm going to file a 'false advertising' claim against them, UNLESS they take down the false claim they made about the band!

(FOURTH UPDATE 5-23-2016) I noticed they FINALLY removed the 'rechargeable' claim on their main page, and will now ADD a few stars for their compliance, (thank you) it may only be 4 instead of 5, but the fact that they showed compliance (and their 'slap band' IS great) is a very promising thing...
profile.summary: Great 'slap band', bright and visible; excellent for cycling at night!  (UPDATED 4-21-2016)

profile.reviewText: I didn't realize there would be so many in a package, even though it stated so in the product description! (don't ask) Anyway, since they mentioned it being used on a "Contour" camera in the description, I took a wild stab in the dark, and saw if one would work on my "Drift Stealth 2" and it did! Before I got these, the wind would make not only a whistling noise in my built-in microphone (since this model doesn't have a jack for an external mic) but, (even though I only use it on my bicycle helmet) it made another,...well,...high-pitched 'Bronx cheer' type noise. (That's the nicest way to put it). But thanks to this windscreen over the microphone, that unpleasant sound is gone, (even in high wind, well 30mph/48kph I don't know about speeds on a motorcycle) and I couldn't be happier about that! Try them for any microphone you think could be exposed to wind, primarily if your're taking a group photo (especially on the beach) with a smaller camera mounted on a tri-pod. These work great for keeping wind noise out!
profile.summary: A beard for your camera!

profile.description: From the little moments in your day to the horizons you pursue, capture life as it happens with Gear 360. The front and rear lenses each capture 180 degrees horizontally and vertically, creating a seamless and complete 360-degree field of view.
profile.reviewText: Hopefully, I'll be able to increase it to 5 stars soon, as it seems to have a learning curve, and I can't quite figure out yet. So far though, I am extremely happy with the battery life and the fact that it has a tripod mount on the exact bottom, and I was able to put it on my bicycle helmet  just the other day. It lasted 2 hours, and STILL had enough juice for another estimated 15 minutes to half an hour, and that was in cold weather! I'm impressed with everything on this camera, I just want to figure out how to use the wifi, to see my footage. From what I have seen so far, (yes I was able to hook it into my PC) it looks like the footage is extremely clear and the audio sounds great, I just can't stitch it together.....YET. In summation, it may be proving to be somewhat confusing right now, but (if you'll pardon the expression) it seems to be a diamond in the rough that just needs a bit more work.
profile.summary: WONDERFUL 360 camera, with one caveat!

profile.description: Unique design, light weight, wear comfortable, attract attention. Effectively protect your eyes, face, nose. Sculpted styling with exceptional fit and peripheral vision. Adjustable Strap to accomodate any helmet. Optically correct clear lens which is durable and shatter-proof. Foam padding around the outer rim for added comfort.
profile.reviewText: This is a good, solid mask with a few caveats, which I will mention a bit later. As for now, I can say that this mask is comfortable, (the sponge-like material that lines it, is better than the somewhat dry, scratchy foam used by cheaper goggles/masks, but I think the harder foam is better. Just my opinion, though) I haven't used them/it (funny how a mask is a mask, yet goggles [even though they're one piece,] are always referred to as a pair, isn't it?) in cold weather yet, but they do a good job at protecting your eyes from the wayward insect (of which there are PLENTY where I live, and I only ride a bicycle!) I got a SMALL insect in my eye the other night (before I had these) and had to stop, pull off the road, and clean out my eye! If I had tried to do it while still riding, I certainly would have crashed! If something so small (they're called "no see 'ums" where I live) can screw up your vision, imagine what a Junebug could do! I did notice that the 'teal' color was decent for seeing in the dark (for me, anyway) never tried it during the day, though. Now, on to the caveats I spoke of earlier. While I said the sponge-like material is soft, (which it is) when I went out the other night, it held onto my sweat, and I could see it in the mask when I removed it. Also, I never removed the part over the nose (even though it CAN be, or so the pictures at the top of the page show) because I didn't want to possibly break the mask, since it comes with no instructions. The last thing I wanted to address, is the tendency the mask has to fog up, not very badly mind you, just bad enough to be a bother, and ONLY if you stop. When you start moving again, it clears up. I haven't put any anti-fog treatment on the mask YET, so that may be a contributor to the problem, too. *I received this mask at a discount for a fair and honest review*, and that's what I have given, hope it helped you in your decision making process.
profile.summary: A nice, useful, and protective mask, just wish it had instructions!

If I had tried to do it while still riding, I certainly would have crashed! If something so small (they're called "no see 'ums" where I live) can screw up your vision, imagine what a Junebug could do! I did notice that the 'teal' color was decent for seeing in the dark (for me, anyway) never tried it during the day, though. Now, on to the caveats I spoke of earlier. While I said the sponge-like material is soft, (which it is) when I went out the other night, it held onto my sweat, and I could see it in the mask when I removed it. Also, I never removed the part over the nose (even though it CAN be, or so the pictures at the top of the page show) because I didn't want to possibly break the mask, since it comes with no instructions. The last thing I wanted to address, is the tendency the mask has to fog up, not very badly mind you, just bad enough to be a bother, and ONLY if you stop. When you start moving again, it clears up. I haven't put any anti-fog treatment on the mask YET, so that may be a contributor to the problem, too. *I received this mask at a discount for a fair and honest review*, and that's what I have given, hope it helped you in your decision making process.
profile.summary: A nice, useful, and protective mask, just wish it had instructions!

profile.description: Get ready to roll with the gear Pro Ryder Put the pedal to the metal with this HD action Cam that's designed for your wheels. Use it inside your car and mount it to your dashboard or attach it to your bike's handlebars when cycling. The Ryder was designed to tag along for the ride Built-in video image stabilization reduces shaking and unwanted distortion when driving or cycling over debris and bumpy roads. Use it for your car, motorcycle, bike, or just strap in onto your helmet and record the action -- rain or shine Additional features include Marine grade waterproof case, motion Detector recording, 2 hour battery life, easy transfer and share computer ability, wide variety of mounting accessories and plenty more Whether you're driving, biking or motorcycling, you'll be able to relive the ride with the gear Pro Ryder
profile.reviewText: I like this camera so much, I'm thinking of buying another one! It has a time/date stamp that you can remove if you want, image stabilization, and the ability to flip the screen 180 degrees (which is very helpful if you plan on mounting it upside-down, which is one of my plans..also, [as I learned the hard way] if you mount it upside-down, don't forget to rotate the camera lens 180 degrees, too!) The only thing I don't like about it, is that the sound is somewhat muffled. If it's in the waterproof case, don't expect ANY sound, which is a good thing, since if it's in its waterproof case, you don't WANT anything getting in! I haven't used the remote, so I can't speak for it, but as far as being tough, like 'Yeki M' said, "It is made very sturdy, and has bounced off the sidewalk a couple times and still works! It is a solid little chunk!" Granted mine has only bounced off the pavement, thank heavens no cars have run it over; I don't know how it would handle THAT! (and I don't want to find out) I also noticed it has a tri-pod mount on the waterproof case, as well as the camera, itself! I know you won't regret buying this, so have at it! (UPDATE 5-7-2015) I've since put this on my road bike as a rear-mounted camera, (after trying the ANART SJ4000, and though I liked it,[a lot] I decided to try this one out as well) and liked the result, and now find myself stuck with a difficult choice between 2 equally good cameras for recording vehicles and such behind me. I used these two products sold here on amazon, and they hold both cameras well "K-EDGE GO BIG Pro Saddle Rail Mount for GoPro Hero (K13-430 Black)" and paired it with this "ARKON GoPro HERO3+ HERO3 HERO2 HERO Mount Connection to 1/4-Inch 20 Camera Adapter" (UPDATE 6-18-2015) Just a piece of advice, the waterproof case isn't nearly as strong as the camera itself, (as one of the buttons came off in my seat bag, where I was keeping it in case the need arose) so be careful with it.
profile.summary: This camera is great!

The screen guard is manufactured from the highest quality ballistic Oleophobic tempered glass material ensuring ultra-resolution for your device to enhance your luminous display and maximum protection. You can enjoy all your phone functions with ultimate protection. Our Shield stands up against heavy duty impact allowing you to be a little more daring with your device! Real touch Sensitivity gives a more natural feel that truly provides impeccable touch screen precision for media viewing, scrolling, texting, dialing and gaming. Product Features Level 9H hardness, 0.33mm thickness & 2.5D Anti-Chip curved edge: protects your mobile smartphone device from damage caused by scratches, scuffs, dirt, or finger prints. Preserves your phone resale value and condition. Keeps your screen crystal clear and BUBBLE FREE providing the perfect touch and viewing experience. Compatibility Samsung Galaxy S5 4G LTE HD SM-G900F, SM-G900H (Unlocked), SM-G900A (AT&T), SM-G900TR (MetroPCS), SM-G900P (Sprint), SM-G900T (T-Mobile), SM-G900R (U.S. Cellular), SM-G900V (Verizon). Package Contents (1 Pack)Tempered Glass Screen Protector, Instruction manual, microfiber cloth, dust removal tape, and smoothing squeegee card. Installation Easy online installation with our YOUTUBE video channel or provided manual
profile.reviewText:
This screen protector is alright, but I didn't see any reason to be 'wowed' by it, (even though I don't think that was the manufactures' purpose, STILL, I would hope they would at LEAST want you to be pleasantly 'moved' by their attention to detail)

 Since the last (glass) screen protector I had was broken by a 3' (0.91 meters) fall, even though I had a case 'protector' on my phone, I decided to get this screen protector, as I also got another case at the same time! Even though * I got this screen protector at no cost, in exchange for a fair and honest review*, I wanted to let my experience be known, in order to give others an idea of what I (and maybe they) had/will have happen if/when they get this.

 It fits great, (and why not? It was designed specifically for this phone!) but does not live up to SOME of the claims made by the manufacturer. For example, when it says "Protects your mobile smartphone device from vulnerability caused by scratches, scuffs, dirt, or finger prints." they're right, except for when they say 'finger prints'. As can be seen in the pictures I've added (if you can't see them, wait about a day, they'll show up) the finger print claim is slightly exaggerated. I just cleaned the display earlier today, and with moderate use of the phone, it looks as though I have NEVER cleaned it!

 Still, the fact that there are 3 screen protectors in this package (along with a 'squeegee') is great, because after a few more screen cleanings, I may just change it, to see if I just got a 'bad' one. I hope I'm wrong though.

 Still, aside from my personal experience with this screen protector, it looks like a decent, and useful screen protector that's worth it to at least try, and, since the price is so low, if you don't like it (You have 3 tries) you haven't lost anything.
profile.summary: A low cost screen protector that's worth it!

profile.reviewText: Especially after trying "True Goddess" incense, I gave this a try not expecting too much. In the description, they say it burns for about 30 minutes, and actually, it burns for more like an hour! Another thing is, it burns evenly and is very consistent in it's size, and it also doesn't kick out any soot; (unlike some other brands) It's very easy to light as well, and it stays lit!(also unlike some other brands!) The ONLY possible drawback I can see, it that it seems to have a slightly 'soapy' smell, but maybe that's part of the scent. For the price, it's one of the best deals for incense out there! Seeing as how everyone likes different things, I will only suggest you give it a try. You may like it as much as I do!
profile.summary: MUCH Better Than I Gave It Credit For!

profile.description: Schampa Black Devil Smile Ball Patch Old School Bandana Single Layer Fleece Neck Gaiter.
profile.reviewText: It seems "Schampa" has a habit of not letting me down. I have the "Schampa Fleece Skullcap (Black, One Size)", the "Schampa BNE005 Fleece Pilot Beanie with Velcro Closure (Black, One Size)", the "Schampa WarmSkin X-Mesh Breather Balaclava (Black, One Size)", this product, and the "Schampa Fleece Drop Flap Beanie (Black, One Size)", and minus 2 of the three items being too small for my head, (the "Warmskin X-Mesh Breather Balaclava", and the "Drop Flap Beanie"- I have a 7 3/4" [196.85 mm] hat size - I CAN wear the 'Drop Flap Beanie', but it's a bit tight) "Schampa" products have ALWAYS been wind-resistant, warm, and VERY comfortable. I tried this, as I hated having wind go down the front of my shirt, and was VERY HAPPY with the results! It seems this is the one brand I can rely on! Do they make gloves? Hard to believe I don't know about it if they do!
profile.summary: Reliable cold weather clothing

profile.description: Majestic Glove economical high visibility yellow jacket, with fixed quilted liner. Polyurethane coated polyester with fully taped seams and concealed attached hood. Elastic ribbed waist, wrist and collar keep out the cold. Outside slash pockets and a cell phone pocket. Meets ANSI/ISEA 107- 2010 Class 3 standard.
profile.reviewText: I'm QUITE surprised at how warm (and wind-resistant) this really is! I heard it was also water-resistant, but I haven't put this claim into practice yet, and hope not to! It can keep one warm down to about 35 - 40 degrees Fahrenheit (1.6 - 4.4 Celsius) any colder, and you can wear a small jacket underneath it, to "layer up" so to speak. That's one reason I would suggest ordering a couple sizes up from what you usually order. I usually wear an XL, so I ordered a 3XL, and it fits fine. I use this for being seen when riding my bicycle, and it works wonderfully during the day, (many times, if the sun comes out, I worry I'll blind drivers, it's so reflective!) and also works like a charm at night! One of the things I REALLY like about this jacket, is the fact that people can see me coming, or see me riding my bike from about a football field away! Like I always say, I'd much rather be seen, than be a  hood ornament! If you like others knowing you're there, this coat is for you! I can see why many public workers use these!
profile.summary: Good thing I read the reviews first for the sizing, but this is a GREAT coat!

profile.description: Give your iPhone 5C the protection it needs with this hybrid design case made of hard PC plastic and soft silicone. The two materials helps prevent against scratches, dirt and drops. The case allows full access to all ports, buttons and camera lense without the need to remove. For Apple iPhone 5C only.
profile.reviewText:
When I ordered this case, I didn't know precisely how I was going to put it on...I thought the silicone part (the red coloring) was going to be relatively hard silicone. Happily, it wasn't. It's VERY soft. Softer (but MUCH stronger than) the rubber bands you find on your local newspaper in the morning. It also fits with the  "Apple iPhone 5 / 5s /5c Premium Pouch Carrying Case with Belt Clip Belt Loops Holster Fits with Otterbox Commuter / Defender Case on Lifeproof Case on"  (By The Way, the previous sentence was a copy/paste job.) Works just GREAT to protect from shocks (Which I've learned the hard way) of drops from getting up with the phone in your lap, and slipping out of my hand when I was trying to retrieve it from my carrying case. Luckily, I haven't had to find out if it's waterproof, yet. It doesn't have any plugs for the charger or headphone ports, so I don't think it would be waterproof. Water RESISTANT maybe, as long as you didn't get any water in the bottom of the case. All in all, this case is a GREAT deal! Cheap, and does an AWSOME job! If you have any questions, feel free to ask me in the comments section!

(UPDATE 9-4-2014)
I ordered another one of these for a friend, since it is such a good and protective case. As stated in my review, it is NOT waterproof; however, it IS water resistant. Also, it is also very good at being protective from shocks, bumps, and general abuse (whether intentional, or not). I've had my original case for about 1-2 years now, and am very pleased with it! Just a bit of info, as I've been asked this question before, I have an iPhone 5C, and I believe that's what the case is made for.
profile.summary: This is one SWEET cellphone case!

profile.description: Winter Russian Style Earflap Hats Polyester Trapper and Hunting Type Hat --- Choose from brown, red, black or grey. Head size adjustable on back of hat, ear strap clasp adjustable by neck. Fasten the ear straps together under your chin for optimal warmth and secure fit. Extra padding sewn into hat to keep head warm. Ear flaps lined with soft material keeps ears warm. Hand wash only and allow to air dry.
profile.reviewText: At first I was thinking "Why would I want a hat that looks like a combination of a baseball hat and a Russian winter hat?" (I have no idea what this kind of Russian hat is called, by the way) I then found out I wanted, (needed) a warm hat with the brim of a baseball hat, to shield me from the sun! I come from Ohio, where the sun is conspicuously absent from September through March, or sometimes April! I then moved to North Carolina, where they don't HAVE that dilemma! Anyway, moving onto the actual REVIEW! This hat is incredibly warm and slightly wind-resistant, (albeit I'm not sure about water-resistance, as I haven't had the chance to test that out! [hope NOT to, though!]) but doesn't have any adjustability to it, albeit it fits on me, and I have a 7 3/4" (196.85 mm) hat size, and albeit it's a tad bit tight, (which means it will certainly fit smaller sizes) it seems rather comfortable.  With me, it wouldn't (didn't) cover my neck, but that's probably because my neck's longer than average. (I'm 6'2") The hat feels like it's rather good quality, and you can either have the flaps up or down, (which pulls the neck cover down, as well) and you can also 'click' it together under your chin (down) or over your head (up) . However, just to let you know, I wish they would have made the clicking mechanism stronger, as it is VERY easy to take it apart, EVEN if it's snapped together! Aside from that little stain on an otherwise clean canvas, this is a WONDERFUL (not to mention useful) hat! One more thing, while I received this product at a discount in exchange for a fair and unbiased review, had I bought this hat at full price, I would have said the very same thing I just did! I REALLY appreciate this hat, and how useful it is! I was just lucky to find it at a discount!
profile.summary: I never thought I would like a hat like this, glad I was proven wrong!

profile.description: This NutraWork plastic slim curved water bottle BPA FREE is made of the finest tritan material, which makes it stainless and odorless. It is configured to be a portable drinking water bottle that will fit in most cup holders and has a convenient flip top drinking spout with straw. It's wide mouth top makes cleaning and adding ice a breeze and with the loop cap design you can connect to your workout bag, backpack, golf bag virtually anything that has a clip. This great hydration water bottles for camping sports and people on the go. Measurements on this water bottle are 9 3/4 inches tall and 2 7/8 inches wide.
profile.reviewText: This is a very nice water bottle, (albeit I haven't used actual water in it, yet,...well wait, I use little bottles with FLAVORING for water in them, so I guess you could say I've used water in it, just flavored water) and is a PERFECT fit for my water bottle carrier on my bike! I REALLY like how if you face the area on the handle you could use to attach to a carabiner (then also add your keys [just an idea]) away from you, since they have a tab on the 'mouthspout' (for lack of a better term) you can just pull it toward you, and since it has a straw inside, attached to the 'mouthspout' (there's that word again!) you don't have to lift your head to take a drink, which is PERFECT for me when I'm riding my bike! I never realized how useful a water bottle with an internal straw could be while riding my bike! I should've gotten one sooner! I can just take the bottle out of the holder, take a drink, and replace it, never taking my eyes off the road, and if you ride a bike, you know how dangerous it can be to take your eyes off the road for even an instant! The bottle also seems to be made of a thick, yet malleable plastic, that feels like it'll bounce (NOT break) if dropped on the ground (depending how much fluid you have in it) yet, it's hard enough not to 'give' much (if at ALL) when squeezing it. It also comes with 'use instructions' in decent, readable English, but some of the 'instructions' repeat themselves, (not verbatim, though) so you may feel the 'Deja Vu' feeling while reading them. All in all, I didn't think this water bottle would be anything special, but am glad I was wrong, and have found a new kind of water bottle to carry on my bike! *I received this product at a discount for a fair and unbiased review*, and I hope I helped you with my description.
profile.summary: I was unaware this water bottle could be so useful in so many ways!

profile.description: Go to the head of class with this learning laptop from DimpleChild! Learn the alphabet, how to spell, comprehension and more! With this adorable monkey laptop, learning has never been this much fun! Easy to carry along with you wherever you go. For ages 3 +.
profile.reviewText:
The positives are that my niece was VERY interested in the laptop. She even began referring to it as her "computer", and was VERY excited to use it. Unfortunately, the negatives outweigh the one positive. The laptop is VERY poorly made. Within only a couple hours of use, the rubber 'keyboard', (which wasn't very well attached to begin with,) was pulled off, and is unable to be correctly reinserted. The top and bottom of the laptop disconnected at the hinge, and are proving EXTREMELY difficult to reattach, (keep in mind my niece wasn't being hard on the laptop, either) Also, the content should be marketed for a 2-year old, not 3+. There is NO interactive component, and the curriculum is incredibly limited. I don't see how a child could learn from this laptop! I received this product at a discount for an honest review, and would recommend AGAINST getting it, PLEASE!

(Update 2-25-2016)
It STILL refuses to reattach, and now won't work, at ALL! I'm going to do what I SHOULD'VE done when it arrived, throw it out!
profile.summary: Please stay away from this laptop!

profile.description: The ADANAC 3000 Digital Stopwatch is water and dust resistant, comes with a 46 nylon lanyard (neck strap) and is jam packed with features. It is laser tuned for 1/100th second accuracy. This stopwatch times 1/100th second for 30 minutes, then 1 second increments up to 24 hours. It can time single and split events, with split-mode timing to freeze the split-time display while total timing continues. It also features time and calendar with alarm. There are separate start-stop and reset buttons, it is durable, compact and easy to use. This is the perfect stopwatch for any Phys-Ed teacher or coach.
profile.reviewText: This is a great watch to have! Not only can I have it be a stopwatch (DUH!) as it states in the description, (and IS) it can display the time in either 12 or 24 hr format, and shows the day and date. Although everything I've previously stated can be confirmed through a cursory glance at the details mentioned on the main page, I have also found out that it is VERY easy to set time & date, day of the week, has a decently large display, and can go under my work 'smock', which is the reason I bought it, since where I work, from the waist up, the only things that can be 'exposed' to the outside, are your hands and eyes. Since the production floor is nearly devoid of all timepieces, I wanted to have something to wear that would let me know the time, but would also stay under my smock, as the wristwatch I had kept 'peeking' out from under my sleeve, and the supervisor told me to leave it in my locker from now on. I wear this stopwatch around my neck, and under my smock but over my shirt, since that way, all I have to do to see the time, is slightly pull apart my smock between two of the four snaps that keep it closed, and take a quick peek! I also found out one other thing, and answered my own question. Yes, you CAN turn off the hourly chime. It shows you exactly how in the instructions. BTW, I know the saying "If all else fails, read the directions" but just do it first this time; the instructions are only a leaflet, and are very easy to read and understand. (they're not from China) So do yourself a favor, save some aggravation, and take the (about 2 minutes) time you'll need, to read the instructions!
profile.summary: VERY useful stopwatch, worth every penny!
