top_5.summary: How Can They Sell These Things, Then Sleep At Night?

input: Generate the review text written by a reviewer who has a given an overall rating of "5.0" for a product with description "Basics cotton briefs are must have for every lingerie drawer. The Vanity Fair Lollipop Briefs feature comfortable legs opening that stay in place and generous coverage. These briefs are perfect for all day wear.". The summary of the review text is "Perfect Replacement for Discontinued Sears Fuller/Fundamental Panties! Wash for True Fit!".
output:
Ever since Sears discontinued their Fuller / Fundamentals line, I've been searching in vain for similar panties. I liked the cotton briefs w/elastic leg for sleeping. I tried other brands, but no elastic legs and they were cut different so they rode up your bum or left part of it showing, not comfortable! I stumbled across these during a Google search for "elastic leg cotton panties " and was surprised by how closely they resembled the Sears panties (side by side comparison, I swear they're the same). I wear a size larger than my everday undies for sleeping, for comfort and "breathing," so I ordered an 8, same as I did in Sears.  Wow, I reviewed huge granny panties! I lay the Sears on top of these and thought, these are going to be saggy, baggy, undies. Then I read a review they shrink, so I washed them, dried them and low and behold, they are now a perfect size 8! They run a bit higher in the waist than the old Sears panties (great when your bloated), and the legs are cut a little different, but not much. They fit much like a full coverage bathing suit bottom and cover every inch of you bum, but don't sag, nor are they too snug. I do find a little extra "leg" around my hip / top of leg area, but that doesn't bother me, pull them down, or up, the elastic will hold them. They do not roll, move, scrunch, bind, or anything else you can think of, I'm loving my new "replacement" undies!

Ladies, buy your regular size, but don't be too alarmed at the size and return, wash and dry and they'll fit true to size! Heh, that rhymes!

profile.description: Have you got what it takes to raise and train at pet horse? This simulation demonstrates your skills and flaws / ESRB E Everyone
profile.reviewText:
I'm an adult PC gamer of horse games and I've played many different ones. My favorite still being  Equestrian Challenge, simply for the graphics and the fact it is challenging! However, this quickly took second place. I personally really enjoyed the graphics, they reminded me a lot of the movie Spirit: Stallion of Cimarron. My review is for the first part of the game Petz Horse Club where Lily, who is competing for the World Cup, is staying on her friend Liam's ranch and is helping rescue the wild horses and figure out why the mares can no longer have children.

Note: The graphics, while "cartoonish", still show the stallions having complete... male parts in the form of a bump. Which I found a bit humorous! There is talk about horse abuse, cheating at horse shows, (both on the part of the bad guys), and the death of a wild mare due to the birth of a foal.

Cons:
Controls - using both mouse and keyboard are a bit annoying, but you get used to it after awhile.
Foals Growing Up - in order for your foal to grow up, you have to groom and wash them at least 6 to 8 times (I found this out at the end of the game or I could have bred a lot more horses). If you do not talk to the right person, you won't find this out until near the end of the game like me.
Unlocking Adonis - you have to beat both single and two-player modes on the bonus games, which can easily be done by one person on both if you are dexterous!
Characters - In the very beginning Liam starts to ask Lily something and he never finishes... why?! I would have liked to have been able to play all three main characters on various missions. That would have given more content/meat to the game.
Paddock - Didn't hold enough horses, you had to keep letting go of stallions you "tamed" in order to put a new one in. If you then wanted to ride one of the stallions you tamed, you had to ride another horse to one of 5 areas and find him.
Jumping - your horse will automatically jump, except in warm-up and show competitions. In steeplechase and cross country it will automatically jump.
Competitions - There are four (I think) total, more would have been fun.
Taming - This became really monotonous after awhile.

Pros:
Graphics - Stunning, in my opinion! I played this on Windows 7 with a high end graphics card and only found a few issues, like when the horses would turn their head you would see "bald spots."
Storyline - I enjoyed the storyline very much, but I wish there had more - I hate it when games end!
Missions - The missions (so to speak) were very good, but I would have liked to have seen more of them also and a bit harder.
Grooming - it wasn't annoying hard, tedious, or long. This is what often breaks a horse game, while it seems to be "needed", it can be ridiculously done to the point of you just want to quit and never go back and play. Not only was it easy, you could choose what kind of brush, hose, etc. and depending on which one you choose it seems that your horse will get cleaner faster or slower, although I didn't time it.
Breeding - You can breed horses! Unlike another game where you had to wait days and days for the horse to get pregnant, and then days and days for it to be born, this happens immediately and they are so adorable. You can them customize what the adult will look like.
Customization - Tons of customization, except for the characters, who never once change their clothes.

Just because my cons outweigh the pros, doesn't mean I don't highly recommend you find this game and buy it. I am really nit-picky when it comes to any/all PC games as I'm an avid PC gamers of many genres. Like I said, this quickly slipped into my 2nd favorite horse game and I will keep it on my computer to go back just to ride the various horses through the areas for the graphics and breed them for fun.

I'm just starting the second one, which actually came up as "Pippa Funnell's: Ranch Rescue" and appears to be a prequel to the previous game (In the menu it is listed as Lily's Previous Adventure's). The graphics have changed a bit, but they are just as beautiful. I didn't realize these games were part of a series, but having read other reviews, will now check out the other games too.
profile.summary: Great Horse Game, Highly Recommended! Adult Review.

profile.description: The Jockey® Seamfree® Sporties Hipster women's underwear is designed without side seams and features sweat-wicking fabric to help keep you cool, dry and comfy. Thin, silicone leg bindings help keep the panties in place, while a hip-hugging fit provides natural comfort under athletic wear.
profile.reviewText:
After Bali changed their undies, I went looking for new ones. I wanted seamless, smooth, comfortable panties that stayed up at all times and didn't roll! profile.reviewText: These are very comfortable, but if you are large up top, the one size fits all aspect doesn't really apply. Let's say if you a DD or larger, the one size fits all doesn't apply to you, this will not be comfortable without a bra. I like to sleep in/lounge around the house in really large shirts and leggings, but when my sisters family visits (all boys) I don't want them to be "uncomfortable" so I bought these very large shirts and throw on a sports bra and all is well. The shirt goes down to my knees and everything is covered up nicely, and I'm still comfortable in my own house! Everyone is happy! profile.description: Harry Potter Order of the Phoenix Series 1 - 7" Action Figures, Set of 4. Set Includes: Harry Potter, Hermione Granger, Ron Weasley, Sirius Black
profile.reviewText:
Beware! These figures are nothing like the picture!  I'm a huge Harry Potter fan and though what fun it would be to have the trio and a very handsome black to display! I receive the items and it was a big let down.

They look nothing like the pictures and there a little inconstancies such as part of Ron's hair wasn't painted, Sirius' beard was a different color on one side than the other, etc. etc.  The facial expressions were poor and Harry's glasses were so thick I though he had coke bottles on. Unless you collect these just to own them, I suggest you spend your money on something else.  I have no seen the larger versions, perhaps they are better done, but the 7" are not.

profile.description: Say Aloha to Trouble in Paradise!Product InformationWorking as a research assistant in Hawaii sounds like fun in the sun butthere's big trouble brewing on the Big Island.  Someone or somethingdestroyed the environmental experiments in the forest around the HilihiliResearch compound.  Is it the mythical Kane Okala or unfriendlyrivals?  It's up to you as Nancy Drew with the help of the Hardy Boys touncover hidden secrets among the strange whispers that haunt the mountains andforests.Product Features  Play as Nancy Drew of Frank and Joe Hardy - Work as a team to solve    this adventure.  Program Your GPS System - Navigate from beaches and forests to    volcanoes.  Design Shell Necklaces - Trade your handcrafted work for Big Island    Bucks.  Find Underwater Treasures - Snorkel for shells and get hooked on    fishing.  Erase Mistakes - Use the "second Chance" option to try    again.  Choose Your Challenge - Play at Junior or Senior level based on    your abilities.Windows Requirements  Windows XP Vista  1 GHz Pentium or equivalent class processor  128 MB of RAM  1 GB or more Hard Drive space  32 MB DirectX compatible Video Card  16-bit DirectX compatible Sound Card  24X CD-ROM drive
profile.reviewText:
I just finished playing #15 in the Nancy Drew series.  I was unsure at first whether to buy it, but since I got it for Christmas, it didn't matter!

I had read reviews on here that made it seem like less fun than the others, but don't listen to them, I loved this installment!

I enjoyed getting to play both Nancy and Frank/Joe Hardy! The puzzles weren't too hard, but not too easy either.  I did get stuck twice and had to ask for small hints (senior level).  The storyline was fun, although perhaps not as in depth as some of the other games and the activities to earn "Big Island Bucks" were fun and not as tedious as some of the previous games.  The graphics, superb as always, and the jungle/beach was very relaxing!

The cons (very minor ones):

1. Storyline was a little weak, as compared to past games, but still fun!

2. It wasn't long enough! Granted, a PC game can't last forever but...

3. While I never have a problem w/voices, I did have to ask myself why Big Island Mike and his daughter, who are from Hawai'i, did not have Hawaiian accents?

4. The tasks are either easier than the other games or I'm just getting so used to playing these games that I figure them out quicker!

Like I said, minor details for a fun, enjoying Nancy Drew game overall!
profile.summary: Another Great Nancy Drew Game!

profile.description: Kate Walker, a young ambitious lawyer, encounters incredible characters and locations in her attempt to track down Hans, the genius inventor - the final key to unlock a pact with destiny. Far and beyond, a mystical Syberia awaits theier arriveal with obstacles far more dangerous than every before, testing their courage and determination.
profile.reviewText:
While I already own Syberia I and II in their 2 disc PC versions, they are my all time favorite pc adventure games and I could not resist buying the Collectors Edition and have both games on 1 DVD disc and for such a low price!

I gave the product 5 stars for the game but if I could rate the packaging (like we used to be able to do), I would give it a 1.  The outer box is nothing more than a cardboard sleeve with a pretty picture.  I carefully peeled off all stickers and while there are no tears, etc. it does take off the clear finish (not a really big deal).  However, where I expected to find at least a jewel case holding my prized game, there was a piece of folded cardboard that says all over it, "Earth Friendly, Making A Difference".  I'm all about saving the Earth but come on folks!  Inside that was the game complete in a paper sleeve.  I inserted the game into a jewel case and when I slipped the cardboard cover over it (hey it's got a cool picture on the front) it fell right out.  The cover is larger than any jewel case I own.  I gave up and decided to just store all my PC games that I keep from here on out in a CD travel case that I originally bought for my car and stash the box back on the shelf, oh well, it looks pretty!

If you are a fan or lover of these games, then I suggest you buy it just for the convenience of the 1 disc DVD game with extras.
profile.summary: Classic Games - Poor Packaging

profile.description: What would you call a printer that combines high intelligence with high-quality, low-cost ink? We call it the KODAK HERO 7.1 All-in-One Printer. It uses affordable ink, so you can print KODAK Quality Photos at home without worrying about the cost. Plus its full of built-in smart features. GOOGLE Cloud Print lets you access it from any computer, smartphone, or tablet  so you can print from anywhere. Double-sided printing lets you save paper and time. Smart Sensor technology tells you just how much time and supplies youll need. And a sleek, responsive touch panel makes the enhanced feature package easy to control. Add it all up and you get a printer with an impressively high IQ that makes printing as easy as 1-2-3.
profile.reviewText: This is by far, the best printer we've ever owned! After our older Kodak just simply refused to do anything, we bought this for several reasons. It had great reviews and it can do multiple things. It can print pictures, although I've not tried it, in a separate tray, it can copy, scan, and even re-size things - which was a must for the artist in the household. It has WiFi capabilities which is great for a house w/multiple computers. I've yet to figure out how to print from my phone and finally gave up, but not a big deal. The ink is cheap and the print quality is fantastic. The paper comes out near the top and stays there firmly and there is no paper tray hanging out to be stepped on by my cats and break off (yes, this happened with the old one, twice!). It's built really nicely and I don't feel like anything would break easily. Highly recommend if you want a printer that does nearly everything (no fax) for a great price.
profile.summary: Best Printer We've Ever Owned!

profile.description: Fresh Kittys Super Jump Litter Box Liners seamlessly blend durable strength with effective kitty clean-up. Each liners heavy-duty grip strips cling to litter pans, preventing pets from dislodging them with vigorous pawing. Ultra-thick material guards against rips, leaks, and spills; scratch guard technology prevents troublesome tearing. When its time to take them out, simply pull the top, tie the handles, and toss! Super Jumbo Litter Box Liners are the biggest yet, fitting litter pans up to 25-inches long!
profile.reviewText:
I have the Catit Jumbo Litter box and after trying the Jonny Cat liners and having to strain to get them to fit, trapped air, and other issues, I gave up. I saw these were larger and bought them. Wow! What a relief! They fit! I tape them all around so they are a tight fit, put in the kitty litter so it's a good two inches deep and no trapped air! I do have to use two bags (double bag), because cat claws will shred these suckers in less than 24 hours (as they will with anything 2 ml). Someone needs to make a jumbo that's about as tough as a spaceship and then maybe cat claws wouldn't shred them. While I hate losing all that litter down the huge hole, I now have a general idea of where the hole always is and plan to put duct tape over that area next time and see if that helps. Note to self, buy duct tape. My cats really like the larger box, as do I, it cuts down on smell (I have no idea why, but it does!) and accidents (pooping out the door), but finding a liner was a hassle! At least the hole generally does not go through to the second bag or only minuscule holes, and thus just "litter dust" has to be shaken out of the pan after I take the bags out, dump them in the trash, and replace them. Great for living in an apartment, cold winters, and my back! Worth the extra money than having to wash it out every 3 weeks. Maybe if I owned my own house, with a hose, etc., but I don't. Can't say it's "quick", because you have to tape the bags down, but at least they fit! Highly recommend for odd shaped, high backed, jumbo boxes, but double bag, because they will be shredded!

UPDATE: Shredded through two bags (double lined) in less than two weeks. So much for easy clean up. I give up on liners. Two stars because it actually fit the box.
profile.summary: Fit High Back, Jumbo Boxes (w/some MacGyverTechniques), but Double Bag! Those Claws Can Shred!

profile.description: In Lucinda Green's Equestrian Challenge you'll create the perfect horse to be your partner in play practice and competition. You'll form strong bonds with your horse as you feed groom and train to perfect your show skills. The more you train with your horse the better it will perform as you win your way to prestigious international competitions of Show Jumping Dressage and Cross Country.Features:Multiple difficulty levels for players of all agesFour officially licensed Grand-Slam Equestrian events - Adelaide Kentucky Badminton and BurghleyCustomize your rider and horse with thousands of combinations to create your own unique duoHundreds of unlockable items including clothes ribbons and prizesEarn beautiful ribbons and trophiesFormat: WIN 98ME2000XP Genre: ENTERTAINMENT Rating: E UPC: 855743001131 Manufacturer No: 113
profile.reviewText:
I purchased this several years ago and I just installed it to play again. Yes, it works on Windows 7. My only disappointment, they didn't release a sequel!

This game is wonderful. I am an adult player and this game really keeps my attention.

Pros:
1. Graphics are beautiful!
2. You can create your horse, although limited, still fun.
3. You can create yourself, also limited, but still fun.
4. Taking care of your horse does not take long if you do it after every training or tournament.
5. You train in 2 star, 3 star, and 4 star jumps, dressage, and cross country. Each one has slightly different scenery.
6. You compete in 4 locations, each in 2 star, 3 star, and 4 star with three events in each competition, dressage, cross country, and jumping.
7. The four locales are very different and different scenery.
8. The game gets increasingly more challenging and it's not easy to start off with!
9. 2 star locations have relatively short challenges, then 3 star gets longer, and 4 star takes about 3 - 4 minutes for dressage, up to 10 minutes for cross country, and 3 - 4 minutes for jumping. That's in REAL TIME.
10. You level up your horse on your own terms as you earn points, so it's up to you where to place you points on stamina, trust, speed, jumping, and agility. These are key to getting good times and winning. Eventually, by the time you finish 4 star events, you can max your horse out to 100. That doesn't mean you'll still get a perfect score or make every jump though. If you come into a jump to fast or at a weird angle, the horse still may refuse you.
11. You can play back video of your rides.

Cons:
1. There isn't even more to this game!
2. The dressage can get really boring after the first few times and w/the sounds it makes and the constant beat, I usually get quite sleepy doing dressage which is done simply by pressing the correct arrow key at the correct time, however, you can watch the horse do actual movements which are extremely realistic.

If you're wondering how the horse is controlled, you use the W and S key to go fast/slow and the A and D key to move side to side. Spacebar jumps and the Shift key makes the horse gallop. Arrow keys are used only for dressage.

If you can find this game for a decent price (don't spend $100 like some people want), buy it! You will NOT regret it, but it may spoil you for other horse games, I know it did me!

I may try and edit my review later and add a video.
profile.summary: The Perfect Horse Riding/Training Game!

profile.reviewText:
Note: My cat is a Siamese/Ragdoll Mix, so he's not a small cat, wide girth and it fits perfectly!

I love it, cat's not too fond of it... yet. My late cat loved to go outside on a harness and leash. I used a dog harness on her, but they never quite fit right. When I saw an actual cat harness, I was thrilled! I'm taking my cat on a plane and I wanted him in a harness for better security. I wanted to get this good and early so I can get him used to it. I had hoped that like my late girl, he would take to it like a duck to water, but no such luck. He's about 10 pounds and is a stocky built cat and this fits great once I let the strap all the way out (quite a girth on my Siamese Cross - DLH). If he's not relaxed, it does go over the shoulder blades, but I've put my fingers under there and they are not pulling/cutting his body and he doesn't act uncomfortable, I just get a look of... "you have shamed me..." So, starts the harness + treats + small leash to try and accommodate him well in advance! Knock on wood, he has stopped rolling around trying to get it off - how he thinks that is going to work I'm not sure, but... I've never tried to understand a cat's logic!

Update: This is coming a bit late, but my cat wore this like a trooper through airport security w/leash and it did NOT set off the metal detector. He was fine in it for the entire trip (cross country), albeit happy to get out of it, of course, and not too happy about putting it back on for the trip home. I'm now relocating cross country and he will have to wear this again (poor guy) and I'm buying another one for my second kitty who is also moving with me, but I haven't told him yet he has to wear a harness. Uh oh.
profile.summary: I love it, but I have "shamed" my cat...

profile.description: Susick Seashell Sifter- The Seashell Collecting Tool. Easily find shells and sea treasures for your beach and seashell crafts. Scoop up your treasures in a hurry before the next wave hits. Perfect for crafters needing quality shells. Unlike other heavy shelling tools, the Susick Sea Shell Sifter weighs less than a pound so you can enjoy using for an entire day at the beach. Can also be used for scooping and sifting in the sand. The unique design lets water and sand drain out of the sifter's durable ABS plastic basket. The basket is 6" wide x 6" deep with 1/4 square openings. The 30" handle is made of stainless steel. After using, rinse with fresh water, turn upside down to let water drain out.
profile.reviewText: I have used this version - which would be considered the "cheaper" version - and the $60 metal version. This version is highly superior. I found tons of shells in Florida with this sifter! It was sturdy, easy to carry, lightweight, and did the job. Those adorable tiny seashells didn't fall through the holes either. That $60 super sifter, heavy, awkward, cut me, bruised me, didn't find one shell, and the small shells fell right through the holes. Not to mention that fancy expensive one didn't even sift the sand right. You don't always get what you pay for, but this one does the job! I purchased two, one for me and one for my niece, although she doesn't go out very far, so my mom and I used them more for several days and many, many hours and they held up. Unlike other reviews, they did not bend, break, or even budge. I found a lot of great shells and tons of live sand dollars, which I had to throw back of course, but they were fun to see! I was amazed at how deep this sifter could dig down in and I chalk it up to the smaller size, compared to the gargantuan size of the metal one I bought, which you could only drag across the surface, unless you had the strength of Hercules. If you are trying to decide on which way to go, save your money, buy this one, heck buy two! See my review on the metal "shark sifter." I highly, highly recommend this sifter over any other!
profile.summary: Recommend this Sifter Over Any Other! Expert Beachcomber!

profile.description: Set in the 1950s, this half-hour situation comedy revolved around the friendship between bright-eyed, naive and demure Shirley Feeney and brassy, tough-talking, street smart Laverne De Fazio. Two bottle cappers for Shotz Brewery, the duo dated an array of questionable men, tolerated their dippy, loony neighbors Lenny and Squiggy, and forever pursued to "make all their dreams come true."
profile.reviewText: Stilly funny decades later! Laverne & Shirley is one of the best T.V. shows ever produced. Laverne & Shirley and the gang move to California in Season 6 and while I thought it wouldn't be as good as previous seasons, I was wrong! In fact, it was better than Season 5, which I found to be quite a downer as it dealt with death and some other really depressing subjects (suicide, etc.). Season 6 was full of surprises, although the character Rhonda I always found to be a bit much and Sonny could have been used a bit more, in my opinion. I enjoyed each and every episode and laughed out loud and hard many times. My favorite has to be "I Do, I Do, I Do," because I'm a huge fan of Peter Noone (Herman's Hermits). I love that they did their own stunts, or at least Penny did, I'm not sure if Cindy did all her own stunts. The gag reel left a lot to be desired, but all in all a great season and a show that never gets old. I will miss seeing Happy Days characters pop in on them though. Can't wait to start Season 7.
profile.summary: Classic Comedy, Still Funny Today!

profile.reviewText:
This is my 2nd cat DVD, the last one (a different company) I have 4 starts to and 6 out of 8 gave it only one paw up... this "mewvie" gets four paws up! It's really more like 6 1/2 cats, as one is pretending not to like it, but I do catch him watching it, although not yet fully addicted like the other six. As I type this, one of them is staring at a blank TV screen right now, hoping I'll turn it on. As soon as they hear the TV come on, they come running. They paw it, bat it, bite it, look behind it, beside it, on top of it and everywhere else to see where that pesky squirrel could have gone, that bird flew to, or the chinchilla jumped to. They look at me with incredibly sad little faces when I turn it off, even if none of them are actually watching it! Watching them watch it is hysterical and makes me wonder about my sanity and the lack of having an actual life. If you read my review on the other DVD I bought for cats, you'll know why I start this TV for cat obsession in the first place, but I don't feel like repeating the entire long story here, suffice to say, the cat we intended it for, shows very little interest, but he is the one that I have caught watching it on the sly. Maybe I'll get him yet. Long story short, it's to try and keep him entertained more inside, so he'll stop attempting to get outside.

Pros: Cats LOVE it. I have 6 little TV junkies now! The video loops over and over from bird to animal and back again. You can select where you want to start the video, on a bird, on an animal, your choice. NO FISH! The other video had fish and they yawned at the prospect of the fish and it had way too much of the fish. Thank you for NO FISH!

Cons: The background noise is birds, always birds, there may be crickets on the screen or mice, but you still hear birds. Maybe this is to attract the cats to the TV, I have no idea, but I can mute it and they still like it. The bird sounds seem to be repetitive and get annoying after awhile and I love birds. However, the same ole same ole over and over and over... yeah, not so much.

I've tried three cat videos so far, Happy Cat TV, this one and Mewvie Episode 2. I thought they would prefer Episode 2, because in my Happy Cat TV they loved the birds. Mewvie Episode 2 is all birds. The birds however are not very "active", they don't fly around enough as in the Happy Cat TV. I cannot return it as it's opened, so I may try and see if they will get interested in it yet, but so far the second one just hasn't been as interesting to them. If you can't decide which one to buy from this collection, I recommend Mewvie Episode 1 (this one) over Mewvie Episode 2.
profile.summary: 6 out of 8 Cats  Give This DVD 4 Paws Up!

profile.description: Fill in squares using simple hints to reveal the hidden picture. You'll need both puzzle-solving skills and creativity to earn your picture reward.
profile.reviewText: PICROSS is an incredibly addicting DS game. I have spent many a nights playing puzzle after puzzle. While I find "easy" mode too easy, "normal" mode went from moderate to hard for me. The mode after that I suspect will be quite difficult since there are no hints and it doesn't tell you if you've made a mistake. The game is laid out nicely so you build from easy to hard. If you finish the puzzle before 60 minutes are up - if you make a mistake in penalizes you - then the picture comes to life/animates. They are quite fun. If you finished each level you unlock up to 10 levels. Once you finish level 10, you unlock and extra/bonus level. I'm going to be disappointed when I finish this game, but I will put it back and in a year or so perhaps I can play it again. Sadly, the company put out a 3D version of PICROSS for the sequel, and my brain doesn't think in 3D so I won't be buying it. I had hoped they would put out a game just like this one. I have not found any other games like this for picture/logic puzzles, and it's a shame, I really wish there were more DS games in this genre. If you like picture/logic puzzles, this game is a must have for your DS!
profile.summary: PICROSS, Near Perfect Picture/Logic Puzzler!

profile.description: Rodgers and Hammerstein's musical about a love triangle in the midst of the Oklahoma land rush is adapted to the screen featuring the enduring songs "People Will Say We're in Love," "Oh, What a Beautiful Mornin," "Oklahoma!" and more. Shirley Jones' debut, this panoramic film was actually shot in Arizona! Academy Award Nominations: 4. Academy Awards: Best Sound Recording and Best Scoring of a Musical Picture.
profile.reviewText:
I noticed all the bad reviews for this DVD and I have to say, I don't know why it has such horrible reviews? No, the DVD's aren't perfect, although the CinemaScope is beautiful, the color pops, the sound is great, and the overall quality is superb.

The main gripe seems to be about the Todd AO version. I didn't know anything about this until I read about it on here and seeing as I didn't have Oklahoma! on DVD yet, I decided to buy the set, horrible reviews aside.

I played the Todd AO version in my Blu-Ray player and I have to say, it looked pretty good to me. Not perfect and yes, I think they could have transferred it better, but it is viewable and pleasurable at the same time.

This is what I found wrong, in my opinion, with the Todd AO, but it didn't deter me from watching it.

1. There is some pulsating of the lighting in the background which your eyes adjust to after awhile and you don't even notice it anymore.

2. When they are focusing on an actor/face, the background does appear somewhat blurry, but it's a soft blur, which from an artistic standpoint is sort of pretty.

3. The blacks are very, very black. For example, in Judd's cabin, which it is blacks/browns, Curly's head really blends in w/the scenery and the whole scene is very dark w/no depth.

4. Many have said that because the Todd AO was filmed in the morning, the actors were more lively, etc. I didn't see this at all. Shirley Jones and Gordon MacRea especially seemed to be nearly identical in both copies of the film. He might have been a little more animated when singing the opening, but not much. Charlotte Greenwood might have danced a tiny bit more lively in "The Farmer and the Cowman", but only a tad. The only actress I noticed a large difference in acting with was Gloria Grahame "Ado Annie", she was much more animated in the singing parts and acting in the Todd AO version, especially noticeable during "I Can't Say No" and "All 'Er Nothin'". Also, the peddler playing opposite her in the "goodbye" seen is more lively, he pushes her sleeve up twice and she continues to push it up v the CinemaScope version where he pushes her sleeve up once, it slides down, and they leave it. Small minor detail I happened to notice. Shirley Jones sobs very little in the Todd AO scene after Judd scares her, but quite a lot in the CinemaScope version.

I haven't viewed them side by side for every frame, but I plan to, just for fun. I do recommend this set, if you want to own both versions. Play the Todd AO version on a Blu-Ray player and it really isn't that bad. It honestly reminded me of movies that weren't remastered on old VHS tapes and we watched them without complaint. Too me, it's simply nice to have in my collection. Would I buy the Todd AO version again if they release it in better quality, sure, but this is perfectly fine for now. Just enjoy the movie for what it is.
profile.summary: Not As Bad As Everyone Says!

profile.description: Finally, a rake designed to help you find ocean treasures like sharks teeth, seashells, sea glass, etc. Featuring a 12" wide basket constructed of 1/4" wire mesh, 48" powder coated split handle for easier shipping and portability, an adjustable foam grip and a large sifting area. Insert one end into the other, attach pin and you are ready to go. Simply scoop, shake out excess material and flip onto the sifting screen! profile.reviewText: I purchased this directly from the site and somehow managed to get it in my suitcase. I took it to OBX and was excited to use it. Needless to say, having used other cheaper sifters and gotten great results, I thought I was in for a real treat. In the Atlantic Ocean in North Carolina I got nothing, literally. I just got sand and some tiny seashells, if I was lucky. Mostly, I got knock on my bum by the waves and then knocked in the head and face by this very large sifter, which hurts. I also cut my toe, and foot on it several times as the edges are super sharp, scraped my knee and nearly killed myself trying to carry it from my vehicle up sand dunes to the beach. Perhaps it only works in certain types of waters, but it didn't work for me at all. I'm sorry I spent the money. I should have stuck with the cheaper versions. However, the handle was nicely made, although it should have come with a small hammer to put it together in your hotel room, because it took me forever to pound the screw into place as the screw vs hole cut for it were not quite the same size. As I did not have a hammer, I had to make do with whatever I could find lying around my hotel room. It wasn't easy. The metal basket also bent very easy and after just a few tries with it, it was no longer the original shape. If you buy this, take it to a beach where you don't have to carry it far, make sure you are in calm waters, and watch your feet!

profile.description: The final season of the half-hour situation comedy focused on brassy, tough-talking, street smart Laverne De Fazio who, along with her family and friends, continued to pursue making all her dreams come true.
profile.reviewText: What can I say, what is Laverne and Shirley w/o Shirley? Not as good, but Penny Marshall did a heck of a job carrying the show almost entirely on her own w/o help from the rest of the cast. We rarely see Carmine or Lenny. The only character we do see a lot of is Squiggy and the ever annoying Rhonda. This a must have to complete your collection and while some episodes were just downright boring or stupid, this season managed to showcase the incredible acting talents of Penny Marshall. Many had me laughing harder than episodes that showcased Laverne & Shirley together! It's a shame she didn't go farther in acting, because she was a brilliant comedian. However, having seen her movies that she directed, I can say she is clearly a multi-talented woman and I would love to meet her someday. The major con was there was no real ending to this series. I believe they had to have some inkling it wasn't going to be renewed and could have found a better way to tidy up the ending. It felt nothing like a a last episode of neither a season, nor a series finale. I was certain there must be me one more episode on the disc, but to my dismay, nothing.
profile.summary: A Must To Complete Your Collection! A Great Showcase of Penny Marshall's Talents!

profile.reviewText: I was really disappointed by this game, to say the least. I installed it and it said you need to play with your blinds closed (during the day) or your lights off (at night). I found this curious until the scenes loaded and I couldn't see a thing. Lights on or off! I'm even using a brand new monitor. I tried to fumble around in the darkness but there was no real direction like in previous Nancy Drew games. The puzzles were illogical and the plot rather loose and pretty easy to guess the outcome. There were very few places to visit and no fun mini-games like in other Nancy Drew games. I don't know why Her Interactive chose to change the entire way they did this game, but it was a bad decision. The tarantula didn't help either! I played it for a bit and even with a walkthrough got frustrated. I finally gave up and uninstalled it. I will continue to play Nancy Drew games, but this one wasn't worth the money.
profile.summary: Not Your Normal Nancy Drew Game

profile.description: "Signed, Sealed, Delivered" is a wonderful combination of romance, comedy and drama that follows the lives of four postal detectives who transform themselves into a team of detectives to track down intended recipients of undeliverable mail. Their missions take them out of the office and into an unpredictable world where redirected letters and packages can save lives, solve crimes, reunite old loves and change futures by arriving late but somehow always on time. The team includes charming Oliver O Toole (Eric Mabius), a genius postal detective and the group s leader; new team member, Shane McInerney (Kristin Booth), a technophile who brings 21st century sensibility to the group; free-spirited, girl next door Rita Haywith (Crystal Lowe) who has a photographic memory; and lovable Norman Dorman (Geoff Gustafson), a master in conventional research methods.
profile.reviewText: I watched this series when it aired and waited impatiently for it to be released on DVD. I pre-ordered it, but was out of town on business when it arrived. Due to life's circumstances, I didn't actually get around to watching it until a few weeks ago. Long after Amazon's 30 day return window. I was very unhappy to find out that there was no sound at the end of Disc 2, Episodes 3 and 5 and none during the credits at all. I had shared these with my mom and I knew what the endings were, but she was going, "what did she say!" The subtitles didn't work either. I called Amazon and explained the problem. They agreed that first several batches sent out had been defective (read other reviews) at no fault to the customer, but at the fault of the whomever produced these DVDs. They immediately shipped me out a new DVD set and sent me a prepaid return label. I'm happy to announce the new DVDs have been fixed! I'm extremely happy with the quality (would love to see these in Blu-Ray) and sound. Also, the original movie that started this all - which fans had hoped would be included and was not - is now available for pre-order and releases in September. The Christmas movie is already available to buy and we can hope they soon release the most recent movie (From Paris With Love) that aired last month on Hallmark Movies & Mysteries. Sadly, Hallmark has decided not to continue this as a series, but in movie installments. Hopefully, they will eventually change their mind and bring it back as a full series, as I think this is better than any of their other series, although I'm also a fan of When Calls the Heart.
profile.summary: Christian Series, Great Morals! Defective Discs Fixed!

profile.description: The Big Larry knows how to light up a room! It is perfect for everyday tasks and if built to handle the most demanding tasks as well. Equipped with new COB LED technology, the Big Larry outputs 400 lumens of intense light on High Mode. While low mode outputs 160 lumens and the emergency red flash strobe / hazard. This intense red light is perfect for distress signaling or roadside emergencies. . The body is made from anodized aircraft-grade aluminum and is water and impact resistant. This is a very durable light. However, please do not toss this light into the sky for fun, just so you can see how many times it will bounce off of the ground and still work. The Big Larry work light is an amazing addition to your EDC kit, toolbox, shop, tackle box, and even your go to kitchen drawer. It is handy for any occupation. Just imagine how you would use it in your everyday life. If you cannot do that, then imagine that you are a mechanic. The magnetic base allows you to stick the flashlight under the hood and light up your work area. Features like the powerful magnetic base, allow for convenient and versatile hands-free lighting. The ergonomic and portable design of the NEBO Big Larry makes it the best choice if you are looking for a super bright and durable COB LED flash light.
profile.reviewText: I live in an area where power outages are common in the winter. Long power outages. I'm sensitive to candles and they only burn so long, plus, I really don't want to burn the place down if I fall asleep and my cat knocks a candle over. I discovered Little Larry and Big Larry at my local hardware. I have a Little Larry for going to and from my car (lifesaver), and one for the bedroom, bathroom, and living room. I keep Big Larry in a cupboard to use when the power goes out as it illuminates at least two rooms of my apartment nicely! I sent one of these to each of the guys in my family for Christmas and they raved over them (after trying to blind everyone with them - men). They were a complete hit! They couldn't believe I (me, a female) could find such an amazing flashlight that was so bright they could probably stay up all night fixing a car, or boat, or whatever it is they need it for and see everything like it was daylight! Yes, it's that amazing! And, it's magnetic! It has a high, low, and a warning signal. Don't hesitate, buy one! These are great for a power outage or for every "handyman" in your family! They're also super heavy, so females, if you have to walk any distance at night, they make a great weapon (this was actually relayed to me as a true story, dark parking lot after work...)! I also recommend "Little Larry" for smaller tasks and/or rooms. Love Nebo!
profile.summary: Love My Larry Flashlights! Great for Power Outages, Walking in the Dark, or Your Favorite Handyman! Females, Use to Protect!

profile.description: S.A. RICHARDS-Prop-It Magnetic Needlework Chart Holder. Place the chart on the stand with the board behind it and the magnets (in different sizes) are designed to be positioned on the chart to highlight the stitching sequences and moved as the work progresses. Elastic page holder keeps the books opened and pages secured. Holder holds individual charts patterns magazines leaflets and books. Folds open instantly and closes flat to 8x11in for convenient storage and portability. This package contains one collapsible stand made of durable black plastic with adjustable supports for over-sized books and charts a freestanding magnetic board and magnetic strips. Made in USA.
profile.reviewText: I hesitated to purchase this do to some bad reviews. When I first go it, I did not unfold it entirely and it fell over. Then I realized, the bottom has to lay perfectly flat (there should be no bend in it - see picture) and continued to push on the holder. That did the job. While the back-end does stay in the air a bit, it don't pose a problem and has never wobbled or fell over once. I think the negative reviews are coming from people who didn't read the directions and/or look at the pictures close enough to realize it folds down farther than you realize and simply dubbed it poorly made. It holds my charts perfectly and the magnetic part is a great bonus.
profile.summary: Perfect for Cross Stitch!

profile.description: Board game
profile.reviewText: Parker Brothers sold the Trivial Pursuit rights over to Hasbro and they can't make a board game to save their life!  The board is annoying.  It's very hard to make out the colors, see the squares right, etc.  The questions are next to impossible, even my parents who are over 50 could not answer most of the questions!  My husband who thinks he knows everything, even admitted that this game was just too hard.  We found the questions to be written poorly and often misunderstood by the phrasing.  We decided to try out Trivial Pursuit IV and loved it!  Hasbro just can't cut it!  I'm sorry to say but I beleive this is the end of Trivial Pursuit as we knew it.
profile.summary: Hasbro Doesn't Cut It!

profile.description: The Kelsyus Floating Lounger is the ultimate pool float for water lovers! Kick back and relax on this fabric-covered floating lounge chair with an integrated backrest, footrest and cup holder. The comfortable cooling mesh seat suspends your lower body just below the water's surface, keeping you cool on hot summer days. Additional mesh covers the supportive backrest and ottoman, providing a luxurious floating experience. Use the convenient side clips to create your own flotilla with other Kelsyus float products, or for tethering the float to your boat or dock when you want to float in place. A patented inner spring around the outside edge of this floating chair provides greater stability and comfort while floating. When you are ready to go, the float folds flat into three compact circles, making this a great float to bring along on vacations or to economize on boat storage spaces. Jet valves allow you to quickly inflate and deflate the lounge without the hassle of an air pump. Approximate dimensions (when fully inflated): 58 in x 36 in x 16 in. Supports adults up to 250 pounds. Sold individually.
profile.reviewText: This is my third Kelsyus product. I have the raft (which isn't the best as the sides to tend to roll up on you, which is annoying, but you can hold them down with your arms if needed), the regular lounger (see other review, love it!) and now this! This is my favorite. Instead of having to use the annoying raft to tan, I now use this lounger. I can get a better full front tan and it's comfortable and relaxing all at the same time. I can sit in this chair forever and just float. You still get a perfectly even tan, even if you're not trying for a tan it's great! I use it both for tanning and just relaxing. I'm 5' 5" and sit slightly slouched, so I can rest my head on the back and my feet are in the perfect spot. You can bend your knees if you want or just let your legs dangle in the water! The water comes up to keep you cool and like the other products, very durable, high quality stuff. I can fall asleep in this thing! Highly recommended! My only complaint, wish it came in different colors, that way everyone could have their own color!
profile.summary: Can't Go Wrong w/Kelsyus!

profile.reviewText:
Over the years I have tried just about every pool chair out there. The ones you put foam through netting, weak and rips, the cheap blow up ones you buy at Wal-Mart, well, they get holes w/in a week, patches, that's a joke! I even tried SwimWays, because they were a bit cheaper and seemed to have good reviews. Then we needed a 2nd chair, but SwimWays was sold out, so I bought this for myself. The person who kept the SwimWays chair is out of a chair this year. She used it about a dozen times last year, we stored it properly, and got it out, blew it up, and when she got out if, it was half flat! The seams had simply ripped all over the place! Now, the Kelsyus chair is nearly identical, you think, but the craftsmanship is clearly better because I used this exact chair pictured here nearly every day last summer and when I got it out of storage this year and blew it up, perfect shape. No leaks, no holes, no tearing, no ripping, no holes in any seams, still looks brand new!

Pros:
1. Quality material and craftsmanship!
2. Allows just enough pool water though (depends on your weight really) to keep you cool, but not totally immersed.
3. Comfortable to the max! I can fall asleep in this thing!
4. Want to cross your legs? Go ahead! It won't tip over! Honest!
5. It blows up fast and holds air very well. I rarely have to add air to it and when I do, it's a few pumps to firm it up.
6. Has never blown away in a storm and I don't have a holder! I put it upside down on the edge of the pool with the "head rest" hanging over near the water and it's fine. I suspect if a storm ever gets that strong, it will just blow it into the pool.

Cons:
That drink holder is a joke, but I've never found a chair/raft/float or otherwise where they actually work. They are lopsided from the air and pressure, the weight of your body, and they fill right up with water. Eh. NO biggie, I keep my water bottle on the deck anyway. I'm not that lazy I can't get up and get a drink. - Yeah, that's the ONLY con!

Did I mention that I also have the raft and I love it too. I also have a SwimWays raft and guess what, it's dead in the water (pun intended) this season too! Love Kelsyus. Just bought one with a footrest so I can give the poor soul who's SwimWay chair died mine. She doesn't like the footrest idea, but I do! Great excuse for another pool chair! Buy with confidence!
profile.summary: THE Best Floating Pool Chair!

profile.description: The Catit Jumbo Hooded Cat Pan provides privacy while retaining the litter inside the pan. The large hood lifts up for easy access for cleaning, while the built-in bag anchor helps keep the bag open and frees hands for scooping. The carbon-impregnated filter effectively traps and removes litter box odors. The door opening measures 10.4 inches by 9.6 inches. The Catit Jumbo Hooded Cat Pan is ideal for multi-cat households. Replacement carbon filters sold separately.
profile.reviewText:
My large version of this box cracked w/in a month. Since it was still more or less functioning, I put off buying a new one until the only thing left was the jumbo. I'm actually glad! While I use more litter, my cats are happier! I have two males, about 13 lbs each, so not small boys. The large box they would sometimes poop outside through the swinging door, but not with this jumbo box! The largest of the two cats, who is built like a line backer, but it's probably an optical illusion as he is all fur, fits in there with ease and I no longer see little faces or bums smushed up against the door. They just disappear. It has also cut down on tracking litter and smell. Would purchase again!

I have tried liners, several kinds, but no longer recommend liners for this box. Even double bagged they shred both in 24 hours and you use three times more litter, because the bags create air pockets. Then once the holes start, all your litter gets trapped underneath and is completely wasted. I wasted a lot of money on liners and litter trying this out.
profile.summary: Excellent Box for Larger Cats!

profile.description: Three all time favorite Quest titles, now for the Nintendo DS system. Includes Jewel Quest Expeditions, MahJon Quest and Jewel Quest Solitaire.
profile.reviewText:
I purchased this because I love the game Tripeaks, as well as Jewel Quest and the Mahjong was a nice bonus.

I have not put this game down since I purchased it, it has rapidly become my favorite DS game. I can play it for hours. The Tripeaks boards start easy but get progressively harder. I had to skip two of the boards, I never could solve them. Once you complete the first book (which is actually the 2nd part of the story, shame I have no idea what the first was - but no fear, they are releasing 1, 2 & 3 in 1 game!) you go to a 2nd book of puzzles to complete. There are just under 100 card games to complete w/jewel boards. After that, you can replay them with a twist, you are awarded a silver trophy which gives you the same game, but with new features, it appears there is also room for a gold trophy (I hope), but I just started the silver trophy.

I highly recommend this game, you will get your moneys worth!
profile.summary: Three Games for the Price of One!

profile.description: The Comfort Plush Elevated Airbed is a part of the Dura-Beam series of airbeds that are providing amazing durability for years of lasting comfort. The secret is in the Fiber-Tech beam construction, which is comprised of thousands of high-strength polyester fibers that provide enhanced comfort, stability and support. Each bed is covered in plush flocking that is soft to the touch, and the horizontal air chambers provide added stability and support around the entire bed. The mattress is also equipped with a quality-tested, 20.8-gauge waterproof flocked top and 16-gauge sides and bottom for durability. And best of all, the Comfort Plush mattress is remarkably easy to inflate thanks to the built-in, high-powered electric pump, which does its job in a mere 3-1/2 minutes. No more fussing with tiring hand or foot pumps or rummaging through the garage for your detached electric pump. And should the mattress feel a little too soft or firm, you can customize the comfort level with the touch of a button. The Comfort Plush is raised 22 inches from the floor, making it far taller than most inflatable mattresses. And at 60 by 22 by 80 inches (W x H x L), the mattress is an official queen size, making it a good fit for fitted sheets. The Comfort Plush Queen bed--which offers a capacity of 600 pounds--is a terrific choice whether you're sleeping at the in-law's overcrowded house or setting up a guest bed in the basement. The mattress comes with an AC power cord and a duffel bag (for storage). Regarding Inflation: Measurements will vary based on the manner in which it is inflated and packaging disclaims approximate size.
profile.reviewText: This was purchased based on the reviews. It was originally purchased by my parents to sleep on at my apartment when they visited from across the country, but I gave them my bed. I put up the mattress and pumped it all the way up. Rock hard. Let a little air out, regionally better. After a few hours, there was a lot less air. By morning, while it hadn't gone down anymore, my back was killing me. Your body simply does not conform to this mattress. It might not be too bad with a really good mattress pad. I have no place to purchase one of those right now and this was purchased months ago before they had to change the date of their trip. The second night I slept on it pumped it all the way up and by morning it had lost air. I love the height, because I didn't want to be right on the cold floors of my apartment. My parents also tried the mattress and agreed, not a good mattress, but a mattress pad might save it for future use. I guess I'll try the couch for the rest of their visit, which isn't much better!
profile.summary: Loses Air, Needs a Mattress Pad.

profile.description: The Intellitouch PT40 Rechargeable Tuner Combines vibration-based tuning with a Lithium Ion rechargeable battery! It is automatic, chromatic, and displays the measured pitch on a large, backlit display for easy tuning. The PT40 tuner ignores background noise - it feels the instrument's vibration instead of using sound. Works on electric and acoustic guitars, basses, violins, banjos, mandolins and more. A USB charging cable (included) enables fast charging.
profile.reviewText: Many years ago I owned the $50 Intellitouch Pro and it worked great. However, when I moved, certain things didn't come with me for some reason. I had bought this for my nephew a few years back when he started playing guitar and it worked well for him, thus I bought one for myself. Doesn't work. The battery is charged, but I get a red screen and nothing happens. I can feel the chord vibrating through the tuner, but it just stays a blank, red screen and picks up nothing. Yes, there is little battery icon and A=440. It even flashed green when I turned it on. I tried the reset button to no avail. After two minutes it turns itself off. Highly disappointed as it's the same guitar I used before with the old Intellitouch Pro. In a pinch I downloaded a free app onto my Droid and it tuned it perfectly. This goes back. Intellitouch used to be top of the line.
profile.summary: Didn't Work, Turns On, Doesn't Pick Up Strings

profile.description: Rachel's new double door pet carrier is ideal for taking pets along for a trip. The carrier includes a see-through top door that opens outward to help get your pet inside with ease. It also includes a side door that opens booth right and left, and can be removed to have the carrier be used as a pet house.
profile.reviewText: This carrier is great! I got it for a long trip and am currently trying to associate the carrier with good things and not bad things (aka no vets!) and taking my cat for car rides in it and back home and he's starting to settle down and get used to it. He's a larger cat, Siamese Cross/Ragdoll and he fits in it comfortably. I love the front entrance, the door is very secure! My old carrier the door fell off when I first got him and he got loose and thankfully I caught him, but wow did that  scare me! This door, I make sure is secure before picking up, but the top and bottom plastic really does keep it from falling forward! I didn't think the door swinging both ways would matter, but I had it up against a couch and that came in handy. I didn't have to turn it around to open the door, one way it would bounce shut, the other way it would simply lie flat against the couch, genius! The top entry is purr-fection! No more hassle fighting with a cat who doesn't want to get in a carrier (although he's getting used it it now), just plop them feet first down in and hold them in while putting the lid down and secure it! I "think" they appreciate the fact they can see out, but it's tinted, so sunlight, etc. isn't blaring in their eyes. The ventilation is nice for trips, plenty of it and a small, rectangular cat bed fits in the bottom nicely for comfort. My cat can stand up and turn around, stretch out some and seems comfortable. He's complaining less and less. I keep it on the floor with the front door completely off when not "in use" as a little house, although he's not having any part of it, the rest of the cats think it's great! Very well made, very secure side clips, unlike a lot of plastic carriers where you fight with those plastic clips, this is a top of the line plastic carrier and well worth the money! Handle is comfortable to grip too, but because of the width it's a little awkward, but find a carrier that isn't. There are clips in the front and back if you can find a strap (not included) to put through there as a shoulder strap. Area in the top for seat belt that secures it very nicely. If you're going to be carrying it for long periods, you might want to consider padding the handle a bit, as it has grooves. Highly recommend!
profile.summary: The Purr-fect Cat Carrier!

profile.description: Who will become the Master Dragonologist? This high-adventure board game is based on the NY Times best-selling title, Dragonology. Players travel around the globe by air, land and sea collecting Dragons and knowledge. Learn about the nine different species of dragons on your quest by using ancient spells and dragon charms to help in your pursuit. The object of the game is to master any three of the nine dragons and be the first to advance to the dragon's eye. This game is beautifully crafted and the pieces and board are intricately detailed. With the same authentic look and feel as the book, Dragonology: The Game includes a game board that is also an ancient map, nine exquisitely detailed 3D sculpted dragons, six well-acclaimed Dragonologist figures, knowledge cards, transportation tickets and a 12-sided die. Dragon figures are of the European, American Amphithere, Cockatrice, Frost Dragon, Gargouille, Asian Lung, Knucker, Wyvern and the Marsupial Dragon. This game takes approximately 60 minutes to play. This is a wonderful game for 2 to 6 players.
profile.reviewText:
I bought this game as a Christmas gift for my mother who collects anything dragons, and also loves to play board games.

My nephew was visiting over the holiday season and also loves dragons so we decided to try it out.  It was an instant hit!

The game rules are easy to understand, the cards are beautifully drawn, the game itself is fun, fun, fun for all ages (9 - 65 were playing!).

The game itself took about 1 1/2 hours w/4 people first time around and a good hour the 2nd time we played it.

The game takes "some" strategy and some "luck" (ie picking the right cards, rolling the right number).

This game is fun, the pieces are well done, the cards and board are great, and very informative information about dragons that I'm sure you didn't know (wink).

My only complaints, they could have made the dice a wee bit bigger and the people do tend to have a falling over problem, and the one dragon could use a base.  Other than these small annoyances, they do not take away from the game play, I'm just picky!

If your looking for fun, family game, buy this, it's well worth the money!
profile.summary: Great Game For All Ages!

profile.description: Rolling pet carrier, backpack, bed and car seat all in one. For pets up to 15-pound. Internal dimension 9x13x15, External dimension 11x14x20
profile.reviewText: I bought this use with my ESA (Siamese/Rag-Doll mix cat who is is built like a football player) to take on an airplane, but it had to fit in the overhead bin, which on Delta is 45 inches. I bought the medium and he's about 15 lbs (give or take) and I coaxed him in it... okay, I shoved him in it and zipped it up and while he didn't fight it, he was smashed! His bum was all the way against the back/bottom and his head was turned sideways against the front/top when laid down. This is not acceptable! He couldn't lay down comfortably, let alone hardly turn around around it. I measured it and w/o the wheels, it ran about 2 inches smaller than what it lists here. Since the plate is removable, I decided to return it for a large, which should fit him just fine as the dimensions are similar to his hard carrier (no wheels) and will fold down for the overhead bin. Like another reviewer, mine came with some splotchy stuff all over the plate (see their pictures, exactly the same), but I can't say that it was mold, because it was completely dry and just didn't look like mold to me. Also, I'm highly allergic and nothing happened. I even smeared it with my fingers and it came off brown. It wiped off quickly with an old toothbrush. I have no idea what it was, but it was weird. It was not anywhere else on the carrier or inside, just on that plate. Buyers beware: the size listed includes the wheels, the outside pockets, and handle! It is NOT the size of the interior! The medium is really somewhere between a small and a medium, being neither a small or a medium. I think the large will be closer to what I would call a medium. Otherwise, it's very pretty, sturdy, love the lining (although I wish you could lift it to tuck puppy pads around it), the handle extends really far and my cat who is very docile, but doesn't like carriers (what cat does), didn't try and rip it to shreds once I got him it, but he also couldn't really move so.. I think he sort of liked the motion and the view. The mesh seems very durable, unlike other soft carriers I've tried. Like other reviewers, the Velcro on the bottom that holds the plate in place will NOT cover up all it, but it will still hold it firmly in place. You just need a little muscle. I like the little rod that goes through the center of the bag, which also has to be removed to fold it flat. The plate and rod all store inside the carrier nicely for later use. Will review the large one once I've used it in three large airports with my ESA (cat)!
profile.summary: Medium is NOT Sized Correctly! Too Small for My Cat!

profile.description: Joey McIntyre is a modern throwback to the classic song-and-dance men of show business, a veteran who has starred on Broadway (in "Wicked") and off (Jonathan Larson's "tick, tick, Boom!"), TV (Dancing with the Stars, Boston Public), film (Tony and Tina's Wedding, The Fantasticks), records (selling 35 million as the youngest New Kid on the Block and a hit solo single, "Stay the Same") and the concert stage. Inspired to do the album by seeing Frank Sinatra perform at L.A.'s Greek Theater just a few years before the legendary crooner's death, McIntyre covers these songs "his way." "This is the music I grew up listening to," he says. "These songs are still so fresh. We tried to respect where they came from, but also give it a modern pop sensibility that reflects the times. It's not a throwback. This record is essentially who I am." McIntyre performed several of the songs from the album during the 38-city Dancing with the Stars--The Tour. "I always wanted to study dance and the show was like going to school. I really learned ballroom dancing. I knew I'd be able to perform before millions of people. I just didn't know it would be 20 million." On Talk to Me, he leads with a firm right hand straight to your heart, launching the next round of his career as a 21st century song and dance man.
profile.reviewText: I have been a fan of NKOTB since the beginning and therefore, of Joey. When at their recent reunion concert I picked up this CD because I love Big Band! The music is directly influenced by Joe's love for Frank Sinatra and in my humble opinion, he sounds better than Frankie any day (sorry Frankie fans). I hope to see another album like this from Joe and if I ever get to meet him face to face again, I'll tell him so! Joe's voice was made for this type of music and had he been born in a different era he would have no doubt been a headliner! profile.description: The Lixit Pill Popper has a soft and safe applicator tip to administer pills with or without liquid. The tip fits various pill sizes and makes it easy to administer medication to your pet.
profile.reviewText:
A little background history... we rescued an adult cat who was being fostered. There was no medical history, all we knew as it had "allergies" and that it wasn't gaining any weight (skin and bones!). It was a pure bred Tonkinese female and I quickly suspected it was ill. I got it to my vet quickly to discover it not only had an upper respiratory infection, but hyperthyroidism and it was older than first suspected. Why the foster "parent" never had any blood work done on a senior cat with no medical history is beyond me, but at least I save a life. Anyway, after a bout of pancreatitis from the stress of moving her, and on top of that, into a home with 8 other cats, we were able to start giving her the thyroid pills. At first, she gobbled up the cream cheese "treats" and everyone was happy, then 2 days later, cream cheese gone, little pink pill is on the floor... next step, pry open mouth, pop down throat, hold mouth shut until she swallows. Wise cat, she won't swallow, spits pill out. Next step, pry open mouth. pop down throat, hold mouth shut, get plastic syringe with water and put water down her throat several times. Unfortunately, in the time it took too get the water, she had time to hide the pill and spit it out after a few bouts of water! Clearly, she's taken pills before! That's when I went hunting for these so called pill guns. This one looked the best, because it had the water and on occasion, the water trick did work, just not always. So, did it work?

Yes, it works! Let's start with what not to do.

1. Do not put it the side of the cats mouth. While this works for liquid medications, it doesn't work for this. This seems to leak a lot of the water out, thus not giving the full amount and leaving room for wise cats to still be able to spit the pill out. Lesson learned.

2. Do not do this slowly, thinking it's "nicer" for the cat, this allows for them to be able to separate pill from water and spit the pill out. Again, lesson learned.

Now, let's talk about the correct way to to do it.

1. Fill the entire barrel with water (as far as it will let you, which is not all the way).

2. Wedge the pill in the tip, it's perfect for thyroid pills!

3. Place about half of the white part (see picture) into the FRONT of the cats mouth (see above, not the side!) and QUICKLY (see above, not slowly) push down and administer the water/pill as quickly as possible. This may seem like you are going to gag your cat on water, but trust me, you don't. They swallow very quickly and they don't have time to react to the surge of water and the pill mixed in with it, thus they can't sort pill from water and they have to swallow it.

Note: They will be peeved. Probably for hours. They may bite, hiss, scratch, and hold a grudge for who knows how long. They may put a 21 pound cat in their place w/in minutes of having received said pill - yes, this has happened and it was quite comical. They may in fact hiss at every cat (And human) they come in contact with an refuse treats just to spite themselves. However, beware, as every other cat in your house will expect a treat just for putting up with the madness of the now peeved cat. You were warned.

I highly recommend this product if you have a pill spitting cat! However, I will say that I don't know if a large pill would fit in the tip.
profile.summary: If at first you don't succeed... try, try again!

top_5.description: Have you got what it takes to raise and train at pet horse? This simulation demonstrates your skills and flaws / ESRB E Everyone
top_5.reviewText:
I'm an adult PC gamer of horse games and I've played many different ones. My favorite still being  Equestrian Challenge, simply for the graphics and the fact it is challenging! However, this quickly took second place. I personally really enjoyed the graphics, they reminded me a lot of the movie Spirit: Stallion of Cimarron. My review is for the first part of the game Petz Horse Club where Lily, who is competing for the World Cup, is staying on her friend Liam's ranch and is helping rescue the wild horses and figure out why the mares can no longer have children.

Note: The graphics, while "cartoonish", still show the stallions having complete... male parts in the form of a bump. Which I found a bit humorous! There is talk about horse abuse, cheating at horse shows, (both on the part of the bad guys), and the death of a wild mare due to the birth of a foal.

Cons:
Controls - using both mouse and keyboard are a bit annoying, but you get used to it after awhile.
Foals Growing Up - in order for your foal to grow up, you have to groom and wash them at least 6 to 8 times (I found this out at the end of the game or I could have bred a lot more horses). If you do not talk to the right person, you won't find this out until near the end of the game like me.
Unlocking Adonis - you have to beat both single and two-player modes on the bonus games, which can easily be done by one person on both if you are dexterous!
Characters - In the very beginning Liam starts to ask Lily something and he never finishes... why?! I would have liked to have been able to play all three main characters on various missions. That would have given more content/meat to the game.
Paddock - Didn't hold enough horses, you had to keep letting go of stallions you "tamed" in order to put a new one in. If you then wanted to ride one of the stallions you tamed, you had to ride another horse to one of 5 areas and find him.
Jumping - your horse will automatically jump, except in warm-up and show competitions. In steeplechase and cross country it will automatically jump.
Competitions - There are four (I think) total, more would have been fun.
Taming - This became really monotonous after awhile.

Pros:
Graphics - Stunning, in my opinion! I played this on Windows 7 with a high end graphics card and only found a few issues, like when the horses would turn their head you would see "bald spots."
Storyline - I enjoyed the storyline very much, but I wish there had more - I hate it when games end!
Missions - The missions (so to speak) were very good, but I would have liked to have seen more of them also and a bit harder.
Grooming - it wasn't annoying hard, tedious, or long. This is what often breaks a horse game, while it seems to be "needed", it can be ridiculously done to the point of you just want to quit and never go back and play. Not only was it easy, you could choose what kind of brush, hose, etc. and depending on which one you choose it seems that your horse will get cleaner faster or slower, although I didn't time it.
Breeding - You can breed horses! Unlike another game where you had to wait days and days for the horse to get pregnant, and then days and days for it to be born, this happens immediately and they are so adorable. You can them customize what the adult will look like.
Customization - Tons of customization, except for the characters, who never once change their clothes.

Just because my cons outweigh the pros, doesn't mean I don't highly recommend you find this game and buy it. I am really nit-picky when it comes to any/all PC games as I'm an avid PC gamers of many genres. Like I said, this quickly slipped into my 2nd favorite horse game and I will keep it on my computer to go back just to ride the various horses through the areas for the graphics and breed them for fun.

I'm just starting the second one, which actually came up as "Pippa Funnell's: Ranch Rescue" and appears to be a prequel to the previous game (In the menu it is listed as Lily's Previous Adventure's). The graphics have changed a bit, but they are just as beautiful. I didn't realize these games were part of a series, but having read other reviews, will now check out the other games too.
top_5.summary: Great Horse Game, Highly Recommended! Adult Review.
