profile.reviewText:
I have a whole drawer full of knives, but ever since getting these three knives I don't need the others any more.

The handles are very comfortable and the knives themselves are SUPER SHARP they cut through just about anything with very little effort.  They have some weight to them and are easy to control.  I would caution most cooks to use them with caution and take your time while cutting with them because they are so sharp, I could see how someone who got distracted while cutting could cut themselves badly.  However, if you pay attention I think you are less likely to cut yourself because they do cut with such ease.  They don't have serrated edges, but I've not found anything that they can't cut...though I don't use them on bread.

I use these three knives for just about everything from vegetables to meat.  I love love love them!  Highly recommend.  You don't need to spend a fortune to get high quality in these Anolon knives.
profile.summary: They cut most anything like butter!

profile.description: ASUS RP-AC52 AC750 Repeater / Access Point / Media Bridge have powerful external antennas that help to eliminate signal dead zones and improve the coverage of any existing wireless router. It ensure reliable high-speed internet coverage everywhere for devices such as notebooks, tablets smartphones, games consoles and smart TVs.
profile.reviewText:
I got this for my parents when I bought them a Ring Wireless Doorbell as a gift.  They didn't get great wireless reception in all parts of the house with their current router and I was worried that the Video Wireless doorbell wouldn't get a good enough signal in order to work properly since it was outside the house.  I had no idea that something like this was available until I ran across it.

I am not technically challenged, however I wouldn't consider myself technically savvy either so I won't go into any technical specifics.  I'll let people who know a lot more about that stuff than I do address any issues they have.  Personally all I care about is that it installs without frustration, and does the job that I need it to.

I setup the ASUS repeater first.  Since my parents can have troubles operating a remote control I thought I would tackle this installation myself.  I was somewhat apprehensive, but it installed fairly quickly and easily with my router which is only a year or so old and is a CISCO.  I don't know what kind of bandwidth it has, etc.  I placed it near the front entrance door since that is the area that I was most worried about.  Honestly, getting the RING wireless doorbell installed and working properly was much more frustrating and time consuming than getting the ASUS repeater up and running.

I'm so glad that I got this ASUS repeater because the last thing we needed was to have wireless connectivity issues along with everything else associated with installing the video doorbell.  Installing the ASUS was a breeze compared to the rest.  It works exactly as we need it to and now we have the added benefit of getting a good wireless signal throughout the house and into parts of the backyard.  With most people having only a cellphone instead of landlines these days that is a real benefit.
profile.summary: Installed quickly and works like a charm

profile.description: Introducing the best of both worlds.A perfectly cushioned mat to protect joints, with a built-in microfiber top cover that actually provides increased grip as temperatures soar. Ideal for hot yoga, power yoga or any vigorous Vinyasa class, Gaiam's Ultra-Dri hot yoga mat absorbs moisture twice as fast as traditional towels and gives you slip-free stability so you can keep your cool during the sweatiest practice. Machine washable to maintain a hygienic foundation. Machine wash separately in cold water; dry flat. The mat may fade and become brittle and unusable if exposed to the sun for extended periods of time. We recommend storing your mat in a mat bag when not in use. 24 W x 68 L x 07 thick (1.8mm).
profile.reviewText:
I'm an occasional Yoga practitioner.  I have a Gaiam mat that I've had for some time and I love it.  When I saw that they had one that had a microfiber mat on the top I was very excited to give it a go.  Initially right out of the box I noticed that it is not nearly as thick as the other Gaiam mat that I have.  I'm not not why it was necessary to change the thickness, but for me it's a downside.  I do like the microfiber towel on the top for the feel and the absorbency, but I find myself reaching for my old mat when I want extra comfort.  So while the idea of the towel is good, I prefer the tried and true ol' reliable mat.  Just a personal preference more than a commentary on the quality of the mat.

Just an FYI, I know one other reviewer had uneven edges on hers, but I didn't notice it on mine.  The color online is pretty true to what it is out of the box.
profile.summary: Yoga mat + towel = great idea

profile.description: Expand your artistic capabilities with Corel Painter Essentials 5 Digital Art Suite for PC and Mac. Sketch, draw, or paint to create amazing art at any skill level, whether from scratch or existing photos. Brush and other art tools closely mimic real oil paint, chalk, charcoal, watercolor, and other media with Corel's RealBristle technology. Convert photos into paintings with a click, or use the brush of your choice to personalize your creation. Native 64-bit support ensures that you can find all the essential tools you need for your individual workflow. Wacom tablet support and the2-in-1 mobile painting interface give you flexibility to create your work organically on-the-go with fine-tuning via keyboard input.
profile.reviewText:
I'm somewhat new to actually using painting software.  I've used Photoshop for a couple of years now and am pretty much self taught on how to use it (mostly for photo manipulation) and have been looking for a tool that will artificially paint a photo to give it a painted look without actually having to paint the picture, which is what initially drew me to Painter Essentials.

I've played around with it a bit and found that some aspects are quick and easy to learn, but others I could use a tutorial or a book to refer to to get the best results.  And that is where I have my biggest complaint.  Not all of it is an intuitive as I would like and unfortunately there aren't as many online resources to refer to for help as you find with Photoshop.  I looked on Amazon and I couldn't find any tutorial books (like Painter for Dummies) to purchase in regards to this program which was really disappointing.  Overall, I like it and could possibly learn to love it once I know how to really use it.
profile.summary: Painter is better than just "Essentials"

profile.description: This vibrant, wooden, bear stacker has 5 colorful discs and a playful head topper with embedded magnets for easy stacking. Stacker is painted with a non toxic finish, and also features a wobble base for an added element of fun. Since 1979, Manhattan Toy has been making award-winning, high quality, educational toys for your baby, toddler or kid. From baby toys and toddler toys to wooden toys and activity centers, our goal is to provide the safest and best toys available. All of our products, from the newest concepts to our time-tested classics, are innovatively designed to inspire imaginative play and delight our customers.
profile.reviewText:
I've been moving away from plastic toys to wooden ones with my new niece.  I had the plastic version from Fisher Price that was similar to this one and I didn't think it was bad....7 years ago before all of the plastic BPA, toxins in toys reports.  So I was looking for a wooden replacement and found this one by Manhattan Toys.

The stacker is well constructed, and much nicer than what I was expecting.  I was a little bit concerned that the toy contained magnets since they can be very dangerous if swallowed, and with a toy meant for infants that put everything in their mouths....I was concerned.  However, I shouldn't have been.  The magnets are encased in the wood blocks so I don't think there is any way that they could be taken out unless you took a tool to it and dug it out.  Even then I don't think it would be an easy task.

What is nice about having magnets in it is that my 7 yr old niece likes to stack them and learns about magnets, and their polars, and my 9 mos old niece likes to knock them over.  A great team effort.  One likes to put it together, the other likes to take it down, LOL.  All of the pieces fit well in little hands, stack easily.  I really like it.  The only reason I gave it a 4 star instead of a 5 star is that I think the red disk is too small.  I've found my 9 mos old niece kind of gagging on it because she is able to get almost all of it in her mouth.  It's not a choking hazard by any means, but I think it should have been a bit bigger.  My solution was to just put the red disk away, which is a shame because the red was her favorite one.  She loves things that are red :)

Overall, I would buy it again despite the design flaw on the size of the red disk.
profile.summary: A fun well built stacking toy

profile.description: Fun colors and coordinating shapes make this three-piece serve ware set the life of the party. These uniquely designed serving pieces showcase cold and hot dishes, from chips and guacamole in the divided dish to garlic and parmesan popcorn in the serving bowl to stuffed peppers on the large oval platter. This durable serve ware is sure to take center stage at football Sundays or Thanksgiving feasts. Stoneware from Rachael Ray offers contemporary, playful shapes in vibrant and fun colors. The bold colors help bring personality to the kitchen, plus these oven-to-table pieces can be mixed and matched with other Rachael Ray stoneware for a truly personalized table. The modern design features flared handles that allow you to get a good grip from any angle and make transporting the stoneware a cinch. The versatile pieces offer a non-porous interior so foods won't react and they are dishwasher, microwave, freezer and oven safe up to 350F.
profile.reviewText:
I like my dishes to have multiple purposes.  I have limited cabinet and storage space, so what I do have, needs to be able to be used in a variety of different ways.  When I initially saw this set I loved the red color.  It's kind of a tomato red with a nice finish to them that cleans up easily.  They are not exactly light weight wise, but they are easy to carry with the handle placement.  If would not order these for someone with a disability or arthritis for that reason. They come in a fairly large box, and are packaged VERY well, which unfortunately means you will have quite a bit of packaging to throw away and most of it isn't recyclable :(

I mistakenly thought that this set could go from the oven to the table, but it's not a bakeware set, but a serveware set.  This is completely my fault for not really reading the description close enough.  Unfortunately this set isn't really meant to be used in the oven, however it is safe for use up to 350 degrees which will accommodate some recipes.  That being said, with the shape and design of the pieces it's more suited to things like chips, appetizers, or pasta salads...that kind of thing, instead of casseroles and such.  One dish is to shallow to really bake in (unless it's maybe nachos), the other is larger, but it's divided

The only reason that I didn't give it 5 stars is that I wish that it had a higher tolerance for oven temperatures, and I wish that the design of the pieces would allow them to stack and store better.  They are bulky and heavy so they take up a bit of space to store...and since I can't really use them for much beyond serving they do have a more limited use than I was anticipating when I ordered them.  I'm still trying to figure out what I am going to use each piece for.

If you entertain a lot with food that you don't necessarily bake, and have extra cupboard space, then I think you will really like this set.  Otherwise you might think twice.
profile.summary: Nice, but a bit bulky and hard to store

profile.description: If simplicity and elegance are the words you live by, then look no further: youve found the right dresser for your little treasures room! We like its versatile look, which blends easily with whatever might inspire you and we guarantee youll like it as much as we do! Grooved metal handles. Features 6 practical drawers. Metal drawer slides. Dimensions: 59,25" (W) x 17" (D) x 32,75" (H). Drawer dimensions #1: 25.5'' (L) x 14.25'' (D) x 5.25'' (H). Accessories not included. Requires complete assembly by 2 adults (tools not included). 59.25'' (W) x 19.375'' (D) x 31.125'' (H). Box dimensions: 66.772'' (L) x 21.496'' (W) x 5.394'' (H), 124 lb. Ships in a heavy box, make sure to have a friend with you. Packaging tested and certified to reduce the risk of damage during shipment. Made in North America with non-toxic laminated particleboard. 5-year quality guarantee. Any questions? Contact South Shore, the manufacturer, available 7/7 by phone, email or chat.
profile.reviewText:
As far as furniture that you have to assemble this dresser is pretty good.  It goes together fairly easily and had all of the necessary parts.  The instructions are like most these days...diagrams and pictures.

The parts are made of mdf/particle board.  It seems strudy once it's assembled.  One of my concerns about the parts is that some of the latches for the drawers are plastic and I don't know how well they will hold up over time.  They work fine currently.

When it arrived the box was pretty banged up, but none of the parts were damaged except for the top of the dresser.  It had a slight and small imperfection that looked like it was caused by something rubbing against it.  The white finish was rubbed off in a small circle.  It wasn't enough for me to ask for a replacement. And these types of pieces of furniture tend to marr easily anyways.

Overall the quality is good.  It's not as good as some other assembly furniture, but it's better than a lot of others.  The price I think is a little high.  If I had it to do over again i would probably start my search at a well known Scandinavian retailer first, then maybe this as a second option.  It's not there is really anything wrong with the dresser.  It has a great style, but I think the quality of the materials could be better for the price.
profile.summary: Great style, goes together easily (with no missing parts)

profile.description: Philips Sonicare for Kids Rechargeable Electric Toothbrush - HX6311/07 Sonicare For Kids has been engineered to be kid-friendly at each brushing phase. Power levels, brush heads, and bristles are specially designed for small, sensitive mouths. Complete with ergonomic handles, Sonicare For Kids makes brushing comfortable and easy. It even features the KidTimer and KidPacer help kids learn to brush for a full two minutes. Sonicare For Kids is safe and gentle on teeth and gingival tissue, while reaching more plaque in hard-to-brush areas than a children's manual toothbrush.
profile.reviewText:
I have a seven year old that we are trying to teach to brush their teeth the right way, so when I saw that this had a teaching mode that beeped when you needed to move to a different section of your mouth I thought it was brilliant!

I've been using a battery operated toothbrush for years and think that it does clean MUCH better than just a standard toothbrush.

PROS
-The head of the toothbrush is smaller so it fits better than some inside their mouth and is easier to get to the back teeth which are sometimes harder to reach
-The timer, and learning mode definitely helps to teach your child how to brush their teeth and not rush through it.  LOVE THAT!
-The stickers were lots of fun and a big hit in personalizing the toothbrush
-my 7 year old doesn't fight like she used to to have her teeth brushed and is doing it on her own.  I do still supervise just to make sure that she is doing it right, but as with many things she enjoys that she can do it by herself.

CONS
-While the head of the toothbrush is exactly the right size for kids, the handle itself is quite bulky and sometimes had a hard time getting the hang of holding it and moving it around for that reason.
-The stickers can be hard to line up so an adult may need to do this :(
-  I also wish that this would have been battery operated instead of a rechargeable electric toothbrush.  While on the one hand I like that you don't waste batteries, on the other hand the last thing I need is something else to sit on the counter and have to plut into an outlet in the bathroom which is already cluttered enough.  Especially if you have more than one child.
-The price.  After getting this and then talking to my sister, I found out that there are some battery operated tooth brushes that also have built in timers to help kids learn to take their time brushing their teeth.  I don't know if they clean as well as the sonic care, but they are significantly cheaper.  That being said, if we have good dental checkups from here on out because she is brushing well then the price of the Sonic care will definitely be worth it.
profile.summary: Who knew brushing could be so fun!

profile.description: The BLACK+DECKER LSTE523 20V MAX Lithium EASYFEED String Trimmer/Edger is part of the 20V MAX System; 1 System - Endless Tasks. Power for your Style. This tool is designed for trimming areas of overgrowth after mowing, as well as edging along borders, sidewalks, and flower beds. It features the Power Drive Transmission which increases torque for more cutting power at the string, and the 2-speed control lets you choose between more power or extended runtime. It easily converts from trimmer to wheeled edger. This unit features EASYFEED which allows you to advance your line with the push of a button with no bumping required. It has a premium micro texture soft grip that provides comfort and control while using the tool, with adjustable height and handle for ideal user comfort. Cutting swath of 12 inches, Line Size - 0.065 in., RPM - 5,500/7,200, Replacement Spool - AF-100. Maximum initial battery voltage (measured without a workload) is 20 votes. Nominal voltage is 18. Includes: (1) LSTE523 20V MAX Cordless Trimmer/Edger, (1) LB2X3020 20V MAX Extended Runtime Lithium Battery, (1) Charger, (1) AFS Spool, (1) Guard
profile.reviewText:
Yard work is my least favorite thing to do.  I try to like gardening and communing with nature....but it hasn't quite happened for me yet :)  Consequently I try to get it over with quickly and with as little fuss as possible.

This trimmer/edger was very well packaged and arrived safely.  It was easy to put together and after charging the battery overnight it was ready to go.

I have an average size yard, and with one full charge I was able to trim and edge my yard.  It was much quieter than a gas trimmer.  It was lightweight, and without the gas powered motor there weren't any fumes and I no longer have to worry about having a separate gas can with gas and oil mixture or all of the maintenance involved with having a gas motor. (ever find yourself out of the gas mixture that you need, have to stop what you are doing to make another trip to get it...been there and with this new trimmer, done that for the last time!). In the past I've also tried corded electric trimmers and while it eliminated the gas aspect, I hated the cord I had to drag around the yard just as much (tripping over it, breaking flower stems by dragging the cord around...).  This Black and Decker cordless battery powered trimmer/edger has enough power to do the job without the drawbacks of gas and corded electric trimmers.  It's perfect for me.

But the thing I like the most is that it's an edger and a trimmer all in one.  I love tools that have a 2-in-1 purpose, because I am more likely to trim and edge, whereas before I might trim, but since I didn't have an edger too (tried to use my previous trimmer for that which was a bust!) it never ended up getting done.

Overall, I love this edger/trimmer.  As a woman I found that the lightweight, yet powerful (enough) trimmer is perfect for what I need it for.  It eliminated several of the things I hated about my other trimmers I've tried ( fumes, gas, cords, arms getting tired, having to buy and store multiple tools and the maintenance).  While it may not be as powerful as a corded or gas powered model, this one fits my needs perfectly.  It's lightweight, much quieter, can do the job of two tools and is easy to use.  I couldn't be happier!
profile.summary: Lightweight, easy to use 2-in-1 tool that is perfect for someone who doesn't enjoy spending all day grooming my yard.

profile.description: The essential cookware set delivers striking contemporary looks with enduring performance. This Circulon Genesis Aluminum Nonstick 12-Piece Cookware Set is sure to meet those standards for every cook searching for reliably healthy and delicious results. The heavy-duty aluminum construction provides fast and even heating and the stylish porcelain exteriors are stain resistant and easy to clean. The unique TOTAL Food Release System combines PFOA-free DuPont Autograph metal utensil safe nonstick with raised circles to reduce abrasion. Long-lasting nonstick cooking surfaces resist scratching, staining and chipping and provide extraordinary food release, whether searing sesame-crusted ahi tuna steaks in the skillets or simmering whole-grain cereal in the saucepot. Stainless steel handles are double riveted for strength and the shatter-resistant glass lids allow cooking to be monitored while sealing in heat and moisture and all pieces are oven safe to 500 Degree F. Cooks can re-energize their kitchen with this fantastic 12-piece set and other pieces from the Circulon collections. Superior nonstick technology helps cooks deliver inspired, healthy dishes that earn rave reviews when cooking with this Circulon Genesis Aluminum Nonstick 12-Piece Cookware Set.
profile.reviewText:
I have an older set of Circulon that I have used for years and have loved to the point that the surfaces are scratched.  I try to be careful and use only silicone, wood, or plastic utensils, but occasionally a metal utensil is needed ( like a whisk) which tends to leave marks on the pans.  These pans had handles that were not metal.  I did use them in the oven, but only at lower temps (like 350)

I wasn't disappointed in this set either.  I like the idea of being able to use these at higher temps from stove-top to oven, but the downside to that is that the metal handles can get hot to the point where a hot-pad is necessary, but even the handles on my old set sometimes got hot too, so I'm used to using them while cooking.

The ridges on the cookware took a bit of getting used to, especially when making eggs.  You can't stir them right away otherwise they are going to get stuck in those ridges and frankly make a huge mess.  If you wait just a bit, then everything will turn out alright.  With most of my cooking the ridges are not a problem, but it seems with breakfast foods like eggs, or pancakes you have to adjust the way you cook them so as not to stick in in the nonstick ridges.

This set does say that it is not dishwasher safe, that fact didn't bother me at all as I have found that I pretty much always hand-wash my pots and pans.

All of the pans are a little on the smaller side.  I would recommend this for a family of four or smaller, and I've also found that I needed to purchase an additional large fryer pan with a lid.  I wish they would have maybe taken out the smallest frying pan, and increased the size of the 3 quart saucepan to a 12" deep fryer with a lid.  That would make this set almost perfect IMO.  Overall this is a quality set that will happily last you for years.
profile.summary: A great place to start

profile.description: U.S. Divers is the leading sporting goods snorkeling brand of Aqua Lung America. Captain Jacques Cousteau, explorer and inventor of the Aqua Lung, was the company's first Chairman of the Board. With 65 years of diving heritage, experience and passion U.S. Divers has become a water sports category leader, offering a wide range of snorkeling gear.
profile.reviewText:
I got this set for my nephew who loves to swim!  He has been progressing in his swimming lessons and using a snorkel and fins was the next step so he needed them for indoor swimming for the most part (but that could change in future).

The sizing was just right and fit as expected.  The materials seem to be of fairly good quality considering the low price.  I would say that this is more for recreational occasional use.  It's definitely better quality than what you would find at a discount retailer like Walmart, but maybe not as good as what you would find at a higher end sporting goods store, or dive shop.

If you are looking for something that your child can play with, or use occasionally then I think this is a great set to start out with.
profile.summary: A good set to begin with

profile.description: The Big Chil has big exterior pockets for your belongings. It insulates contents both hot or cold for 3 hours. It is collapsible. It has a wipe-clean PVC-free interior lining. The Hip Pod has a collapsible design that makes it easy to take everywhere. It is great for travel. The Mesh Wrap 2 Pak has a collapsible design that makes them easy to take everywhere. The (re)zip bulk is machine washable with towels and line dry. It is see-through. It replaces disposable baggies. It is made from FDA-Grade PEVA film. It is PVC Free.
profile.reviewText:
I was really excited to use this set, but after having it I find myself really only using the larger insulated bag.  Otherwise when grocery shopping I tend to like the recycled bags sold at my grocery store because they hold more, and since they are square based they fit much better into the back end of my vehicle.

There are a few things that I feel could be improved upon:

* The price.  I don't think being green necessarily has to equate to spending lots of money and at $50 I think that is expensive for what I have ended up utilizing this set for.
* The durability.  I have questions about how durable this set will be over the long haul.  Being made out of plastic I don't know that the seems will actually hold the 70 lbs it says it will.  One reviewer has had the zipper break.  This is not my experience, but I do wonder how long it will last.

What I did like:

* I loved the idea and the purpose behind the company and the products that they make.  It's fun and environmentally friendly and I love that they have tags on the inside of the items telling you how many plastic bags you save, or were used to manufacture the item saving them from the landfill.

Overall it's a good idea, but maybe not fully realized it's potential, and a bit pricey in my opinion.
profile.summary: Some Useful Items, Some Not So Much

profile.description: Experience extraordinary image quality and blockbuster performance with the bright Home Cinema 3500 projector, perfect for your living room or dedicated home theater. Offering up to 3x Brighter Colors than competitive models, Epson 3LCD projectors ensure stunning images. Featuring 2500 lumens of color brightness and 2500 lumens of white brightness - plus up to 70,000:1 contrast ratio - the Home Cinema 3500 presents 2D and unbelievable 3D entertainment. Get Full HD 1080p with exquisite, enhanced detail. And, with wide vertical and horizontal lens shift and 1.6x zoom lens, positioning is easy and flexible. The projector also includes two built-in 10 W speakers for lifelike sound.
profile.reviewText:
My BIL has had a projector for years, and says it's the only way to go.  So when we decided to setup our own home theater in the basement I thought we should give it a try, especially since it can do 3D.

I had mediocre expectations.  I like bright clear pictures, and didn't really think that this option would replace movie going for me, but I couldn't have been more wrong!  This thing is amazing.  Sure, it's not exactly cheap, but you can start with the projector and build upon it for a try cinema experience.  For now, we have this setup on a bookcase at the end of our "theater" in the basement.  Because of the placement we don't have to worry about bright light interfering with the quality of the picture.  Eventually we may mount it on the ceiling, and while the speakers that are part of the projector are fine, we decided that we would invest in surround sound too.

I won't go too much into the technical aspects of the projector, you can read that in the product description.  What I can say though is that you don't have to have a lot of technical knowledge to get this up and running.  It's fairly straight forward. Setting up a home projector was daunting to me and felt overwhelming since I basically just like to open a box and have things work, LOL.  I'm pleased to say that it was almost that easy.  I was also worried that the fan might be loud and distract from our movie experience, but that wasn't really the case at all.  I wouldn't say it was whisper quiet, but it wasn't distracting either.

The color and clarity of the images are STUNNING.  I can't even begin to tell you how amazing the picture is, compared to what I expected it to be.  I haven't tried a 3d movie yet as I don't have a 3d dvd player, but I can't wait to try it out.  It's another of our upgrades that we plan to do.

With streaming videos becoming more popular, and the outrageous cost for a family to go to the movies I'm so glad that we decided to get the Epson Home Cinema.  I can see that our family will get lots of use out of this and end up saving money.

I'll update the post once we are able to try a 3-D movie.
profile.summary: A True Home Cinema is Easy to Get with This Projector

profile.description: The attractive Bistro Stand Mixer is a handsome addition to any kitchen. A powerful 700-watt, 7 speed motor delivers up to twice the power of traditional stand mixers to tackle all your mixing needs. It features large, stainless steel mixing bowls with a rubber-covered handle for easy pouring and carrying. The splash-guard can be removed effortlessly and has a funnel attachment for easy addition of ingredients while operating. Attachments include a beater, a whisk and a non-stick dough hook. Additional attachments are sold separately. Easy to use with a lift-assist mixer head which locks into place and a rotating attachment head which maximizes mixing.
profile.reviewText: My trusty Kitchen Aid mixer stopped working and I didn't know if it was going to be worth fixing or if I should just get a new stand mixer. I had the Kitchen Aid for approximately 10 years, and while that is a long time and I do use it frequently, I felt that it should have lasted longer. I've heard of the Bodum brand and it is quite popular in Europe so I decided to give it a whirl. It came very well packaged and I was excited to use it. It came with three attachments, a hook, a paddle and a whisk. It sits quite a bit shorter than the Kitchen Aid stand mixer so it did fit under the upper cabinets on my kitchen counter. However, when I tried to tilt the head all of the way up I found that I did have to pull it out a small bit to get it to open all of the way. It's not a light mixer, and it does have suction cups on the bottom so it made it cumbersome. For reasons unknown to me the top of the mixer is made of clear plastic. You don't actually see parts moving, and it doesn't open to store the attachments so I don't know what purpose it actually serves. I don't like that it is made of plastic. The casing of my Kitchenaid is all metal. The bowl snaps in securely which is nice. The pour shield which they say is optional is different in that it securely attaches to the top head of the mixer, so that when you pop the top the lid goes with it. Here's what I liked: * It did the job I needed it to do. *I liked that the pour shield secures to the top of the machine and that the hole to put in ingredients is just big enough. It would keep little fingers safely away from the moving parts when on. *You have to turn it on, as well as turn the dial before the mixer will start. Here's what I didn't like: *Even at the lowest speed to incorporate the flour into the mixture. This mixer starts out at a higher speed then slows down. I didn't think I needed to use the shield while making cookies, and it was a HUGE mistake. I had flour everywhere at the lowest speed. Word of caution, I would ALWAYS use the shield when making anything with this mixer no matter the speed you are using. * I used the paddle attachment when making the dough and had to constantly stop it to scrap the sides of the bowl, because the attachment turned and mixed and left about a 1/2" perimeter on the edge that it doesn't even tough. Most mixers get closer than that including my Kitchenaid without the paddle that has the scraper attached to it. While making cookie dough it was just an inconvenience, but if you were whipping egg whites or something like that it could cause you problems. * There are a lot of plastic parts to this. For instance the top of it, and the turn dial to control the speed. I didn't like the turn dial off to the side as it made it hard to see what speed I needed and it is harder to keep clean than if it was just a slide handle like on the Kitchenaid. *Parts of the outside have a rubbery feel to it with little nobs. Not really sure what purpose they serve except for making gripping it or just that it looks cool, but what I do know what that it was a nightmare to clean up. You have to get in between each of those little nubs to clean the surface if you aren't a clean baker. I much prefer the smooth surface of the Kitchaid it is much easier to clean up *At first I thought that the mixer was defective because when I turned the speed dial it didn't do anything. Unlike the Kitchenaid which just requires you to slide the speed lever to the on position, there is a on/off switch on the back that you have to turn on before it will do anything. This is both good and bad. Good in that little ones won't turn it on when you are not ready by turning the dial, but also bad in that it's all the way at the back and not easy to get to unless you slide it out. All in all, is the Bodum mixer good? It was pretty good. I think they thought more about the "look" of the design rather than some of the functionality. Why the paddle doesn't get closer to the slides is a big minus for me. I also felt that it probably wouldn't last 10 years with all of the plastic parts. It was much harder to clean, and I didn't like how the motor started fast, then slowed down to the speed you selected. In the end, I gave this to my sister and got my Kitchenaid fixed for $50, and it's like new again. If you are going to spend several hundred dollars for a stand mixer this would not be my first choice, maybe not even my second. It will do the job, but not as well as some other options for the same $$ or maybe even less. For my money I would buy even the lowest model Kitchenaid. You can get more attachements, and if your's happens to break after years of repeated use, you can have it fixed fairly inexpensively. KitchenAid KSM75WH Classic Plus Tilt-Head 4-1/2-Quart Stand Mixer, White.
profile.summary: I'll stick with my Kitchen Aid...

profile.description: Fellowes is proud to introduce The Softest Place Your Wrists Can Rest with the new PlushTouch Wrist Rests. This product features the innovative new FoamFusion Technology that provides superior comfort to help relieve wrist pressure. Microban antimicrobial protection keeps the product cleaner. Non-skid backing keeps wrist support in place. Soft breathable material withstands daily wear and tear.
profile.reviewText:
I spend many hours every day on the computer and really do fear carpal tunnel syndrome so I decided to get this gel pad to reduce the strain on my wrists.  In the past I've gotten the wrist pad for a mouse from the same company, but had a hard time adjusting to it so I stopped using it altogether.  Despite that I wanted to give the wrist pad for the keyboard a try.

When I received the package it was a bit cumbersome to get out of the packaging and actually cut myself trying to get it out of the stiff plastic.  I don't know why they couldn't just package it in a box instead of the molded plastic.  Then when I finally got it out I was assaulted with a very chemically smell that was very strong.  So strong I almost decided to pitch it without even using it.  After almost a week the smell dissipated to where it was mostly unnoticeable so I was able to finally give it a try.  Caution:  If you are a person who is sensitive to chemical smells, then I would seriously reconsider buying this product for this factor alone.

The foam wrist pad itself is very comfortable.  It's supportive without being hard and has the perfect amount of give to it.  However, if you have an ergonomic keyboard, like I used to, this wrist pad will sit up higher than the edge of the keyboard which isn't very comfortable at all.  Or if you use a cooling pad for your laptop, which makes the base of the laptop sit up higher, then the wrist pad is too low to be of any benefit.  In essence, even though it is comfortable, it may or may not provide the relief that you are looking for with a wrist pad like this unless the 1" height is right where you need it.  I unfortunately didn't think about checking this out before ordering it.

The design is pleasing, but I'm not quite sure why the left side is wider than the right.  The base of the product does have a gel like finish to it that sticks to the surface of your table quite well, while still being able to adjust it easily.  It doesn't move around on you when you type, which I do like.  I've readjusted mine a few times and found that it picks up any dust particles that might be on the surface like a magnet, which reduces how well it sticks.  This is easily remedied by cleaning the surface with a wet rag.  However, this does tend to increase the odor that I mentioned earlier.  It seems as though the offensive odor has something to do with the non skid surface on the back of the product.

I was eager to give this product a try, and even though I can see that it has it's benefits, the design prohibits it from being universally useful to all keyboards or laptops.  I would definitely make sure that the 1" height is what you need before purchasing.  In addition the smell of the product is severely off-putting.  If the non skid backing is the culprit, then the manufacturer should seriously reconsider their options to achieve this attribute without offensive odor.  I can't attest to how well the microban protection works.  Overall I can only recommend it with reservations.
profile.summary: Nice Feel, but Strong Chemical Odor...May Not Be For Everyone

profile.description: A beloved tradition for more than 25 years, the 2016 Holiday Barbie doll rings in the wonder of the holidays and all the joyous festivities. Dressed in a beautiful aqua ombre sparkle skirt with detailed bodice and bracelet, Holiday Barbie doll has the perfect glamorous look that will shine bright all season long. Specially designed packaging is ideal for gift-giving and sure to make 2016 Holiday Barbie a treasured keepsake for years to come. Happy holidays! For ages 6 and over.
profile.reviewText:
I have been purchasing these collectible dolls as presents for the holidays for several years now, and I think this has to be my favorite holiday Barbie.  I love the shimmery fabric of the skirt and the snowflake pattern on the bodice. My only downside is that both of her arms are bent, and are not flexible.  I have one little one that doesn't like bent arms because it makes getting some clothing hard to get on and off.  That won't be the case with this dress, but I can foresee problems with other Barbie clothing with sleeves.

I appreciate that over the course of the last couple of years the price for the holiday Barbies have remained consistent.  I appreciate that the Barbie brand is trying to represent their consumers, and I also like that while she evolves with the times, she's still essentially the same.  This dress is so beautiful in the colors that are shown on the blond doll, I'm not quite sure why they felt the need to change the colors of the dresses with the ethnicity of the Barbie.  (Blonde the turquoise, Hispanic has a red dress, and the African American has a blue dress).  I think all of them would have looked beautiful in this design and I particularly love the packaging....like they are inside a snow globe.

Overall though it's a gift that I'm sure the girls that I bought them for are going to love, more for the gown than the actual Barbie doll, and they will play with them and love doing her hair even though they are considered a collectible ;)
profile.summary: Stunning Holiday Barbie for 2016!

profile.description: Food science is real science  and it tastes good. What better way to get kids to take an interest in what they eat than to teach them the science behind the food? Be Amazing! Toys Dr. Dessert does just that. The kit includes recipes and components for six amazing food recipes including chocolate cake, a bubbling beverage, fruit juice gelatin, ice cream and a popsicle ring. Note that you supply the food ingredients, the kit supplies the science. Several experiments go along with each recipe building on the science principles being taught. Kids learn about polymers, acids and bases, carbonation, states of being and more.
profile.reviewText:
I subscribe to a mail order craft & science kit for my niece called Kiwi Crates designed for ages 3-6.  I love them. They are fantastic.  The instructions are always clear, she loves when they come in the mail.  She learns something and has fun while doing it.  The best part.....it comes with absolutely everything that you will need to do the crafts.  Everything.  And it's quality products as well.  You get your money's worth down to the penny with the Kiwi Crates.  I can't recommend them enough.  But the Be Amazing Toys Dr. Dessert Kit is entirely different.

You get the impression that this kit is all about science and food, but in reality it's a collection of instructions where you can make the food described on the box, but you have to supply all of the necessary items to do the project.  What comes in the box are just a few very cheap plastic bits to do other experiments.  And while there are sheets that give good scientific information it was less than engaging.  There was more work than fun in this science experiment kit.  I wouldn't buy this again, and I wouldn't seek out any more BE AMAZING TOYS products.  I'm still in search of something that is of the same quality and price as the Kiwi Crates, but for ages 8+.
profile.summary: Be Amazing Toys aren't really that amazing :(

profile.description: Dyson digital motor V6 2 Tier Radial Cyclone technology The latest motorized head with carbon fiber filaments Mini motorized tool **To prove this our engineers test for pick up performance across carpets (ASTM F608), hard floors (ASTM F2607) and hard floors with crevices (IEC 60312-1 5.2). To mimic actual use, they load machines with dust before testing (IEC 60312 1 5.9).
profile.reviewText:
I've been a convert to Dyson vaccums for many years.  Every time I use my full size Dyson vacuum I am amazed at how much dirt it sucks up.  One thing I didn't enjoy was hauling it out for quick touch-ups, or trying to vaccum the stairs with it.  And being left handed I was always cursing the placement of the cord.  You wouldn't think it would matter, but it's always bothered me.  With this cordless vac, I get the ease and convenience for touchups & even better no cords to wrangle!  Love that :)

Some things I did find after using it many times:

The hand held unit gets hot after using it for several minutes.
The Charge lasts about 15-30 min of use and is great for touchups, but I don't know if I would recommend it for primary use.
Great for doing stairs, sucking up bugs and spiders, and makes it much easider to clean vents up high, and to reach cob webs.
I find that I use this practically daily for touch-ups, but use my traditional dyson vacum for weekly cleanings.
While it does say that it has as much suction power as a regular vacuum, I don't feel that that is necessarily true.  That being said, it does have great suction power, and is the best handheld cordless vac I've every used.

Empyting the canister is like other dyson vacs, but unlike other dyson vacs the canister doesn't come completely apart for cleaning.  Ocassionally dust will collect up to the top and it's hard to get out.  I had to get a special brush to sweep up in the canister to get the rest of the residue out.  I've only had to do this a couple of times, but I wish the canister would either come apart like the other dyson I have, or it would have come with a brush to get the gunk out.

I also love how easy it is to change out the tools.  With the press of a button, and a click and you are ready to go with any of the tools it comes with, or the extra accessories you can buy.  Another plus is that it comes with a wall mount that stores the tools so they are always at hand when you need them.  They sell an accessory tool kit, but I've found that I don't really need it.  It came with the tools that I've found are useful to the cleaning that I do with this vacuum.

Overall, another great product from Dyson!
profile.summary: Easy to use, no cords & great suction power.  Win, win, win!

profile.description: The GreenPan Rio collection brings a touch of color to your kitchen. The 7" Ceramic Non-Stick Open Frypan in Black is complete with our Thermolon healthy ceramic non-stick coating for an impressively easy release every time you cook. Rio offers you a tasteful mix of optimal heat distribution and 100% cooking and cleaning convenience. After all, GreenPan quality also extends to the details, from the stay-cool Bakelite handle to the heat-retaining base. Complete with a limited lifetime warranty for worry-free cooking.
profile.reviewText:
I've also used traditional nonstick coating pans, but my sister has a ceramic pan and loves it ( a different brand).  After reading how bad the traditional non stick coating can be for you, as well as wanting to cut down on the amount of saturated fats and cooking sprays we use I thought I would finally try out the ceramic coqt d cooking pan when my old one had seen better days.

I tried cooking an egg with it first and was absolutely amazed at how well the ceramic nonstick coating works.  I used absolutely NO cooking spray and it slid right out of the pan.  It was fabulous!  I've attached sed it several times since with the same results.  Nothing sticks, cleans up so easily.  I love it!  It cooks evenly, and has a comfortable handle that doesn't get hot to touch.

The only drawback I've had is that it's a relatively shallow pan so when I cook vegetables or something that I stir often I sometimes have things slide off the edges and out of the pan because the nonstick coating works so well.  I will be replacing all of my pans with the ceramic coated ones as my old ones wear out.  These are great and worth every penny.
profile.summary: I love ceramic!  A healthier nonstick way to cook.

profile.description: Unique architectural elements can make a room come alive, and Notch kitchen and bar pulldown faucets have the form and function to deliver this focal point confidently. The 45-degree slant of the handle creates a unique presence, while supple, gentle lines give it a versatile transitional style.
profile.reviewText:
I'm always impressed with the quality of Moen's products.  This is the second faucet of theirs that I have and I love the quality, craftsmanship, and style.

The only complaint that I have is that this faucet needs a single hole sink.  I had planned on getting a new sink when replacing the faucet anyways, but after doing some shopping at my local improvement stores I found that these sinks are special order and MUCH more expensive than the usual three hole sinks.  I found that you can order a plate to cover the extra holes and use a sink that is stock, but I think the plate should be automatically included in the kit since sinks with multiple holes seem to be the standard.  I hate that I was all excited to get this installed, but ran into the issue of ordering parts before that can happen.  If they would have included the plate to cover the extra holes this would be a solid five star product.
profile.summary: Great quality, fantastic style...may need to order extra parts before installing

profile.description: Automatically detects and purifiers the air. Certified asthma and allergy friendly by the Asthma and Allergy Foundation of America Utilizes a True HEPA Filter With Antimicrobial Treatment to safely remove 99.97% of airborne particles including pollen, ragweed & other allergens, viruses, germs, dust mites, mold spores & cigarette smoke. Includes special high performance mode for allergy, cold and flu seasons. Carbon filter reduces odors from a 300 to 600 square foot area.
profile.reviewText:
I have absolutely terrible allergies, and this year they seemed to be worse than they have the last few years, which is why I decided to get the Fellowes AeraMax Air Purifier, that and the fact that it claims to filter out the flu virus.  I have a seven year old, and a 8 mos old in the house and I am very concerned that the 8 mos old might get the flu so I am hoping that this little beauty lives up to it's claim.

First, it was very well packaged.  Everything arrived safely and was easy to unpack and setup.  It probably took less than 5 mins to get it from the box, to having it plugged in and working.  I initially thought I would put it in the bedroom, but it was actually quite a bit larger than I expected it to be.  Yes, I know, the dimensions are listed in the description, but I didn't really pay attention to that part.  Based on the picture I thought it would be more like a table top purifier, but it definitely is much larger than that, so I placed in the family room.

I keep it plugged in all the time, and for the most part when the light is blue, you can't even hear it cycle the air.  When we open the front door it often turns orange, or red, and runs at the speed it needs to to clean the air quickly.  I have the fan set on auto so that the purifier itself determines how high the fan needs to run.  I've noticed that I don't have to take my allergies pills as often as I did prior to having the purifier and for that alone I think this is worth every penney.

I couldn't be more pleased with this product and I highly recommend it.  It leaves the air clean, without odors, and once you plug it in, you don't have to do anything else to it except for maybe changing the filters (which I haven't had to do yet).

p.s. if you want this in your bedroom the blue lights might bother you.  If they do, then you may want to try using black electrical tape over a few of the lights.  I don't mind the fan noise (when you can hear it) because even on high it's fairly quiet and more like white noise.  I honestly don't even notice when it's running anymore, even when it's on high.
profile.summary: What's not to love?

profile.description: Create your own jungle adventures with this soft activity book. Smiling giraffe and turtle finger puppets pop through cutouts on each page, allowing parents to interact with baby. Safari scenes, tuggable details and a handy strap offer unlimited ways to play.
profile.reviewText:
I've purchased a few Skip Hop products before.  Some have been really good, others have been a big disappointment.  This soft book kind of falls in between.  The idea is cute, but it doesn't really hold my 11 mos old nieces attention.

I thought this soft book would be a big hit and couldn't wait to give it to my 11 mos old niece.  She loves puppet books (Itsy Bitsy Spider is a fav, along with Curious George).  She loves teethers.  She loves the soft books with flaps and crinkles.  This book has all of that.  It should have been a sure thing...but for some reason she doesn't play with it at all.

I love that it has a loop that you can attach it to a car seat or stroller, and that it can be washed

The colors and graphics are cute, but it only has one center flap, so I guess you could say it has 4 "pages".  Most of the pages are just soft.  One flap on the tree is crinkle.  The animals have textured fabric, but everything else is smooth.  I wish the book would have had more fabric textures on the inside pages.

I would say that the biggest drawback...at least for me is that the puppets are spaced awkwardly for my hands and makes it hard to animate the giraffe and turtle at the same time.  I do have smaller hands, so that may be part of the reason I have problems with it, but the finger holes aren't terribly large.  As a result I don't know how larger fingers (men's) may fit.

Overall, I liked the potential of this soft activity book then the reality of it.  The puppets are awkward.  It only has one internal page.  The textures are limited and it just isn't interesting to my 11 mos old niece.  She prefers the other two soft books that  I have to this one, and the three other puppet books I have for her, which is a shame because I had high hopes for this one :(  Especially since it was by far the most expensive of all of them.
profile.summary: Cute Idea, but not a Favorite

profile.description: With updated modern styling featuring clean horizontal lines, the Moen Rizon Faucet is a sophisticated upgrade for your bath. The lever handle with red and blue markings allows for effortless control of the water temperature and the water volume, and the aerated flow is ideal for everyday bathroom tasks. The mirror-like chrome finish works with any bathroom style, and the one-hole mount construction creates a cleaner look against custom countertops. Backed by Moen's Limited Lifetime Warranty and certified to meet EPA WaterSense standards, the Moen Rizon Faucet brings dependable and efficient performance to your bathroom.
profile.reviewText:
This is just a faucet right?  True, but I have to admit that I think this thing is like a work of art.  Design, function, craftsmanship...it's all here in this fantastic faucet.  I feel kind of silly getting so excited over something like this, but I absolutely love it.

It is a bit pricey, but it so far out surpasses the other cheaper models that only wish they were this one that it is worth the price.  Another thing that I love is that it is MADE IN THE USA.  I love that almost as much as I love the faucet.  I had a single handle faucet with a chrome finish that was installed when the house was built but after a couple of years the finish started to wear off (and this was in a spare bathroom that didn't get as much use).  I decided to replace it and wanted something with a single handle that was modern, but that would still fit into the not so modern look of the rest of the bathroom.  This faucet was a perfect fit and was exactly what I wanted.

It is made of quality components, is very well packaged, easy to install and comes with all that you will need for installation.  As a woman who is only slightly handy I really appreciate that.  I recommend this faucet very highly.  I plan to replace my other bathroom faucet with this one as well.
profile.summary: but I have to admit that I think this thing is like a work of art

profile.description: Press it down and watch it go. The press and go kitty is the perfect tool to support gross motor development in crawlers and walkers. The easy -to-grasp kitty speeds across the floor with one simple push. Just press down on the center of the kitty and let it go.
profile.reviewText:
I've purchased Manhattan Toys before and have generally been very happy with them.  This toy is no exception.

This toy is well designed, and will work on hardwood, tile, and carpeted floors.  I don't have super plush carpet, but I think this will probably work on most carpets as long as it isn't shag.  The toy is hard to push down to get it to go, and is one of the things that I wish were better, but you can push it and it will roll without using the spring mechanism which is what my little ones do when they play with it by themselves.

I love that it rolls at a nice easy pace, so if it runs into something (walls, baseboards, furniture) you don't have to worry about it leaving a mark/dent.  I also love that it doesn't make noise, and doesn't take batteries.  I think kids today can sometimes be overstimulated with all of the flashing lights and sounds that a lot of toys make.  This toy holds their attention just as long, if not longer than most.  My 7 year old niece loves playing with this and getting it go for her younger 10 mos old sister.  The 10 mos old can't take her eyes off of it when it's moving.  She follows it around with her eyes, and crawls after it as well.

Overall it's a hit, but I am trying to transition away from toys that don't say that they are BPA, phthalates, PVC free.  Especially when they are made in China.  I wish this toy was made of plastic like the Green Toys brand are, or even better made of wood that was non toxic.  Since the packaging didn't say it was "free" of these chemicals I can only assume that it's possible that they do contain them and that does worry me.  Finally, it's doesn't have frustration free packaging :(

Because it's hard to push down for a child,  and I don't know if the plastic is toxic or not I had to give it three stars even though the kiddos enjoy playing with it.
profile.summary: Many things could make this toy better

profile.description: The Imation LINK Power Drive lets you move and store data to free up storage space on your iPhone or iPod touch. The drive also lets you restore battery life so you'll stay connected longer and be able to backup photos, videos and files wherever you go.
profile.reviewText:
Link to the rescue!  I love this little gadget.  It was very simple to use, takes up very little space, does it's job well and solves my storage issue.  You can't ask for more in my opinion!

I'm not one to go out and buy the latest device.  If mine is in working order, then I consider my phone just fine.  My phone is a workhorse and the longer I have it the more uses I find for it :)  Because of that I seem to be running out of storage and this little beauty helped me solve my problem without having to upgrade my phone.

It may not be for some who like the latest and greatest, but I really really like it.  I liked it so much that I got one for my sister too.
profile.summary: A Simple, Efficient Problem Solver

top_5.description: Power PDF is the most dynamic, mobile and easy-to-use PDF product that Nuance has ever created. It boasts Windows 10 touch-enabled support on laptop and tablet devices like the Microsoft Surface. Your productivity will soar in the office or on the go. You can collaborate like never before using connectivity to popular cloud services, signing, certifying and protecting your documents from unwanted access. Always be prepared to publish perfect PDF content that is truly accessible and optimized on the web, by email or no matter how you choose to share your work. Power PDF is the most secure and compatible way to read, create, edit and convert your documents and forms with surprising accuracy. It’s the smarter way to work with PDFs at a value that can’t be beaten.
top_5.reviewText:
I am a frugal buyer, but whatever I buy I like it to work, and work well.

I've been using free PDF creators that are available on line (CutePDF writer, and Open Office) for years and have been relatively happy with them. After all they are free, so you can't expect all of Adobe Acrobat capabilities.  I wanted to have the ability to edit PDF and a few other options that I couldn't do with the other free programs so I decided to give Power PDF a try.  It seemed like it would give me exactly what I needed without having to spend major $$$ for Adobe Acrobat.

I was able to successfully install the program and use it with relative ease.  Frankly I found that the free versions were easier and less cumbersome to use, but decided I would use this program anyways because of linking to the cloud.  That was a very attractive feature of the program for me as I already store a lot in my Google Drive.  What I didn't know at the time that I got the program was that it has limited capabilities because the technology to send it to the cloud isn't owned by Nuance, but licensed from another company.  I've exceeded my limit, when I didn't even know there was a limit.  It doesn't say anything about a limit on the product features on Amazon.  If I want to continue to use this feature I have to buy an upgrade.  I did not expect this, nor do I feel that I should have to pay even more for a feature that is listed as a selling feature.

For that reason alone I removed one star.  This product works, with some features that I can't do with a free version, but honestly if it doesn't sync like I wanted it to I have a feeling that I will use the free versions for most everything since they are easier to use, and only use the Power PDF by Nuance for when I need to do something that the free versions can't.  I thought that this would be a one stop solution for me and it turns out that this is just one step up from free, but no where near Adobe Acrobat.  Granted there is a huge $$ difference between the two, but I don't really feel that this product is worth almost $100 list price.
top_5.summary: On the Fence, product description not 100% accurate

top_5.description: Sage 50 Pro Accounting 2013 has just what you need for your expanding business. With easy-to-use accounting features, you can pay bills and get paid, plus, you get tools to help you control cash flow and manage employees. Automate invoices and checks, record customer payments, track sales and inventory, and more. Plus, Sage 50 Pro Accounting comes with Sage Business Care*, an auto-renewing program that provides automatically delivered upgrades, access to customer support, online training, installation support, customized reporting, and more. You will save time and money, and accomplish more every day with Sage 50 Pro Accounting.
top_5.reviewText:
I started a small business last year and I kept completely awful records.  AWFUL.  So when it came to doing taxes it was a complete nightmare.  I'm a one man(woman) show and expected this year to be better than last year, so I thought that I should start fresh this year and actually keep accounting so I got the Sage 50.

My first impression, is that this is WAY more robust than what I actually need and find that it takes more time for me to try and get the hang of using this software to be beneficial for me.  It's not that I have trouble learning how to use new software, but for the business that I have I have very few out of pocket expenses, so I've found myself using an Excel spreadsheet because it's extremely quick and accessible and is saved in the cloud (so that if my computer crashes I still have all of my data).  Whereas launching the software and trying to input the information correctly takes more time than frankly I am willing to give to the process right now.

In the end, this program is just way more than I need, and unfortunately will take more time to setup correctly and learn how to use than I am willing to give to it.  If you have multiple employees (which I don't), and need to setup customer accounts, track accounts receivable and payable then the Sage Pro is probably exactly what you need, it just wasn't for me.  Technically speaking I didn't have any problems with it, but then again I barely scratched the surface of it's usability.
top_5.summary: Maybe Easy to Use For People Who Know What They Are Doing

top_5.description: Your home is more than a house, its the daily moments and experiences you share that make it uniquely you. At Ashley Furniture, we celebrate being home with you. We are passionate about being the best and most affordable furniture providers for your home. Rooms are meant for living and dreaming. Helping you furnish your home inspires us in everything we do. From designing collections and products around the latest trends, to looking for ways to reduce costs.
top_5.reviewText:
I've purchased other pieces of furniture online before.  A lot of it arrived damaged or broken, but not this chair!  It arrived quickly and the delivery service called a day in advance to make sure someone would be home during the delivery time.  The delivery service arrived within the window time frame they gave me.

The chair was packed in a large box that was on a skid.  They took the box and skid off the truck and placed it in the garage.  I asked them to take the skid with them so that I wouldn't have to find a way to dispose of it.  Inside the box the chair was wrapped in plastic and had padding around it.

The chair was fairly easy to move inside.  It's a nice size that it's more than comfortable to sit in, but not so oversized that it makes it hard to maneuver through doorways etc.  The legs come packaged and you have to put them on the chair, but that was super easy to do.  Putting the cushion on, and attaching the legs are the only things that you have to assemble.

You may think that since the chair is something that you ordered online that the quality of the chair would be inferior.  Nothing could be further from the truth.  This chair seems to be the same quality of one you would buy at your local furniture store.  Sturdy, comfortable and stylish.

I love the pattern of the fabric.  It looks exactly like it does in the picture.  One thing I especially like about this chair is that the arms aren't bulky and that it sits relatively high.  Which is great for someone that is taller, or who has a hard time getting out of chairs that sit lower to the ground.  It has a nice firm back that makes it comfortable to sit in for longer periods of time.  I'm even more impressed with the seat cushion.  It holds its shape and doesn't flatten to nothing when you sit in it while still remaining cushy.

Overall I can't express enough at how happy I am with this chair.  From delivery to how it sits its perfect.
top_5.summary: Sturdy, comfortable and stylish

top_5.description: High-Performance Vacuum - Great for Homes with Pets LET IT RUN. YOUR WORK IS DONE. While you do other things, Neato Botvac vacuums dirt, crumbs and dust bunnies from all floor types and every corner of your home. Ideal for pet owners and allergy sufferers.
top_5.reviewText:
I was somewhat ambivalent about using a Robot Vacuum.  My aunt has a Roomba and wanted to take it back to the store after a week, but couldn't.  As a result I've held off on trying one.  I've never had one before so I have no knowledge of previous models, or other brands.  My review is based solely on my experience with this beautiful piece of machinery.

* I was a bit intimated by the prospect of programming the bot, but found that it wasn't as bad as I had anticipated
* I was also a bit worried about when to run it, or if it ran during the day that it would get in the way, it doesn't

I wish the dust bin was bigger, but I guess if they did that it wouldn't be able to fit under some of the spaces that it currently does.  I love that it will recharge itself, and then start up where it left off.  I love that it works on both my tile and carpet.  Could I live without it....yes.  Do I want to....no ;)

The Neato is expensive, but if you hate vacuuming like I do, and have dust allergies where you want to get under furniture and keep the dust to a minimum then this little beauty may be the answer to your prayers!
top_5.summary: I have some deep love for my Botvac!

Each knife features a blade forged from top-quality Japanese stainless steel and stone-finished with a fine taper-ground edge for exceptional cutting performance. Use the versatile 8-inch chef knife to trim and slice meats, mince onions and chop freshly picked carrots and celery. Featuring Anolon(r) SureGrip(r) technology, the silicone-grip handles on these gourmet-quality knives are constructed for comfortable, reliable grasp in the hand. Full bolsters elegantly connect blades and handles and the knives are finished with stainless steel end caps for balance. Sturdy plastic fitted sheaths help protect the blades between uses and this gourmet specialty knife set makes a great complement to other quality cutlery and kitchenware in the Anolon(r) collection. Your creative kitchen deserves the finest cut and your gourmet knives are in hand with the beautiful, long-lasting Anolon(r) SureGrip(r) Cutlery 3-Piece Japanese Stainless Steel Chef Knife Set.
top_5.reviewText:
I have a whole drawer full of knives, but ever since getting these three knives I don't need the others any more.

The handles are very comfortable and the knives themselves are SUPER SHARP they cut through just about anything with very little effort.  They have some weight to them and are easy to control.
